### [1] [Counting Events, Not Seeing Them: Diagnosing and Repairing the Readout Failure in Video LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09949)
*Dongwu Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 视频大模型在"物体反复出入画面"的计数任务上表现很差，常被归因为缺乏物体永久性（object permanence）。本文用可构造、标签经独立校验的合成测试床表明：计数信号其实存在，只是"读不出来"——线性探针能以93%解码逐窗口的物体在场，而全局计数解码退化为时长混淆。作者提出两种面向读出端的修复（情节定位监督、离散事件符号侧信道），在7B–30B系统上把同物计数从46.7%提升至65.0%（上限66.7%，随机33%）。该方法可零成本迁移到独立工厂，并通过审计测量装置发现四类数据完整性缺陷。真实视频基准REALCOUNT（n=18，盲审）显示该边界依然存在（最好55.6% vs 随机33.3%），符号零样本迁移失败；1轮域内适配为负结果（六种手段28–50%），但3轮调度表明符号通道受限于预算不足：在序列不相交的oracle时间线下读者可达94.4%，使用部署检测器时间线时2轮即达72.2%。残余差距源于检测器证据质量及读者对检测器噪声的匹配，而非读者容量：冻结特征边界探针显示信号弱（AUC 0.62，置换对照0.51）且跨片段不可迁移（片内0.77 vs 跨窗0.62）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频大模型在计数物体穿越屏幕次数上显著失败，普遍被归因于缺少物体永久性表征。作者质疑这一归因是否完整：若计数信号其实已在表征中存在、只是下游读出失败，那么现有解释与改进方向都会偏离真正的瓶颈。因此需要建立标签可靠、可独立验证的测试床，区分"表征缺失"与"读出缺失"，并检验该失败是否可修复、能否迁移到真实视频。

Method: （1）构建construction-grounded合成测试床，标签独立校验，用于区分表征与读出；（2）用线性探针分别解码逐窗口物体在场与全局计数，检验时长混淆；（3）提出两种读出端修复：情节局部化监督（episode-localization supervision）与离散事件符号侧信道（discrete event-symbol side channel），在7B–30B系统上评测；（4）迁移实验：跨独立工厂零成本迁移、符号零样本迁移；（5）对测量装置做数据完整性审计；（6）真实视频盲审基准REALCOUNT（n=18）；（7）1轮与3轮域内适配实验，比较oracle时间线与部署检测器时间线；（8）冻结特征边界探针，含置换对照与片内/跨窗迁移对比。

Result: 逐窗口在场线性探针解码达93%，而全局计数解码塌缩为时长混淆；两种读出端修复将同物计数从46.7%提升至65.0%（oracle 66.7%，随机33%）。迁移到独立工厂零成本。审计测量装置发现四类数据完整性缺陷，此前掩盖了边界所在。REALCOUNT上边界仍存在（最佳55.6% vs 随机33.3%），符号零样本迁移失败。1轮域内适配为负（六种手段28–50%）；3轮调度显示该限制属预算不足：序列不相交oracle时间线下读者达94.4%，部署检测器时间线下2轮达72.2%。冻结特征探针AUC 0.62（置换对照0.51），片内0.77 vs 跨窗0.62，说明信号弱且不跨片段迁移。

Conclusion: 将视频大模型的计数失败简单归因于"缺失物体永久性"并不完整：计数信号确实存在但未被读出，失败更多位于读出端与检测器证据质量，而非读者容量本身。该失败在合成与真实视频上均可通过读出端修复部分缓解，且修复可迁移；但真实场景仍受检测器时间线噪声与读者—噪声匹配程度的约束。研究同时提示，此类结论高度依赖测量装置的数据完整性，需对基准与管线做严格审计。

Abstract: Video LLMs fail conspicuously at counting how many times an object crosses the screen, a failure attributed to missing object permanence. Using construction-grounded synthetic testbeds with independently validated labels, we show this attribution is incomplete: the count signal is present but unread - linear probes decode per-window presence at 93% while global count decoding collapses to a duration confound. Concurrent work reports the same representation-output dissociation for repetition counting; we show that in exit-and-reappear event counting it is repairable: two readout-directed repairs (episode-localization supervision and a discrete event-symbol side channel) raise same-object counting from 46.7% to 65.0% (oracle 66.7%) on a chance-33% benchmark across 7B-30B systems. Transfer to an independent factory costs nothing, and an audit of the measurement apparatus exposes four data-integrity failures that had obscured the boundary. A real-video audit (REALCOUNT, n=18, blind-audited) shows the boundary persists - best 55.6% at chance 33.3% - and symbol transfer fails zero-shot. A 1-epoch in-domain adaptation bench is negative (six levers at 28-50%), but a 3-epoch schedule shows this is budget-limited for the symbol channel: with a 3-epoch schedule and sequence-disjoint oracle timelines the reader reaches 94.4% on REALCOUNT, and with the deployed detector's timelines a 2-epoch run reaches 72.2%. The residual gap is detector evidence and the reader's match to detector noise, not reader capacity: a frozen-feature boundary probe finds the signal weak (AUC 0.62 over a 0.51 permutation control) and non-transferring across clips (0.77 within-clip vs. 0.62 across windows).

</details>


### [2] [Video-DCI: How Far Are VLM Agents from Human Viewers in Direct Video Corpus Interaction?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09951)
*Garry Yang,Yuqiao Liu,Hao Lin,Luohao Pan,Xinru Chen,Wanqi Ren,Zhikang Xu,Yizhan Huang,Huaixiao Tou,James Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Video-DCI 诊断基准与人类-智能体可比协议（DCI-Loc 定位、DCI-QA 端到端跨视频证据发现），用于研究多轮视频证据检索；实验发现普遍的“检索-落地”落差：前沿 VLM 能暴露相关片段但难以转化为精确引用，且该损失在多视频场景中更早出现并不断累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类回答复杂视觉问题时会反复查看短片段、更新认知并重新分配注意力，但现有视频基准要么直接给出相关视频、要么只评估最终答案或孤立定位、或允许文本捷径，导致"多轮视觉证据寻求"这一关键能力缺乏系统性考察。

Method: 构建 Video-DCI 诊断基准及与人类功能对齐的智能体协议，实现直接视频语料交互。含两部分：DCI-Loc 评测时间证据定位；DCI-QA 评测跨视频证据的发现、保留与组合——每个视频池内主题相关，但答案需要来自多视频的隐藏时间证据，人/智能体仅凭问题与视频池，迭代检视有限局部窗口、保留证据并以带引用时间跨度作答；同时用人类轨迹作为各轮证据获取与使用的参考曲线。并做消融分析。

Result: 各模型表现出稳定的"检索—落地"落差：DCI-Loc 上前沿 VLM 往往能检索并暴露参考时刻，但能转化为精确最终引用的比例远低于人类；DCI-QA 上这种损失出现得更早并在跨视频过程中累积。消融表明迭代搜索优于一次性检索。

Conclusion: 多轮检索是必要但不充分的：当前智能体更擅长累积候选与观察，而不擅长收敛到精确且联合充分的证据；未来需在证据筛选与联合充分性判断上改进。

Abstract: Humans answer complex visual questions by inspecting short moments, updating what they know, and redirecting attention toward missing evidence. Existing video benchmarks, however, often provide the relevant video, evaluate only final answers or isolated localization, or permit textual shortcuts, leaving multi-round visual evidence seeking underexplored. We introduce Video-DCI, a diagnostic benchmark and functionally matched human-agent protocol for Direct Video-Corpus Interaction. It comprises DCI-Loc for temporal evidence localization and DCI-QA for end-to-end discovery, retention, and composition of cross-video evidence. In DCI-QA, videos within each pool are topically related, yet every answer requires hidden temporal evidence from multiple videos. Given only the question and video pool, humans and agents iteratively inspect bounded local windows, retain supporting evidence, and answer with cited temporal spans. Human trajectories provide reference curves for evidence acquisition and use across rounds. Experiments reveal a consistent retrieval-to-grounding gap. On DCI-Loc, frontier VLMs often retrieve and expose the reference moment, yet convert far less of this exposure into precise final citations than the human reference. On DCI-QA, the loss begins earlier and compounds across videos. Ablation studies further confirm that iterative search outperforms one-shot retrieval. Multi-round search is therefore necessary but insufficient: current agents accumulate candidates and observations more readily than precise, jointly sufficient evidence.

</details>


### [3] [Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning for Handwritten Letter Recognition: A Controlled Study on EMNIST Letters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09953)
*Azam Nouri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出混淆自适应边界学习（CAML）：用替补分区构建稀疏加权混淆图，在最终训练中对特定易混字对施加余弦间隔约束，无额外参数，但在EMNIST Letters上仅带来统计上不显著的微小提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手写字符识别虽准确率高，但错误高度集中在视觉相似的字符类之间（前期几何基识别工作留下的残差混淆），作者试图从训练目标（损失设计）角度而非模型结构角度缓解这类混淆错误。

Method: CAML：从试运行训练中留出的发现分区构建稀疏加权混淆图，识别8个目标混淆对（I/L、G/Q、U/V、R/V、D/O、C/E、I/J、H/N），在最终训练中对这些字对加入成对余弦分离约束。不引入额外分类器、路由规则或推理期参数。实验采用严格匹配的交叉熵CNN基线（相同架构、训练数据、确定性增强、优化器与检查点选择），在EMNIST Letters干净集与10种预设损坏条件下的测试集上评估，并做McNemar检验与Holm校正。

Result: 干净测试集准确率95.6346%→95.6731%，macro-F1 0.956326→0.956724；10种损坏条件平均准确率约95.3812%→95.4303%；目标字对内部对称错误由614降至605（1.47%）。但全局差异小且不显著：修复124个基线错误同时新增116个错误（McNemar p=0.6515），Holm校正后无损坏条件下的显著差异。

Conclusion: CAML未能确立全局优越性，但证明在防泄漏（leakage-controlled）设置下，成对特定的间隔目标可以改变针对性的错误结构，对已较强分类器的整体收益有限；也提示这类小型改进需要更严谨的统计检验与报告。

Abstract: Handwritten character recognition systems can achieve high accuracy while retaining concentrated errors among visually similar classes. Motivated by residual letter confusions in earlier geometry-based recognition work, we investigate whether these errors can be addressed through the training objective. We introduce Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning (CAML), which constructs a sparse weighted confusion graph from a discovery partition held out from pilot training and applies pair-specific cosine-separation constraints during final training. CAML adds no classifier, routing rule, or inference-time parameters.
  We evaluate CAML on EMNIST Letters against a strictly matched cross-entropy CNN baseline, using the same architecture, final training data, deterministic augmentation, optimizer, and checkpoint selection. Eight confusion pairs are targeted: I/L, G/Q, U/V, R/V, D/O, C/E, I/J, and H/N. On the official clean test set, accuracy changes from 95.6346% to 95.6731%, and macro-F1 from 0.956326 to 0.956724. Mean accuracy across ten predefined corrupted conditions increases from approximately 95.3812% to 95.4303%; symmetric errors within targeted pairs decrease from 614 to 605 (1.47%).
  The global differences are small and not statistically reliable. CAML fixes 124 baseline errors but introduces 116 new errors on clean data (exact McNemar p=0.6515), and no corruption-specific difference remains significant after Holm correction. Thus, CAML does not establish global superiority, but shows that a leakage-controlled, pair-specific margin objective can alter targeted error structure with limited overall benefit for an already strong classifier.

</details>


### [4] [DiffusedSplitFed: Latent Diffusion-based Obfuscation for Reconstruction-Resilient Split Federated Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09954)
*Chamani Shiranthika,Parvaneh Saeedi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DiffusedSplitFed：在 SplitFed 的客户端—服务器切分点引入潜空间去噪扩散模型（LDDM），对传输表示进行混淆，以抵御重建攻击并保持医学图像分割性能；设计 V1–V3 三种结构变体，在三个医学影像数据集上验证安全性、精度与计算复杂度的权衡，并给出条件收敛分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习、拆分学习及 SplitFed 可在不共享原始患者数据的前提下支持协作医学图像分析，但 SplitFed 训练中交换的中间特征和梯度可能通过重建攻击泄露敏感信息，因此需要在传输过程中保护表示并尽量不损害分割效果。

Method: 在 SplitFed 的客户端—服务器切分点集成潜空间去噪扩散模型（LDDM），对传输表示进行混淆；构建 V1–V3 三种结构变体，采用不同的双重条件与全局特征融合组合，以研究重建抵抗能力、分割精度和计算复杂度之间的权衡；在 HAM10K、Blastocysts、FHPsAOPMSB 三个医学影像数据集上进行多次独立运行与配对统计分析，并提供条件收敛分析以刻画 LDDM 引起的梯度扰动和局部优化对训练的影响。

Result: 与 Baseline SplitFed 相比，DiffusedSplitFed 在所评估的图像重建攻击下表现出更强的抵抗能力，同时保持有竞争力的分割性能；与现有基于扩散的分割方法相比，在评估设置下也展现出有竞争力的分割精度。

Conclusion: 潜空间扩散式表示混淆有望为抗重建攻击的协作医学图像分割提供有效方案；但不同结构变体在安全性、精度和计算开销之间存在权衡，需结合应用场景选择。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL), Split Learning (SL), and Split Federated Learning (SplitFed) enable collaborative medical image analysis without sharing raw patient data. However, intermediate features and gradients exchanged during SplitFed training may reveal sensitive information through reconstruction attacks. To address this vulnerability, we propose \textbf{DiffusedSplitFed}, a SplitFed framework that integrates Latent Denoising Diffusion Models (LDDMs) at client--server split points to obfuscate transmitted representations while preserving segmentation performance. Three architectural variants (V1--V3) are developed using different combinations of dual conditioning and global feature fusion to investigate trade-offs among reconstruction resistance, segmentation accuracy, and computational complexity. Experiments on three medical imaging datasets (HAM10K, Blastocysts, and FHPsAOPMSB), supported by multiple independent runs and paired statistical analyses, demonstrate improved resistance to the evaluated image reconstruction attacks compared with Baseline SplitFed, while maintaining competitive segmentation performance. Comparisons with existing diffusion-based segmentation methods further demonstrate competitive segmentation accuracy under the evaluated settings. A conditional convergence analysis is also provided to characterize the effects of LDDM-induced gradient perturbations and local optimization on training. These findings highlight the potential of latent diffusion-based representation obfuscation for reconstruction-resilient collaborative medical image segmentation. The implementation is available at https://github.com/ChamaniS/DiffusedSplitFed.

</details>


### [5] [RadAI: Gaze-Intention Fusion Pipeline for Attention-Guided Educational Videos in Chest X-Ray Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09955)
*Kavish Mehta,Yuvan Siddharth Katamaneni,Akash Awasthi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RadAI：仅凭胸片与报告即可预测放射科专家注视序列、将其与诊断发现对应并渲染为带合成语音解说的EMME式教学视频，实现无需新采集眼动数据的可扩展注视引导培训。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸片判读错误常源于视觉搜索失败：受训者被指出后能识别异常，但自身不会注视到相关区域；而专家的搜索策略（看哪里、按何顺序、看多久）大多隐含未被显式传授。眼动建模示例（EMME）虽有效，但每例都需专家眼动采集，导致教学素材极其有限、难以规模化。

Method: RadAI 为端到端框架：输入仅为一张胸片及其报告，先预测专家注视序列（fixation sequence），再将序列中各时间区间与所追查的诊断发现关联，抽取对应图像区域，最终渲染成 EMME 风格视频，并对每个高亮发现配以合成语音解说。

Result: 在 EGD-CXR 数据集 97 个病例上评估，检验所高亮区域是否与标注的异常位置相符。

Conclusion: 作者将本工作定位为一种可规模化生成放射科住院医师与医学生教学内容的框架，使注视引导式训练摆脱对新增眼动数据的依赖。

Abstract: Chest radiograph interpretation errors often arise from failures in visual search: although trainees may correctly identify an abnormality once pointed out, they frequently fail to fixate on the relevant region, while expert search strategies (where radiologists look, in what sequence, and for how long) remain largely implicit. Eye movement modeling examples (EMME), which replay a recorded expert's gaze over the image, have been shown to improve novice detection of findings on chest radiographs, but producing one requires an eye-tracking session on that specific case, so teaching sets are limited to recorded sessions by experts. In this work, RadAI is presented, the first end-to-end framework for transforming predicted radiologist gaze into narrated instructional videos, enabling scalable gaze-guided training without collecting new eye-tracking data. Given only a chest X-ray and its report, RadAI predicts an expert fixation sequence, associates each interval of that sequence with the diagnostic finding it pursues, extracts the corresponding image region, and renders the result as an EMME-style video in which each highlighted finding is narrated with synthesized speech. RadAI is evaluated on 97 cases from the EGD-CXR dataset, assessing whether the highlighted regions correspond to annotated abnormality locations. We position this work as a framework for scalable generation of educational content for residents and medical students in the field of radiology.

</details>


### [6] [MAPA: Mode-Aware Prototype Allocation for Latent Dataset Distillation in 3D Medical Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09956)
*Weiqi Zhang,Hiroyuki Kubo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MAPA是一种潜空间数据集蒸馏方法，通过将合成原型按类内众数分配，缓解"原型集中"问题，在5个3D医学分类任务上较最强潜空间基线提升平衡准确率4.2个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将数据集蒸馏用于3D医学分类受限于体素级样本合成的内存与优化开销；在冻结自编码器潜空间蒸馏虽可在同等存储预算下容纳更多原型，但类级匹配（如分布匹配）会使原型集中于稠密潜区域、忽视稀疏类内区域，形成"原型集中"的类内不平衡。

Method: 提出MAPA（Mode-Aware Prototype Allocation）：用对真实潜变量聚类得到的固定锚点标记类内众数，并通过软分配将原型分散到各众数上，同时保留类级匹配；辅以轻量防坍缩正则与课程式加权以稳定优化。

Result: 在五个3D医学分类任务上，相同原型数量下，MAPA较最强潜空间基线的总体平衡准确率提升4.2个点；在MosMedData上的探索性严重度分析显示最差分层召回率改善，且正常样本特异性未下降。

Conclusion: 在潜空间蒸馏中显式建模类内多众数结构，可在不增加存储与原型数量的前提下缓解原型集中、提升类间与类内均衡性能，对3D医学分类具有实用价值。

Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) synthesizes a small training set from a large one, but applying it to 3D medical classification is constrained by the memory and optimization costs of synthesizing full volumetric samples. Under a storage-equivalent budget, distilling in the latent space of a frozen autoencoder reduces this cost and fits more synthetic samples (prototypes) than in voxel space. However, class-level matching, such as distribution matching, causes prototypes to concentrate in dense latent regions while underrepresenting sparser intra-class regions, a consistent imbalance that we term prototype concentration. To address this, we propose MAPA (Mode-Aware Prototype Allocation), a latent distillation method that spreads prototypes across intra-class modes while preserving class-level matching. MAPA marks these modes with fixed anchors estimated by clustering the real latents and distributes prototypes over them through a soft assignment, together with a lightweight anti-collapse regularizer and curriculum weighting that stabilize the optimization. Across five 3D medical classification tasks, MAPA improves the aggregate balanced accuracy by +4.2 points over the strongest latent baseline while using the same number of prototypes. An exploratory severity analysis on MosMedData suggests improved worst-stratum recall without loss of normal-case specificity.

</details>


### [7] [HALMES: Knowing When to Intervene in LVLM Hallucination Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09957)
*Ruining Hu,Jiaqi Lu,Xiao Liu,Ying Shen,Yu Wang,Lin Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对LVLM对比解码"全阶段无差别干预"会破坏正确生成、诱发新幻觉的问题，作者发现幻觉异常会提前逐步出现在前面的token片段中，据此提出轻量即插即用模块HALMES，从注意力特征识别幻觉前兆片段并选择性触发对比解码，将全阶段干预转为按需精准纠正，在多种LVLM与基准上进一步降低幻觉并减少对正常输出的负面影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型仍易产生与图像内容不一致的物体幻觉。现有对比解码作为免训练推理期缓解方法，通常在每一步解码都干预输出分布，这种不加区分的全阶段干预可能破坏原本正确的生成，甚至引入新的幻觉，因此需要更精准的干预时机。

Result: 在不同LVLM架构和多个基准上的大量实验表明，HALMES能进一步提升现有对比解码方法的幻觉缓解性能，同时降低全阶段干预对正常输出的负面影响。

Conclusion: 对幻觉易发片段进行建模并选择性干预是有效且必要的；将无差别全阶段对比解码转变为按需的定向纠正，可在保持正确生成的同时更有效地抑制物体幻觉。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in multimodal tasks. Nevertheless, their outputs remain prone to object hallucinations that are inconsistent with visual content. Contrastive decoding, as a training-free inference-time mitigation approach, typically intervenes in the output distribution at every decoding step. However, such indiscriminate full-stage intervention may disrupt originally correct generations and even induce new hallucinations. To address this issue, we first analyze the relationship between internal attention features and hallucinated token segments in LVLMs, revealing that hallucination-related abnormalities already emerge progressively in preceding token segments. Based on this observation, we propose HALMES, a lightweight plug-and-play module that identifies hallucination precursor segments from attention features during generation and selectively triggers contrastive decoding. HALMES can be integrated with various full-stage contrastive decoding methods, transforming indiscriminate intervention into on-demand targeted correction. Extensive experiments across different LVLM architectures and multiple benchmarks show that HALMES further improves the hallucination mitigation performance of existing contrastive decoding methods while reducing the negative impact of full-stage intervention on normal outputs, validating the importance of modeling and selectively intervening on hallucination-prone segments.

</details>

Abstract: Hippocampal atrophy is among the earliest structural markers of Alzheimer's disease, and reliable hippocampal segmentation across serial MRI visits is a prerequisite for measuring it. We present HippoMamba, a network that combines a 3D convolutional encoder and decoder with a Mamba selective state space block at the bottleneck, designed to process one or more MRI visits of a subject. On the Medical Segmentation Decathlon hippocampus dataset (260 subjects, five-fold cross-validation), HippoMamba obtained a mean Dice similarity coefficient of 0.8861 $\pm$ 0.0094, the highest among six convolutional and transformer-based methods trained with the same folds and patch size, and its per-subject Dice was significantly higher than that of each method (Holm-corrected Wilcoxon tests, $p \leq 0.013$). Its mean 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (1.45 mm) and average surface distance (0.44 mm) were the lowest of the compared methods, although they did not differ significantly from those of Attention U-Net, and the Hausdorff distance did not differ significantly from that of SegResNet. In a pre-specified analysis of participants followed for at least two years, annualised volume change derived from per-visit segmentation was moderately correlated with that of FreeSurfer (r = 0.503, 95% CI 0.319 to 0.659), with a larger mean rate. Here a robot arm moves a flexible strip by oscillating along a one-dimensional path, and four iPhones, three fixed and one handheld, film it for ten minutes. The videos are synchronized, the cameras are posed from the scene, and the position of the gripper is given per frame as the input of the system. Abstract: Although audio-driven human animation has achieved impressive realism, it still lacks effective Multi-Scene Temporal Control: orchestrating background transitions at precise timestamps while preserving a coherent foreground subject. To address these challenges, we introduce SceneShifter, a training-free framework for precise multi-scene control in audio-driven human animation. SceneShifter guides spatio-temporal self-attention by suppressing cross-scene attention among background tokens while preserving cross-scene attention among foreground tokens. To support this guidance under large motion, SceneShifter extracts dynamic foreground masks from the self-attention layers and heads that best capture subject trajectories. Experiments show that SceneShifter achieves frame-level scene timing, strong subject preservation, and high visual quality, outperforming existing baselines. </details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型通常以零样本或全数据微调后的成功率进行比较，这种方式无法反映适配到目标场景所需的真实数据与计算成本，掩盖了模型之间的适配效率差异，因此需要系统研究适配效率（adaptation efficiency）。

Conclusion: 零样本或全数据微调的成功率不足以刻画VLA的适配能力，适配效率（数据与计算敏感性）会揭示被掩盖的显著模型差异；π₀.₅在样本效率上全面领先，预训练中VLM是否与动作专家联合训练是导致冻结VLM敏感度差异的关键因素；验证损失只能作为套件内的粗略代理指标，无法准确度量跨模型的效率差距。

Abstract: Pretrained vision language action (VLA) models show strong zero-shot performance, but are rarely deployed directly and are often first post-trained on demonstrations from the target setting. Yet VLAs are typically compared by zero-shot or full-data fine-tuned success, revealing little about the data and compute required for adaptation. We study adaptation efficiency for six VLAs ($π_{0}$, $π_{0.5}$, and GR00T N1-N1.7) on four LIBERO suites, varying both demonstrations and training steps. We study one pretraining factor behind these differences by freezing the VLM during finetuning: this severely degrades the $π$ models, whose VLM is jointly trained with the action expert during pretraining, but barely affects GR00T models. Finally, validation loss on held-out demonstrations tracks closed-loop success within a suite, but understates how much more sample-efficient $π_{0.5}$ is than $π_{0}$.

Abstract: Objective: It is not known whether the input representation governs the quality of explanations of deep learning models for electrocardiogram analysis. Significance: Treating interpretability as a representation-design problem offers a route towards explanations clinicians can check against known electrophysiology.

### [13] [ReelCache: An Efficient KV Cache Compression and Management System for Multi-Round Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09973)
*Tianyu Wang,Daiyang Yu,Zhiwei Ren,Junbo Li,Jitian Zhang,Longfei Shangguan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReelCache 是一个面向多轮长视频生成的自回归视频扩散模型 KV cache 压缩系统，通过层内低秩+视频编码压缩与层间树状缓存管理，在几乎不掉点的情况下大幅降低 KV 存储并加速生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型在多轮视频生成中会产生庞大的 KV cache：全部保留会造成显存爆炸，直接丢弃后重建又会严重拖慢后续视频块生成。因此需要一种既省显存又不牺牲速度的长视频生成缓存方案。

Method: ReelCache 由两部分组成：(1) 层内压缩器（intra-chunk compressor）：在通道维度做低秩分解，再对分解得到的系数施加视频编码；并在线逐 transformer 层预测分解秩，以满足预设的保留能量（retained-energy）目标；(2) 层间缓存管理器（inter-chunk cache manager）：在相邻视频块间共享基方向（basis directions），并以树结构组织块状态，使不同生成分支共享历史状态，同时支持 resume、rewind、fork 等恢复操作。

Result: 在五个视频生成模型上进行实验：相对基线，KV 存储降低 14.46–21.13 倍，下一视频块生成加速 1.25–3.36 倍，六个代表性 VBench 指标下降不足 1%。

Conclusion: ReelCache 表明“层内压缩 + 层间结构化缓存管理”的组合可有效解决长视频自回归扩散中的显存与延迟矛盾，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升存储效率与生成速度，并天然支持交互式的分支式视频生成流程。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models produce large KV caches during multi-round video generation. Keeping all these KV chunks would consume substantial memory, while rebuilding discarded caches would significantly delay video chunk generation. This paper presents ReelCache, a KV cache compression system for efficient multi-round, long video generation. ReelCache combines an intra-chunk compressor with an inter-chunk cache manager. The compressor applies low-rank decomposition across channels and video coding to the resulting coefficients, predicting the decomposition rank per transformer layer online to meet retained-energy targets. The cache manager shares basis directions across consecutive chunks and organizes chunk states in a tree, allowing generation branches to share historical state while supporting restoration for resume, rewind, and fork. Experiments across five video generation models show that ReelCache reduces KV storage by 14.46-21.13x relative to baselines and accelerates next-chunk generation by 1.25-3.36x, with less than 1% drop in six representative VBench metrics. GitHub: https://github.com/Tianyu9748/ReelCache

</details>


### [14] [Seeing Like a Shopper: Validating Vision-Language Models as Synthetic Consumers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09977)
*Woongki Kim,Seungkook Baek,Minhyeok Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文检验视觉语言模型（VLM）能否作为"合成购物者"复现真实消费者行为：在购买篮层面与真实家庭数据高度一致，在单次货架选择层面则受产品位置与字母标签干扰，作者据此提出 ShelfSight 基准与因子模型加以校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型已被广泛用作问卷、行为实验和市场调研中的"合成受访者"，但这类模拟大多基于文本阅读；而真实购物者在货架前是"看"着选商品的。因此需要验证视觉语言模型能否胜任"合成购物者"，并厘清其选择在多大程度上反映真实偏好、在多大程度上是视觉呈现带来的偏差。

Method: 研究分两个层面。①购买层面：基于家庭消费记录构建 VLM 购物者，让其依据商店目录规划购物行程、从货架图片中挑选商品，并与来自三个国家的六个公开数据集比对，同时与训练好的回归模型对比。②单次货架选择层面：发现模型答案会把产品本身与其摆放位置、字母标签混淆，于是提出 ShelfSight——可独立操控产品、位置、标签、视角与价格的货架渲染图集，并配套因子模型（factor model），把产品偏好与"答案效应"（标签与位置造成的偏差）分离，答案效应按图像类型各估计一次并予以剔除。

Result: 合成购物篮命中的留出购买与家庭自身历史行程相当；合成群体差异与真实群体差异的相关性约为训练回归模型的两倍。无需额外拟合，VLM 购物者即可复现俄罗斯按性别与年龄划分的酒精购买行为、台湾按门店距离划分的行程规模，并在实测区间内对情境、价格和陈列作出反应。在单次货架选择上，模型答案明显受位置与字母标签干扰；在 ShelfSight 上，主流托管 VLM 能读懂货架、遵循明示需求、在不同视角间保持产品偏好，并像预算型消费者一样对价格作出反应。

Conclusion: VLM 可以成为有效的合成购物者：其未校正的货架选择混有对字母"A"和图像位置的系统性偏好（答案效应），在按图像类型估计并扣除这些效应后，其选择能够反映真实的产品偏好。这为用视觉语言模型开展消费者研究提供了可行路径与必要的校正方法。

Abstract: Language models are widely used as synthetic respondents in surveys, behavioral experiments, and market research. Most of these respondents read text, whereas shoppers in a store choose by looking at shelves, which makes vision-language models (VLMs) natural synthetic shoppers. We test whether VLM shoppers follow real consumers at two levels. At the purchase level, VLM shoppers built from household records plan their trips from a store directory and select products from shelf images, and we compare their purchases with six public datasets from three countries. The synthetic baskets hit held-out purchases as often as the households' own past trips, and synthetic group differences correlate with real ones twice as strongly as those of a trained regression. Without fitting, VLM shoppers reproduce alcohol purchases by gender and age in Russia and trip sizes by store distance in Taiwan, and respond to situations, prices, and displays within measured ranges. At the level of a single shelf choice, a model's answer confounds the product with its position and letter label. We therefore introduce ShelfSight, shelf renderings that vary products, positions, labels, viewpoints, and prices independently, together with a factor model that separates product preferences from the effects of label and position, which we call answer effects. On ShelfSight, hosted VLMs read the shelf, follow stated needs, keep their product preferences across views, and respond to price as budget shoppers. These answer effects, a preference for the letter A and for positions in the image, are estimated once per image type and removed. VLMs are thus good synthetic shoppers whose corrected shelf choices reflect product preferences.

</details>


### [15] [Preconditioned Implicit Midpoint Langevin Sampling for Non-Smooth Bayesian Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09980)
*Sichen Wang,Zhipeng Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 P-IMLA：一种预条件隐式中点 Langevin 采样器，用于带非光滑正则项的高维对数凹目标；核心是消除预条件 Euler-Maruyama 在大步长下的稳态方差膨胀，使采样在任意步长下对高斯目标精确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维对数凹目标采样中，矩阵预条件可支持大步长，但预条件 Euler-Maruyama 恰好在大步长时放大稳态方差；非光滑正则项又增加了采样与理论分析难度。

Method: 采用隐式中点离散，并利用 Cayley 变换恒等式去除方差盈余，构造 P-IMLA；通过白化将 IMLA 的尖锐收缩率转移到有效条件数 κ_eff；用后向误差分析在显式光滑性假设下给出仅有漂移偏差、而非 Euler 型扩散偏差；再用 M-范数 Moreau 包络构造近端非光滑变体，并建立三项误差预算。

Result: P-IMLA 对高斯目标在任意步长下方差精确；非高斯情形下由 κ_eff 控制收敛；非光滑变体具备三项误差分解。高斯与 TV 正则图像实验验证：随 κ_f 增大，无预条件中点方案仍有长暂态，而 P-IMLA 保持 κ_eff 主导且近似方差精确。

Conclusion: P-IMLA 通过隐式中点与预条件/白化及 Moreau 包络，兼顾大步长稳定性、方差精确性和非光滑正则处理，为高维对数凹采样提供了更优的误差与条件数控制。

Abstract: We introduce P-IMLA, a preconditioned implicit-midpoint Langevin sampler for high-dimensional log-concave targets with non-smooth regularization. The obstruction is that the large steps enabled by matrix preconditioning are precisely where preconditioned Euler-Maruyama inflates stationary variance. Implicit midpoint removes this surplus via a Cayley-transform identity, making P-IMLA Gaussian-exact at any step size. Beyond Gaussians, whitening transfers the sharp IMLA contraction rate to $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$, and backward-error analysis gives drift-only rather than Euler-type diffusion bias under explicit smoothness assumptions. An $M$-norm Moreau envelope yields a proximal non-smooth variant with a three-term error budget. Controlled Gaussian and TV-regularized imaging experiments confirm the predicted separation: the unpreconditioned midpoint scheme retains long transients as $κ_f$ grows, whereas P-IMLA remains $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$-governed and near variance-exact.

</details>


### [16] [QCVS: Question-Contrastive Visual Steering for Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09982)
*Tong Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出问题对比视觉引导（QCVS），通过双差激活探测分离出与目标查询相关的干预方向，并用双阈值门控实现稀疏、精准的单次隐状态修正，在提升准确率的同时大幅降低误伤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在推理时的引导（steering）往往把与查询相关的推理动态与低层感知噪声纠缠在一起，导致在对错误预测进行修正时反而破坏原本正确的预测（附带性退化）。亟需一种无需真值监督、能隔离任务特定干预方向的方法。

Method: QCVS（Question-Contrastive Visual Steering）：①双差激活探测——将目标查询下的空间布局扰动与通用描述参照进行对比，抵消与任务无关的视觉伪影，从而无需监督地隔离任务特定干预方向；②双阈值门控机制——同时评估相对交互强度与信号幅度，仅在必要时施加一次有界的隐状态更新（稀疏、单步干预）。

Result: 在Qwen3.5（2B–9B）多个规模与DeepSeek-VL2上，于DynaMath和We-Math数据集评测：在约22%–30%的稀疏覆盖下取得SOTA准确率提升；修复率最高达13.98%，同时将附带损伤压低至0.41%。

Conclusion: 通过对比式探测与门控稀疏干预，QCVS实现了高精度、低副作用、计算高效的推理时视觉引导，验证了"分离查询相关信号与感知噪声"这一思路的有效性。

Abstract: Inference-time steering in vision-language models often entangles query-relevant reasoning dynamics with low-level perceptual noise, causing collateral degradation on correct predictions. We propose Question-Contrastive Visual Steering (QCVS) to isolate task-specific intervention directions via double-differential activation probing. By contrasting spatial layout perturbations under the target query against a generic description reference, QCVS cancels task-agnostic visual artifacts without ground-truth supervision. A dual-threshold gating mechanism then evaluates relative interaction strength and signal amplitude, selectively applying a single bounded hidden-state update only when necessary. Empirical evaluations across multiple scales of Qwen3.5 (2B to 9B) and DeepSeek-VL2 on DynaMath and We-Math demonstrate that QCVS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy gains under sparse coverage (approximately 22%-30%). Crucially, QCVS yields repair rates up to 13.98% while suppressing collateral damage down to 0.41%, proving high intervention precision and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [17] [Stochastic Deep Supervision for Gallery-Consistent Early-Exit Face Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09987)
*Guray Ozgur,Tahar Chettaoui,Eduarda Caldeira,Naser Damer,Fadi Boutros*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SD-ViT 通过对随机选取的中间 block 施加共享嵌入头的深度监督，使 ViT 在任意深度都能产出可直接与全深度 gallery 比对的身份嵌入，实现免重算的固定深度早退。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT 在人脸识别上性能强，但推理深度固定，难以部署在资源受限场景；而标准 ViT 只通过反向传播间接影响中间层，中间表示并未被直接优化成可用的身份嵌入，导致早退不可用。

Method: 提出 SD-ViT 训练框架：每次迭代随机选一个中间 block，将其送入与最终层完全相同的 embedding head 和分类器，用加权的 margin-penalty softmax 损失训练，从而构成经共享分类器的随机采样式深度监督；两层损失共享头与分类器，迫使中间 token 与末层 token 映射到同一嵌入空间。

Result: 在公开基准上，全深度推理与常规训练的同一骨干相比 IJB-C 差距在 0.4 点以内；早退探针在 50% 计算量下能恢复其自身全深度性能的 96% 以上，且无需修改或重算参考 gallery；全深度校准的单一验证阈值从 1/4 深度起即可继续使用。

Conclusion: 通过随机深度监督共享嵌入头，可使 ViT 在每一 block 深度都获得具有判别力且空间对齐的身份嵌入，从而以预算选择的固定深度出口实现无需重算 gallery 的高效人脸识别，兼顾全深度精度与早退效率。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) perform strongly in face recognition (FR), yet their fixed-depth inference limits deployment in resource-constrained settings. We propose SD-ViT, a training framework that gives a usable exit at every block depth by making every depth produce discriminative embeddings, for budget-selected fixed-depth exits. Standard ViTs supervise intermediate layers only through backpropagation, so their intermediate representations are not directly optimized to form usable identity embeddings. SD-ViT adds a stochastic auxiliary signal: at each iteration a randomly selected intermediate block is passed through the same embedding head as the final layer and trained with a weighted margin-penalty softmax loss. The objective is thus stochastically sampled deep supervision through a shared classifier. Because both loss terms share that head and classifier, intermediate tokens are trained to map into the same embedding space as final-layer tokens. This matters for FR, where matching is by similarity: a probe processed at an early exit can be compared directly against full-depth gallery embeddings, with no gallery recomputation or adaptation layers. On established benchmarks, SD-ViT stays within 0.4 IJB-C points of the same backbone trained conventionally at full depth, while its early-exit probes recover over 96% of their own full-depth performance at 50% of the computational cost without modifying the reference gallery. A single verification threshold calibrated at full depth remains usable from quarter depth onward.

</details>


### [18] [Retrieval-Grounded Multi-View Reasoning for Clinically Reliable Radiology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09993)
*Wanshu Fan,Zeyu Wang,Zheng Tong,Qi Ai,Wencai Weng,Haifan Gong,Congyu Liao,Guoliang You,Xiaofeng Liu,Dongsheng Zhou,Cong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出检索增强框架 RG-MVR，通过视觉门控的稀疏检索证据、自适应多视图证据推理与结构化临床提示学习，缓解胸片报告生成中"检索报告貌似相似但临床不一致"及诊断标签不平衡的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸片报告生成面临两大障碍：一是检索到的报告虽在图像上相似，却在临床语义上与当前影像不一致，直接使用会引入事实性错误；二是诊断标签分布不平衡，导致模型偏向常见表述而忽略阳性/阴性/不确定状态的区别。

Method: RG-MVR 由三部分组成：(1) 检索增强证据接地模块，将稠密记忆摘要与经视觉门控的稀疏检索证据相结合，以抑制无关检索内容；(2) 自适应多视图证据推理模块，针对每个病例自适应地为图像、记忆摘要与检索证据分配权重；(3) 临床提示学习器，将"发现是否被提及"与"阳性/阴性/不确定"状态分开建模。

Result: 在 MIMIC-CXR 上取得临床标签 F1 0.483、BLEU-4 0.118；在 IU X-ray 上分别为 0.202 与 0.110。在包含 22 例检查的探索性外部队列中，临床标签一致性显著下降（F1 仅 0.071），无依据陈述仍较普遍，但医师评估发现其无依据的时间对比陈述（9 例 vs 20 例）与设备相关陈述（7 例 vs 15 例）少于基线方法。

Conclusion: 证据感知的检索与结构化诊断提示能够减少特定类型的报告错误（如时间对比与设备描述），但模型在外部队列上的临床标签一致性仍然很低、无依据陈述普遍存在，说明方法的泛化性有限，尚需更大规模的外部验证。

Abstract: Chest radiograph report generation is hampered by retrieved reports that resemble the current image but are clinically inconsistent with it, and by diagnostic-label imbalance. We present RG-MVR, a retrieval-grounded framework comprising Retrieval-Augmented Evidence Grounding, which combines dense memory summaries with visually gated sparse retrieved evidence; Adaptive Multi-view Evidential Reasoning, which weights image, memory, and retrieved evidence per case; and a Clinical Prompt Learner, which models finding mention separately from positive, negative, or uncertain status. On MIMIC-CXR, RG-MVR achieved a clinical-label F1 of 0.483 and a BLEU-4 of 0.118 (IU X-ray: 0.202 and 0.110). In an exploratory external cohort of 22 examinations, clinical-label agreement declined markedly (F1, 0.071) and unsupported statements remained common, although physicians found fewer unsupported temporal comparisons (9 vs. 20 cases) and device-related statements (7 vs. 15) than with the baseline. Evidence-aware retrieval and structured diagnostic prompting may reduce specific reporting errors, but broader external validation is required.

</details>


### [19] [SurvAD: How Anomalies Survive Diffusion Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09997)
*Lexing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究扩散模型异常检测中“异常残漏”现象，发现一阶确定性采样器沿异常方向满足精确递归，其连续极限为生存律：异常随噪声下降按保留率r指数衰减，该规律可跨步数、采样器和噪声日程预测残漏，并据此提出SurvAD方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式异常检测通过将测试图像重建为正常样本来发现异常，但异常在重建过程中有多少被保留、即“残漏”如何随采样过程演化，此前缺乏刻画，导致检测残差图的可靠性和可预测性不足。

Method: 作者从理论上分析一阶确定性采样器沿异常方向的递归关系，推导出连续极限下的生存律，以保留率r描述模型在访问状态上的异常保留；基于该定律分析步数增长对应的曝光偏差，并提出SurvAD：在类推理起点上微调重建器，并拟合一个比较器，在残差图上补充证据而不破坏其余区域的异常排序。

Result: 实测一条路径即可在四种扩散模型和真实缺陷上，将邻近起点的其他步数、采样器与日程的残漏预测误差控制在百分之几以内；SurvAD仅增加不到2%推理时间，便将DeCo-Diff的多类像素平均精度从76.8提升到80.7（MVTec AD）、从57.5提升到60.0（VisA），以少9倍可训练参数匹配CostFilter-AD，并在Dinomaly协议下超过其报告结果。

Conclusion: 异常残漏可由保留率驱动的指数生存律精确刻画，残漏随步数增长本质上是曝光偏差；改变采样路径或训练方式会在残漏与细节误差之间权衡。SurvAD利用该规律以极小开销显著提升扩散异常检测性能，说明对采样动力学的理论理解可转化为有效方法。

Abstract: Diffusion-based anomaly detectors reconstruct a test image towards normality, yet how much of an anomaly survives, its leak, remains uncharacterized. We show that a first-order deterministic sampler obeys an exact recursion along the anomaly, whose continuous limit is a survival law. The anomaly decays exponentially as the noise falls, at a rate set by the retention $r$, the share the model keeps on the states it visits. Because $r$ depends on the noise level and not on the step count, one measured path predicts the leak of other step counts, samplers and schedules from a nearby start to within a few hundredths, on four diffusion models and real defects. The law also shows that the leak's growth over steps is exposure bias and that normal details obey the same law, so changing the path or the training trades leak for detail error. We introduce SurvAD, which fine-tunes the reconstructor on inference-like starts and fits a comparator that adds evidence to the residual map without suppressing its ranking elsewhere. For under $2\%$ more inference time, SurvAD raises the multi-class pixel average precision (P-AP) of DeCo-Diff from $76.8$ to $80.7$ on MVTec AD and from $57.5$ to $60.0$ on VisA. It matches CostFilter-AD on the same reconstructor with $9\times$ fewer trainable parameters and, under Dinomaly's protocol, exceeds its reported P-AP on Dinomaly on both benchmarks.

</details>


### [20] [Quality-Governed Deep Learning Network for Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09998)
*Asifiqbal Saiyed,Nitesh Chilakala,Jimmy Joseph,Praneetha Goli,Rohini Maskar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出质量引导的QGDL-Net，用可学习质量门控在解码前微调编码器特征，实现FLAIR脑肿瘤二分类分割，在BraTS 2021上Dice达0.9747并优于U-Net和Attention U-Net。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: U-Net与Attention U-Net的跳跃连接在肿瘤边界异质时会产生弱对比或噪声响应，且编码器特征缺乏对切片质量（对比度、信噪比）的显式建模。

Method: 设计QGDL-Net：基于对比度与SNR统计量预测切片质量，并通过可学习质量门控（quality gates）在解码前对编码器特征进行微调；在BraTS 2021上以80:20划分训练/验证，做FLAIR切片二分类分割；用EigenCAM可视化解释。

Result: Dice 0.9747、IoU 0.9506、精确率0.9755、召回率0.9739、F1 0.9747、准确率0.9982，均超过U-Net与Attention U-Net；EigenCAM与分割叠加图显示更优的肿瘤定位与病灶区域可解释激活。

Conclusion: 引入切片质量感知的门控机制可有效抑制跳跃连接的噪声响应，提升分割精度与可解释性；但仅限二分类与单一数据集验证，泛化性仍需进一步证明。

Abstract: The segmentation of brain tumors from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an essential step for computer-aided neuro-oncology, treatment planning and follow-up. While effective encoder-decoder representations are achieved by U-Net and Attention U-Net, the skip sections of the network can generate weak-contrast or noisy responses in the case of heterogeneous boundaries of the tumor. In this paper, we introduce a Quality-Governed Deep Learning Network (QGDL-Net) that can be used for binary tumor segmentation from FLAIR MRI slices. The proposed model is able to predict the slice quality based on contrast and SNR statistics and to fine-tune the encoder features prior to decoding by learnable quality gates. We used the 80:20 train-validation split for experiments with BraTS 2021. QGDL-Net achieved a Dice of 0.9747, IoU of 0.9506, precision of 0.9755, recall of 0.9739, F1 of 0.9747 and accuracy of 0.9982, outperforming U-Net and Attention U-Net. The EigenCAM maps and segmentation overlays provide better tumor localization and interpretable activation around the lesion regions.

</details>


### [21] [Optimized Car Damage Detection Using CNN and Object Detection Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10001)
*Sania Ejaz,Jaison Shajan Thomas,Zaheeruddin Ahmed,Sushma Hans*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种两级级联架构：先用CNN将输入图像分为"完好/受损"以过滤无损图像，再用目标检测网络定位并分类划痕、凹陷、玻璃碎裂与撞毁，并借助迁移学习实现单套模型服务多场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车辆损伤检测在保险理赔、事故上报、维修厂车辆进出登记等场景中需求迫切。已有相关工作多聚焦单一任务或特定用例，缺乏能适配多类业务流程的统一方案，同时直接对全部图像做检测会浪费算力于大量无损图片。

Abstract: Expert annotation in digital pathology is expensive, and low-label regimes remain common in realistic histopathology workflows. Abstract: Few-shot fine-grained video action recognition requires recognizing novel action classes from only a few labeled examples. The difficulty is that visually similar actions often share actors, scenes, poses, and objects, differing only in the order, timing, and short duration of motion changes. We study this problem under three practical constraints: few tunable parameters, low compute cost, and use of the video modality alone. We propose Motion-aligned Temporal Adapter (MATA), a parameter-efficient adapter on top of a frozen CLIP backbone. MATA specializes CLIP features along the temporal dimension using two components: temporal phase alignment through learnable temporal positional embeddings, and a local motion transition operator through depth-wise convolution. With only ~3.6M tunable parameters, MATA achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple fine-grained benchmarks while remaining robust to both visual corruptions and temporal disruptions induced by frame dropping. A comparative analysis examines the capabilities, limitations, and potential integration of general-purpose computer vision platforms, content moderation services, and specialized CSAM detection tools within existing detection workflows. An experimental evaluation was conducted using Google Cloud Vision AI and Sightengine to investigate sexual-content classification and child-adult age estimation. The results highlight differences in classification taxonomies and outputs across providers, as well as significant limitations in age classification, particularly for adolescents. These findings highlight the importance of using AI-based assessments as complementary tools for analysis and prioritization, rather than as definitive determination of CSAM. Finally, the paper examines the relevant European Union regulatory framework, with particular attention to the EU AI Act, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), fundamental rights, transparency, accountability, and human oversight. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mamba 能以线性时间捕获全局上下文，但现有 3D 医学分割方法在每个分辨率层级都使用全通道宽度的多方向扫描，导致模型参数量大（64–138M）且 FLOPs 高，难以满足轻量化部署需求。

Method: 提出 Grouped Multi-Directional (GMD) Mamba：将输入通道 C 划分为 G 组，每组沿不同方向展平并在一次扫描中完成，从而在一次遍历内获得多方向上下文，计算复杂度为 O(C²/G) 而非 O(K·C²)。同时采用稀疏化设计，仅在编码器最深层级引入 Mamba 模块，构成轻量分割网络。

Conclusion: 通过分组多方向扫描替代全宽度多方向扫描、并将 Mamba 限制在最深编码阶段，可在显著降低参数量与计算开销的同时保持甚至超越现有方法的 3D 医学分割精度，验证了扫描策略分组化设计的高效性。

Abstract: Mamba has the capability to capture global context in linear time for 3D medical image segmentation. However, existing methods employ Mamba with full-width directional scans at every resolution, keeping the model large (64-138M parameters and high FLOPs). We propose Grouped Multi-Directional (GMD) Mamba, a lightweight network based on the GMD scan that divides input channels $C$ into groups $G$ and flattens each group in different directions in one pass. This gives multi-directional context at $O(C^2/G)$ instead of $O(K \cdot C^2)$, where $K$ is the number of scan directions. Additionally, we employ Mamba only at the deepest encoder stages, resulting in 19.2M parameters. On BraTS2023, it achieves the best average Dice of 92.0% and the lowest HD95 of 2.7 at $\sim$1/7 the parameters of SegMamba-V2. For model validation, we also ran experiments on the MSD Spleen dataset, achieving competitive performance. The implementation details and code are publicly available at https://github.com/2802990u/GMD-Mamba.

</details>

Abstract: Mamba is a neural network architecture that reduces computational complexity, and has been shown to be effective for 3D medical image segmentation. Specifically, we demonstrate compression of a 139M-parameter SegMamba-V2 teacher into a lightweight TinyUNet3D student with about 0.96M parameters, achieving about 145$\times$ compression with a performance drop of just over one Dice point. We further investigate the utility of knowledge distillation in a range of data-labeling scenarios under identical experimental settings, and show that its advantage is most prominent when labeled data is scarce. To demonstrate the generalizability of our approach, experiments are conducted on three datasets: BraTS 2023, MSD Spleen and MSD Hippocampus. The code for TinyUNet3D is publicly available at: https://github.com/2802990u/tinyunet3d-dist-kd.

### [27] [Improving the Diffusability of Motion Tokenizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10160)
*Guanhe Huang,Songqiao Han,Tangzheng Lian,Oya Celiktutan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对潜空间扩散动作生成中"分词器容量提升带来重建改善但生成质量不匹配"的生成-重建权衡问题，提出可扩散动作分词器 DiMoT：通过评论家频谱适配（CSA）抑制潜空间高频能量，并用 Alpha-Flow 动作解码器（AMD）以平均速度预测实现一步生成式解码，在多个文本到动作基准上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜扩散模型配合VAE分词器在高效文本驱动人体动作生成上表现良好，但存在生成-重建权衡：单纯增大分词器容量能提升重建质量，却不能同比提升文本条件生成质量。作者假设该权衡源于VAE分词器内部的频谱失配——编码器产生偏向高频的潜空间，解码器则引入时间伪影。因此研究重点不是扩大扩散主干，而是提升分词器的"可扩散性"。

Method: 提出 DiMoT（Diffusable Motion Tokenizer）。其一，Critic Spectral Adaptation（CSA）利用预训练扩散模型作为评论家，抑制潜空间中的高频能量，以改善文本条件优化；其二，Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder（AMD）通过平均速度预测进行生成式解码，在保持动作动力学的同时实现高效的一步解码。

Result: 大量实验表明，DiMoT 在多个具有挑战性的文本到动作基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，获得更优的动作保真度与文本-动作对齐效果。

Conclusion: 提升分词器的可扩散性（而非扩大扩散主干）是缓解生成-重建权衡的有效途径；频谱层面的潜空间调控与生成式一步解码相结合，可同时兼顾重建、生成效率与文本条件生成质量。

Abstract: Latent diffusion models paired with a variational auto-encoder (VAE) tokenizer have shown promising performance for efficient text-driven human motion generation. However, motion latent diffusion suffers from a generation-reconstruction trade-off: simply increasing tokenizer capacity enhances reconstruction but fails to proportionally improve text-conditioned generation quality. We assume this trade-off stems from a spectral mismatch inside the VAE tokenizer: the encoder yields a latent space biased toward high frequencies, and the decoder introduces temporal artifacts. In this paper, we propose the Diffusable Motion Tokenizer (DiMoT) to improve the diffusability of the tokenizer, rather than scaling up the diffusion backbone. To improve text-conditioned optimization, Critic Spectral Adaptation (CSA) leverages a pretrained diffusion model as the critic to suppress high-frequency latent energy. To preserve motion dynamics, the Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder (AMD) performs generative decoding via average-velocity prediction, enabling efficient one-step decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiMoT achieves state-of-the-art performance across various challenging text-to-motion benchmarks, yielding superior motion fidelity and text-motion alignment. Project page: https://githubhgh.github.io/dimot/.

</details>


### [28] [CXR-CMFA: A Cross-Modal Feature Aggregation Network for Chest X-Ray Pathology Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10174)
*Talukder Hasnat Zadid,Jahin Sultana,Felipe Bochini Brisola,Kishore Roy,Mysha Rahman,Syeda Asrafa Islam,Md. Abdullah-Al-Jubair*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级跨模态特征聚合网络CXR-CMFA，融合双流视觉编码器与TF-IDF-MLP报告编码器，在MIMIC-CXR上实现二分类胸片病理检测，AUC达99.19%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸片判读难：细微病变易被重叠解剖结构遮挡，且存在图像质量差异与单张影像信息不足的问题。纯图像模型丢弃了放射报告的互补诊断信息；而大型视觉语言模型计算开销大、难以实际部署。因此需要一种轻量、能利用报告文本的跨模态方法。

Method: CXR-CMFA由三部分组成：(1) 双流视觉编码器——EfficientNet-B0提取全局解剖表征，DenseNet-121提取局部病理细节；(2) TF-IDF-MLP报告编码器获得文本嵌入；(3) 两个融合模块——DMSAM用报告嵌入对全局/局部视觉特征做门控，CGFF学习每个样本的视觉与文本贡献权重。训练与评测均采用MIMIC-CXR官方划分。

Result: 在MIMIC-CXR留出测试集上取得93.45%准确率、99.88%精确率、91.8%召回率、95.7% F1、99.19% AUC；984例正常样本中仅4例假阳性。消融实验中，相比仅用全局图像的变体AUC提升22.47个百分点。

Conclusion: 紧凑的"报告条件化"融合即可获得强判别性能，无需依赖大型预训练语言模型，适合高特异性筛查流程。

Abstract: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation remains challenging because subtle pathology can be obscured by overlapping anatomy, image-quality variation, and limited visual evidence in isolated radiographs. Although image-only deep learning models provide useful baselines, they discard the complementary diagnostic context available in radiology reports, while large vision-language models can be computationally expensive for practical deployment. This paper presents CXR-CMFA, a lightweight cross-modal feature aggregation network for binary CXR pathology classification. The proposed framework combines a dual-stream visual encoder, using EfficientNet-B0 for global anatomical representation and DenseNet-121 for local pathological detail, with a TF-IDF-MLP report encoder. Two fusion modules integrate these modalities: the Dual-Modal Spatial Attention Module (DMSAM) uses the report embedding to gate global and local visual features, and the Cross-Modal Gated Feature Fusion (CGFF) module learns per-instance weights for visual and textual contributions. Experiments on the MIMIC-CXR benchmark, using the provided train, validation, and test splits, show that CXR-CMFA achieves 93.45% accuracy, 99.88% precision, 91.8% recall, 95.7% F1-score, and 99.19% AUC on the held-out test set. The model produces only four false positives among 984 normal test cases, supporting its suitability for high-specificity screening workflows. An ablation study further demonstrates a 22.47 percentage-point AUC improvement over the global-image-only variant, confirming the value of adaptive cross-modal fusion. These results indicate that compact report-conditioned fusion can provide strong discriminative performance without relying on large pretrained language models.

</details>

*Ronald L. P. D. de Jong,Tim J. M. Jaspers,Raf A. H. Vervoort,Aron F. H. A. Bakker,Anna L. Dijk,Yiping Li,Jip L. Tolenaar,Jelle P. Ruurda,Willem M. Brinkman,Daan de Geus,Fons van der Sommen,Josien P. W. Pluim,Marcel Breeuwer*

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微创手术中识别解剖结构可支持术中导航并提升患者安全，但现有进展受限于两点：一是数据集规模小且多为单一术式，缺乏跨术式的多样性；二是所用分割方法多源自自然场景，未针对手术视频的解剖结构与时序特性进行设计。

Method: 工作包含数据与模型两部分。数据方面构建ATLAS-120k：来自100台手术视频的121,018帧片段级语义分割标注，覆盖14种腹腔镜与机器人辅助术式、41个类别，标注流程结合人工标注、基于跟踪器的标签传播与外科医生审核。模型方面提出ATLAS（利用基础表征进行上下文学习的解剖识别），以领域内基础模型嵌入为基础，引入针对术式与手术阶段的上下文查询，并通过帧间查询传播实现短期记忆，形成视频语义分割模型。

Abstract: Recognizing anatomical structures during minimally invasive surgery (MIS) could support intraoperative navigation and improve patient safety, but progress is limited by small, single-procedure datasets and by segmentation methods developed for natural scenes. ATLAS builds on in-domain foundation-model embeddings and adds context queries for the procedure and surgical phase, together with query propagation between frames for short-term memory. *Paul Sansah Gyreyiri,Diksha Shukla*

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Interactive VR/MR applications demand photorealistic 3D representations that support real-time rendering and object-level manipulation. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves high rendering quality, it represents scenes as unstructured, monolithic primitives. Existing object-aware 3DGS methods jointly optimize geometry and semantic states but suffer from two key failure modes: noisy foundation-model masks on complex geometry, and label-geometry coupling, in which co-optimized identity gradients mislabel boundary Gaussians. We introduce RigidGS, an end-to-end pipeline that decouples geometric learning from object identity. We propose a depth- and temporally-aware mask refinement module that addresses two complementary SAM2 failures: over-inclusion on thin structures and under-inclusion on multimodal-depth objects. We then determine object identities entirely upstream via COLMAP projection voting and freeze them during training, directing mask supervision solely toward geometric optimization. Refined masks alone substantially improve competing methods, yet a residual gap in label-geometry coupling persists that our fixed-identity design eliminates. Finally, RigidGS enables real-time rigid-body manipulation on Meta Quest~2 without mesh extraction. Our code and project page are available at https://gyreyirisansah.github.io/rigidgs.

</details>


### [31] [Anatomy-Preserving Unpaired Medical Image Translation via Shared Latent Anchoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10236)
*Zhilin Zou,Hieu Le,Saumya Gupta,Jingyi Xu,Prateek Prasanna,Chao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两阶段解耦框架：先学习模态无关的共享结构空间，再用条件流模型在冻结结构条件下渲染目标域外观，实现无配对医学图像翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无配对医学图像翻译方法用单一模型学习直接的源域到目标域映射，将结构保持与外观生成纠缠在一起，容易在翻译结果中扭曲具有临床意义的解剖结构。作者认为这两项目标应完全解耦：解剖结构应独立于生成过程被捕获，生成器只应作用于冻结的结构表示。

Result: 在OCT-to-OCTA合成与脑部MR-to-CT翻译两个任务上验证。方法在两项任务上均优于所有无配对基线，尽管无需配对监督，也超过有配对监督的基线：OCT-to-OCTA上PSNR最高提升11.2%、SSIM最高提升26.4%；MR-to-CT在整图、软组织与骨骼区域均取得一致增益。代码已在GitHub开源。

Conclusion: 将结构建模与外观生成彻底解耦，可使无配对医学图像翻译在保持解剖结构的同时获得目标域外观，且在无配对监督下超越配对方法，验证了解耦范式的有效性与泛化性。

Abstract: Unpaired medical image-to-image translation requires synthesizing target-modality images from source-modality images without aligned supervision. Existing methods learn a direct source-to-target mapping that entangles structure preservation and appearance generation within a single model, often distorting clinically meaningful anatomy in the translated output. We argue that these two objectives should be decoupled entirely: anatomical structure should be captured independently of generation, and the generator should operate only on a frozen structural representation. To this end, we propose a two-stage framework for unpaired medical image translation. In the first stage, we learn a shared structure space by training a structure encoder-decoder on source images, target images, and structural masks jointly, using mask reconstruction to anchor the latent space to modality-agnostic anatomy. For source images without mask annotations, a target-domain memory bank provides soft structural supervision via prototype retrieval. In the second stage, a conditional flow model learns to render target-domain appearance under fixed structural conditions. This ensures the generator inherits target appearance statistics and can focus entirely on structural conditioning rather than learning appearance from scratch. We validate our framework on OCT-to-OCTA synthesis and brain MR-to-CT translation. Our method outperforms all unpaired baselines on both tasks and, despite requiring no paired supervision, also surpasses paired baselines, improving PSNR by up to 11.2% and SSIM by up to 26.4% on OCT-to-OCTA, and achieving consistent gains across whole-image, soft-tissue, and bone regions on MR-to-CT. The project repository is available on GitHub.

</details>

*Armin Mustafa,Syed Sameed Husain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文面向执法佩戴式视频（BWV）审查，提出对象级检测数据集与网络，以及事件级视频理解评测协议，并用多模态模型进行压力测试，强调辅助性AI与需逐项核验的AI应分级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有执法CV主要识别静态目标，BWV仍依赖人工审阅，已有AI工具多只用音频；多模态视频AI有望降低BWV审查成本并提升效率，但缺少贴近调查条件的基准与端到端事件理解评测。

Method: 构建与英国执法机构合作的KnifeHunter数据集（2.5万余图像、543类、调查条件协议）及融合局部与全局特征的检索架构KHNet；提出面向“事件+转录”视频理解流程的评测协议，覆盖转写、说话人归属、事件检测、时间定位与无支撑事件，并由经盲态人工标签验证的评审判定事件是否有录制支撑；在UKBWV-27（27段公开BWV、118分钟）上评测三类2026全模态模型与NarrativeBridge-PAL-GPT-5混合流程。

Result: KHNet在约12.5万干扰图像下，中、难协议mAP分别达85.7%和63.4%。事件级评测中，混合流程在六项指标中五项领先，但仍有13.6%预测事件无支撑、27.7%话语说话人归属错误；所有流程在剪辑发布、长视频和噪声音频上均退化。

Conclusion: 多模态视频AI可用于BWV审查，但当前端到端可靠性不足，应建立“准备度分级”，区分可辅助完成的任务与必须逐项核验输出的任务。

Abstract: Computer vision (CV) for policing has centred on recognising objects such as seized weapons, while body-worn video (BWV) is still reviewed by people, with existing AI tools using only its audio. Multimodal video AI could make BWV review faster and cheaper. At the object level, we present the KnifeHunter dataset, developed with UK law enforcement, with over 25,000 images of 543 knife classes and a protocol reflecting investigative conditions, and KHNet, a retrieval architecture fusing local and global features, which with about 125,000 distractor images attains 85.7% and 63.4% mean Average Precision (mAP) on the medium and hard protocols. At the event level, we present an evaluation protocol for video understanding pipelines, which describe a video as events and a transcript, that scores transcription, speaker attribution, event detection, temporal localisation and unsupported events. Whether each event is supported by the recording is labelled by a judge validated against blinded human labels. We apply it to complete pipelines, three 2026 omni-modal models and our hybrid NarrativeBridge-PAL-GPT-5 pipeline, on UKBWV-27, a pilot stress-test set of 27 publicly released UK BWV recordings (118 minutes). On this set the hybrid pipeline leads on five of six measures, yet it leaves 13.6% of predicted events unsupported and misattributes 27.7% of utterances, and every pipeline degrades on recordings from edited releases, long recordings and noisy audio. We propose readiness levels separating assistive tasks from those requiring verification of every output.

</details>


### [33] [Beyond Frame-Level Accuracy: Analyzing Video-Level Stability in Transformer-Based Deepfake Forensics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10249)
*Syed Azmul Hasan,Mowmita Pervin Hera,Afroza Lona Mim,M M Jihad Hossain,Hazrat Ali,Mohammad Farhad Bulbul*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文在统一的人脸中心化框架下，公平对比 ResNet-18、EfficientNet-B0 与 ViT-B/16 三类架构的深度伪造检测性能：ViT-B/16 在视频级表现更稳（Celeb-DF v2 准确率 92.8%、AUC 0.950），但跨数据集泛化存在明显不对称差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法报告的性能往往基于异构的预处理流程、不一致的数据划分和各自的训练协议，导致架构之间难以进行公平比较；同时需要厘清 CNN 与 Transformer 在帧级与视频级检测上的真实差异及跨域泛化能力。

Method: 构建统一、可复现的人脸中心化检测框架，对 CNN（ResNet-18、EfficientNet-B0）与 Transformer（ViT-B/16）采用完全相同的预处理、数据增强、优化设置与数据划分，在 Celeb-DF v2 与 FaceForensics++ 上训练；使用三个独立随机种子验证，并采用 bootstrap 置信区间；同时进行跨数据集（FF++↔Celeb-DF）评估。

Result: CNN 模型在帧级具有竞争力，但经视频级聚合后性能下降；ViT-B/16 视频级表现更稳定，在 Celeb-DF v2 上取得 92.8% 视频级准确率 [95% CI: 91.7–94.0] 与 AUC 0.950 [95% CI: 0.934–0.964]（3 种子 bootstrap）。跨数据集评估呈现显著不对称泛化差距：AUC 0.79（FF++→Celeb-DF）对 0.64（Celeb-DF→FF++）。

Conclusion: 在给定数据域内，全局自注意力机制可提升深度伪造检测的鲁棒性与视频级稳定性；但域内视频级稳定性并不能迁移到未见过的篡改域，跨域泛化仍是未来工作的关键方向。

Abstract: Deepfake videos generated by advanced generative models pose serious threats to digital security, misinformation control, and media forensics. Although numerous detection methods have been proposed, their reported performances are often based on heterogeneous preprocessing pipelines, inconsistent data splits, and model-specific training protocols, hindering fair architectural comparison. This work presents a controlled and reproducible comparative study of convolutional neural networks (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0) and a transformer-based architecture (ViT-B/16) within a unified, face-centric deepfake detection framework. All models are trained using identical preprocessing, augmentation, optimization settings, and data splits on Celeb-DF v2 and FaceForensics++, and results are validated across three independent random seeds with bootstrapped confidence intervals. Experimental results show that while CNN-based models perform competitively at the frame level, their performance degrades after video-level aggregation. In contrast, ViT-B/16 demonstrates more stable video-level performance, achieving 92.8\% [95\% CI: 91.7--94.0] video-level accuracy and an AUC of 0.950 [95\% CI: 0.934--0.964] on Celeb-DF v2 (3-seed bootstrapped). Cross-dataset evaluation across the same three random seeds reveals a large, asymmetric generalization gap (AUC 0.79 FF++$\rightarrow$Celeb-DF vs. 0.64 Celeb-DF$\rightarrow$FF++), indicating that in-domain video-level stability does not transfer to unseen manipulation domains. These findings indicate that global self-attention improves robustness and video-level stability for deepfake detection within a given data domain, while highlighting the need for further work on cross-domain generalization.

</details>


### [34] [STAIRS: Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling for Unrolled MRI Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10260)
*Xiangjian Hou,Chang Ni,Chao Qin,Zhiwei Tan,Xin Wang,Xinrui Ye,Rong-Rong Chen,Chun Yuan,Xiaodong Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 STAIRS，通过将展开式 MRI 重建的中间结果投影到由小到大的嵌套傅里叶支撑，并按支撑变化条件化更新，实现由粗到细的加速 MRI 重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度展开网络每级都估计完整未采样频谱，计算负担重，且未显式利用“先恢复低频、再逐步扩展高频”的结构先验。

Method: 以训练协方差的正则化对数行列式得分的条件增量定义归一化谱坐标；用二元（dyadic）目标为早期级分配更大坐标增量，并在训练前映射为固定嵌套支撑；每级更新以支撑转移为条件，同时保持采样掩码与数据一致性模块不变，兼容 Transformer 与卷积骨干。

Result: 在 fastMRI 与 Stanford2D 的单/多线圈重建中提升 HUMUSNet 和 NAFNet，并在放射科标注病理区域上有效；优于基于预测器的渐进策略且参数与推理延迟更低；逐级分析显示重复投影纠错、中间误差更低；消融支持 dyadic 分配优于均匀扩展和人工前置分配，支撑投影与转移条件化均有增益，跨数据集双向验证有效。

Conclusion: 支撑调度与正则器设计互补，可作为展开式 MRI 重建的通用增强策略。

Abstract: Accelerated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) forms images from incomplete Fourier measurements, shifting acquisition burden to computational reconstruction. Deep unrolled networks interleave learned regularization and data consistency, yet typically estimate the full unmeasured spectrum at every cascade. We propose STAIRS (Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling), which projects intermediate reconstructions onto nested Fourier supports that expand to the full spectrum and conditions each update on its support transition. Conditional increments of a regularized log-determinant score of training covariance define a normalized spectral coordinate, accounting for dependencies between newly and previously admitted frequencies. Dyadic targets allocate larger coordinate increments to earlier cascades and are mapped to fixed supports before training, enabling coarse-to-fine reconstruction with unchanged sampling masks and data consistency. On fastMRI and Stanford2D, STAIRS improves matched Transformer (HUMUSNet) and convolutional (NAFNet) backbones in single- and multi-coil reconstruction, including radiologist-annotated pathology regions. It also outperforms predictor-based progression with lower parameter overhead and inference latency. Stage-wise analysis shows repeated error correction by projection and lower intermediate reconstruction errors than the backbones alone throughout support expansion. Ablations favor dyadic allocation over uniform expansion for square and line-band supports and over manual front-loading for square windows. Support projection alone improves reconstruction, and transition conditioning strengthens the gain. Cross-dataset evaluation shows improvements for both backbones in both directions. Support allocation thus complements regularizer design in unrolled MRI reconstruction.

</details>


### [35] [Domain Generalization for Style-Debiased Object Detection via Label-Consistent Training across Multiple Styles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10262)
*Chaoran Zhang,Shirshak Bhusal,Zhilin Gao,Qiang Xue,Haoting Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种仅用源域数据的域泛化目标检测框架 OAMSC：借助扩散模型生成 20 种风格变体，并以场景级与目标级的"原点锚定"一致性约束抑制风格捷径，提升对未见域检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标检测的域泛化（DG）旨在提升模型在未见目标域上的表现，但现有检测器在视觉差异明显的目标域上性能显著下降。原因在于模型受限于有限的训练风格，容易过拟合表面的统计线索（风格捷径），而非学习目标级语义。受人类感知启发——人类主要关注语义相关特征、忽略无关的风格线索——作者希望从数据与训练约束两侧抑制风格敏感的捷径学习。

Method: 提出 Origin-Anchored Multi-Style Consistency（OAMSC），一个 source-only 框架，由两部分组成：（1）数据准备：利用现成的扩散模型将源数据集扩展为 20 种不同风格，并对所有生成图像进行人工校验，确保各风格变体间目标实例与标注保持一致；（2）训练阶段：在场景级和目标级施加"原点锚定"的一致性约束（origin-anchored consistency），强化域稳定特征学习、抑制风格敏感线索的影响。整体为数据中心的通用设计，可与其他 DG 方法互补。

Result: 在多个具有挑战性的 DG 基准上进行的大量实验与消融研究表明，OAMSC 在多样的域偏移下均具有稳定有效性与较强的泛化性能；方法同时适用于单阶段与两阶段检测器。此外，作者构建了两个风格迁移数据集（合计约 18 万张图像），并开源训练代码与数据集。

Conclusion: 通过多风格数据合成与跨风格一致性学习的结合，OAMSC 有效缓解了检测器对风格统计线索的过拟合，在不依赖目标域数据的前提下提升了跨域检测泛化能力，且具有良好的模型兼容性与方法互补性。

Abstract: Domain generalization (DG) for object detection aims to improve model performance on unseen target domains. Existing detectors, however, suffer substantial degradation on visually distinct unseen domains, as models confined to limited training styles tend to overfit superficial statistical cues rather than object-level semantics. Motivated by human perception, which attends primarily to semantically relevant features while ignoring irrelevant style cues, we propose Origin-Anchored Multi-Style Consistency (OAMSC), a source-only framework that couples multi-style data synthesis with cross-style consistency learning to suppress style-sensitive shortcut learning. For data preparation, we leverage off-the-shelf diffusion models to expand the source datasets into 20 distinct styles, with all generated images manually verified to ensure that object instances and annotations remain consistent across style variants. During training, we impose Origin-anchored consistency constraints at scene and object levels to reinforce the learning of domain-stable features while suppressing the influence of style-sensitive cues. Extensive experiments and ablation studies on multiple challenging DG benchmarks demonstrate the consistent effectiveness and strong generalization performance of OAMSC across diverse domain shifts. Notably, our approach applies to both one-stage and two-stage detectors, while its data-centric design is complementary in principle to other DG methods. The training code and two style-transfer datasets constructed for the experiments, comprising approximately 180K images in total, are publicly available on GitHub.

</details>


### [36] [LoCo: Selective Local Competition for Discriminative Open-Vocabulary Multi-Label Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10321)
*Zhuoming Li,Bo Han,Xiaoyu Wang,Yuheng Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文重新审视开放词表多标签识别中的局部预测，指出现有方法多聚焦全局图文匹配或文本侧表示而忽视局部预测。作者提出局部语义稀疏性视角，并据此设计LoCo框架，通过空间一致的视觉编码器、选择性Softmax与多尺度推理，将局部预测打造成强判别分支，在四个基准上显著超越TagCLIP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OV-MLR方法主要改进全局图文匹配或文本侧表示，局部预测研究不足。作者发现只要能处理好局部视觉特征的空间一致性与兼容性感知的局部竞争这两个性质，局部预测即可成为强判别分支。其依据是局部语义稀疏性：每个图像区域只与少量查询概念相关，但不同粒度或类型的兼容概念可能在局部共存。

Method: 提出LoCo（选择性局部竞争）框架：1）采用空间一致的视觉编码器减少局部特征纠缠；2）引入Selective Softmax，仅在局部不兼容类别之间施加竞争，同时保留兼容概念的响应；3）多尺度推理提升不同尺度下的局部预测；4）可与已有全局预测器集成，提供互补的图像级上下文。

Result: 在四个多标签基准上，单独使用LoCo相较TagCLIP平均F1提升3.4%、mAP提升3.8%；LoCo+DualPrompt在对比方法中取得最高平均成绩，分别比TagCLIP提升4.8%和5.2%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，局部语义稀疏性可作为开发更具判别力的开放词表多标签识别方法的有效基础，局部预测路线具备较大潜力。

Abstract: Open-Vocabulary Multi-Label Recognition (OV-MLR) aims to identify all queried semantic concepts present in an image. Existing methods mainly improve global image-text matching or text-side representations, leaving local prediction largely under-explored. In this paper, we revisit local prediction and reveal that it can serve as a strong discriminative branch once two properties are properly handled: spatial consistency of local visual features and compatibility-aware local competition. This perspective is motivated by local semantic sparsity: each image region is related to only a small subset of queried concepts, while compatible concepts of different granularities or types may still coexist locally. We instantiate this perspective with LoCo, a selective Local Competition framework for OV-MLR. LoCo adopts a spatially consistent visual encoder to reduce local feature entanglement, and introduces Selective Softmax to impose competition only among locally incompatible categories while preserving compatible responses. Multi-scale inference further improves local prediction at different scales. LoCo can also be ensembled with an existing global predictor to provide complementary image-level context. Experiments on four multi-label benchmarks show that standalone LoCo improves average F1-score and mAP over TagCLIP by 3.4% and 3.8%, respectively. LoCo + DualPrompt achieves the highest averages among the compared methods, with gains of 4.8% and 5.2% over TagCLIP. Our results suggest that local semantic sparsity offers a useful basis for developing more discriminative open-vocabulary multi-label recognition methods. The code is available at https://github.com/lee-plus-plus/LoCo.

</details>


### [37] [TimeTraveler: Temporal Strategy Planning with Time Dictionary for Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10337)
*Minkuk Kim,Junho Kim,Seong Tae Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TimeTraveler 提出用"时间词典"（timestamp 索引的结构化字幕）作为可查询的显式证据源，并为每个查询做时间策略规划（回看过去 / 读取当下 / 等待未来），在流式视频问答上优于依赖紧凑视觉记忆或固定证据访问方式的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频理解（SVU）中，答案的证据可能在过去、当前场景，甚至需要等待未来观测才出现。现有流式系统多依赖紧凑视觉记忆或固定的证据访问机制，容易丢失细粒度细节，也无法根据每个查询的时间意图自适应调整回答过程。

Method: 提出 TimeTraveler 流式 VQA 框架，核心是"时间词典"（Time Dictionary）：将每个已观测时刻存储为以时间戳索引的结构化字幕，构成可查询的显式证据源。给定查询后，模型先进行时间策略规划，判断应回溯过去证据、读取当前上下文，还是等待未来观测，再执行对应策略的证据获取流程。

Result: 在流式视频问答基准上的对比实验表明，TimeTraveler 通过保留细粒度时间证据并为每个查询选择合适的时序策略，提升了流式问答表现。项目主页：https://geppa.github.io/TimeTraveler。

Conclusion: 将流式视频中的观测压缩为时间戳索引的结构化字幕词典，并显式建模"过去—现在—未来"的时序策略选择，是兼顾细粒度证据保留与查询自适应的一种有效方案。

Abstract: Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires models to answer user queries over continuously evolving video streams. Unlike offline video QA, SVU must handle queries whose evidence may lie in the past, appear in the current scene, or emerge only after future observations. Existing streaming video systems often rely on compact visual memories or fixed evidence-access schemes, which can lose fine-grained details and fail to adapt the answering process to the temporal intent of each query. In this paper, we propose TimeTraveler, a streaming VQA framework that performs temporal strategy planning with a Time Dictionary. Inspired by the need to search across different temporal regions of a stream, TimeTraveler stores each observed moment as a timestamp-indexed structured caption and uses this dictionary as an explicit source of queryable evidence. Given a query, TimeTraveler determines whether to recall past evidence, read the present context, or wait for future observations, and then applies a strategy-specific evidence acquisition process. Comparative experiments on streaming video QA benchmarks show that TimeTraveler improves streaming question answering by preserving fine-grained temporal evidence and selecting the appropriate temporal strategy for each query. The project page is available at https://geppa.github.io/TimeTraveler.

</details>

*Nathaniel Redmond,Fidel Omar Tito Cruz,Devansh Sharma,Shehreen Azad,Sirshapan Mitra,Shruti Vyas,Yogesh S. Rawat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出MaRiO基准，用于评估多智能体协作场景下多模态大模型的跨视角推理能力，并发现现有模型在跨智能体对应关系与几何线索利用上的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型评测多集中于单视角或共享相机参数的多视角设定，忽略了多个智能体从各自独立视角观测同一环境并协同推理的挑战。
