Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong visual perception capabilities, but existing evaluations largely focus on single-view or multi-view settings with shared camera parameters, leaving the challenge of multi-agent collaborative scenarios underexplored. In such settings, multiple agents observe a shared environment from independent viewpoints, and reliable decisions require reasoning across these independent observations of the same environment. To study this problem, we introduce MaRiO, a benchmark for evaluating multi-agent collaborative reasoning, and evaluate 23 state-of-the-art MLLMs on it. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) tasks governed by static perception are generally easier than tasks that require transformational event sequences; (2) most models struggle to resolve cross-agent correspondences, with errors increasing with scene complexity; and (3) models show limited ability to leverage geometric cues present in the scene. As an initial step toward addressing these challenges, we explore geometry-guided synthetic view augmentation that generates intermediate transition frames between agent observations, providing auxiliary spatial context that improves performance in certain categories. Overall, our results highlight that multi-agent collaborative reasoning remains an open challenge and an important direction for multimodal embodied systems. The code is available on the project page: https://omarftt.github.io/MaRiO-page/.

</details>


### [39] [PoseBench: Probing Pose Awareness in Visual Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10347)
*Most Nilufa Yeasmin,Draix Wyatt,Ruyi Lian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PoseBench，系统评测预训练2D视觉基础模型特征中的姿态感知能力，发现其是隐式但非均匀的性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 姿态感知（特征空间与物体姿态流形对齐）对姿态敏感的3D视觉任务有价值，但主流2D视觉基础模型仅用单张图像预训练，缺乏显式3D/姿态监督，因此需要回答：大规模预训练后它们是否具备姿态感知能力？

Method: 构建PoseBench基准：采用渐进式评估设计，用留出渲染视图探测受控条件下的内在姿态感知结构，用真实图像查询评估该结构在真实世界变化下的可访问性与鲁棒性；并引入基于姿态图的 refinement 作为补充探针，检验特征邻域与姿态流形的兼容性。评测覆盖10个预训练家族、31个公开检查点。

Result: 结果显示姿态感知是2D视觉基础模型的一种隐式但非均匀的性质；姿态图refinement带来一致增益，说明特征空间保留了与底层姿态流形兼容的结构。

Conclusion: PoseBench为理解并选择适用于姿态敏感3D视觉任务的预训练特征提供了系统化依据。

Abstract: Pose awareness characterizes the extent to which a learned feature space aligns with the underlying object-pose manifold, such that observations with similar poses exhibit greater feature similarity than those with increasingly different poses. While such structure is desirable for pose-sensitive 3D vision tasks, visual foundation models pre-trained on individual 2D images typically lack explicit 3D or pose supervision. This raises a fundamental question: Do 2D visual foundation models exhibit pose awareness after large-scale pretraining? To answer this question, we introduce PoseBench, a systematic benchmark to probe pose awareness in pretrained visual features. Our evaluation follows a progressive design: held-out rendered views probe intrinsic pose-aware structure under controlled conditions, while real-image queries evaluate how robustly this structure remains accessible under real-world variations. We further introduce pose-graph-based refinement as a complementary probe of compatibility between feature neighborhoods and the underlying pose manifold. Across 31 publicly available checkpoints from 10 pretraining families, PoseBench reveals that pose awareness is an implicit but non-uniform property of 2D visual foundation models, and consistent gains from pose-graph refinement suggest that feature spaces retain structure compatible with the underlying pose manifold. PoseBench therefore provides a systematic basis for understanding and selecting pretrained features for pose-sensitive 3D vision tasks.

</details>


### [40] [Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating for Multimodal Medical Data Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10348)
*Muntaqim Ahmed Raju,Priyanka Siddappa,Md Shifat Haider Al Amin,Ruizhe Ma,Md Ripon Ahammed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"引导式共注意力+自适应门控"多模态融合框架，用token级引导、双向交叉注意力和样本自适应门控构建方向性图文表示，在胸片-报告二分类任务上取得96.05%准确率等指标的最优平均表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态融合不仅需要跨模态信息交换，还需明确"哪些表示应参与交互"以及"互补的跨模态视角应如何组合"，而现有做法往往忽略交互方向性与token相关性、且采用样本无关的融合方式。

Method: 包含三个组件：(1) token级引导（token-wise guidance），在交叉注意力之前对表示进行调制；(2) 双向交叉注意力，构造两个方向性表示——文本token查询视觉特征得到的"图像条件化文本表示"，以及反向的"文本条件化图像表示"；(3) 自适应门控（adaptive gate），为每个样本学习两个方向表示的相对贡献权重。在配对的胸部X光片与放射报告数据上做正常/异常二分类，并进行消融实验。

Result: 两个交叉注意力方向表现出明显不同的性能特征，说明互换查询模态与源模态并不能得到可互换的表示。消融实验显示双向交互、自适应门控与token引导带来互补增益。模型达到96.05%准确率、96.10% F1、98.37% AUC、95.60% Sens@95Spec、96.51% Spec@95Sens，在所有评估指标上平均性能最高。

Conclusion: 构建多模态表示时应显式建模交互方向、token相关性与样本相关的融合方式，这三者共同带来性能提升。

Abstract: Multimodal fusion requires not only exchanging information across modalities but also determining which representations should participate in the interaction and how complementary cross-modal views should be combined. We introduce Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating, a fusion framework that integrates token-wise guidance, bidirectional cross-attention, and sample-specific fusion. The proposed method constructs two directional representations: an image-conditioned text representation, obtained by allowing textual tokens to query visual features, and a text-conditioned image representation formed in the reverse direction. Token-wise guidance modulates the representations before cross-attention, while an adaptive gate learns the relative contribution of the two resulting directional representations for each sample. We evaluate the approach using paired chest radiographs and radiology reports as an image-text test bed for binary (normal vs. abnormal) classification. The two cross-attention directions exhibit distinct performance characteristics, demonstrating that reversing the query and source modalities does not produce interchangeable representations. Ablation experiments further show that bidirectional interaction, adaptive gating, and token guidance provide complementary benefits. The proposed model achieves 96.05% accuracy, 96.10% F1-score, 98.37% AUC, 95.60% Sens@95Spec, and 96.51% Spec@95Sens, yielding the highest mean performance across all evaluated metrics. These findings support explicitly modeling interaction direction, token relevance, and sample-dependent integration when constructing multimodal representations.

</details>


### [41] [DAPointRWKV: Domain Adaptive Vision RWKV for Point Cloud Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10353)
*Yinghui Li,Qianyu Zhou,Hao Yang,Richard Dazeley,Ye Zhu,Xuequan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DAPointRWKV框架，将RWKV引入域自适应点云补全，通过几何感知RWKV骨干、渐进式解码器与双结构正则化三组件实现线性复杂度的高精度跨域形状补全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 域自适应点云补全需弥合有标签源域与无标签目标域的几何差异。现有CNN/Transformer/Mamba类方法存在感受野受限、计算复杂度高、几何偏置不足、序列化敏感等问题。RWKV虽具线性复杂度长程建模能力，但直接用于该任务存在缺乏显式几何先验、循环建模与由粗到细生成不匹配、目标域自适应不稳定三大障碍。

Method: DAPointRWKV包含三个组件：(1) Geometry-Aware RWKV (GA-RWKV) 骨干，引入几何感知的循环表示学习以嵌入显式几何先验；(2) RWKV-Oriented Progressive Decoder (RWKV-PD)，通过局部token引导的细化，将RWKV token表示与由粗到细的重建过程衔接；(3) Dual Structural Regularization (DSR)，以可见结构锚定与完整形状假设稳定化来提升目标域迁移稳定性。

Result: 在合成与真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，DAPointRWKV一致优于现有最先进方法，验证了其在跨域点云补全上的有效性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该工作首次系统地将RWKV适配到域自适应点云补全，证明线性复杂度序列建模在结合几何先验与结构正则化后，可兼顾效率与跨域补全精度，为该方向提供了新的建模范式。

Abstract: Domain adaptive point cloud completion (DA PCC) aims to bridge the geometric discrepancy between labeled source domains and unlabeled target domains for accurate 3D shape completion. Existing methods based on CNNs, Transformers, and Mamba-like sequence models still face challenges from limited receptive fields, high computational complexity, insufficient geometric bias, and serialization sensitivity. Recently, Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) provides a linear-complexity alternative for long-range sequence modeling. However, adapting RWKV to DA PCC remains challenging due to the lack of explicit geometric priors, the mismatch between recurrent modeling and coarse-to-fine generation, and unstable target-domain adaptation. To address these challenges, we propose DAPointRWKV, a novel RWKV-based framework for DA PCC. DAPointRWKV consists of three components: Geometry-Aware RWKV (GA-RWKV) Backbone, RWKV-Oriented Progressive Decoder (RWKV-PD), and Dual Structural Regularization (DSR). Specifically, GA-RWKV introduces geometry-aware recurrent representation learning, RWKV-PD bridges RWKV token representations with coarse-to-fine reconstruction through local token-guided refinement, and DSR stabilizes target-domain transfer through visible-structure anchoring and complete-shape hypothesis stabilization. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that DAPointRWKV consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [42] [ClearForm: Shared-Surface Gaussian Splatting for Transparent and Opaque Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10370)
*Hajeong Lee,Jong-Il Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ClearForm：基于共享平面高斯与双不透明度合成的透明界面重建方法，解决几何-外观合成困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 透明界面重建困难：观测色彩大多来自背后场景，若同一透明度相关 alpha 同时控制颜色与几何合成，揭示背景会削弱透明表面对几何重建的贡献，形成 Geometry-Appearance Compositing Dilemma（GACD），并降低平面深度估计中的界面支撑。

Method: 提出 ClearForm：共享平面高斯表示，采用几何保持的双不透明度表面重建——共享平面高斯在几何合成中保留界面贡献，同时在 RGB 中建模透射与稀疏反射，并配以透明度感知的几何约束；引入 Dual-Evidence Lifecycle（DEL），依据多视角几何或 RGB 重建证据保留高斯原语，以适配不同合成器对原语可见性的需求。

Result: 3D-FRONT-T 上 CD 27.05 mm、F1 0.928（PGSR 复现 59.18 mm，GLINT 报告 34 mm CD / 0.836 F1）；TransLab 上 CD 1.65 mm、F1 0.963、PSNR 40.14 dB。匹配消融中，双不透明度合成将 CD 从 59.25 降至 27.09 mm，DEL 提升 PSNR 2.06 dB。

Conclusion: 通过解耦几何与外观的不透明度合成并管理原语生命周期，可有效缓解 GACD，实现高精度透明界面几何与大范围外观的同时重建。

Abstract: Transparent-interface reconstruction must recover glass surfaces even when most observed color comes from the scene behind them. We present ClearForm, a shared-planar-Gaussian method for jointly reconstructing transparent interfaces and the appearance seen through them. We identify and analyze the Geometry-Appearance Compositing Dilemma (GACD): when the same transparency-dependent alpha controls both color and geometry, revealing the background can weaken a transparent surface's contribution to geometric reconstruction. We derive its effect on plane-based depth estimation, identify a mechanism that can weaken geometric learning, and quantify the loss of interface support through controlled comparisons. To address this conflict, we develop geometry-preserving dual-opacity surface reconstruction. Shared planar Gaussians retain interface contributions in geometry compositing while modeling transmission and sparse reflection in RGB, supported by transparency-aware geometric constraints. To manage the different primitive-visibility requirements of these compositors, we introduce Dual-Evidence Lifecycle (DEL), which retains Gaussians supported by multi-view geometry or RGB reconstruction evidence. On 3D-FRONT-T, ClearForm achieves 27.05 mm Chamfer distance (CD) and 0.928 F1, compared with 59.18 mm CD for our PGSR reproduction and the reported 34 mm CD and 0.836 F1 for GLINT. On TransLab, it achieves 1.65 mm CD, 0.963 F1, and 40.14 dB PSNR. In matched ablations, dual-opacity compositing reduces CD from 59.25 to 27.09 mm, while DEL improves PSNR by 2.06 dB. Our project page is available at https://hajeongx.github.io/clearform/.

</details>


### [43] [PhysDNet: Physics-Driven Gradient Amplification for Real-Time Image Dehazing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10376)
*Rayen Dhahri,Lei Sun,Victor Javier Kartsch Morinigo,Alice Pagnoux,Luca Benini,Danda Pani Paudel,Luc Van Gool*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量多模态去雾网络PhysDNet，融合NIR与稀疏LiDAR深度，并用物理约束双头目标训练，实现低算力边缘实时去雾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去雾网络计算开销大、易过拟合合成雾，难以在资源受限的边缘设备上实时部署；实际动态环境需要高效、高保真且泛化较好的复原方法。

Method: 构建轻量多模态架构，融合近红外图像与稀疏LiDAR深度；采用物理约束双头训练目标，通过对固定Koschmieder反演进行可微分化，形成密度自适应梯度放大，将学习资源集中于退化严重区域，且不增加推理成本。

Result: 在Seeing Through Fog基准上，以低5.2倍计算量取得领先1.67 dB的提升，并恢复54.9%的雾致检测损失；消融与跨域实验显示物理引导训练提升泛化性，包括违反Koschmieder假设的非均匀雾；L/M/S变体在<4 W下分别达到29/45/99 FPS，兼容固定功能NPU。

Conclusion: PhysDNet以极小容量实现高质量去雾和更高训练效率，兼顾边缘实时部署与跨域泛化，证明物理约束训练可在不增加推理开销的前提下改善资源分配与恢复效果。

Abstract: Modern dehazing networks are often computationally expensive and overfit to synthetic haze, limiting real-time deployment. This underscores an urgent demand for efficient, high-fidelity restoration methods that can operate on resource-constrained edge devices in practical, dynamic environments. We introduce PhysDNet, a lightweight multimodal architecture that fuses NIR imagery with sparse LiDAR depth and is trained with a physics-constrained dual-head objective. Differentiating through a fixed Koschmieder inversion induces density-adaptive gradient amplification, acting as an implicit resource allocation mechanism that concentrates learning on heavily degraded regions without increasing inference cost. PhysDNet delivers superior restoration with minimal capacity and enhanced training efficiency, facilitating real-time deployment on edge devices without increasing inference overhead. On the Seeing Through Fog benchmark, PhysDNet outperforms competitors by 1.67 dB at 5.2 times lower compute while recovering 54.9% of fog-induced detection loss. Ablations and cross-domain evaluations show that physics-guided training improves generalization, including under non-homogeneous haze that violates the Koschmieder assumption. PhysDNet further demonstrates compatibility with fixed-function NPUs, running at 29/45/99 FPS at <4 W across L/M/S variants. Code, deployment scripts and pre-trained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Heatdh/PhysDnet.

</details>

*Zhangding Liu,Neda Mohammadi,John E. Taylor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究评估 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在野火-城市交界区（WUI）活跃火场中做结构级火灾威胁识别的能力，采用"合成场景 + 受控燃烧实验"双轨评分协议：合成轨有效输出准确率 94.0%，受控燃烧轨 69.2%（随机基线 16.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WUI 火灾日益威胁社区与基础设施，亟需快速视觉评估手段。既有研究多集中于火灾检测与灾后损失评估，而"活跃火事件进行中"的结构级威胁识别仍研究不足，缺少可规模化的评测手段与真实火条件下的参照基准。

Result: 零样本下合成轨 1,808/1,824、受控燃烧轨 39/45 返回有效目标字段；有效输出准确率分别为 94.0% 与 69.2%，受控燃烧轨随机基线为 16.0%。当火蔓延线索视觉上较为显著时，模型在多样设计场景中基本能锁定目标；受控燃烧轨表现显著优于随机，但错误主要源于复杂场景中空间关系理解困难。

Conclusion: 双轨协议兼具可扩展的压力测试能力（设计场景）与物理火条件下的行为参照（受控燃烧）。作者建议后续利用合成数据对 VLM 进行后训练，再在更大规模、更多样的真实 WUI 火灾数据集上评估适配后的模型。

Abstract: Wildland urban interface (WUI) fires increasingly threaten communities and infrastructure, motivating the need for rapid visual assessment. Recent research has focused primarily on detecting fire and assessing post-event damage. However, structure-level fire threat identification during active WUI fire events remains underexplored. This study evaluates Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct for this active-fire decision using two separately scored tracks: 1,824 synthetic images from 491 designed WUI scenarios and 45 frames from a controlled-burn experiment conducted in collaboration with Columbus Fire & EMS Department. Under zero-shot prompting, the model returned valid target fields for 1,808 synthetic images and 39 controlled-burn frames. Accuracy among valid outputs was 94.0% for the synthetic track and 69.2% for the controlled-burn track, compared with a 16.0% random-selection baseline for the latter. On the synthetic track, the model generally identified the intended target across varied designed WUI scenarios when the relevant fire-spread cues were visually distinct. Controlled-burn performance was well above random selection, but errors showed difficulty interpreting spatial relations in complex scenes. The dual-track protocol provides scalable stress testing in designed scenarios and a controlled-burn reference for assessing model behavior under physical fire conditions. Future work can use the synthetic data for VLM post-training and then evaluate the adapted models on larger and more diverse real WUI fire datasets.

</details>


### [45] [RefineSplat: Reconstruction-Guided Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10379)
*Yiren Lu,Disheng Liu,Sreya Srinidhi,Yunlai Zhou,Yiran Qiao,Chaoda Song,Tuo Liang,Jing Ma,Huan Wang,Yu Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RefineSplat：在Segment-then-Splat框架基础上，通过重建引导的反馈机制与视角感知嵌入，实现更鲁棒的开放词汇3D场景分割与检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇3D场景理解多采用"先重建后分割"范式（splat-then-segment），但存在视角不一致、物体边界模糊、物体级对应弱等问题，尤其在复杂静态与动态场景中表现欠佳。

Method: 基于此前的Segment-then-Splat框架提出RefineSplat：(1)保持以物体为中心范式，先2D追踪再为每个物体用专属3D高斯重建，保留显式物体-高斯对应；(2)引入重建引导的反馈机制，利用渲染掩码与多视角一致性修正2D追踪；(3)提出视角感知嵌入分配策略，为每个物体维护多个视角聚类嵌入；(4)构建Blender-OVS合成基准，含精确物体网格与点云。

Result: 在静态与动态基准上实验显示：渲染视角分割性能提升，物体级Chamfer距离降低，同时保持有竞争力的场景重建质量。

Conclusion: 通过闭环化2D追踪与3D重建、引入视角感知语义嵌入，并构建精确几何评测基准，RefineSplat为开放词汇3D分割与检索提供了更鲁棒的以物体为中心解决方案。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment and retrieve arbitrary objects in 3D scenes using natural language queries. Most existing methods typically follow a splat-then-segment paradigm, where 3D Gaussian Splatting is first reconstructed and then augmented with labels or language features for subsequent segmentation. However, this pipeline often suffers from view inconsistency, ambiguous object boundaries, and weak object-level correspondence, especially in complex static and dynamic scenes. Building on our prior Segment-then-Splat framework, we present RefineSplat, a reconstruction-guided extension that retains its object-centric paradigm: it first tracks objects in 2D and then reconstructs each object with a dedicated set of 3D Gaussians, preserving explicit object-Gaussian correspondence for unified open-vocabulary segmentation and retrieval. To improve robustness, we further close the loop between 2D tracking and 3D reconstruction. Since off-the-shelf video trackers can produce unreliable masks that propagate errors into object reconstruction, we introduce a reconstruction-guided feedback mechanism that refines object tracking using rendered masks and multi-view consistency. Moreover, instead of assigning each object a single language embedding, we propose a viewpoint-aware embedding assignment strategy, where each object maintains multiple view-clustered embeddings to capture view-dependent semantic cues. We also introduce Blender-OVS, a synthetic benchmark of static and dynamic sequences with exact object meshes and point clouds, enabling direct evaluation of extracted geometry. Experiments on static and dynamic benchmarks show improved rendered-view segmentation and lower object-level Chamfer distances, with competitive scene reconstruction quality.

</details>


### [46] [From Reflection to Co-Evolution: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10382)
*Xinxiang Yin,Xinglang Zhang,Haodong Chen,Zhiqing Cui,Weidong Tang,Yuxuan Wang,Junrui Wang,Jingyi Zhang,Jianfeng Zhang,Jian Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以"记忆的来源决策"作为留存检验：定位关键轨迹步、抽取候选记忆，并在相同上下文中带/不带该候选重放来源决策，据此构建 Anchor——按"分布偏移幅度"与"来源角色一致性"双重筛选记忆，使冻结策略也能实现经验驱动的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在长程交互中学习需依赖记忆，但看似合理的经验可能冗余，甚至强化不当行为；现有方法缺少一个可操作的标准来判断某条记忆是否值得保留。作者据此提出：能否用"记忆来源决策"的重放结果作为留存与否的实用检验。

Method: 1) 定位轨迹中具有因果影响的步骤并抽取候选记忆；2) 在相同上下文中，分别带与不带该候选记忆重放其来源决策，测量对决策分布的偏移。基于两个观察——多数候选几乎不改变探测分布、成功与失败的来源动作都可能被强化或抑制——提出 Anchor：在记忆留存前同时检验"偏移幅度"和"来源-角色一致性"，通过筛选的记忆用于指导后续轨迹。

Result: 在留出的 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 任务上，相对各主干网络的最强基线，成功率与平均分最高分别提升 19.9% 和 17.2%；使用 Qwen3.5-27B 时，ALFWorld 保留的记忆卡片比未筛选版本少 41%，且在 WebShop 上以更少 token 优于全部四个成本对比基线。

Conclusion: 以来源决策重放作为记忆留存检验是可行且有效的：在冻结策略下即可实现经验驱动的持续改进，同时显著降低记忆数量与 token 成本，兼顾效果与效率。

Abstract: LLM agents have made impressive progress in coding and mathematical reasoning, motivating growing interest in learning from long-horizon interaction. Memory supports this process, but plausible lessons can be redundant or reinforce inappropriate actions. Can a memory's source decision provide a practical test for whether to retain it? We localize consequential trajectory steps, extract candidate memories, and replay each source decision with and without its candidate under the same context. This reveals two properties: most candidates barely shift the probed distribution, and both successful and failed source actions can be reinforced or suppressed. These observations motivate Anchor, which tests shift magnitude and source-role alignment before retention. Admitted memories guide later trajectories, enabling experience-driven improvement under a frozen policy. On held-out ALFWorld and WebShop tasks, Anchor improves success rate and mean score by up to 19.9% and 17.2%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline for each backbone. With Qwen3.5-27B, it retains 41% fewer ALFWorld cards than unfiltered retention and outperforms all four WebShop cost-comparison baselines while using fewer tokens.

</details>


### [47] [Tiresias: Towards Language-Conditioned World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10392)
*Fengyi Wu,Yifei Dong,Yetong Sha,Lingdong Kong,Qiyu Hu,Bohan Xiong,Qi Dai,Alexander G. Hauptmann,Zhi-Qi Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出统一的语言条件世界建模任务 LCWM 及基准 LCWM-Bench（15 个数据集、142,987 条轨迹、428,961 条指令），并提出选择性想象智能体 Tiresias：扩散策略生成候选轨迹、轨迹排序器筛选、视频预训练世界模型想象视觉后果、视觉排序器评估，最终选出最优规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型可借助内部模拟支持规划，自然语言又是直观的任务指定方式，但现有语言条件世界建模研究分散在导航、机器人、3D 游戏、驾驶等不同领域，动作空间、数据集与评测协议各不相同，缺乏可比与可迁移的统一评估环境。

Method: 1）定义共享任务 LCWM：输入初始智能体视角观测与语言指令，输出可完成指令的动作序列；2）构建 LCWM-Bench，整合 15 个数据集（导航、机器人、3D 游戏、驾驶），统一动作接口与评测协议，包含 142,987 条 episode、428,961 条三种风格的指令；3）提出 Tiresias 智能体：语言条件扩散策略生成候选轨迹，轨迹排序器做初筛，视频预训练世界模型对各候选进行视觉后果想象，再由视觉排序器评估 rollout，结合轨迹分数选出最终规划。

Result: Tiresias 在 LCWM-Bench 上取得有竞争力的规划与想象性能；消融实验表明轨迹排序与视觉验证带来互补收益；替换候选生成方式（其他 proposal 方法）后，训练得到的排序器依然有效，说明其不依赖特定扩散策略。

Conclusion: LCWM-Bench 与 Tiresias 共同提供了一个统一评测设定与有效起点，为研究基于世界模型的语言引导规划奠定基础，并展示"选择性想象"（先筛选、再想象、再视觉校验）是一种可行且具扩展性的规划范式。

Abstract: World models enable planning through internal simulation, while natural language provides intuitive task specification. Yet, language-conditioned world modeling remains fragmented across domains with disparate action spaces, datasets, and evaluation protocols. We introduce LCWM, a shared task that maps an initial agent-view observation and a language instruction to an action sequence that fulfills the instruction. Its accompanying benchmark, LCWM-Bench, integrates 15 datasets across navigation, robotics, 3D gaming, and driving under a shared action interface and evaluation protocol, pairing 142,987 episodes with 428,961 instructions in three styles. We further propose Tiresias, an agent that plans via selective imagination: a language-conditioned diffusion policy generates candidate trajectories, a trajectory ranker shortlists them, and a video-pretrained world model imagines their visual consequences. A visual ranker evaluates these rollouts, complementing trajectory scores to select the final plan. Tiresias achieves competitive planning and imagination performance on LCWM-Bench. Ablations demonstrate the complementary benefits of trajectory ranking and visual verification, while experiments with alternative proposal methods show that the trained rankers remain effective beyond our diffusion policy. Together, LCWM-Bench and Tiresias provide a unified evaluation setting and an effective starting point for studying language-guided planning through world models.

</details>


### [48] [Frequency-Structure Complementary Modeling for Hyperspectral Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10413)
*Song Qiya,Tian Siyu,Li Shutao,Dian Renwei,Sun Long,Liu Jinyang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FSCM-Net，通过频域依赖学习与结构自适应局部细化互补，提升多光谱/高光谱融合的空间细节重建与光谱保真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法多依赖卷积聚合或注意力空间-光谱交互：传统特征域注意力未显式刻画空间token与潜通道坐标上的变化模式，空间共享局部算子也难以适应异质结构。

Method: 设计空间-光谱频率校准注意力（SSFCA）：由傅里叶交互的query-key表示构建空间token亲和性，并在输入条件频域滤波后沿学习到的通道坐标构建潜通道亲和性，经共享增益校准后与空间响应融合；设计结构一致动态特征融合（SC-DFF）：结合MSI正则化结构张量线索与上下文调制HSI细节，生成通道和位置相关的聚合核；两模块嵌入多尺度编码器-解码器。

Result: 在两个模拟基准和一个真实遥感数据集上，相较代表性融合方法，在空间细节重建和光谱保持方面取得更优性能。

Conclusion: 频域依赖建模与结构自适应局部细化具有互补性，联合嵌入多尺度框架可有效协调表示级交互与结构自适应重建。

Abstract: Existing methods mainly rely on convolutional aggregation or attention-based spatial-spectral interaction. However, conventional feature-domain attention does not explicitly characterize variation patterns along spatial-token and learned latent-channel coordinates, while spatially shared local operators lack the flexibility to adapt neighborhood aggregation to heterogeneous structures. To address these limitations, we propose a Frequency-Structure Complementary Modeling Network (FSCM-Net), which couples frequency-aware dependency learning with structure-adaptive local refinement. Specifically, a Spatial-Spectral Frequency Calibration Attention (SSFCA) module constructs spatial-token affinities from Fourier-interacted query-key representations and builds latent-channel affinities after input-conditioned frequency filtering along learned channel coordinates. The latent-channel response is then calibrated by a learned shared gain and combined with the spatial-token response. Complementarily, a Structure-Coherent Dynamic Feature Fusion (SC-DFF) module combines regularized structure-tensor cues from MSI features with context-modulated HSI detail representations to generate channel- and position-dependent aggregation kernels. This design makes local HSI refinement responsive to smooth regions, edges, and textures while maintaining spectral fidelity. The two modules are progressively integrated within a multiscale encoder-decoder to coordinate representation-level interaction and structure-adaptive reconstruction. Experiments on two simulated benchmarks and one real remote-sensing dataset demonstrate favorable performance against representative fusion methods in spatial detail reconstruction and spectral preservation.

</details>


### [49] [ESTRA: Enabling Extreme Attention Sparsity for Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10448)
*Enhuai Liu,Yunke Wang,Yutong Wang,Changming Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ESTRA：一种无需训练的极端稀疏注意力加速方法，在仅5%注意力密度下即可实现3.26×—4.71×端到端加速，并保持接近稠密生成的视频质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散Transformer因长时空序列上的注意力计算而推理开销巨大。稀疏注意力可降低成本，而现有免训练方法在高稀疏度下质量迅速下降，限制了可获得的加速比，因此需要一种在高稀疏度下仍能保持生成质量的方法。

Method: ESTRA将精确注意力集中于少量重要key-value token，其余贡献用簇代表近似。为高效识别重要token，先对相似query分组，用其代表对单个key打分；并引入基于方差的校正来细化簇代表的注意力权重，提高近似精度。整个过程无需训练。

Result: 在Wan2.1-14B与HunyuanVideo-13B上，ESTRA在5%注意力密度下分别取得3.26×和4.71×端到端加速，且在保真度和多数VBench维度上优于Sol-Attn与SVG-EAR。即使密度低至1%，其相对稠密生成的保真度仍优于12.5%密度的Sol-Attn，加速比最高达5.39×。

Conclusion: ESTRA为免训练稀疏注意力建立了新的质量—效率前沿，表明通过重要性token选取、query分组打分与方差校正，可在极端稀疏度下兼顾视频生成质量与推理速度。

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but attention over long spatiotemporal sequences makes inference computationally expensive. Sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only a subset of query-key interactions exactly, and recent training-free methods further approximate the remaining interactions. These methods, however, degrade quickly at high sparsity, which limits the achievable speedup. We present ESTRA (Extreme Sparsity Through Refined Attention), a training-free acceleration method that preserves generation quality even at extreme sparsity. ESTRA concentrates exact attention computation on a small set of important key-value tokens and approximates the remaining contributions with cluster representatives. To identify these tokens efficiently, it groups similar queries and uses their representatives to score individual keys. A variance-based correction further refines the attention weights of the cluster representatives, improving the accuracy of the approximation. Experiments on Wan2.1-14B and HunyuanVideo-13B show that ESTRA establishes a new quality-efficiency frontier for training-free sparse attention, achieving $3.26\times$ and $4.71\times$ end-to-end speedups at 5% attention density while surpassing Sol-Attn and SVG-EAR in fidelity to dense generation and on most VBench dimensions. Even at 1% density, ESTRA remains more faithful to dense generation than Sol-Attn at 12.5%, while reaching up to $5.39\times$ speedup.

</details>


### [50] [WordEval: Evaluating Word-Native Operation Fidelity in Document Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10475)
*Jinyoung Park,Yupan Huang,Shimin Zhang,Jiayu Ding,Yilin Jia,Yuzhong Zhao,Tengchao Lv,Wenshan Wu,Shaohan Huang,Nan Yang,Xiangyang Zhou,Dongdong Zhang,Li Dong,Lei Cui,Sun Mao,Xun Wang,Tao Ge,Huitian Jiao,Si-Qing Chen,Changick Kim,Furu Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 WordEval——一个以"编辑操作保真度"为核心的 Word 文档智能体基准，通过 Word 原生对象/属性校验，测出各智能体在原子编辑与组合编辑上的能力落差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Word 是办公自动化的核心环境，但其编辑会修改结构化对象模型（效果体现在对象属性上），不同于纯文本编辑。现有基准把文档处理当作众多任务域之一，用关键词匹配、逐任务属性检查或截图对比来判定结果，无法验证"每个编辑是否按意图落实到 Word 对象与属性上"。

Method: 构建 WordEval 基准：共 642 个用例、覆盖 15 个 Word 功能域（文字、列表、图表、形状几何、SmartArt 等）。其中 546 个原子用例覆盖 231 条命令，96 个组合用例在同一文档中叠加多次编辑；用 Word 原生 oracle 检查任务相关的对象属性与保持性条件。用例由"编辑单元规范"构造，生成受控输入文档、参考文档与对齐的 oracle 检查；每个组合用例关联对应原子用例，以支持细粒度失败诊断。

Result: 评测 8 个智能体系统：许多系统在 Atomic 轨道上表现不佳，且各功能域之间性能差异明显；所有系统在 Compositional 上均低于 Atomic，且差距大小因系统而异。原子意图链接与记录的失败诊断提供了互补的视角来解释这些差异。

Conclusion: 以操作保真度为中心的评测能揭示现有办公类基准掩盖的编辑失败模式；原子—组合双层结构与失败诊断链路可用于定位智能体在 Word 对象级编辑上的具体短板，为后续改进提供依据。

Abstract: Microsoft Word is a central environment for office automation, and the faithful execution of its editing operations is an important capability for document agents. Unlike plain-text editing, editing in Word modifies a structured object model, where the requested effect is realized in object properties. Existing benchmarks, however, evaluate office workflows or desktop automation, treating word-processor documents as one task domain among many and verifying outcomes with keyword matching, per-task property checks, or screenshot comparison. We introduce WordEval, an operation-fidelity benchmark that instead centers evaluation on Word editing operations, testing whether each requested edit is realized as intended changes to Word objects and properties. It contains 642 cases across 15 Word feature areas, ranging from text and lists to charts, shape geometry, and SmartArt. 546 atomic cases cover 231 commands, 96 compositional cases combine multiple edits in a single document, and a Word-native oracle checks task-specific object properties and preservation conditions. Cases are constructed from editing-unit specifications, yielding controlled input documents, reference documents, and aligned oracle checks. Each compositional case is linked to corresponding atomic cases, supporting fine-grained diagnosis of editing failures. We evaluate eight agent systems and find that many struggle on the Atomic track, with performance varying across feature areas. Moreover, every system scores lower on Compositional than on Atomic, with gaps that vary substantially by system. Exact atomic-intent links and recorded failure diagnoses provide complementary views of this variation.

</details>


### [51] [They Can See It but Not Say It: Iterative Self Knowledge Re-expression in Visual Reasoning Relative Pose Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10483)
*Mengyu Wang,Ken Deng,Yftah Ziser,Shay B. Cohen,Tiejun Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统分析了视觉-语言模型在视觉推理相对位姿识别（VRRPI）任务中存在的稳定输出偏置，并提出无需标注的自知识重表达与迭代去偏流水线（SKR-ID），通过冷启动去偏提示与递归logit排序阈值机制，将输出机制从通用下一词预测转为任务专用分类头，显著缓解系统性偏置并大幅提升开源VLM的Macro-F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VRRPI任务暴露出当前视觉-语言模型（VLM）在多视角3D空间推理能力上的严重缺陷。作者通过系统分析发现，VLM在VRRPI中表现出稳定的输出偏置：无论视觉证据如何，都倾向于预测特定的运动模式。这种固有偏置导致性能塌缩，而依赖人工标注数据的微调成本高昂，因此亟需一种无需标注即可纠正偏置的方案。

Conclusion: VLM在VRRPI中的失败主要源于稳定的预测偏置而非单纯能力缺失；通过将输出重表达为分类任务并结合去偏提示与基于中位数logit的动态重排序，可以在零标注条件下显著改善多视角3D空间推理性能。该工作提示：输出接口与偏置校正设计对释放VLM空间推理能力至关重要。

Abstract: The task of visual reasoning relative pose identification (VRRPI) has exposed critical weaknesses in the multi-view 3D spatial reasoning capabilities of modern vision-language models (VLMs). We present a systematic analysis of VLMs' behavior in VRRPI, uncovering stable output biases where VLMs disproportionately predict specific motion patterns regardless of visual evidence. To mitigate these inherent biases, we propose self knowledge re-expression with iterative debiasing (SKR-ID), an annotation-free pipeline that adapts VLMs for VRRPI using only randomly extracted unannotated image pairs. SKR-ID transitions VLMs' output mechanism from generic next-token prediction to task-optimized classification heads. The pipeline proceeds in two stages: (1) a cold-start initialization using debiasing object-centric prompts to anchor motion inference in 2D visual evidence; and (2) a recursive logit-ranking mechanism that enforces statistical parity by using the median logit value as a dynamic threshold. Experimental evaluation across frontier VLMs on standard benchmarks demonstrates that SKR-ID significantly mitigates systematic biases. Our method improves open-source VLMs' Macro-F1 scores from 35.0-45.4% to 53.7-58.0%, without using any annotated data. These results show that SKR-ID can effectively improve 3D reasoning performance from a severely collapsed baseline. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/astudentuser/Codes_of_SKR-ID.

</details>

Abstract: Background: Well-annotated, diverse medical imaging datasets remain a major constraint for vision-based medical AI. Carotid ultrasound models were trained on a private Human Phenotype Project cohort (aged 40-75 years) with and without synthetic augmentation. Clinicians rated image plausibility. Evaluation used AUROC, AUPR, calibration, and decision curve analysis. Findings: Synthetic-only models achieved AUROCs of 0.877 (95% CI 0.843-0.910) for pneumonia (n=14863), 0.963 (0.948-0.975) for retinal detachment (n=1149), and 0.711 (0.600-0.823) for renal calculus (n=4122), comparable to real-data-trained models, but their calibration and net benefit were not consistently more favorable. With mixed synthetic-real training, a carotid ultrasound model produced an ordinal vascular age index that stratified 633 external subjects into subgroups differing in BMI and glucose (both p<0.01), linking vascular aging to cardiometabolic health. Clinician-guided editing raised low-quality CT plausibility from 3.10/5 to 4.30/5. Interpretation: Synthetic data can complement real data in model training, subgroup representation, and model testing via controlled editing, but its clinical value should be assessed with calibration, decision curve analysis, and clinician review, not discrimination alone.

TL;DR: 本文提出 DeLang-SR，一种单步流匹配框架，用于暗光图像超分辨率。它将可测物理统计量转化为结构化的"退化语言"，借助预训练文生图模型的语义先验引导速度场方向，同时用连续的空间更新强度场（作为局部可变的欧拉步长）调节修复幅度，实现对空间异质退化的自适应处理。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 暗光超分辨率面临极端空间异质性：严重欠曝和噪声区域需要激进的生成式增强以重建细节，而曝光良好区域则需保守更新以避免幻觉纹理。标准扩散与流匹配模型依赖全局统一的积分轨迹，难以适配这种空间变化的退化，因此方法次优。

Result: 在配对暗图像与真实暗图像上的实验，以及消融研究与诊断分析表明，DeLang-SR 为暗光超分辨率提供了一条有效且可解释的单步路径。代码与预训练模型已开源。

Abstract: Image super-resolution in the dark is fundamentally challenged by extreme spatial heterogeneity: severely underexposed and noisy regions demand aggressive generative enhancement to reconstruct missing details, while relatively well-exposed areas require conservative updates to prevent hallucinated textures. Standard diffusion and flow-matching models, however, rely on globally uniform integration trajectories, making them sub-optimal for such spatially varying degradations. In this paper, we propose DeLang-SR (Degradation-Language steered Super-Resolution), a one-step flow-matching framework that explicitly decouples the restoration direction and magnitude. Rather than treating low-light corruption as arbitrary latent features, DeLang-SR translates measurable physical statistics into structured degradation language, harnessing the semantic prior of pretrained text-to-image models. The degradation-language intent, complemented by image-specific visual tokens, steers the velocity field (direction) toward restoration-relevant manifolds. Simultaneously, a continuous spatial update-strength field acts as a locally varying Euler step-size field (magnitude), applying stronger integration steps in heavily degraded shadows while enforcing conservative updates in reliable regions. Experiments on paired and real dark images, together with ablations and diagnostic analyses, show that DeLang-SR provides an effective and interpretable one-step route to super-resolution in the dark. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/moriyaya/DeLang-SR.

### [54] [Disentangling Channel Semantics in Vision Transformers via Token Decorrelation and Composition-Aware Modulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10497)

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MuCa-ViT，通过因子化Token学习（FTL）与通道组合感知调制（CAM）解决多通道ViT中上下文Token在高通道冗余下坍缩至少数主导通道的问题，在三个基准上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多通道图像要求模型同时刻画全局共享的空间结构与通道特有的语义差异。现有多通道ViT用memory token等上下文Token组织多通道表征，但在通道间高度冗余时这些Token会坍缩到少数主导通道上，产生冗余表征与有偏的全局摘要，无法可靠支持"按通道组合"进行解释。

Method: MuCa-ViT统一框架，含两个耦合机制：(1) Factorial Token Learning（FTL）：在上下文Token层面施加去相关约束，使[CLS]捕获全局共享语义、memory token保留互补的通道特有线索；(2) Channel Composition-Aware Modulation（CAM）：以FTL精炼后的[CLS]作为语义锚点，生成样本级调制信号，在统一骨干网络内实现通道组合感知的解释，取代静态通道嵌入。并配合诊断性分析（通道冗余度与性能增益的关系）验证设计动机。

Result: 在JUMP-CP、CHAMMI、So2Sat三个基准上均优于现有多通道ViT；性能提升幅度与各数据集的通道间冗余度（ρ∈[0.19, 0.77]）一致，印证了驱动设计的诊断分析结论。

Conclusion: 上下文Token坍缩是高冗余多通道场景下的关键瓶颈；通过Token级去相关与基于[CLS]锚点的样本级调制，可在单一统一骨干中同时实现共享语义建模与通道组合感知，且增益随数据冗余度系统性变化，说明该框架具有可解释的适用边界。

Abstract: Multi-channel images encode heterogeneous channel semantics aligned over a shared spatial structure, which requires models to jointly capture globally shared structure and channel-specific variations. Recent multi-channel Vision Transformers attempt to address this challenge by augmenting the [CLS] token with memory tokens to organize multi-channel representations under varying channel compositions. However, we find that these context tokens collapse onto a few dominant channels under high inter-channel redundancy, producing redundant representations and a biased global summary that fails to reliably support composition-aware channel interpretation. We propose MuCa-ViT (Multi-Channel Composition-Aware Vision Transformer), a unified framework that addresses these limitations through two coupled mechanisms. Factorial Token Learning (FTL) enforces token-level decorrelation among context tokens, encouraging the [CLS] token to capture globally shared semantics while memory tokens preserve complementary channel-specific cues. Channel Composition-Aware Modulation (CAM) uses the FTL-refined [CLS] as a semantic anchor to generate sample-wise modulation signals, which enable composition-aware interpretation of channels within a unified backbone rather than relying on static channel embeddings. Experiments on JUMP-CP, CHAMMI, and So2Sat show that MuCa-ViT outperforms prior multi-channel ViTs across all three benchmarks, and the magnitude of improvement aligns with the inter-channel redundancy of each dataset ($ρ\in [0.19, 0.77]$), validating the diagnostic analysis that motivates our design. Our code is available at https://github.com/kimdanni/MuCa-ViT .

</details>

*Yichen He,Xin Huang,Yuxi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文指出视觉语言模型（VLM）对画面几何的利用不稳定，直接注入外部几何测量反而会损害性能；作者提出 CompositionEvidence，从冻结的检测/深度/线条专家中提取九种可复现特征并构建共享24维表示，通过"免训练门控证据通道"和"轻量软token通道"两种接口注入，在ShotBench构图任务上分别将Qwen2.5-VL-7B从49.5%提升至56.2%与61.0%，并在九个VLM（含五个商用模型）上系统验证了增益与退化的边界条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电影化构图问题本质上依赖画面内几何关系，而VLM对此类几何信息的利用并不一致。外部感知工具虽能显式提供几何测量，但朴素的提示注入会覆盖模型原本有用的视觉预测：在ShotBench上，把几何信息放在问题之前使Qwen2.5-VL-7B从49.5%降到46.3%，注入被破坏的测量更降至33.6%。因此作者希望找到一种可靠的几何证据表示与注入方式，既能利用外部几何又不破坏模型原有能力，并厘清"显式几何"何时有益、何时有害。

Method: 提出 CompositionEvidence：从冻结的检测、深度与线条专家中提取九种可复现的构图特征，并汇总为一个共享的24维表示，再通过两种接口注入VLM：(1) 免训练通道——在问题之后附加门控的中性证据文本；(2) 最小训练通道——用仅7.37M参数的小投影器把同一表示映射为四个软token，而VLM主体保持冻结。此外在九个VLM（含通过官方API访问的五个商用模型）上进行跨模型评测，并做了证据损坏条件下的鲁棒性实验。

Result: 免训练通道达到56.2%（+6.7，精确McNemar p=0.0018），在证据被破坏时仍达48.4%；最小训练通道达到61.0%（+11.5）。跨九个VLM的零样本准确率范围为43.8%–63.0%，该文本通道带来的变化区间为+6.7到−6.9个百分点，且基线最高的模型反而出现了退化。

Conclusion: 显式几何信息对VLM的作用并非单向增益，而取决于两点：几何测量的可靠性，以及接收模型自身整合该信息的方式。合理的表示设计与注入接口（后置门控、低容量软token）能稳定带来提升，而粗暴的提示注入可能覆盖模型的原有视觉判断，造成性能下降。

Abstract: Cinematic composition questions depend on in-frame geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) use inconsistently. External perception tools can expose this geometry, but naive prompt injection can overwrite useful visual predictions. On ShotBench composition, pre-question geometry reduces Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 49.5% to 46.3%; corrupted measurements lower it to 33.6%. CompositionEvidence derives nine reproducible features from frozen detection, depth, and line experts and supplies their shared 24-dimensional representation through two interfaces. A training-free channel appends gated neutral evidence after the question, reaching 56.2% (+6.7, exact McNemar p=0.0018) and 48.4% under corrupted evidence. A minimal-training channel maps the same representation to four soft tokens with a 7.37M-parameter projector while leaving the VLM frozen; it reaches 61.0% (+11.5). Across nine VLMs, including five commercial models queried through official provider APIs, zero-shot accuracy ranges from 43.8% to 63.0%, and the text channel changes it by +6.7 to -6.9 points; the highest baseline is among the regressions. The effect of explicit geometry depends on measurement reliability and on how the receiving model integrates it.

</details>

Abstract: Recent large human reconstruction models create remarkable animatable 3D avatars from a single image, but their appearance remains entangled with the illumination and cannot be relighted. In contrast, existing 3D relightable-avatar reconstruction methods typically require person-specific optimization. We present ZARA, a zero-shot feed-forward framework that reconstructs an animatable 3D Gaussian avatar together with its intrinsic attributes from a single image. ZARA couples a pretrained large-scale human reconstruction model with a Material Transformer to inherit geometry priors while learning material-aware Gaussian representations. To preserve localized details, we introduce Gaussian-aligned material feature fusion strategy, which injects multi-scale material features onto individual Gaussians and combines them with geometry tokens. As most human-avatar datasets lack ground-truth material maps, we use pseudo-material labels as conditioning inputs and supervision targets during training. We further introduce MatFace regularization to preserve facial structure and color in albedo prediction under unreliable facial pseudo-material supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ZARA reconstructs animatable and relightable humans within tens of seconds without person-specific optimization or post-processing, outperforming existing baselines in both relighting quality and materials generalization ability.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉注意力通过调制CNN中间特征来增强性能，但其对下游决策（最终分类判断）的具体影响机制仍缺乏清晰解释，现有研究多停留在特征层面，缺少可量化、可预测的决策层面分析工具。

Method: 构建决策空间框架：把乘法注意力建模为对中间特征的扰动，基于一阶泰勒展开推导该扰动对"目标类 vs. 竞争类"分类间隔（margin）变化的预测值；同时定义决策对齐分数（DAS），量化扰动方向与局部间隔梯度方向的对齐程度。在CIFAR-100数据集上，使用SimAM与CBAM两种注意力模块，跨ResNet-18、ResNet-20、ResNet-50、ResNet-56、MobileNetV2五个骨干网络进行实验，考察预测一致性、DAS与间隔变化的相关性以及下游激活状态的变化；并进一步做单注意力（单一插入位置）实验。

Result: 在多数末端注意力配置下，预测的间隔变化与实际观测到的间隔变化吻合良好；DAS与实际间隔变化呈正相关。单注意力实验表明，预测一致性和DAS-间隔相关性随注意力插入位置而变化，在网络的较后阶段插入时关联更强。

Conclusion: 注意力对分类决策的作用可以在决策空间中被一阶近似有效刻画，DAS可作为衡量注意力是否"朝有利方向"推动决策的实用指标；注意力位置显著影响该效应的可预测性与强度，后层注意力与决策的关联更为直接，为注意力模块的设计与插入位置选择提供了理论化、可量化的依据。

Abstract: Visual Attention enhances convolutional neural networks (CNNs) by modulating intermediate features, yet their effects on downstream decisions remain less understood. We present a decision-space framework that models multiplicative attention as an intermediate feature perturbation and derives a first-order prediction of its effect on the target-versus-competitor classification margin. We further introduce the Decision Alignment Score (DAS) to quantify the directional alignment between the perturbation and the local margin gradient. We evaluate the framework on CIFAR-100 using SimAM and CBAM across five popular CNN backbones, ResNet-18, ResNet-20, ResNet-50, ResNet-56, and MobileNetV2. The analysis examines prediction agreement, DAS margin correlations, and downstream activation-state changes. Across most final-attention configurations, predicted and actual margin changes show good agreement, while DAS exhibits positive correlations with actual margin changes. Single-attention experiments further show that prediction agreement and DAS margin correlations depend on attention placement, with stronger associations at later stages.

</details>


### [58] [ROLECUE: Diagnosing Cross-Lingual Role-Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10575)
*Niaz Mohaiman Abtahi,Evan Maksud*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ROLECUE 诊断基准，用 192 组双人动作图与六种语言的规范/受事前置句，分离评测 VLM 的视觉角色识别、文本语义角色解析、图文联合匹配、回答合规性与外部模块组合，发现八种开源 VLM 存在多语言“组件—联合”性能落差及恒定语义顺从偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型能识别图像事件、解析句子，但不清楚它们何时、如何把视觉中的 Agent-Patient 结构绑定到依赖形态、语序或构式的语言语义角色上；聚合式基准可能掩盖组件能力与联合推理之间的差距。

Method: 构建受控诊断 ROLECUE：将 192 张经验证的双人动作图像与德语、土耳其语、日语、英语、韩语、孟加拉语的标准语序和受事前置句配对；分别评测纯图像角色识别、纯文本角色解析、图文直接匹配、回答合规行为，以及用模型自身组件预测进行外部模块化组合。

Result: 在八种近期开放权重 VLM 上呈现结构化谱系：部分模型未通过视觉或语言组件测试，部分基本解决诊断，部分退化为恒定语义赞同；若干模型出现组件—联合差距，即可靠的纯图像与纯文本角色预测无法转化为直接联合推理。最大非退化差距达 44.9 个百分点，bootstrap 区间确认非点估计假象。

Conclusion: 结果揭示多语言组件—联合性能差距与被聚合基准掩盖的接受偏差，说明在解释联合多模态错误前，必须先做组件级诊断。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can recognize events in images and parse sentences, but it remains unclear when they bind visual Agent-Patient structure to linguistic semantic roles across languages whose role cues depend on morphology, word order or construction. We introduce ROLECUE, a controlled diagnostic that pairs 192 validated two-person action images with German, Turkish, Japanese, English, Korean and Bangla sentences in canonical and patient-first orders. The evaluation separates image-only role recognition, text-only role parsing, direct image-sentence matching, response-compliance behavior and an external modular composition of the model's own component predictions. Across eight recent open-weight VLMs, ROLECUE reveals a structured spectrum: some models fail visual or linguistic component tests, some largely solve the diagnostic, some collapse to constant semantic assent and several show component-joint gaps in which reliable image-only and text-only role predictions do not survive direct joint inference. The largest non-degenerate gaps reach 44.9 percentage points, with final bootstrap intervals confirming that the effect is not a point-estimate artifact. These results reveal multilingual component-joint performance gaps and acceptance biases hidden by aggregate VLM benchmarks and show why component diagnostics are necessary before interpreting joint multimodal errors.

</details>


### [59] [MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10592)
*Jiaju Ma,Ashvini Kumar Jindal,Chuhua Wang,Sumithra Bhakthavatsalam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MotionGraphicsBench：100 个由专家整理、基于真实 Lottie 设计的 SVG 动效编辑任务，用可读的确定性验证程序替代参考动画或 VLM 评判，系统评测大模型对空间、外观与时间组合要求的遵循能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型可根据静态图和自然语言生成动效，但缺少能检验其是否同时满足空间、外观与时间等多重要求的评测方法；参考动画比对或 VLM 打分存在实现多样性与判定可靠性问题。

Method: 构建 100 个实例的专家标注基准：输入静态 SVG 与动效编辑提示，分离图形生成与运动生成；从真实 Lottie 设计衍生多样时空动画组合；为每个实例配套确定、人类可读的验证程序，通过多智能体流程结合人工标注动画与合成测试用例生成，可接受不同有效实现并逐条报告通过/失败。

Result: 在 180 个动画的平衡测试集上，验证程序与人类判断原始一致率 93.3%，高于 GPT-6 Astra VLM 基线的 83.3%，且批准与拒绝召回率均更优；评测 32 个 LLM、12 个提供方的 47 种配置，pass@1 为 6.0%–67.7%；15 个模型最高推理强度、每例 32 次尝试下，pass@32 为 38.0%–95.0%，增加尝试对每个模型均有提升。

Conclusion: 该基准能细粒度揭示模型在动效生成中的失败模式：常无法匹配参考姿态、遵循指定运动轨迹或协调相关事件；基准已开源，为动效生成提供可扩展、可验证的评测框架。

Abstract: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of 100 instances for animating an input static SVG with a motion edit prompt. By supplying all required visual elements, our editing task reflects a designer-like workflow and isolates motion generation from graphic generation. Derived from real-world Lottie motion designs, our benchmark contains diverse combinations of spatio-temporal animation behaviors. Each benchmark instance pairs its model input with a deterministic, human-readable verification program that accepts different valid implementations and reports which prompt requirements pass or fail, rather than comparing against a reference animation or using a VLM judge. We construct these programs with a multi-agent pipeline using human-labeled animations and synthesized test cases. On a balanced test set of 180 animations, our programs achieve 93.3% raw agreement with human judgments, compared with 83.3% for a GPT-6 Astra VLM baseline, and outperform the baseline in both approval and rejection recall. Across 47 configurations from 32 LLMs and 12 providers, pass@1 ranges from 6.0% to 67.7%. Across 15 models evaluated at their highest available reasoning effort with 32 attempts per instance, additional attempts improve every model, but pass@32 still ranges from 38.0% to 95.0%. Our analysis of verification programs reveals that generated animations often fail to match reference poses, follow requested motion trajectories, or coordinate related events. We release our benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/figma-ai/motion-graphics-bench.

</details>


### [60] [The RenAIssance: Caption-Guided Diffusion Models for Historical-Art Visual Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10599)
*Zhanyu Tuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RenAIssance流水线，将历史欧洲艺术品集合转化为可复用的文生图资源：用BLIP生成场景级描述，在约1.5万对DEArt图文数据上训练轻量LoRA适配器，使Stable Diffusion v1.5生成图像向历史艺术分布靠拢，同时保留生成新概念的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI可将文化馆藏扩展为可提示响应的视觉媒体，但历史艺术品通常缺少适配现代图像生成器所需的配对描述，因而难以直接迁移其风格与内容。

Method: 构建可扩展流水线：先用BLIP为历史欧洲艺术品生成场景级标题，得到约15,000个DEArt图文对；再据此为Stable Diffusion v1.5训练紧凑的LoRA适配器，将历史艺术风格表示与基础生成器解耦。

Result: 在历史与当代、不同长度的提示下，适配器在所有设置中均改善了相对DEArt参考分布的FID，仅带来CLIP文本—图像相似度的适度下降；定性结果显示同一适配器既能生成符合时代特征的主体，也能以连贯的历史视觉语言表现当代概念。

Conclusion: 该方法通过可复用的LoRA风格表示，为可控历史艺术媒体创作、交互式创作和富媒体体验提供了实用构建模块。

Abstract: Generative AI can expand cultural collections into prompt-responsive visual media, but historical artworks rarely provide the paired descriptions needed to adapt modern image generators. We present The RenAIssance, a scalable pipeline that turns a collection of historical European artworks into a reusable text-to-image media resource. The pipeline generates scene-level captions with BLIP and uses the resulting approximately 15,000 image--text pairs from DEArt to train a compact LoRA adapter for Stable Diffusion v1.5. The adapter shifts generated images toward the historical-art distribution while retaining the base model's ability to render novel concepts. On historical and contemporary prompts of different lengths, it improves FID to the DEArt reference distribution in every setting with only a modest decrease in CLIP text--image similarity. Qualitative results show that the same adapter can render both period-appropriate subjects and contemporary concepts in a coherent historical visual language. By decoupling a reusable style representation from the base generator, the approach offers a practical building block for controllable historical-art media creation, interactive authoring, and rich-media experiences.

</details>


### [61] [Reason First, Retrieve What Matters: Hypothesis-Guided Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10609)
*Yisong Hu,Junbo Wang,Yuke Li,Jiangbin Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HypoKFS 是一种免训练、即插即用的框架，将关键帧选择与 MLLM 迭代推理耦合：先用稀疏帧构建初始假设空间，根据答案分布判断是否需要补充选帧，再由保留假设引导选择有区分力的帧并迭代推理与假设细化，从而把额外视觉计算集中到未解决的假设上，避免不必要的全局图文匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频理解需要在有限帧预算内定位并推理稀疏、时间上分散的证据。现有方法通常从密集采样候选集中检索与查询相关的帧，但全局图文匹配计算开销大；当少量均匀采样帧已提供足够证据时，这种计算是不必要的。此外，仅依赖查询相关性可能忽略区分竞争答案的关键证据，而一次性选帧也无法纠正早期选择错误。

Method: 提出 HypoKFS，一个免训练、即插即用的关键帧选择与迭代推理框架。首先在稀疏采样帧上推理，构建初始假设空间；根据得到的答案分布决定是否需要额外选帧。若需要，则利用保留假设引导选择具有区分力的帧，随后重新推理并细化假设，形成迭代过程。该方法将额外视觉计算导向尚未解决的假设，同时避免全局帧匹配。

Result: 在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 和 MLVU 上，跨多个 MLLM 骨干模型取得一致提升；准确率最高提升 6.7 个百分点，并在仅使用参考帧-假设匹配成本 1.3% 的情况下，在 Video-MME 上达到 72.9% 准确率。

Conclusion: HypoKFS 通过假设驱动的自适应选帧与迭代推理，在不训练模型的情况下提升了长视频理解的效果与计算效率，具有较好的通用性和即插即用价值。

Abstract: Long video understanding requires models to identify and reason over sparse, temporally distributed evidence within limited frame budgets. Existing keyframe selection methods typically retrieve query-relevant frames from a densely sampled candidate set before inference. However, global image-text matching incurs unnecessary computation when a small set of uniformly sampled frames already provides sufficient evidence. Query relevance alone may also overlook evidence that distinguishes competing answers, while one-shot selection offers no opportunity to correct earlier selection errors. We propose HypoKFS, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples keyframe selection with iterative inference by multimodal large language models (MLLMs). HypoKFS first reasons over sparsely sampled frames to construct an initial hypothesis space. The resulting answer distribution determines whether additional frame selection is needed. When needed, the retained hypotheses guide the selection of discriminative frames, followed by renewed inference and hypothesis refinement. This iterative process directs additional visual computation toward unresolved hypotheses while avoiding unnecessary global frame matching. Experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple MLLM backbones. HypoKFS improves accuracy by up to 6.7 percentage points and achieves 72.9% accuracy on Video-MME at only 1.3% of the reference frame-hypothesis matching cost.

</details>


### [62] [EndoSCOP-V: A Multi-Turn Video Understanding Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Models in Endoscopy Reporting and Clinical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10626)
*Abhishek Tyagi,Tanmay Jain,Vilas Biradar,Krithi Krishna Koduri,Misba Hul Bashir Masoodi,Swetha Rapolu,Hardik Rughwani,Rachana Kotha,Anjan Kumar Kaipa,Anudeep Katrevula,Rakesh Garlapati,Aniruddha Pratap Singh,Rajendra Patel,Abhay Tyagi,Sundeep Lakhtakia,Mohan Ramchandani,Rakesh Kalapala,D. Nageshwar Reddy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出 EndoSCOP-V，一个面向内镜视频、多轮结构化报告与临床推理的评测框架，包含 1307 段真实内镜/结肠镜视频与 20274 个由结构化电子病历确定性生成的问答轮次，并采用马尔可夫上下文剪枝的 oracle-forcing 协议逐轮评测。15 名认证内镜医师在 1500 题上取得 78% 严格准确率，最佳 27B 级开源 LMM 仅 59.8%，最优前沿专有模型在严格 NDR 准确率上落后医师 23 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有内镜多模态基准多局限于静态图像或单病种视频，无法覆盖真实报告中随视频推进而产生的时序定位、形态、严重程度和干预推理；单帧或单病种设定会遗漏多分钟链条式临床推理。

Method: 构建视频驱动的多轮评测框架 EndoSCOP-V：1,307 段真实内镜与结肠镜视频（63.2 小时，97% 为 1080p，平均约 174 秒）；20,274 个问答轮次由临床医生填写的结构化内镜报告 EHR 确定性实例化，非逐例合成或 LLM 改写；来源于 1,033 个临床审阅模板（约每病 18 个），覆盖 9 任务 × 30 子任务、54 种 WEO MST 3.0 疾病；22% 操作含共病，最多 6 种。采用马尔可夫上下文剪枝的 oracle-forcing 协议逐轮注入金标准答案，隔离单轮推理与级联对话错误。

Result: 15 名 board-certified 内镜医师在 1,500 题上建立 78% 严格准确率基线；14 个开放权重 LMM 中最佳 27B 级模型达 59.8%，排除格式平凡的疾病排除项后降至 53.4%；在 between-subjects spot-check 中，3 个前沿专有模型的最佳者在严格 NDR 准确率上落后医师组 23 个百分点；子任务分析显示定量测量、多变量分级和长时程视频中的干预推理存在持续差距。

Conclusion: EndoSCOP-V 揭示了当前 LMM 在真实内镜视频多轮临床报告推理上与临床医生存在显著差距，尤其在定量测量、多变量分级和干预推理方面；该基准为结构化内镜报告与长时程视频临床推理提供了更贴近真实工作的评测基础。

Abstract: Endoscopic diagnosis unfolds over native video, where a single positive finding during traversal of the gastrointestinal tract sets off a multi-minute chain of reasoning over location, morphology, severity and intervention. Existing endoscopy multimodal benchmarks test only static images or single-disease videos, which miss the temporal and clinical reasoning that real-world reporting demands. We introduce EndoSCOP-V, a video-grounded multi-turn evaluation framework for structured endoscopy reporting and clinical reasoning. It contains 1,307 real-world endoscopy and colonoscopy videos (63.2 h; 97% 1080p) averaging about 174 s. Its 20,274 question-answer turns are instantiated deterministically from clinician-filled structured endoscopy-reporting EHRs, so no per-case annotation is synthetic or LLM-rephrased. They come from 1,033 clinician-reviewed templates, about 18 per disease, that span a clinically aligned 9-task x 30-sub-task reporting taxonomy over 54 World Endoscopy Organization (WEO) MST 3.0 diseases. 22% of procedures carry co-existing pathologies, up to six per case. A Markovian context-pruned oracle-forcing protocol evaluates the dialogue turn by turn, injecting the gold answer before each subsequent turn so that per-turn reasoning is isolated from cascading dialogue errors. A panel of 15 board-certified endoscopists sets a 78% strict-accuracy baseline on 1,500 questions. Across 14 open-weight LMMs, the best 27B-class model reaches 59.8% strict accuracy, falling to 53.4% once format-trivial disease-rejection items are excluded. On a between-subjects spot-check, the best of 3 frontier proprietary models trails the clinician panel by 23 pp on strict NDR accuracy. Sub-task analysis reveals consistent gaps in quantitative measurement, multi-variable grading and intervention reasoning on long-horizon video. Data: Hugging Face (EndoSCOP-V). Code: GitHub (abhi25t/EndoSCOP-V).

</details>


### [63] [Latent-WAM++: Shaping World and Action Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10632)
*Yichen Zhang,Yupeng Zheng,Linbo Wang,Pengxuan Yang,Zebin Xing,Junli Wang,Shiwei Li,Kangwei Liu,Fan Ren,Qichao Zhang,Yifeng Pan,Ji Tao,Dongbin Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以表征为中心的世界动作模型 Latent-WAM++，使每个中间表征的监督方式与其规划角色对齐，在 NAVSIM v2 达到 90.1 EPDMS，HUGSIM 零样本 47.0 RC / 30.1 HD-Score，端到端训练仅需 190 GPU-hours（较 Latent-WAM 降低 88.1%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）主要监督未来状态或最终动作，连接预测与规划的中间世界表征和动作表征只受到间接约束，导致表征质量与规划需求不匹配。

Method: Latent-WAM++ 由三部分组成：(1) World Representation Construction：融合场景-自车未来预测、SIGReg 分布稳定化与冻结几何先验，无需 EMA 目标编码器即获得时序可预测、非退化且几何感知的世界表征；(2) Trajectory MeanFlow Planner：直接预测多模态轨迹提案，并用改进的 MeanFlow 速度空间目标优化，实现一步采样；(3) Visual-Action Representation Alignment：将输出前的动作特征与基于当前视觉语义的 stop-gradient 目标对齐。

Result: NAVSIM v2 上取得 90.1 EPDMS 的 SOTA 性能；HUGSIM 零样本评测达 47.0 平均 RC 与 30.1 平均 HD-Score；规划器端到端训练耗时 190 GPU-hours，相比 Latent-WAM 的 1,600 GPU-hours 下降 88.1%。

Conclusion: 按规划角色分配中间表征监督是提升端到端自动驾驶世界动作模型性能与训练效率的有效范式。

Abstract: We introduce Latent-WAM++, a representation-centered World Action Model (WAM) for end-to-end autonomous driving. Existing WAMs are primarily trained to predict future states or final actions, leaving the intermediate world and action representations that connect prediction to planning only indirectly constrained. Latent-WAM++ matches the supervision of each representation to its role in planning. World Representation Construction combines scene-ego future prediction, SIGReg-based distribution stabilization, and frozen geometric priors to learn a temporally predictive, non-degenerate, and geometry-aware world representation without an EMA target encoder. Trajectory MeanFlow Planner directly predicts multimodal trajectory proposals while being optimized with an Improved MeanFlow velocity-space objective, enabling one-step sampling. Visual-Action Representation Alignment further aligns the resulting pre-output action features with a stop-gradient target derived from current visual semantics. Latent-WAM++ achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM v2 and under zero-shot evaluation on HUGSIM, reaching 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and 47.0 average RC and 30.1 average HD-Score on HUGSIM. Training the planner end to end costs 190 GPU-hours for Latent-WAM++ versus 1,600 for Latent-WAM, a reduction of 88.1%.

</details>


### [64] [FG-DSA: Frequency-Guided Depthwise Separable Attention for Efficient Dense Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10653)
*Yiyao Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FG-DSA框架，用2D FFT高通滤波将频域先验注入深度可分离空间注意力，以线性复杂度提升资源受限场景下的密集预测与生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源受限场景中的密集预测与生成面临反复下采样导致空间细节丢失、边界退化的问题；现有注意力机制虽缓解语义歧义，但难以保留高频特征，或需付出很高计算代价。

Method: FG-DSA采用2D FFT高通滤波模块，将频域先验显式注入空间注意力机制，并结合深度可分离注意力，使轻量网络能够以线性复杂度恢复锐利边界；同时可作为模块嵌入扩散生成U-Net。

Result: 实验表明FG-DSA能有效恢复细粒度物体边界，并在语义分割任务上带来稳定性能提升；作为扩散生成U-Net模块时，仅增加极少参数和FLOPs即可显著改善生成图像细节。

Conclusion: 频域引导的深度可分离注意力是一种高效且通用的密集视觉理解与生成增强方案，在分割和扩散生成任务中兼具细节恢复能力与低计算开销。

Abstract: Dense prediction and generative modeling in resource-constrained scenarios remain challenging, as repeated downsampling substantially reduces spatial detail and degrades boundaries. Although recent attention mechanisms have alleviated the problem of semantic ambiguity, they often fail to preserve high-frequency features or do so at the expense of a very high computational cost. In this paper, we propose the Frequency Guided Depthwise Separable Attention for Efficient Dense Prediction (FG-DSA), a novel framework for efficient dense visual understanding and generation. FG-DSA employs a 2D FFT high-pass filtering module to explicitly inject frequency domain priors into the spatial attention mechanism, allowing lightweight networks to recover sharp boundary transitions with linear complexity. A range of experiments show that FG-DSA is effective at recovering fine object boundaries and leads to a consistent performance gain in the task of semantic segmentation. Importantly, we show that FGA-DSA can be used as a module in diffusion-based generative U-Nets, leading to a significant improvement in the detail of the generated images with very little additional parameter and Floating Point Operation (FLOP) cost.

</details>


### [65] [Dynamics-Informed Action Learning for Goal-Conditioned Latent Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10660)
*Yinuo Jiang,Guangzhi Wang,Yiran Wang,Junfu Pu,Cheng Cheng,Honghao Chen,Cheng Cheng,Ying Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DIAL 通过训练期的 rollout 对齐与多步逆动力学监督，并在测试期用逆动力学与正向动力学自回归耦合来初始化 CEM 的动作提案分布，从而弥合潜空间世界模型中"动力学学习"与"规划使用"之间的鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜世界模型可在紧凑表示空间中规划动作序列实现视觉控制，但存在两个缺口：(1) teacher-forcing 式训练从未让动力学模型接触到规划时递归预测出的潜状态，存在训练-推理不一致；(2) 基于采样的规划器通常从与目标无关的提案出发初始化动作搜索，没有利用世界模型已学到的动作条件动力学信息。

Method: 提出 Dynamics-Informed Action Learning（DIAL）。训练端：rollout alignment 让前向模型暴露于自身的自回归潜预测；多步逆动力学监督训练轻量逆动力学头，从潜状态转移推断动作；并对模型生成的转移（逆头参数固定）施加上述监督，促使预测 rollout 保留动作相关信息。测试端：自回归耦合逆动力学与正向动力学，朝向目标构造"动力学知情"的动作序列，用以初始化 CEM 提案分布的均值，随后由标准 CEM 采样-更新过程细化。

Result: 在四个视觉控制基准上，DIAL 在标准与长时程场景中均优于现有潜世界模型与规划基线。

Conclusion: 将动力学学习的训练目标与规划时的动作搜索对齐（训练侧暴露自回归潜误差、注入逆动力学监督；推理侧用逆动力学生成初始化），可以显著提升潜世界模型的规划性能与长时程鲁棒性，说明"学到的动力学如何被用于规划"本身是一个值得显式设计的关键环节。

Abstract: Latent world models enable visual control by planning action sequences in compact representation spaces, but a gap remains between how latent dynamics are learned and how they are used for planning. First, teacher-forced training does not expose the dynamics model to the recursively predicted latent states encountered during planning. Second, sampling-based planners typically initialize action search from goal-agnostic proposals, without exploiting the action-conditioned dynamics learned by the world model. We introduce Dynamics-Informed Action Learning (DIAL) to bridge these two gaps. During training, rollout alignment exposes the forward model to its own autoregressive latent predictions, while multi-step inverse supervision trains a lightweight inverse dynamics head to infer actions from latent-state transitions. We further apply the inverse head to model-generated transitions with its parameters held fixed, encouraging predicted rollouts to retain action-relevant information. At test time, DIAL autoregressively couples the inverse and forward dynamics to construct a dynamics-informed action sequence toward the goal, which initializes the mean of the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) proposal distribution. The subsequent CEM search then refines this initialization using the standard sampling and updating procedure. Experiments across four visual control benchmarks demonstrate that DIAL outperforms existing latent world models and planning baselines in both standard and long-horizon scenarios.

</details>


### [66] [Physically Guided TeX Generation for Low-Light Visual Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10665)
*Daoheng Li,Jianjun Qian,Mengkai Yan,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TeX-Gen 是一个物理引导框架，可从配对的可见光与红外图像生成温度、发射率和纹理图，无需像素级物理标签，并在多个低光视觉数据集上验证了任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光条件下可见光对比度下降、细节被遮蔽，而红外图像缺乏颜色与纹理，因此需要融合红外与可见光信息。现有融合方法多优化外观或任务特征，未显式解耦热观测中的耦合因素，物理可解释性不足；高光谱热测量虽可物理分解，但依赖专用硬件，像素级物理标注也成本较高。

Method: 提出 TeX-Gen：TeX Generation 构建互补的多视角特征，并用独立分支门控将线索分别路由到温度图、发射率图和纹理图；TeXMetric 综合辐射重建、通道结构与材料一致性，在无需像素级物理标签的情况下评估生成图；TeX Tune 冻结生成器，联合优化调整模块与任务网络，实现任务引导的性能提升。

Result: 在 FLIR、LLVIP、M3FD 和 MSRS 数据集上，TeX-Gen 在低光环境下取得有竞争力的任务性能；在 HADAR 数据集上进一步分析 TeXMetric 分数与下游检测性能之间的关联。

Conclusion: 该工作以物理引导方式从可见光-红外图像生成可解释的热物理表征，降低了高光谱硬件和像素级物理标注依赖，并通过无标签评估与任务调优提升低光视觉任务表现。

Abstract: Low-light conditions reduce visible contrast and obscure details, while infrared images lack color and texture, motivating the fusion of infrared and visible information for visual tasks. Existing fusion methods primarily optimize image appearance or task-specific features without explicitly disentangling the coupled factors underlying thermal observations, limiting their physical interpretation under thermal degeneracy. Hyperspectral thermal measurements enable physical decomposition, but they require specialized imaging hardware, while pixel-level physical annotations for supervision or evaluation incur additional costs. We propose TeX-Gen, a physically guided framework for TeX generation from paired visible and infrared images in low-light visual tasks. TeX Generation constructs complementary multi-view features and employs independent branch-specific gates to route cues into the Temperature, Emissivity, and Texture maps. TeXMetric integrates radiometric reconstruction, channel structure, and material consistency to assess the generated maps without requiring pixel-level physical labels. TeX Tune improves performance through task-guided adjustments, jointly optimizing the adjustment modules and task network while keeping the generator frozen. Experiments show that TeX-Gen achieves competitive task performance in low-light environments on the FLIR, LLVIP, M3FD, and MSRS datasets. Experiments on HADAR also examine the association between TeXMetric scores and downstream detection performance.

</details>


### [67] [Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10672)
*Qi Wang,Jinjia Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文针对异构架构间知识蒸馏中logit偏移、尺度和锐度不一致的问题，提出HACD：将师生logit映射为共享单位超球面上的中心化、温度软化概率方向，并以非对称对比方式让学生输出在批次内识别自己的教师目标。方法无需额外可学习参数，每样本仅需一次教师前向，在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1K的多数异构师生对上取得最佳或次佳精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer教师到CNN学生等跨架构蒸馏较难，因为两类网络学习到的表示不同。Logit虽共享标签空间，但异构教师的logit存在偏移、尺度和锐度差异，非目标类语义组织性较弱；传统逐样本匹配logit数值，等于让学生模仿另一架构的表达方式，而非迁移更有价值的关系结构。

Method: 提出异构非对称对比蒸馏HACD。该方法将教师和学生logit映射到共享单位超球面上的中心化、温度软化概率方向，以消除架构相关偏移，并由温度控制输出锐度同时保留有信息的非目标类。批次内每个学生输出需识别自己的教师目标，其他教师目标作为负样本；教师在适度增强视图上计算目标，学生则分别以适度和强增强视图与之对比。

Result: HACD不增加可学习参数，每样本仅需一次教师前向。在CIFAR-100的12个异构师生对中11个取得最佳或次佳精度，且不使用真实标签；在ImageNet-1K的15个对中14个达到最佳或次佳，相比报告的vanilla KD平均分别提升8.82和1.33个百分点。

Conclusion: 异构教师蒸馏应传递预测的关系结构而非逐样本logit数值。HACD通过超球面概率方向对齐与批次内非对称对比实现该结构迁移，在多个跨架构师生组合上稳定优于传统KD，且计算与参数开销较低。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) between architectural families, e.g., from a Transformer teacher to a CNN student, is difficult because the two networks learn different representations. Logits share a label space, but heterogeneous teachers differ in logit offset, scale, and sharpness, and their non-target classes are less semantically organized. Conventional logit distillation matches these values sample by sample, asking the student to imitate how another architecture expresses its predictions. We argue that a heterogeneous teacher should pass on the relational structure of its predictions, i.e., how it arranges samples relative to one another, and propose Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation (HACD) to transfer this structure. HACD maps teacher and student logits to centered, temperature-softened probability directions on a shared unit hypersphere, which removes architecture-dependent offsets and lets the temperature control how sharply peaked outputs enter the representation while keeping informative non-target classes. Each student output must then identify its own teacher target within the batch. Because every teacher target also acts as a negative for the others, HACD computes the targets on a moderately augmented view and contrasts both a moderate and a strong student view against them. HACD adds no learnable parameters and needs one teacher pass per sample. It achieves the best or second-best accuracy on 11 of 12 heterogeneous pairs on CIFAR-100, without ground-truth labels, and on 14 of 15 pairs on ImageNet-1K, improving over the reported vanilla KD results by 8.82 and 1.33 percentage points on average. Checkpoints are available at https://github.com/BTAEYANG/HACD-Heterogeneous-Asymmetric-Contrastive-Distillation; the code will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [68] [MGE: A Membership Guided Data Extraction Attack against Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10678)
*Yuchang Mei,Longqiang Wang,Haoyang Jiang,Mingyang Yi,Shaolei Zhang,Keman Huang,Wuqiong Pan,Ju Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出成员引导提取（MGE）框架，将数据提取建模为条件生成，利用成员推理分类器信号作条件，并结合对抗梯度与并行分支解码，从预训练扩散模型中高效提取训练数据，实验证明可提取数百张图像，凸显扩散模型隐私风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在图像生成上表现优异，但其固有的记忆特性带来训练数据泄漏（数据提取攻击）的安全隐患。为揭示该风险，需要一种能有效从预训练扩散模型中提取训练数据的方法。

Method: 提出成员引导提取（MGE）框架，核心思想是把数据提取建模为条件生成，条件信号来自成员推理分类器；并引入对抗梯度与并行分支解码以提升成功率与效率。

Result: 在图像生成基准上的实验表明，MGE 能够提取出数百张图像，验证了训练数据泄漏攻击的可行性。

Conclusion: 扩散模型存在显著训练数据泄漏风险，需对模型隐私保护给予更多关注。

Abstract: Recently, diffusion models have achieved remarkable performance in image generation. However, their inherent memory properties introduce a potential safety risk of training data leakage, i.e., data extraction attack. To illustrate such risk, we propose a membership guided extraction (MGE) framework to effectively extract training data from a pre-trained diffusion model. Our core idea is to formulate the data extraction as a conditional generation, where the condition signal is from a membership inference classifier. To improve the success rate and efficiency of MGE, we propose adversarial gradient and parallel branch decoding. Our experiments on image generation benchmarks demonstrate that our MGE can extract hundreds of images, which shows that more attention should be paid to privacy-preserving of diffusion model.

</details>


### [69] [JoVox: Joint Hierarchical Flow Matching for Lightweight Voxel Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10690)
*Xiangjun Tang,Jianqi Chen,Peter Wonka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 JoVox：一种离散流匹配框架，学习体素层级所有层的联合分布，让细层细胞参与粗层决策，并配合两级预测与"解除掩码"重访策略，实现高保真且轻量的体素生成，在无条件和图像条件任务上超越基线，相比 TRELLIS.2 训练吞吐高 8 倍、前向 FLOPs 仅 1/15、GPU 用量 4 vs 32、Chamfer 距离低 11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真体素生成与轻量性难以兼得：现有生成器要么高保真但计算沉重，要么轻量但保真度低。分层方法虽保持体素轻量性，但其粗层决定了所有更细单元的分布位置，却仅用最少形状信息生成且从不被重新审视，因此常出现"看似合理但错误"的粗层。核心洞察是让细层单元参与粗层单元的决策。

Method: 1）JoVox 采用离散流匹配（discrete flow matching）框架，学习体素层级中所有层的联合分布，而非为每层单独建模，从而在预测粗单元时细单元已在邻近区域生成；2）两级预测（two-level prediction）：一次输出比当前层细两级的单元，使网络处理的层数减半；3）解除掩码（unmasking）策略：在细层生成后重访早期决策，修正掩码扩散模型中的不一致性。

Result: 在无条件生成与图像条件体素生成上均优于基线。相比当前 SOTA 的 TRELLIS.2：训练吞吐提升 8 倍，单次前向 FLOPs 仅为 1/15，仅需 4 块 GPU（对比 32 块），同时质量更高，Chamfer 距离降低 11%。

Conclusion: 通过联合建模体素层级所有层的分布并让细层反向影响粗层决策，配合两级预测与决策重访，可在保持体素轻量性的同时显著提升保真度与效率，说明粗层错误并非分层方法的固有缺陷，而可通过联合分布学习加以纠正。

Abstract: Generating high-fidelity voxels while keeping their lightweight nature remains an open problem in computer vision. Current generators are either high-fidelity but computationally heavy, or lightweight but of lower fidelity. Hierarchical methods keep the lightweight nature of voxels. However, their coarse levels, which decide where all finer cells can appear, are generated with the least information about the shape and are never revisited, so they are often plausible but wrong. Our key insight is to let finer cells take part in deciding coarse cells. To this end, we propose JoVox, a discrete flow matching framework that learns the joint distribution of all levels of the voxel hierarchy, instead of a separate distribution for each level, so that coarse cells can be predicted with finer cells already generated nearby. Within this framework, we further introduce a two-level prediction, which outputs the cells two levels finer at once instead of one level finer, halving the number of levels that the network processes and yielding voxels of higher fidelity. We also introduce an unmasking strategy that revisits early decisions once finer cells are generated and corrects inconsistencies in masked diffusion models. Our framework outperforms the baselines on both unconditional and image-conditioned voxel generation. Compared with the current state-of-the-art TRELLIS.2, we achieve 8x higher training throughput, 1/15 of the FLOPs in a forward pass, train on 4 vs. 32 GPUs, and obtain higher quality with an 11% lower Chamfer distance.

</details>


### [70] [Perception, Not Reasoning, Limits Visual Theory of Mind](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10694)
*Mohamed Rayan Barhdadi,Syed Talal Wasim,Juergen Gall,Erchin Serpedin,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出视觉心智理论（ToM）的主要瓶颈不在信念推理，而在感知前端：模型难以从视觉场景中抽取结构化的场景状态。作者用五条件“分离协议”在保持推理任务不变的情况下改变感知保真度，并以“感知贡献比”量化视觉—文本差距的闭合程度；在抽象2D面板与自然3D游戏场景上评测7个VLM、约15.9万次API调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在文本版错误信念任务上接近人类，但同一问题改为视觉呈现后性能下降超过20个百分点。主流解释将问题归因于概念/推理能力缺失，并主张新增信念推理模块；作者认为更主要的瓶颈是感知：模型不是不会推理，而是“看不见”正确场景状态。

Method: 提出五条件分离协议：保持推理任务不变，仅改变感知保真度，从纯视觉到纯文本设置多个条件；用感知贡献比（Perceptual Contribution Ratio）衡量某一保真度条件闭合了视觉—文本差距的比例。场景包括Heider–Simmel传统的抽象2D面板，以及MuMA-ToM和MindPower中的自然3D游戏场景。评测7个VLM，约159,000次API调用；对比真实场景状态脚手架与自动解析器（含前沿VLM）生成的脚手架。

Result: 真实场景状态脚手架在所有设置中显著缩小视觉—文本差距；在抽象面板和MuMA-ToM上达到或超过纯文本推理。自动解析器生成的脚手架则失败。纯视觉条件下最常见错误是“现实偏差”，占错误信念失败的60%：模型报告物体实际所在位置，而非缺席代理人所相信的位置，说明感知前端未能跟踪每个时刻哪些代理在场。

Conclusion: 在所评测协议下，视觉ToM的主要瓶颈是结构化视觉场景状态抽取，而非信念推断。要提升视觉ToM，应优先改进感知前端对代理在场性与场景状态的结构化提取，而非仅增加概念性信念推理模块。

Abstract: Vision-language models pass text-based false-belief probes at near-human levels but drop by over twenty percentage points on abstract panels the moment the same problem is conveyed visually. The consensus diagnosis is conceptual, prescribing new belief-reasoning modules. We argue the dominant bottleneck is perceptual: not what the model cannot reason about, but what it cannot see. We propose a five-condition dissociation protocol that holds the reasoning task constant while varying perceptual fidelity from visual only to text only, and quantify the result with the Perceptual Contribution Ratio, the share of the visual-to-text gap a given fidelity closes. We test this on two kinds of scenes: abstract 2D panels in the Heider--Simmel tradition, and naturalistic 3D game scenes from MuMA-ToM and MindPower. The evaluation covers seven VLMs and roughly 159,000 API calls. Ground-truth scaffolds substantially close the gap in every setting, and on the abstract panels and MuMA-ToM they match or exceed the text-only reasoning. Whereas scaffolds built by automatic parsers, including frontier VLMs, fail. The most common error in the visual-only condition is \emph{reality bias}, which accounts for 60\% of false-belief failures. Models report where an object actually is, not where an absent agent believes it is. This points to a perceptual front-end that fails to track which agents were present at each moment. Under the evaluated protocol, structured visual scene-state extraction, rather than belief inference, is the dominant bottleneck for visual ToM.

</details>


### [71] [PLS-GS: Probabilistic Lidar Scaffolds for Compact, Surface-Aligned Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10699)
*Krishnan Harikumar,Alejandro Fontan,Thierry Peynot,Emili Hernández,Niko Sünderhauf*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PLS-GS 提出一种概率 LiDAR 支架（Hierarchical Gaussian Mixture Model），联合拟合位置与颜色以指导 3DGS 重建，并用 Mahalanobis 支撑损失约束渲染高斯基元贴近 LiDAR 表面，从而在户外大场景中以更少基元获得更紧凑、更快的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 通常仅依赖图像优化，缺乏精确几何约束；而机器人与建图场景常同时提供相机图像和高精度 LiDAR 数据，如何利用这种互补传感构建与实测表面对齐的紧凑 3DGS 表示是本文动机。

Method: 构建概率 LiDAR 支架：对位置与颜色联合拟合层次化高斯混合模型（GMM），形成连续自适应支架，避免体素/八叉树离散划分；每个可渲染高斯关联一个 GMM 分量，并在该分量协方差诱导的局部表面坐标系中受约束；引入 Mahalanobis 支撑损失限制渲染高斯偏离 LiDAR 表面的程度。

Result: 在五个大型户外场景中，PLS-GS 的基元比图像初始化和 LiDAR 初始化基线更贴近 LiDAR 测量，同时使用显著更少基元，模型更紧凑、渲染更快；在相同容量下也更贴近 LiDAR 测量且渲染质量相当。

Conclusion: PLS-GS 表明，将 LiDAR 几何以概率混合模型形式作为支架，可有效提升 3DGS 的几何对齐性与紧凑性，适合机器人/建图等相机-LiDAR 联合场景。

Abstract: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is typically optimized from images only, many robotics and mapping applications provide both camera and high-definition LiDAR data, combining rich visual appearance with accurate geometric structure. We introduce PLS-GS, a probabilistic LiDAR scaffold for Gaussian Splatting that exploits this complementary sensing setting to construct a compact 3DGS representation aligned to the measured surface. PLS-GS fits a Hierarchical Gaussian Mixture Model jointly over position and color, yielding a continuous and adaptive scaffold that eliminates the need for discrete scene partitioning such as voxel grids or octrees. The fitted mixture then guides the renderable 3DGS Gaussians: each rendering Gaussian is associated with a GMM component and constrained in the local surface frame induced by that component's covariance. A Mahalanobis support loss bounds the deviation of the rendering Gaussians from the corresponding LiDAR-derived surface. Across five large outdoor scenes, PLS-GS places primitives markedly closer to the LiDAR measurements than both image- and LiDAR-initialized baselines, while employing substantially fewer primitives, yielding a considerably more compact model and faster rendering. At matched capacity, PLS-GS places primitives closer to the LiDAR measurements, with comparable rendering quality. Code is available at https://github.com/k-harikumar/PLS-GS.

</details>


### [72] [Quadratic Bezier Splatting with Structural Initialization for Efficient Painting Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10713)
*Jinfan Liu,Xuhan Zhan,Mengqin Zhao,Guangyi Deng,Wuze Zhang,Bingbing Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出模型引导的笔画审计渲染框架，用可解析、可微的二次Bezier Splatting建模连续曲线笔画，并结合多尺度笔画解码器、测试时优化与单笔画审计，提升布局连贯性、重建质量与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于笔画的渲染常被当作像素级重建任务，过度依赖全局误差下降，导致笔画缺乏结构化规划而退化为碎片化曲线；同时，局部有缺陷的图元会被重叠层掩盖，难以被优化过程剔除。

Method: 提出模型引导的笔画审计渲染框架：1）使用Quadratic Bezier Splatting对连续曲线笔画进行解析建模，并实现高效可微alpha合成；2）基于该渲染器构建前馈多尺度笔画解码器，学习笔画尺度分配并提供结构化初始化；3）在测试时进行笔画优化以完成高保真细化；4）引入单笔画审计机制，显式评估局部笔画质量，阻止缺陷图元通过逐层补偿在优化中存活。

Result: 与现有方法相比，方法获得更连贯的布局，PSNR最高提升5.46 dB，表示更紧凑约16%，渲染器前向与反向联合计算加速220.3倍。

Conclusion: 将笔画渲染从纯像素级重建转向结构规划与局部质量审计相结合，可在提升重建质量与表示紧凑性的同时显著加速计算，说明显式建模连续笔画并审计单笔画质量是有效方向。

Abstract: Stroke-based rendering is often optimized as a pixel-level reconstruction task. This over-reliance on global error reduction not only degrades strokes into fragmented curves due to a lack of structured planning, but also allows locally defective primitives to be concealed by overlapping layers. To address these issues, we introduce a model-guided framework for stroke-audited rendering. Our framework uses Quadratic Bezier Splatting to analytically model continuous curved strokes with efficient differentiable alpha compositing. Built on this renderer, a feedforward multi-scale stroke decoder provides a structural initialization with learned stroke-scale allocation, while test-time stroke optimization supplies the reconstruction capacity needed for high-fidelity refinement.
