Spatial adapters are assigned before this boundary and temporal adapters after it, without modifying the adapter architecture itself. On four fine-grained action recognition benchmarks, STRAP improves accuracy by up to 11.8% over uniform placement, reduces trainable parameters by 29 to 48%, and lowers inference time by up to 10%. On standard benchmarks, it matches accuracy with fewer parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/th-nesh/STRAP.

</details>


### [107] [Map2SLAM: From Streaming Map Prediction to Real-Time SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11169)
*Jian Gao,Lin-Zhuo Chen,Yihang Chen,Jiagang Chen,Jiacheng Dong,Xun Cao,Nan Xue,Yinghao Xu,Yao Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Map2SLAM 将冻结的流式 3D 基础模型（LingBot-Map）作为观测源，把其输出接入外部的持久 SLAM 状态，通过前端关键帧写入与后端异步重观测实现可修正的轨迹与几何，在多个数据集上 ATE 降低 40% 以上并保持实时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式 3DFM 能在线估计相机位姿与稠密几何，但其预测一经输出便固定不变，无法通过回环闭合纠正累积漂移，因而尚不等同于 SLAM。核心问题于是变成：如何调度这类模型的推理，并让其结果成为可被反复修正的状态。

Method: 保持 LingBot-Map 完全冻结，仅训练一个轻量检索头，在该模型的推理接口之上构建 SLAM：前端用因果流式推理逐帧跟踪，并决定哪些帧作为关键帧写入持久状态；后端异步决定何时、对哪些历史帧重新观测，以新的上下文重新运行模型的联合推理；经验证的闭环观测在线校正轨迹，分段观测在序列结束后精化稠密几何。所有调用共享每幅图像的单次编码器前向，其缓存特征同时用于回环检索，因此频繁重调用不增加额外编码开销。

Result: 在 KITTI、VBR 与 Oxford Spires 上取得最优性能，相较最佳免标定基线平均 ATE 降低 40% 以上；在 NVIDIA RTX 5090D 上以 518×154 分辨率保持 28 FPS 以上的实时跟踪。

Conclusion: 该工作表明无需微调大型 3D 基础模型，只需合理调度其推理并引入外部持久状态与异步重观测机制，即可把流式 3DFM 升级为具备回环纠错能力的 SLAM 系统，兼顾精度与实时性。

Abstract: Streaming 3D foundation models (3DFMs) estimate camera poses and dense geometry online, but they fall short of SLAM: their predictions are fixed once emitted, so loop closures cannot correct accumulated drift. With such models already providing strong geometric capability, a central question for SLAM becomes how to schedule their inference and how to keep its results as revisable state. We present Map2SLAM, which keeps LingBot-Map frozen, trains only a lightweight retrieval head, and builds SLAM on the model's inference interface, turning its predictions into observations of an external persistent SLAM state. The front-end tracks every incoming frame with the model's causal streaming inference and decides which frames are written to the persistent state as keyframes. The back-end asynchronously decides when and which past frames to re-observe, re-running the model's joint inference over them with fresh context; verified loop observations correct the trajectory online, and segment observations refine dense geometry after the sequence. All invocations share a single frame encoder pass per image, whose cached features also drive loop retrieval, so frequent re-invocation incurs no additional encoding cost. Map2SLAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, VBR, and Oxford Spires, reducing mean ATE by over 40% compared with the best uncalibrated baselines, while maintaining real-time tracking at over 28 FPS at a resolution of $518\times154$ on an NVIDIA RTX 5090D GPU. Please visit our project page at https://robbyant-research.github.io/Map2SLAM/.

</details>


### [108] [Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression for Extreme Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11200)
*Bingxin Wang,Yuan Lan,Yang Xiang,Yiqing Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SAVAR：在极低码率（<0.01 bpp）下，用VAR生成式编解码器传输早期尺度token与紧凑caption，分别提供布局与全局语义，从而减少身份/纹理不确定导致的重建失真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极低码率图像压缩本质是受约束的生成问题：既要补全缺失细节，又要保持与源图像一致。现有自回归token模型虽能提供由粗到细的先验，但传输的早期尺度token往往不足以确定物体身份和纹理，易产生与源图像不一致的重建。

Method: SAVAR基于Visual Autoregressive（VAR）建模：传输早期尺度token和紧凑caption；由保留尺度重建部分VQ-VAE latent，并将其映射为序列起始（start-of-sequence）初始化；同一latent还用于在自适应LayerNorm前条件化caption嵌入，从而分离VAR式生成中通常由共享条件承担的两个角色。

Result: 在Kodak和CLIC2020的极低码率区间，与匹配的ARPC保留尺度工作点相比，SAVAR在更低bpp下将LPIPS降低约8–9%，DISTS最多降低22%；在单张NVIDIA L20X GPU上重建512×512图像约需218 ms，保持较快的自回归解码速度。

Conclusion: SAVAR通过源锚定的token-latent初始化与caption语义条件分离，在极低码率下实现更低的感知失真并保持快速解码，为生成式图像压缩提供了有效方案。

Abstract: In the extreme-low bitrate range below $0.01$ bpp, image compression becomes a constrained generation problem: the reconstruction depends on inferring plausible missing details while staying close to the input image. Autoregressive token models provide an efficient coarse-to-fine prior for this setting, but the transmitted early-scale tokens often leave object identity and texture underdetermined, which can lead to source-inconsistent reconstructions. We introduce Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression (SAVAR), a generative codec built on Visual Autoregressive (VAR) modeling. SAVAR transmits early-scale tokens and a compact caption. The tokens provide image-specific layout information, while the caption supplies global semantics. SAVAR reconstructs a partial VQ-VAE latent from the retained scales, maps it to the start-of-sequence initialization, and uses the same latent to condition the caption embedding before adaptive layer normalization, separating two roles that are typically driven by a shared condition in VAR-style generation. On the Kodak and CLIC2020 datasets in the extreme-low range, SAVAR reduces perceptual distortion relative to matched ARPC retained-scale operating points, lowering LPIPS by about $8$--$9\%$ and DISTS by up to $22\%$ at a lower bpp. It reconstructs a $512 \times 512$ image in about $218$ ms on one NVIDIA L20X GPU, retaining fast autoregressive decoding in the evaluated setting.

</details>


### [109] [Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11934)
*Wanhui Luo,Hongbo Zhao,Yi Zhou,Qijun Chen,Yiming Nie,Rui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 S²D-FVO 单目鱼眼视觉里程计框架，将球面光束法平差（SBA）与无监督深度学习结合，利用切空间角度重投影残差和中值深度尺度正则，提升长轨迹尺度一致性与深度估计精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目鱼眼相机视场大、配置简单，适合机器人定位建图，但长轨迹存在严重尺度漂移；无监督深度学习可缓解该问题，然而鱼眼图像强畸变使深度估计困难，且传统像素重投影残差与标量角度残差对切向扰动不敏感。

Method: 构建 S²D-FVO 框架：SBA 采用由球面对数映射得到的切空间角度重投影残差，使其在两个切向方向均保持敏感性且范数等于标量角度残差；加入基于中值深度的尺度正则项约束重建尺度；在无监督深度学习中用 SBA 替代位姿估计网络以提供更可靠相对位姿，并用训练好的深度网络为 SBA 提供尺度参考，同时优化三维路标位置。

Result: 在多个公开数据集及两个新采集的大规模数据集上实验表明，该框架在深度与轨迹估计精度上优于代表性现有方法，并适用于不同相机模型。

Conclusion: SBA 引导的无监督深度学习与深度尺度参考形成互补闭环，可有效提升单目鱼眼 VO 的尺度一致性和深度估计精度，具有良好的泛化性与实用性。

Abstract: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.

</details>


### [110] [Viscot-steer: Disentangling and Transferring Visual Chain-of-Thought via Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11209)
*Ningning Wang,Beier Zhu,Xingyu Zhu,Kaiyun Yang,Xun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练激活引导框架 Viscot-steer，将视觉思维链拆分为“定位”和“推理”两类向量并跨异构 LVLMs 迁移，在多个基准上平均超过最强基线 1.86 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-CoT 能力通常依赖昂贵后训练且与特定主干模型强耦合，难以迁移到其他 LVLMs；现有跨模型迁移方法把视觉-CoT 当作单一能力，忽略定位与推理的功能差异，并引入与阶段无关的干预。

Method: Viscot-steer 是免训练的激活引导框架：先将视觉-CoT 解耦为 grounding vector 与 reasoning vector，从源模型对应能力层中提取；再将其对齐到目标模型激活空间；最后在边界框预测和推理轨迹生成阶段分别引导定位层与推理层。

Result: 在高分辨率视觉理解、通用视觉感知与推理、数学视觉推理等基准上，Viscot-steer 可将不同视觉-CoT 模型的能力迁移到结构差异明显的 LVLMs，主指标平均优于最强能力迁移基线 1.86 个百分点。

Conclusion: 按功能解耦并按阶段引导的激活干预，比将视觉-CoT 视为单一能力的统一表示更有效，为跨异构 LVLMs 的视觉-CoT 能力迁移提供了免训练方案。

Abstract: Visual chain-of-thought (visual-CoT), also known as "thinking with images", equips LVLMs with the ability to locate and use key visual evidence for reasoning. However, acquiring such visual-CoT capabilities requires costly post-training and tightly couples them to a specific backbone, making transfer to other LVLMs difficult. Existing cross-model transfer methods typically treat visual-CoT as a monolithic capability, using a unified representation that ignores the functional distinction between grounding and reasoning and introduces stage-irrelevant interventions. To address this problem, we propose Viscot-steer, a training-free activation steering framework for transferring visual-CoT capabilities across heterogeneous LVLMs. Specifically, Viscot-steer first disentangles visual-CoT into grounding and reasoning vectors and extracts them from the source-model layers associated with the corresponding capabilities. It then aligns the vectors with the activation space of the target model and steers the grounding and reasoning layers during bounding-box prediction and reasoning-trace generation, respectively. Across benchmarks covering high-resolution visual understanding, general visual perception and reasoning, and mathematical visual reasoning, Viscot-steer transfers capabilities from different visual-CoT models to architecturally diverse LVLMs and outperforms the strongest capability-transfer baseline by an average of 1.86 percentage points on the primary evaluation metrics.

</details>


### [111] [Compass 1: Towards Open-World and Persistent Embodied Navigation from Monocular RGB Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12087)
*Hai Zhang,Siqi Liang,Yanjun Guo,Shoufeng Zhang,Yunhao Wang,Hangyu Du,Haoguang Mai,Hongchen Li,Jiazhi Yang,Jialong Zeng,Yu Hu,Chen Chen,Gangcheng Jiang,Zishun Zhuo,Lirui Zhao,Zhigang Li,Yu Qiao,Zhenjie Yang,Fu Zhang,Hongyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Compass 1 是首个统一语言理解与视频生成的具身导航基础模型，通过历史表示与结构化 VQA 监督实现近 2 分钟视觉历史回溯，并在开放世界导航中显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身导航架构难以同时维持长期空间感知与长时序执行稳定性，通常只能有效利用最近少量帧，无法支撑开放环境中的持久导航。

Method: 在不改变底层架构的前提下，引入 History Representation：将稀疏视觉关键帧与显式 History Representation Map 结合，保留长期时空上下文；并提出 History Utilization，即包含任务阶段 grounding、探索一致性和时空目标检索三类任务的结构化 VQA 监督协议，以支持地图 grounded 推理和稳定长时序导航。同时构建单目 RGB 视频标注流程，开源超过 500 小时真实交互数据和 2000 小时以上带标注网络视频数据。

Result: Compass 1 主要在 1m 高度相机分布上训练，可泛化至 0.35m 轮式机器人、0.5m 四足机器人、0.85m 人形机器人和 1.5m 无人机等不同具身形态与场景。开放世界评估总体成功率达 79.4%，最强基线为 17.8%；基础任务零样本执行超过 90%，探索能力提升 250%，困难的历史回溯任务从 0% 提升至 58%。

Conclusion: Compass 1 通过历史表示与历史利用协议，将语言理解、视频生成和长期视觉记忆统一到具身导航基础模型中，实现了跨具身、跨场景的强泛化与长时序导航能力。

Abstract: Embodied navigation requires agents to achieve persistent spatial awareness and long-horizon execution stability in open-world environments. However, existing navigation architectures struggle to sustain both capabilities, remaining effective only over a handful of recent frames. We present Compass 1, the first embodied navigation foundation model to unify language understanding and video generation while enabling memory backtracking through nearly 2mins of visual history. Without altering the underlying architecture, we introduce History Representation, which integrates sparse visual keyframes with an explicit History Representation Map to preserve long-term spatiotemporal context. To effectively leverage this history, we further introduce History Utilization, a structured VQA supervision protocol comprising three categories: task-stage grounding, exploration consistency, and spatiotemporal target retrieval, enabling map-grounded reasoning and stable persistent long-horizon navigation. To fuel this system, we establish a complete annotation pipeline for monocular RGB videos and open-source a massive dataset featuring over 500 hours of high-quality real-world interactions and over 2,000 hours of annotated web videos. Trained mainly on the distribution of 1m height camera, Compass 1 generalizes seamlessly across diverse embodiments and scenarios, ranging from indoor environments to pedestrian-dense streets, spanning wheeled robot at 0.35m, quadruped dog at 0.5m, humanoid at 0.85m, and aerial drone at 1.5m. Compass 1achieves a dominant overall success rate of 79.4% across open-world evaluations, compared to 17.8% for the strongest baseline. It demonstrates exceptional zero-shot execution exceeding 90% on foundational tasks, a 250% boost in exploration, and an unparalleled leap from 0% to 58% in challenging persistent history backtracking.

</details>


### [112] [DynOLAT: OLAT Video Prediction for Controllable Dynamic Full-Body Relighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11210)
*Taoming Liu,Yinji ShenTu,Guangzhao He,Yudong Jin,Yukang Ye,Siyu Zhang,Fan Jia,Wei Hua,Hujun Bao,Xiaowei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DynOLAT：从平光输入预测时序一致的OLAT基视频，再按目标环境图线性组合，实现动态全身人体可控重光照；并构建首个大规模动态全身OLAT数据集（2400万帧+、224组身份-服装组合）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习式动态人体重光照方法虽视觉上合理，但光照响应不精确：阴影/高光方向易偏离目标，亮度不忠实跟随目标相对强度，更像外观协调而非可控重光照。需要使方向性与相对强度显式可控。

Method: DynOLAT为可泛化的OLAT视频预测框架：不直接合成单一重光照外观，而是从平光视频预测时序一致的One-Light-At-a-Time基视频；再依据目标环境图得到线性权重，对基视频线性组合。方向响应体现在OLAT基中，相对强度由环境图权重决定。另提出动态采集管线并构建大规模动态全身OLAT数据集。

Result: 数据集含224个身份-服装组合、超过2400万帧（同一人的不同服装视为不同组合）。实验表明DynOLAT对目标光照方向与相对强度的响应比基线更忠实，可在保持细节与时序连贯的同时实现可控视频重光照。数据集与处理工具将公开。

Conclusion: 以OLAT基预测+环境图线性组合的分解式重光照，比直接端到端合成更利于显式控制光照方向与强度；配套数据与工具将推动动态人体重光照研究。

Abstract: Accurate lighting response is essential for realistic dynamic human relighting, because shadows, highlights, and color changes should follow the target illumination in both direction and relative strength. Current learning-based relighting methods can generate visually plausible videos, but they often exhibit imprecise lighting responses: shadows and highlights may drift away from the target direction, and the output brightness may not faithfully follow the relative intensities in the target environment, making the result closer to appearance harmonization than controllable relighting. To address this issue, we propose DynOLAT, a generalizable OLAT video prediction framework for dynamic full-body humans. Instead of directly synthesizing a single relit appearance, our method predicts temporally consistent One-Light-At-a-Time (OLAT) basis videos from flat-lit inputs, and then linearly combines the predicted bases according to the target environment map. This OLAT-based formulation makes the directional response explicit in the predicted bases, while the relative lighting strength is determined by the linear weights derived from the environment map. We further introduce a dynamic capture pipeline and the first large-scale dynamic full-body OLAT dataset, comprising over 24 million frames from 224 identity-outfit combinations, where different outfits of the same person define separate combinations. Experiments show that DynOLAT responds more faithfully to variations in target lighting direction and relative intensity than the tested baselines, enabling controllable video relighting while preserving fine appearance details and temporal coherence. The dataset and processing tools will be publicly released to foster future research.

</details>


### [113] [Disentangling Where and When:Factored Spatio-Temporal Explanations for Video Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11214)
*Bhavan Vasu,Giuseppe Raffa,Prasad Tadepalli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于扰动的视频动作识别事后解释框架，将解释分解为空间外观掩码与时间运动掩码并联合优化，在多个数据集上以更高稀疏度取得更优删除AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频动作识别的事后解释方法通常把空间外观信息与时间动态信息混合在单一显著性图中，难以区分二者各自对预测的贡献。

Method: 构建因子化扰动框架，在冻结的动作识别模型上联合优化空间外观掩码M_a与时间运动掩码M_m；采用最近帧替换识别关键时间动态；引入分离惩罚避免外观掩码在运动掩码已丢弃的帧上分配预算；使用基于ReLU的面积约束惩罚超出预算的解释区域；并提出独立扫描空间像素与时间帧的分离评测协议及相应理论证明。

Result: 在EPIC-Kitchens-55、EGTEA Gaze+和Something-Something V2上，该方法相对主流基线取得最低删除AUC，同时生成的掩码约稀疏五倍。

Conclusion: 空间外观与时间运动贡献可以被有效解耦；所提框架在解释忠实度与稀疏性之间取得更好平衡，优于现有基线。

Abstract: Post-hoc explanation methods for video action recognition typically conflate spatial appearance and temporal dynamics into a single saliency or importance map. We propose a perturbation-based framework that disentangles these contributions into a spatial appearance mask ($M_a$) and a temporal motion mask ($M_m$). The two masks are jointly optimized against a frozen action recognition model through factored perturbation architecture, with nearest frame replacement to identify important temporal dynamics. A separation penalty discourages the appearance mask from spending budget on frames that the motion mask has already discarded. A ReLU-based area constraint penalizes explanations larger than an assigned budget. To evaluate these explanations, we introduce a separation protocol that sweeps spatial pixels and temporal frames independently, backed by proofs characterizing the proposed method. Across EPIC-Kitchens-55, EGTEA Gaze+, and Something-Something V2, our method attains the lowest deletion AUC against leading baselines while producing masks roughly five times sparser.

</details>


### [114] [EgoLabel: Zero-Shot Egocentric Auto-Labeling with Cross-Modal Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12149)
*Xiaozhi Zhang,Changjia Xu,Yaoyuan Yan,Haoxiang Jie,Bingjie Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出零样本流水线 EgoLabel，组合现成模型实现第一人称自动标注，并给出跨模态配准与一致性诊断；在 H2O 上以逐手深度锚定降低手-深度残差，但同时揭示对齐精度与绝对度量精度之间的显著差距及评估局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一人称自动标注需要深度、相机位姿、物体与人体姿态等来自独立模型的估计在几何上互相一致；然而各单位、坐标约定与尺度差异会使单独看似合理的预测相互矛盾，因此需要显式的跨模态配准与一致性诊断。

Method: 构建零样本流水线 EgoLabel，不使用目标域标注训练：(1) MonST3R 提供几何/深度；(2) LocateAnything 配合 GMC-BoT-SORT 与 SAM 2 完成物体检测与跟踪分割；(3) V-HPOT 估计手部姿态，FisheyeViT 作全身兼容性演示。核心为逐手深度锚定的跨模态配准，并输出一致性诊断指标。主评测使用 H2O 传感器深度。

Result: 在 20 个序列上，逐手深度锚定相较单一全局尺度将各序列手-深度残差中位数的均值降低 23%，汇总中位数为 84.6 mm，而真值参考为 20.5 mm。手部 PA-MPJPE 为 14.53±1.29 mm，绝对 MPJPE 却达 119.1±31.3 mm，显示对齐精度与度量精度差距明显。三个纯 RGB 序列上，Sim(3) 对齐后相机 ATE 为 1.40±0.29 cm。另发现滑动窗口实现问题会使传感器初始化深度在优化中发生漂移。

Conclusion: 该工作刻画了配准流水线的实用价值与当前极限：由于手部锚定与其残差共享同一深度图，残差反映的是内部一致性而非独立精度；同时对滑动窗口实现缺陷的揭示提示后续需改进尺度锚定与评估协议。

Abstract: Egocentric auto-labeling requires depth, camera pose, object, and human-pose estimates to agree across independently developed models. Differences in units, coordinate conventions, and scale can make individually plausible predictions geometrically inconsistent. We present \textbf{EgoLabel}, a zero-shot pipeline that combines off-the-shelf models without target-domain labeled training and provides explicit cross-modal registration and consistency diagnostics. The pipeline integrates MonST3R for geometry, LocateAnything with GMC-BoT-SORT and SAM~2 for objects, and V-HPOT for hands; FisheyeViT provides a separate whole-body compatibility demonstration. Our main hand evaluation uses H2O sensor depth. Across 20 sequences, per-hand depth anchoring reduces the mean of per-sequence median hand--depth residuals by $23\%$ relative to a single global scale, yielding a pooled median of $84.6\,\mathrm{mm}$ against a $20.5\,\mathrm{mm}$ ground-truth reference. Hand PA-MPJPE is $14.53\pm1.29\,\mathrm{mm}$, whereas absolute MPJPE is $119.1\pm31.3\,\mathrm{mm}$, revealing a substantial gap between aligned and metric accuracy. On three RGB-only sequences, camera ATE is $1.40\pm0.29\,\mathrm{cm}$ after $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ alignment. We also identify a sliding-window implementation issue that allows sensor-initialized depth to change during optimization. Because hand anchoring and its residual share the same depth map, the residual measures internal consistency rather than independent accuracy. These results characterize both the utility and the current limits of the registration pipeline.

</details>


### [115] [Auto-GlaKG: Automated Biomarker Reasoning for Explainable Glaucoma Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11258)
*Cheng Huang,Zeyu Han,Yian Hu,Yaopeng Ding,Jingxi Qiu,Yadi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Auto-GlaKG框架：用ResNet50从眼底图像预测CDR及6项形态体征，再由知识图谱规则推理聚合成青光眼评分，实现可解释的自动检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可解释青光眼检测需要建立眼底图像、临床有意义生物标志物与诊断预测之间的透明联系；知识图谱推理可提供结构化解释，但仅用标注生物标志物评估无法反映仅输入图像时的真实性能。

Method: Auto-GlaKG将基于ResNet50的生物标志物预测与固定临床先验规则结合：网络在生物标志物监督下预测杯盘比（CDR）和6种形态学体征，知识图谱推理器将各体征的带符号规则贡献聚合为青光眼评分；采用分层、分组感知的五折交叉验证在689张眼底图像上评估。

Result: 汇总AUC为0.951（95%CI 0.931–0.969），敏感度0.970、特异度0.779；匹配的图像分类器AUC也为0.951，规则阶段每图仅增加约0.2 ms；将预测CDR替换为标注CDR后，折均值AUC由0.953提升至0.995。

Conclusion: 该框架为基于图像的预测提供显式规则级解释，并表明CDR估计是后续使用独立测量生物标志物进行验证的优先方向。

Abstract: Interpretable glaucoma detection requires a transparent connection between fundus images, clinically meaningful biomarkers, and diagnostic predictions. Knowledge graph (KG) reasoning provides this structure, but performance measured using annotated biomarkers does not establish performance when only images are available. We present Auto-GlaKG, an automated framework that combines image-based biomarker prediction with fixed clinical-prior rules. A ResNet50 network predicts the cup-to-disc ratio (CDR) and six morphological signs using biomarker supervision, and a KG reasoner aggregates their signed rule contributions into a glaucoma score. On 689 fundus images evaluated using stratified, group-aware five-fold cross-validation, Auto-GlaKG achieves a pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.951 (95\% confidence interval: 0.931--0.969), with sensitivity of 0.970 and specificity of 0.779. The matched image classifier also achieves an AUC of 0.951, while the rule stage adds 0.2~ms per image. Replacing predicted CDR with its annotation increases fold-mean AUC from 0.953 to 0.995. The framework provides an explicit rule-level account of image-based predictions and identifies CDR estimation as a priority for validation using independently measured biomarkers.

</details>


### [116] [DuSS-PET: Self-Supervised Low-Dose PET Reconstruction Using Pseudo-Dual-Domain Consistency Without Paired Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11265)
*Shuijin Lin,Yuzhu He,Yongbo Wang,Jianhua Ma,Fan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DuSS-PET：无需配对低/全剂量数据的自监督低剂量PET重建框架


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PET成像质量依赖较高辐射剂量；现有深度学习低剂量重建多依赖配对低剂量与全剂量扫描，而这类配对数据在临床中难以获取，限制了实际应用。

Method: 提出基于Noisier2Noise范式的自监督框架DuSS-PET，不依赖任何配对低/全剂量数据。采用Bernoulli损坏策略在图像空间近似模拟低计数噪声，生成伪sinogram表示；框架包含自适应Swin Transformer进行伪sinogram恢复、即插即用图像增强模块，以及约束伪sinogram与图像表示一致性的自监督策略。

Result: 在多中心数据集上，DuSS-PET重建性能优于现有自监督方法，并在多种剂量水平下达到与全监督方法相当甚至更优的结果；在不同扫描仪厂商之间表现出较好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该工作是较早通过伪sinogram与重建图像一致性约束实现自监督低剂量PET重建的框架之一，图像空间生成的伪sinogram可作为有效的计算一致性约束，在无需全剂量训练扫描的情况下提升成像质量。

Abstract: Positron emission tomography (PET) is pivotal in medicine and healthcare, but requires high radiation doses for quality imaging. Although deep learning has shown promise for low-dose PET reconstruction/enhancement, existing methods primarily rely on fully supervised learning, which requires paired low- and full-dose scans that are clinically impractical to obtain. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose DuSS-PET, a novel self-supervised PET reconstruction framework that operates without any paired low- and full-dose data. Our method is built upon a computational Noisier2Noise (Nr2N) paradigm, featuring a Bernoulli corruption strategy that serves as an image-space approximation to emulate low-count noise patterns in image-derived pseudo-sinogram representations. The DuSS-PET framework integrates three core components: an adaptive Swin transformer for pseudo-sinogram restoration, a plug-and-play module for image enhancement, and a consistency-constrained SSL strategy that enforces agreement between the pseudo-sinogram and image representations. Extensive experiments on multi-center datasets demonstrate that DuSS-PET achieves superior reconstruction performance, outperforming state-of-the-art SSL methods and achieving comparable or even better results than fully supervised approaches across various dose levels. In particular, it exhibits exceptional generalization across different scanner vendors. This work is among the first self-supervised low-dose PET reconstruction framework that enforces consistency between reconstructed images and pseudo-sinograms, where the pseudo-sinogram generated in the image space serves as a solid computational consistency constraint for enhanced imaging without full-dose training scans. The source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/ladderlab-xjtu/DuSS-PET.

</details>


### [117] [BiRefNet-V2: Rethinking Bilateral Reference for High-Resolution Dichotomous Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11272)
*Peng Zheng,Deng-Ping Fan,Binglu Wang,Nicu Sebe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出 BiRefNet-V2，将二值图像分割重新表述为“受控信息恢复”，通过局部性保持的语义门控细节注入、无需边界标注的学习式边界流，以及双分支解码器，在 13 个评测集上取得 SOTA，并将训练轮数从 600 降到 50。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二值图像分割需要像素级前景/背景分离，并保留细丝、锐边和复杂纹理。原有 BiRefNet 的双边参考存在缺陷：向内参考丢失局部空间结构且缺少语义引导，向外参考仅依赖单通道梯度注意力。

Method: 作者把问题重述为受控信息恢复：局部性决定哪些空间信息保留，语义选择性决定哪些信息进入，聚焦边界监督决定细化位置。具体包括：(1) 通过 space-to-depth 变换、重叠 patch 和 Semantically Guided Gate 实现保局部且语义引导的细节注入；(2) 学习式边界流与聚焦监督，在无需边界标注的情况下生成全通道残差注意力；(3) 双分支解码器，结合深度可分离边界卷积与大核注意力。框架现代化采用 LayerNorm、GELU、Lion 优化器和 DINOv3 主干。

Result: 在 DIS5K、伪装目标检测和高分辨率显著目标检测的 13 个评测集上均达到 state-of-the-art；训练轮数从 600 降至 50。

Conclusion: BiRefNet-V2 通过受控信息恢复的设计有效改进了双边参考范式，在保持细节与边界精度的同时显著提升训练效率，并展现出跨任务、跨评测集的强泛化性能。

Abstract: Dichotomous image segmentation requires pixel-accurate foreground-background separation while preserving fine structures such as thin filaments, sharp edges, and intricate textures. BiRefNet addressed this challenge through bilateral references, combining image patches and gradient information, but its inward reference loses local spatial structure and lacks semantic guidance, while its outward reference relies on single-channel gradient attention. We recast this paradigm as controlled information recovery - locality determines what spatial information survives, semantic selectivity what information enters, and focused boundary supervision where refinement occurs - and propose BiRefNet-V2 to implement it: (1) locality-preserving and semantically guided detail injection through space-to-depth transformation, overlapping patches, and a Semantically Guided Gate; (2) a learned boundary stream with focused supervision that generates full-channel residual attention without requiring boundary annotations; and (3) a dual-branch decoder integrating depth-wise boundary convolutions with large-kernel attention. A modernized framework - LayerNorm, GELU, the Lion optimizer, and a DINOv3 backbone - cuts training from 600 to 50 epochs. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on DIS5K, camouflaged object detection, and high-resolution salient object detection across all 13 evaluation sets. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet-V2.

</details>


### [118] [TransArt3D: From Two States to Articulated 3D Reconstruction with Video Transition Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11304)
*Chenhao Guan,Liying Yang,Xinxing Yu,Hao Mo,Tianshun Han,Renjun Gao,Yanyan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TransArt3D 用两张端点图像重建可交互的铰接式 3D 资产，将视频扩散模型隐含的过渡先验转化为显式的部件结构与关节运动学，在 PartNet-Mobility 上取得优于同输入及部分更多状态方法的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从少量图像重建可交互铰接资产高度欠约束。现有优化方法依赖静态 3D 先验并逐状态独立评分，单状态重建误差会泄漏到运动部件与关节，形成虚假运动；视频扩散模型虽能建模状态间运动，但仅以 2D 方式隐式表达。

Method: 提出基于优化的 TransArt3D：先用过渡耦合的 3D 共识联合提升端点间生成帧，稳定不变区域并初始化部件与关节；再用整流流运动学细化，让视频先验监督整个过渡的 3D 运动场，同时以部件分配和共享关节约束优化；最后用运动感知的规范外观融合，将两幅端点图像映射到统一规范表面，补全仅单状态可见的纹理区域。

Result: 在 PartNet-Mobility 上，TransArt3D 在相同两幅端点输入下，几何与关节精度优于对比方法；在铰接状态几何、关节定位和外观方面，超过使用六个观测状态的方法。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，将视频扩散中的状态过渡先验显式转化为部件级结构与关节运动约束，可有效缓解少视图铰接重建中的虚假运动问题，并为机器人、仿真等应用提供更准确的铰接资产重建方案。

Abstract: Reconstructing interactable articulated assets from a few images is key to robotics and simulation, yet highly underconstrained. Existing optimization-based methods fit an articulated asset under a static 3D prior that scores each state independently, so per-state reconstruction errors leak into the estimated moving part and joint as false motion. Video diffusion models capture how objects move between states, but only implicitly in 2D. To this end, we present TransArt3D, an optimization-based framework that reconstructs an articulated 3D asset from two endpoint images by translating this video transition prior into explicit part structure and joint kinematics. It first lifts frames generated between the endpoints with a transition-coupled 3D consensus that applies the static 3D prior jointly across frames, stabilizing unchanging regions and initializing the parts and joint. A rectified-flow kinematic refinement then lets the video prior supervise a 3D motion field over the whole transition, while part assignment and a shared joint constrain the field throughout optimization, keeping per-state errors out of the articulation. Finally, a motion-aware canonical appearance fusion uses the recovered articulation to map both endpoint images onto one canonical surface, texturing regions that only one state reveals. On PartNet-Mobility, TransArt3D outperforms methods given the same two endpoints in geometry and joint accuracy, and surpasses methods given six observed states in articulated-state geometry, joint localization and appearance.

</details>


### [119] [Beyond Similarity Entropy: A Rank-Guided Data-Free Quantization Framework for Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11320)
*Runqing Jiang,Ye Zhang,Pengpeng Yu,Zhuo Song,Changjun Li,Longguang Wang,Yulan Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RankQ-ViT：利用秩引导的数据无量化框架，提升ViT低比特量化校准样本的多样性与有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT计算与存储开销大，难以部署到移动端；现有数据无量化方法通过最大化patch相似性熵合成校准样本，但相似性熵只描述相似度数值的离散程度，不能保证样本覆盖多样特征方向，限制量化校准效果。

Method: 观察到高斯噪声生成的patch相似性矩阵秩低于真实图像，提出块感知自对比目标，在合成数据生成中促进特征多样性且无需逐步显式计算矩阵秩；随后依据秩与语义一致性筛选校准样本，并对量化模型进行分块重建。

Result: 在ImageNet、COCO、ModelNet40和ShapeNet上，跨多种架构与任务的实验验证了RankQ-ViT的有效性，尤其在低比特量化下表现突出。

Conclusion: 以秩为引导可更有效地生成和筛选ViT量化校准数据，为无训练数据条件下的ViT压缩提供可行方案。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated remarkable performance, yet their computational and memory demands pose significant challenges for deployment on mobile devices. Data-free quantization (DFQ) enables the compression of ViTs without access to their original training data. Existing DFQ methods often synthesize calibration samples by maximizing the entropy of patch similarity. However, similarity entropy describes the dispersion of similarity values without ensuring that the generated samples cover diverse feature directions, potentially limiting their effectiveness for quantization calibration. To address this limitation, we propose RankQ-ViT, a rank-guided DFQ framework for ViTs. We first observe that patch similarity matrices derived from Gaussian noise tend to have lower ranks than those derived from real images. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a block-aware self-contrastive objective that promotes feature diversity during synthetic data generation without explicitly computing matrix rank at each optimization step. We then select calibration samples based on their rank and semantic consistency and use them for block-wise reconstruction of the quantized model. Experiments on ImageNet, COCO, ModelNet40, and ShapeNet demonstrate the effectiveness of RankQ-ViT across multiple architectures and tasks, particularly under low-bit quantization. The code is available at https://github.com/Runqing-forMost/rankq-vit.git

</details>


### [120] [Conditional Diffusion-Based Proxy Representation Recovery for BCVA Prediction with Missing SLO Modality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11326)
*Chuyi He,Hua Zou,Fei Luo,Zixian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于条件扩散的SLO代理表征恢复方法，解决白内障术后BCVA预测中SLO模态缺失问题，在潜在特征空间恢复代理表征并融合预测，准确率0.9714、MAE 0.0423。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术前预测白内障术后最佳矫正视力（BCVA）有助于预后评估与个体化决策。多模态学习可融合术前OCT图像、SLO图像与临床文本表征患者状态，但真实临床数据中SLO图像常因采集或数据管理问题而缺失，导致多模态输入不完整，需要有效应对SLO模态缺失问题。

Method: 提出基于条件扩散的SLO代理表征恢复与融合预测方法。将SLO缺失问题建模为潜特征空间中的代理表征恢复而非原始图像重建：先融合OCT图像特征与临床文本特征构建OCT-文本条件表征，引导扩散模型反向去噪过程估计样本特定的SLO代理表征；再以恢复的代理表征替代缺失的SLO模态，输入下游多模态融合预测网络完成术后BCVA预测。

Result: 在2,141例术前多模态白内障样本（SLO缺失率58.80%）上验证，在绝对预测误差≤0.1 LogMAR判据下准确率达0.9714，平均绝对误差0.0423，优于代表性术后视力预测方法与缺失模态学习方法。

Conclusion: 表征层面的代理恢复可有效缓解SLO模态缺失对术后BCVA预测的影响，验证了所提方法的有效性与实用性。

Abstract: Preoperative prediction of postoperative best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) can support prognosis assessment and individualized decision-making in cataract surgery. Multimodal learning can integrate preoperative optical coherence tomography (OCT) images, scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) images, and clinical text to characterize patient status. However, SLO images are often missing in real-world clinical data due to acquisition or data-management issues, resulting in incomplete multimodal inputs. To address this problem, this paper proposes a conditional diffusion-based method for SLO proxy representation recovery and fusion prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw SLO images, the proposed method formulates SLO missingness as proxy representation recovery in the latent feature space. Specifically, OCT image features and clinical text features are first fused to construct an OCT-text conditional representation, which guides the reverse denoising process of the diffusion model to estimate sample-specific SLO proxy representations. The recovered SLO proxy representation is then used as a substitute for the unavailable SLO modality and incorporated into the downstream multimodal fusion prediction network for postoperative BCVA prediction. Experiments were conducted on 2,141 preoperative multimodal cataract samples, with an SLO missing rate of 58.80%. The proposed method achieved an accuracy of 0.9714 under the criterion of an absolute prediction error within 0.1 LogMAR and a mean absolute error of 0.0423, outperforming representative postoperative visual acuity prediction and missing-modality learning methods. These results indicate that representation-level proxy recovery can alleviate the impact of SLO modality missingness on postoperative BCVA prediction.

</details>


### [121] [SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12870)
*Yu Zhou,Xinyuan Xia,Xuankun Yang,Yinghao Yang,Wendi Chen,Bowen Liu,Jianhan Ma,Weicheng Duan,Jun Lv,Cewu Lu,Yanwei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了世界动作模型（WAM）在引入动作学习时如何保持语言-视频对齐，通过构建约4.7万小时多源视频池，厘清语言-视频监督、语言-视频-动作监督及其联合训练对性能的影响，并给出数据与监督设计准则，最终在仿真与真实任务上取得显著超越基线的泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型研究多聚焦架构与训练机制，默认视频预训练获得的语言-视频对齐是稳固基础；但引入动作学习可能损害该对齐，而关于数据与监督设计如何维持对齐的原则性指导仍然缺乏，因此需要系统性地实证研究。

Method: 构建约47,000小时的数据池（通用视频、第一视角视频、UMI演示与机器人演示），在此之上系统对比三种监督形式：纯语言-视频监督、语言-视频-动作监督以及二者联合使用；分析语言标注质量对预训练语言-视频能力的影响，以及UMI与机器人演示的动作监督如何将能力扩展到动作建模；并进一步研究联合训练配方与模型架构，在固定训练预算下考察数据混合、架构效率与预训练规模扩展。

Result: 固定训练预算下，混合第一视角视频与UMI演示可提升控制泛化能力；模型架构影响经验利用效率，在选定配置下扩展预训练可带来进一步收益。仅用RoboTwin Clean演示做后训练，Easy（Clean-to-Clean）与Hard（Clean-to-Random）条件下成功率分别为88.10%与61.56%；三项真实世界任务平均成功率40.00%，显著优于最强基线的23.33%。

Conclusion: 语言-视频对齐在动作学习中需要显式的数据与监督设计来维持；合理的数据混合（第一视角视频+UMI演示）、恰当的监督形式组合与架构选择，配合预训练扩展，能有效将语言-视频能力转化为语言-视频-动作能力，并在仿真与真实 unseen 条件下获得更强泛化。作者开源了整理数据、训练代码与模型权重。

Abstract: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. However, introducing action learning may impair this alignment. Principled guidance on data and supervision design for maintaining language-video alignment during action learning remains limited. To investigate this, we curate a pool of approximately 47,000 hours of general videos, egocentric videos, UMI demonstrations, and robot demonstrations. Building on this, we systematically study how language-video supervision, language-video-action supervision, and the joint use of these two forms affect WAM performance. In particular, we examine how language annotation quality affects pretrained language-video capabilities, and how action supervision from UMI and robot demonstrations extends these capabilities to language-video-action modeling. To better scale the model, we further conduct detailed studies on joint training recipe and model architecture. Under a fixed training budget, mixing egocentric videos and UMI demonstrations improves control generalization. Model architecture affects how effectively these experiences are used, while scaling pretraining under the selected configuration brings further gains. The resulting recipe, post-trained on RoboTwin Clean demonstrations only, achieves success rates of 88.10% and 61.56% under Easy (Clean-to-Clean) and Hard (Clean-to-Random) conditions, respectively. Our model achieves 40.00% SR across three real-world tasks, compared with 23.33% for the strongest baseline, indicating better generalization under unseen conditions. We release the curated data, training code, and model weights.

</details>


### [122] [MoT3DVG: A Benchmark for Outdoor 3D Visual Grounding with Motion-Aware Descriptions and Temporal Cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11334)
*Shijia Zhao,Xusheng Guo,Qiming Xia,Xun Huang,Kezheng Xiong,Zhihong Liu,Chenglu Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出面向动态室外场景的3D视觉定位数据集MoT3DVG及框架DynaVG，利用运动描述和短长期时序编码提升动态目标定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D视觉定位（3DVG）主要面向静态室内物体，难以适用于动态室外自动驾驶场景；运动描述能够刻画移动物体的时间动态，为动态感知的室外3DVG提供新思路。

Method: 构建MoT3DVG大规模数据集，包含850个场景、31,128帧和144,568条带运动描述的语言提示；提出DynaVG框架，在语言-点云对齐前引入短长期集成动态编码模块SLIDE，通过短时窗口编码与长时窗口移位同时建模局部运动线索和全局时序上下文。

Result: 在MoT3DVG上的大量实验表明DynaVG达到最先进性能，验证了运动感知编码的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作将3DVG拓展到动态室外场景，揭示了相关开放挑战，并为未来室外3DVG研究提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: 3D visual grounding (3DVG) localizes language-referred objects in 3D scenes, with broad applicability in both indoor and outdoor environments. However, existing 3DVG research focuses on static indoor objects, limiting its use in dynamic outdoor autonomous driving. Motion descriptions, which capture the temporal dynamics of moving objects, offer a promising way to address this challenge. We therefore introduce MoT3DVG, a large-scale dataset for dynamic-aware outdoor 3DVG with temporally evolving motion descriptions. It contains 850 scenarios with 31,128 frames from nuScenes dataset, and provides 144,568 language prompts with motion-aware descriptions for dynamic objects across time. We further propose DynaVG, a novel framework that effectively leverages temporal cues for outdoor 3DVG. In addition to the standard modality-specific encoders, DynaVG introduces a Short-Long Integrated Dynamic Encoding (SLIDE) module before the language-point cloud alignment. SLIDE models both local motion cues and global temporal context via short-term window encoding and long-term window shifting. Extensive experiments demonstrate its state-of-the-art performance on MoT3DVG, validating the effectiveness of motion-aware encoding. Our work reveals open challenges and promising directions for future research in outdoor 3DVG.

</details>


### [123] [World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12885)
*Heng Fang,Zehui Guo,Yuehan Zhang,Mingyang Du,Dingkang Liang,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 World In-Context Learning（WICL）：冻结模型从单个示范出发，在仿真世界中排练任务，并把环境反馈写入上下文而非权重；RoboScript 在 RoboTwin 2.0 的 50 个任务上达到 83.4% 平均成功率，单示范、无梯度更新，超过最强训练策略 20 分以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统训练得到的动作策略把操作技能写进网络权重，导致所学能力与训练分布强耦合；而现有上下文学习（ICL）虽避免这种耦合，却因跨场景示范缺少当前世界反馈而难以匹敌训练策略。作者观察到上下文中学到的是语义信息（任务步骤与物体角色），而非视觉外观，因此经验可跨世界迁移。

Method: 提出 WICL 范式：冻结模型从示范开始，在仿真器等世界中排练任务，将反馈写入上下文而不是权重。构建 RoboScript 模块化基础设施：从单个示范出发，在仿真中排练学习任务，将学到的知识冻结为 Task Memory，并以数据隔离方式部署到新场景，确保部署输入在真实机器人上可用；还支持跨具身记忆适配。

Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 全部 50 个任务上，RoboScript 在干净与随机化设置中取得 83.4% 平均成功率；每任务仅一个示范且无梯度更新，超过最强训练动作策略 20 分以上。方法可跨视觉分布泛化、通过反思改进、随基础模型扩展，并通过跨具身记忆适配迁移到物理双臂机器人。

Conclusion: 将世界置于闭环中，机器人可以在上下文中学习操作任务，效果可媲美在权重中学习；WICL/RoboScript 为无需梯度更新的可迁移操作学习提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript

</details>


### [124] [NuJEV: Structured Visual Judgments for Consistent Nuclei Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11359)
*Yonghuang Wu,Pengfei Wang,Zhenyang Liang,Yize Ma,Pengfei Song,Guoqing Wu,Jinhua Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NuJEV在Qwen3-VL-2B中引入并行的"核感知头"+视觉LoRA，把细胞核定量从自由文本生成改为结构化预测（存在性、中心、类型），一次编码同时服务核头与原语言解码器，实现定位、分型与计数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细胞核定量不止是要一个数量，还需要定位并判断类型；而自由形式生成不可靠。受"用结构化决策替代自由生成"思路启发，作者希望让多模态大模型以结构化方式完成核感知。

Method: 联合训练视觉LoRA与一个并行预测头，输出核的存在性、中心点与类型；同一份图像编码同时送入该核头与原始语言解码器。语言解码器负责解析用户对区域和类型的请求，计数则由预测出的核直接统计得到。

Result: 在2,732张PanNuke测试图上，五查询平均绝对误差MAE₅为1.844，稠密图像上为5.268；定位F1 0.816、分型F1 0.682。匹配编码器消融显示视觉适配使稠密误差降低41.0%；对语言请求，相对直接生成将请求MAE降低76.2%。

Conclusion: 结构化决策式建模优于自由生成，使多模态大模型在细胞核任务上同时获得较强的定位、分型、计数能力与语言交互能力，且代码将开源。

Abstract: Nuclear quantification requires locating and typing nuclei, beyond generating a count. Inspired by Jev's structured decisions in place of free-form generation, we introduce NuJEV for nuclear perception in Qwen3-VL-2B. We jointly train visual LoRA and a parallel head to predict nuclear presence, centers, and types. One image encoding feeds both the nuclear head and original language decoder. The decoder interprets region and type requests, with counts computed from the predicted nuclei. On 2,732 PanNuke test images, NuJEV achieves a five-query mean absolute error ($\mathrm{MAE}_5$) of 1.844 overall and 5.268 on dense images, with localization/typed F1 of 0.816/0.682. A matched encoder ablation shows 41.0\% lower dense error with visual adaptation. For language requests, NuJEV reduces request MAE by 76.2\% relative to direct generation. Our code will be released as open source.

</details>


### [125] [SegDis: Foreground Segmentation Followed by Type Discrimination for Salient and Camouflaged Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11378)
*Dingning Luo,Shuo Dou,Tong Jiang,Xianfeng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SegDis 将 SOD/COD 联合检测解耦为“前景概率”和“给定前景下的类型概率”，分别负责前景定位与类型判别，在 USC12K 上以约 1/8 参数取得 68.98% FG-mIoU 和 78.35% mIoU，CSCS 为 5.75。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联合 SOD/COD 方法多只输出二值掩码，无法区分目标类型；USC12K 的基线 USCNet 又将“前景是否存在”与“类型判断”耦合在同一归一化中，导致失败来源难以归因。跨任务研究表明前景定位可在 SOD 与 COD 间迁移，但类型判别不能迁移，因此二者需要分离机制。

Method: 提出 SegDis，将输出分解为显式前景概率和条件类型概率：FLR 提供高质量、任务无关的前景支持；RTA 在不使用任务标识的情况下，依据前景-背景关系细化 SOD/COD 类型分配。由于前景支持被显式建模，每个真实前景像素可被判为类型正确、类型互换或漏检，从而分别诊断前景恢复错误与类型分配错误。

Result: 在 USC12K 上，使用 PVT-v2-B2 的 SegDis 达到 68.98% FG-mIoU 和 78.35% mIoU，参数量约为 USCNet 的 1/8；CSCS 为 5.75。跨任务实验显示，仅用 COD 训练的模型可在 SOD 图像上恢复前景，但其类型判断更受训练分布影响，而非前景-背景关系。

Conclusion: 该工作说明联合 SOD/COD 中的前景定位与类型判别应解耦建模。SegDis 通过显式前景支持和条件类型分配，在提升联合检测性能的同时实现更细粒度的错误诊断，并显著降低参数量。

Abstract: Salient and camouflaged object detection (SOD and COD) both recover foreground support, yet most joint methods output only a binary mask and therefore cannot distinguish the type. USC12K distinguishes the two types, but its baseline USCNet still binds foreground existence to the type within a single normalization, so the failure source cannot be attributed. Our cross-task study shows that foreground localization transfers between SOD and COD, whereas type discrimination does not: a COD-only model recovers foreground on SOD images but its type judgement follows the training distribution rather than the foreground-background relation, so the two decisions require separate mechanisms. SegDis factorizes the output into an explicit foreground probability and a conditional type probability given foreground: FLR provides high-quality task-agnostic support, and RTA refines the SOD/COD assignment from the foreground-background relation without a task identifier. Because support is explicit, each ground-truth foreground pixel is classified as correct-type, type-swapped, or missed, so foreground-recovery and type-assignment errors are diagnosed separately. With PVT-v2-B2, SegDis attains 68.98% FG-mIoU and 78.35% mIoU on USC12K at about one-eighth of USCNet's parameters; CSCS is 5.75.

</details>


### [126] [Let the Gallery Learn Itself: Training-Free Iterative Side-View Face Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11391)
*Zijun Huang,Suncheng Xiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无训练框架Gallery Self-Evolution（GSE），在测试时通过去重FIFO机制让底库(evaluation gallery)自我进化，无需梯度更新即可提升人脸识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人脸识别系统若要在新场景/新外观下提升性能通常需要重新训练或微调模型，代价高且需要GPU。作者希望探索一个"零梯度更新"的替代思路：让测试时的底库自身随识别过程进化，从而在不重训模型的前提下适应新外观变化（如大姿态侧脸）。

Method: GSE为训练无关（training-free）框架：核心机制为 dedup-FIFO 队列式管理（curation）。在识别成功后把新的外观样本归档进底库，同时永久锁定原始enrollment模板不被覆盖；每个身份最多保留30个embedding，新样本入队时按去重与先进先出规则淘汰旧样本。推理只在CPU上进行。

Result: 在CFP-FP与IJB-C基准上：45°偏航角的侧脸差距缩小约+23个点；TAR@FAR=0.001 提升约+9.4个点；全部以CPU级计算成本完成。

Conclusion: 通过测试时底库自我进化，可在零重训、零GPU的条件下显著提升人脸识别（尤其是侧脸/姿态差异场景）性能，说明"数据侧自适应"是模型侧重训之外的一条实用低成本路径。

Abstract: What if a face recognition system could learn from every encounter without a single gradient update? We present Gallery Self-Evolution (GSE), a training-free framework where the gallery itself adapts at test time. The core mechanism---dedup-FIFO curation---archives novel appearance samples after successful recognition while permanently locking the enrollment template, bounded at 30 embeddings per identity. On CFP-FP and IJB-C benchmarks, GSE closes the side-view gap by +23 points at 45° yaw and boosts TAR@FAR=0.001 by +9.4 points, all at CPU-level cost. No retraining. No GPU. Just a gallery that grows smarter every time it meets you.

</details>


### [127] [GenRM-Flow: Generators are Process-aware Reward Models in Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11421)
*Siming Fu,Ruizhe He,Zheming Fu,Zeyue Xue,Fengkai Liu,Yufei Jiao,Jie Huang,Xiaoxiao Ma,Xuan Yang,Lihui Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有视频奖励模型依赖视觉语言模型或冻结生成器的表征能力打分，忽略了生成能力本身。本文从KL约束最优策略的解析解出发，将奖励项等价映射为流匹配中速度预测误差的相对差异，提出GenRM-Flow：经偏好微调的视频生成器本身就是过程感知奖励模型，并可用于替代FlowAWR中的外部VLM打分器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型与人类偏好对齐高度依赖奖励模型质量，但现有视频奖励模型都从模型的"表征能力"而非"生成能力"获取奖励信号：或把VLM改造成像素空间打分器，或在冻结的生成器特征上训练辅助打分头。生成器真正预测速度、去噪潜变量、生成视频的能力在给自身生成物打分时完全没有被利用，作者认为这忽视了离线偏好学习的一个结构性性质。

Method: 1）理论上指出：任何近似离线偏好数据集的偏好优化目标，其数学本质都在逼近一个严格定义的KL约束最优策略；2）从该解析解中剥离出奖励项，并将精确的生成对数似然映射到其流匹配替代量，推出经验奖励可确定性地表示为连续时间速度预测误差的相对差异；3）将该等价形式化为GenRM-Flow框架，使偏好微调后的生成器直接在含噪潜空间中充当过程感知奖励模型；4）进一步理论证明对比式（DPO、IPO）与非对比式（RWR）等不同微调目标只是通往同一最优策略的不同优化路径，各自都能从速度预测误差中读出奖励；5）把提取的过程奖励无缝替换FlowAWR中的外部VLM打分器。

Result: 所提出的生成式奖励完全基于生成器原生潜变量输出、无需额外奖励网络，即可作为外部VLM打分器的替代品，并在下游视频生成任务上带来可测量的性能提升。

Conclusion: 奖励信号可以直接从视频生成器自身的生成过程（速度预测误差）中读取，从而使"生成器即奖励模型"；该结论统一了对比式与非对比式偏好优化目标，为视频生成的对齐提供了一种无辅助奖励网络、过程感知且理论自洽的范式。

Abstract: Aligning video generation models with human preference depends critically on the quality of the reward model that scores generated videos. Current video reward models, however, source their reward signal from a model's representational rather than generative capacity: they either repurpose vision-language models as pixel-space scorers, or train auxiliary scoring heads on top of frozen generator features. The generator's actual ability to predict velocities, denoise latents, and produce videos plays no role in scoring its own generations. We argue that this overlooks a structural property of offline preference learning. Any preference optimization objective that approximates an offline preference dataset mathematically targets a strictly defined KL-constrained optimal policy. By isolating the reward term from this analytical solution and mapping the exact generation log-likelihood to its flow-matching surrogate, the empirical reward emerges deterministically as the relative difference in continuous-time velocity-prediction errors. We formalize this equivalence into GenRM-Flow, a framework where a preference-tuned video generator inherently operates as a process-aware reward model directly in the noisy latent space. We further show theoretically that distinct fine-tuning objectives, whether contrastive like DPO and IPO or non-contrastive like RWR, are alternative optimization pathways toward the same optimal policy, each inducing a reward readout from the generator's velocity-prediction errors. Furthermore, the extracted process reward seamlessly substitutes external VLM scorers in FlowAWR. Operating purely on native latent outputs without auxiliary reward networks, this generative reward drives measurable improvements in downstream video generation.

</details>


### [128] [Flex-DDCM: Zero-Shot Task-Oriented Image Compression via Diffusion Trajectory Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11427)
*Yixin Gao,Runsen Feng,Xin Li,Zhibo Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Flex-DDCM：基于 Turbo-DDCM 的零样本任务导向图像压缩框架，通过扩散轨迹引导实现像素保真、感知质量与下游任务性能的灵活折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本扩散压缩方法虽能生成感知上佳的图像，但图像压缩也服务于机器分析任务；现有零样本编解码器缺乏灵活性，难以满足不同应用对重建结果的多样化需求，且任务适配通常需要额外解码复杂度。

Method: 在 Turbo-DDCM 基础上，对已编码的扩散轨迹施加任务引导的噪声选择，将任务引导的影响嵌入压缩表示；各引导项可单独或组合使用，并以时间步相关的强度控制其在去噪过程中的作用权重。

Result: 实验显示可在像素保真度、感知质量和下游任务性能之间实现灵活权衡，性能可媲美经训练的任务导向编解码器，且解码速度快于 Diff-ICMH。

Conclusion: 通过轨迹级引导即可在不增加解码复杂度的情况下实现零样本任务适配，为面向任务的图像压缩提供了一种灵活高效的方案。

Abstract: Recent zero-shot image compression methods exploit the powerful priors of pretrained diffusion models to produce perceptually pleasing reconstructions without compression-specific training. However, image compression serves not only human viewing but also machine analysis, while existing zero-shot codecs have limited flexibility in meeting the diverse reconstruction requirements of these applications. In this paper, we propose Flex-DDCM, a framework for zero-shot task-oriented image compression via diffusion trajectory guidance. Building on Turbo-DDCM, we adapt the coded diffusion trajectory through task-guided noise selection, embedding the effects of task guidance into the compressed representation. Guidance terms can be applied individually or combined, with timestep-dependent strengths controlling their influence throughout denoising. This design enables task adaptation without introducing additional decoding complexity. Experiments demonstrate flexible trade-offs among pixel fidelity, perceptual quality, and downstream task performance, with competitive performance against trained task-oriented codecs and faster decoding than Diff-ICMH.

</details>


### [129] [Unlearning at Speed: Rapid Activation Dampening for Efficient Machine Unlearning in Real-World Face Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11433)
*Rouqaiah Al-Refai,Leo Scheubel,Philipp Terhörst*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向大规模开放集人脸识别的快速定向遗忘方法RAD，通过抑制与目标身份最相关的神经元实现遗忘，并提出Forget Score评估开放集遗忘效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法多针对闭集分类、小规模模型和数据，难以适用于真实世界中大规模、开放集的人脸识别系统；同时现有遗忘指标与开放集问题存在不匹配。

Method: RAD通过近似遗忘身份与保留身份之间的平均神经元激活差异，识别与目标身份最相关的神经元，并采用敏感性控制的阻尼机制进行选择性抑制；同时提出Forget Score，在表示空间中对遗忘进行概率解释，以适配开放集评估。

Result: 在多个近期大规模人脸识别架构和数据集上，RAD实现了较强的遗忘效果，同时保持模型整体效用，并显著提升遗忘速度。

Conclusion: RAD是一种可扩展且实用的人脸识别机器遗忘方法，适合大规模开放集场景。

Abstract: Machine unlearning has become increasingly important in face recognition, where regulations like the GDPR empower users to request the removal of their personal data from deployed models. However, most existing unlearning methods are designed for closed-set classification with small-scale models and training data, and therefore do not generalize to real-world face recognition systems, which operate in an open-set setting with large-scale models and data. In this work, we propose Rapid Activation Dampening (RAD), a fast and targeted unlearning method tailored specifically for large-scale open-set face recognition. RAD approximates differences in average neuron activations between forget and retain identities, identifying and selectively suppressing neurons that are most associated with the targeted identity through a sensitivity-controlled dampening mechanism. We further propose the Forget Score (FS), which addresses the mismatch between existing unlearning metrics and open-set problems by providing a probabilistic interpretation of forgetting directly in the representation space. Experiments across several recent large-scale face recognition architectures and datasets show that RAD achieves strong forgetting while preserving overall model utility and substantially improving unlearning speed. These findings establish RAD as a scalable and practical approach to machine unlearning in face recognition systems.

</details>


### [130] [How to "train" a surgeon? Benchmarking generalist agents in surgical scene understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11437)
*Gengyuan Zhang,Xiao Han,Shijie Zhou,Abdullah Koukash,Jingpei Wu,Jindong Gu,Yuqicheng Zhu,Nassir Navab,Volker Tresp,Ghazal Ghazaei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出两阶段评估框架，用于系统评测通用多模态大模型在手术场景理解中的能力边界与智能体推理潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术数据稀缺且评估协议碎片化，导致通用多模态大模型在手术场景理解上的评估仍不充分。

Method: 构建两阶段框架：阶段一提出SurgKnowBench诊断基准，整合跨术式、跨任务的公开手术数据集，评测闭源与开源MLLM；阶段二提出SurgAgentGym智能体环境，允许通用MLLM智能体通过SurgWiki有界知识搜索和通用视觉定位完成手术任务，评估推理时工具介导的证据使用，无需额外手术训练。

Result: 现有模型保留部分视觉先验，但在关系理解、流程理解和工作流评估上较弱；智能体推理主要缩小感知密集型任务的差距，细粒度定位和专家式评估仍是持续瓶颈。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了预训练手术能力边界，并表明智能体推理可部分提升手术理解，为未来智能体式手术理解研究提供了路径。

Abstract: Evaluating general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for surgical scene understanding remains limited due to scarce surgical data and fragmented evaluation protocols. We address these challenges through a two-stage evaluation framework for surgical scene understanding. In Stage I, we introduce SurgKnowBench, a diagnostic benchmark that harmonizes public surgical datasets across procedures and tasks and evaluates proprietary and open-source MLLMs to map the boundary of pretrained surgical competence. SurgKnowBench reveals that current models retain partial visual priors but remain weak on relational and procedural understanding and workflow assessment. Building on this failure frontier and motivated by the scaffolded nature of surgical training, we introduce SurgAgentGym, an agentic environment where general-purpose MLLM agents can use bounded knowledge search over SurgWiki and general-purpose visual grounding for surgical tasks. SurgAgentGym evaluates whether generalist agents can improve surgical understanding at inference time through tool-mediated evidence use, without additional surgical training. Our results show that agentic inference narrows the gap mainly for perception-heavy tasks, while fine-grained localization and expert-style assessment remain persistent bottlenecks. This opens a path toward future studies of agentic surgical understanding.

</details>


### [131] [Semantically Aligned KV Cache Compression for Efficient Agentic Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11452)
*Weizhong Huang,Huaijia Kou,Tianyu Xie,Xiawu Zheng,Liujuan Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SemanticKV：一种免训练、语义对齐的 KV cache 压缩方法，利用规划器提取的语义约束指导保留哪些缓存条目，在智能体式自回归视频生成中实现省内存、降开销且不损失生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体式自回归视频生成将语义规划、序列生成与视觉校验结合，但不断增长的视觉历史会放大 KV cache，导致内存占用与注意力计算成本剧增，尤其在多条候选轨迹（rollout）并行时更严重。现有压缩方法只针对单个生成器优化，忽略规划器的语义约束，可能优先保留与用户要求的属性或动作无关的状态，从而损害可控性。

Method: SemanticKV 为免训练方法：先用文本交叉注意力定位与语义约束相关的视频位置，将这些位置的 self-attention 查询按约束分组；组内对注意力权重求平均、组间取最大，使某条目只要被任一约束强烈使用即可得高分；随后在内存预算下做单次 top-k 选择，保留高分条目的 key、value 与位置不变。对固定查询分组与等成本条目，该选择可最小化最差分组被丢弃注意力的加性上界。方法在每个候选轨迹内独立运行，无需重训练或额外生成。

Result: 在三个基准、5/30/60 秒生成任务上评估四个自回归视频骨干网络。于 Causal Forcing、压缩比 0.7 时，VBench 总分 84.10，超过最强压缩基线 84.05 与 Full KV 的 83.99；相对 Full KV 实现 1.22 倍加速，KV cache 内存由 6.04 GB 降至 1.81 GB，缩减 3.35 倍。

Conclusion: SemanticKV 是首个在智能体式自回归视频生成中显式利用规划器语义约束指导 KV cache 保留的压缩方法，在显著降低内存与计算开销的同时保持甚至略优于全量缓存的质量，且无需训练、可直接嵌入各候选轨迹独立运行。

Abstract: Agentic autoregressive video generation combines semantic planning, sequential generation, and visual verification for controllable synthesis. Growing visual histories enlarge the key-value (KV) cache, increasing memory use and attention costs across candidate rollouts. Existing compression methods primarily optimize individual generators without the planner's semantic constraints, risking low priority for states supporting requested attributes or actions. We introduce SemanticKV, a training-free method for semantically aligned KV cache compression. To our knowledge, SemanticKV is the first KV cache compression method for agentic autoregressive video generation that explicitly uses planner-extracted semantic constraints to guide retention. Text cross-attention identifies constraint-related video positions, whose self-attention queries are collected into separate groups. Attention weights are averaged within each group and maximized across groups, giving each cached entry a high score when strongly used by any represented constraint. A single top-k selection retains high-scoring entries under the memory budget, leaving their keys, values, and positions unchanged. For fixed query groups and equal entry costs, this selection minimizes an additive upper bound on worst-group discarded attention. The method operates independently within each candidate without retraining or additional video generations. We evaluate four AR video backbones on three benchmarks for 5-, 30-, and 60-second generation. On Causal Forcing at a compression ratio of 0.7, SemanticKV obtains a VBench Total Score of 84.10, compared with 84.05 for the strongest compressed baseline and 83.99 for Full KV. It achieves a 1.22x speedup over Full KV and reduces KV-cache memory from 6.04 GB to 1.81 GB, a 3.35x reduction.

</details>


### [132] [NightSteps: A Night-Time Dataset and Benchmark for Pedestrian Crossing Intention Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11583)
*Sjoerd Takken,Shaodi You*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文构建并评估了夜间行车记录仪行人过街意图预测数据集 NightSteps，并用人工、Gemini、ChatGPT 作为基线验证其可用性，结果显示人工表现最高（准确率88.17%、F1 80.21%），大模型次之，说明该数据集可用于夜间 PCIP 模型评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有行人过街意图预测（PCIP）模型大多在白天光照充足条件下训练，由于缺乏夜间视频数据，其在夜间与弱光环境下的鲁棒性几乎未知。为填补这一空白并提升夜间道路安全，需要构建夜间基准数据集。

Method: 采集来自全球六座城市、覆盖多样路况的夜间行车记录仪第一视角视频构建 NightSteps 数据集；数据包含原始行人位置数据与对应 track id，以及准确的过街行为真值标签；随后用 Gemini、ChatGPT 与人工评估三种方式在视频片段上做过街预测，并与初始真值标签对比，以证明数据集可用性。

Result: 人工评估准确率 88.17%、F1 80.21%；Gemini 准确率 60%、F1 42.50%；ChatGPT 准确率 79.13%、F1 63.64%。人工表现最优，两个大模型均低于人工水平。

Conclusion: NightSteps 可作为一个夜间 PCIP 的基准数据集，用于未来模型评测，以推动夜间行人过街意图预测性能提升、改善夜间道路安全。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles use pedestrian crossing intention prediction (PCIP) to participate safely in traffic. Existing models are largely trained under favourable daytime conditions with sufficient daylight. Little is known about the robustness of these models under night-time and low-light conditions, due to the lack of datasets containing night-time footage. This paper investigates how a dataset, named NightSteps, can be constructed and evaluated as a baseline benchmark. The dataset is based on nighttime dashcam footage collected from six different cities around the world, capturing a wide variety of road conditions. The dataset consists of dashcam-recorded point-of-view footage, raw data of pedestrians' locations with corresponding 'track ids' and ground-truth labels containing accurate information about pedestrian crossing behaviour, resulting in a diverse dataset. Gemini, ChatGPT, and human assessment are used to demonstrate the usability of the dataset by predicting crossings in clips from the dataset and comparing the results with the initial ground-truth labels. These results show that human input achieves an accuracy of 88.17% and an F1-score of 80.21%. Predictions from Gemini and ChatGPT perform lower, with accuracies of 60% and 79.13% respectively, and F1-scores of 42.50% and 63.64%. The evaluation demonstrates that the NightSteps dataset can be used for future model evaluation to test the performance of PCIP, with the aim of improving road safety at night.

</details>


### [133] [Med-DualLoRA: Local Adaptation of Foundation Models for 3D Cardiac MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10967)
*Joan Perramon-Llussà,Amelia Jiménez-Sánchez,Grzegorz Skorupko,Fotis Avgoustidis,Carlos Martín-Isla,Karim Lekadir,Polyxeni Gkontra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Med-DualLoRA：一种客户端感知的参数高效联邦微调框架，通过加性分解将全局共享 LoRA 与本地私有 LoRA 分离，仅聚合全局部分，在多中心非IID 3D CMR 疾病检测中兼顾个性化、性能与通信效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型在心脏磁共振等医学影像任务上经任务适配后表现优异，但单中心数据适配易导致性能不足与模型偏置，而因隐私限制难以集中微调临床数据；联邦微调虽可保护隐私，却在非IID多中心数据下效果不佳，且适配大模型时通信开销巨大。

Method: 设计 Med-DualLoRA：客户端感知的PEFT联邦框架，将LoRA参数加性分解为全局共享模块与本地模块，二者均在本地训练，但仅全局模块跨站点共享与聚合，本地适配器保持私有；并发现仅适配两个Transformer块即可保持性能，进一步提升效率。在ACDC与M&Ms合并数据集上以厂商为客户端，对尖端cine 3D CMR基础模型进行疾病检测微调评估。

Result: 与其他联邦PEFT基线相比，Med-DualLoRA取得统计显著更优的性能：平衡准确率0.768、特异度0.612，同时保持良好的通信效率；仅适配两个Transformer块即可在不损失性能的前提下提升效率。

Conclusion: 该工作为真实临床约束下医学基础模型的本地联邦适配提供了可扩展方案，在提升个性化与性能的同时显著降低通信成本。

Abstract: Foundation models (FMs) show great promise for robust downstream performance across medical imaging tasks and modalities, including cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), following task-specific adaptation. However, adaptation using single-site data may lead to suboptimal performance and increased model bias, while centralized fine-tuning on clinical data is often infeasible due to privacy constraints. Federated fine-tuning offers a privacy-preserving alternative; yet conventional approaches struggle under heterogeneous, non-IID multi-center data and incur substantial communication overhead when adapting large models. In this work, we study federated FM fine-tuning for 3D CMR disease detection and propose Med-DualLoRA, a client-aware parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) federated framework that disentangles globally shared and local low-rank adaptations (LoRA) through additive decomposition. Global and local LoRA modules are trained locally, but only the global component is shared and aggregated across sites, keeping local adapters private. This design improves personalization while significantly reducing communication cost, and experiments show that adapting only two transformer blocks preserves performance while further improving efficiency. We evaluate our method on a multi-center state-of-the-art cine 3D CMR FM fine-tuned for disease detection using ACDC and combined M\&Ms datasets, treating each vendor as a federated client. Med-DualLoRA achieves statistically significant improved performance (balanced accuracy 0.768, specificity 0.612) compared to other federated PEFT baselines, while maintaining communication efficiency. Our approach provides a scalable solution for local federated adaptation of medical FMs under realistic clinical constraints.

</details>


### [134] [FastGRT: Accelerating Training of 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11586)
*Meet Banthia,Xiaoteng Liu,Hexu Zhao,Aurojit Panda,Jinyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FastGRT 通过解耦光线遍历与混合、复用前向计算结果并优化梯度累积和 BVH 更新，在 Vulkan 上实现首个支持训练与渲染的 GRT 系统，训练速度较 3DGRT 提升 1.9–4.97 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于高斯的光线追踪（GRT）能实现光栅化方法（如 3DGS）难以达到的渲染效果，但其训练成本远高于 3DGS；作者希望找出并降低 GPU 上 GRT 训练的主要开销。

Method: 分析 Gaussians 光线追踪在 GPU 上的执行过程，发现训练开销很大程度来自计算组织方式；提出 FastGRT：将光线遍历与混合解耦，在反向传播中复用前向计算，并采用快速梯度累积与混合 BVH 更新策略；基于 Vulkan 实现，支持训练和渲染。

Result: FastGRT 是首个基于 Vulkan、同时支持训练与渲染的 GRT 实现；相比 3DGRT，训练时间缩短为原来的 1/1.9 至 1/4.97（即提速 1.9–4.97 倍），同时保持原有渲染公式不变，代码开源。

Conclusion: 通过从计算组织层面优化 GRT 训练流程，可在不改变渲染公式的前提下显著降低训练成本，证明系统级设计与实现优化对高斯光线追踪训练具有重要意义。

Abstract: Ray Tracing enables rendering capabilities that are difficult to achieve with rasterization-based approaches such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). However, the training cost of Gaussian-based ray tracing (GRT) is much higher than that of 3DGS. In this paper, we study how ray tracing using Gaussians executes on GPUs and show that a considerable fraction of the training cost arises from how the computation is organized. We develop FastGRT, which decouples ray traversal from blending and reuses work done in the forward pass for the backward pass. FastGRT further incorporates optimizations such as fast gradient accumulation and a hybrid BVH update strategy to tackle other major bottlenecks in the training pipeline. We implement FastGRT in Vulkan. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first Vulkan-based GRT implementation that supports both training and rendering. Compared to 3DGRT, FastGRT improves training time by 1.9$\times$ to 4.97$\times$, while preserving the original rendering formulation. Our code is open source.

</details>


### [135] [MICE: Multi-animal Interaction Context Encoder - A Hierarchical Foundation Model for Mouse Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11644)
*Yen-Shuo Su,Weihan Li,Anqi Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MICE是一个面向小鼠行为的分层基础模型：个体编码器提取多尺度运动学特征，Perceiver式社会编码器用可学习潜码本解耦参数量与动物数量，联合预训练于6个小鼠姿态数据集（1–4只、7–27关键点），单一权重可适配任意群体规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小鼠姿态行为量化是神经科学、行为学、药物研发和动物福利的基础工具，自监督基础模型天然适配。但真正重要的行为（攻击、求偶、骑跨、理毛等）本质上是多动物交互行为，而现有自监督姿态模型存在三大缺陷：对每只动物独立编码、丢弃交互信号；硬编码动物数量；每次只在一个数据集上预训练。因此需要一个能原生处理多动物社会交互、且与群体规模无关的小鼠行为基础模型。

Method: 提出MICE（Multi-animal Interaction Context Encoder）分层基础模型：1）在6个小鼠姿态语料上联合预训练，覆盖1–4只动物与7–27个关键点；2）分层个体编码器，在多个时间尺度上捕捉单鼠运动学特征；3）Perceiver式社会编码器，借助可学习潜码本（latent codebook）将参数量与动物数量解耦，使单一checkpoint无需重训即可服务任意群体规模。

Result: 在覆盖6个数据集的4种评测协议中，MICE达到或超过此前基于关键点的基线方法；逐层探针（layer-wise probing）显示，社会编码阶段在个体编码器之上进一步提升特征判别性，验证分层设计有效。

Conclusion: MICE表明，将社会交互编码与群体规模解耦的分层自监督预训练，可有效支撑多动物小鼠行为分析，并可作为跨数据集、跨配置的通用行为表征基础模型；代码、权重与数据已开源。

Abstract: Quantifying mouse behavior from pose is a foundational tool in neuroscience, ethology, drug discovery, and animal welfare. Self-supervised foundation models are a natural fit, but a foundation model for mouse behavior must handle social behavior - many behaviors that matter (aggression, courtship, mounting, allogrooming) are inherently multi-animal. Existing self-supervised pose models fall short: they encode each animal independently and discard interaction signal, hard-code the animal count, and pretrain one dataset at a time. We introduce MICE (Multi-animal Interaction Context Encoder), a hierarchical foundation model for mouse behavior that pretrains jointly on six mouse-pose corpora spanning one to four mice and 7 to 27 keypoints. MICE combines a hierarchical individual encoder capturing per-mouse kinematics at multiple temporal scales with a Perceiver-style social encoder whose learned latent codebook decouples parameter count from animal count, so a single checkpoint serves any group size without retraining. Across four evaluation protocols spanning six datasets, MICE matches or exceeds prior keypoint-based baselines, and layer-wise probing shows the social stage incrementally improves discriminability beyond the individual encoder. Code, weights, and data are available at https://github.com/eric0708/MICE.

</details>


### [136] [LocateAnyMesh: Grounding 3D Mesh Queries in 2D Images with Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11692)
*Chris Choy,Zhiding Yu,Jan Kautz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LocateAnyMesh：以带纹理三维网格本身作为提示词的一部分，用冻结3D编码器+连接器把网格token与图像、指令token拼接，实现图像中目标物体的定位（LAM-Select选区域提案，LAM-Direct直接回归坐标），无需渲染查询视图或逐物体微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在图像中查找特定资产时，带纹理的3D网格同时描述了几何与外观，是天然且信息完整的查询形式；但既有方法通常依赖渲染查询视图或视图模板匹配，成本高且需针对新物体做适配。

Method: 将网格作为提示词的一部分输入视觉语言模型：冻结的3D编码器把带颜色的表面采样点映射为紧凑token序列，由可学习的连接器与图像token、指令token并列拼接（PPAT网格token）。设计两个定位模型——LAM-Select在图像区域提案上做选择，LAM-Direct直接预测坐标。新物体只需一次编码器前向、无需物体级微调或渲染查询视图。辅以网格编码器对比实验、隔离表面颜色的LAM-Direct研究，以及单种子LAM-Select延伸实验（指向与纯网格描述）。

Result: LAM-Select 在所报告的真实图像数据与官方 BOP YCB-V 评测上提升了定位效果；对比实验显示不同网格编码器存在差异，表面颜色对直接预测有可分离的影响；延伸实验给出指向与仅用网格的描述证据，但该延伸为单种子结果且不替代主定位模型。

Conclusion: 网格token可作为一种有效的查询表示，支持在真实图像上定位特定资产；方法仍存在局限：物体存在性判断、身份绑定、提案覆盖度以及描述保真度方面尚待改进。

Abstract: Textured 3D meshes specify object geometry and appearance, making them a natural query for finding a particular asset in an image. We introduce LocateAnyMesh, a vision-language model that uses the mesh itself as part of its prompt. A frozen 3D encoder maps colored surface points to a compact token sequence, which a learned connector places alongside image and instruction tokens. We evaluate two grounding models with PPAT mesh tokens: LAM-Select selects image-region proposals, while LAM-Direct predicts coordinates directly. Neither requires rendered query views or view-template matching. New objects require a single encoder pass and no object-specific fine-tuning. LAM-Select improves localization on the reported real-image suites and the official BOP YCB-V evaluation. Secondary experiments compare mesh encoders, and a LAM-Direct study isolates surface color. A single-seed LAM-Select continuation supplies pointing and mesh-only description evidence without replacing the reported localization model. The results support mesh tokens as a query representation, with remaining limitations in presence decisions, identity binding, proposal coverage, and descriptive fidelity.

</details>


### [137] [SurgTAP-3D: A Large-Scale Cross-Surgery Video Dataset with Contact-Aware 3D Motion Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11697)
*Jiaxin Guo,Wenzhen Dong,Taoyu Wu,Haomin Kuang,Mengya Xu,Kejian Shi,Ziyi Wang,Tongfan Guan,Mingkai Jia,Yue Wang,Qi Dou,Yun-Hui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 构建大规模体内伪3D手术运动追踪数据集 SurgTAP-3D（52万帧、4549个动作片段、140万2D/3D点轨迹），并提出统一的手术3D点追踪框架将单目手术视频转为结构化4D标注，建立器械与组织追踪基准并验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微创手术3D场景动态理解是迈向智能自主手术系统的关键步骤，但现有公开数据集在真实临床场景中的可扩展性与多样性有限，且标注通常只关注组织或器械之一，忽略了工具-组织交互。这一缺口限制了增强现实导航以及由视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型或世界模型驱动的自主手术等应用，这些应用需要大规模、高质量的3D监督数据。

Method: 构建 SurgTAP-3D 大规模体内伪3D手术运动追踪数据集与基准，包含520K帧、4549个动作片段、140万条2D/3D点轨迹，覆盖机器人及手工手术并统一动作类别。为实现可扩展标注，设计统一的手术3D点追踪框架，通过接触区域提示、主动工具分割、动态光束法平差（bundle adjustment）和全局4D优化，将未标定单目手术视频转换为结构化4D标注，产出时序一致的轨迹、伪尺度几何、相机位姿与器械掩码。

Result: 数据集涵盖遮挡、烟雾、出血、器械快速运动等手术环境真实挑战。在 SurgPose、SurgT、STIR 上建立综合基准，覆盖器械与组织追踪，并演示器械位移估计、可变形表面重建与基础模型微调。大量实验与分析表明该数据集与标注框架在3D手术点追踪、重建和手术动作理解方面有效。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了手术场景中大规模、高质量且兼顾工具-组织交互的3D监督数据空白，提供可扩展的统一标注框架与综合基准，为3D手术点追踪、重建及由VLA/世界模型驱动的智能手术系统奠定数据与方法基础。

Abstract: Understanding 3D scene dynamics in minimally invasive surgery (MIS) is a fundamental step toward physically intelligent and autonomous surgical systems. However, existing public datasets offer limited scalability and diversity in real-world clinical scenarios. Moreover, annotations typically focus on either tissue or instruments alone, overlooking tool-tissue interactions. This gap limits applications such as augmented reality guidance and autonomous surgery driven by vision-language-action (VLA) models or world models, which demand large-scale, high-quality 3D supervision. In this work, we construct SurgTAP-3D, a large-scale in-vivo pseudo-3D surgical motion tracking dataset and benchmark, comprising 520K frames, 4,549 action clips, and 1.4M 2D/3D point trajectories from diverse robotic and manual procedures under unified action categories. To make annotation scalable, we design a unified framework for surgical 3D point tracking that converts uncalibrated monocular surgical videos into structured 4D annotations through contact-region prompting, active-tool segmentation, dynamic bundle adjustment, and global 4D refinement. This pipeline adapts foundation priors to surgical videos and produces temporally consistent trajectories, pseudo-scale geometry, camera poses, and instrument masks. The dataset captures realistic challenges inherent to surgical environments, including occlusions, smoke, bleeding, and rapid instrument motion. We establish a comprehensive benchmark on SurgPose, SurgT, and STIR, covering both instrument and tissue tracking. We demonstrate instrument displacement estimation, deformable surface reconstruction, and foundation-model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of our dataset and annotation framework for 3D surgical point tracking, reconstruction, and surgical action understanding. Homepage: https://wrld.github.io/surgtap-3d/

</details>


### [138] [Correctness Metric Matters: NWD-Based Calibration Loss for Tiny Person Detection in UAV Infrared Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11735)
*Tian Zhang,Zhirong Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文指出，无人机红外小目标检测中，沿用IoU硬阈值的二值预测校准（BPC）在几何上不适定，会压低本应较高的置信度；作者改用连续、尺度不变的归一化Wasserstein距离（NWD）作为校准目标，在HIT-UAV上显著降低定位感知ECE且不损mAP，并厘清该指标级修正的适用边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检测校准损失通常把“预测是否正确”定义为预测框与真值框的IoU是否超过硬阈值。对于UAV红外图像中占比不足0.1%的极小目标，同样的像素误差在目标缩小时会被放大惩罚，导致BPC错误地抑制高置信度预测，因此需要重新审视校准中的正确性目标本身。

Method: 用连续、尺度不变的归一化Wasserstein距离（NWD）替代IoU硬阈值目标，作为BPC的校准正确性度量；在HIT-UAV上按低、中、高信杂比（SCR）分组评估定位感知ECE（LaECE），并设置独立中心偏移锚点验证增益来自几何修正；同时分析校准权重平台、与验证集拟合的等渗映射叠加效果，以及该指标级修正的边界。

Result: 在HIT-UAV上，BPC+IoU使LaECE在Low/Mid/High SCR组分别从0.0689升至0.0761、0.0649升至0.0733、0.0653升至0.0682；改用NWD目标后，三组LaECE_NWD相对BPC+IoU均显著下降（p<10^-7），mAP基本不变（0.9356 vs. 0.9347）。增益在较宽的校准权重平台上成立；独立中心偏移锚点确认其为真实几何修正。NWD无需推理时映射层；叠加验证集拟合的等渗映射可进一步降低校准误差，二者作用于同一误差的不同分量。训练分布中的目标—背景热配对及逐图检测数异质性下的检测级聚合超出该指标级修正边界。

Conclusion: 检测校准的“正确性目标”不应默认继承IoU硬阈值，尤其对UAV红外小目标；采用尺度不变的NWD可更合理地定义校准目标，在不牺牲检测精度的情况下显著改善定位感知校准。该修正有效但有明确边界：热配对分布偏差与检测级聚合异质性仍需在其他层面处理。

Abstract: Detection calibration aligns predicted confidence with empirical correctness. Existing calibration losses inherit their correctness definition from box regression, specifically IoU against a hard threshold. We show that this target is geometrically ill-posed for tiny objects in UAV infrared imagery, where persons occupy less than 0.1\% of the image. The same pixel error is penalized more heavily as the target shrinks, so binary prediction calibration (BPC) actively suppresses confidences that should be high. On HIT-UAV, BPC with an IoU target degrades image-level localization-aware ECE (LaECE) from 0.0689 to 0.0761, 0.0649 to 0.0733, and 0.0653 to 0.0682 across Low, Mid, and High signal-to-clutter ratio (SCR) groups. We replace the IoU target with a continuous, scale-invariant normalized Wasserstein distance (NWD). The NWD target reduces LaECE\(_{\mathrm{NWD}}\) relative to BPC+IoU on all three groups (\(p<10^{-7}\)) with mAP neutral (0.9356 vs.\ 0.9347), and an independent center-offset anchor confirms that the gain is a genuine geometric correction. The improvement holds across a broad plateau of calibration weights. The NWD formulation requires no inference-time mapping layer. If a validation-fitted isotonic map is applied on top of it, calibration is lowered further, and the two corrections act on different components of the same error. The metric-level remedy has a measurable boundary. Target-background thermal pairing in the training distribution and detection-level aggregation under per-image detection-count heterogeneity lie outside it. Both are quantified independently of the NWD target.

</details>


### [139] [EarthJev: Efficient Visual Evidence Acquisition and Decision for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10005)
*Pengyu Dai,Yao Zhang,Jian Song,Junjue Wang,Yafei Ou,Yuzeng Chen,Junshi Xia,Hongruixuan Chen,Naoto Yokoya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EarthJev 将区域评分与答案生成解耦，在冻结问答模型下结合空间指针验证、证据感知批式评分和格式特定置信校准，实现高分辨率遥感 VQA 的高效主动观察。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超高分辨率遥感 VQA 需要在有限视觉输入预算下定位细粒度证据。主动观察可通过选择性探索缓解该问题，但反复进行生成式区域判断会带来较高搜索成本；同时决策涉及空间指针有效性、证据存在性和推理正确性等不同目标，统一生成判断难以高效区分。

Method: 提出 EarthJev：分离区域评分与答案生成，并保持回答模型冻结。空间指针验证器利用视觉与几何线索指导探索或跳过搜索；证据感知决策机制用轻量头在冻结表征上批量评分紧凑候选视图，避免生成文本式区域判断；随后通过格式特定置信校准，在基于记忆生成的候选答案与基于已获取证据总览的候选答案之间进行选择。

Result: 在五个基准上，使用 Qwen3.5-9B 取得 53.06% 的平均准确率，较同回答模型的 ZoomSearch 在每个基准上提升 2.33–14.73 个百分点，并将平均延迟从 11.30 秒/题降至 1.67 秒/题。对四个额外冻结回答模型适配决策模块与校准映射后，相较对应单次基线平均提升 3.41–6.53 个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将区域评分与答案生成解耦，并针对不同预测目标设计决策信号与校准机制，可在不训练回答模型的情况下兼顾超高分辨率遥感 VQA 的准确率与推理效率，并具有跨回答模型的适配性。

Abstract: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing visual question answering (VQA) requires locating fine-grained evidence in large scenes under limited visual input budgets. Active observation addresses this challenge through selective exploration, but repeated generative judgments can make region search costly. Its decisions also concern distinct prediction targets: spatial pointer validity, evidence presence, and reasoning correctness. We propose EarthJev, a framework that separates region scoring from answer generation and uses target-specific decision signals while keeping the answering model frozen. A spatial pointer verifier uses visual and geometric cues to guide exploration or bypass search. An evidence-aware decision mechanism scores compact candidate views in batches using a lightweight head on frozen representations, without generating textual region judgments. Format-specific confidence calibration then guides selection between candidate answers generated from memory and overview presentations of the acquired evidence. Across five benchmarks, EarthJev achieves a mean accuracy of 53.06% with Qwen3.5-9B, outperforming ZoomSearch with the same answering model by 2.33 to 14.73 percentage points per benchmark while reducing mean latency from 11.30 - 1.67 seconds per question. With four additional frozen answering models, model-specific fitting of the decision modules and calibration mappings yields mean accuracy gains of 3.41 - 6.53 percentage points over the corresponding single-pass baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/Da1daidaidai/EarthJev

</details>


### [140] [Dense Flow from Adaptive Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11738)
*Cheng-Lin Hsieh,Stella X. Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FATE方法，将匹配尺度与稠密光流分辨率解耦，通过自适应Token支撑进行可靠匹配并复用支撑实现精确稠密光流重建，在零样本精度上取得最优。


<details>
