We study four encodings that place skeletal motion in different geometric spaces: Gaussian joint heatmaps on the pixel lattice, which we show to be a morphological dilation of the joint point set by a quadratic structuring function; root-relative joint positions in Euclidean space; local joint rotations on $\SO$ through a continuous 6D embedding; and a redundant full kinematic encoding. For each, we train VQ-VAE tokenizers whose codebooks lie on the unit hypersphere, varying codebook size, temporal stride, and code dimension. Beyond reconstruction, we measure codebook utilization and the effective vocabulary size, i.e., the number of equiprobable spherical Voronoi cells with the same entropy as the observed token distribution. Rotation and position encodings keep converting additional codewords into effective vocabulary, whereas the full kinematic encoding saturates at a few hundred effective cells and heatmaps at fewer than sixty. The smallest code dimension gives the highest utilization for three of the four encodings, and the effect of temporal stride depends on the encoding. Encodings of the same pose family can thus yield effective vocabularies differing by an order of magnitude, a difference that reconstruction loss alone does not reveal, which points to input geometry as a first-order design choice in motion tokenization.

</details>


### [208] [OptiCover: A Scalable and Multi-Surface Framework for Cold-Start Visual Optimization under Semantic Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12727)
*Guillaume Guy,Mihajlo Grbovic,Joe Mills,Selen Uguroglu,Liwei He,Pratiksha Kadam,Nalini Kartha,Qian Aria Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Airbnb 提出 OptiCover 框架，在严重冷启动与语义约束下自动为房源挑选并优化封面图，已大规模上线并带来显著在线收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 封面图对电商视觉营销至关重要但研究不足。Airbnb 房源含大量房间/设施/景点照片，房东却只能手动选一张静态封面并在多个异构产品界面复用；同时超过 90% 的照片缺乏互动标签造成严重冷启动，且不同界面与搜索意图下偏好各异、视觉吸睛的照片可能语义上与房源不符。规模上涉及数亿张照片、每天数十万次新上传。

Method: 提出 OptiCover，一个支持语义约束与多界面互动信号的可扩展冷启动视觉优化框架，包含四个组件：(i) 候选照片生成器，通过多种代理信号筛选候选照片；(ii) 在冻结 CLIP 嵌入上运行的轻量视觉头，用于大规模语义打分；(iii) 基于视觉语言模型(VLM)的跨模态 grounding 校验器，强制语义代表性；(iv) 探索日志模块(ELM)，跨异构产品界面与上下文搜索意图组织随机化互动数据采集。

Result: 通过大量离线研究与在 HomePage、Search 等多个界面上的在线实验评估。OptiCover 已上线生产，每日执行数千万次照片替换；在线结果显示 HomePage 互动率提升 1.5%，Search 上预订者增加 0.35%，带来数百万美元增量收入。

Conclusion: OptiCover 在冷启动、语义约束与多界面信号下实现了可扩展的封面图自动优化，并已在生产环境取得可观商业收益；研究表明动作空间塑形(action-space shaping)与语义约束是性能提升的主要驱动因素。

Abstract: Selecting an effective cover photo is a critical yet understudied problem in visual merchandising for e-commerce marketplaces. On Airbnb, hosts upload many photos depicting different rooms, amenities, and points of interest, but must manually choose a single static cover photo that is reused across heterogeneous product surfaces. This creates substantial challenges: over 90\% of listing photos have no engagement labels, leading to a severe cold-start regime; guest preferences vary across surfaces and search intents, and visually captivating photos may be semantically misaligned with the underlying listing. At Airbnb scale, this corresponds to hundreds of millions of photos and hundreds of thousands of new uploads per day.
  We propose \emph{OptiCover}, a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic constraints and multi-surface engagement signals. The framework combines (i) a photo candidate generator that identifies candidate photos through various proxies, (ii) lightweight vision heads applied to frozen CLIP embeddings for large-scale semantic scoring, (iii) a cross-modal grounding validator based on a vision-language model (VLM) that enforces semantic representativeness, and (iv) an Exploration Logging Module (ELM) that orchestrates the collection of randomized engagement data across heterogeneous product surfaces and contextual search intents.
  We evaluate OptiCover through extensive offline studies and multiple online experiments across HomePage, and Search surfaces. OptiCover is now deployed in production and performs tens of millions of photo swaps daily. Online results show a 1.5\% engagement lift on the HomePage and a 0.35\% increase in bookers on Search, generating millions of dollars in incremental revenue. Our findings suggest that action-space shaping and semantic constraints are primary drivers of performance.

</details>


### [209] [Plant Orbiter: 3D Plant Reconstruction and Generation with Video Diffusion Orbit Cameras and 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12739)
*Zane K. J. Hartley,Yong En Kok,Lewis A. G. Stuart,Andrew P. French,Michael P. Pound*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Plant Orbiter：利用视频扩散模型从单张图像生成植物三维高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splats），提升植物形态重建精度与高通量实用性，并可结合二维扩散模型实现文本到三维植物生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字表型流水线需要高精度、高通量的三维植物形态测量，但植物形态复杂、结构纤细且存在遮挡，现有从二维向三维的转变仍难以高效获取植物的“数字三维双胞胎”。

Method: 基于视频扩散的最新进展，从单张图像生成高质量植物三维高斯溅射表示；并将其与二维扩散模型结合，用于文本提示生成三维植物模型。

Result: 在植物形态重建上优于现有先进方法，对所有基线取得最高的三维 F-score；同时相机布置更易对齐、成本更低，更适合高通量流水线；结合二维扩散模型后，在文本生成三维植物模型任务上达到先进水平。

Conclusion: Plant Orbiter 为单图像/文本驱动的植物三维建模提供了更准确且更实用的方案，有助于加速育种与研究中的植物表型分析。

Abstract: Modern digital phenotyping pipelines require the precise measurement of a range of 3D morphological plant traits. The accurate, high throughput acquisition of these traits helps breeders and researchers accelerate the development of new varieties, techniques and products. Recent advances in 3D technologies have enabled a rapid transition from 2D to 3D pipelines, but high throughput acquisition of digital 3D twins of plants remains a significant challenge due to complex morphology, thin structures and occlusions. In this paper we present Plant Orbiter, a new approach to generating 3D plants that leverages recent advances in video diffusion to produce high quality 3D Gaussian Splats of plants from a single image. We show that our method more accurately recreates plant morphology than other state-of-the-art methods, achieving the highest 3D F-score against all baselines, while being more practical for high throughput pipelines due to easier alignment and reduced cost of camera placement. Combined with a 2D diffusion model, we show that our method also achieves state-of-the-art results in the generation of 3D plant models from a text prompt.

</details>


### [210] [CrossLiDAR: Controllable Multi-Sensor LiDAR Sequence Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11131)
*Khanh Nguyen,Thomas Walker,Hichem Telli,Carlos de la Torre-Ortiz,Stefano Fiorini,Salah Eddine Bekhouche,Mohammed-En-Nadhir Zighem,Wassim Swaileh,Tinghuai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CrossLiDAR：一种基于Transformer的统一框架，可生成可控、时空一致且标定一致的多传感器LiDAR序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真LiDAR仿真是自动驾驶系统规模化开发与验证的瓶颈；现有生成器通常受限于单一传感器配置、结构与几何控制能力不足，且长时序4D生成存在漂移。

Method: 采用range图像紧凑隐空间，结合rectified flow目标与MM-DiT骨干；引入Inter-sensor Module实现多传感器交互，并用ControlNet式分支提供BEV先验或3D框等结构条件；生成短N帧序列后自回归扩展以增强长时一致性。

Result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上显著优于SOTA，JSD平均改善29.56%，MMD平均改善15.36%。

Conclusion: CrossLiDAR支持标定一致的多传感器长时序LiDAR rollout，为可控、场景化自动驾驶仿真测试提供了新途径。

Abstract: High-fidelity LiDAR simulation remains a bottleneck for scalable development and validation of autonomous systems. Existing generators can synthesize realistic scans, but they are typically constrained to a single sensor configuration, offer limited control over structure and geometry, and drift in long-horizon 4D generation. We present CrossLiDAR, a unified transformer-based framework capable of generating controllable and spatio-temporally consistent multi-sensor LiDAR sequences. Our approach leverages a rectified flow objective with a Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT) backbone, within a compact latent space of range images. To support multiple LiDAR sensors, an Inter-sensor Module enables interaction across sensors, while a ControlNet-style branch provides structural conditioning (e.g., BEV priors or 3D bounding boxes). For modeling the temporal consistency, CrossLiDAR generates short $N$-frame sequences and extends them autoregressively to improve long-horizon coherence. Our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 29.56\% in JSD and 15.36\% in MMD evaluated on nuScenes and the Waymo Dataset. CrossLiDAR bridges the gap to modern autonomous-driving simulation by enabling calibration-consistent multi-sensor LiDAR rollouts over long horizons for controllable, scenario-based testing.

</details>


### [211] [Complementarity-Driven Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12798)
*Lukun Wu,Jie Li,Ziqi Ren,Ruiyang Xia,Yan Gao,Xinbo Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DTHA框架，用CLIP与DINOv2双教师分层对齐EEG，在THINGS-EEG零样本检索上达到92.4% Top-1，较此前最优提升12.4个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG视觉解码主要只与CLIP系列视觉基础模型对齐，未充分利用神经响应中的层级视觉信息；作者据此提出“机制—范式对应”观点，认为仅图像模型与图像—文本模型在视觉层级上具有互补偏差。

Method: 提出双教师分层对齐（DTHA）：共享EEG编码器由冻结的多模糊CLIP与浅层DINOv2教师通过双分支对比对齐监督；引入融合检索目标学习自适应权重以组合互补表征；并设计AMSPBE编码器，结合时空注意力与可学习头皮模式库，建模区域时间动态与滤波器组地形。

Result: 在THINGS-EEG零样本检索中取得92.4% Top-1，超过此前最优12.4个百分点；空间、频谱与表征相似性分析及THINGS-MEG评估支持其有效性、生物合理性与跨模态泛化能力。

Conclusion: 跨范式视觉基础模型的互补监督能够更完整地从脑活动中提取层级视觉信息，为EEG视觉解码提供了新的机制视角与有效框架。

Abstract: Decoding visual information from EEG is central to brain--computer interfaces and brain-inspired intelligence, and contrastive alignment with pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) has become the dominant paradigm. However, existing methods align EEG solely with CLIP-family VFMs, leaving hierarchical visual information in neural responses under-exploited. To address this gap, we formulate a mechanism-paradigm correspondence view linking hierarchical visual processing (from appearance to semantics) to the complementary biases of cross-paradigm VFMs, with image-only models (e.g., DINO) and image--text models (e.g., CLIP) capturing distinct facets of this hierarchy. Guided by this view, we propose the Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment (DTHA) framework. Concretely, a shared EEG encoder is supervised by frozen multi-blur CLIP and shallow DINOv2 teachers via dual-branch contrastive alignment, so each branch fully supervises the visual cues it emphasizes. A fused-retrieval objective learns adaptive weights to combine their complementary visual representations for zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval. For the shared EEG encoder, we introduce the Attentive Modulated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder (AMSPBE), combining temporo-spatial attention with a learnable scalp-pattern bank for accurate, interpretable visual feature extraction, while modeling regional temporal dynamics and filter-bank topographies. On THINGS-EEG zero-shot retrieval, DTHA achieves 92.4% Top-1 accuracy, exceeding prior state of the art by 12.4 percentage points. Spatial, spectral, and representational-similarity analyses, together with THINGS-MEG evaluation, validate DTHA's effectiveness, biological plausibility, and cross-modality generalization. This complementarity-driven perspective shows that supervision from cross-paradigm VFMs enables more complete extraction of hierarchical visual information from brain activity.

</details>


### [212] [2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12805)
*Aarya Bhave,Anushka Ajay Bhave*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出2D Gum-Net，将原用于冷冻电镜三维子断层对齐的Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network迁移到二维弹性配准，用稠密空间变换器+控制点网格回归+B样条/双三次上采样与DCT谱池化，实现全无监督稠密形变场预测；在指纹数据集上仅用合成样本训练、零样本测试真实基准，结构相关性最高提升15.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密非刚性配准（估计像素级形变场使两幅图像几何一致）在医学影像、结构生物学与对应关系估计中十分基础，但基于学习的方法面临核心瓶颈：真实数据几乎无法获得稠密形变的真值标注。作者希望完全无监督地学习弹性形变场，并借助指纹这一自相似性强、形变真实且含可验证特征点（细节点）的场景作为严苛测试床。

Method: 将面向冷冻电镜三维子断层对齐的Gum-Net迁移到二维：三个模块全部二维化重设计，刚性变换头替换为Dense Spatial Transformer，回归稀疏控制点网格并经双三次插值上采样为全分辨率形变场Φ；下采样采用DCT谱池化，以冻结基矩阵乘法实现（约50倍GPU加速），以保留max/average池化会破坏的细密准周期结构。训练完全基于合成指纹按压样本，直接在真实基准上零样本评测，并用独立匹配器通过细节点检验形变场的拓扑正确性。

Result: 在FVC2004上结构相关性最高提升15.7%；在独立匹配器下真实匹配分数提高，而冒认（imposter）分数基本不变，说明预测的形变恢复了真实结构而非凭空捏造对应关系。

Conclusion: 全无监督的2D Gum-Net可在无真值形变监督下预测稠密弹性形变场，且从合成数据到真实数据的零样本泛化有效；独立匹配器的评分变化模式（真匹配升、冒认不变）为形变场的结构正确性提供了外部证据，DCT谱池化对保留高频结构也有明确价值。

Abstract: Dense non-rigid registration, the recovery of a pixel-wise deformation field that warps one image into geometric agreement with another, is fundamental across medical imaging, structural biology, and correspondence estimation, yet learning-based approaches face a severe bottleneck: ground-truth deformation fields are notoriously difficult to obtain for real data. We present 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields fully unsupervised. We transfer the Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net), originally developed for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-electron tomography, to 2D elastic registration: all three modules are redesigned in 2D, and the rigid transformation head is replaced by a Dense Spatial Transformer that regresses a sparse control-point grid, lifted to a full-resolution field $Φ$ by bicubic interpolation. Downsampling uses DCT spectral pooling, implemented as frozen-basis matrix multiplications ($\approx 50\times$ GPU speedup), preserving the fine, quasi-periodic structure that max and average pooling destroy. We evaluate on contact-based fingerprints, a challenging testbed for this task: locally self-similar ridge patterns make correspondence maximally ambiguous, skin pressed against a sensor generates authentic large-displacement elastic distortion, and minutiae act as precise landmarks through which an independent matcher externally verifies the topological correctness of predicted fields. Trained purely on synthetic impressions and evaluated zero-shot on real benchmarks, our method improves structural correlation by up to 15.7% on FVC2004 and raises genuine match scores under an independent matcher while leaving imposter scores essentially unchanged. This suggests that the predicted deformations restore true structure without fabricating correspondences.

</details>


### [213] [What kills $v$-prediction? A Patch-wise PCA Perspective on Pixel-Space Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12852)
*Tianze Luo,Haofeng Huang,Yuan Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过 patch-wise PCA 分析像素空间 Flow Matching 的训练难点，指出 v-prediction 存在"带宽瓶颈"，并提出 Raw-injected Transformer（RiT）以恢复有效 v-prediction。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Latent Diffusion 虽为主流，但存在两阶段训练复杂度和预训练自编码器重建上限；像素空间 Flow Matching 虽端到端简洁，却在标准 v-prediction 目标下训练困难。已有研究将困难归因于加噪目标的离流形特性，并因此转向 x-prediction，但作者希望检验这一解释是否充分，并厘清 x-prediction 有效的真正机制。

Method: 采用 patch-wise PCA 进行谱分析，发现在次要主成分方向上的速度主要由原始加噪输入决定，深层骨干需保留与主成分建模相竞争的信息，形成"带宽瓶颈"。通过受控实验与表征分析，发现 x-prediction 的参量化提供了一条原始输入旁路，且其学习到的输入表征可自发集中于主成分方向；在低秩观测假设下分析所诱导的流，将 x-prediction 刻画为隐式条件均值解码器，从保留信息中重建被丢弃分量。据此提出 RiT：将轻量原始条件解码器与输出端 shortcut 结合，分离语义建模与原始状态传播。

Result: RiT 恢复了有效的 v-prediction，并在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 论文揭示了预测目标与架构带宽之间的交互关系：v-prediction 的困难并非仅源于离流形目标，而与骨干网络的信息带宽限制相关；显式注入原始输入并加输出端 shortcut 可缓解该瓶颈，为像素空间生成建模提供了新的设计视角。

Abstract: Latent Diffusion Models dominate generative modeling but face two-stage training complexity and the inherent reconstruction limits of pre-trained autoencoders. Pixel-space Flow Matching offers a simplified end-to-end alternative yet often encounters training difficulties when using the standard $v$-prediction objective. Recent research attributes this difficulty to the off-manifold nature of noised targets, motivating a shift toward $x$-prediction. In this paper, we investigate this explanation through patch-wise Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and identify a bandwidth bottleneck. The velocity in minor components is largely determined by the raw noisy input, requiring deep backbones to preserve information that competes with principal-component modeling. Through controlled experiments and representation analysis, we further examine why $x$-prediction remains effective: its parameterization provides a raw-input bypass, while its learned input representation can spontaneously concentrate on principal directions. Under low-rank observations, our analysis of the induced flow characterizes $x$-prediction as an implicit conditional-mean decoder, reconstructing discarded components from the retained information. These observations motivate the Raw-injected Transformer (RiT), which combines a lightweight raw-conditioned decoder with an output-side shortcut to separate semantic modeling from raw-state propagation. Our method restores effective $v$-prediction and achieves competitive performance on ImageNet $256\times256$, providing a perspective on the interaction between prediction objectives and architectural bandwidth.

</details>


### [214] [AI-based characterization of lymphoid structures and the tumor microenvironment reveals lower mature tertiary lymphoid structures, lymph-node follicles, and plasma cells after neoadjuvant therapy in lung squamous cell carcinoma](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12855)
*Arne Schmidt,Justin Nieder,Cornelius Boehm,Julika Ribbat-Idel,Marius Teodorescu,Marie-Lisa Eich,Simon Schallenberg,Gabriel Dernbach,Katja Lingelbach,Miriam Haegele,Timo Milbich,Adam Narai,Maria Stoelben,Hans Pinckaers,Lukas Ruff,Kai Standvoss,Christian Watermann,Christiane Kuempers,Sven Perner,Verena Sailer,Jasmin Tiebach,Torsten Goldmann,Sebastian Marwitz,Johannes Braegelmann,Frederick Klauschen,Marija Pezer,Rosemarie Krupar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过AI病理分析比较新辅助治疗与初治肺鳞癌的肿瘤-淋巴结免疫轴，发现新辅助治疗与成熟淋巴结构减少及体液免疫与肿瘤耦合减弱相关，而非整体免疫指标下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成熟三级淋巴结构（TLS）与淋巴结滤泡（SLS）支撑的浆细胞应答影响肺癌预后及免疫治疗获益，但这一"局部-区域"免疫轴在新辅助治疗与初治肿瘤间的差异尚不清楚。

Method: 分析匹配的新辅助治疗（neoLUSC, n=20）与初治（naivLUSC, n=20）肺鳞癌患者的H&E全切片图像及近端/远端淋巴结；用Aignostics Atlas HETA模型定量各组织分区细胞密度与细胞共定位；用经病理医师标注验证的深度学习模型检测TLS与SLS并评估其成熟度；在独立队列（n=458，46例接受治疗）中检验预后价值。

Result: neoLUSC肿瘤间质浆细胞密度较naivLUSC低72%（p=0.004）、间质淋巴细胞低48%（p=0.015），巨噬细胞与粒细胞无显著差异；总TLS与未成熟TLS无差异，但肿瘤内成熟TLS（p=0.034）及肿瘤远端淋巴结中成熟SLS（p=0.003）在neoLUSC中更少；peri-TLS浆细胞密度与肿瘤淋巴细胞密度在naivLUSC相关（rho=0.54, p=0.017），在neoLUSC中不相关（rho=0.07）。验证队列中，间质浆细胞密度（HR 0.69, p=0.011）与淋巴细胞-浆细胞共定位（HR 0.66, p=0.004）与更长生存相关，新辅助状态与更短生存相关（HR 1.50, p=0.026）。

Conclusion: 新辅助治疗与成熟淋巴结构减少及体液免疫区室与肿瘤耦合减弱相关，而非全面的免疫指标降低；间质浆细胞/共定位轴可作为候选预后生物标志物。

Abstract: Mature, germinal centre-bearing tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) and mature lymph node follicles (secondary lymphoid structures, SLS) sustain the plasma cell response that shapes outcome and immunotherapy benefit in lung cancer. How this loco-regional axis differs between neoadjuvant-treated and therapy-naive tumors is poorly defined. We analyzed H&E whole-slide images of resected tumors and paired proximal and distal lymph nodes from matched neoadjuvant-treated (neoLUSC, n=20) and therapy-naive (naivLUSC, n=20) lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) patients. Aignostics Atlas H&E Tissue Analysis (HETA) models quantified cell densities per tissue compartment and cell-cell co-localization; a dedicated deep-learning model validated against pathologist annotations detected TLS and SLS and graded their maturity. Prognostic value was tested in an independent cohort (n=458; 46 treated). In neoLUSC tumors, stromal plasma cell density was 72% (p=0.004) and stromal lymphocyte density 48% (p=0.015) lower than in naivLUSC; macrophages and granulocytes did not differ significantly. Total and immature TLS did not differ, whereas mature TLS in the tumor (p=0.034) and mature SLS in the tumor-distal lymph node (p=0.003) were lower in neoLUSC patients. Peri-TLS plasma cell density correlated with tumor lymphocyte density in naivLUSC (rho=0.54, p=0.017) but not in neoLUSC tumors (rho=0.07). In the validation cohort, stromal plasma cell density (HR 0.69, p=0.011) and lymphocyte-plasma cell co-localization (HR 0.66, p=0.004) were associated with longer survival, and neoadjuvant status with shorter survival (HR 1.50, p=0.026). Neoadjuvant therapy is thus associated with fewer mature lymphoid structures and weaker coupling of the humoral compartment to the tumor rather than uniformly lower immune readouts. The stromal plasma cell/co-localization axis is a candidate prognostic biomarker.

</details>


### [215] [Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12875)
*Hao Gu,Jin Yao,Zezhou Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Click3R，用稀疏人工点击对应点交互校正前馈三维重建模型的错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈式大规模三维重建模型只输出单一且不可更改的预测，一旦失败无法修正，缺乏纠错机制。

Method: 给定图像对与用户提供的少量跨视角点对应，通过轻量级点对应适配器将几何约束注入三维重建网络，以消除重复纹理、对称结构、大视角变化和无纹理区域等歧义；并构建专门暴露现有方法失败模式的挑战性基准。

Result: 仅需一次对应点击即可降低重建误差，在标准基准与自建基准上均取得提升。

Conclusion: 稀疏人工交互是纠正几何重建错误的有效且实用的手段。

Abstract: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction. When these models fail, there is no mechanism to correct their mistakes. To address this limitation, we introduce Click3R, a framework for interactive geometric correction of feed-forward models using sparse human correspondence clicks. Given an image pair and a small set of cross-view point correspondences provided by a user, Click3R injects geometric constraints into the 3D reconstruction networks through a lightweight point correspondence adapter, enabling the model to resolve ambiguities in challenging scenarios such as repetitive textures, symmetric structures, large viewpoint changes, or textureless regions. To evaluate interactive reconstruction, we curate a challenging benchmark specifically designed to expose failure modes of existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods. Experiments show that Click3R reduces reconstruction error with as few as a single correspondence click, improving performance on both standard and our curated benchmarks. Our results highlight that sparse human interaction provides an effective and practical mechanism for correcting geometric reconstruction errors.

</details>


### [216] [Grasping the Future: Joint 3D Hand-Object Forecasting From Internet Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12879)
*Rustin Soraki,Matthew Wallingford,Ryan Aby,Brandon Chee,Jason Ren,Ali Farhadi,Homanga Bharadhwaj,Roozbeh Mottaghi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Grasping-the-Future，一个统一的生成式模型，可联合预测三维手-物运动（手腕、手指关节、物体位姿），并用掩码时空补全+flow matching 统一处理多种交互预测任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与物体交互时需要同时预判物体如何运动和手如何随之运动，人类视频天然记录了日常活动中这种关系，是学习"预测未来交互"的自然数据源。但要从视频中学到该能力，必须先从已完成的交互中恢复三维运动，再用它预测后续可能发生的情况；已有工作多为单一预测任务设计，缺少统一框架，且难以在运动过程中保持抓握（接触）关系、也缺乏可扩展的三维监督。

Method: 1）建模对象为手-物联合三维运动：手腕运动、手指关节articulation、物体位置与朝向；2）训练范式为掩码时空补全（masked spatiotemporal completion）结合 flow matching，用单个模型支持多种任务——预测未来交互、由物体运动推手部运动或反之、生成朝向目标末态物体位姿的双轨迹、补全部分观测的交互；3）显式建模手-物关系并引入接触约束，以在运动生成中保持抓握关系；4）数据侧构建可扩展管线：将预训练感知模型与联合几何优化相结合，从互联网视频重建完整的交互轨迹，再与带标注的交互数据集混合作为全部任务的训练数据。

Result: 在所有预测任务上均表现强劲，在具备三维标注的数据集上超过已公开的预测器（forecasters）；并进一步通过将预测轨迹重定向（retarget）到机器人本体，验证了轨迹在几何与物理上的合理性。

Conclusion: 该工作表明：以"视频恢复的三维交互轨迹"为监督、以统一的掩码补全/flow matching 为生成框架，可以用一个模型覆盖多种手-物运动预测设定，并借助接触约束保持抓握一致性，从而把人类视频中的交互先验迁移到机器人操作等下游应用。核心贡献可概括为"统一的多任务手-物运动生成模型 + 可扩展的视频三维监督管线 + 面向机器人实体的可行性验证"。

Abstract: To interact with an object, we need to anticipate both how it will move and how our hands should move with it. Human videos capture these relationships across everyday activities, offering a natural source for learning to predict future interactions. Learning from them requires recovering motion from completed interactions and using it to anticipate what could happen next. We present $\textit{Grasping-the-Future}$, a unified generative model of joint 3D hand-object motion, including wrist motion, finger articulation, and object position and orientation. Through masked spatiotemporal completion and flow matching, we train a single model for several prediction tasks: forecasting future interactions, predicting hand motion given object motion or vice versa, generating both trajectories toward a desired final object pose, and completing partially observed interactions. We explicitly model hand-object relations and incorporate contact constraints to help preserve grasp relationships during motion. To obtain 3D supervision from internet videos, we develop a scalable pipeline that combines pretrained perception models with joint geometric optimization to reconstruct completed interactions. We combine these recovered trajectories with annotated interaction datasets as training data for all tasks. We demonstrate strong performance across all tasks, outperforming released forecasters on datasets with 3D annotations. Moreover, we show geometric and physical plausibility of the predicted trajectories by retargeting them to a robotic embodiment. Videos are available at https://grasping-the-future.github.io.

</details>


### [217] [Beyond Modality Preference: Controlling Multimodal Arbitration under Modality Conflict in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12883)
*Zhaoying Pan,Shenyu Lu,Jun Hui Wong,Junyi Chai,Xiaoqian Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文研究多模态大模型在模态冲突时不可靠的问题，发现一组可因果影响“跟随视觉还是文本证据”的注意力头（arbitration heads），并提出无需训练的推理时干预，将模型偏置到指定可信模态，实现双向控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型整合多模态信息，但当不同模态输入相互冲突时，模型可能偏向并非任务最可靠的模态，导致预测不可靠。因此需要在推理阶段对模态仲裁进行控制，使模型遵循任务指定的模态优先级。

Method: 作者识别出一小组“仲裁注意力头”（arbitration heads），这些头对模型预测究竟依据视觉证据还是文本证据具有因果影响。基于此，提出一种轻量、无需训练的推理时干预：在推理阶段对这些注意力头施加偏置，使其倾向指定的可信模态。并检验这些头在不同校准集规模下的稳定性及跨设置泛化性。

Result: 识别出的仲裁头在不同校准集规模下保持稳定，并能跨设置泛化；对这些头进行引导可在多个基准上有效实现模态依赖的双向控制，使预测与任务指定的模态优先级一致。

Conclusion: 该研究给出了一个有效的控制机制，可在推理时对齐多模态大模型的预测与任务指定的模态优先级；方法轻量且无需训练，并公开了代码。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate information across modalities, but become unreliable when those modalities disagree. Under conflicting inputs, MLLMs may favor modalities that are not the most reliable for the task, thus motivating inference-time control of modality arbitration. We identify a small set of attention heads, termed arbitration heads, that causally influence whether predictions follow visual or textual evidence. Building on this, we introduce a lightweight, training-free intervention that biases these heads toward a designated trusted modality at inference time. The identified heads are stable across calibration set sizes and generalize across settings, and steering them enables effective bidirectional control of modality reliance across diverse benchmarks. Our findings identify an effective control mechanism to align MLLM predictions with task-specified modality priorities. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/modality-arbitration.

</details>


### [218] [Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12886)
*Haozhi Yuan,Handong Li,Yifan Zhang,Qianshan Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Reframe 后训练框架，把"观测状态"而非仅"输出分布"作为对齐对象，通过 GD-GRPO（证据感知奖励+随机丢弃原始视觉输入）与 OG-MOPD（rollout 中途修复工具动作并从修复观测继续蒸馏）两阶段互补，在 14 个图像/视频基准上超过 Mix-RL 与 vanilla MOPD，且无需任务特定 SFT 冷启动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉智能体的后训练可走智能体强化学习与多教师在线策略蒸馏两条互补路线，但工具使用带来两个相互关联的问题：一是模型容易忽略工具返回的有用观测（观测未被有效利用）；二是动作本身缺乏视觉落地，导致可用的证据质量不足，进而限制后续蒸馏的效果。作者认为根因在于以往方法只对齐输出分布，而未把"观测状态"当作对齐对象。

Method: Reframe 采用两阶段设计：(1) Ground-Drop-GRPO（GD-GRPO）：用证据感知奖励训练空间与时间两类专家，并随机移除原始视觉输入，迫使模型获取有落地的证据并真正依赖工具返回的观测；(2) Observation-Gated-MOPD（OG-MOPD）：在 rollout 过程中把有缺陷的工具动作替换为规范（canonical）动作，并从修复后的观测继续蒸馏。两阶段互为补充——学会依赖工具观测能让策略从观测修复中获益更多。整个流程不需要任务特定的 SFT 冷启动。

Result: 在 14 个图像与视频基准上的大量实验显示，Reframe 同时优于 Mix-RL 与 vanilla MOPD 两类基线。消融实验表明，与基于结果的 GRPO 相比，GD-GRPO 显著提升了模型对观测的依赖程度与工具增益（tool gain）。

Conclusion: 将观测状态纳入对齐目标是一种有效的视觉智能体后训练思路：证据感知训练 + 输入遮蔽促使模型利用工具观测，观测修复式蒸馏则弥补动作缺陷带来的证据缺口，二者协同且无需冷启动 SFT。该工作提示未来 agentic 后训练应更多关注中间观测质量，而非仅优化最终输出分布。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence and use the returned observations. Second, Observation-Gated-MOPD (OG-MOPD) replaces deficient tool actions with canonical ones mid-rollout and resumes distillation from the repaired observation. The two stages complement each other, as learning to rely on tool-returned observations can help the policy benefit from observation repair. Neither stage requires a task-specific SFT cold start. Extensive experiments over 14 image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Reframe outperforms both Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD. Ablation results show that GD-GRPO increases observation dependence and tool gain compared with outcome-based GRPO.

</details>


### [219] [Uncertainty, Not Concealment: A Mechanistic Reappraisal of Sycophancy in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10297)
*Mohamed I. Eldagla,Zeyad H. ElShafei,Ahmed M. Anter*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文用表征探测、激活引导和双向强制选择三部分诊断，区分医学视觉语言模型是“检测到冲突但隐瞒”还是“本身不确定”。结果显示模型存在行为层面的矛盾抑制，但冲突方向引导无法诱发矛盾报告，强制二选一也无法恢复，且不匹配时对图像的跨模态注意力下降，说明矛盾被表征为被门控的模糊不确定性而非被隐藏的知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗检索增强生成中的视觉语言模型需要判断检索到的报告是否与X光影像矛盾，这对安全部署至关重要。已有“谄媚掩码”假设认为模型内部能检测冲突但拒绝报告，因此需要区分“隐瞒”与“不确定性”。

Method: 提出三部分诊断框架：表征探测、激活引导、双向强制选择；在四个指令微调的胸片视觉语言模型上实验，并用线性探针区分匹配/不匹配输入，与简单CLIP模型比较；同时分析跨模态注意力。

Result: 确认模型在行为上抑制矛盾报告；线性探针能够区分匹配与不匹配输入，且优于CLIP基线；但沿学到的冲突方向进行激活引导始终不能诱发矛盾报告，强制二选一也无法恢复矛盾判断；不匹配样本上模型对图像的跨模态注意力反而下降。

Conclusion: 这些模型未能指出矛盾，并非因为内部检测到冲突却隐瞒，而是图文不匹配被表征为带 hedging、被门控的不确定性。研究呼吁进行重新接地（re-grounding）和不确定性显式化，而非仅依赖冲突探测。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) in medical retrieval-augmented generation must be able to say when a retrieved report contradicts the X-ray, so understanding whether they can detect such conflicts is important for safe deployment. The sycophancy mask hypothesis holds that these models internally detect conflicts but refuse to report them, concealing a detected contradiction. We introduce a three-part diagnostic that separates concealment from uncertainty: representation probing, activation steering, and two-way forced choice. Across four instruction-tuned VLMs on chest X-rays, we confirm behavioral suppression of contradiction and find that a linear probe separates matched from mismatched inputs, beyond what a simple CLIP model achieves. Steering the learned conflict direction never elicits contradiction, and forcing a binary choice does not recover one; instead, cross-modal attention to the image drops on mismatched pairs. We conclude that these models fail to contradict because the mismatch registers as hedged, gated uncertainty rather than concealed knowledge, calling for re-grounding and uncertainty surfacing. Code is available at https://github.com/mohamed-eldagla/Uncertainty-Not-Concealment/.

</details>


### [220] [Action Transfer Across Character Body Plans in Latent-Action World Models: An Empirical Study of Animated Characters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10523)
*Amarnath R*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文研究潜动作世界模型能否将从一个2D角色学到的动作迁移到不同身体结构的角色，并提出新的迁移评分来避免“屏幕运动”捷径。实验覆盖新合成卡通角色基准、Sprites和DeformingThings4D，发现固定相机下仅复制屏幕运动的基线即可达0.71；跟随相机时最佳模型在未见动物家族仅0.46、人类仅0.20。线性探针能以66%–86%平衡准确率识别动作类别（随机17%），说明动作信息仍保留，但正确动作只缩小了部分预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D角色间不同身体结构的动作迁移仍缺乏研究；常用迁移增益混入身体运动与屏幕运动，甚至会给忽略动作的模型满分。

Method: 提出比较同一来源下正确动作与错误动作的迁移评分；在含六种身体方案的新合成2D卡通角色基准、Sprites及431个DeformingThings4D动画上测试五种训练目标，并区分固定相机与跟随身体相机；辅以线性探针评估动作类别信息。

Result: 固定相机下，仅复制源角色屏幕运动的基线得分为0.71，与多数学习模型相当；跟随相机下最佳模型对未见动物家族仅0.46、对 humans 仅0.20；线性探针对未见动物家族动作分类的平衡准确率为66%–86%，随机为17%。

Conclusion: 潜动作保留了“正在执行何种动作”的信息，但正确动作只能部分缩小新角色的预测误差差距；跨身体动作迁移仍是挑战，需避免屏幕运动捷径并改进身体结构泛化。

Abstract: Latent-action world models learn actions from video without labels, and recent methods aim to share these actions across bodies. Transfer between 2D characters with different body structures remains underexplored. In this paper, we study whether an action learned from one character can make a character with a different body perform the same action. A cat, a blob and a human can all jump, but each moves its body in its own way. The usual transfer gain mixes body motion with screen movement and can assign a perfect score to a model that ignores its action. To address this, we introduce a transfer score that compares the correct action with wrong ones from the same source. We test five training objectives on a new synthetic benchmark of 2D cartoon characters with six body plans, the standard Sprites benchmark, and 431 selected animal and human animations from DeformingThings4D. With a fixed camera, a baseline that only copies the source's screen movement scores 0.71, as high as most learned models. In contrast, with a camera that follows the body, the best model reaches only 0.46 for an unseen animal family and 0.20 for humans. With this camera, a linear probe identifies the action class of unseen animal families with 66% to 86% balanced accuracy (chance 17%). The learned actions therefore retain information about which action is performed, but the correct action closes only part of the prediction error gap for a new character.

</details>


### [221] [InfCoiL: Coordinated Planner-Controller Learning for Closed-Loop Physics-Based Human-Object Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11517)
*Yude Zou,Yifei Yao,Yiwei Hao,Hanqing Wang,Xing Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: InfCoiL：一个闭环的文本/目标条件物理仿真人-物交互框架，通过共享形态接口把形态感知的流匹配规划器与统一多形态控制器耦合，并用同一批物理仿真轨迹交替强化微调两者，提出SFPO实现流匹配规划器的在线优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本与目标条件的HOI为物理角色动画提供了直观的高层意图接口，但要映射为物理可行且接触丰富的动作，需要生成式规划器加物理控制器。现有规划-控制系统中，要么开环执行计划，要么闭环但规划器保持固定，导致执行反馈无法反过来重塑规划内容。

Method: (1) 结构上：形态感知的 flow-matching 规划器 + 统一多形态控制器，通过共享形态接口在自回归"规划-执行"闭环中耦合；(2) 训练上：用来自同一物理 rollout 的强化学习交替微调规划器与控制器；(3) 算法上：提出 Semantic Flow Policy Optimization (SFPO)，对选定的去噪转移施加基于通道级语义协方差的随机化（覆盖异构 HOI 特征），并以完整闭环执行的序列级、组相对奖励进行优化。

Result: 在留出的 OMOMO 序列上，InfCoiL 在目标达成任务成功率与物理跟踪精度上均优于开环分层基线方法。

Conclusion: 闭环协同的规划器-控制器学习（配合可在线RL微调的流匹配规划器）能有效利用执行反馈改进规划质量，从而在物理人-物交互中取得更好的任务成功与跟踪精度。

Abstract: Text- and goal-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) provides an intuitive interface for specifying high-level intents in physics-based character animation. Mapping such intents to physically plausible, contact-rich behaviors naturally calls for a generative planner and a physics-based controller, yet existing planner-controller systems either execute plans open-loop or close the loop while keeping the planner fixed, so execution feedback never reshapes what is planned. We present InfCoiL, a closed-loop framework for physics-based HOI from coordinated planner-controller learning. InfCoiL couples a morphology-aware flow-matching planner with a unified multi-morphology controller through a shared morphology interface in an autoregressive plan-and-execute loop, and alternately fine-tunes both components with reinforcement learning from the same physical rollouts. To optimize the flow-matching planner online, we introduce Semantic Flow Policy Optimization (SFPO), which stochasticizes selected denoising transitions with channel-wise semantic covariance over heterogeneous HOI features and assigns group-relative, sequence-level rewards from complete closed-loop executions. On held-out OMOMO sequences, InfCoiL outperforms open-loop hierarchical baselines in goal-reaching task success and physical tracking accuracy. Project page: https://infcoil.github.io/

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [222] [Process then Retrieve: Investigating the Origins of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09897)
*Arpita Shanbhag,Julia Tran,Dhruv Mandala,Ayda Sultan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探究视觉语言模型中"模态差距"的成因，提出文本token在嵌入层的信息密度远低于视觉token，导致模型浅层优先处理文本表征，并通过机制分析验证该假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）中存在显著的"模态差距"（modality gap），即视觉与语言表征在嵌入空间中分布不一致，但其根源仍不清楚。作者希望从信息密度这一角度，解释该差距在嵌入层如何产生，并进一步影响模型浅层计算资源的分配。

Method: 作者对比两种模态token在嵌入层的语义密度，量化文本token与视觉token所携带信息量的差异；并通过机制性分析（mechanistic analysis）进行干预实验：将视觉token位置替换为语义上最接近的文本token对应物，观察浅层注意力分配的变化。

Result: 结果显示，文本token进入模型时的语义密度明显低于视觉token；模型浅层因此更倾向于先加工文本表征，再与视觉信息融合。当把视觉token替换为语义最近的文本token后，浅层对这些位置的注意力显著增加，验证了信息密度差异是模态差距的重要来源之一。

Conclusion: 模态间的信息密度失衡是视觉语言模型模态差距的重要成因，并影响浅层的加工顺序与注意力分配。该发现为缓解模态差距、改进VLM架构中的多模态推理能力提供了理论基础与可操作方向。

Abstract: Understanding the origins of the modality gap in vision language models remains a significant challenge. This work investigates whether differences in information density between modality specific tokens at the embedding layer contribute to this imbalance. We show that text tokens enter the model with much lower semantic density than visual tokens, driving early layers to focus on processing text representations before combining them with vision. Through mechanistic analysis, we demonstrate that replacing vision token positions with their semantically closest text token counterparts elicits increased attention to those positions in early layers. These findings provide a foundation for addressing the modality gap and provide insight to improve multimodal reasoning in VLM architectures.

</details>


### [223] [MAGE: Towards Generalizable Multi-timescale EEG Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09928)
*Tuan-Kiet Doan,Van-Chien Nguyen,Trung-Hieu Tran,Quang-Hung Pham,Ngoc-Son Vu,Huy Phan,Phi Le Nguyen,Duc-Han Le,Nikola Simidjievski,Van-Tam Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MAGE脑电基础模型，通过多时间尺度注意力和可训练聚合模块动态捕捉EEG跨尺度神经动态，在七个数据集上以更少参数优于现有EEG基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型多采用固定时间尺度，难以刻画EEG中天然存在的跨多个时间尺度的神经动态特征，限制了对不同下游任务的适应能力。

Method: MAGE包含两个核心机制：一是新颖的多时间尺度注意力机制，用于学习跨多个时间尺度的表征；二是可训练的聚合模块，用于动态识别并适应输入信号中最具信息量的时间尺度。

Result: 在七个数据集上的实验表明，MAGE持续优于现有EEG基础模型，同时参数量显著更少；结果还支持不同下游任务受益于不同时间尺度这一假设。

Conclusion: 多时间尺度动态建模对EEG基础模型有效，可在降低参数量的同时提升跨数据集、跨任务性能，并揭示任务与时间尺度之间的适配关系。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) data plays an important role in understanding human brain activity, with various major applications. While current approaches, which largely build on EEG foundation models, have demonstrated strong performance across datasets and tasks, they typically rely on a fixed temporal scale. This design choice limits their ability to capture characteristics of neural dynamic behavior, often spanning across multiple timescales, which are naturally captured in EEG recordings. To address this limitation, we propose MAGE (\textbf{Multi-timescale Adaptive Generalization for EEG}), a foundation model that dynamically adapts to capture and integrate information across different timescales. Specifically, MAGE combines two key mechanisms: (i) a novel multi-timescale attention mechanism, capable of learning representations across multiple temporal scales and (ii) a trainable aggregation module, that dynamically identifies and adapts to the most informative timescale of the input signal. Experimental results across seven datasets demonstrate that MAGE consistently outperforms existing EEG foundation models while using substantially fewer parameters. Moreover, our results support the hypothesis that different downstream tasks benefit from distinct temporal scales. All source code will be released.

</details>


### [224] [Causal Discovery Bench: Can LLMs Autonomously Conduct Effective Experiments?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09934)
*Zhuoyang Liu,Ning Peng,Ming Shen,Zijun Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Causal-Discovery-Bench，一个可验证、可配置结构方程模型与资源约束的沙盒，用于在无语义线索条件下评测 LLM 智能体的序贯实验设计与因果发现能力；基于 3,802 个回合、13 个模型、7 大类 40 项指标的分析，发现智能体存在四级难度层级，且 94.5% 的错误源于实验设计而非因果推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在自主科研中不仅需要基于已有证据推理，还需设计信息量高的实验、分配资源、分析序贯观测并决定何时停止并下结论；然而这些能力缺乏系统、可验证的评测。现有基准多依赖领域语义线索，难以纯粹衡量实验设计与因果发现能力。

Method: 构建 Causal-Discovery-Bench 沙盒：使用可配置的结构方程模型生成可验证的因果结构，并施加资源约束；在无领域语义线索的环境中评测智能体的序贯实验设计与因果发现。实验覆盖 5 家厂商的 13 个模型、共 3,802 个回合，从 7 个指标家族、40 项指标分析智能体行为；并通过动作轨迹归因与消融实验区分实验设计错误与推断错误，同时考察放松资源约束、基础统计工具和高级工具的影响。

Result: 智能体表现呈现四级难度层级：单次实验设计、因果关系的序贯探索、兼顾成本与统计功效的资源感知实验、以及自主解决冲突证据。正确整理证据后的因果推断与自主实验中的因果发现之间存在显著性能差距；动作轨迹分析表明 94.5% 的错误归因于实验设计而非推断，消融实验进一步支持该结论。仅放松资源约束不能可靠解决序贯发现失败；基础统计工具可显著提升多个模型家族的表现，而高级工具在模型缺乏底层前置能力时收益有限。

Conclusion: LLM 智能体的自主因果发现瓶颈主要在实验设计而非证据推断；评测应显式覆盖序贯决策、资源分配与停止规则。提升基础统计与实验设计能力比直接引入高级工具更关键，资源约束放松也不是万能解。

Abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents get actively adopted for autonomous research, they must not only reason over existing evidence, but also design informative experiments, allocate resources, analyze sequential observations, and decide when to stop and make conclusions. Yet these capabilities remain poorly measured. We introduce Causal-Discovery-Bench (https://github.com/mshen1019/causal-discovery-bench), a verifiable sandbox with configurable structural equation models and resource constraints to evaluate sequential experimental design and causal discovery without domain-semantic cues. Across 3,802 episodes with 13 models from 5 vendors, we analyze agent behavior along 40 metrics in seven families. Agents' performance exhibits a four-level difficulty hierarchy spanning single-experiment design, sequential exploration of causal relationships, resource-aware experimentation balancing cost and statistical power, and autonomous resolution of conflicting evidence. We identify a substantial performance gap between causal inference from correctly curated evidence and navigating causal discovery through autonomous experimentation: Analyzing agents' action trajectories attributes 94.5% of their mistakes to experimental design rather than to inference, which is further consolidated with ablation studies. Relaxing resource constraints alone does not reliably resolve failures in sequential discovery. In contrast, basic statistical tools substantially improve performance across multiple model families, while advanced tools provide little additional benefit when models lack prerequisite lower-level capabilities.

</details>


### [225] [Fresh Enough to Decide: Age of Intelligence for Cost-Aware Model Synchronization in Dynamic IoT Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09935)
*Hui Wang,Seyyedali Hosseinalipour,Jacob Chakareski,Ming Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出"智能龄期"(AoInt)指标，以模型版本相对、客户端特定、动作效用失真的方式刻画模型陈旧程度，并将模型同步建模为"陈旧决策遗憾"与"刷新开销"的权衡，给出 KL 与参数两种同步策略及路径性理论保证，实验表明校准后的参数式策略在性能接近 KL 策略的同时将联合同步成本降低 6.15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源受限的物联网设备需缓存学习模型以支持实时决策，但模型频繁更新带来带宽、能量与服务开销。由于与决策相关的模型差异未必随时间增长而增大，传统以时间计龄的指标不再适用，因此需要重新定义"模型陈旧度"并设计高效的同步机制。

Method: 定义 AoInt 为模型版本相对、面向特定客户端、并基于动作效用失真的度量，将同步问题形式化为陈旧决策遗憾与刷新成本的权衡。提出两种策略：KL-AoIntSync 利用客户端特定的无标签探针累积输出分布变化；Param-AoIntSync 仅使用服务器广播的标量参数变化量，并对其进行校准。在固定客户端分布、动作集与效用函数下建立路径性（pathwise）保证。

Result: 数值结果表明，经校准的 Param-AoIntSync 相比 Instant-Parameters 策略将联合同步成本降低 6.15%，且性能与 KL-AoIntSync 相当；两种策略的理论保证得到验证。

Conclusion: 以决策效用失真定义的 AoInt 能更贴切地衡量模型对决策价值的老化程度；轻量级的参数感知同步在几乎不损失决策质量的前提下显著降低同步开销，适合带宽与能耗受限的 IoT 场景。

Abstract: Resource-constrained IoT devices cache learned models for real-time decisions, but frequent updates incur substantial bandwidth, energy, and service overhead. Because decision-relevant model differences need not grow with elapsed time, we define Age of Intelligence (AoInt) as a model-version-relative, client-specific, and action utility distortion, and formulate synchronization as a tradeoff between stale-decision regret and refresh cost. Furthermore, we develop Kullback-Leibler-aware AoInt Synchronization (KL-AoIntSync), which accumulates output-distribution changes using client-specific unlabeled probes, whereas Parameter-aware AoInt Synchronization (Param-AoIntSync) uses a server-broadcast scalar parameter change. Then, we establish pathwise guarantees with fixed client distributions, action sets, and utilities. The numerical results show that calibrated Param-AoIntSync reduces joint synchronization cost by 6.15% relative to an Instant-Parameters policy while performing comparably to KL-AoIntSync.

</details>


### [226] [Topological Deep Learning Challenge 2026: Bridging the Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10046)
*Guillermo Bernárdez,Lev Telyatnikov,Mathilde Papillon,Marco Montagna,Louisa Cornelis,Louis Van Langendonck,Antonio Purificato,Bruno Neri,David Leko,Donatella Genovese,Eleonora Grassucci,Jan-Willem Van Looy,Johan Mathe,Lucia Testa,Luka Benić,Melanie Weber,Olga Zaghen,Pavlo Vasylenko,Raffael Theiler,Scott Mahan,Gaurav Khanal,Valentina Sánchez,Dario Loi,Gabriele Onorato,Prasanna Devadiga,Taejin Paik,Anier Velasco Sotomayor,Jonas Müller,Aarav Gupta,Riyan Patel,Grold Otieno Mboya,Pushparaj Devadiga,Adam Gohain,Dominik Filipiak,Michael Banf,Alireza Mohammadian,Amirreza Akbari,Gabriel Chaviano Díaz,Marcos Chávez Mesa,Ankit Grover,Rémi Bourgerie,Alessio Comparini,Ankit Kumar,Mohammad Yusuf,Devesh Kaushal,Francesco Orsi,Ghazal Mostofi,Kolya Lettl,Salwa Khattami,Gabriel Franco,Yelizaveta Falkouskaya,Jorge Luiz Franco,Kajal Singla,Fernando David Espinosa Iñiguez,Raj Patil,Eric Dolores-Cuenca,Luigi Petti,Chenguang Xu,Stefano Blando,Christine Zeh,Lennart Bastian,Kaden Zheng,Vihan Tiwari,Sud Athreya,Hisataka Kajita,Hugo Micheron,Rémi Devaux,Antoine Jardin,Tegan Emerson,Olga Fink,Nina Miolane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍2026年拓扑深度学习挑战赛(TDL Challenge: Bridging the Gap)，首次在同一评估流水线中并排比较GNN与TNN：68份合格提交、34支队伍，覆盖图、单纯复形、胞腔复形、超图与组合域，并首次引入公开排行榜。结果显示两赛道的差异高度依赖任务，三角形计数上差距尤为显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前几届挑战赛主要扩充了拓扑深度学习(TDL)的建模与数据生态，但GNN与TNN之间缺乏在同一实验条件下的公平、可比评测。因此本届希望"弥合差距"，把两类模型纳入统一的评估流程与共享基准，从而客观刻画两者在不同任务上的能力差异。

Method: 在TAG-DS第二届会议上举办挑战赛，设置Track 1（GNN）与Track 2（TNN）两个赛道；要求参赛者在TopoBench中实现近期最先进架构，并在由GraphUniverse生成的合成基准上评测，该生成器可独立控制同质性(homophily)、平均度与度分布重尾性；同时首次采用公开排行榜记录并汇总提交结果。

Result: 共获得来自34支队伍的68份合格提交，覆盖graph、simplicial、cellular、hypergraph与combinatorial等域。分析表明两赛道差距强烈依赖任务：社区检测任务上平均准确率差距不大；而在三角形计数任务上，Track 1的平均误差是Track 2平均值的1.85倍；此外若干结构感知的GNN在三角形计数上甚至优于Track 2的平均水平。

Conclusion: GNN与TNN之间不存在普遍性优劣，性能差异主要由任务结构需求决定；高阶结构信息在三角形计数这类任务上带来明显收益，而部分结构增强GNN可弥补差距。统一的基准、可控的数据生成与公开排行榜为TDL社区提供了可复现的横向比较框架。

Abstract: This paper describes the 2026 edition of the Topological Deep Learning Challenge: Bridging the Gap, hosted at the second Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS) Conference. Where previous editions grew the modelling and data ecosystem of Topological Deep Learning (TDL), this edition set out to place Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Topological Neural Networks (TNNs) side by side under a single evaluation pipeline. Participants implemented recent state-of-the-art architectures in TopoBench, with Track 1 covering GNNs and Track 2 covering TNNs. They evaluated these implementations on shared synthetic benchmarks generated with GraphUniverse, which independently controls homophily, average degree and degree-distribution heaviness. The challenge yielded 68 qualifying submissions from 34 teams, spanning the graph, simplicial, cellular, hypergraph and combinatorial domains. For the first time, submissions were also tracked on a public leaderboard, which we summarize and analyze here. Our analysis finds that the differences between the submitted tracks are strongly task-dependent: the mean accuracy gap is modest on community detection, while on triangle counting the Track 1 mean error is 1.85 times the Track 2 mean. Several structurally informed GNNs also outperform the Track 2 mean on triangle counting.

</details>


### [227] [Selected-Risk Calibration for Feasibility at Returned Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10050)
*Raghav Thind,Youran Sun,Ling Liang,Haizhao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Selected-Risk Calibration (SRC) 框架：针对代理约束（surrogate constraint）优化中"代理可行≠真实可行"的问题，以优化器实际返回的决策为校准对象，保证在至少 1−δ 概率下所认证的每个 margin 的 selected risk（返回决策不可行的概率）不超过 γ。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 优化问题常用代理约束替代真实约束，但代理可行的决策未必满足真实约束；而现有基于随机输入覆盖的 split conformal 保证并不能约束"返回决策"的不可行风险，反馈协变量偏移下的似然比重加权在学习约束于返回解处激活时也不适用。

Method: SRC 直接以优化器在给定目标分布下返回的决策为校准样本，对学习到的约束进行校准，从而对 held-out 目标上认证的 margin 给出 selected risk ≤ γ 的高概率（1−δ）保证；并理论分析指出 split conformal 的随机输入覆盖保证无法界定 selected risk、似然比重加权在该场景失效。

Result: 实验显示：覆盖约 90% 随机输入的 conformal margin 实际仅覆盖低至 17% 的返回决策；SRC 认证的每个 margin 在未见目标上的违反率均低于目标值；在同等成本下，62 组对比中有 57 组 SRC 的不可行解数量不多于基线。

Conclusion: SRC 适用于任何"由代理模型选择决策、且可在部分实例上验证可行性"的场景，为代理约束优化的可行性提供了面向决策的风险保证。

Abstract: When an optimization problem uses a surrogate constraint, a decision that is feasible for the surrogate need not be feasible for the true constraint. We propose Selected-Risk Calibration (SRC), a framework that calibrates a learned constraint against the optimizer's returned decisions for objectives drawn from a given distribution. SRC guarantees that, with probability at least $1-δ$, every margin it certifies on held-out objectives has selected risk, the probability that the returned decision is infeasible, of at most $γ$. We also show that the random-input coverage guarantee of split conformal prediction does not bound the selected risk, and that likelihood-ratio reweighting for feedback covariate shift does not apply when the learned constraint is active at the returned decision. Our experiments show that a conformal margin covering about $90\%$ of random inputs covered as few as $17\%$ of the returned decisions, and every certified margin had a violation rate below its target on unseen objectives. Moreover, at equal cost, SRC's correction had fewer or equal infeasible solutions to the baselines in 57 of 62 comparisons. The SRC framework applies to any setting in which a surrogate model chooses a decision whose feasibility can be verified for a sample of instances.

</details>


### [228] [All roads lead to Markov kernel networks: A representation theorem for discretization-stable learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10051)
*S David Mis,Trevor Teolis,Ivan Dokmanić,Matti Lassas,Maarten V. de Hoop*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出"一致离散化稳定性"的定量刻画，并证明任何满足该性质的算子都可精确表示为"稳定 Markov 核网络"，从而统一 transformer、FNO、Flowers 等架构并给出可系统设计的架构空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算子学习需要近似函数到函数的映射，并要求在输入离散化改变时保持稳定（离散化不变性）。作者希望把这一常被定性讨论的性质做成可量化的判据，并据此回答"什么样的架构本质上保证了稳定性、如何系统地设计新架构"这一问题。

Method: 将输入函数及其离散化统一表示为概率测度，用测度间的 Wasserstein 距离给出输出变化与输入扰动之间的 Hölder 型界，定义"一致离散化稳定性"；随后建立表示定理，证明所有一致离散化稳定算子均可精确写成稳定 Markov 核网络（由"读核"等组件构成），并把读核刻画为正则化变分问题的解，通过选择代价函数与正则项来对应不同架构。

Result: 得到表示定理：一致离散化稳定算子 ⇔ 稳定 Markov 核网络；该框架作为 transformer、FNO、Flowers 及其混合体的联合推广。变分形式下特定代价与正则项可分别恢复 transformer、FNO、Flowers 的核，并给出保证一致离散化稳定性的充分条件；从而把架构设计转化为"参数化核网络的哪一部分、如何参数化"的选择问题。

Conclusion: 论文为离散化稳定的算子学习提供了一个统一的表示与设计空间，并把架构创新系统化为核的变分建模问题，兼顾理论保证与工程可设计性。

Abstract: Operator learning seeks to approximate function-to-function maps in a way that remains stable when the input discretization changes, a property sometimes called "discretization invariance". We consider a quantitative refinement of this idea, called $\textit{uniform discretization stability}$, which builds on a common representation of input functions and their discretizations as probability measures and provides a Hölder bound relating output changes to the Wasserstein distance between these measures. Our main result is a representation theorem showing all uniformly discretization stable operators can be written exactly as a $\textit{stable Markov kernel network}$---an abstract architecture that is a joint generalization of transformers, Fourier neural operators (FNO), Flowers, and other successful learned operators. Our representation theorem characterizes a design space for discretization-stable operator learning; designing new architectures becomes a question of which parts of a Markov kernel network to parameterize, and how. We further show that the read kernels of these networks can be realized as solutions of regularized variational problems, with particular choices of costs and regularizers recovering the kernels of transformers, FNO, Flowers, their hybrids, and beyond. This variational formulation provides a systematic approach to architecture design, together with sufficient conditions for uniform discretization stability.

</details>


### [229] [fNIRSAtlas: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10082)
*Kalle Mäkelä,Tuukka Ruotsalo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文发布 fNIRSAtlas——迄今最大的开放 fNIRS 分类基准，含 19 个公开数据集、23 个任务，提供全自动流程与跨被试/被试内标准评测，并系统评测多类基线模型，发现深度学习方法在有限数据上验证后往往难以泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: fNIRS 在脑机接口与认知状态解码中颇具潜力，但机器学习研究受限于数据集规模小且彼此孤立、评测协议不统一，导致方法之间难以公平比较、进展难以累积。

Method: 构建 fNIRSAtlas 基准：(1) 整合 19 个公开数据集合共 23 个分类任务，覆盖运动执行、运动想象、心算、工作记忆、情绪识别等范式；(2) 提供从原始数据到评测的全自动流水线；(3) 定义跨被试与被试内两类标准化基准任务，保证可复现对比；(4) 在基准上评测来自 fNIRS、相关神经影像及时间序列机器学习文献的多种基线模型。

Result: 各任务性能差异显著；在有限数据上被验证有效的方法（尤其是深度学习方法）往往无法在其原评测设置之外泛化。

Conclusion: fNIRSAtlas 作为一个可扩展、开放、可复现的基准，有助于推动 fNIRS 机器学习更稳健、更具累积性的研究进展，代码与数据已公开。

Abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for brain-computer interfaces and cognitive state decoding, but progress in machine learning for fNIRS has been limited by small, isolated datasets and inconsistent evaluation protocols. We introduce fNIRSAtlas, the largest open benchmark for fNIRS classification to date, comprising 23 classification tasks from 19 public data collections, spanning diverse experimental paradigms, including motor execution, motor imagery, mental arithmetic, working memory, and emotion recognition. fNIRSAtlas provides a fully automated pipeline from raw data to evaluation and defines standardized benchmark tasks for both cross-subject and within-subject classification, ensuring reproducible comparison of methods. We evaluate a variety of baseline models from fNIRS and related neuroimaging and time-series machine learning literature on the benchmark. Our results demonstrate that performance varies substantially across tasks and that methods validated on limited data -- especially deep learning approaches -- often fail to generalize beyond their original evaluation. fNIRSAtlas serves as an extensible, open, and reproducible benchmark to support more robust and cumulative progress in machine learning for fNIRS data. Our code and data can be found at https://fnirsatlas.github.io.

</details>


### [230] [Transferring local rib responses to new component geometries in sheet forming with a graph-based Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10086)
*Yingxue Zhao,Haoran Li,Haosu Zhou,Tobias Pfaff,Nan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出将局部特征效应与全局几何部分解耦，并用迁移学习实现少样本、跨几何的板金成形代理建模；所提R-BiLoGo在热冲压角部构件侧壁加强筋任务上以更少目标仿真取得较低误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 板金构件由全局几何与局部特征共同决定材料流动；若代理模型学习所有组合需大量训练数据，但同一类局部特征常复用于多种全局几何，因此存在解耦与迁移的潜力。

Method: 部分解耦局部特征与全局几何：先在单一全局几何上学习局部特征效应，再通过迁移学习推广到其他全局几何。提出基线条件残差代理模型R-BiLoGo，用于热冲压角部构件侧壁加强筋；输入为基线响应与加强筋引入的几何扰动，输出为相对基线的位移和减薄变化。

Result: 在源几何及3个目标几何中的2个上，R-BiLoGo误差低于层次图模型和Transolver类模型。22个目标几何中，约半数目标用20次目标仿真迁移即可达到或优于80次从零训练；同样80次目标仿真下，迁移使95%目标误差下降。用4个无参数几何描述子和4个角部子类的受控变化分析发现：迁移收益随源-目标表面距离和高曲率变化增大而下降，对浅于源的目标也下降；其他角部类型中趋势类似但幅度不同。

Conclusion: 局部特征与全局几何的部分解耦加迁移学习可显著降低跨几何代理建模的数据需求；R-BiLoGo验证了基线残差建模的有效性，几何描述子可解释迁移收益，为多几何板金成形快速预测提供数据高效方案。

Abstract: Sheet metal components often consist of a global geometry, such as the corner radii and forming depth of a corner component, and local features added to it. During forming, both affect material flow. A surrogate learning all their combinations may need large training data. However, the same local feature type is often used on many global geometries. This study therefore partly decouples local features from the global geometry. The local-feature effect is first learned on one global geometry, needing fewer simulations than learning all combinations, then transferred to other global geometries via transfer learning, which can need fewer target simulations than training from scratch. A baseline-conditioned residual surrogate, R-BiLoGo, is proposed for ribs on the side walls of hot-stamped corner components. Its inputs are the baseline response and the geometric perturbation introduced by the ribs. Its outputs are the changes in displacement and thinning from the baseline. R-BiLoGo gave lower errors than a hierarchical graph-based model and a Transolver-based model on the source geometry, and on two of three selected target geometries after transfer. Across the 22 target geometries, transfer learning with 20 target simulations gave errors similar to or lower than training from scratch with 80 target simulations for about half of the targets. With the same 80 target simulations, transfer learning reduced errors for 95% of targets. The effect of the global geometry on transfer was studied with four parameter-free geometric descriptors and controlled variations across 4 corner subclasses. The benefit of transfer decreased with increasing surface distance and high-curvature change between source and target, and for targets shallower than the source. These trends were also seen in other corner types with a different magnitude.

</details>


### [231] [Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10096)
*Weizhong Huang,Jinchao Zhang,Xiawu Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CoMixKV：面向多智能体LLM系统的跨智能体协同混合精度KV缓存量化框架，在共享显存预算下联合分配各智能体各层位宽，兼顾精度与显存效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统通过协作解决复杂任务，但各智能体同时驻留的KV缓存不断增长，形成显存瓶颈。若将单模型量化策略独立套用于各智能体，会忽略不同智能体对精度的差异化需求，可能损害整体协作推理质量，因此需要一种统一协调的精度分配方案。

Method: 提出CoMixKV，将在线敏感度估计与共享预算下的智能体-层联合位宽分配相结合。敏感度估计器基于局部注意力误差上界，利用最近的query、key、value推导敏感度，无需校准数据、试量化或额外前向。共享控制器结合敏感度分数、剩余可量化容量与字节级存储成本，最小化总估计误差，并在智能体启动/结束及新观测到来时刷新分配。所选位宽仅作用于新量化块，近期状态保持原生精度，已量化块不变。

Result: 在4个基准、3个LLM主干、平均2/3/4比特设置下，CoMixKV相对评测的量化基线表现强劲。Gemma-4-31B-it在平均3比特下达到68.35%平均准确率，超最强量化基线0.59%。Qwen3-32B上峰值KV缓存显存降低32.08%，相对FullKV实现1.38倍推理加速。

Conclusion: CoMixKV是首个在共享显存预算下跨同时驻留智能体缓存联合分配精度的混合精度KV缓存量化框架，在保持协作推理精度的同时有效降低显存占用并提升推理速度，为多智能体LLM系统的显存瓶颈提供了协同化解决思路。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems solve complex tasks through collaboration, but their growing, simultaneously resident key-value (KV) caches create a memory bottleneck. Applying single-model quantization policies independently ignores differences in agents' precision needs, potentially degrading collective reasoning. We introduce Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization (CoMixKV), which combines online sensitivity estimation with joint agent-layer bit-width allocation under a shared memory budget. To our knowledge, CoMixKV is the first mixed-precision KV-cache quantization framework to jointly allocate precision across simultaneously resident agent caches under such a budget. The estimator derives sensitivity from a local attention-error bound using recent queries, keys, and values, without calibration data, trial quantization, or additional model passes. A shared controller combines these scores with remaining quantizable capacity and byte-level storage costs to minimize total estimated error. Allocations are refreshed as agents start or finish and new observations become available. Selected widths apply only to newly quantized blocks; recent states retain native precision and previously quantized blocks remain unchanged. Across four benchmarks and three LLM backbones at average 2-bit, 3-bit, and 4-bit settings, CoMixKV achieves strong accuracy against the evaluated quantization baselines. At the average 3-bit setting on Gemma-4-31B-it, it achieves 68.35% average accuracy, exceeding the strongest quantized baseline by 0.59%. On Qwen3-32B, it reduces peak KV-cache memory by 32.08% and achieves a 1.38x inference speedup over FullKV.

</details>


### [232] [TrialJev: Open-Weight Single Pass Eligibility Scoring for Patient Trial Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10145)
*Omar Ibrahim,Grant Hamblin,Benjamin Haibe-Kains*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TrialJev 是一个开源的临床试验资格打分器，基于 LoRA 微调的 Qwen 模型加指针头，用单次前向传播对自然语言选项打分而无需自回归解码；在 TREC 2022 合成患者上准确率约 81%，优于同数据微调的生成式判定模型，速度快 2.45–2.70 倍，并可在单卡本地运行以保护患者数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床试验初筛需评估大量"患者-试验"配对以排出需详细审核的候选，但患者记录常受共享限制，无法上传至外部模型 API；同时生成式判定需要逐 token 解码，推理开销大，难以支撑大规模初筛。

Method: 提出 TrialJev：采用 LoRA 适配的 Qwen 模型并加装指针头（pointer head），在单次前向传播中直接为自然语言答案选项打分，完全跳过自回归解码。模型在 TREC Clinical Trials 2021 上训练，在 50 位未见过的 TREC 2022 合成患者构成的 6,975 个"符合/排除"配对上评测；与同数据微调、以生成方式输出判定的 LLM 对比，并在 batch=1 匹配条件下测速；另做 A/B-logit 消融以区分"免解码"与"指针头"各自的贡献；并与专有的 Jev API 在统一由开发集拟合的决策校正下比较。

Result: TrialJev 达到 80.97%（Qwen3.5-27B）与 81.84%（Qwen3.8-27B）准确率，生成式微调 LLM 分别为 79.87% 与 79.93%；匹配 batch=1 时生成判定耗时是 TrialJev 单次推理的 2.45–2.70 倍（9B–27B）。经统一决策校正后两个 27B 模型为 80.99% 与 81.88%，专有 Jev API 为 81.28%，配对置信区间包含零。27B 模型单卡本地推理每对约 178 ms，患者文本不出本地。消融显示效率优势主要来自"避免解码"而非指针头本身。

Conclusion: TrialJev 定位于候选试验的初筛排序，与可解释模型及人工临床审核互补而非替代。局限在于仅用合成患者评测、计时依赖具体实现、临床有效性尚未验证。作者已在 Hugging Face 开源适配器、指针头与模型卡。

Abstract: Clinical trial screening requires assessing large numbers of patient-trial pairs to prioritize candidates for detailed eligibility review, often under restrictions on sharing patient records. We introduce TrialJev, an open-weight eligibility scorer that uses LoRA-adapted Qwen models and a pointer head to score natural-language answer options in a single forward pass, without autoregressive decoding. Trained on TREC Clinical Trials 2021 and evaluated on 6,975 eligible-or-excluded pairs from 50 unseen TREC 2022 synthetic patients, TrialJev achieves 80.97% (Qwen3.5-27B) and 81.84% (Qwen3.8-27B) accuracy, compared with 79.87% and 79.93% for LLMs fine-tuned on the same data to generate verdicts. In matched batch-1 measurements, verdict generation takes 2.45-2.70 times as long as the one-pass inference of TrialJev at 9B-27B. Under a common development-fitted decision correction, the two 27B TrialJev models reach 80.99% and 81.88% accuracy, compared with 81.28% for the proprietary hosted Jev API; paired confidence intervals include zero. TrialJev runs locally on a single GPU, requiring approximately 178 ms per pair at 27B, without transmitting patient text to an external model API. An A/B-logit ablation shows that avoiding decoding, rather than the pointer head alone, accounts for the measured efficiency advantage. TrialJev is intended for first-pass prioritization of candidate trials, complementing rather than replacing explanatory models and clinical review. Evaluation is limited to synthetic patients and implementation-specific timing, and clinical use has not been validated. Adapters, pointer heads, and model cards are released on Hugging Face.

</details>


### [233] [Learning Across Heterogeneous Feature Spaces with Group Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10153)
*Xenia Konti,Arjun Tschand,Chuan Hong,Nicoleta J. Economou-Zavlanos,Michael M. Zavlanos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向异质特征空间的分组鲁棒学习框架：不再按最高损失加权，而是优化最差组的“超额损失”，并用组专属编码器映射到共享隐空间、以可学习高斯锚点按结局聚类，从而在特征空间部分或完全不相交时实现跨组知识迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床中患者接受不同检查组合，模型需在异质甚至完全不相交的特征空间上保持准确。现有方法通常提高高损失患者权重，但高损失可能源于特征本身信息有限，损失无法继续下降；当特征空间完全不相交时，现有方法退化为各组独立建模，无法进行知识迁移。

Method: 将共享同一特征空间的患者视为一个组，提出优化最差组的超额损失，即组损失与其可达最优估计之间的差距，以避免把“特征无信息”误判为“模型不公”。同时为各组设置组专属编码器，将样本映射到共享隐空间，并在其中使用可学习高斯锚点按结局对患者进行聚类，从而促进组间协作与知识共享。

Result: 在表格和影像医学数据集上，包括特征空间完全不相交的设置，该框架在组间最优损失不同或单组难以训练良好模型时优于现有最先进方法；最差组损失最多降低79%，超额损失最多降低95%，参数量最多减少18倍。

Conclusion: 面向异质特征空间的鲁棒学习应关注相对于各组可达最优的超额损失，而非单纯加权高损失样本；结合组专属编码器与共享隐空间中的高斯锚点，可在特征空间不相交时仍实现有效的跨组知识迁移，并显著改善最差组性能与参数效率。

Abstract: In clinical applications, patients undergo different combinations of tests, and machine learning models must therefore ensure accurate predictions across heterogeneous feature spaces. Current approaches upweight the patients with the highest loss, without accounting for the limited predictive information in their features preventing their loss from going any lower. Moreover, when patients' feature spaces are fully disjoint, current methods reduce to training independent models, preventing knowledge transfer across them. We propose a framework for group robust learning across heterogeneous feature spaces, where groups are patients sharing a feature space. Since a high loss may simply reflect uninformative features, we instead optimize for worst-group excess loss, the gap between a group's loss and an estimate of its achievable optimum. To allow collaboration between groups, we use group-specific encoders mapping into a shared latent space in which learnable Gaussian anchors cluster patients by outcome. On tabular and imaging medical datasets, including fully disjoint feature settings, our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods when groups differ in their optimal losses or cannot train a good model on their own, reducing worst-group loss by up to 79% and excess loss by up to 95% with up to 18$\times$ fewer parameters.

</details>


### [234] [Projected Neural Additive Models as Universal Approximators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10186)
*Nhon N. Phan,Qiang Du,John D. Clayton,WaiChing Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出投影神经可加模型（PNAMs）的理论基础：通过可学习线性变换引入跨变量交互，证明其通用逼近性、精确多项式表示所需最少投影数与最优岭函数逼近速率，并用结构化稀疏与符号回归恢复可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经可加模型（NAM）可解释性强但加性结构刚性、表达力不足；多层感知机（MLP）具有通用逼近能力却缺乏透明性。作者希望兼顾表达力与可解释性，弥补NAM无法建模变量间交互的理论缺陷。

Method: 在NAM基础上引入可学习线性变换 T，将输入投影到多个方向后分别建模，形成PNAM；从理论上分析其跨导数、通用逼近能力、精确多项式表示所需最少投影数及 Cs 函数的逼近速率；同时采用结构化稀疏正则和事后符号回归，实现全局输入排序、参数剪枝及学习基到紧凑解析表达式的转换。

Result: 证明标准NAM因跨导数恒为零，连 χ1χ2 都无法逼近；PNAM是通用逼近器，并刻画精确多项式表示所需的最少投影数；给出 O(M^{-s/(N-1)}) 的逼近速率，该速率对岭函数逼近已知最优。在纽结理论不变量、MNIST和相场断裂力学实验中，PNAM达到或超过同类架构精度，并能发现显著特征、生成参数量少几个数量级的符号模型。

Conclusion: PNAM通过低维可学习投影有效恢复跨变量交互表达能力，同时借助稀疏化与符号回归保持可解释性，为可解释且高表达力的神经网络建模提供了理论与实证支持。

Abstract: Neural additive models (NAMs) offer interpretability but lack expressivity due to their rigid additive structure, whereas multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) achieve universal approximation at the cost of transparency. We establish the first theoretical foundation for projected neural additive models (PNAMs), which augment NAMs with a learnable linear transformation $\boldsymbol{T}$ to capture cross-variable interactions. While standard NAMs cannot approximate even the simplest interaction term $χ_1 χ_2$ because their cross-derivatives are identically zero, we prove that PNAMs are universal approximators and characterize the minimum number of projections required for exact polynomial representation. Furthermore, we derive an approximation rate of $\mathcal{O}(M^{-s / (N - 1)})$ for $\mathcal{C}^s$ functions (i.e., functions with $s$ continuous derivatives), where $M$ denotes the number of projections and $N$ the input dimension; this rate is known to be optimal for ridge function approximation. To recover interpretability from the projected inputs, we introduce structured sparsity regularizers and post-hoc symbolic regression techniques that enable global input ranking, parameter pruning, and the conversion of learned bases into compact analytical expressions. Experiments on knot theory invariants, MNIST, and phase field fracture mechanics demonstrate that PNAMs match or surpass similar architectures in accuracy while discovering salient features and yielding symbolic models with orders of magnitude fewer parameters.

</details>


### [235] [Fast Accurate Quantum Monte Carlo without Metropolis Adjustment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10187)
*Reuben Cohn-Gordon,Gabriel Pescia,Sumner N. Hearth,Jakob Robnik,Uroš Seljak,Peter Lunts*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将计算统计中“未调整”HMC核（不做Metropolis-Hastings校正）引入量子蒙特卡洛，在自旋-费米子量子相变模型上验证其比调整型HMC更高效且结果仍准确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子系统性质可写成概率分布的期望值，可用QMC/MCMC估计；HMC因利用哈密顿动力学而广泛使用。传统做法需用Metropolis-Hastings校正HMC核以保证无偏收敛，但计算统计领域近期结果表明未调整HMC（UHMC）可在保持相对有限样本方差误差很小的渐近偏差下显著更高效。作者希望检验该思路在QMC场景（尤其是高维、难采样的量子模型）中是否成立。

Method: 以量子蒙特卡洛框架下的高维“自旋-费米子”（spin-fermion）量子相变模型为测试对象，对比未调整HMC核与标准MH调整型HMC核的采样性能，以“每次梯度调用的有效样本量（ESS per gradient call）”作为核心效率指标，并同时检查估计结果的准确性（偏差是否可忽略）。

Result: 在该自旋-费米子模型上，未调整HMC在每次梯度调用的有效样本量上优于调整型HMC，同时估计结果保持准确，表明其引入的渐近偏差相对于有限样本方差误差可忽略。

Conclusion: 未调整HMC可安全有效地用于QMC，尤其适用于高维、计算昂贵的量子多体模型；在可接受的微小渐近偏差下换取更高采样效率，为凝聚态与高能物理中的QMC实践提供了有价值的替代方案。

Abstract: In quantum systems, physical quantities of interest can be expressed as expectation values of a probability distribution, which allows their estimation by Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods. This approach, an instance of Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC), plays a central role in obtaining predictions of system properties relevant to condensed matter and high energy physics. The use of Hamiltonian dynamics to design a Markov kernel, known as Hybrid or Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC), is widespread in quantum applications. In this context, it is standard to use an HMC kernel that is ``adjusted'' with the Metropolis-Hastings (MH) criterion, so that estimates of expectations converge to their true value in the limit of infinite sample size. However, recent work in computational statistics suggests that an \emph{unadjusted} HMC kernel can be significantly more efficient, while safely maintaining an asymptotic bias which is small relative to the error arising from the variance of the finite sample size. We adapt this approach to the QMC setting, focusing on a challenging and high-dimensional \emph{spin-fermion} model of a quantum phase transition. We find that unadjusted methods outperform adjusted HMC in terms of effective sample size per gradient call, while retaining accurate results.

</details>


### [236] [BiMuon: A Geometry-Aware Stochastic Bilevel Optimization Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10188)
*Zhen Qin,Zhiyao Zhang,Yingbin Liang,Jia Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 BiMuon：将隐式超梯度估计与 Muon 风格正交化矩阵更新结合，用于随机双层优化，兼顾矩阵结构并缓解下层曲率导致的上层谱失衡；进一步给出分块对角近似与相对步长分配规则，并具 O(ε^{-4}) 迭代复杂度保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有随机双层优化方法常把矩阵梯度展平为向量处理，忽略神经网络中普遍的矩阵结构；同时下层问题曲率会使上层几何出现显著谱失衡，限制优化效果。因此需要一种几何感知的双层优化方法。

Method: 提出 BiMuon：在上层采用 Muon 风格的正交化矩阵更新，并结合双层优化中的隐式超梯度估计。针对多矩阵参数模型，进一步研究分块对角矩阵近似，并基于上层进展与分块下层敏感性推导相对步长分配规则。

Result: BiMuon 是首个采用 Muon 风格正交化矩阵更新的随机双层优化方法，并具有 O(ε^{-4}) 的迭代复杂度，匹配 Muon 类矩阵参数化方法的最佳已知速率。在表示学习和分块双层优化任务上的实验为该方法的有效性提供了经验支持。

Conclusion: BiMuon 通过矩阵感知的上层正交化更新与隐式超梯度估计，为随机双层优化提供了一种兼顾理论复杂度与计算/并行效率的新方案；分块近似和步长分配规则增强了多矩阵参数场景下的实用性。

Abstract: Stochastic bilevel optimization provides a general framework for many machine learning applications, such as hyperparameter learning, data reweighting, language model alignment, and actor-critic reinforcement learning. However, most existing bilevel optimization methods treat matrix-valued gradients as flattened vectors and perform optimization in the resulting vectorized space, ignoring the matrix structures common in modern neural networks. Moreover, the lower-level (LL) problem curvature can induce significant spectral imbalance in the upper-level (UL) geometry. Such limitations of existing bilevel optimization methods motivate us to develop BiMuon, a geometry-aware stochastic bilevel optimization method that integrates implicit hypergradient estimation in bilevel optimization with Muon-style orthogonalized updates at the UL. To our knowledge, BiMuon is the first stochastic BLO method with Muon-style orthogonalized matrix updates and an $O(ε^{-4})$ iteration-complexity guarantee, matching the best-known rates achieved by Muon-type methods based on matrix parameterizations. To improve computational and parallel efficiency for models with multiple matrix parameters, we further study BiMuon for blockwise diagonal matrix approximation and derive a relative stepsize allocation rule based on UL progress and blockwise LL sensitivity. We evaluate BiMuon on representation learning and blockwise bilevel optimization, providing empirical support for our methods.

</details>


### [237] [BO-Arena: An Evolving Benchmark for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10198)
*Colin Doumont,Thomas Christie,Henry Moss,Philipp Hennig*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 高维贝叶斯优化（HDBO）领域缺乏可靠统一的基准测试，现有论文常遗漏最强基线或使用错误实现；作者提出可扩展的标准化实现包 BO-Arena，并据此发现简单因素即可驱动性能，进而提出无需复杂 GP 近似的新算法，并质疑复杂方法是否真的优于简单 GP 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HDBO 新方法层出不穷，但“当前最优方法”难以判断。作者怀疑该领域基准测试实践存在系统性问题：部分工作未与最强基线比较，甚至包含关键方法的错误实现，而缺少共享参考实现使同行评审难以发现这些错误。

Method: 作者系统审视 HDBO 的基准测试实践，提出 BO-Arena：一个持续维护、可扩展、提供最先进算法规范实现的软件包，用于新方法开发和严格基准测试；并基于 BO-Arena 开展实验分析，据此设计新算法。

Result: 作者发现 HDBO 性能的主要驱动因素比此前认为的更简单；所提新算法在观测较多的任务上可与当前最优方法竞争，且不依赖近期方法中复杂的 GP 近似。

Conclusion: 当前证据不足以证明更复杂的方法显著优于简单高斯过程基线；领域需要标准化实现与更严谨的基准测试来可靠判断方法优劣。

Abstract: High-dimensional Bayesian optimisation (HDBO) is an increasingly crowded field with new methods proposed at every major conference, making it ever harder to answer a deceptively simple question: "Which method is currently state-of-the-art?" In this paper, we question the efficacy of benchmarking practices in the field, and find them to be systematically ineffective: multiple published works fail to benchmark against the strongest available baselines, or even include incorrect implementations of key methods. Without a shared reference implementation, such errors are difficult to detect during peer review. We therefore introduce BO-Arena, an actively maintained and extensible package providing canonical implementations of state-of-the-art algorithms, which allows researchers to develop new methods and benchmark them rigorously. Using BO-Arena, we find that what currently drives performance in HDBO is even simpler than previously thought. We use these insights to propose a new algorithm which is competitive with the state of the art on problems with many observations, without resorting to the complex GP approximations used in recent methods. Finally, we question whether there is currently sufficient evidence that any more complex method outperforms a simple Gaussian process baseline for HDBO.

</details>


### [238] [Semiprime Factorization with Discrete Diffusion and Beam Search: Scaling Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10202)
*Brendan O Donoghue,Nenad Tomasev,Volodymyr Mnih,Timothy Nguyen,Dalin Guo,Arun Nair,Kenneth Yang,Alexandre Frechette,Jasper Xian,Jean Tarbouriech,Pavel Tyletski,Ingrid von Glehn,Johannes Bausch,Demis Hassabis,Raia Hadsell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用离散去噪扩散训练的 Transformer 搭配测试时引导束搜索，可从数据中直接学习半素数分解，成功分解 68 位整数（此前最好 56 位），并给出以问题规模为主导的经验缩放律，指出其对密码安全无实际威胁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索不含任何数论先验、纯数据驱动的学习式半素数分解能走多远，并厘清该类方法的算力扩展规律，判断其是否对现有密码体系构成风险。

Method: 以离散去噪扩散目标训练 Transformer，推理阶段采用带引导的测试时束搜索解码出因子候选；扩散模型充当生成先验，用于筛出有希望的候选因子，再由精确验证或格基后处理完成最终分解；同时拟合近似质量与训练数据量、模型规模、测试时计算量之间的经验缩放律。

Result: 在 68 位半素数上成功分解，较此前 56 位的最好结果显著提升；缩放分析显示，与语言任务不同，问题规模（比特长度）是缩放行为的主导因素，在留出测试集上达到固定精度所需算力随比特长度指数增长，故分解密码学相关规模整数的预期成本仍不可承受。

Conclusion: 学习式方法可在无数论先验条件下把半素数分解的记录推进到 68 位，但效率仍低于经典算法且算力需求随位数指数上升，因此该结果不构成对密码安全的威胁，更多体现为生成式先验与搜索式后处理的组合潜力。

Abstract: We demonstrate that transformer architectures trained with discrete denoising diffusion and decoded via guided test-time beam search can learn to recover the prime factors of semiprime integers directly from data. Our approach establishes a new frontier for learning-based semiprime factorization, successfully factoring 68-bit integers-a substantial advance over the prior 56-bit state of the art. While computationally less efficient than classical factoring algorithms, our model requires no domain-specific number-theoretic priors and learns purely from training examples. In practice, the diffusion model acts as a generative prior, identifying promising factor candidates where exact verification or lattice-based post-processing can complete the factorization. Furthermore, we derive empirical scaling laws relating approximation quality to training data volume, model size, and test-time computation. In contrast to language, problem size is the key driver of scaling behavior. Achieving a fixed accuracy on a held-out test set requires compute that scales exponentially with bit length. Consequently, our findings pose no threat to security, as the projected compute cost required to factorize cryptographically relevant integers remains prohibitive.

</details>


### [239] [DisMUSE: An Efficient Distributed Singular-Spectrum-Based Optimization Approach with Theoretical Convergence Guarantee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10212)
*Zhen Qin,Zhiyao Zhang,Yingbin Liang,Jia Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出 DisMUSE——面向数据中心与联邦场景的高效分布式奇异谱（SSB）优化框架，以 Muon 风格精确正交化动量作为谱更新，结合递归方差缩减动量估计，达到 O((KT)^{-1/3}) 收敛率，并进一步分析有限 Newton–Schulz 迭代与低秩动量传输两种扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于奇异谱的优化器能保留梯度的矩阵结构、实现几何感知优化，但现有方法大多为集中式，难以用于大规模并行分布式学习；分布式 SSB 优化仍处早期，收敛保证与通信效率均为开放问题。

Method: 提出 DisMUSE 分布式 SSB 优化框架：采用 Muon 式精确正交化动量作为谱更新，并集成递归方差缩减动量估计器；在此基础上研究两个扩展：(1) 仅进行有限步 Newton–Schulz（NS）迭代的近似实现，(2) 基于低秩（LR）动量传输的通信高效变体，并量化其误差。

Result: 达到 O((KT)^{-1/3}) 的收敛率（K 为节点数，T 为每节点本地迭代数），与方差缩减非凸分布式优化的已知最优速率一致；有限 NS 迭代版本在一致归一化支撑谱条件下以相差一个乘性因子的方式保持同阶收敛；低秩动量传输变体给出了其对稳定性界（stationarity bound）引入误差的刻画，明确了精度与通信开销之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 该工作为分布式奇异谱优化提供了带收敛保证且兼顾通信效率的统一框架，并系统刻画了近似正交化与压缩通信带来的性能折衷，为大规模并行与联邦场景下的几何感知优化奠定理论与方法基础。

Abstract: In recent years, singular-spectrum-based optimizers have attracted increasing attention due to their ability to preserve the matrix structure of neural network gradients, thereby enabling geometry-aware optimization. However, most singular-spectrum-based (SSB) approaches remain centralized, limiting their use in distributed learning infrastructures that exploit massive parallelism. Distributed SSB optimization is still at an early stage, with open questions about convergence guarantees and communication efficiency. To fill this gap, we propose the Distributed Momentum-based Spectral Estimator (DisMUSE), an efficient distributed SSB optimization framework for both data-center and federated settings. Using Muon-style exact orthogonalized momentum as the spectral update, DisMUSE integrates a recursive variance-reduced momentum estimator and achieves an $O((KT)^{-1/3})$ convergence rate, where $K$ and $T$ denote the number of nodes and local iterations per node, respectively. This rate matches the best-known rates for variance-reduced nonconvex distributed optimization. Building on this variance-reduced framework, we study two extensions. First, our DisMUSE method with finite Newton-Schulz (NS) iterations preserves the same convergence order under a uniform normalized support-spectrum condition, up to a multiplicative factor. Second, we develop a communication-efficient variant based on low-rank (LR) momentum transmission and quantify the error it introduces to the stationarity bound, characterizing the trade-off between accuracy and communication cost.

</details>


### [240] [Rethinking How to Leverage Cheap Physics for Data-Efficient Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10217)
*Shuo Zhang,Senwei Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对神经算子监督训练标注（数值解）昂贵的问题，作者发现用物理信息主动挑选标注输入相比随机采样并无稳定优势，转而提出用物理信息改进初始化：PI-Init 先用物理损失在无标注输入上预训练神经算子，再进行监督微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子训练需要昂贵的数值模拟生成输入-解配对，而PDE输入与方程本身是廉价的物理信息。作者希望弄清如何用这些廉价物理信息减少对标注解的需求，并检验"用物理挑选待标注输入"这一直观思路是否有效。

Method: 先通过采集（acquisition）实验检验物理引导的样本选择策略，发现其相对随机采样无一致优势；据此提出PI-Init：在无标注输入上用物理信息损失（PDE残差等）预训练神经算子，保留所得参数作为监督微调的初始化；并给出线性化分析说明预训练为何能降低有限标注无法纠正的初始化误差。

Result: 在多种PDE基准与多种神经算子架构上，PI-Init在预测精度、分布外泛化与标签效率上均有提升。代表性结果：相同标签预算下误差最多降低62.7%；在标签减少90%的情况下取得与纯监督训练相当或更好的精度。

Conclusion: 廉价物理信息更适合用于改进神经算子的参数初始化，而非用于挑选标注样本；PI-Init简单有效，可显著提升标签效率与泛化性，为减少昂贵数值标注提供可行路径。

Abstract: Neural operators learn mappings from PDE inputs, such as initial conditions and coefficient fields, to the corresponding solutions. Once trained, they can rapidly predict solutions for new inputs. However, obtaining input-solution pairs for supervised training often requires expensive numerical simulations, whereas PDE inputs and governing equations provide inexpensive physical information.
