This raises a question: how can cheap physical information reduce the need for labeled solutions? A natural approach is to use physics to select inputs for labeling, but our acquisition experiments show no consistent advantage over random sampling. This observation motivates exploring an alternative: using cheap physics to improve neural operator initialization before supervised training. We propose Physics-Informed Initialization (PI-Init), a simple yet effective method that pretrains neural operators on unlabeled inputs using physics-informed losses and retains the learned parameters for supervised fine-tuning on the labeled dataset. A linearized analysis shows that pretraining can improve downstream prediction accuracy by reducing initialization errors that limited labeled data cannot effectively correct. Experiments across diverse PDE benchmarks and neural operator architectures demonstrate improvements in predictive accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, and label efficiency. Representative results show error reductions of up to 62.7% at the same label budget and comparable or better accuracy with 90% fewer labels, relative to supervised-only training.

</details>


### [241] [Lower-Level Agnostic Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10223)
*Peiwen Qiu,Prashant Khanduri,Jia Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究下层目标不可知的二层优化问题，提出坐标级伪超梯度方法 LeGo-BiO，用有限差分估计下层解对上层变量的 Jacobian，并给出确定性与随机 setting 下的收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有二层优化算法通常假设可访问下层目标函数、梯度、Hessian/Jacobian 或展开过程，但当下层响应来自黑盒求解器、仿真器、对手或学习预测器时，该假设失效；因此需要研究仅能获得近似下层解的二层优化。

Method: 提出 LeGo-BiO：一种坐标级伪超梯度方法。它通过 \bar{y}(x) 的有限差分估计缺失的 Jacobian \nabla_x \bar{y}(x)；对每个上层坐标构造 1-sparse 更新方向，从而隔离对应的 Jacobian 列，避免全参数响应差分的方向投影限制，并保留上层变量的一阶梯度信息以提升上层梯度估计精度。

Result: 在下层误差界/Polyak-Lojasiewicz 型条件下，无需下层强凸性，分别建立确定性与随机 setting 的收敛保证；确定性情形达到 O(T^{-1})，随机情形在下层近似误差几何下降时达到 O(T^{-1/2})。实验表明，即使对下层目标不可知，LeGo-BiO 仍具有竞争力。

Conclusion: LeGo-BiO 为下层目标不可知场景提供了一种可行且具理论保证的二层优化方法，避免依赖下层目标梯度或 Jacobian，并能利用上层一阶信息提升梯度估计质量。

Abstract: Bilevel optimization is a fundamental framework for machine learning problems, where an upper-level (UL) objective depends on the solution of a nested lower-level (LL) problem. Existing bilevel algorithms typically assume that the LL objective is available for evaluation, differentiation, or unrolling. However, this assumption can fail when the LL response is produced by a black-box solver, simulator, adversary, or learned predictor. In this paper, we study LL agnostic bilevel optimization, where the UL learner has access only to an approximate LL solution $\bar{\mathbf{y}}(\mathbf{x})$ and cannot query the LL objective, its gradients, Hessian/Jacobian information, or the procedure that generates the LL response. We propose LeGo-BiO, a coordinate-wise pseudo-hypergradient method that estimates the missing Jacobian $\nabla _{\mathbf{x}}\bar{\mathbf{y}}(\mathbf{x})$ using finite differences of $\bar{\mathbf{y}}(\cdot)$. For each UL coordinate, LeGo-BiO constructs a decision vector subject to 1-sparse updates, thereby isolating the corresponding Jacobian column needed in the UL gradient computation. This avoids the directional-projection limitation of full-parameter response differences and, unlike derivative-free/zeroth-order approximations of the entire UL gradient, preserves the available first-order gradient information with respect to the UL variables for more accurate UL gradient evaluation. We establish convergence guarantees for LeGo-BiO in both deterministic and stochastic settings under an LL error-bound/Polyak-Lojasiewicz-type condition, without requiring LL strong convexity. Our bounds yield an $O(T^{-1})$ rate in the deterministic setting and an $O(T^{-1/2})$ rate in the stochastic setting when the LL approximation error decreases geometrically. Experiments demonstrate competitive performance of LeGo-BiO despite being agnostic to the LL objective.

</details>


### [242] [RAD-TFM: Robust and Domain-Adapted Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10230)
*Matthew Peroni,Franck Le,Vadim Sheinin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RAD-TFM：将表格基础模型的合成数据生成器参数化，用对抗式的分布鲁棒视角自适应地强调对模型最具挑战性的数据集，并引入与真实领域数据对齐的约束，从而在仅使用不到原始预训练数据 0.1% 的额外合成数据下显著提升 TabPFN V2 与 TabICL V2 的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）可在纯合成数据上预训练，这为"设计数据生成器以诱导模型具备理想性质"提供了空间。但已有工作主要致力于构造更高质量的生成器先验以提升整体预训练效果，属于"平均性能"导向，未针对模型的具体薄弱环节进行定向强化。

Method: 作者的关键洞见是：一旦把生成器分布参数化，就可以采用对抗式的分布鲁棒视角——训练中不断调整生成器，使其偏向生成对当前模型特别困难的数据集，并以"最优性间隙（optimality gap）"度量形式化该目标。同时提出一种使合成数据生成与给定领域的真实数据集对齐的方法，将对偶方（生成器）约束在真实数据分布附近，保证生成数据合理可信。二者共同构成 RAD-TFM（Robust and Domain-Adapted Tabular Foundation Models）流程，这是一个与具体模型无关的对抗式训练框架。

Result: 在 TabPFN V2 分类器上应用 RAD-TFM，在 6 个不同的表格基准上均取得提升，平均归一化 AUC 相比最强基线最高提升 10.8 个百分点，且额外仅使用不足 10 万个合成训练数据集（不到原始预训练数据的 0.1%）。将同一流程应用于 TabICL V2，在三个主要基准上同样带来提升，表明框架具有通用性。

Conclusion: 结果表明，仅依靠合成数据进行定向的对抗式继续训练（adversarial continued training），是提升表格基础模型的一条有前景的新方向；它把研究重心从"设计更好的先验"转向"针对模型弱点动态生成数据"，并以极低的数据代价获得显著收益。

Abstract: The development of tabular foundation models (TFMs) has accelerated in recent years, outperforming traditional ML methods on many tabular benchmarks. A key finding is that TFMs can be pretrained entirely on synthetic datasets, opening opportunities to design data generators that encourage desirable model properties. Prior work has mainly focused on crafting high-quality priors over generators to improve overall pretraining performance. Our key insight is that parameterizing the generator distribution enables an adversarial, distributional robustness perspective: during training, we can adapt the generator to emphasize datasets that are particularly challenging for the model, which we formalize by introducing an optimality gap measure. Further, we develop a method to align the synthetic data generation with real-world datasets from a given domain, constraining the adversary to generate realistic data. Together, these algorithms comprise the Robust and Domain-Adapted Tabular Foundation Models (RAD-TFM) pipeline, a model-agnostic adversarial training framework. Applied to the TabPFN V2 classifier, RAD-TFM improves performance across 6 diverse tabular benchmarks, with up to a 10.8 percentage-point improvement in mean normalized AUC over the strongest baseline, using fewer than 100k additional synthetic training datasets, less than 0.1% of the original pretraining data. Applying the same pipeline to TabICL V2 also improves performance across three major benchmarks, demonstrating the generality of the framework. These results highlight a promising new direction for targeted adversarial continued training of TFMs using synthetic data alone.

</details>


### [243] [Implicit Bias in State Space Models and Linear Autoregressive Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10237)
*Gal Katzhendler,Gilad Yehudai,Gal Vardi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究线性状态空间模型与线性自回归模型中参数共享导致的隐式偏置，提出“有效次数”刻画，证明梯度下降方向收敛到有效次数最大间隔问题的KKT点，并揭示长度偏差机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性SSM和线性自回归序列模型会在样本相关的不同步数上复用同一组参数，不同样本通过不同预测器施加约束，经典同质模型的隐式偏置结论难以直接适用，因此需要理解非齐次预测器与参数共享对隐式偏置的影响。

Method: 在分类设定下构建多个非齐次多项式预测器共享参数的通用模型；在标准插值、方向收敛假设以及轨迹相关的有效次数条件下，分析指数损失上梯度下降的渐近方向，并将其与有效次数最大间隔问题联系起来。

Result: 证明梯度下降方向收敛到有效次数最大间隔问题的KKT点；其中只有最小有效次数的样本施加硬间隔约束，而间隔增长更快的样本渐近不活跃，仅需满足可行性。

Conclusion: 给出线性SSM和线性自回归模型隐式偏置的一阶刻画，揭示长度偏差：更长输入序列或额外自回归步会提高样本有效次数，最小有效次数样本主导极限分类器；说明非齐次性与参数共享如何改变经典同质隐式偏置结果。

Abstract: Linear State Space Models (SSMs) and linear autoregressive sequence models reuse the same parameters across a sample-dependent number of steps. As a result, different examples impose constraints through different predictors, even though all predictors share the same weights. We study this phenomenon through a general model of multiple non-homogeneous polynomial predictors with shared parameters, in a classification setting. Under standard interpolation and directional-convergence assumptions, together with a trajectory-dependent effective-degree condition, we show that gradient descent on the exponential loss converges in direction to a KKT point of an effective-degree max-margin problem. In this problem, only examples with minimal effective degree impose hard margin constraints; examples with faster-growing margins are asymptotically inactive except for feasibility.
  Our result provides a first-order characterization of the implicit bias in linear SSMs and linear autoregressive models. It exposes a mechanism of length bias: a longer input sequence or additional autoregressive steps may increase the example's effective degree, and the examples with the smallest effective degree dominate the limiting classifier. Our result highlights how non-homogeneity and parameter sharing alter classical homogeneous implicit-bias results.

</details>


### [244] [PACE: Keeping the Right Tokens in the KV Cache Is Not Enough for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10240)
*Suman Chatterjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PACE 是一个"规划器感知"的 KV 缓存引擎，把"保留关键 token"与"限制 RoPE 位置距离"两件事结合：让 agent 的规划器告诉缓存未来会读哪些上下文，并对保留 token 重新编号，使任意长度会话中查询与键的旋转位置距离保持在 8K 以内。在 100K 编程会话上以 2048 token 预算通过 97% 隐藏单测（H2O 42%、SnapKV 3%），并在 1M–2M token 会话、单张 24GB GPU 上分别达到 99%/100%，KV 状态不到 0.7GB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程 LLM agent 的会话可达百万 token 级，KV 缓存远超单卡容量，服务系统只能保留小额度 token 而淘汰其余。现有淘汰方法都只关注"留下哪些 token"，并默认"留下的 token 即可被取用"。作者指出这一假设不成立：在 Qwen3-8B、100K 编程会话、2048 token 预算下，即使保留率高达 0.996，定义与使用之间距离从 2K 增长到 90K 时准确率仍从 93% 掉到 64%。关键 token 虽在缓存中却"取不出来"，随距离增长的是它们到查询的旋转位置距离（RoPE 距离）。

Method: PACE 由两个互补组件构成：(1) 规划感知保留（plan-aware retention）——利用 agent 规划器推断未来步骤将要读取的上下文，指导缓存保留决策；(2) 有界位置（bounded positions）——对保留下来的 token 重新编号，使它们到查询的旋转位置距离在任何会话长度下都低于 8K。两者缺一不可。方法在预注册评估协议下与 H2O、SnapKV 在同一预算下对比，并在 Qwen3-8B 与 Mistral-7B 上验证；重新编号是精确的，不带来可测的困惑度损失。

Result: 100K token、fresh 任务上，PACE 通过 97% 隐藏单测，H2O 为 42%、SnapKV 为 3%（同预算）。消融显示单独使用任一组件只有 63%，组合显著更优（p < 10^-4）。长度外推成立：1M 与 2M token 会话（定义出现在使用前 0.9M / 1.8M token）中 PACE 通过 99% 与 100% 检查并召回全部会话事实，而"仅有界位置、无前瞻"从 33% 降到 13%。KV 状态仅约 0.7GB，而完整缓存需 147–295GB。重新编号精确、困惑度无可见损失，仅增加 9% 墙钟时间。Mistral-7B 上（其编程能力上限约 40%，即使不淘汰也只有该水平），PACE 保持在该上限，而仅靠保留的策略低于上限。

Conclusion: 论文揭示了一个被忽略的失效模式：KV 淘汰的瓶颈不只是"留哪些 token"，还有"留下的 token 是否在位置空间上可达"。以 RoPE 距离为代表的相对位置约束会随会话长度线性恶化，使高保留率也无法保障下游准确率。把规划器的未来读取意图（保留什么）与位置重编号（怎么让它可达）耦合起来，可以在极小预算与极小显存下实现近无损长程上下文服务，且代价低廉（9% 额外时延、无困惑度损失）。这为长上下文 serving 提供了"内容选择 + 位置重映射"联合设计的新范式。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate sessions of up to millions of tokens, far more key-value (KV) cache than one GPU holds, so serving systems keep a small budget of tokens and evict the rest. Eviction methods differ in which tokens they keep but share one goal: that the tokens a later step needs are still cached. We show this is not enough. In 100K-token coding sessions on Qwen3-8B with a 2,048-token budget, a planner-guided policy that keeps over 99% of the needed tokens resident still fails late steps increasingly often: its accuracy falls from 93% to 64% as the gap between a definition and its use grows from 2K to 90K tokens, at residency 0.996. The needed tokens are resident but unretrievable: what grows is their rotary-position distance to the query. We present PACE (Planner-Aware Context Engine), a KV-cache engine that couples plan-aware retention, in which the agent's planner tells the cache which context future steps will read, with bounded positions, which renumber kept tokens so their rotary distance to the query stays below 8K at any session length. In a pre-registered evaluation on fresh tasks, PACE passes 97% of hidden unit tests at 100K tokens, against 42% for H2O and 3% for SnapKV under the same budget, and needs both components: either alone reaches 63% (the combination beats each, p < 10^-4). The result holds with length: in 1M- and 2M-token sessions on one 24 GB GPU, with definitions written 0.9M and 1.8M tokens before use, PACE passes 99% and 100% of checks and recalls every session fact, while bounded positions without foresight falls from 33% to 13%; PACE holds under 0.7 GB of KV state where the full cache would need 147-295 GB. Renumbering is exact, costs no measurable perplexity, and adds 9% wall time. On Mistral-7B, whose coding ability caps it at 40% even with nothing evicted, PACE stays at that ceiling while retention alone falls below it.

</details>


### [245] [Transit-Oriented Land Use Planning Using Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10281)
*Bo Yang,Yuebing Liang,Zhan Zhao,Fangyi Ding,Yunhan Zheng,Shenhao Wang,Jinhua Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出DRL4TOD——一个基于深度强化学习（DRL）的框架，用图神经网络刻画地块—路网—地铁站的空间依赖，自动为站点周边地块配置用地类型与容积率（FAR），并联合优化密度、多样性与公交运能利用，同时最小化重建成本；在上海两个真实站点案例中优于规则方法与遗传算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TOD是可持续城市发展的关键策略，强调在站点步行范围内进行高密度、混合用地开发；但传统TOD规划多依赖启发式方法，难以高效地定量识别最优的公交导向土地利用模式，缺少能同时兼顾多重目标与开发可行性的自动化优化工具。

Method: 构建DRL4TOD框架：以图神经网络（GNN）捕捉地块、道路网络与地铁站之间的空间相互依赖关系；再用DRL优化策略为选定地块分配用地类型与容积率（FAR）；目标函数联合优化土地利用密度、土地利用多样性与公交运能利用率，并将重建成本作为惩罚项以反映开发可行性；通过调整各目标权重实现偏好可调。

Result: 在上海两个真实站点区域的实验中，DRL4TOD一致优于规则方法与遗传算法，在取得更优TOD效果的同时重建成本更低；通过调整目标权重，框架可灵活改变优先级（如重视财务可行性时更强调成本最小化）。

Conclusion: DRL4TOD可作为决策支持工具，在规划者设定的优先级下生成协调的用地与FAR配置，而非给出单一固定设计方案；对政策制定者而言，它提供地块级、约束感知的备选方案，使多目标间的权衡显式化，支撑关于开发强度与可行性的针对性决策。

Abstract: Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) is a key strategy for advancing sustainable urban development by promoting high-density, mixed-use land development within walking distance of public transit stations. However, traditional TOD planning often relies on heuristic methods, making it difficult to efficiently identify quantitatively optimized transit-oriented land use patterns. This paper presents DRL4TOD, a deep reinforcement learning framework that automatically optimizes land use types and floor area ratios (FARs) around transit stations in alignment with TOD principles. DRL4TOD incorporates a graph neural network to capture spatial interdependencies among land parcels, road networks, and metro stations, and uses a DRL-based optimization strategy to assign land-use types and FARs to selected parcels. It jointly optimizes multiple objectives, including land use density, land use diversity, and transit capacity utilization, while minimizing reconstruction costs to account for development feasibility. Applied to two real-world station areas in Shanghai, DRL4TOD consistently outperforms rule-based approaches and genetic algorithms, achieving more effective TOD outcomes with lower reconstruction costs. By adjusting objective weights, the framework enables flexible prioritization, such as placing greater emphasis on cost minimization when financial feasibility is a concern. These results demonstrate DRL4TOD's potential as a decision-support tool for generating coordinated land-use and FAR configurations under planner-specified priorities, rather than prescribing a single fixed design. For policymakers, the framework provides parcel-level, constraint-aware alternatives that make trade-offs among competing objectives explicit and support targeted decisions about development intensity and feasibility.

</details>


### [246] [A Clinical Evaluation of Conformal Prediction for Chest Radiograph Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10288)
*Nikolaos Kontogeorgis,Pascal Krezer,Klaus-Rudolf Kladny,Arne Estler,Christian F. Baumgartner,Lisa Koch,Saif Afat,Michael Muehlebach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出 CLARITY，一套区分"临床后果性错误"与"微小偏差"的放射报告可接受性判定标准，并用放射科医生对 MLLM 生成报告的标注来检验保形预测（CP）与自动评测指标的可靠性，发现常用"可接受性代理指标"与真实临床可接受性基本脱钩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型在自动生成放射报告上进展明显，但幻觉问题突出，需要具备临床意义的风险控制手段。保形预测本可提供统计保证，然而现有 CP 方法依赖未校准的自动抽取器，且未考虑错误在临床上的重要性差异（把致命错误与措辞偏差等同对待）。

Method: 提出 CLARITY（临床可接受性准则）框架，明确界定哪些错误具有临床后果、哪些只是轻微偏差；为摆脱对自动判官的依赖，组织放射科医生按 CLARITY 对 MLLM 生成的报告进行人工标注，并以该专家标注为基准，系统评测多种 CP 策略与自动评测指标的表现。

Result: 基准测试显示，常用的可接受性代理指标（自动判官与自动评测度量）系统性地无法检出临床上重要的错误；自动化的可接受性判断与真实临床可接受性之间呈现高度解耦。

Conclusion: 在放射报告生成的风险控制中，直接使用自动判官作为 CP 的校准依据不可靠；需要以临床可接受性为标准、由专家标注支撑的评测与校准方式，CLARITY 为此提供了可操作的判定框架与基准。

Abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have improved automated radiology report generation, they remain prone to hallucinations, necessitating clinically meaningful risk-control methods. Conformal prediction (CP) provides statistical guarantees, yet existing CP approaches rely on uncalibrated automated extractors and fail to account for the clinical relevance of errors. We introduce clinical admissibility criteria (CLARITY), a framework for evaluating radiology reports that explicitly distinguishes clinically consequential errors from minor deviations. To eliminate reliance on automatic judges, we collected radiologist annotations of MLLM-generated reports using CLARITY. By benchmarking CP strategies and automatic evaluation metrics against these expert annotations, we demonstrate that commonly used admissibility proxies systematically fail to detect clinically relevant errors. Our findings reveal that automated admissibility judgments are largely decoupled from true clinical admissibility.

</details>


### [247] [Plug-and-Play Verifier for Decoupling Process Reward in Stabilizing Long-Horizon Agentic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10305)
*Mingwei Xu,Jieyuan Pei,Binghao Tu,Hao Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可插拔验证器（plug-and-play verifier）框架，通过显式验证中间推理产物，将稠密过程奖励与稀疏结果奖励结合，稳定长程推理训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程推理需在连续推理步骤与工具交互中保持有效进展。现有RL训练中，actor-critic依赖可学习critic估计步骤优势，GRPO等无critic方法仅依赖稀疏的结果奖励分组变体；两类奖励要么隐含、要么无法区分"部分有用"的失败轨迹与完全无效轨迹，导致随推理链变长而难以维持一致的推理路径。

Method: 提出即插即用验证器框架：通过统一接口从智能体运行轨迹中抽取中间推理产物，交由领域专用验证器评估，并把验证分数聚合为有界的过程奖励；再采用两阶段后训练调度，将稠密验证过程奖励与稀疏结果奖励结合。

Result: 在HotpotQA上以Qwen3.5-4B评测，准确率达60.18%，优于标准GRPO基线（57.73%）；验证器还能像最后的自我反思与自我一致性一样进一步稳定推理步骤。

Conclusion: 可插拔验证器为长程推理提供了一种模块化方案，可学习更稳定、更可靠的推理行为。

Abstract: Stabilizing long-horizon reasoning requires intelligent agents to sustain useful progress across successive reasoning steps and tool interactions. Such agents are typically trained with reinforcement learning (RL), where actor-critic RL uses a learnable critic network to estimate step advantages, while critic-free methods such as GRPO eliminate critic models and rely mostly on the group variants of sparse outcome-only rewards. Both reward types leave partially useful failed trajectories either implicit or indistinguishable from entirely unproductive ones, and as reasoning horizons grow, it becomes difficult to maintain consistent reasoning trajectories. In this work, we propose a \textit{plug-and-play verifier} framework for stabilizing long-horizon reasoning through explicit verification of intermediate reasoning artifacts. Specifically, the framework decouples process verification through a unified interface that extracts intermediate reasoning artifacts from agent running trajectories, evaluates them using domain-specific verifiers, and aggregates the verification scores as bounded process reward. Then, we combine our dense verified process rewards and the sparse outcome rewards through a two-stage post-training schedule. We showed that with plug-and-play verifiers, we further stabilize the reasoning steps as last-mile self-reflection and self-consistency. Typical evaluation on HotpotQA using Qwen3.5-4B achieves a superior accuracy (60.18\%), outperforming the standard GRPO baseline (57.73\%). Our results suggest that plug-and-play verifiers provide a modular approach to learn more stable and reliable reasoning behaviors over long horizons.

</details>


### [248] [How Much Is Left Matters: False Positives and False Negatives in Partial-Prompt Contamination Tests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10307)
*Abhishek Anand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统审计了"部分提示补全"这一基准污染检测方法的可靠性，发现其标记结果强烈依赖于剩余文本长度，且在真实负例（AIME 2025/2026）上产生大量假阳性，同时漏检上游蒸馏污染；作者据此提出长度分层报告、前缀不超过60%、风格匹配的后截止对照以及跨家族校准等改进建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分提示补全测试（给出题目开头、检验模型能否复现后文）被广泛用于检测基准污染，但其有效性本身缺乏系统验证。作者希望检验该测试的假阳性、假阴性来源，特别是剩余文本长度的影响，以及在真实未见题目上的表现。

Method: 在七个开源权重模型上审计该测试，使用 MATH-500 与 AIME 2025/2026（作为真负例，后者晚于所有模型训练截止）两个基准。分析不同前缀长度（40%/60%/80%）与剩余词数下 ROUGE-L 阈值（如≥0.75）与精确匹配的标记率；比较同家族与跨家族模型的标记情况以进行校准；并考察从 Qwen2.5-Math 蒸馏模型的可检测性。

Result: 标记率随剩余文本长度剧烈变化：剩余≤8词的问题被标记的频率远高于剩余≥25词者（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为31.5% vs 5.5%），且半数至四分之三的 ROUGE 标记来自短剩余文本。在真负例上，ROUGE-L≥0.75 在60%前缀下误标最高6.7%；80%前缀下即使精确匹配也有8.6%（AIME 2026 为6.2%），而40–60%前缀下为0%。该测试还漏检上游污染：蒸馏自 Qwen2.5-Math 的模型几乎无可识别的模型特异性召回。以其他家族模型为参照进行校准可消除大部分标记，同时在所有前缀长度上稳定分离出 Qwen2.5 特有的污染信号。

Conclusion: 部分提示补全测试的结果高度依赖前缀长度与剩余词数，在真负例上存在显著假阳性，并对上游蒸馏污染缺乏敏感性，直接使用易误判。作者建议采用长度分层的报告方式、限制前缀长度不超过60%、使用风格匹配且晚于训练截止的对照题目，并进行跨家族校准，以提升污染检测结论的可信度。

Abstract: Partial-prompt completion, where a model receives the first part of a benchmark problem and is checked for whether it reproduces the rest, is a widely used test for benchmark contamination. We audit this test on seven open-weight models using MATH-500 and recent AIME 2025/2026 problems, which serve as true negatives. Memorization flags depend strongly on how much text remains: for every model, problems with at most 8 leftover words are flagged several times more often than problems with at least 25 (31.5% vs. 5.5% for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), and half to three-quarters of all ROUGE-based flags come from short leftovers. On true negatives, a ROUGE-L >= 0.75 threshold flags up to 6.7% of problems at a 60% prefix, and at an 80% prefix even exact match flags 8.6% (pooled over models; 6.2% on AIME 2026, which postdates every model), against 0% at 40-60%. The test also misses contamination upstream: models distilled from Qwen2.5-Math, whose base is heavily flagged in prior work, show almost no model-specific recall. Calibrating each model against models from other families removes most flags while isolating a consistent Qwen2.5-specific signal at every prefix length. We recommend length-stratified reporting, prefixes of at most 60%, style-matched post-cutoff controls, and cross-family calibration.

</details>


### [249] [TripletAD: Weakly Supervised Anomaly Detection in Embedding Space with Rare Anomalies and Scarce Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10352)
*Sumit Wadhwa,Souvik Nath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TripletAD：在"仅少量标注异常、其余数据不可信为正"的curated-label设定下，用三元组边界嵌入+双软惩罚线性打分头实现弱监督异常检测，在24个ADBench数据集上于异常稀少时优于DevNet/PReNet/DeepSAD与GBDT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际异常检测任务常只有极少量已确认异常，且未审核的其余数据不能假定为正常。常规做法把未确认异常重新标为正常会引入标签噪声，因此需要一种在"未确认异常直接剔除"的curated-label协议下仍能有效利用少量标签的弱监督方法。

Method: 提出TripletAD：学习三元组边界（triplet-margin）嵌入，并为线性打分头引入两项软惩罚进行校准——针对已标注异常的partial cross-entropy，以及区分异常与正常样本平均得分的相对对比hinge损失。关键设计是每个挖掘出的三元组都含一个已标注异常，使少量标签在整个训练集上被反复复用而非被稀释；方法无需逐数据集调参。

Result: 在24个ADBench数据集（输入为文本/图像/语音的预训练嵌入）上，异常稀少时TripletAD优于DevNet、PReNet、DeepSAD及梯度提升树。1%异常率下六种方法中平均AUCPR最高，比DevNet高20%；天然稀少的Speech数据集上AUCPR为0.394（最佳基线0.196）；MVTec-AD上仅1/4或1/2异常被标注时最优。70个稀少/稀疏标签设置汇总后平均排名最佳（6种方法中2.21），并经Wilcoxon符号秩检验（Holm校正）显著优于各基线。异常较频繁时与这些方法持平。对损失权重与训练时长不敏感；但在原始表格特征上GBDT仍更强。

Conclusion: 在少量已确认异常且未审核数据不可信的现实条件下，采用curated-label协议并让每个三元组锚定一个真实异常标签，可显著提升稀有异常场景的检测性能，且方法简单、免调参、稳健；其适用边界是预训练嵌入输入，原始表格特征场景仍推荐梯度提升树。

Abstract: Many practical anomaly detection problems come with only a handful of confirmed anomalies, and the unreviewed remainder of the data cannot be trusted to be normal. We study this setting under a curated-label protocol, in which unconfirmed anomalies are removed from training rather than relabelled as normal, and propose TripletAD, a weakly supervised detector that learns a triplet-margin embedding and calibrates a linear scoring head with two soft penalties: a partial cross-entropy on labelled anomalies and a relative-contrast hinge that separates the mean scores of anomalous and normal samples. Because every mined triplet contains a labelled anomaly, the few labels are reused across the entire training set instead of being diluted by it. On 24 ADBench datasets whose inputs are pre-trained embeddings (text, image and speech vectors), TripletAD outperforms established state-of-the-art weakly supervised detectors (DevNet, PReNet and DeepSAD) and gradient-boosted trees when anomalies are rare. At a 1% anomaly rate it has the highest mean AUCPR of six methods, 20% above DevNet; on the naturally rare Speech dataset it doubles the best baseline (0.394 vs. 0.196 AUCPR); and on MVTec-AD it is best when only a quarter or half of the anomalies are labelled. Pooled over 70 rare- or sparse-label settings, it has the best average rank (2.21 of 6) and outperforms each baseline under Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction. When anomalies are more frequent it performs on par with these methods. The method needs no per-dataset tuning and is insensitive to its loss weights and training length; on raw tabular features, gradient-boosted trees remain the stronger choice.

</details>


### [250] [Bias, Measurement Error, and Double-Dipping: When Can GNN Convolutions Help Brain Connectome Prediction?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10364)
*Tommaso Castellani,Jiaqi Li,Muriah D. Wheelock,Rezwana Rosen Razzaque,Helmut Laufs,Hong Chen,Claire Donnat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文将fMRI连接组预测中的GNN失效问题归结为errors-in-variables：观测协方差是真实连接组的含噪估计。作者在线性渐近设定下分解图卷积效应，并指出仅在一个由脑社区结构、预测信号、图构建和记录时长共同决定的狭窄有利区间内，消息传递才能带来预测增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实证研究和作者自己的实验都发现，fMRI预测中的GNN往往打不过更简单的图无关基线。作者试图从统计上解释这种失败：经验功能连接矩阵既被当作特征，又被用来构图，而它本身只是有限时间序列估计出的含噪协方差，并非真实连接组。

Method: 将连接组预测形式化为errors-in-variables问题：真实连接组潜在，观测协方差含噪。在线性渐近框架下，把图卷积的影响分解为三个机制：平滑带来的偏差与方差降低、图估计误差，以及同一含噪矩阵同时决定图与特征所导致的双重使用效应。随后在适配神经科学的潜在社区模型下，刻画消息传递可能有助预测的条件，并用模拟验证分解、用真实数据检验GNN流程所处区间。

Result: 模拟实验验证了该三机制分解；真实数据实验表明，常见的连接组GNN流程往往落在有利区间之外，因而难以优于图无关基线。理论上只存在一个由脑社区结构、预测信号强度、图构建方式和记录长度共同决定的狭窄有利区域。

Conclusion: 该工作为“图卷积何时能帮助脑连接组预测、为何经常不能”提供了首个统计解释：当观测连接组的噪声、图估计误差和双重使用效应超出平滑收益时，GNN的优势会消失。这提示需要更谨慎地图构建与去噪，或重新评估GNN在fMRI预测中的适用边界。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are an important tool for fMRI prediction, where empirical functional connectivity matrices serve both as features and for graph construction. However, recent studies and our own experiments show that these methods often fail to outperform simpler graph-agnostic baselines. We propose a statistical explanation for this failure by formulating connectome prediction as an errors-in-variables (EIV) problem: the true connectome is latent, while the observed covariance matrix is a noisy finite-time-series estimate. In a linear asymptotic setting, we decompose the effect of graph convolution into three mechanisms: smoothing-induced bias and variance reduction, graph estimation error, and a double-dipping effect arising when the same noisy matrix determines both graph and features. Under a latent community model adapted to neuroscience, we identify a narrow favorable regime, set by the brain community structure, the predictive signal, the graph construction and the recording length, in which message passing can improve prediction. Simulations validate this decomposition, while real-data experiments illustrate that connectome GNN pipelines often fall outside this regime. Our results provide a first step towards explaining when graph convolutions can help brain connectome prediction, and why they often do not.

</details>


### [251] [CHARM: Certified Homology-Aware Reverse-scale Mapping via Diffusion-Guided Quotient Towers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10375)
*Zhe Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CHARM：将二维坐标与可验证同调证据、样本级定位结合的降维方法，通过安全收缩与覆盖商塔加速结构计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有降维方法主要优化邻域或距离保持，仅凭平面坐标无法证明高阶结构的同调类型与样本级支撑；而直接在单纯复形上计算同调代价高昂，因复形规模随维度急剧膨胀。

Method: 提出CHARM：以扩散坐标引导覆盖提案；用保同伦型的安全收缩与Cover Quotient Tower缩小结构计算的定义域；用精确代数认证并追踪同调代表元；再用反向尺度布局将其支撑放在共享坐标中。理论部分给出安全收缩的拓扑等价性、商塔与粗图hop-distance Rips滤波的乘性3-交错、欧氏与粗图Rips滤波间的加性失真界，以及正尺度上的复合乘性保证。

Result: 在22个数据集、41,637个样本、固定配置下，CHARM在非合成数据全部15个样本加权指标中排名前二，且在四项欧氏持久图距离上均为最小；全基准共产生957条可追溯支撑记录；球壳实验中一条认证H2记录在二维视图中定位出1,578个原始样本。

Conclusion: CHARM在保持降维可视化几何探索能力的同时，提供同调类型与位置的显式、可验证证据，兼顾效率与可解释性。

Abstract: Widely used dimensionality reduction methods prioritize neighborhood or distance 1 preservation, yet planar coordinates alone cannot certify the homological type or 2 sample-level support of higher-order structures. Obtaining this evidence directly 3 is costly because simplicial complexes grow rapidly with dimension. We propose 4 Certified Homology-Aware Reverse-scale Mapping (CHARM), which combines 5 two-dimensional coordinates with certified homology records and sample-level 6 localization. Diffusion coordinates guide cover proposals; safe contractions and a 7 Cover Quotient Tower reduce the domain of structural computation; exact algebra 8 certifies and tracks homology representatives; and reverse-scale layout places their 9 supports in shared coordinates. Safe contraction preserves the homotopy type of 10 the input flag complex. The quotient tower is multiplicatively 3-interleaved with 11 the coarse-graph hop-distance Rips filtration. Verifiable distance-distortion bounds 12 give an additive guarantee between the original Euclidean and coarse-graph Rips 13 filtrations, and composite multiplicative guarantees for the tower on positive scales. 14 Across 22 datasets and 41,637 samples under a fixed configuration, CHARM 15 ranks among the top two on all 15 sample-weighted metrics for nonsynthetic data, 16 including the smallest values on all four Euclidean persistence-diagram distances. 17 It also provides 957 traceable support records across the full benchmark. On a 18 spherical shell, one certified H2 record identifies 1,578 original samples in the 19 two-dimensional view. CHARM thus combines geometric exploration with explicit 20 evidence of homological type and location.

</details>


### [252] [Quantitative Assessment of Crystal Structure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10380)
*Sergio Rincón,Gabriel González,Nicolás Andrade,Rafael Velásquez,Sebastián Ojeda,Juanita Puentes,Nicolás Aparicio,Paula Cárdenas,Pablo Arbeláez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 OPAL-Bench，一个方向不变、多晶型感知的 CSP 基准，将 CSP 与 SICSP 分开评估，并结合无阈值几何与物理指标评测 7 种 CSP 与 2 种 SICSP 方法，同时发布 SE(3)-等变流匹配基线 OPAL-CSP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CSP 评测存在三大问题：依赖阈值敏感或不可比的指标；过度关注几何性能而忽视物理合理性；未考虑同一成分可结晶为多种稳定结构的多晶型现象。此外，SICSP 方法在推理时接收晶体学模板，本质上是不同任务，却常与标准 CSP 基线直接比较。

Method: 构建 OPAL-Bench 基准，将 CSP 与 SICSP 作为两个独立任务评估；在 4 个数据集上，用无阈值的几何距离与物理距离指标评测 7 种 CSP 方法和 2 种 SICSP 方法；并提出 SE(3)-等变流匹配基线 OPAL-CSP 用于 CSP 赛道。

Result: 没有任何方法在所有指标上占优；几何性能与物理合理性之间相关性不强；OPAL-CSP 在几何指标上具有竞争力，在物理指标上位列最佳之列。

Conclusion: OPAL-Bench 通过多晶型感知协议统一几何与物理指标，为 CSP 生成质量提供更全面的评估框架。

Abstract: Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) aims to predict a material's 3D structure from its chemical composition, with applications from energy storage to biomedical devices. Despite its importance, existing evaluation frameworks suffer from key limitations: they rely on threshold-sensitive or incomparable metrics, focus predominantly on geometric performance while overlooking physical plausibility, and fail to account for polymorphism, where a chemical composition can crystallize into multiple stable structures. In parallel, recent Symmetry-Informed CSP (SICSP) methods often report results alongside standard CSP baselines while receiving crystallographic templates at inference, which constrain the search space and make SICSP a fundamentally different task. To address these limitations, we introduce an Orientation-invariant, Polymorph-Aware, Large Benchmark (OPAL-Bench) that evaluates CSP and SICSP as separate tasks. We evaluate 7 CSP and 2 SICSP methods under OPAL-Bench across 4 datasets using threshold-free geometric and physical distance metrics. Our results show that no method dominates across all metrics, and that geometric performance is not strongly correlated with physical plausibility. We also release OPAL-CSP, an SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching baseline for the CSP track that performs competitively on geometric metrics and ranks among the best on physical ones. By unifying geometric and physical metrics under a polymorph-aware protocol, OPAL-Bench enables a more comprehensive assessment of generative quality in CSP.

</details>


### [253] [Pruning DNA Sequence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10386)
*Faias Satter,Shaker Islam,Aminul Islam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出序列剪枝（SP）框架，在 DNA 语言模型预训练中动态移除已易于预测的基因组序列，最高减少 96% 数据处理量且基本保持下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据剪枝可去除学习信号贡献小的样本以降低训练成本，但此前尚未在 DNA 语言模型预训练中得到研究。

Method: SP 利用模型前向传播直接得到的逐序列预训练准确率作为难度信号，动态剔除已"学懂"的序列，无需独立评分模型或额外语料遍历；并在两个语料、三类模型家族、MLM 与 CLM 两种目标共五种设置下评估，同时支持困惑度、EL2N 等替代准则。

Result: 预训练数据处理量最多减少 96%，下游性能基本保持；中等节省下 MCC 提升最多 1.2 点；最高节省时仅用 4% 基线 GPU 小时且性能损失很小；在多数比较中优于 InfoBatch 与 BPAS；准确率准则下游效果最佳。

Conclusion: 基因组预训练无需反复处理全部序列，序列级动态剪枝能显著提升数据与计算效率。

Abstract: Data pruning can substantially reduce training cost by removing examples that contribute little additional learning signal, but it has not been studied for DNA language-model pretraining. We introduce Sequence Pruning (SP), a dynamic pruning framework that removes genomic sequences as they become easy for the model to predict. SP uses per-sequence pretraining accuracy computed directly from the model's forward pass, requiring no separate scoring model or additional pass over the corpus. We evaluate SP across five pretraining settings spanning two corpora, three model families, and both MLM and CLM objectives, with downstream evaluation on five genomic benchmarks. SP reduces pretraining data processing by up to 96% while largely preserving downstream performance. At moderate savings, pruning improves performance by up to 1.2 MCC points over full-data pretraining; at the highest savings, pretraining uses only 4% of the baseline GPU hours with little performance loss. SP also outperforms the dynamic pruning methods InfoBatch and BPAS across most comparisons. Beyond accuracy, our framework supports alternative criteria such as perplexity and EL2N, although accuracy yields the strongest downstream performance at matched savings. These results show that genomic pretraining does not require repeatedly processing all available sequences and that dynamic sequence-level pruning can substantially improve its data and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/FaiasPromit/pruning-dna-sequence.

</details>


### [254] [From Task Affinities to Optimal Allocations: Probabilistic Graphical Modelling for Supervised Finetuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10389)
*Prateek Chanda,Saral Sureka,Krishnateja Killamsetty,Ganesh Ramakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TASKMIXPGM，用马尔可夫随机场/能量模型刻画 SFT 任务间的单任务效用与任务间行为散度，学习连续任务混合比例，并在预算约束下给出弱子模性近似保证，得到的固定混合方案在多种模型族与预算下优于均匀/按规模采样等启发式方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在固定训练预算下做大规模异构任务的监督微调（SFT）代价高昂，因此关键在于选取有效的任务子集（即最优任务混合）。但实践中常用均匀采样或按数据集规模比例采样等简单启发式，忽略了任务间的相互作用，导致迁移效果受损、预算浪费在冗余任务上。

Method: 将每个 SFT 任务视为马尔可夫随机场中的一个节点：一元势（unary potential）刻画单个任务的效用，二元势（pairwise potential）通过各单任务微调模型预测分布之间的行为散度（behavioral divergence）建模任务间关系；以能量模型框架学习连续任务混合权重，使目标在效用、覆盖度与冗余度之间取得平衡。理论上分析由此诱导的集合函数，证明其在预算约束下具有弱子模性（weakly submodular），从而为离散任务选择提供近似保证。

Result: 给出了一个固定、与基准无关（benchmark-independent）的任务混合方案，在多个模型族和不同训练预算下均优于启发式混合方法；同时 TASKMIXPGM 揭示了任务交互中可解释的结构，识别出互补性与冗余性，可指导有效的 SFT 混合设计。

Conclusion: 任务混合的选择可被形式化为预算约束下的连续优化问题，通过能量模型/马尔可夫随机场同时建模任务效用与任务间交互，能够同时获得理论近似保证与实际可迁移的固定混合配置，并提升任务交互的可解释性，说明显式建模任务间关系比启发式采样更有效。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning over a large pool of heterogeneous tasks is often computationally expensive, leading practitioners to train language models on a fixed training budget of carefully chosen SFT tasks. Thus, achieving strong downstream performance hinges on selecting an effective subset of tasks, or equivalently, identifying an optimal task mixture under a fixed budget constraint. In practice, supervised finetuning mixtures are often determined using simple heuristics (e.g., uniform or size-proportional sampling) that ignore task interactions, which can hurt transfer and waste budget on redundant task sources. We introduce TASKMIXPGM, a framework for learning continuous task mixtures through energy-based modelling over SFT tasks. Each task forms a node in a Markov random field, with unary potentials capturing task utility and pairwise potentials modelling inter-task relationships via behavioral divergences between predictive distributions of single-task fine-tuned models. Optimizing this objective yields task mixtures that balance utility, coverage, and redundancy. We further show that the induced set function defined over the set of such tasks is weakly submodular under budget constraints, enabling approximation guarantees for discrete task selection. Empirically, we provide a fixed, benchmark-independent mixture that improves over heuristic mixing across multiple model families and different training budgets. TASKMIXPGM also uncovers interpretable structure in task interactions, revealing complementarities and redundancies that inform effective SFT mixtures.

</details>


### [255] [Finite Time Analysis of Risk-Sensitive RL via Noisy Power Iteration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10393)
*Waqar Mirza,Yashaswini Murthy,Laixi Shi,Eric Mazumdar,Adam Wierman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究从随机观测中估计正算子主特征对的问题，将其视为带噪归一化幂迭代，并在Hilbert投影度量下建立有限时间随机逼近保证；主要应用于指数效用下的风险敏感平均代价强化学习，得到风险敏感TD与Q学习算法及$\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指数效用风险敏感平均代价RL中Bellman方程具有乘性结构，价值函数由非线性特征值问题刻画而非加性不动点，传统加性TD/Q学习框架难以直接适用；同时实际学习只能依赖单条Markov轨迹的随机观测，需要有限时间理论保证。

Method: 将主特征对估计建模为噪声归一化幂迭代：每步应用采样得到的正算子估计后重新归一化；在适合Perron--Frobenius乘性几何的Hilbert投影度量下进行有限时间随机逼近分析；把策略评估与控制统一到该框架，在显式正性、混合性和线性函数逼近假设下推导风险敏感TD与Q学习算法。

Result: 在显式正性、混合及线性函数逼近假设下，证明恢复特征向量与特征值的有限时间界，样本复杂度为$\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$（至多相差问题相关常数）；结果覆盖表格型与线性函数逼近两种情形，并借助指数效用与KL鲁棒控制的对偶性，给出KL鲁棒平均代价RL的有限时间保证。

Conclusion: 该工作为风险敏感平均代价RL提供了基于Hilbert投影度量的统一有限时间分析框架，说明噪声幂迭代可有效求解乘性Bellman特征值问题，并将保证扩展到KL鲁棒平均代价RL。

Abstract: Estimating the principal eigenpair of a positive operator from stochastic evaluations gives rise to a noisy form of normalized power iteration: each step applies a sampled operator estimate and then renormalizes. We establish finite-time stochastic-approximation guarantees for this procedure, working in Hilbert's projective metric, which is well-suited to the multiplicative geometry of Perron--Frobenius eigenproblems. Our main application is risk-sensitive average-cost reinforcement learning (RL) with exponential utility. In this setting the Bellman equations are multiplicative, and value functions are characterized by nonlinear eigenvalue problems rather than additive fixed points. We cast both policy evaluation and control in this framework, obtaining risk-sensitive TD- and Q-learning algorithms that learn from a single Markovian trajectory. Under explicit positivity, mixing, and linear function approximation assumptions, we prove finite-time bounds on the recovered eigenvector and eigenvalue with $\tilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity up to problem-dependent constants. The results cover both tabular and linear function approximation regimes, and through the duality between exponential utility and KL-robust control yield finite-time guarantees for KL-robust average-cost RL as well.

</details>


### [256] [Regularization Amplifies Subliminal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10397)
*Lawrence Feng,Jacob Mitchell Springer,Gaurav R. Ghosal,Ziqian Zhong,Aditi Raghunathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 正则化不但不能抑制隐藏偏见的“隐秘传递”，反而会放大它。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明隐藏偏见可通过与偏见无明显语义关系的数据发生传递。直觉上，正则化通过限制模型适应程度应能抑制这种“隐性影响”，本文系统检验这一假设。

Method: 在“阈下学习（subliminal learning）”以及幻影迁移（phantom transfer）、logit线性选择等相关隐秘影响设定下，系统比较全量微调与低秩适应（LoRA）、显式惩罚项、增加数据等不同正则化强度的效果。

Result: 结果与预期相反：正则化会放大隐藏偏见的传递。阈下学习在完全微调下通常不出现，但LoRA或显式惩罚可诱发强传递；幻影迁移与logit线性选择呈类似趋势；增加数据（一种隐式正则化）同样增强隐秘影响。

Conclusion: 正则化带来的“简单性偏好”可能正是促进隐秘影响的机制；并进一步假设使隐秘传递最大化的正则化强度取决于任务复杂度。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that hidden biases can be transferred through data with no apparent semantic relationship to those biases. Can regularization limit this covert influence? By constraining adaptation, regularization might be expected to suppress behavioral changes on seemingly unrelated inputs. We systematically study this hypothesis in subliminal learning, as well as in related settings of covert influence, including phantom transfer and logit-linear selection. We find the opposite: regularization amplifies the transfer of hidden biases. In particular, subliminal learning is typically absent under full fine-tuning, but low-rank adaptation or explicit penalties can induce strong transfer. Phantom transfer and logit-linear selection show similar trends. Adding more data, an implicit form of regularization, also strengthens covert influence. Together, these findings suggest that the simplicity biases induced by regularization may facilitate covert influence. We further hypothesize that the level of regularization that maximizes covert transfer depends on task complexity.

</details>


### [257] [Sharp Logarithmic-Product Bounds for List Replicability of Sign Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10408)
*Guangjian Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 证明任意非空 m 个二元概念在 n 个域点上的列表可复制性至多 805ln(2m)ln(2n)，解决 Blondal 等的对数乘积猜想；Hanner 矩阵给出同阶下界，并通过 face width 等几何/拓扑工具建立精确公式与无界间隙。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究学习规则的列表可复制性，即需要多少个准确假设才能以任意高置信度覆盖学习规则输出；核心目标是解决关于其对数乘积上界的猜想，并厘清其与几何、拓扑量之间的关系。

Method: 在立方体各面上构造嵌套无圈子集；用临界点估计获得高连通区域，以加权胞腔粘贴保持跨面兼容性，再借立方承载定理转化为准确有限覆盖与学习规则。追加一个常数坐标后，将列表可复制性等价为几何量 face width；对图定向类推导精确乘积公式。另发展熵倾斜与双侧 Gibbs 构造、结构化矩阵的组合上界、经典族精确计算及 Paley 矩阵指标研究。

Result: 得到上界 805ln(2m)ln(2n)；Hanner 矩阵给出同阶下界，包括方阵及不等对数纵横比的显式族。face width 精确刻画列表可复制性，图定向类满足精确乘积公式；存在列表可复制性为 4k+1、等变指标为 3k 的显式类，故二者加法间隙无界。还给出熵倾斜工具、结构化矩阵上界、经典族精确值和 Paley 矩阵指标结果。

Conclusion: 该工作解决了列表可复制性的对数乘积猜想，并给出匹配阶下界；同时把列表可复制性转化为 face width 这一精确几何量，揭示其与等变指标之间可存在无界加法间隙，并提供一系列构造与计算工具。

Abstract: List replicability measures how many accurate hypotheses suffice to contain the output of a learning rule with arbitrarily high confidence. We prove that every nonempty class of $m$ binary concepts on $n$ domain points has list replicability at most $805\ln(2m)\ln(2n)$. This resolves the logarithmic-product conjecture of Blondal, Hatami, Hatami, Lalov, and Tretiak. Hanner matrices give lower bounds of the same order, for square matrices and for explicit families with unequal logarithmic aspect ratios. The upper bound is obtained by constructing nested acyclic sets in the faces of a cube. A critical-point estimate supplies highly connected regions, weighted cell attachments keep the sets compatible across faces, and a cubical carrier theorem converts them into accurate finite covers and learning rules. Appending one constant coordinate turns list replicability into an exact geometric quantity, the face width, and graph-orientation classes satisfy exact product formulas. In particular, there are explicit classes with list replicability $4k+1$ and equivariant index $3k$, so the additive gap between the two is unbounded. We also develop entropy-tilting and two-sided Gibbs constructions, give combinatorial upper bounds adapted to structured matrices, compute exact values on classical families, and study the index of Paley matrices.

</details>


### [258] [Dynamic State Estimation from Sparse PMUs via Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10468)
*Huy Hoang Le,Haoguang Wang,Christian Moya,Marcos Netto,Guang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种物理信息图神经算子（PI-GNO），仅用少数发电机母线的稀疏、间歇PMU量测，一次前向即可估计全网机组转子角与转速轨迹；摆方程以硬约束或带学习修正项的软约束嵌入，支持无状态标签训练与掩码训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力系统动态状态估计需在量测稀疏且不连续、模型存在误差的条件下重构全网动态状态；传统卡尔曼平滑器与移动时域估计（MHE）等方法需逐场景优化、依赖精确模型与状态标签，计算代价高、泛化受限，因此需要兼具物理一致性与可学习性的快速算子。

Method: 构建图注意力编码器处理PMU量测，将摆方程作为硬约束或带可学习修正项的软约束嵌入算子；直接在仿真量测上训练而无需状态标签；多PMU场景下采用掩码训练（隐藏一路输入但保留在损失中）；在四个输电系统上与调参卡尔曼平滑器、优化基准、硬约束MHE及基于仿真状态训练的神经网络对比，并考察模型误差与详细机组模型（参数仅通过电压相量体现）下的表现。

Result: 在四个输电系统上，该算子是不做逐场景优化、不使用状态标签的最精确估计器；仅在最小系统且模型误差较大时，调参卡尔曼平滑器更优。基于仿真状态训练的神经网络在两个最小系统上更准，但在118节点系统中算子比硬约束MHE更快且更准；存在模型误差时，算子以远低于优化基准的计算成本达到相当或更优精度。结果在详细机组模型、参数仅经由电压相量体现的条件下依然成立。

Conclusion: 将摆方程作为结构先验嵌入图神经算子，可在无状态标签、量测稀疏间歇与模型误差条件下实现快速、准确且物理一致的全网动态状态估计，较优化类方法显著降低计算代价，为实时动态状态估计提供了可行途径。

Abstract: This paper proposes a physics-informed graph neural operator for power system dynamic state estimation. From a sparse, intermittent measurement window at a few generator buses, the operator estimates the rotor-angle and speed trajectories of all machines, unmeasured ones included, in one forward pass. A graph-attention encoder processes the measurements, and the swing equations are imposed as a hard constraint or as a soft one with a learned correction that absorbs model errors. It is trained on simulated measurements, without state labels. With several phasor measurement units, masked training hides one from the input but keeps it in the loss. On four transmission systems, simulations show that the operator is the most accurate estimator that neither optimizes per scenario nor uses state labels, except on the smallest system at large model errors, where tuned Kalman smoothers are better. Networks trained on simulated states are more accurate on the two smallest systems but not on the 118-bus system, where the operator is faster and more accurate than hard-constrained moving-horizon estimation. Under model errors, it matches or outperforms an optimization-based benchmark at a fraction of its cost. The results hold for a detailed machine model with exact parameters seen only through voltage phasors.

</details>


### [259] [Learning a Unified Cross-Model Semantic Dictionary via Gated Bottleneck Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10503)
*Jinchi Zhu,Tie Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GB-SAE，通过表征因子分解学习统一共享字典与多个私有字典，实现跨模型统一可解释性与特征复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于相似数据分布预训练的基础模型语义结构重叠，但因架构、预训练目标和协议不同导致表征各异，难以统一可解释与跨模型复用特征。现有方法仅对齐潜在坐标，概念本身仍为模型专属，无法共享或复用。

Method: 将统一跨模型可解释性建模为表征因子分解问题，提出门控瓶颈稀疏自编码器（GB-SAE），同时学习统一的共享字典（编码跨模型公共语义结构，可复用）和多个模型专属私有字典（捕捉模型特定偏差残差概念）。

Result: 在ViT、SigLIP、DINOv2、ConvNeXt等不同基础模型上评估，GB-SAE在重建能力、统一且忠实的可解释性、以及对未见模型和下游任务的复用性与泛化能力上均表现优异。

Conclusion: GB-SAE通过共享-私有字典分解实现跨模型统一可解释性与特征复用，代码已开源。

Abstract: Foundation models pretrained on similar data distributions tend to learn overlapping semantic structure, but their representations are distinct due to different model architecture, pretraining objectives and protocols. This prevents unified interpretability and cross-model feature reuse. Existing approaches extract interpretable concepts from individual models and align these concepts in a shared coordinate system using cross-reconstruction objectives, but the alignment only applies to latent coordinates while the concepts themselves remain model-specific and cannot be shared or reused. This paper introduces the Gated Bottleneck Sparse Autoencoder (GB-SAE), which casts unified cross-model interpretability as a representation factorization problem and solves it by simultaneously learning a unified shared dictionary and multiple private model-specific dictionaries via a gated bottleneck sparse autoencoder framework. The shared dictionary encodes the cross-model common semantic structure in unified concepts that are reusable across all participating models (and beyond), while each private dictionary comprises residual concepts that capture model-specific biases. We evaluate GB-SAE with distinct foundation models including ViT, SigLIP, DINOv2, and ConvNeXt. GB-SAE demonstrates superior reconstruction capability, unified and faithful interpretability, strong reusability and generalization to unseen models and downstream tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/trustAIoT/GB-SAE_NeurIPS.

</details>


### [260] [CALFA-KV: Joint Calibration and Fisher-Guided Anchors for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10511)
*Xiancai Tian,Leichao Zhang,Shenhui Zhang,Yi Shan,Hailong Li,Feng Lin,Xiaotian Yu,Aijun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CALFA-KV：离线联合拟合 key 中心、径向归一化参数与 K/V 码本以对齐冻结模型的注意力投影输出，并用交叉熵梯度估计通道级 Fisher 敏感度；在线据此对每个 KV 状态的重建误差加权，在每层每 KV 头预算下挑选最高分状态高精度保存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1-bit KV cache 量化误差较大，单纯量化或选择性高精度存储往往割裂；作者希望把量化器校准与"按重要性保留少量高精度锚点"结合，从而在极低比特下降低重建误差与下游损失。

Method: 1) 离线：联合拟合 key 中心、径向归一化参数和 K/V 向量码本，目标是对齐冻结模型投影后的注意力输出；2) 离线估计通道级 Fisher 型敏感度（参考下一 token 交叉熵损失的梯度平方）；3) 在线：用敏感度加权每个 KV 状态（某层某 KV 头中某 token 的 K/V 对）的平方重建误差并打分；4) 在每层、每 KV 头固定锚点预算下保留最高分状态为高精度；5) 理论：在精确恢复条件下，给出基于分数的锚点选择相对同预算最优解的超额风险上界（风险定义为一阶损失变化的条件均方）。

Result: 在每层每 KV 头额外 56 个 FP16 锚点预算下，CALFA-KV(d8b8) 在三个模型上于七个基准的平均分均优于所有评估的名义 1-bit 基线；同预算下 CALFA-KV(d8b10) 的名义索引率为 1.25 bits/channel，将同指标上与 BF16 的差距缩小到 0.90–2.01 分。

Conclusion: 将校准式码本设计与 Fisher 引导的锚点选择相结合，可在约 1 bit 级别实现稳定的 KV cache 压缩，并以理论界与多基准实验共同支撑其有效性。

Abstract: 1-bit key-value (KV) cache compression can combine quantizer calibration with selective high-precision storage to reduce reconstruction error. We propose Calibration and Fisher-guided Anchors for KV cache compression (CALFA-KV). Offline, we jointly fit a key center, radial normalization parameters, and K/V vector codebooks to match the frozen model's projected attention output. We also estimate channel-wise Fisher-type sensitivities from squared gradients of a reference next-token cross-entropy loss. Online, we use these sensitivities to weight the squared reconstruction errors of each KV state. Here, a KV state is one token's key-value pair within one layer and KV head. We retain the highest-scoring states at high precision under a per-layer, per-KV-head budget. Under exact restoration, we bound the excess risk of score-based anchor selection relative to the optimum at the same anchor budget, where risk is the conditional mean square of the first-order loss change. With a budget of 56 additional FP16 anchors per layer and KV head, CALFA-KV (d8b8) outperforms all evaluated nominal 1-bit baselines on the mean score across seven benchmarks for each of the three models. At the same anchor budget, CALFA-KV (d8b10) uses a nominal index rate of 1.25 bits per channel and narrows the gap to BF16 to 0.90--2.01 points on the same metric.

</details>


### [261] [FADE: Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation for Training-Free Diffusion Transformers Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10514)
*Jinlong Yang,Lizilin,Jinke Wu,Yao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FADE框架，通过分数阶异常扩散动力学建模DiT特征演化，实现免训练的扩散Transformer加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiTs）迭代采样计算开销巨大，现有基于整数阶算子的特征缓存方法难以适应DiT潜轨迹的非平稳、高曲率动态特性，易产生误差累积，因此需要更适配的加速方案。

Method: 揭示DiT特征演化具有异常扩散特性及一定时空异质性；据此提出免训练加速框架FADE，用异常扩散模型刻画特征演化，并采用Mittag-Leffler分数阶算子适应高曲率非线性轨迹；基于复杂动态的跨样本稳定性，通过离线剖析构建多维查找表（LUT），实现极低开销的时空自适应参数在线检索。

Result: 在多种架构与模态上评估，FADE取得SOTA加速效果，在激进跳步间隔下仍保持优异生成保真度，且延迟开销可忽略。

Conclusion: FADE将异常扩散与分数阶算子引入DiT特征预测，结合离线构建的LUT实现高效时空自适应参数检索，为扩散Transformer提供了免训练、低开销、高保真的加速新范式。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as the preeminent paradigm for high-fidelity generative modeling across various modalities, yet their practical deployment is hindered by the severe computational overhead of iterative sampling. While recent feature-caching methods mitigate this latency through feature reuse or forecasting based on integer-order operators, they remain limited in adapting to the non-stationary and highly curved dynamics of DiT latent trajectories. In this work, we reveal that DiT feature evolution exhibits anomalous diffusion characteristics and a certain degree of spatiotemporal heterogeneity, rendering static, integer-order forecasting operators inadequate and prone to error accumulation. To address this, we propose Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation (FADE), a unified framework for training-free diffusion transformers acceleration. FADE models DiT feature evolution via anomalous diffusion and employs a Mittag--Leffler fractional operator to better adapt to high-curvature and non-linear latent trajectories of DiTs. Leveraging the empirical observation that these complex dynamics maintain cross-sample stability, we further construct a Look-Up Table with multiple dimensions through offline profiling. This enables negligible LUT-retrieval overhead, spatiotemporally adaptive parameter retrieval during online inference. Extensive evaluations across diverse architectures and modalities demonstrate that FADE achieves state-of-the-art acceleration, preserving exceptional generation fidelity under aggressive skip intervals with negligible latency overhead. Our project page is available at https://youngkinlon.github.io/fade-project-page/.

</details>


### [262] [Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation: Evaluating Hierarchical Policies from Non-Hierarchical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10543)
*Yunfu Deng,Josiah P. Hanna*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出IO-FQE方法，在增强的状态-选项空间中估计价值函数，实现无需选项标注数据的分层策略离线策略评估，并在长时域连续控制任务上消除朴素FQE的偏差、显著降低MSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线策略评估（OPE）在扁平马尔可夫策略上已有充分研究，但分层策略（高层策略选择时序扩展的选项option，直到终止条件满足）的评估工作很少。现有主要方法是选项级逐步重要性采样，需要带选项标注的轨迹，且方差随时域增长；朴素地把拟合Q评估（FQE）扩展到分层策略会带来策略价值估计的有偏问题。

Method: 提出组内拟合Q评估（Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation, IO-FQE）：在增强的"状态-选项"空间中估计价值函数，从而在数据缺乏选项运行标注时也能进行分层策略的OPE。并给出两种面向连续动作空间的IO-FQE具体实例化。

Result: 在长时域分层连续控制任务（AntMaze导航与OGBench Puzzle操作）上验证：IO-FQE消除了将FQE朴素应用于分层策略所产生的偏差，并相比选项级重要性采样大幅降低均方误差（MSE）。

Conclusion: IO-FQE为分层策略提供了一种低偏差、低方差的OPE方案，且放宽了对选项标注轨迹的依赖，具备在长时域分层连续控制问题上的实用性。

Abstract: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the expected return of a target policy from previously collected data without additional environment interaction. While OPE methods for flat Markovian policies are well studied, little work has addressed evaluating hierarchical policies in which a high-level policy selects temporally extended options that generate primitive actions until a termination condition is met. The primary existing approach applies per-decision importance sampling at the option level, but requires option-annotated trajectories and exhibits variance that still grows with the horizon. For non-hierarchical policies, fitted Q-evaluation (FQE) typically achieves lower error than importance sampling by leveraging the classic Bellman equation for policy evaluation; however, a naive extension of FQE to hierarchical policies results in a biased policy value estimate. In this paper, we introduce Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation (IO-FQE), which estimates a value function in the augmented state-option space; this approach enables OPE of hierarchical policies even when we lack annotations of what option was run in the data. We develop two continuous-action instantiations of IO-FQE and show on long-horizon hierarchical continuous control tasks (AntMaze navigation and OGBench Puzzle manipulation) that IO-FQE eliminates the bias incurred by a naive application of FQE to hierarchical policies and substantially lowers mean squared-error compared to option-level importance sampling.

</details>


### [263] [Dual-Granularity Learning for Regression with Continuous Noisy Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10550)
*Hui Guo,Boyu Wang,Grace Y. Yi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GRAIN双粒度框架，用于带噪声标签的回归：细粒度残差学习解耦标签噪声，粗粒度分箱对比正则保持序结构，并通过直方图桥接双向耦合，提升多种噪声下的鲁棒性与泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分类任务中的噪声标签学习已被广泛研究，但回归场景相对不足。回归标签为连续值且噪声幅度因样本而异，带来冲突需求：中小偏差需对标签值敏感以做实例级修正；大偏差（标注损坏或离群）使精确标签不可靠，需降低对精确标签依赖、利用样本间序结构。因此需统一捕捉全局结构与样本特定偏差。

Method: 提出GRAIN双粒度框架：1）细粒度层面，从鲁棒损失公式推导显式残差学习机制，引入实例特定辅助变量，将标签噪声与预测信号解耦；2）粗粒度层面，引入基于分箱的对比正则，构建与标签邻近度一致、保序的特征结构，处理局部残差修正无法应对的噪声；3）通过基于直方图的桥接机制双向耦合两层：粗粒度结构引导建立有序特征空间以锚定残差学习，细粒度残差修正实例级偏差。

Result: 实验结果表明，GRAIN在多种噪声条件下持续提升鲁棒性与泛化能力。

Conclusion: 双粒度、序结构保持与残差修正相结合，可有效应对回归中的异质标签噪声，为噪声回归提供统一框架。

Abstract: Learning with noisy labels has been extensively studied for classification, yet its regression counterpart remains relatively underexplored. Unlike classification, regression involves continuous-valued targets where label noise exhibits heterogeneous magnitudes across instances, which poses conflicting requirements on the model: correcting small-to-moderate deviations requires sensitivity to label values for instance-level refinement, whereas large deviations caused by corrupted or outlying annotations render exact label values unreliable, necessitating reduced reliance on exact labels and instead leveraging ordinal structure among samples. These requirements call for methods that capture both global structure and sample-specific deviations in a unified manner. To this end, we propose GRAIN, a dual-granularity framework for robust noisy regression. At the fine-grained level, we derive an explicit residual learning mechanism from a robust loss formulation, introducing instance-specific auxiliary variables to decouple label noise from predictive signals. At the coarse-grained level, we introduce a binning-based contrastive regularization that enforces an order-preserving feature structure aligned with label proximity, addressing noise beyond the capacity of local residual refinement. The two levels are coupled via a histogram-based bridging mechanism that enables bidirectional information flow: coarse-grained structural guidance establishes a well-ordered feature space that anchors residual learning, while fine-grained residual refinement corrects instance-level deviations that structural regularization alone cannot resolve. Experimental results show that GRAIN consistently improves robustness and generalization under diverse noise conditions.

</details>


### [264] [Meta-Reinforcement Learning with Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10553)
*Jake Grigsby,Siddhant Agarwal,Yu Lei,Leonidas Varveropoulos,Yuke Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出行为基础模型（BFM）与元强化学习（meta-RL）可作为「固定环境下在线适应新奖励函数」的两类替代方案，并进一步提出混合方法 MetaBFM，使 BFM 能扩展到新环境、新奖励，兼具元 RL 的分布内性能与零样本 RL 的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: meta-RL 需要多样化训练环境与奖励函数，但测试时智能体可能被要求追求任何目标，难以预先穷举所有目标。BFM 从无奖励数据学习策略并支持零样本 RL（ZSRL），近期工作还表明 BFM 的任务推断可在线完成而无需任务专用数据。作者据此认为 BFM 与 meta-RL 是在固定环境中在线适应新奖励的两种互补路线，希望将 BFM 扩展到更一般的设定（含新环境），以在更广范围内与 meta-RL 竞争。

Method: 首先识别出四个挑战：环境识别、在线数据采集、测试时探索、以及混合奖励监督下的学习；随后逐一研究，并提出混合方法 MetaBFM：训练阶段将「监督式奖励跟随」与「无监督学习」结合；测试阶段可在探索、利用与 ZSRL 式奖励推断三者之间插值调节。

Result: MetaBFM 能够达到监督式 meta-RL 的分布内性能水平，同时可泛化到训练集之外的奖励函数；对四个挑战的单独分析也验证了各组件的作用。

Conclusion: BFM 与 meta-RL 是互补的研究方向，二者优势结合可使自适应智能体从有限的固定监督目标中学习到更丰富多样的行为，并支持测试时对新环境与新目标的在线适应。

Abstract: Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) trains agents to adapt to novel tasks from test-time experience, but requires diverse training environments and reward functions. While environments are becoming cheaper to generate, it remains difficult to anticipate every objective an agent may be asked to pursue at test time. Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) learn policies from reward-free data and support zero-shot RL (ZSRL): adaptation to new objectives at test time using a large reward-labeled dataset. Recent work has shown that BFM task inference can instead be performed online without prior task-specific data. We note that this capability positions BFMs and meta-RL as alternative approaches for online adaptation to new reward functions in a fixed environment. We then ask whether we can extend BFMs to compete with meta-RL more broadly, including in novel environments, and identify four challenges: environment identification, online data collection, test-time exploration, and learning from mixed reward supervision. We study each individually, then propose MetaBFM, a hybrid method that addresses all four. During training, it combines supervised reward-following with unsupervised learning; at test time, it can interpolate between exploration, exploitation, and ZSRL-style reward inference. We demonstrate that MetaBFM can recover the in-distribution performance of supervised meta-RL while generalizing to reward functions outside the training set. Our work suggests that BFMs and meta-RL are complementary research directions whose combined strengths allow adaptive agents to learn more diverse behaviors from a fixed set of supervised objectives.

</details>


### [265] [Confronting Uncertainty in Mechanism-AI Coupled Dynamical Systems via Optimal Transport and Information Geometry: Part I. Distribution Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10563)
*Pengfei Song,Yanni Xiao,Shuangshuang Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文从最优传输与信息几何视角，为机制-AI耦合动力系统中的不确定性建立统一的数学表述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机制-AI耦合动力系统常用于复杂生物系统研究，但噪声、稀疏和不完全观测带来的不确定性限制其可靠性，亟需系统化的不确定性刻画与量化框架。

Method: 将不确定性量化表述为Riemannian度量下概率密度空间上能量泛函的极小化问题，损失通过微分方程评估；统一描述Wasserstein与Fisher-Rao等度量下的梯度流，并用抽象伴随敏感性分析给出相应数值求解方法。

Result: 该表述将多种动力系统贝叶斯推断方法纳入统一框架，并在相同计算预算下通过数值实验比较后验近似与预测不确定性。

Conclusion: 研究为动力系统建模及异质性演化提供了几何视角，并连接了多种贝叶斯推断方法。

Abstract: Mechanism-AI coupled dynamical systems are increasingly used to study complex biological systems. However, uncertainty associated with noisy, sparse, and partially observed data limits their reliability. This paper presents a systematic mathematical formulation for treating these uncertainties from the perspective of optimal transport and information geometry. We formulate the uncertainty quantification problem as the minimization of an energy functional on a probability density space equipped with a Riemannian metric, with the loss evaluated through a differential equation, and give a unified description of the gradient flows of the energy functional under specific metrics, such as the Wasserstein and Fisher-Rao metrics. Furthermore, we present corresponding numerical methods for solving these gradient flows using abstract adjoint sensitivity analysis. The formulation connects a range of Bayesian inference methods for dynamical systems; numerical experiments compare posterior approximation and predictive uncertainty under a common computational budget. Moreover, it also provides a geometric perspective on dynamical modeling and the study of heterogeneity evolution.

</details>


### [266] [Predictive Modelling of Solid Waste Generation through Time Series Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10579)
*Mitra Tithi Dey,Punyasha Chatterjee,Amlan Chakrabarti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文基于斯里兰卡2012–2018年真实生活垃圾数据，系统比较SARIMAX、Prophet、LSTM、GRU四种时间序列模型，并分析节假日、工作日/周末、季节、温湿度等因素对垃圾产生量的影响，结果显示LSTM与SARIMAX整体预测性能最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确预测城市生活垃圾产量对资源规划、收运调度和降低环境影响至关重要；现有研究存在不足，如缺乏下级行政单元的细粒度数据、数据集规模小，且往往忽略节假日、周末、季节性、温度与湿度等影响垃圾产生的关键因素。

Method: 采用斯里兰卡2012–2018年真实MSW数据，对SARIMAX、Prophet、LSTM、GRU四种常用时间序列预测模型进行综合对比；并开展分因素分析，考察节假日、周内/周末差异、季节模式以及气温、湿度对垃圾产生行为的影响；以MAE、MAPE、RMSE和R²评价模型性能。

Result: 节假日与周末垃圾产生量较低；夏季与冬季较高，季风期与后季风期相对较低；温度与湿度同垃圾产生量无直接线性关系，但其季节变化与不同季节垃圾产生量变化相关联。LSTM与SARIMAX取得最佳整体预测性能。

Conclusion: 多维因素驱动的分因素分析有助于刻画垃圾产生规律，LSTM与SARIMAX在真实MSW数据上表现最优，可为城市固废管理与收运规划提供可靠预测支撑。

Abstract: Reliable forecasting of Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) production is pivotal for sustainable urban management, as it enables efficient resource planning, optimized collection schedules, and reduced environmental impacts. Existing works on MSW forecasting have some limitations, such as unavailability of granular data from lower administrative units, small datasets, limited or sometimes no consideration of important factors that can affect MSW generation, including holidays, weekends, seasonality, changes in temperature or humidity.
  This work presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of four popularly used time series forecasting models, namely Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Regressors (SARIMAX), Prophet, Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), using a real-world MSW dataset from Sri Lanka spanning 2012-2018. A detailed factor-wise analysis is conducted to examine waste generation behaviour considering holidays, weekday-weekend variations, seasonal patterns, temperature and humidity. The results show lower waste generation during holidays and weekends, higher generation during Summer and Winter, and comparatively lower generation during Monsoon and Post-Monsoon. Temperature and humidity do not exhibit a direct linear relationship with waste generation, although their seasonal variations are associated with the changes in waste generation across different seasons. All model performances are evaluated using Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and the coefficient of determination (R2). Among the evaluated models, LSTM and SARIMAX achieve the best overall forecasting performance.

</details>


### [267] [Detent: Batch-Invariant LLM Serving and RL Rollouts at Near-Stock Speed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10611)
*Peixu Xin,Runchuan Feng,Jiazhen Guo,Kan Wu,Ming Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Detent将LLM引擎的核函数选择表达为可执行程序，只需固定该程序中少数依赖批次的值即可实现批次不变性，在几乎不损失延迟的前提下达到确定性推理与RL可复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复现评测、可验证推理与同策略RL需要同一请求在不同批次组合下产生逐位相同的输出。现有引擎的确定性模式通过为每个算子保留单一保守核函数来消除批次依赖，但代价是显著的延迟开销；而许多快速核函数本身已具备批次不变性，真正的问题在于核函数选择所读取的少数批次相关取值。

Method: 将核函数选择建模为一个由引擎执行的程序，在其中自动寻找必须固定的最少取值集合，并针对具体工作负载在部署前对这些取值进行调优（tuning），从而在不替换快速核函数的情况下实现批次不变性。

Result: 在vLLM与SGLang上部署Llama-3.1-70B与Qwen3-30B-A3B的多GPU环境中，Detent保持批次不变；按负载调优后每输出token延迟为Stock（各引擎标准设置）的1.04–1.17倍，而确定性模式为1.67–10.3倍。SGLang下与确定性模式的GSM8K准确率持平，并覆盖多引擎、多GPU代际、不同张量并行度及稠密/MoE模型。带种子的RL rollout在至Llama-3.1-70B的模型上可跨批次与缓存切分逐位重放；基于Detent核函数与取值的训练器可逐位匹配rollout logprob，每token耗时为Stock的1.03倍，BF16 GRPO保持稳定，而Stock的运行崩溃。

Conclusion: 批次不变性不必以牺牲延迟为代价：只需固定核函数选择程序中少量批次相关取值即可，Detent在推理与RL训练场景下均实现了逐位可复现性，同时接近标准引擎的延迟，并显著优于现有确定性模式。

Abstract: Reproducible evaluation, verifiable inference and on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) need an LLM engine to give a request the same output bits whichever requests share its batch. Batch-invariant kernels exist, but engines still select each kernel and its parameters from the batch. Two kernels that compute the same sum can round it differently. The engines' deterministic modes remove the choice by keeping one conservative kernel per operator and pay for it in latency. Many fast kernels are batch-invariant by themselves, so it is enough to fix the few batch-dependent values that kernel selection reads. Detent expresses kernel selection as a program that the engine executes. It finds the fewest values in this program that must be fixed and tunes them for the workload before deployment. On multi-GPU deployments of Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen3-30B-A3B in vLLM and SGLang, Detent is batch-invariant. Tuned per load, it serves at 1.04-1.17x the latency per output token of Stock (each engine with its standard settings), against 1.67-10.3x for the deterministic modes. In SGLang it matches the GSM8K accuracy of SGLang's deterministic mode. Detent covers multiple deployment combinations, including multiple engines, GPU generations, tensor-parallel degrees, and dense and MoE models. Seeded RL rollouts of models up to Llama-3.1-70B replay bit for bit under other batches and cache splits. A trainer on Detent's kernels and values matches every rollout logprob bit for bit at 1.03x Stock's rollout time per token. BF16 GRPO then stays stable where Stock's run collapses.

</details>


### [268] [Clinical Evidence-Guided Residual Learning for Medication Recommendation with Dynamic DDI Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10613)
*Zesheng Li,Chengchang Pan,Honggang Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EviDrug：以临床证据引导的残差学习框架，用访视感知编码器、训练病例记忆与药物集交互模块构建患者特异处方，并以DDI反馈自适应调控正则强度；在三个ICU数据集上AP、F1、Jaccard均领先12个基线，且参数与运行成本低于MetaDrug。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物推荐需同时融合患者特异的治疗证据与处方内部的交互结构。核心难点在于：判断哪些证据支持某一药物，并在保持预测质量的前提下确定交互项的正则化强度。

Method: 提出EviDrug残差学习框架。临床记忆主干由自训练的访视感知编码器、训练病例记忆库和一个药物集交互模块组成，用于生成患者特异处方；门控精炼头将主干状态、临床关联与历史条件化的药物表示结合，通过有界logit修正进行微调；利用DDI反馈，依据训练查询预测自适应调整正则化强度。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV、NWICU、SICdb三个数据集上，EviDrug在AP、F1、Jaccard上优于12个已发表方法，AP分别比最强基线提升2.26、2.06、1.71个百分点；相较MetaDrug参数更少、运行成本更低；对照实验显示DDI减少且预测质量稳定。

Conclusion: 将患者特异证据检索与药物交互结构学习相结合，并通过DDI反馈动态控制正则化，可在不牺牲预测性能的情况下提升药物推荐准确性并降低潜在药物相互作用，具备较好的效率优势。

Abstract: Medication recommendation must combine patient-specific treatment evidence with the interaction structure of a prescription. The central challenge is to determine which evidence supports each medication and how strongly to regularize interactions while preserving predictive quality. We propose EviDrug, a clinical evidence-guided residual learning framework. Its clinical-memory backbone integrates a self-trained visit-aware encoder, training-case memory and one medication-set interaction block to establish a patient-specific prescription. A gated refinement head combines the backbone states with clinical associations and history-conditioned medication identities through bounded logit corrections. Drug-drug interaction (DDI) feedback adapts regularization strength using training-query predictions. Across MIMIC-IV, NWICU and SICdb, EviDrug leads twelve published-method baselines in AP, F1 and Jaccard, improving AP by 2.26, 2.06 and 1.71 percentage points over the strongest comparator. These gains come at lower parameter and runtime costs than MetaDrug. Matched controls demonstrate DDI reductions with stable predictive quality. Code is available at https://github.com/LIZESHENG13/EviDrug.

</details>


### [269] [What Do Collusion Probes Read? Three Pitfalls in Evaluating Multi-Agent Collusion Monitors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10620)
*Mainul Hasan Mohsin,Mohammad Shahidur Rahman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出激活探针看似能完美检测LLM智能体间的秘密串通，实则主要检测"被指示串通"而非"决定串通"；新基准通过引入拒绝指令的智能体区分二者，并揭示三类评估陷阱，最终给出更严谨的监测协议与在线监测方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作宣称激活探针（activation probes）可近乎完美地监测LLM智能体之间的秘密串通，但这些评估可能混淆了"智能体收到串通指令"与"智能体真正决定串通"两种情况，导致监测能力被高估。作者希望厘清探针究竟在读什么，并建立更可靠的评估方法。

Method: 构建新基准：2,500个委员会场景与1,476个代码审查场景，并加入"收到串通指令但拒绝执行"的智能体，从而把"指令"与"决策"分离开来。在此基础上评估已发表的检测器与自研探针，做消融（去掉指令信息）、对比"投票后评分"与"投票前检测"、统计公开辩论行为比例，并训练基于智能体自身选择的探针；同时将扫描统计量（scan statistics）改造为适用于任意规模群体的在线监测器。

Result: 已发表检测器几乎无法区分串通者与拒绝者；最佳探针在很大程度上是在读取指令信息——去掉指令后智能体AUROC从1.00骤降至0.61。另发现两个夸大结果的陷阱：若在投票之后评分，仅读取投票的简单规则也能达到AUROC 0.990，但投票前毫无检测能力；57%的尝试中没有任何串通者在公开场合为目标辩护。而"决策"本身仍可被读出：用智能体自身选择训练的探针在无指令信息时AUROC为0.73；其目标被微调进权重的串通者也能被探针检出（AUROC 0.995，预注册）。

Conclusion: 现有串通监测评估存在系统性高估，激活探针主要反映指令而非决策。作者将上述对照实验整理成一套可测试任意串通监测器的协议，并把扫描统计量适配为适用于任意规模群体的在线监测方法，为LLM智能体串通监测提供了更严谨的评估与部署范式。

Abstract: Activation probes look like near-perfect monitors for secret collusion among large language model (LLM) agents. We show that they mostly detect that an agent was told to collude, not that it decided to. Our benchmark (2,500 committee and 1,476 code-review episodes) adds agents who receive the collusion instruction and refuse it, separating instruction from decision. Published detectors barely tell colluders from these refusers, and our best probe separates them mostly by reading the instruction: without it, agent AUROC falls from 1.00 to 0.61. Two further pitfalls inflate reported results: scored after the vote, a rule that only reads the votes reaches AUROC 0.990 but finds nothing before it; and in 57% of attempts no colluder argues for the target in public. The decision is still there: a probe trained on agents' own choices reads it (AUROC 0.73 without the instruction), and probes find colluders whose goal was fine-tuned into the weights (AUROC 0.995; pre-registered). We turn the controls into a protocol for testing any collusion monitor, and adapt scan statistics into an online monitor for groups of any size.

</details>


### [270] [Causal Heteroscedastic Structure Learning From Incomplete Temporal data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10668)
*Abdellah Rahmani,Pascal Frossard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Cheesefill，一个基于最优传输的框架，用于在缺失值与异方差噪声同时存在时学习多变量时间序列的因果结构，通过条件归一化流参数化因果机制并联合学习随机校正映射，将朴素插补精化为与推断因果机制一致的轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变量时间序列因果发现面临三重障碍：一是数据普遍存在缺失值，"先插补再发现"的流水线会扭曲数据分布并产生虚假因果图；二是瞬时效应本身难以识别，缺失又使插补与图恢复相互纠缠；三是真实数据常带异方差噪声，其方差由瞬时原因与滞后原因共同驱动，违背标准方法的核心假设。现有方法通常只假设数据完整、噪声同方差或关系严格滞后，无法同时应对上述问题。作者进一步通过消融实验表明，顺序地而非联合地解决这些问题会导致性能显著下降。

Method: Cheesefill 将因果机制用条件归一化流（conditional normalizing flows）参数化，并联合学习一个随机校正映射，把朴素插补结果修正为与推断出的因果机制一致的时间序列轨迹。理论上证明：在随机校正映射上优化等价于 Kantorovich 问题的条件核（conditional kernel）重构，由此神经参数化可给出可处理的目标函数。

Result: 在合成数据与真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，Cheesefill 在多种缺失机制（缺失率与缺失模式）下均持续优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 缺失值、瞬时效应与异方差噪声必须联合建模而非分步处理；将因果发现与插补统一为最优传输框架，可有效缓解插补偏差与虚假因果边，为真实场景下的时间序列因果发现提供理论支撑与实用方案。

Abstract: Discovering causal structures in multivariate time series (MTS) is critical in domains such as finance and neuroscience, yet remains challenging in practice due to three distinct obstacles. First, MTS are routinely corrupted by missing values, where naive impute-then-discover pipelines distort the underlying data distribution and yield spurious causal graphs. Second, identifying instantaneous effects is difficult even on complete data, and missingness further entangles imputation with graph recovery. Third, real-world data frequently exhibits heteroscedastic noise with variance driven by both instantaneous and lagged causes, violating the core assumptions of standard discovery methods. Existing approaches fail to address these challenges concurrently, typically presuming complete data, homoscedastic noise, or strictly time-lagged relationships. Crucially, we show through ablation studies that resolving these issues sequentially, rather than jointly, leads to a substantial degradation in performance. To overcome this, we introduce Cheesefill, an optimal transport framework for causal structure learning under missingness and heteroscedastic noise. Cheesefill parameterizes causal mechanisms using conditional normalizing flows and jointly learns a stochastic correction map that refines naive imputations into trajectories consistent with the inferred causal mechanisms. Theoretically, we prove that optimizing over stochastic correction maps is equivalent to a conditional kernel reformulation of the Kantorovich problem, from which our neural parameterization yields a tractable objective. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that Cheesefill consistently outperforms existing baselines across diverse missingness regimes.

</details>


### [271] [Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning using Behavior Regularisation and Latent Feasibility Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10677)
*Mahesh Keswani,Parth Bhardwaj,Ankur Kumar,Raunak P. Bhattacharyya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FOCAL：将行为正则化策略梯度融入CVAE演员，并按可行性划分一阶优化目标，实现安全离线强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全离线RL需在满足安全约束的同时最大化回报。现有基于可达性分析提取策略的方法多用AWR，但其指数加权会放大价值估计误差，且未能像行为正则化策略梯度那样有效利用学习到的critic。

Method: FOCAL将行为正则化策略梯度嵌入条件变分自编码器（CVAE）演员；用按状态可行性划分的一阶目标更新actor：可行转移上提升回报，不可行转移上降低约束违反；推理时依据状态可行性动态调整潜在先验尺度以调节动作采样保守性。

Result: 理论上证明AWR的策略更新方差随优势误差指数增长，而FOCAL仅随价值估计误差方差线性增长；在DSRL基准上，FOCAL在所有评估任务均满足约束，并获得与基线相当或更高的回报。

Conclusion: FOCAL通过可行性分区的一阶策略梯度与CVAE演员，避免了AWR指数加权的不稳定性，在安全离线RL中兼顾约束满足与回报表现。

Abstract: Safe offline reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to learn policies that maximize return while satisfying safety constraints, using a static dataset. To characterize state-wise safety, reachability analysis identifies the feasible region, defined as the set of states from which constraints can be satisfied at every future step. Policies are commonly extracted from learned value functions with advantage-weighted regression (AWR). However, AWR relies on exponentiated weights that amplify value estimation errors, whereas behavior-regularized policy gradient methods directly utilize the action gradient of the value function and often make more effective use of learned critics. We propose Feasibility-Optimized Conditional Actor Learning (FOCAL), a method that incorporates behavior-regularized policy gradients into a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) actor. FOCAL optimizes this policy using a first-order objective partitioned by feasibility, updating the actor to increase return on transitions estimated to be feasible and to reduce constraint violations on transitions estimated to be infeasible. During inference, FOCAL dynamically adjusts the scale of the latent prior according to the estimated feasibility of the state to adjust the conservatism of action sampling. Theoretically, we show that for AWR, the policy update variance depends exponentially on the advantage error, whereas for FOCAL it scales linearly with the variance of the value estimation error. Across the DSRL benchmark, FOCAL satisfies the constraints on all evaluated tasks while achieving competitive or higher returns compared to baselines.

</details>


### [272] [A Geometric Theory for Nonequilibrium Transformer Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10691)
*Aythami Bethencourt de León,Darryl D. Holm*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 建立基于统计物理的变分几何框架，用自由能与Fisher–Rao梯度流刻画固定参数下Transformer注意力权重与token表示的联合演化，并给出收敛性、跟踪界、能量耗散和全局适定性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer中注意力权重与token表示会共同演化，但缺少从统计物理和几何视角统一描述其连续时间动力学、稳定性与收敛性的理论框架。

Method: 为注意力定义自由能，并令注意力权重沿Fisher–Rao梯度流演化；在固定表示下分析softmax极小性；在时变表示下通过logit变量变换研究线性化动力学；将表示及其动量的Hamiltonian动力学与同一能量驱动的注意力弛豫耦合；进一步构造两个引入attention value map的Hamiltonian。

Result: 证明softmax矩阵是唯一自由能极小元且正注意力轨迹收敛到它；给出相对瞬时softmax的跟踪界及注意力收敛到固定矩阵的充分条件；耦合系统满足能量耗散律；证明注意力流及三个耦合系统的全局适定性。

Conclusion: 论文为Transformer注意力与token表示的联合演化提供了统一的变分几何与统计物理理论，给出动力学收敛性、能量耗散与适定性的理论保证。

Abstract: We develop a variational and geometric theory based on statistical physics for the joint evolution of Transformer attention and token representations at fixed model parameters. To this end, we introduce a free energy for the attention and model the evolution of the attention weights by its Fisher--Rao gradient flow. At fixed token representations, we prove that the softmax matrix is the unique free-energy minimiser and that every positive attention trajectory converges to it. For prescribed time-dependent representations, we show that the attention dynamics becomes linear after a change to logit variables. This result yields tracking bounds relative to the instantaneous softmax and sufficient conditions for attention to converge to a fixed matrix. Hamiltonian dynamics for the representations and their momenta are then coupled to the attention relaxation driven by the same energy. This coupling results in an energy-dissipation law. We also develop two alternative Hamiltonians incorporating the attention value map. We prove global well-posedness of the attention flow and all three coupled systems.

</details>


### [273] [Spectral Bias Reduction in Local Gated ReLU Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10700)
*Victorita Dolean*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文从Gram矩阵谱的角度分析浅层ReLU模型的谱偏置，提出门控局部ReLU字典，并证明其在L²回归中可显著缓解谱偏置，但在H¹能量损失中会保持甚至反转频率排序，需预条件器才能修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度训练神经网络普遍存在低频学得快、高频学得慢的谱偏置，但哪些架构选择能缓解谱偏置仍不清楚；作者希望在可解析的浅层ReLU线性参数模型中统一分析L²回归与H¹变分/物理信息损失。

Method: 将每个模式的学习速率刻画为Gram矩阵特征值，并针对一般对称双线性形式a(·,·)分析；提出将ReLU特征乘以hat单位分解权重的门控局部ReLU字典。由此Gram矩阵对任意局部双线性形式呈块带状，内部为块Toeplitz结构，并由矩阵值符号控制谱性质。

Result: 对L²回归，符号下界远离零，谱比不随窗口数增加而恶化，匹配模型规模下频率相关学习速率离散度从1.9×10^5降至4.5；对H¹刚度矩阵，符号在零频处消失，门控不能改善Θ(N²)条件数，反而反转频率排序。用同一内部模板构造的预条件器可消除谱偏置。1D回归与Poisson实验验证这种二分性，且回归效果在隐层参数也被训练时仍存在。

Conclusion: 架构层面的门控局部字典可有效缓解L²回归中的谱偏置，但对H¹变分损失单独依靠架构不足；需要与离散算子结构匹配的预条件器，说明损失形式与架构需协同设计。

Abstract: Neural networks trained by gradient-based methods learn the low-frequency content of a target function faster than its high-frequency content. This spectral bias is well documented, but it is much less clear which architectural choices mitigate it and which cannot. We study the question for shallow ReLU models linear in their trainable parameters, where each mode is learned at a rate given by a Gram-matrix eigenvalue, and for a general symmetric bilinear form $a(\cdot,\cdot)$, so that least-squares regression ($a=$ the $L^2$ inner product) and variational or physics-informed losses ($a=$ the $H^1$ energy form) are two instances of one analysis.
  Within this framework we propose gated local ReLU dictionaries, obtained by multiplying each ReLU feature by a hat partition-of-unity weight, in the spirit of partition-of-unity finite elements and overlapping Schwarz methods.
