On MMLU-Pro, it achieves 1.145% pooled savings with no observed harm. Further analysis shows that the intervention captures decision stability rather than correctness (AUROC 0.502). These results demonstrate the potential of causal activation probes for efficient inference-time control without permanent model modification.

</details>


### [308] [Target Recoverability under Selective Labels: A Failure Mode in ECG-Based Acute Coronary Syndrome Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11063)
*Alexander Schubert,Anton Håkansson,Ziad Obermeyer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在选择性标签（selective labels）场景下，若诊断目标包含模型输入无法检测的病例（undetectable cases），会导致测试人群中看似可预测的关系在未测试人群中失效甚至反转。作者形式化该机制，以ECG预测急性冠脉综合征（ACS）为实证：在导管检查患者中AUROC 0.740-0.770，但在未测试患者的30天MACE预测中AUROC仅0.381-0.478（劣于随机）；而只用ECG可见亚型训练的模型AUROC达0.680-0.709，用不稳定心绞痛训练的模型AUROC为0.310（反向）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学ML模型常从"医生选择检测的患者"的标签中学习。选择性标签偏差已被广泛认知，但另一个被忽视的问题是：当诊断目标包含模型的输入本身无法检测的病例时会发生什么。由于检测决策依赖模型看不到的信息，这些不可检测病例在已测试人群中可能显得"可预测"，从而产生在未测试人群中失效甚至方向反转的虚假关系。作者希望系统化这一机制并验证其危害。

Method: 1）形式化"选择性标签 + 不可检测病例"导致虚假关联的机制；2）通过模拟验证该效应会随检测选择性升高、不可检测病例比例增加而加剧，而仅在可检测病例上训练的模型仍保持信息量；3）实证：以心电图（ECG）预测急性冠脉综合征（ACS），用血运重建作为ACS代理标签，对比三个ECG基础模型微调后在"导管检查患者"与"未测试患者"两类人群中的表现；并比较不同ACS亚型（ECG可见 vs. 不稳定心绞痛等可能无ECG改变的亚型）训练的效果。

Result: 模拟显示该偏差随测试选择性增强和不可检测病例增多而恶化，而仅用可检测病例训练的模型仍具信息量。实证中，三个ECG基础模型在导管检查患者中表现良好（AUROC 0.740-0.770），但在未测试患者的30天主要不良心血管事件（MACE）上劣于随机（AUROC 0.381-0.478）。用ECG可见亚型训练的模型保持区分度（AUROC 0.680-0.709），而用不稳定心绞痛（可无ECG改变）训练的模型与风险呈反向关系（AUROC 0.310）。

Conclusion: 在选择性标签条件下，有效学习要求两点：①预测目标必须能从模型输入中被推断（即可检测性）；②评估必须在预期的部署人群中进行，而部署人群常常超出被检测过的患者范围。忽视这两点会导致模型在真实部署中失效甚至反向预测。

Abstract: Medical machine learning models often learn from diagnoses observed only in patients clinicians chose to test. The biases of such selective labels are well known, but less understood is what happens when a diagnosis includes cases the model's inputs cannot detect. Because testing decisions draw on information the model does not see, these cases can appear predictable among tested patients, producing relationships that fail, and can even reverse, among the untested. We formalize this mechanism and show in simulations that it worsens as testing becomes more selective or undetectable cases more common, while models trained only on detectable cases remain informative. We empirically study electrocardiogram (ECG)-based prediction of acute coronary syndrome (ACS), which is confirmed only by invasive testing and whose subtypes differ in how clearly they appear on the ECG. Three ECG foundation models fine-tuned on revascularization, our ACS proxy, performed well among catheterized patients (AUROC 0.740-0.770) but worse than chance for 30-day major adverse cardiovascular events among untested patients (AUROC 0.381-0.478). Models trained on ECG-visible subtypes retained discrimination (AUROC 0.680-0.709), whereas a model trained on unstable angina, which can occur without ECG changes, was inversely related to risk (AUROC 0.310). Under selective labels, effective learning therefore requires prediction targets that can be inferred from the model's inputs and evaluation in the intended deployment population, which often extends beyond the patients who were tested.

</details>


### [309] [Discrete Diffusion Playground: A 2D Benchmark for Discrete Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11068)
*Justin Shao,Sihyun Park,David Ryan Koes,Maria Chikina*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出离散扩散训练场（Discrete Diffusion Playground）诊断基准：用精确离散双射把已知2D连续分布转成二值token序列，使生成样本可解码回2D并与真值分布直接比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散是类别生成建模的有前景框架，但现有评测协议往往无法揭示模型是否真正学到了目标分布（代理指标可能掩盖分布失配）。需要一个训练在离散序列上、又能回到已知真值分布进行直接比较的严格测试平台。

Method: 构建诊断基准：通过精确的离散化双射将已知2D连续分布（平滑高斯混合、倾斜棋盘格，含锐利边界、不连通支撑、坐标相关结构）转为二值token序列；支持精确网格散度、Wasserstein距离、密度可视化与非参数两样本检验。并在该平台上对比掩码扩散与自回归模型，附加反转/交错token顺序的对照实验。

Result: 掩码扩散模型能学到有意义的自适应揭示顺序，但在平滑目标上稳定性劣于自回归基线，在倾斜棋盘格上基本失败；自回归模型能保持目标几何结构，且对照实验表明其优势并非仅来自有利的比特顺序。标准代理指标会掩盖这些失败。

Conclusion: Playground 提供了一个简单而严苛的基准，可用于压力测试离散生成模型，并推动开发能检测真实分布失配（而非代理性能）的评测指标；代码已开源。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion is a promising framework for categorical generative modeling, but current evaluation protocols often fail to reveal whether models have actually learned the target distribution. We introduce the Discrete Diffusion Playground, a diagnostic benchmark that converts known 2D continuous distributions into binary token sequences through an exact discretized bijection. This creates a rare setting in which models are trained on discrete sequences, but generated samples can be decoded back into 2D and compared directly against a known ground-truth distribution. The benchmark spans smooth Gaussian mixtures and tilted checkerboards with sharp boundaries, disconnected support, and coordinate-dependent structure, allowing it to expose failures that are invisible in standard proxy metrics. It supports exact grid divergences, Wasserstein distances, density visualizations, and nonparametric two-sample tests, providing both quantitative evaluation and interpretable failure diagnosis. Using this testbed, we show that masked diffusion models can learn meaningful adaptive reveal orders but remain less stable than autoregressive baselines on smooth targets and largely fail on tilted checkerboards, where autoregressive models preserve the target geometry. Control experiments with reversed and interleaved token orderings show that autoregressive performance is not explained by favorable bit order alone. The Playground provides a simple but stringent benchmark for stress-testing discrete generative models and for developing evaluation metrics that detect real distributional mismatch rather than proxy performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/shaojus/DiscreteDiffusionPlayground .

</details>


### [310] [System Prompts Affect Response Bias More Than Discriminability in LLM Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11074)
*Mohan W. Gupta,Sandy Tanwisuth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过交叉八类安全任务系统提示与三种清晰度水平，在HarmBench、XSTest、IHEval上评估13个模型，并用信号检测理论区分"辨别力"与"拒绝倾向"，发现系统提示主要改变模型的拒绝意愿而非辨别安全/不安全请求的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型安全评估多聚焦"合规—拒绝"权衡（该拒则拒、该答则答），忽略了同一请求在不同系统提示下可触发不同任务选择这一更广泛的现象；仅看拒绝率也无法区分模型是"更能辨别安全性"还是"更倾向于拒绝"。

Method: 构建受控评估：将8类安全任务提示族与3种清晰度水平交叉，固定HarmBench、XSTest、IHEval的评测样本，评估13个模型；引入信号检测理论，将表现分解为辨别力（区分安全与不安全请求的能力）与响应标准（拒绝意愿）。

Result: 模型间辨别力差异显著，但系统提示主要改变拒绝意愿，对辨别力影响较小且不一致；提高提示清晰度使模型更愿意拒绝，却未可靠提升辨别能力；除拒绝外，不同提示族还会使模型在澄清、安全帮助等六种行为策略间发生迁移。

Conclusion: 系统提示主要改变模型对安全相关请求的响应方式（响应标准/行为策略），而非持续提升其区分安全与不安全请求的能力；安全评估应超越单一拒绝率指标，纳入提示条件下的任务选择与辨别力分析。

Abstract: Large language model safety evaluations often focus on a compliance-refusal tradeoff: models should refuse unsafe requests without refusing safe ones. We argue that this misses a broader form of prompt-conditioned task selection, where the same request can elicit different behaviors depending on the system prompt. We investigate this using a controlled evaluation crossing eight safety-task prompt families with three clarity levels across HarmBench, XSTest, and IHEval. Holding benchmark items fixed, we evaluate 13 models and use signal detection theory to distinguish two possibilities: whether models become better at telling safe from unsafe requests (discriminability), or simply more willing to refuse (response criterion). We find substantial differences in discriminability across models, but system prompts primarily shift the willingness to refuse, with smaller and less consistent effects on discriminability. Increasing prompt clarity makes models more willing to refuse without reliably improving their ability to distinguish safe from unsafe requests. Beyond refusal, prompt families also shift responses among six distinct behavioral policies, including clarification and safe help. Together, these findings show that system prompts primarily change how models respond to safety-relevant requests rather than consistently improving their ability to distinguish safe from unsafe ones.

</details>


### [311] [When Calibration Data Matter in Sub-4-Bit Language Model Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11079)
*Yehong Jiang,Yen-Kuang Chen,Xinmin Tian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 FragCal-DC：在通用文本校准中补充“低精度下保真度骤降”的任务族训练文档，并系统比较六种数据相关量化方法在 1.7B–8B 六个稠密模型、十个任务上的表现。结果显示，任务信息校准对迭代式 SignRound V2 与 OmniQuant 在 2-bit 最有效；SignRound V2 平均提升 1.83 个百分点，70B 上 GPTQ 与 SignRound V2 也在 2-bit 受益。恢复主要集中于校准中包含的任务族，且重建误差变化并不能稳定解释精度增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特训练后量化虽能降低语言模型内存，却可能显著损害下游任务精度。现有校准通常依赖通用文本，但“任务相关信息何时能恢复精度、哪些量化器会受益”仍缺乏系统认识。

Method: 提出 FragCal-DC：先用 2-bit 扫描找出全精度精度保留较低的任务族，再将相应训练文档补充进通用文本校准。采用 2–4-bit 扫描定位可用功能区间，并进行四随机种子校准比较；覆盖六种数据相关量化方法、六个 1.7B–8B 稠密模型和十个任务，另在 70B 模型上验证。

Result: 在最低可用功能比特宽度下，迭代式 SignRound V2 与 OmniQuant 在 2-bit 改善明显，而单遍 GPTQ 与 AWQ 主要在 3-bit 呈较小平均响应。2-bit SignRound V2 在六个模型上相对通用文本校准的平均十任务精度提升 1.83 个百分点；70B 上 GPTQ 与 SignRound V2 在 2-bit 也均改善。任务级控制表明，恢复集中于校准所包含的任务族，即使答案标签设计错误仍保留约 90% 的平均精度增益；重建误差变化与精度增益并不稳定相关。

Conclusion: 任务信息驱动的校准可作为低比特量化中保持下游精度的设计原则；但收益依赖量化器类型、比特宽度和任务族匹配，且不能简单用重建误差预测下游精度恢复。

Abstract: Low-bit post-training quantization reduces language-model memory but can sharply degrade downstream task accuracy. Calibration usually relies on generic text, but when task-informed data recover accuracy and which quantizers benefit remain poorly understood. We introduce FragCal-DC, which supplements generic text with training documents from task families with low retention of full-precision accuracy in a two-bit scan. We use a two- to four-bit sweep to locate functional regimes and four-seed calibration comparisons to evaluate six data-dependent methods across six dense models (1.7B-8B) and ten tasks. At their lowest tested functional bit widths, iterative SignRound V2 and OmniQuant improve at two bits, whereas single-pass GPTQ and AWQ show small mean responses at three bits. At two bits, SignRound V2 gains 1.83 percentage points in mean ten-task accuracy over generic-text calibration across six models. At 70 billion parameters, GPTQ and SignRound V2 both improve at two bits, with functional generic-calibration baselines. For two-bit SignRound V2, task-level controls show that recovery concentrates on families included in calibration, while incorrect answer designations retain about 90% of the mean accuracy gain. Changes in reconstruction error do not consistently track accuracy gains. These findings support task-informed calibration as a design principle for preserving downstream accuracy in low-bit quantization.

</details>


### [312] [A Hierarchical Tokenization Framework for Voxel-Level fMRI Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11081)
*Karanpartap Singh,Yue Zhao,Mohammad H. Abbasi,Ehsan Adeli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HBAR 提出一种分层 token 化框架，将体素级静息态 fMRI 组织为体素组-脑区-大尺度功能网络的多尺度表示，在最高约 415 倍压缩下仍优于同压缩率扁平 tokenizer，并系统比较了固定图谱、全学习与软先验引导的分层结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维神经影像数据需要紧凑表示，但常规脑区划分会丢失精细空间信息，且结构化先验在表示学习中的作用尚缺乏系统研究。

Method: 构建 HBAR 分层 token 化框架，将体素级静息态 fMRI 逐级聚合为子脑区体素组、脑区和功能网络；支持固定图谱、全学习和软先验引导三种层级，并采用离散 token 与多尺度结构进行表示学习。

Result: 在 HCP-YA 上，约 415 倍压缩时 HBAR 的脑区与网络相关性高于同压缩率扁平 tokenizer；52 倍压缩下打乱解剖分组使脑区相关性从 0.920 降至 0.886；自回归训练下人口学读出显示层级结构可能带来收益。

Conclusion: HBAR 将子脑区输入、紧凑离散 token 与多尺度脑结构结合，为高维神经影像数据的表示学习提供了实用框架，并表明结构化分层先验有助于提升表示质量。

Abstract: We introduce HBAR (Hierarchical Brain Activity Representation), a hierarchical tokenization framework for learning compact, multi-scale representations of neuroimaging data. HBAR organizes voxel-level resting-state fMRI into a hierarchy spanning sub-parcel voxel groups, parcels, and large-scale functional networks, enabling up to 415x compression while preserving fine-grained spatial information beyond conventional parcellation. The framework supports fixed atlas-based, fully learned, and softly prior-guided hierarchies, allowing us to systematically study the role of structured priors in brain representation learning. On HCP-YA, at approximately 415x compression, HBAR achieves higher parcel and network correlations than rate-matched flat tokenizers, while at a lower 52x compression rate, shuffling the anatomical grouping reduces parcel correlation from 0.920 to 0.886. Demographic readouts with autoregressive training also reveal potential gains from the hierarchical structure. By combining sub-parcel inputs, compact discrete tokens, and multiscale brain structure, HBAR offers a practical framework for representation learning in high-dimensional neuroimaging data.

</details>


### [313] [Uncertainty-Guided Reward Labeling for Reinforcement Learning under Limited Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11091)
*Renhao Zhang,Shreyas Chaudhari,Bruno Castro da Silva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"保留标签"设定下的有限反馈强化学习(RLLF)：被查询的奖励可用于训练奖励模型。作者将策略次优性分解为离线RL误差与奖励模型不确定性两部分，提出SURE方法，用后继特征选择既不确定又通向高价值状态的奖励样本，从而高效利用标注预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLLF中只有少量离线数据可被标注奖励，核心问题是该标注哪些样本。此前工作把奖励选择建模为奖励选择问题，但将下游策略学习视为黑盒，且假设被查询的奖励不保留用于训练奖励模型。作者关注更现实的"保留标签"设定，此时奖励可被存储并用于拟合奖励模型，于是标注预算应被用于战略性地降低奖励不确定性，而非直接优化黑盒策略。

Method: 作者首先给出学习策略次优性的上界，分解为两项：固定离线数据集上离线RL的误差，以及奖励模型的不确定性。由于奖励选择无法改变离线数据集，标注预算只能用于降低奖励不确定性。受RLLF中"有用奖励倾向于让智能体保持在高回报轨迹上"这一观察启发，提出Successor-Guided Uncertainty REduction(SURE)：利用后继特征(successor features)选择那些既有高不确定性、又对应着可到达高价值状态的状态的奖励。作者从由界诱导的设计目标出发形式化推导SURE，并刻画其精确的单步边际增益。

Result: 在多个领域和多种离线RL骨干网络上，SURE仅用少量奖励标注即可达到接近全反馈的性能，显示出作为反馈高效强化学习方法的有效性。

Conclusion: SURE为解决保留标签设定下的奖励选择问题提供了有理论依据且经验有效的方案：通过后继特征引导的不确定性削减，将有限标注预算导向不确定且可通向高回报状态的样本，从而在少标签条件下实现接近全反馈的策略性能。

Abstract: In reinforcement learning from limited feedback (RLLF), only a small fraction of an offline dataset can be labeled with rewards, and the central question is which samples should be labeled to learn a high-performing policy from the resulting partially labeled dataset. Prior work formalized this as a reward-selection problem by focusing on the selection stage while treating downstream policy learning as a black box, in a regime where queried rewards are not retained for reward-model training. We instead study the retained-label setting, where queried rewards can be stored and used to fit a reward model before policy learning. We bound the suboptimality of the learned policy in terms of two sources of error: one arising from offline RL on a fixed, offline dataset, and the other from uncertainty in the reward model. Since reward selection cannot change the offline dataset, the limited labeling budget must be used to strategically reduce reward uncertainty. Motivated by RLLF's observation that useful rewards tend to keep the agent on high-return trajectories, we introduce Successor-Guided Uncertainty REduction (SURE), a novel method that uses successor features to select rewards that are both uncertain and associated with states from which high-valued states are reachable. We formally derive SURE from a bound-induced design objective and characterize its exact one-step marginal gain. Empirically, SURE reaches near full-feedback performance with few reward labels across a variety of domains and offline-RL backbones, yielding an effective method for feedback-efficient reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [314] [Task presentation and execution paths shape LLM mathematical performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11102)
*Min Huang,Mingyan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过配对对比实验，研究语言模型的数学能力如何依赖于「信息如何输入、生成文本如何被利用、答案如何提交」这三个环节，揭示生成文本（草稿）的条件性价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望厘清数学表现中常被混淆的三个因素：提交协议（submission requirement）、生成文本的复用（draft reuse）与候选可用性（candidate availability），从而理解模型失败提交后留下的材料在何种条件下仍有用。

Method: 采用配对对比（paired comparisons）设计分离上述三个因素。在65个开发问题上比较不同提交指令；在固定提交协议下，对198个初次提交失败的问题，分别仅给问题、给草稿、给候选、同时给草稿与候选进行对照；并比较保留尾部片段与保留头部片段、以及第二个补全模型的表现，另设初始提交可解析的队列作对照，使用Holm多重校正进行显著性检验。

Result: 允许持续推导的指令在390次短输出调用中未产生任何有效最终答案，而单行提交指令产生390个格式有效输出（389个可解析答案）。固定提交协议下：仅问题9.09%、仅草稿33.84%、仅候选46.46%、草稿+候选59.60%正确率；草稿在候选固定时增加13.13个百分点，候选在草稿固定时增加25.76个百分点，均经Holm校正后显著且呈次可加性；保留尾部片段比保留相近长度的头部片段高10.10个百分点（Holm校正p=0.027）；第二个补全模型显示相同方向的输入效应。在初始提交可解析的队列中，提供草稿时候选未带来额外正确答案，而无草稿时候选增加约27个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究确立了生成文本的条件性价值：失败提交可留下有用材料，但其贡献取决于同时提供了哪些其他信息以及保留了哪些内容。这强调提交协议、草稿复用与候选可用性需在数学能力评测中分别控制与理解。

Abstract: Mathematical performance depends on how a language model receives information, uses generated text and submits an answer. We study these dependencies through paired comparisons that separate submission requirements, draft reuse and candidate availability. On 65 development problems, an instruction permitting continued derivation produced no valid final answers in 390 short-output calls; a single-line submission instruction produced 390 format-valid outputs, including 389 parseable answers. Under the fixed submission protocol, 198 problems with failed initial submissions were answered correctly in 9.09p of cases with the question alone, 33.84p with its draft, 46.46p with candidates, and 59.60p with both. Drafts added 13.13 percentage points with candidates fixed, and candidates added 25.76 points with drafts fixed; both effects were significant after Holm correction and were subadditive on the accuracy scale. Retaining a trailing excerpt outperformed retaining a leading excerpt of similar average length by 10.10 points Holm-adjusted p 0.027. A second completion model showed the same directions of input effects on the fixed materials. In a cohort with parseable initial submissions, candidates added no correct answers when the previous draft was supplied, but added 27 points when it was absent. These results establish a conditional value of generated text: a failed submission can leave useful material, whose contribution depends on what else is supplied and what is retained.

</details>


### [315] [Jointly Optimizing Memory, Computing and Offloading for Energy-Efficient DNN Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11106)
*Yunchu Han,Zhaojun Nan,Sheng Zhou,Zhisheng Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对边缘智能DNN推理中的内存瓶颈，提出内存、计算与卸载联合优化方案，在时延约束下最小化能耗，仿真显示近最优且显著节能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNN推理等应用复杂度上升，内存资源需求增加，内存已成为影响时延和能耗的关键瓶颈；传统计算卸载与DVFS未充分考虑内存频率优化。

Method: 将时延约束下的能耗最小化建模为MINLP问题；针对卸载与资源优化的耦合，在固定卸载策略下分解为本地和边缘两个子问题：本地子问题转化为几何规划求最优内存频率与计算频率，边缘子问题用凸优化求解；进一步设计坐标下降算法联合优化所有变量。

Result: 所提算法达到近最优性能，与最优策略的差距最多为9.3%；相比未进行内存频率优化的基准方案，设备能耗最多降低16.1%。

Conclusion: 联合优化内存、计算与卸载可有效缓解DNN推理中的内存瓶颈，在满足时延约束的同时显著提升边缘智能系统的能效。

Abstract: In edge intelligence systems, computation offloading and dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) are widely used to improve energy efficiency. However, as applications like deep neural network (DNN) inference evolve in complexity, their demands for memory resources have progressively increased, establishing memory as a critical bottleneck that impacts both latency and energy consumption. In this paper, we propose a joint optimization scheme integrating memory, computing and offloading for energy-efficient DNN inference. We formulate the energy minimization problem under deadline constraints as a mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) problem, where the main challenge arises from the coupling between offloading and resource optimization. To address this issue, we decompose the original problem into two subproblems under a fixed offloading policy. The local subproblem is transformed into an equivalent geometric programming (GP) problem to derive the optimal memory frequency and computing frequency, while the edge subproblem is solved via convex optimization. An efficient coordinate descent (CD) algorithm is further developed to jointly optimize all variables. Simulation results demonstrate that our proposed algorithm achieves near-optimal performance with the gap from the optimal policy being at most 9.3%, and reduces the energy consumption of devices by up to 16.1% compared with benchmarks without memory frequency optimization.

</details>


### [316] [Compositional Conformal Risk Control for Multi-Stage LLM Cascades](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11114)
*Yuxia Sun,Jiahuang Wang,Haoting Liu,Zhiwei Huang,Tingrui Pei,Saiqin Long*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CompCRC框架，为预设的多阶段LLM级联控制错误风险：将接受错误答案的风险分解为各阶段可加贡献，在独立数据上选择预算分配与阈值，并在留出数据上认证，从而在条件可交换性下给出有限样本的系统级风险保证，同时提升准确率并降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多阶段LLM级联可在准确率与推理成本间取得平衡，但可靠部署还需控制错误风险，并定位风险在各阶段的来源。现有系统级风险控制缺少阶段级归因与预算分配机制。

Method: 提出Compositional Conformal Risk Control（CompCRC）。将接受错误答案的风险在全查询总体上分解为各阶段可加的风险贡献，把局部风险预算与系统级保证关联；构造并冻结多组候选预算分配与接受阈值，在独立数据上选择候选，在单独留出数据上认证其阶段级风险贡献；在条件可交换性假设下给出有限样本保证。

Result: 在α=0.45的比较预算下，CompCRC三个阶段在MMLU、GSM8K、HellaSwag上均通过局部检查。与同样通过系统级认证的Global-CRC相比，CompCRC将观测到的接受错误风险降低1.33–2.00个百分点，最终准确率提高0.67–2.00个百分点，并在HellaSwag上降低加权推理成本30.37%。基于成本的预算分配相比均匀分配将单位成本准确率提高10.6%–46.7%。阶段级统计还能识别未通过局部认证的阶段，提供诊断信息。

Conclusion: CompCRC为多阶段LLM级联提供了可认证的系统级风险控制与阶段级风险归因，兼顾准确率、成本与可靠部署，并具备对失败阶段的诊断能力。

Abstract: Multi-stage large language model (LLM) cascades balance accuracy and inference cost, but reliable deployment also requires controlling error risk and identifying its sources across stages. We propose Compositional Conformal Risk Control (CompCRC), a risk-control framework for pre-specified multi-stage LLM cascades. We decompose the risk of accepting incorrect answers into additive stage-wise contributions over the full query population, linking local risk budgets to a system-level guarantee. CompCRC constructs and freezes candidate budget allocations and acceptance thresholds, selects one candidate on independent data, and certifies its stage-wise risk contributions on separate held-out data. Under conditional exchangeability, we establish a finite-sample guarantee: the marginal expected accepted-error risk of the complete deployment procedure does not exceed the global risk budget. At the reported comparison budget of $α=0.45$, all three stages of CompCRC pass their local checks on MMLU, GSM8K, and HellaSwag. Compared with Global-CRC, which passes system-level risk certification at the same budget, CompCRC reduces observed accepted-error risk by 1.33--2.00 percentage points, improves final accuracy by 0.67--2.00 percentage points, and reduces weighted inference cost by 30.37\% on HellaSwag. The selected cost-based budget allocation also improves accuracy per unit cost by 10.6\%--46.7\% over uniform allocation. Further experiments show that stage-wise statistics identify stages that fail local certification checks, providing diagnostic information alongside system-level risk control.

</details>


### [317] [When gene summaries reveal the answers: Gene Ontology circularity in gene embedding benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11118)
*Jiawei Wu,Huishu Wang,Junlin Chen,Hongyi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出基因摘要文本中可能含有用于评估基因嵌入的GO注释，导致信息泄漏与性能高估；作者通过去除/替换摘要文本并重新拟合探针来量化这一影响，并提出GeneProv用于在匹配文本上比较编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基因文本摘要（如Alliance of Genome Resources由GO注释生成的句子）可能直接包含评估嵌入时使用的标签信息，从而使基因功能预测评估产生泄漏。作者希望量化这种摘要来源依赖对嵌入性能评估的影响。

Method: 作者统计GO生成摘要覆盖的基因比例；对同一语料分别保留与移除生成摘要后嵌入，并重新拟合线性探针和MLP进行功能预测；比较TF-IDF编码器及仅用实验注释评估的模型；用UniProt功能描述替换生成摘要作对照；在小鼠和酵母中重复类似分析；提出GeneProv用于匹配文本下的编码器比较及跨GO恢复、非GO终点和共必需性评估。

Result: 生成摘要覆盖19,256个人类蛋白编码基因中的6,172个（32.1%），并覆盖有1–10篇关联文献基因的58%。在1–10篇文献基因中，移除摘要使线性探针的每基因AUROC降低0.078（95% bootstrap区间0.072–0.084），MLP降低0.033；TF-IDF同样受益，仅用实验注释评估的模型也受影响。用UniProt功能描述替换可恢复大部分损失，尽管逐字重叠很少。小鼠和酵母中也观察到对描述来源的类似依赖。

Conclusion: 基因嵌入评估可能因摘要文本包含评估标签而被高估；需要在匹配文本和不同终点上比较编码器。GeneProv提供了此类评估工具，并提示应谨慎解释基于文献/注释衍生文本的基因表示性能。

Abstract: A gene summary can contain the very annotations used to evaluate an embedding of its text. The Alliance of Genome Resources converts Gene Ontology (GO) annotations into sentences, which NCBI Gene displays and GenePT includes in its input. These summaries covered 6,172 of 19,256 human protein-coding genes (32.1%), including 58% of genes with one to ten linked publications. We embedded the same corpus with and without the generated summaries and refitted a function-prediction probe on each version. Among genes with one to ten publications, removal reduced the reported per-gene area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) by 0.078 with a linear probe (95% bootstrap interval 0.072-0.084) and by 0.033 with a multilayer perceptron. These estimates use a historical GO scorer that mishandled ties. The original predictions are unavailable for rescoring. A simple TF-IDF encoder also benefited from the summaries, as did models evaluated only on experimental annotations. Replacing generated summaries with UniProt function descriptions recovered much of the lost performance despite little verbatim overlap. UniProt also curates many of the evaluation labels. In mouse and yeast, we found a similar dependence on the source of the description. We introduce GeneProv to compare encoders on matched text and to examine how representation rankings change across GO recovery, non-GO endpoints and co-essentiality.

</details>


### [318] [DISCOVER: Online Variance-Guided Data Discovery for Budgeted Multimodal GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11145)
*Peyman Gholami,Shivam Chandhok,Saber Malekmohammadi,Shayan Shams,Robert Xiao,Leonid Sigal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DISCOVER——面向多模态 GRPO 的预算约束在线数据发现框架，通过语义聚类+奖励迁移估计样本效用并动态更新，仅标注高价值提示，在 10% 样本预算下显著提升视觉语言模型的数学推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO 等可验证奖励的强化学习后训练虽有效，但数据与算力效率低：rollout 与标注预算被消耗在几乎不产生学习信号的提示上。需要让模型在训练过程中动态识别对当前策略最有价值的样本。

Method: 1）将多模态样本池按语义聚类，查询少量密度多样化的代表性样本以获取初始奖励观测；2）在训练中通过稀疏奖励反馈的迁移来估计未标注样本的效用；3）随策略演化，用近因加权的 rollout 观测动态更新效用估计；4）用同时考虑奖励方差与难度的策略条件分数，只挑选高效用提示进行标注；5）发现预算耗尽后转为基于效用的回放（utility-based replay）。

Result: 在 ViRL39K 与 VLAA-Thinking 上使用 Qwen3-VL-2B，在严格 10% 唯一样本预算下显著提升多模态数学推理表现，优于预算匹配的随机采样、难例采样、同等训练步数下的全池 GRPO，以及在线选择基线。消融实验验证了语义覆盖、在线奖励迁移与稳定发现节奏的重要性。

Conclusion: DISCOVER 是一个实用的数据高效多模态强化学习后训练框架；关键在于语义覆盖式的代表性采样、稀疏奖励的在线迁移与策略条件的效用选择三者结合。

Abstract: Recent advances in reinforcement learning have made verifiable rewards a central post-training paradigm for improving multimodal reasoning. However, methods such as GRPO remain data- and compute-inefficient, spending rollout and annotation budget on prompts that provide little learning signal. We propose DISCOVER, an online data-discovery framework for budgeted multimodal GRPO that enables vision-language models to dynamically identify prompts that are most useful for the current policy. DISCOVER first organizes the multimodal sample pool into semantic clusters and queries a small set of density-diverse representative samples to obtain initial reward observations. During training, it estimates the utility of unannotated samples by transferring sparse reward feedback from queried samples. Since sample utility changes as the policy evolves, DISCOVER dynamically updates these estimates with recency-weighted rollout observations. It then selects only high-utility prompts for annotation using a policy-conditioned score that accounts for reward variance and difficulty. Once the discovery budget is exhausted, DISCOVER continues with utility-based replay. Experiments on ViRL39K and VLAA-Thinking with Qwen3-VL-2B show that DISCOVER substantially improves multimodal mathematical reasoning under a strict 10% unique-sample budget, outperforming budget-matched random selection, hard-example sampling, full-pool GRPO under the same training-step budget, and online selection baselines. Ablations further validate the importance of semantic coverage, online reward transfer, and stable discovery cadence, establishing DISCOVER as a practical framework for data-efficient multimodal RL post-training.

</details>


### [319] [ZarrFM: A Canonical Tensor Storage Architecture for EEG Foundation-Model Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11149)
*Dheeraj Chintapalli,Sunkalp Chandra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向脑机接口大规模EEG语料的执行导向存储表示ZarrFM，在Zarr v3单一层级中整合索引元数据、规范化通道空间、显式掩码、稳定受试者划分、事件表与块对齐分片；与EDF/FIF/NPY/HDF5/Parquet对比，显示查询、存储、吞吐和可靠性优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BCI统计模型需要大规模异构EEG语料，但现有数据集在采样率、通道布局、窗口长度和存储格式上不一致，造成大量预处理与I/O开销；BIDS主要面向组织与交换，缺少执行导向的高效表示。

Method: ZarrFM将整个语料存为单一Zarr v3层级，包含两级索引元数据、规范通道空间、显式掩码、哈希稳定的受试者划分、经验证的事件表和块对齐分片；在真实PhysioNet记录与合成语料上，与EDF、FIF、NPY、HDF5和Parquet进行对比。

Result: 200条记录上，两级索引将元数据查询从601次请求降至14次；保留原生信号编码使存储从EDF的42.4 MB/小时降至22.7 MB/小时；块对齐采样达3,131窗口/秒，比Parquet快至多11倍；独立Zarr实现读取位级一致，并发故障注入追加可无数据丢失恢复。

Conclusion: ZarrFM可作为大规模EEG预训练的紧凑、可互操作且执行高效的存储层，并在查询效率、压缩存储、读取吞吐和可靠性方面优于现有格式。

Abstract: Statistical models for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) increasingly require large, heterogeneous EEG corpora, yet existing datasets vary in sampling rates, channel layouts, window lengths, and storage formats, creating substantial preprocessing and I/O overhead. We propose ZarrFM, an execution-oriented representation that complements BIDS by storing a corpus as a single Zarr v3 hierarchy with indexed metadata, canonical channel spaces, explicit masks, hash-stable subject splits, verified event tables, and block-aligned sharding. On real PhysioNet recordings and synthetic corpora, we compare ZarrFM with EDF, FIF, NPY, HDF5, and Parquet. Across 200 recordings, its two-level index reduces metadata queries from 601 requests to 14. Preserving native signal codes reduces storage from 42.4 MB/hour in EDF to 22.7 MB/hour, while block-aligned sampling reaches 3,131 windows/s, up to 11 times faster than Parquet. Reads remain bit-identical across independent Zarr implementations, and concurrent failure-injected appends recover without data loss. These results show that ZarrFM can provide a compact, interoperable, and execution-efficient storage layer for large-scale EEG pretraining.

</details>


### [320] [TEAM: Topology-Aware, Semantic-Sensitive, General Transformer for Multimodal-Attributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11189)
*Yushuo Li,Xunkai Li,Zhengyu Wu,Ronghua Li,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TEAM：以"节点-模态"token 为基本单元构建与编码图上下文的多模态属性图框架，通过模态编码树与模态源上下文 Transformer 实现细粒度跨节点跨模态交互，在多项指标上取得最佳平均表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态属性图（MAG）方法多以"节点级状态"和"拓扑定义的邻域"为中心传播信息，存在两点局限：有界邻域内可能只含语义弱证据；而真正相关的兼容上下文又未必局限于该邻域。同时，把节点当作单一交互单元会掩盖细粒度的模态贡献。

Method: 1）以节点-模态 token 代替整节点特征作为交互单元；2）将局部拓扑展开为 Modality Encoding Tree，并做"树锚定"的语义证据获取，在组织局部结构上下文的同时把可访问证据空间扩展到树外；3）提出 Modality-Source Context Transformer（MSCT），编码选中的节点-模态 token 并协调不同模态源组之间的交互；4）在读出前始终保留文本与视觉属性为独立交互单元，从而实现细粒度跨节点、跨模态信息交换。

Result: 在所有对比基线中，TEAM 在全部图学习指标、三项 G2Text 指标与两项 G2Image 指标上均取得最高的平均成绩。在 Toys 数据集上，Accuracy 与 Macro-F1 分别领先最强基线 3.37 与 2.93 个百分点。

Conclusion: 以模态为中心、以节点-模态 token 为基本单元，并借助树锚定的证据扩展与模态源上下文交互，可有效突破邻域受限与整节点聚合带来的信息损失，在多项图学习与跨模态生成任务上稳定优于代表性 MAG 方法。

Abstract: Multimodal-Attributed Graphs (MAGs) organize heterogeneous data in graphs whose nodes are characterized by modalities such as text and images rather than traditional unimodal attributes. However, many representative MAG methods organize propagation around node-level states and topology-defined neighborhoods, which can obscure fine-grained modality contributions: a bounded neighborhood may contain semantically weak evidence, while compatible context need not be confined to it. To address both limitations, we propose TEAM, a modality-centric framework that constructs and encodes graph context with node-modality tokens rather than treating each node as a single interaction unit. Concretely, TEAM unfolds the local topology into a Modality Encoding Tree and performs tree-anchored semantic evidence acquisition, organizing local structural context while expanding the accessible evidence space outside the constructed local Tree. We further introduce the Modality-Source Context Transformer (MSCT), which encodes the selected node-modality tokens and coordinates interactions among modality-source groups. By retaining textual and visual attributes as separate interaction units until readout, it supports fine-grained cross-node cross-modal exchange without first collapsing them into whole-node features. Across the evaluated baselines, TEAM attains the highest reported mean on all graph-learning metrics, all three G2Text metrics, and both G2Image metrics. On Toys, it surpasses the strongest baseline by 3.37 and 2.93 percentage points in Accuracy and Macro-F1, respectively.

</details>


### [321] [MCSA: Multi-Cutoff Spectral Aggregation in SO(3) Equivariant GNNs for Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11226)
*Junfu Tan,Mengfan Wu,Yu Zhu,Yu Shi,Yifang Qin,Chang Liu,Bonan Zhu,Ziheng Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文分析SO(3)等变消息传递的径向谱性质，发现截断半径决定径向相互作用的特征空间频率尺度，据此提出即插即用的多截断谱聚合模块（MCSA），融合不同截断半径的径向核以丰富多尺度几何表征，并在多种EGNN骨干上提升能量、力、应力及高阶性质预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于等变图神经网络的机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）虽进展显著，但跨不同空间尺度准确刻画原子相互作用仍具挑战；作者希望从径向谱角度理解截断半径的作用，并据此构建多尺度表征方法。

Method: 研究SO(3)等变消息传递的径向谱性质，建立截断半径与径向相互作用特征空间频率尺度之间的关系；提出Multi-Cutoff Spectral Aggregation（MCSA）即插即用模块，聚合不同截断半径的径向核；利用径向核的紧支撑性，在角度张量积操作前融合与截断相关的径向权重，从而避免冗余角度计算并保持旋转等变性。

Result: 在多个代表性EGNN骨干上的大量实验显示，MCSA在能量、力、应力预测上取得一致提升，并提高声子色散、晶格热导率等高阶性质的精度；在具有不同相互作用尺度的层状材料上的评估验证了基于物理动机选择截断半径的有效性。

Conclusion: 截断半径控制径向相互作用的特征空间频率尺度，多截断径向核聚合可有效增强等变原子势的多尺度几何表征能力；MCSA兼顾效率与旋转等变性，是一种可推广的即插即用增强方案。

Abstract: Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (MLIPs) based on Equivariant Graph Neural Networks (EGNNs) have achieved remarkable progress in atomistic modeling. However, accurately representing atomic interactions across different spatial scales remains challenging. In this work, we investigate the radial spectral properties of SO(3)-equivariant message passing and establish that the cutoff radius controls the characteristic spatial-frequency scale of radial interactions. Based on this analysis, we propose Multi-Cutoff Spectral Aggregation (MCSA), a plug-and-play module that aggregates radial kernels with different cutoff radii to enrich multi-scale geometric representations. To achieve efficient implementation, we exploit the compact support of radial kernels to fuse cutoff-dependent radial weights before angular tensor-product operations, avoiding redundant angular computations while preserving rotational equivariance. Extensive experiments across representative EGNN backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in energy, force, and stress prediction, as well as enhanced accuracy in higher-order properties, including phonon dispersion and lattice thermal conductivity. Further evaluations on layered materials with distinct interaction scales demonstrate the effectiveness of physically motivated cutoff selection. Code is available at: https://github.com/JF-Tan/MCSA.

</details>


### [322] [DeltaForge: A Post-hoc Mixture-of-Experts VLA for Multi-Domain Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11856)
*Bingzhang Wang,Mo Poorsartep,Yasaman Esfandiari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DeltaForge：首个面向驾驶的后验混合专家 VLA，用 SVD 将多个独立微调模型的权重更新拆成共享基与少量域特定分量，并用双路由器实现高效多域整合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶 VLA 通常按域分别微调，形成多个专用专家，整合成本高；权重合并会随异构域增多而掉点，稠密 MoE 路由又过于昂贵。

Method: 对同一基座模型在各域的权重更新联合做 SVD，分离跨域共享部分与极小的域特定部分；路由器仅处理这些微小域特定分量。随后在小型代理数据集上，用软标签训练两个协同的 clip 级盲路由器，分别路由 VLM 推理专家和 flow-matching 动力学专家。

Result: 在涵盖城市、越野、高速，以及汽车、卡车、全地形车的六个异构域上，DeltaForge 接近各域专用专家精度，并在参数与计算量接近单模型的条件下优于所有合并、路由、集中式和联邦式基线；新增域只需将权重更新投影到共享基，无需端到端重训，且能泛化到未显式训练的域组合。

Conclusion: DeltaForge 以低参数和低计算成本实现了驾驶 VLA 的多域专家整合，支持可扩展的新域增量接入与跨域组合泛化。

Abstract: Fleets of driving vision-language-action (VLA) models are developed one domain at a time: each operator finetunes a shared base model on private data, producing specialized experts that are costly to consolidate into a single model. Weight merging loses accuracy as heterogeneous domains accumulate, and dense mixture-of-experts routing is prohibitively expensive to combine them. We present DeltaForge, to our knowledge the first post-hoc mixture-of-experts VLA for driving, which consolidates N independently finetuned per-domain models into a single multi-domain model from their weights and a small proxy set alone. When different operators finetune the same base model, their weight updates end up sharing a lot of structure. We exploit this by decomposing all the updates together using singular value decomposition (SVD), splitting each one into a shared part (the same across all domains) and a tiny domain-specific part. The router then only needs to work with those tiny domain-specific pieces, not the full expert weights, which is what keeps the approach efficient. Then two cooperating clip-level blind routers, one over the VLM reasoning experts and one over the flow-matching dynamics experts, are trained from soft labels on the proxy dataset. Across six diverse domains spanning urban, off-road, and highway driving on cars, trucks, and all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), DeltaForge approaches the accuracy of the per-domain experts and surpasses every merging, routing, centralized, and federated baseline at close to single-model parameter and compute cost. Adding a new domain requires only projecting its weight update onto the shared basis with no end-to-end retraining needed. The resulting model also generalizes to domain combinations it was never explicitly trained on.

</details>


### [323] [TLRS-DPO: Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11232)
*Suxin Ji,Hungtao Wan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TLRS-DPO，在标准DPO框架上引入词元级风险评分与选择性惩罚，实现细粒度偏好对齐，在不显著损失有用性的前提下提升安全性与对齐质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO是RLHF的简洁替代方案，并被广泛用于大语言模型对齐，但其序列级目标无法精确定位或抑制使整体可接受回复变得不安全或不可取的局部模式，即缺乏词元级的细粒度控制能力。

Method: TLRS-DPO在完全离线、基于参考模型的框架下引入三项设计：1）词元级鲁棒补偿项，将拒绝回复上的策略-参考对数比转化为局部风险分数；2）课程式调度机制，训练过程中逐步增强补偿强度；3）风险自适应筛选机制，仅对高风险词元进行惩罚而非惩罚整条序列。该方法可作为标准DPO训练器的即插即用修改。

Result: 实验表明，与强DPO基线相比，TLRS-DPO提升了对齐质量与安全相关行为表现，同时对有用性的影响很小。

Conclusion: TLRS-DPO在序列级偏好拟合与词元级行为控制之间建立桥梁，以低实现成本为DPO提供细粒度风险控制能力，是一种有效且易部署的对齐改进方案。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a simple and widely used alternative to RLHF for aligning large language models (LLMs), but its sequence-level objective cannot precisely locate or suppress the local patterns that make an otherwise acceptable response unsafe or undesirable. We propose TLRS-DPO (Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization), which augments DPO with fine-grained token-level control while remaining fully offline and reference-based. TLRS-DPO introduces a token-level robust compensation term that converts the policy-reference log-ratio on rejected responses into localized risk scores, a curriculum-style schedule that gradually increases the strength of this compensation during training, and a risk-adaptive screening mechanism that selectively penalizes only high-risk tokens instead of entire sequences. This design bridges sequence-level preference fitting and token-level behavior control, and can be implemented as a drop-in modification to standard DPO trainers. Empirically, TLRS-DPO improves alignment quality and safety-relevant behavior with minimal impact on helpfulness compared to strong DPO baselines.

</details>


### [324] [How Many Candidates Does a One-Step World Model Need? A Random-Codebook Account of Nearest-of-m Training on Frozen DINO Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11887)
*Yong Hwi Song,Keon Myung Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在冻结的DINOv2/v3 patch token上用可枚举未来的基准测试一步式世界模型，检验"小m的nearest-of-m（IMLE）足够"与"应用严格proper能量分数替代硬最小值"两个猜想，结果表明m=16的nearest-of-m在模态不确定性下覆盖更优、延迟仅约为50步flow matching的1/30，并用"随机码本期望失真"这一视角统一解释其优劣。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有一步式随机世界模型面临两难：确定性特征预测器会产生模态平均（mode averaging），而diffusion/flow matching每步需数十次网络评估，代价高昂。nearest-of-m匹配（条件隐式极大似然，IMLE）只对最接近真实未来的候选施加拉近，是代价最低的随机目标。近期工作提出两个待验证猜想：其一，特征空间世界模型只需很小的m；其二，应以严格proper的能量分数（energy score）取代硬最小值损失。本文旨在用可枚举未来的基准对二者做实证检验。

Method: 在冻结的DINOv2/v3 patch token上训练一步式世界模型，选用未来可枚举的基准（含模态式不确定性场景，以及随机Push-T变体）。对比对象包括：nearest-of-m（m=16）、50步flow matching、一步flow生成器与能量分数生成器（参数规模匹配）。核心分析视角是：nearest-of-m目标等价于从生成器抽取m个样本构成随机码本的期望失真（expected distortion），由此推出三项预先注册的预测——(i) 在永不重复的上下文中对已实现结果的记忆化，强度由码本miss失真I(m)而非miss概率支配，且能量分数生成器无法通过增大m规避；(ii) 模态概率随m增大而趋于平坦，与已知最优解相差在0.01以内；(iii) 在连续高维结果上出现欠离散（under-dispersion）。此外还评估在自rollout上的逐步匹配，并通过消融分离流形与覆盖两种收益。

Result: 在模态式不确定性下，m=16的nearest-of-m对枚举未来的覆盖优于50步flow matching（延迟约为其1/30）、一步flow生成器以及与参数匹配的能量分数生成器；其rollout保持在token流形上，而flow rollout出现漂移。三项预测均得到验证：记忆化强度由I(m)支配且能量分数生成器提高m亦无法摆脱；模态概率随m平坦化，与已知最优值误差<0.01；连续高维结果上存在欠离散，从而限制其在真实机器人视频上的适用性。在随机Push-T变体上，对自rollout做逐步匹配使长时域误差降低约三分之一，消融实验分离出流形保持与覆盖度两方面的贡献。规划任务中，尽管风险估计准确，规划成功率并未提升——这一负结果连同其诊断一并报告。

Conclusion: nearest-of-m（IMLE）是特征空间一步式随机世界模型中极具性价比的目标：小m即可超越多步flow matching的覆盖质量并显著降低延迟，且更稳定地停留在token流形上。其行为可由"随机码本的期望失真"这一单一量统一刻画，从而预测记忆化、模态概率平坦化与欠离散等失效模式；能量分数并非必要替代方案。方法在高维连续结果（如真实机器人视频）上存在内在界限，且准确的风险估计不足以保证下游规划收益。

Abstract: One-step stochastic world models avoid the mode averaging of deterministic feature predictors without the tens of network evaluations per step that diffusion and flow matching require. The simplest such objective is nearest-of-m matching (conditional implicit maximum likelihood estimation, IMLE): draw m candidate futures and pull only the one closest to the observed outcome. Recent work conjectures that a small m suffices for feature-space world models and that a strictly proper energy score should replace the hard minimum. We test both claims with one-step world models on frozen DINOv2/v3 patch tokens, using benchmarks whose futures can be enumerated. Under mode-like uncertainty, nearest-of-m with m=16 covers the enumerated futures better than 50-step flow matching (at about 1/30 of its latency), one-step flow generators and an energy-score generator at matched parameter counts, and its rollouts stay on the token manifold where flow rollouts drift. One quantity governs the choice of m: the nearest-of-m objective is the expected distortion of a random codebook of m draws from the generator. This view yields three predictions, recorded before the corresponding runs: (i) memorization of the realized outcome in contexts that never repeat, whose strength is governed by the codebook's miss distortion I(m) rather than its miss probability, and which an energy-score generator does not escape by raising m; (ii) a flattening of mode probabilities with m, matching a known optimum within 0.01; and (iii) under-dispersion on continuous high-dimensional outcomes, which bounds the method on real robot video. Per-step matching on self-rollouts cuts long-horizon error by a third on a stochastic Push-T variant; an ablation separates its manifold and coverage benefits. Planning success does not improve despite accurate risk estimates, a negative result we report with its diagnosis.

</details>


### [325] [ALETHEIA: A Multi-Frequency Eddy Current Pulsed Thermography Dataset for Neural Operator Learning in Nondestructive Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11252)
*Changbin Sun,Jie Xiao,Xiaotian Chen,Yuankai Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个面向无损检测（NDT）的3D神经PDE求解器基准数据集Aletheia，模拟涡流致热与瞬态传热，支持正演与稀疏含噪表面观测下的反演任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实约束下的时空PDE神经求解仍具挑战，尤其是边界观测稀疏且含噪的逆问题；现有工作缺乏面向NDT的统一3D评测平台。

Method: 构建Aletheia数据集：仿真导电固体中的涡流致热及热传导过程，包含10个激励频率（1–100 kHz）下逾4700个高分辨率样本，提供体积热源与随时间演化的温度场；并纳入裂纹钢轨红外热成像实测数据用于校准。在规则/非规则网格上定义四类典型任务，评测多种神经算子。

Result: 形成可同时支持温度演化正演预测、以及由表面红外测量反演内部热源/缺陷的统一3D基准；提供多神经算子的基线评测与真实数据对照。

Conclusion: Aletheia为真实NDT条件下神经PDE求解器提供统一评测平台，推动可靠的数据驱动正/反演建模研究，数据与代码已公开。

Abstract: Learning neural solvers for spatiotemporal partial differential equations (PDEs) under real-world constraints remains a key challenge in scientific machine learning, especially for inverse tasks with sparse and noisy boundary observations. We present the Aletheia dataset, the first 3D benchmark for learning data-driven solvers in the context of nondestructive testing (NDT). The dataset simulates eddy-current-induced heating in conductive solids and models the resulting transient heat propagation governed by the heat equation. Aletheia contains over 4,700 high-resolution samples across 10 excitation frequencies (1-100,kHz), each providing volumetric heat source and temperature fields over time. It supports both forward prediction of temperature evolution and inverse reconstruction of internal heat sources or defects from surface infrared measurements. Real infrared thermography data from cracked rail specimens are included for calibration and comparison. We define four canonical tasks on both regular and irregular grids and benchmark them using various neural operators. Aletheia establishes a unified platform for evaluating neural PDE solvers under realistic NDT conditions, enabling progress in reliable, data-driven inverse modeling. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/sherlock-0327/ALETHEIA.

</details>


### [326] [Primitives and Paths: Predicting What Post-Training Can Do from What the Base Model Already Has](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11260)
*Anqi Qu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个二维"后训练可训练性"状态空间框架，主张强化学习能否教会模型新能力取决于基座模型的能力状态，并用合成组合任务验证了该框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关于强化学习（RL）是"教会"语言模型新能力还是仅"放大"预训练已有能力，现有文献存在矛盾证据：pass@k 研究认为 RL 只是重新加权潜在行为，而部分受控组合实验则显示超出放大的增益。作者指出这一问题不存在脱离基座模型能力状态的统一答案，因而需要一个能刻画"状态依赖性"的分析框架。

Method: 提出二维状态空间：(1) 有效全解支撑度（effective full-solution support）：在可行探索预算下能否采样到成功轨迹；(2) 原子原语覆盖度（atomic primitive coverage）：剥离组合负担后，各组成技能能否被单独执行。两维交叉划分出三个区制——放大区制、组合受限区制、习得受限区制，各自对应不同经验特征与干预策略。作者给出前瞻性测量协议，并在三个小型语言模型上，用合成组合任务进行实证探究。

Result: 原语掌握本身不足以保证 RL 学会组合。能可靠执行全部原语的检查点，若训练中从未采样到完整解，则仍无法提升；而少量使支持度非零的组合监督即可带来显著 RL 增益。

Conclusion: RL 的可学习性取决于基座模型所处的能力状态，而非单一固定的"放大 vs. 习得"二分。该框架将中期训练重新定位为后训练的准备阶段：其作用是推动模型进入 RL 能有效发挥作用的状态，并为测量与干预提供了可操作的分区诊断依据。

Abstract: Does reinforcement learning teach language models new capabilities, or merely amplify ones acquired during pre-training? The literature offers evidence for both: pass@$k$ studies suggest RL reweights latent behaviours while some controlled composition studies demonstrate gains beyond simple amplification. We argue that this question has no answer independent of the capability state of the base model, and propose a two-dimensional state space for post-trainability. The first axis, \emph{effective full-solution support}, measures whether successful trajectories can be sampled under a feasible exploration budget. The second axis, \emph{atomic primitive coverage}, measures whether the constituent skills of a solution can be executed when the burden of composition is removed. Together, these dimensions motivate three regimes -- amplification, composition-limited, and acquisition-limited -- each predicting a distinct empirical signature and calling for a distinct intervention. We propose a prospective measurement protocol and investigate the framework using synthetic composition tasks across three small language models. We find that primitive mastery alone does not guarantee that RL can learn a composition. Checkpoints that execute every primitive reliably can fail to improve when complete solutions are never sampled during training, whereas modest composition supervision that establishes nonzero support enables substantial RL gains. The framework reframes mid-training as preparation for post-training: its role is to move models into states from which RL can operate effectively.

</details>


### [327] [Chatter Attack: Resource Consumption Attack for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11261)
*Yibo Miao,Yichuan Cao,Xiao-Shan Gao,Yinpeng Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Chatter Attack：通过优化对抗提示，诱导模型生成预定义短目标短语并触发“自我怀疑”状态，从而在避免搜索空间爆炸的同时拉长输出；黑盒场景下进一步提出贝叶斯提示优化（BPO）。实验显示响应长度最高增至31.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理成本高，恶意用户可通过诱导超长输出来增加延迟和运营开销。既有资源消耗攻击依赖强制重复或压低EOS token的logit，但在自回归采样生成中，搜索空间随长度指数增长，轨迹不稳定，导致攻击效果和稳定性受限。

Method: 提出 Chatter Attack：优化对抗提示以诱导预定义的短目标短语，避免搜索空间爆炸并仍能引发长响应；用短“怀疑诱导”短语触发自我怀疑，并通过推理注意力损失和全局熵损失在生成过程中维持该状态。为扩展到黑盒设置，提出贝叶斯提示优化（BPO），通过构造离散token核全局建模目标函数，并利用先验信息高效探索搜索空间。

Result: 在多个模型和数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于基线，最大响应长度提升至31.5倍，并揭示了真实LLM推理服务面临的资源耗尽风险。

Conclusion: Chatter Attack 为资源消耗攻击提供了一种更稳定、可扩展的提示优化思路，并在白盒与黑盒场景中验证了有效性；其结果表明LLM推理服务存在实际的资源耗尽安全隐患，需要关注输出长度控制与成本防护。

Abstract: LLMs are powerful but incur substantial inference cost, which can be exploited by malicious users to induce overly long outputs, increasing latency and operational expense. Prior resource consumption attacks either coerce repetition or suppress the end-of-sequence token by lowering its logit value. However, with autoregressive, sampling-based generation, the search space grows exponentially with length and small deviations or unstable trajectories can derail optimization, limiting attack effectiveness and stability. To address this issue, we introduce Chatter Attack, a novel class of resource consumption attacks that optimize adversarial prompts to induce predefined short target phrases, thereby avoiding search-space explosion while still eliciting long responses. Specifically, Chatter Attack triggers self-doubt using short doubt-inducing phrases as the target, and sustains this state throughout generation via inference attention loss and global entropy loss. To extend to black-box settings, we further propose a novel Bayesian Prompt Optimization (BPO) method, which models the objective function globally by constructing a discrete token kernel, efficiently exploring the entire search space using prior information. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets show that our method outperforms baselines, with maximum response length increases to 31.5$\times$, and revealing practical resource-depletion risks for real-world LLM inference services.

</details>


### [328] [Beyond Node Attributes: A Controlled Evaluation and Ablation of Local Interaction Statistics for Ethereum Phishing Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11263)
*Thanh Dat Tran,Duy Loi Duong,Duy Luu Hoang,Minh Huy Tran,Vo Minh Thu Le,Nhat Tung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出并系统评估了无标签局部交互特征扩展（UFE），在控制数据划分与模型配置一致的前提下，验证其能否为以太坊钓鱼账户检测带来稳定增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有钓鱼账户检测方法通常以完整流程比较，特征、架构与训练协议相互混杂，难以单独识别交互信息本身的贡献，因此需要一个特征层面的受控评估。

Method: 从每个账户的入/出调用与转账边计算12项局部交互统计（不读取类标签），将其追加到HEIG-Phish的14个原始特征上；在逻辑回归、随机森林、LightGBM、图注意力网络、GraphSAGE与Meta-IFD六类模型上构造Baseline/Plus成对实验，保持划分、配置、随机种子、阈值与采样邻域一致，仅改变输入特征块，并在20个预设分层划分上评估，另做精确边随机森林消融。

Result: 在2,763个有标签外部账户的20个划分上，UFE使测试Macro-F1提升1.0–9.1个百分点，六类模型的每一对实验在全部20个划分上均有改善，Nadeau–Bengio校正后的95%置信区间均高于零，假阳性率全部下降；消融显示增益主要来自入向转账边求和特征，其余11个UFE特征的增量贡献未被确立。

Conclusion: 结果支持在报告图模型的同时报告特征增强基线，但结论限于单一静态转导基准的重划分稳定性，尚不能说明时间外推或跨数据集泛化能力。

Abstract: Methods for detecting phishing accounts on Ethereum are usually evaluated as complete pipelines that differ in features, architecture, and training protocol, which makes the contribution of interaction information hard to isolate. This paper evaluates the Unlabeled Feature Extension (UFE), a block of 12 local interaction statistics computed from each account's incoming and outgoing call and transfer edges without reading class labels. UFE is appended to the 14 source features of HEIG-Phish and tested with six model families: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, LightGBM, Graph Attention Network, GraphSAGE, and Meta-IFD. Within each pair of Baseline and Plus variants, the data partition, model configuration, random seed, decision threshold, and sampled neighborhoods are identical; only the input feature block changes. Across 20 predetermined stratified partitions of the same 2,763 labeled externally owned accounts, UFE increased test Macro-F1 by 1.0 to 9.1 percentage points across the six models. Every pair improved on all 20 partitions, all Nadeau-Bengio corrected 95% confidence intervals lie above zero, and the false-positive rate decreased for all six models. An exact-edge Random Forest ablation over 10 predetermined partitions associates most of the gain with the incoming transfer-edge sum attribute; once this feature is present, an incremental contribution of the remaining 11 UFE columns was not established. The results support reporting feature-augmented baselines alongside graph models, but they show stability under re-partitioning of one static, transductive benchmark rather than temporal or cross-dataset generalization.

</details>


### [329] [RAIL: Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning for Student-Compatible Teacher Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12251)
*Meraj Mammadov,Pedro Zuidberg Dos Martires,Johannes Andreas Stork*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 RAIL：在教师策略训练阶段用对比学习构建师生共享的潜在表征，并让教师直接在该共享空间中训练，从源头缩小师生观测差异导致的模仿差距，无需奖励塑形或事后学生微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从图像/车载传感器等原始输入做强化学习面临高维观测和稀疏奖励；常见做法是用带特权状态的教师策略蒸馏出仅依赖原始输入的学生策略。但教师使用了学生不可得的信息时，精确模仿不可能，形成不可消除的模仿差距。现有方法多靠奖励塑形或教师训练后对学生再做强化学习来缓解，本文希望直接在教师训练阶段解决该错配。

Method: RAIL 通过对比学习学习一个在教师与学生观测之间共享的潜在表征，并让教师策略直接在该共享表征空间中训练。由于教师被约束在共享空间上操作，其学到的行为更可由学生观测复现，从而降低模仿差距并保持任务性能。

Result: 在多个环境中，RAIL 在不修改奖励、不对学生做事后微调的情况下优于强基线，并超过直接从原始观测进行强化学习；所学表征还支持仅训练教师即可实现对新任务的零样本迁移。

Conclusion: RAIL 将师生观测错配的处理前移到教师训练阶段，以共享表征约束教师策略，有效缩小模仿差距，并兼顾任务表现、零样本迁移和无需额外奖励设计/学生微调的实用性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from raw sensory inputs such as images or onboard sensors can be challenging due to high-dimensional observations and sparse rewards. A common strategy is to train a teacher policy with access to privileged state information and then distill it into a student policy that acts from raw inputs alone. However, when the teacher relies on information unavailable to the student, exact imitation may be impossible, creating an irreducible imitation gap. Existing approaches typically mitigate this mismatch through careful reward shaping or additional reinforcement learning on the student policy after the teacher has been trained. Instead, we introduce Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning (RAIL), which addresses the mismatch during teacher training itself. RAIL learns a latent representation shared across teacher and student observations using contrastive learning, and trains the teacher policy directly in this space. Because the teacher policy is constrained to operate on this shared space, it learns behaviors that are reproducible from student observations. This substantially reduces the imitation gap while preserving task performance. Across multiple environments, RAIL outperforms strong baselines without reward modification or post-hoc student fine-tuning, and surpasses direct reinforcement learning from raw observations. The learned representations further enable zero-shot transfer to new tasks through teacher-only training. Project site: https://merajmammadov.com/rail/.

</details>


### [330] [How Efficient Is Your Agent? Online Predictive Bounds under Budget Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11279)
*Roy Maor Lotan,Shai Feldman,Yaniv Romano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出PROBE方法，在有限预算下为在线到达的AI智能体任务构建校准的时间-成功上预测界，利用逆概率加权反馈与偏差修正实现在线校准，理论保证覆盖率并满足预算约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估AI智能体时，任务顺序到达且预算有限，部分运行会被提前停止，导致"时间-成功"（完成任务所需交互次数）被右删失而无法观测，上预测界的正确性也可能未知，因此需要在在线、带删失的环境下构建可靠的上预测界并高效分配预算。

Method: 提出PROBE（Predictive Bounds for Online Budget Efficiency）：在运行每个任务前构建其上预测界，用逆概率加权（IPW）反馈进行在线校准，并引入在保持无偏性的同时最小化覆盖率缺口的修正项；同时自适应地在各智能体任务间分配有限预算以降低预期覆盖缺口。

Result: 理论上证明PROBE在任意有限时间范围内提供覆盖率保证且满足预算约束；在软件工程、检索增强生成和指令遵循实验中，PROBE相比校准基线取得更接近目标水平的覆盖率，且预测界更紧。

Conclusion: PROBE为预算受限、右删失条件下的在线智能体评估提供了具有理论保证的校准上预测界方法，兼顾覆盖率有效性与预测界紧致性，可用于实际智能体评测场景。

Abstract: We evaluate AI agents in an online setting where tasks arrive sequentially and, before running each task, we construct an upper predictive bound on its \emph{time-to-success}---the number of interactions until the task is completed successfully. Under a limited budget, some runs are stopped early, so their time-to-success is unobserved (right-censored), and the correctness of the bound may be unknown. We introduce \emph{\textbf{PR}edictive Bounds for \textbf{O}nline \textbf{B}udget \textbf{E}fficiency} (\texttt{PROBE}), a method for constructing calibrated upper predictive bounds while adaptively allocating a limited budget across agent tasks to reduce the anticipated coverage deficit. Our method calibrates the bounds online using inverse-probability-weighted feedback together with a correction designed to minimize coverage deficit while remaining unbiased. We prove that \texttt{PROBE} provides a coverage guarantee for any finite time horizon while satisfying the budget constraint. Experiments on software engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and instruction following show that \texttt{PROBE} attains a coverage rate closer to the target level with tighter predictive bounds than a calibrated baseline.

</details>


### [331] [Simulation-aided Reinforcement Learning with Control Variates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12643)
*Omer Hemo,Ido Sefi,Mirco Mutti,Aviv Tamar,Kfir Y. Levy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于控制变量（control variates）的保守式仿真辅助强化学习方法：仿真数据只用于降低学习过程的方差，而不直接改变学习目标，从而避免仿真器误差带来的偏差。方法先在策略评估中建立，再嵌入actor-critic框架实现策略改进，并扩展到离线RL；在多个MuJoCo任务上优于标准仿真混合方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL需要昂贵且有噪声的真实环境数据，仿真器虽能廉价生成大量数据，但标准做法（把仿真经验与真实经验直接混合）会因仿真器不准确而使解偏离最优策略，尤其在偏差方向不利时性能显著下降。因此需要一个既能利用仿真数据、又不被其偏差带偏的方案。

Method: 采用控制变量思想重构仿真数据的角色：把仿真数据作为方差的"控制变量"而非学习目标本身，构建保守的仿真辅助学习算法。先在策略评估（RL的基础模块）上推导实现，再结合actor-critic做策略改进，并进一步扩展到offline RL场景。

Result: 在多个MuJoCo基准任务上，该方法相比标准仿真混合方法取得性能提升，验证了控制变量作为仿真辅助RL有效工具的可行性。

Conclusion: 关键结论是"用仿真降方差而非定目标"：把仿真数据从塑造目标转为控制变量，可在保留其数据量优势的同时抑制仿真器不准确带来的偏差，且该思路可从策略评估贯穿到策略改进与离线场景，具有良好的通用性。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms often rely on data collected from a target environment, which can be expensive and noisy. Although simulators can generate large amounts of additional data, standard simulation mixing approaches, which directly combine simulated and real experience, can degrade performance due to simulator inaccuracies, especially when they bias the solution away from the optimal policy. We propose a conservative simulation-aided learning method based on control variates, where simulated data is used solely to reduce variance in the learning process rather than directly shaping the learning target. We develop our approach for Policy-Evaluation, which is a fundamental building block of RL algorithms. Then we combine it within the actor-critic framework towards policy improvement, as well as extend it towards offline RL scenarios. Experiments on multiple MuJoCo benchmark tasks demonstrate improvements over standard simulation mixing approaches, highlighting control variates as an effective tool for simulation-aided reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [332] [PROLA: Principal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation for Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11318)
*Minseo Yoon,Minseong Bae,Sojin Lee,Hyunwoo J. Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“预测式时空天气降尺度”（PSWD）任务，并设计共享预训练主干+固定数值支架+轻量残差头的时空分解框架；核心是PROLA低秩适配方法，将固定低秩预算分配于预训练权重主方向与正交补，并用梯度信号重缩放rank-1优化器更新。实验表明PROLA优于代表性低秩适配基线，并在多数据集、多任务上具有更广适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率天气预测能捕捉粗粒度全球预报遗漏的局地大气模式；大型预训练天气主干提升了全球预报能力，但如何以低成本将其适配为“由近期粗状态预测未来高分辨率场”仍具挑战。该问题同时要求空间与时间分辨率细化，并预测未来高分辨率轨迹。

Method: 将问题形式化为Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling（PSWD）。框架将预测分解为空间与时间两个阶段，使用共享预训练主干、固定数值支架和轻量残差头。提出PROLA（PRincipal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation）：在预训练权重的主方向及其正交补之间分配固定低秩预算，并利用梯度信号对rank-1优化器更新进行重缩放，从而在不增加可训练秩的情况下改进适配。

Result: 在PSWD设定下，PROLA优于代表性低秩适配基线；在多种数据集和任务上的进一步实验支持PROLA的更广泛适用性，其收益不局限于主要天气降尺度场景。

Conclusion: 共享预训练主干与时空分解框架可有效支持未来高分辨率天气轨迹预测；PROLA作为一种更有效的低秩适配策略，在固定可训练秩预算下提升适配性能，并具备跨任务推广潜力。

Abstract: High-resolution weather prediction is important for resolving local atmospheric patterns missed by coarse global forecasts. Large pretrained weather backbones have improved global forecasting, but adapting them to produce future high-resolution fields from recent coarse states remains challenging and costly. We formulate this setting as Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling (PSWD), a task that jointly refines spatial and temporal resolution while predicting future high-resolution trajectories. To this end, we propose a framework that decomposes prediction into spatial and temporal stages using a shared pretrained backbone, fixed numerical scaffolds, and lightweight residual heads. For backbone adaptation, we introduce PROLA (PRincipal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation), which allocates a fixed low-rank budget between pretrained weights' principal directions and their orthogonal complement. PROLA further rescales rank-1 optimizer updates using gradient signals, improving adaptation without increasing trainable rank. Experiments in the PSWD setting show that PROLA outperforms representative low-rank adaptation baselines. Further experiments across diverse datasets and tasks support the broader applicability of PROLA, showing that its benefits extend beyond the primary weather downscaling setting.

</details>


### [333] [$Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12732)
*Xinrui Zu,Michael Przystupa,Zhao Yang,Shujian Yu,Kevin Sebastian Luck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在LeWorldModel基础上引入逆向动力学预测器和逆向动力学动作预测器两个额外潜在损失，以增强潜空间结构，提升世界模型的性能与规划效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型已广泛用于机器人操作与运动等基于模型的控制任务。早期架构依赖解码器来防止模式坍缩并学习可预测的潜空间，而近期方法（如JEPA、LeWorldModel）倾向于不使用解码器，仅用潜在前向动力学预测器和稳定化熵项学习嵌入。作者希望进一步增强潜嵌入结构，以提升方法在真实机器人实时控制中的适用性。

Method: 在LeWorldModel中加入两个额外的潜在损失：一个逆向动力学预测器（backward dynamics predictor）和一个逆向动力学动作预测器（inverse dynamics action predictor），在不使用解码器的情况下对潜嵌入施加更强的结构约束。

Result: 在标准世界模型基准和两个模拟机器人操作任务上，验证了所提方法在性能与规划效率上均取得进一步提升。

Conclusion: 通过引入逆向动力学预测器与逆向动力学动作预测器两个潜在损失，可对潜嵌入施加更多结构，从而在性能与规划效率上获得增益，这对提升此类方法在真实机器人实时基于模型控制中的适用性至关重要。

Abstract: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [334] [When Sensors Fail: Coverage Auditing with Incomplete Sensor Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11324)
*Chung-I Huang,Wen-Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出一种“测量记录审计”方法，用于在传感器断网导致部分预测目标不可评分时，检验预测区间覆盖率的真实表现，避免边际性能掩盖覆盖缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传感器断网会造成两类问题：一是预测区间覆盖率不足可能被总体边际表现掩盖；二是断网期间未来读数缺失，使部分已发布预测无法评分。因此需要一种审计框架，将发布时刻的断网时长、原始目标可得性与时间一致性的统计证据联系起来。

Method: 构建测量记录审计：保留完整预测键；在每个测量时点批量处理所有传感器与重叠预测期；将对同时覆盖计数和可评分计数的边界投影到累积条件期望覆盖比上，并区分该目标与经验覆盖率、断网条件总体覆盖率。

Result: 交通与空气质量数据示例显示，汇总覆盖率与长断网条件下覆盖率存在差距；在METR-LA中，仅7.6%的长间隔已发布预测具有原始可观测目标。30项主要顺序断网状态审计中，26项无定论，4项缺乏可评分支持。

Conclusion: 该文给出核心构造和部分聚合证据，强调断网条件下预测区间覆盖审计需考虑目标可得性和时间一致性证据；但主要审计结果多为无定论，说明现有数据支持仍有限。

Abstract: Sensor outages can conceal prediction-interval coverage deficits behind acceptable marginal performance, while unavailable future readings leave some issued forecasts unscorable. We present a measurement-record audit that links issue-time outage duration, original target availability, and time-uniform statistical evidence. The audit retains complete forecast keys, batches all sensors and overlapping horizons at each measurement tick, and projects simultaneous covered-count and scored-count bounds onto a cumulative conditional expected coverage ratio. This target is distinguished from empirical coverage and outage-conditional population coverage. Selected traffic and air-quality results illustrate the gap between pooled and long-outage coverage; in METR-LA, only 7.6% of issued long-gap forecasts have originally observed targets. Of 30 primary sequential outage-state audits, 26 are inconclusive and four lack scored support. This concise presentation gives the core construction and selected aggregate evidence without the full experimental supplement.

</details>


### [335] [When Credit Turns Against Tools: Transition-Aware Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11330)
*Xiangyu Lu,Zhanke Zhou,Jiazhe Ning,Chentao Cao,Jiangchao Yao,Bo Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文诊断了智能体强化学习中工具调用能力退化的三种耦合机制（工具token失衡、聚合放大、失败驱动重试），并提出 Transition-Aware Credit Assignment (TACA)，通过优势投影、决策对比与监督回放稳定推理到工具调用的过渡，在六个推理基准上平均提升 4.61（Qwen2.5-1.5B）与 3.61（Qwen2.5-3B）个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 采用可验证奖励的智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）让模型通过多轮工具交互训练，但训练过程中模型的推理性能与工具调用能力反而可能下降。作者希望定位这种退化根源并加以抑制。

Method: 先做机制归因：①工具token不均衡，错误轨迹每轮工具token更多导致整体工具奖励为负；②token均值聚合使更长的错误轨迹在策略更新中权重更大，放大负信号；③失败驱动的重试会拉长轨迹，把负credit延伸到纠错尝试。方法上提出TACA：(a) Advantage Projection，在每个prompt组内对工具调用token施以最小均匀平移，使平均优势非负；(b) Decision Contrast，对比同一prompt下工具辅助与直接回答的奖励以引导工具使用决策；(c) Supervised Replay，用先前采样到的正确轨迹中的调用做监督回放，强化工具调用生成。

Result: 在多个模型与任务上，TACA提升了性能并在训练中保持更可靠的工具交互；在六个推理基准上相对MT-GRPO，Qwen2.5-1.5B平均准确率提升4.61个百分点，Qwen2.5-3B提升3.61个百分点。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 工具调用能力的退化源于信用分配层面的系统性偏差而非单纯数据问题，针对“推理→工具调用”这一过渡环节进行定向信用分配（非负优势投影、决策对比、成功轨迹回放）可有效缓解抑制效应，实现性能与工具交互稳定性的双重提升。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains language models through multi-turn tool interactions, yet their reasoning performance and tool-calling ability can decline during training. We trace this degradation to three coupled mechanisms: (1) tool-token imbalance produces negative overall tool credit when incorrect trajectories contain more tool tokens per turn than correct ones; (2) aggregation amplification can further strengthen this negative signal as token-mean aggregation gives longer incorrect trajectories greater weight in policy updates; and (3) failure-driven retries prolong trajectories as models tend to call tools again after execution errors, extending potential negative credit to recovery attempts. To counter this suppression, we propose Transition-Aware Credit Assignment (TACA), which targets the transition from reasoning to tool use through supervision of both call initiation and generation. Specifically, TACA uses Advantage Projection to enforce a nonnegative mean advantage on tool-call tokens within each prompt group through a minimal uniform shift. Additionally, TACA guides tool-use decisions with Decision Contrast, comparing rewards for tool-assisted and direct answers to the same prompt. Through Supervised Replay, it reinforces tool-call generation using calls from previously sampled correct trajectories. Across models and tasks, TACA improves performance and sustains more reliable tool interaction during training, raising mean accuracy over MT-GRPO on six reasoning benchmarks by 4.61 percentage points for Qwen2.5-1.5B and 3.61 for Qwen2.5-3B. Our code is available at https://github.com/tmlr-group/TACA.

</details>


### [336] [Where Should a Gate Look? Input vs. State Gating in Diagonal State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11336)
*Riccardo Zattra,Giacomo Baggio,Leonardo De Marchi,Augusto Ferrante,Francesco Ticozzi,Marco Del Prà,Antonio Orvieto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在 diagonal state-space models 中，用简单的状态反馈门控调节记忆更新能否提升表达力；比较输入门控、状态门控及二者结合，并给出严格表达力分离与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代状态空间模型因线性、常对角动态而高效，但缺少经典 RNN 的非线性状态间交互；当记忆更新依赖过去上下文时，这种交互可能很重要。作者因此追问：仅通过一个简单门控引入状态反馈，是否足以增强对角状态空间模型的表达力。

Method: 比较三类门控：依赖当前输入、依赖循环状态、或同时依赖二者；在标量模型中理论分析 induction-head 任务，并在高维模型上开展 induction-head 与 selective copying 实验。

Result: 建立严格表达力分离：标量模型中，状态门控可在任意词表规模和序列长度下解决 induction-head；在状态转移矩阵的标准稳定性假设下，输入门控在某个有限实例上失败。高维实验中状态门控在 induction-head 上保持优势，而输入门控在 selective copying 上更好。

Conclusion: 即使简单、对角形式的状态反馈门控也能解锁输入控制模型不具备的能力；输入门控与状态门控优势互补，结合时整体性能最强。

Abstract: Modern state-space models owe much of their computational efficiency to their linear, often diagonal, dynamics. Classical recurrent neural networks instead allow nonlinear state-to-state interactions, which can be beneficial when memory updates need to depend on the past context. In this paper, we ask whether state feedback through a simple gate regulating memory updates can enhance the expressivity of diagonal state-space models. To investigate this question, we compare gates that depend on the current input, the recurrent state, or both. We establish a strict expressivity separation: for scalar models, state gating solves induction-head tasks for arbitrary vocabulary size and sequence length, whereas input gating fails on a finite instance under standard stability assumptions on the state transition matrix. Experiments show that state gating retains its advantage on induction-head tasks in higher-dimensional models, whereas input gating performs better on selective copying tasks. Together, our results show that even a simple, diagonal form of state-feedback gating can unlock capabilities unavailable to input-controlled models, while input and state gating offer complementary strengths and achieve the strongest overall performance when combined.

</details>


### [337] [OPSRL-SSP: Optimistic Posterior Sampling for Stochastic Shortest Path with Minimax-Optimal Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11337)
*Yiming Xu,Xian Wei,Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 OPSRL-SSP，一种面向未知转移的随机最短路径（SSP）在线强化学习算法，通过分 epoch 的对数时间采样调度与伪状态乐观边界构造，实现高概率 regret 界 Õ(B⋆√(SAK)+B⋆S²A)，其主项达到 minimax 下界，并推广到一般零成本 SSP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后验采样方法在 SSP 上经验表现良好，但 regret 保证未达到 minimax 最优阶；同时 Jafarnia-Jahromi 等人遗留了 SSP 后验采样的开放问题。

Method: 提出 OPSRL-SSP：算法按 epoch 运行，对后验采样数量采用对数、时间相关的调度；通过引入赋予乐观边界值的伪状态来增强转移模型，从而诱导乐观性；并将分析扩展到一般零成本 SSP，使用通用成本扰动论证。

Result: 建立高概率 regret 界 Õ(B⋆√(SAK)+B⋆S²A)，其中 B⋆ 为最优策略期望成本上界，S、A 分别为状态与动作数，K 为回合数；主项与 minimax 下界 Ω(B⋆√(SAK)) 相匹配。

Conclusion: OPSRL-SSP 弥补了 SSP 后验采样方法 regret 非最优的不足，解决了该设定下后验采样的开放问题，并说明方法可覆盖一般零成本 SSP。

Abstract: We study online reinforcement learning for the stochastic shortest path (SSP) problem with unknown transition dynamics. Although existing posterior-sampling methods perform well empirically on SSPs, their regret guarantees do not achieve the minimax-optimal order. We address this limitation by proposing OPSRL-SSP, an optimistic posterior-sampling algorithm for the SSP setting. The algorithm operates in epochs and uses a logarithmic, time-dependent schedule for the number of posterior samples. To induce optimism, we augment the transition model with a pseudo-state assigned an optimistic boundary value. We establish a high-probability regret bound of $\tilde{O}(B_\star \sqrt{SAK} + B_\star S^2 A)$, where $B_\star$ is an upper bound on the expected cost of the optimal policy, $S$ and $A$ are the numbers of states and actions, respectively, and $K$ is the number of episodes. In addition, we extend the analysis to general zero-cost SSPs using a universal cost-perturbation argument. The leading term matches the minimax lower bound $Ω(B_\star \sqrt{SAK})$, thereby addressing the open problem raised by Jafarnia-Jahromi et al. [19] for posterior sampling in the SSP setting.

</details>


### [338] [Agent Self-Improvement with Frozen Weights: The Added Value and Limits of Failure Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11342)
*Arkid Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文评估AI智能体的“harness”（模型周边的提示/笔记）能否从失败轨迹中学习。结论是：能学，但增益有限且场景依赖。固定权重的9B模型上，由更大教师模型撰写笔记，在生成式客服决策任务中，基于智能体错误的笔记比隐藏错误时提升4.0个百分点；其中“尝试并保留高分笔记”的流程本身贡献约60%。但在完整客服对话中未显示改进；单条经验筛选仅通过2条客服经验（尚待新数据验证）和1条未见过错误的工具使用经验（新任务无显著增益）；探索性结果显示无流程的中性笔记甚至优于学习经验；盲审还发现240条工具使用测试项中146条有缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体改进多依赖模型权重更新或人工设计提示，作者关心在模型权重固定时，能否利用智能体失败轨迹自动改进其harness（模型周围的笔记/提示），并检验这种“从失败中学习”的真实增益是否稳健、可迁移。

Method: 使用固定权重的开源9B参数模型，由更大的教师模型为其撰写笔记；设置对照实验比较“基于失败轨迹的笔记”与“同一流程但隐藏失败信息”的笔记；在生成式客服决策任务和完整客服对话上评估准确率；同时用严格筛选流程提取单条经验（lessons），并在新数据/新工具使用任务上测试；辅以探索性比较和盲审测试项质量。

Result: 生成式客服决策中，失败驱动笔记比隐藏失败信息提升4.0个百分点；单纯“尝试并保留更高分笔记”的搜索流程贡献约60%的总提升。完整客服对话中未显示改进。单条经验筛选中，2条客服经验通过但尚待新数据测试；1条未看失败信息的工具使用经验在新任务上无显著增益。探索性结果显示，无流程的中性笔记得分高于学习到的经验。盲审判定240条工具使用测试项中146条有缺陷。

Conclusion: 从失败轨迹中学习改进智能体harness存在可测但有限的效果，且主要增益可能来自搜索/选择流程而非失败信息本身；在更真实、完整的任务和新任务上的泛化证据不足，测试质量也存疑。因此不应夸大“失败驱动自我改进”的效果，需要更严格的跨任务验证与更可靠的评测设计。

Abstract: We evaluate whether an AI agent's harness, the notes around its model, can learn from the agent's failure traces beyond a matched search that never sees them. It can, but less than it looks. We tested an open 9-billion-parameter model with fixed weights; a larger teacher model wrote its notes. On generated customer-service decisions, where both note writers were told the target rules, notes based on the agent's mistakes improved accuracy by 4.0 percentage points over notes from the same process with the mistakes withheld. That process alone, trying and keeping better-scoring notes, reached about 60% of the total improvement. In full customer-service conversations the same notes showed no demonstrated improvement. Separately, a strict screen of single lessons admitted two customer-service lessons, still awaiting tests on new data, and one tool-use lesson, written without seeing the agent's mistakes, which showed no demonstrated gain on new tool-use tasks. A neutral note with no procedure scored higher than the learned lessons (exploratory). A blind audit judged 146 of 240 tool-use test items defective.

</details>


### [339] [Spatial Harness: Grounding Spatial Reasoning in Executable World States with Physics Engines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11344)
*Chentao Cao,Zhanke Zhou,Sangni Duan,Bo Han,Hang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Spatial Harness，将场景表示为显式可执行的世界状态，用物理引擎反馈替代模型内隐式空间想象，显著提升 VLM 的空间推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）处理空间推理时，完全依赖模型内部推理：先从部分视角隐式构建场景理解，再"想象"视角变换后的结果。这种做法存在双重风险——场景解读错误会直接导致答案错误；即便解读正确，靠想象得到的变换也未必满足真实的空间约束，且过程不可验证、不可干预。

Method: Spatial Harness 框架包含三部分：(1) 从问题中抽取场景约束，并结合专门的视觉估计结果；(2) 由 Perceiver 模块将物体与相机统一放置到共享坐标系下，形成显式的世界状态；(3) 将该状态实例化到物理引擎中，由 Reasoner 执行视角变换，利用引擎计算出的度量（距离、朝向、可见性等）与渲染视图来引导最终推理。这样把"内部想象"替换为"外部可执行的仿真验证"。

Result: 在 MindCube、SAT、MMSI-Bench、SpatialRGPT-Bench 四个基准上，对开源与闭源 VLM 进行评测。MindCube 上 Qwen3.5-27B 由 52.70% 提升至 71.14%，超过 pySpatial 7.52 个百分点；在给定相同标注物体与相机位姿的条件下，达到 98.25%，而模型内部推理仅为 71.81%。

Conclusion: 显式、可执行的世界状态表示能有效替代 VLM 的隐式空间想象，物理引擎反馈为空间推理提供了可靠、可验证的约束依据；位姿精度是决定性因素，说明提升感知前端与显式建模的一致性是后续关键方向。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning requires understanding how objects and observers are arranged in a scene and how their relations change with viewpoint or movement. Vision-language models (VLMs) typically perform both steps through model-internal reasoning, forming an implicit scene interpretation from partial views and imagining the consequences of spatial transformations. A misread scene can lead to a wrong answer, while even a correct interpretation does not ensure that imagined transformations satisfy spatial constraints. We introduce Spatial Harness, which represents scenes as explicit and executable world states to ground spatial reasoning in physics-engine feedback. A Perceiver integrates scene constraints extracted from the question with specialized visual estimates to place objects and cameras in a shared coordinate frame. The resulting state is instantiated in a physics engine, where a Reasoner executes viewpoint changes and uses computed measurements and rendered views to guide reasoning. We evaluate on MindCube, SAT, MMSI-Bench, and SpatialRGPT-Bench with open- and closed-weight VLMs. On MindCube, Spatial Harness improves Qwen3.5-27B from 52.70% to 71.14%, surpassing pySpatial by 7.52 percentage points. Given identical annotated object and camera poses, it reaches 98.25% versus 71.81% for model-internal reasoning. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tmlr-group/Spatial-Harness

</details>


### [340] [MG-Cache: Multi-Granularity Caching for Accelerating Diffusion Transformer Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11365)
*Zesen Chen,Youxuan Xu,Shigang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练的多粒度缓存方法 MG-Cache，在时间步与 Transformer 层两个粒度上复用计算，以加速 DiT 高分辨率图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT 推理成本高，尤其高分辨率生成；现有 diffusion caching 难以准确识别不同模块的重要性，也缺少跨时间步与层粒度的缓存协调，导致误差累积难以控制。

Method: 两阶段缓存策略：第一阶段离线进行时间步 profiling，识别可复用的冗余时间步；第二阶段自适应逐层缓存，结合输入稳定性与各 Transformer 层的重要性，选择性缓存稳定的 Attention 与 MLP 子模块。

Result: 在主流开源 DiT 模型上验证有效：显著加速且保持与未缓存输出较高保真度，在 HunyuanVideo 上最高达 4.18 倍加速。

Conclusion: MG-Cache 通过多粒度、免训练的缓存设计有效利用 DiT 计算冗余，在控制误差累积的同时实现显著推理加速。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformer (DiT) models, while having become a powerful backbone for generative synthesis, suffer from high inference cost on generating high-resolution images. Diffusion caching has emerged as a promising acceleration technique to reduce inference cost. However, existing caching strategies fail to accurately identify the varying importance of different computational modules and rarely coordinate cache reusing across the timestep and layer granularities, making it difficult to control error accumulation. To address these limitations, we propose multi-granularity caching (MG-Cache) for DiTs, a novel and fully training-free approach to exploit computational redundancy both on timesteps and Transformer layers. Our core innovation contains a two-stage caching strategy: an offline timestep profiling analysis that identifies redundant timesteps for cache reuse, followed by an adaptive layer-wise caching strategy that combines input stability with importance of each Transformer layer to selectively cache stable Attention and MLP submodules. Extensive experiments on mainstream open-source DiT models validate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving significant acceleration while maintaining high fidelity to the uncached output, with up to a 4.18x acceleration on HunyuanVideo.

</details>


### [341] [D3Tree: Learning to Prune Block-Diffusion Draft Trees for Efficient Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11371)
*Hong Nie,Zhangchi Gao,Jun Yu,Bo Wang,Jianqing Sun,Shengping Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: D3Tree 学习块扩散草稿树中哪些节点值得验证：用仅 2H+2 参数的树规模预测头估计候选节点条件存活率，沿父链阈值化得到祖先闭合子树，并在高负载下按预测存活率分配批级节点预算，从而在投机解码中显著提速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 块扩散草稿器一次前向生成整块 token，基于逐位置边际构建的草稿树可提升投机解码的期望接受长度；但树中每个节点都占用目标模型验证的一行 query，并发服务时低产出分支会与其他请求争夺验证容量。现有树方法按草稿概率在固定或按成本选定的每请求预算内选节点，因而总是保留草稿器排序的前缀，无法判断哪些节点真正值得验证。

Method: 提出 D3Tree：在冻结草稿器上训练一个仅含 2H+2 参数的树规模预测头，输入草稿状态、候选嵌入及草稿对数概率，预测每个候选的条件存活率；沿父链对存活率乘积做阈值化，得到祖先闭合且大小随请求和 decoding round 自适应的子树。训练使用完整候选树上的条件标签；可选联合模式还会引导草稿器偏向被保留的参考路径。服务时轻负载验证整棵树，重负载下按预测存活率分配一个批级节点预算，并按目标模型矩阵乘 tile 尺寸设定大小；保留树共享一次祖先掩码的目标前向，构建、剪枝与调度在 GPU 上运行并与主机端重叠。

Result: 在 6 个视觉语言验证器和 17 个文本及多模态基准上，D3Tree 在 72 个负载设置中的 70 个最快；单请求相对自回归解码加速 3.2–4.0 倍，64 并发请求时加速 1.3–1.8 倍，而固定预算树在该并发下已低于自回归速度。在时变到达轨迹下，其在每个到达阶段的平均端到端时延最低。

Conclusion: D3Tree 通过学习节点级存活率并将验证预算从固定前缀选择转为自适应、祖先闭合的子树选择，解决了并发服务中草稿树低产出分支挤占验证容量的问题；在多种模型与基准、不同负载及动态到达场景下均取得更优的端到端性能。

Abstract: Block-diffusion drafters propose a whole block of tokens in one forward pass, and draft trees built from their position-wise marginals increase the expected accepted length of speculative decoding. Every tree node occupies a query row in target verification, so under concurrent serving low-yield branches compete with other requests for verification capacity. Existing tree methods select verified nodes by draft probability under a fixed or cost-selected per-request budget, and thus always retain a prefix of the drafter's ranking. We present D3Tree, which learns which nodes of a block-diffusion draft tree are worth verifying. A tree-size head with 2H+2 parameters predicts each candidate's conditional survival from the draft state, the candidate embedding, and its draft log-probability. Thresholding the product of these scores along parent chains yields an ancestor-closed subtree whose size adapts to each request and decoding round.
