The head is trained on a frozen drafter with conditional labels on the full candidate tree; an optional joint mode also steers the drafter toward the retained reference path. At serving time, D3Tree verifies whole trees under light load and, under heavy load, allocates one batch-wide node budget by predicted survival, sized to the target's matrix-multiplication tiles. Retained trees share one ancestor-masked target pass, while construction, pruning, and scheduling run on the GPU and overlap with the host. Across six vision-language verifiers and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, D3Tree is fastest in 70 of 72 load settings, with 3.2-4.0x speedup over autoregressive decoding for one request and 1.3-1.8x at 64 concurrent requests, where fixed-budget trees fall below autoregressive speed. Under a time-varying arrival trace, it has the lowest mean end-to-end latency in every arrival phase.

</details>


### [342] [Self-Supervised Collapse Prevention with Score-Based Entropy Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11379)
*Adarsh Kappiyath,Silpa Vadakkeeveetil Sreelatha,Xiatian Zhu,Yann LeCun,Lu Yin,Amir Bar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EBReg 利用潜空间 score 估计正则化潜分布，防止自监督表示坍缩；ImageNet-1K 上 ViT-L 线性探针达 75.57%，并在 ImageNet-C 上通过 score 引导的测试时适应平均相对提升约 5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型中的 score-based 目标已在生成建模中证明有效，但其在自监督表示学习中的潜力仍未被充分探索。核心难点在于自监督训练容易发生表示坍缩，需要一种保持多样性的正则信号。

Method: 提出 Entropy-Based Regularization（EBReg）：联合学习编码器与潜变量 score 模型，用学习到的 score 提供保持多样性的信号。基于互信息下界，将目标表述为视图对齐加平滑边缘熵最大化，并在不显式估计密度的情况下优化边缘熵。同一 score 模型在测试阶段可将受损表示向训练潜分布细化。

Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上取得有竞争力的表示，ViT-L 线性探针准确率为 75.57%；在多种架构上，score 引导的测试时适应进一步改善 ImageNet-C 鲁棒性，平均相对准确率提升约 5%。

Conclusion: score 模型不仅能作为自监督表示学习的多样性正则工具，还可复用为测试时表示修正机制，兼顾表示质量与分布偏移下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Diffusion models have demonstrated the effectiveness of score-based objectives for generative modeling, yet their potential for self-supervised representation learning remains underexplored. We introduce Entropy-Based Regularization (EBReg), a framework that uses latent score estimation to regularize the latent distribution during self-supervised training. EBReg jointly learns an encoder and a latent score model, and utilizes the learned score to provide a diversity-preserving signal that prevents representational collapse. Motivated by a mutual-information lower bound, we formulate the objective as view alignment with smoothed marginal entropy maximization and optimize the marginal entropy without explicit density evaluation. The same score model can additionally be used at test time to refine corrupted representations toward the training latent distribution. Empirically, EBReg learns competitive representations on ImageNet-1K, achieving 75.57% linear-probe accuracy with ViT-L. Across diverse architectures, score-guided test-time adaptation further improves robustness on ImageNet-C, yielding an average relative accuracy gain of approximately 5%.

</details>


### [343] [Decomposing Earth Embeddings with Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11398)
*Vitus Benson,Fanny Yang,Markus Reichstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将稀疏自编码器（SAE）引入地球观测基础模型的嵌入分解，提出面向卫星像素的定制评测协议，验证SAE能在AlphaEarth与Tessera上生成稀疏、近单语义、更贴合细尺度空间结构的可解释特征，并初步探索其在下游应用中的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球观测基础模型产出的全球米级分辨率嵌入虽支撑农业、生态、水文等领域，但高度不透明：单个维度纠缠了互不相关的物理概念，导致难以解释、稳健性难以评估。现有针对语言模型的解释评测（如LLM评委）无法迁移到卫星像素，且空间自相关带来额外挑战，因此需要一种原则化的特征分解方法及定制化评测。

Method: 提出用稀疏自编码器（SAE）在过完备字典上将地球嵌入分解为稀疏、近似单语义的特征。因LLM评委不适用于卫星像素且需考虑空间自相关，设计定制评测协议，从三方面评分：匹配稀疏度下的重建质量、与参考概念的对齐程度、空间尺度特性；每项均与基线对比，基线中包括一个解码器为冻结随机字典的SAE。并在两个应用上测试稀疏编码：陆地覆盖子概念发现与基于适用域估计的分布外像素检测。

Result: 在匹配稀疏度下，SAE对AlphaEarth与Tessera嵌入的重建优于所有基线；其特征对齐的参考概念远少于原始维度（AlphaEarth上88%的特征最多对齐20个概念组中的一个，大多数不对齐任何概念，而原始维度中位数为12）；更集中于细空间尺度（BatchTopK与Matryoshka在640m图块内承载23%–32%的方差，对比仅9%）。冻结随机解码器的SAE同样具备后两项性质，说明这些源于稀疏性；但只有学习得到的字典能准确重建嵌入（AlphaEarth上训练SAE的未解释方差少8倍）。两个应用均显示稀疏特征的可行用途，但尚不足以实际使用。

Conclusion: 稀疏自编码器能有效将地球观测基础模型的不透明嵌入分解为更稀疏、更单语义、更贴合细尺度结构的可解释特征，并已初步验证其在子概念发现与分布外检测中的应用潜力。尽管下游应用仍不够可靠，本文整体是迈向"可检查特征"的地球观测模型的一步。

Abstract: Earth observation foundation models produce global metre-resolution embeddings that underpin work across agriculture, ecology, hydrology, and beyond. Yet these embeddings are opaque: each dimension entangles unrelated physical concepts, which makes them difficult to interpret and their robustness hard to assess. Here, we propose sparse autoencoders (SAEs) as a principled way to decompose Earth embeddings into sparse, approximately monosemantic features over an overcomplete dictionary. Because LLM judges of interpretations do not transfer to satellite pixels, and spatial autocorrelation matters, we introduce a tailored evaluation protocol. It scores any SAE on reconstruction at matched sparsity, alignment with reference concepts, and spatial scale, each against baselines that include an SAE whose decoder is a frozen random dictionary. On this protocol, SAEs reconstruct AlphaEarth and Tessera embeddings better than every baseline at matched sparsity. Their features align with far fewer reference concepts than raw embedding dimensions (on AlphaEarth, 88% align with at most one of 20 concept groups, most with none, against a median of 12 per raw dimension). They also carry more of their variance at fine spatial scales (23 to 32% within a 640 m patch for BatchTopK and Matryoshka, against 9%). An SAE with a frozen random decoder shares both properties, which therefore follow from sparsity, whereas only a learned dictionary reconstructs the embedding accurately: on AlphaEarth, trained SAEs leave eight times less variance unexplained. We test the sparse code on two applications, discovering land-cover sub-concepts and detecting out-of-distribution pixels by area-of-applicability estimation. Both indicate how sparse features could be used, but neither is yet reliable enough for practical use. Together, these results are a step toward Earth observation models whose features can be inspected.

</details>


### [344] [Computationally Efficient Offline Policy Optimization with All-Policy Linear Realizability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11423)
*Zhijie Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究有限时域MDP中离线策略优化：每层只需一次凸回归，达到 \u001cO(ε^{-2}) 样本复杂度，且计算复杂度关于 B 仅为对数多项式；并给出置信半径与舍入实现保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在仅有一条未知马尔可夫行为策略的独立完整轨迹、且满足全策略占用覆盖的离线设定下，希望在线性动作值函数可实现条件下，同时获得接近最优的样本效率和关于系数范数 B 的低计算复杂度，并放宽对初始状态分布及可实现性/覆盖检查的要求。

Method: 利用所有确定性马尔可夫策略动作值函数线性于已知特征、系数范数不超过 B 的假设；采用逐层一次凸回归，使用单一一致的马尔可夫见证策略的停止回报目标；通过共享参考设计与有界预测约束，将快速截断回归误差转化为原始线性预测的逐点置信；用截断杠杆控制性能损失，避免在尺度 B^{-2} 上做经验协方差近似；对置信半径向上舍入以保持见证策略，并给出有理数输入下的多项式时间位实现。

Result: 得到 \u001cO(ε^{-2}) 的样本依赖和关于 log(2+B) 的多项式计算复杂度；保证适用于任意固定初始状态分布，且可实现性与覆盖仅需对确定性策略检验。还给出具有一致近似可实现性、关于 B 多项式依赖的协方差覆盖变体；两动作下界表明精度指数 2 是必要的。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了有限时域线性MDP离线策略优化的高效算法：每层一次凸回归即可达到最优样本率，并在计算上对 B 仅呈对数多项式依赖，同时通过见证策略、置信半径舍入和截断杠杆技术提供严格的统计与实现保证。

Abstract: We study offline policy optimization in finite-horizon Markov decision processes where every deterministic Markov policy has an action-value function linear in known features, with coefficient norm at most $B$. From independent complete trajectories of one unknown Markov behavior policy, and under all-policy occupancy coverage, we give an algorithm with $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ sample dependence and computational complexity polynomial in $\log(2+B)$. The algorithm performs exactly one convex regression per layer. Its stopped-return targets are the values of a single consistent Markov witness policy. A shared reference design and bounded prediction constraints convert fast clipped-regression error into pointwise confidence for the raw linear predictions. Truncated leverage controls the performance loss without requiring empirical covariance approximation at scale $B^{-2}$. Rounding confidence radii upward preserves the exact witness and yields a polynomial-time bit implementation for rational numerical inputs. The guarantees allow any fixed initial-state distribution; realizability and coverage need only be checked for deterministic policies. We also establish a covariance-coverage variant with uniform approximate realizability and polynomial dependence on $B$. A two-action lower bound shows that the accuracy exponent $2$ is necessary.

</details>


### [345] [Learning to Rank Propagators in Constraint Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11447)
*Matija Lojović,Mladen Nikolić*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文用静态问题特征学习实例相关的传播器优先级：把任务建成 learning-to-rank，用自注意力模型联合打分并以 Plackett-Luce 目标训练，再将预测排序映射为 Choco 的离散优先级，从而在困难实例上显著提升求解性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传播器的执行顺序会显著影响约束规划求解器的性能，但现有求解器的传播器优先级多由固定的人工设计启发式决定，未考虑具体实例的差异。

Method: 将传播器优先级预测建模为排序学习问题，解决"优先级整体质量可用求解时间衡量、但单个传播器的理想优先级不可直接观测"的难题。采用基于自注意力的模型对同一实例中的传播器联合打分；训练信号来自在随机优先级分配下测得的求解时间所导出的成对偏好，并使用基于 Plackett-Luce 的排序损失。预测排序在搜索开始前映射到 Choco 求解器的离散优先级层级，不修改其传播与搜索流程；在 XCSP3 实例上评估。

Result: 按问题类别挑选的 698 个最难测试实例上，与 Choco 默认优先级相比，学习到的优先级使求解实例数从 634 增至 654，中位求解时间降低 27.93%，PAR1 降低 12.65%；改进幅度因问题类别而异，且一个简单地在学习优先级与默认优先级间选择的策略可进一步增加求解实例数。

Conclusion: 传播器排序对求解时间有实质影响，学习实例相关的传播器优先级能够提升约束规划求解性能，尤其在困难实例上效果明显。

Abstract: The order in which propagators are executed can substantially affect the performance of constraint programming solvers, yet propagator priorities are typically determined by fixed, manually designed heuristics. In this work, we explore learning instance-dependent propagator priorities from static problem features. We formulate the task as a learning-to-rank problem, addressing the challenge that the quality of a priority assignment can be measured through solver runtime, while the desired priorities of individual propagators are not directly observable. A self-attention-based model jointly scores the propagators present in an instance and is trained using pairwise preferences derived from solver runtimes measured under randomized propagator priority assignments, with a Plackett-Luce-based ranking objective. Predicted rankings are mapped to the discrete priority levels of the Choco solver before search begins, without modifying its propagation or search procedures. We evaluate the approach on XCSP3 instances and demonstrate that propagator ordering can have a substantial impact on solving time. On a test set of 698 instances, picked out as most difficult by problem class, the learned priorities increase the number of solved instances from 634 to 654, reduce median solver runtime by 27.93%, and reduce aggregate penalized runtime (PAR1) by 12.65% compared with Choco's default priorities. We further observe that improvements vary across problem classes and show that a simple policy selecting between learned and default priorities further increases the number of solved instances. These results demonstrate the potential of learning instance-dependent propagator priorities to improve constraint programming performance, particularly on difficult instances.

</details>


### [346] [Data-informed Adaptation of Foundation Models for Causal Effect Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11504)
*Chunwei Ma,Russell D Wolfinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MoE-Learner：用数据嵌入的变差函数（variogram）作为无需反事实的“路由信号”，在多个假设特定视角下选择最合适的因果专家，从而把因果假设的验证从先验固定选择转为可由数据几何检查的准则，在 IHDP、ACIC、Lalonde 上取得最佳平均排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果推断中反事实不可观测，训练目标与推断目标之间存在差距；CFM 虽通过大规模合成先验预训练降低流程负担，但摊销式推断不透明，难以判断模型对特定数据隐含依赖哪些假设。真实数据生成过程与结构因果模型高度多样，先验上很难知道哪种因果推断策略与给定数据集兼容。

Method: 聚焦观测数据与方法特定假设之间的兼容性，发现数据嵌入的几何特征——特别是 variogram——可作为判断某因果估计策略是否适用的信号。据此提出 MoE-Learner：将数据集嵌入到多个假设特定视角，并以 variogram 作为无需反事实的路由器，评估各因果专家的有效性，形成混合因果专家框架。

Result: 在 IHDP、ACIC、Lalonde 基准数据集上取得最佳平均排名；方法不消除因果假设，而是将其验证从固定先验选择转为可直接从数据几何检查的准则；与（因果）基础模型正交，可与之结合。

Conclusion: MoE-Learner 在数据特征与因果估计策略之间建立桥梁，提供一种透明、可由数据驱动的假设兼容性验证与专家选择方式，而非再提出一个 CFM。

Abstract: Due to the fundamental problem of causal inference -- the impossibility of observing counterfactual outcomes -- there is always a gap between the training goal (outcome, propensity) and the inference target (CATE, ATE). Traditional causal effect estimation revolves around setting assumptions, selecting identification strategies, and choosing causal estimators, while more recently, Causal Foundation Models (CFMs), built on Prior-Data-Fitted Networks (PFNs), ease this process by pretraining on massive synthetic prior datasets. Despite their success, such amortization makes causal inference less transparent, obscuring which assumptions the model implicitly relies on for a given dataset. The high diversity of real-world data-generating processes (DGPs) and Structural Causal Models (SCMs) makes it hard to know, a priori, which causal inference strategy is compatible with a given dataset. In this work, we focus on this compatibility between an observational dataset and method-specific assumptions, and find that geometric characteristics of data embeddings -- specifically, the variogram -- provide a useful signal of whether a given causal estimation strategy is appropriate. We develop MoE-Learner, a mixture-of-causal-experts framework that embeds a dataset under multiple assumption-specific views and uses the variogram as a counterfactual-free router to assess each expert's validity. Rather than eliminating causal assumptions, this shifts their validation from a fixed, a priori choice to a criterion that can be checked directly from data geometry. MoE-Learner achieves the best average rank on benchmark datasets (IHDP, ACIC, Lalonde). Being orthogonal to (causal) foundation models, our method builds a bridge from data characteristics to causal estimation strategy rather than proposing another CFM.

</details>


### [347] [Boundary Mass in Feature Space as a Label-Budget Diagnostic for Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11525)
*Siming Zhang,Zhehui Shen,Shijie Chen,Yansen Yu,Hang Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"有效边界复杂度"（effective boundary complexity）：在冻结表征与线性探针设定下，把"目标样本落在决策边界薄带内的质量"按类别平衡归一化，作为预测下游标签预算的诊断量；理论上证明光滑表征映射下一阶由边界法向伸缩决定，实验在74个映射上以0.38%中位相对误差验证定律，并在CIFAR-100/Tiny-ImageNet上显示其可预测标签需求与骨干排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可迁移性与探针质量分数只刻画全局对齐、似然、间隔与校准，回答不了实践中真正关心的问题：表征"看起来有用"之后，学下游边界还需要多少标签。稀缺标签的代价集中体现在边界附近的模糊区域，因此需要一个能度量该区域样本质量、并与标签预算直接挂钩的诊断指标。

Method: 定义边界质量：统计学习到的边界周围薄带内的目标样本质量，并用类别平衡归一化，使"密集模糊区"与"预测类不平衡"同时被计入。理论部分在光滑表征映射假设下证明密度变化与切向曲面变化在一阶相互抵消，法向的拉伸/压缩成为主导因素。据此构造缓存特征估计器：在一个数据切分上拟合探针，在独立的留出特征上统计靠近其边界的样本；并给出可微代理以支持优化。实验含受控变换验证、真实冻结特征上的法向/切向操控、五向OvR接口的骨干排序，以及三种采样策略的标签获取实验。

Result: 受控变换在74个映射上复现预测定律，中位相对误差0.38%；真实冻结特征上法向变化同时驱动测得的边界质量与标签需求，切向对照保持一阶系数不变；可微代理在匹配top-1效用下将测得复杂度降低16–36%；CIFAR-100与Tiny-ImageNet上边界质量可作为近并列表征的第二阶段诊断，五向实验中骨干排序与OvR接口一致性Spearman为0.872；获取实验中初始边界质量与实现标签预算在三种采样策略下相关0.779–0.830。

Conclusion: 边界附近的目标质量是一个有理论支撑、可用缓存特征低成本估计的标签预算诊断量，能补充现有全局可迁移性/探针质量指标，并在近并列表征之间提供有效区分；代码已开源。

Abstract: Low-label transfer is often decided by a practical question: after a representation looks useful, how many labels are still needed to learn the downstream boundary? Transferability and probe-quality scores characterize global alignment, likelihood, margins, and calibration. Boundary-near target mass complements these diagnostics by measuring the ambiguous regions where scarce labels are most costly. We propose effective boundary complexity, a label-budget diagnostic for frozen representations and linear probes. It measures mass in a thin strip around the learned boundary and normalizes it by class balance, so dense ambiguous regions and predicted-class imbalance are both counted. We prove that, under a smooth representation map, density change and tangential surface change cancel at first order, leaving boundary-normal stretch or compression as the governing factor. This yields a cached-feature estimator that fits a probe on one split and counts independent held-out features near its boundary. Experiments support the diagnostic at three levels. Controlled transformations match the predicted law across 74 maps with 0.38% median relative error. On real frozen features, normal-direction changes move both measured boundary mass and label demand, while tangent controls preserve the first-order coefficient. A differentiable surrogate reduces measured complexity by 16-36% at matched top-1 utility. Finally, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet experiments support boundary mass as a second-stage diagnostic for near-tied representations. Five-way experiments show strong OvR-interface backbone-ranking agreement (Spearman 0.872), while acquisition experiments show high correlations between initial boundary mass and realized label budgets across three sampling policies (0.779-0.830). Code is available at https://github.com/qqaqq-code/boundary_mass.

</details>


### [348] [A Stability Analysis of AdamW: Unstable Equilibria and Non-Convergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11526)
*Baiyu Su,Lizhang Chen,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从动力系统视角分析AdamW，指出其不动点对应一个带约束与正则化的隐式优化问题的驻点，但并非所有不动点都稳定；稳定性受曲率、权重衰减和动量参数影响，甚至一维情形下也可能出现持续振荡而非收敛。作者进一步给出高维连续时间动力学局部稳定的充分条件，并提出一种保持不动点的收敛性修正方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AdamW在深度学习中广泛使用，但其动力学行为仍缺乏清晰理解。作者希望回答AdamW究竟关联何种优化问题、何时可期望收敛，以及能否据此设计更可靠的优化器。

Method: 采用动力系统分析框架：将AdamW视为连续/离散动力系统，刻画其不动点与约束正则化优化问题驻点之间的对应关系；分析曲率、权重衰减和动量对稳定性的影响；从一维情形推广到高维，推导连续时间动力学局部稳定的充分条件；并提出保持原不动点的收敛性修正。

Result: AdamW的不动点与某约束正则化问题的驻点一致，但不动点未必稳定；稳定性敏感依赖曲率、权重衰减和动量参数。即使在一维情形，平衡点也可能不稳定，轨迹会出现持续振荡而非收敛。高维情形下给出了连续时间动力学局部稳定的充分条件，并构造了保持AdamW不动点的收敛性改进方案。

Conclusion: 该工作厘清了AdamW对应的隐式优化目标及其收敛条件，揭示了其动力学中可能的不稳定与振荡现象，并为设计更可靠的优化器提供了理论依据和修正思路。

Abstract: AdamW is ubiquitous in deep learning, yet its behavior remains poorly understood. We analyze its dynamics through the lens of dynamical systems and show that AdamW admits an implicit fixed-point objective: its fixed points coincide with the stationary points of a constrained and regularized optimization problem. However, not all of these fixed points are stable under AdamW's dynamics, and stability depends sensitively on curvature, weight decay, and momentum parameters. Even in one-dimensional settings, equilibria may be unstable, and trajectories can exhibit persistent oscillations rather than convergence to them. We further extend the analysis to higher dimensions, deriving sufficient conditions for local stability of the continuous-time dynamics, and propose a convergent modification that preserves AdamW's fixed points. These results clarify what optimization problem AdamW is associated with, when its convergence can be expected, and how its dynamics could inspire more reliable optimizers.

</details>


### [349] [Data Manipulation Attacks Against Machine Learning Integrated Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11529)
*Soyon Choi,Scott Alfeld,Meiyi Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对由视觉、规划等多个ML模型组合而成的CPS/状态机式AI系统，提出为数据操纵型攻击者生成"攻击策略"（状态→攻击的映射）的框架与最优策略求解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有大量工作证明单个机器学习算法可被操纵或欺骗，但真实系统中的自动决策往往由多个ML算法组合完成（如CPS中视觉、规划等模型串联，影响内部状态并最终在物理世界采取行动）。然而，现有关于ML算法（不）安全性的文献虽多，却并不清楚攻击者如何把"欺骗单个学习器"的能力用于攻击整体组合系统。

Method: 将组合式AI系统建模为状态机/CPS，构造一个数据操纵型攻击者模型；以攻击策略（从系统状态到具体攻击的映射）刻画攻击行为，给出基本威胁模型，并提出计算最优攻击策略的方法，同时说明后续扩展方向。

Result: 论文为工作进展（work-in-progress）报告，主要给出框架、威胁模型与最优攻击策略的计算方法学，并规划了扩展；摘要中未报告具体实验数据或量化结果。

Conclusion: 该文旨在通过提出组合学习安全性的攻击策略框架来引发讨论、促成新的合作，为后续研究工作奠定问题建模与方法基础。

Abstract: There is a well-established body of work demonstrating that individual machine learning (ML) algorithms can be manipulated or deceived. However, in many real-world systems, multiple ML algorithms are composed to enable automated decision-making, particularly in Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS). Often such systems use a composition of vision, planning, and other ML models to affect their internal state and ultimate take actions in the physical world. While there is a huge literature on the (in)security of ML algorithms, it is not immediately clear how an attacker might leverage their ability to trick individual learners when attacking the composition as a whole. We develop methods for creating an attack policy (a mapping from state to attack) for a data-manipulating attacker affecting a CPS or other state-machine-based AI compositions. We describe our framework, a basic threat model and corresponding methods for computing an optimal attack policy, as well as planned extensions. The goal of this work-in-progress paper is to stimulate conversation and forge new collaborations regarding the security of compositional learning.

</details>


### [350] [Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11531)
*Ambroise Odonnat,Theo Gnassounou,Laetitia Chapel,Romain Tavenard,Ievgen Redko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文对对视觉基础模型与大语言模型的表示进行逐层、逐模块的线性探测（超14.4万次评估），发现层与模块应联合选择，并给出简单固定的探测策略（视觉用Act@100，语言用LN2@60），可回收大部分最优增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有探测实践多直接使用最后一层，虽已有工作表明中间层特征更优，但研究基本只沿"深度"维度展开，把每个Transformer block视为不可分的原子单元，忽略block内部不同模块（attention、feedforward、normalization等）的表示差异，因而可能严重低估可用特征的质量。

Method: 对视觉基础模型（VFMs）与大语言模型（LLMs）进行超过144,000次线性探测评估，系统地按层（layer-by-layer）与按模块（module-by-module）拆解Transformer表示，联合比较"层—模块"组合的探测效果；在此基础上归纳并验证若干简单固定的探测策略：视觉采用最后一层前馈激活（Act@100），语言采用60%深度处的第二归一化层（LN2@60），并与最终层残差流基线及最优层—模块对进行对比。

Result: 最优"层—模块"组合相对固定层而仅用最终层残差流的提升，显著大于仅更换最佳层带来的提升；同一模块在不同层上的表现差异很大，说明有用表示无法仅由深度刻画。固定策略Act@100与LN2@60在多数评估中优于基线，并分别平均回收视觉42%、语言86%的最优层—模块组合增益；对VFM而言，当预训练与下游数据的迁移难度越大时，这类增益越明显。

Conclusion: 探测基础模型表示时应将层与模块联合考虑，而非把block当作原子单位、只沿深度搜索；模块级分析能揭示深度之外的表示结构。实践上可直接采用无需搜索的固定策略（视觉Act@100、语言LN2@60）以低成本获得大部分收益，且收益随迁移难度上升而增大，为下游适配与特征选择提供了简单可用的准则。

Abstract: Which representation should be probed in a transformer-based foundation model? Recent work shows that the standard practice of probing the final layer is often suboptimal, as intermediate layers can provide better features. Yet, representations are still largely studied along depth alone, treating each transformer block as an atomic unit. In this work, we analyze transformer representations layer by layer, module by module. Through more than 144,000 linear probing evaluations of vision foundation models (VFMs) and large language models (LLMs), we show that layer and module choices should be considered jointly: the best layer-module pair yields substantially larger gains over the final-layer residual stream than the best layer with the residual stream fixed. Moreover, module performance can vary substantially across layers, showing that useful representations cannot be characterized by depth alone. Building on these findings, we evaluate simple fixed probing strategies: the final-layer feedforward activation (Act@100) for vision and the second normalization layer at 60% depth (LN2@60) for language. These strategies improve over the probing baseline in a majority of evaluations and recover, on average, 42% and 86% of the gains from probing the best layer-module pair for vision and language, respectively. For VFMs, these gains increase with the transfer difficulty between pretraining and downstream data.

</details>


### [351] [UTOPI: Efficient Egocentric Long-Video Understanding in AR via User-Guided Token Pre-Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11562)
*Ziqi Wang,Su Chen,Qiance Tang,Jieyu Lin,Ziyun Li,Barbara De Salvo,Sai Qian Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UTOPI：面向AR眼镜第一视角长视频的即插即用预压缩模块，利用头部运动估计帧间重叠进行视点偏移不变剪枝，并结合眼动注视点分离前景/背景，实现最高95%压缩且保持下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频理解受关注，AR设备成为重要部署平台；但第一视角视频存在大量时间冗余，给资源受限的AR硬件带来沉重内存与计算负担，亟需在输入模型前进行高效压缩。

Method: 提出UTOPI即插即用预压缩模块：1）利用用户运动信号估计帧间重叠，设计视点偏移不变的剪枝算法去除冗余帧；2）利用眼动追踪识别注视点，将被关注的前景内容与背景分离，并通过微调的神经网络调整机制优先保留前景。

Result: 在多个基准和多种模型骨干上，UTOPI最高实现95%的压缩率，同时保持原有任务性能。

Conclusion: UTOPI表明，结合可穿戴运动与眼动信号可在AR端大幅降低第一视角长视频的冗余与计算成本，是一种通用、可插拔的长视频预压缩方案。

Abstract: As long-video understanding gains increasing attention, augmented reality (AR) devices are emerging as a compelling deployment platform. However, egocentric videos exhibit significant temporal redundancy, imposing substantial memory and computational burdens on resource-constrained AR hardware. To address this challenge, we introduce UTOPI, a plug-and-play pre-compression module designed specifically for egocentric long videos on AR platforms. First, we leverage user motion signals to estimate inter-frame overlap and propose a viewpoint-shift-invariant pruning algorithm. Second, we exploit eye-tracking sensors to identify user fixations, enabling the separation of attended foreground content from background and its preferential retention via a fine-tuned neural network-based adjustment mechanism. Across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, UTOPI achieves up to 95% compression while preserving performance. Code and project page are available at https://sai-lab-nyu.github.io/utopi/.

</details>


### [352] [Building heterogeneous multistep workflows in automated microscopy: reward design and knowledge transfer for autonomous structure property discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11609)
*Sergei V. Kalinin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个预算约束的自主显微镜框架，用于多步骤结构-性质工作流，控制器不仅决定"测哪里"，还决定"采集什么信息、扫描速率、何时重校准"，并通过真实电子能量损失谱数据的两组实验验证其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主显微镜若要真正把快速采集转化为科学进展，就不能只决定测量位置，还需决定采集何种信息、以何种扫描速率采集以及何时重新校准仪器；而现有工作缺乏统一、可复现且可审计的框架来权衡科学收益与动作成本。

Method: 构建预算受限的多步骤结构-性质工作流框架，融合显式科学奖励、动作成本、仪器观测模型、实验前知识向在线campaign的迁移（预测器精度与计算成本、经验学习成熟度函数用于加权模型奖励、预先刻画的漂移特性），并保持评估独立于控制器。基于真实电子能量损失谱数据集开展两组campaign：一是在成像与谱学、图像尺寸、扫描速度间选择；二是在仪器漂移下额外决定何时重校准。

Result: 两组campaign表明：响应发现与结构-性质学习偏好不同的代理模型和采集策略；简单的采集规则构成强而实用的基线；独立误差分析揭示了模型不确定性作为学习信号可靠与否的边界；漂移campaign中显式配准显著提升定位精度，框架量化了其对谱学通量的代价。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了可复现地设计、比较与审计自主实验的途径，并明确了显微镜部署所需能力：可独立执行的动作、经表征的扫描与探测器响应、带时间戳的配准遥测，以及完整的动作记录。

Abstract: Autonomous microscopy can turn fast acquisition into scientific progress when it decides not only where to measure, but also what information to acquire, at what scan rate, and when to recalibrate the instrument. We develop a budget constrained framework for such multistep structure-property workflows. It combines explicit scientific rewards, action costs, instrument observation models, transfer of pre experiment knowledge into the online campaign, and evaluation kept independent of the controller. The transferred knowledge includes predictor accuracy and computational cost, empirical learner maturity functions that weight model-derived rewards, and drift characteristics established before controller training. Using a real electron energy-loss spectroscopy dataset, we run two complementary campaigns. In the first, the controller chooses between imaging and spectroscopy, image size, and scan speed. In the second, the instrument drifts and the controller also decides when to recalibrate. The campaigns show that response discovery and structure-property learning favor different surrogate models and acquisition strategies. They also show that simple acquisition rules form strong, practical baselines. Independent error analysis reveals where model uncertainty is and is not a reliable learning signal. In the drift campaign, explicit registration greatly improves positional accuracy, and the framework measures what this costs in spectroscopy throughput. Together, these results provide a reproducible way to design, compare, and audit autonomous experiments, and they define what microscopes must provide for deployment: independently executable actions, characterized scan and detector responses, timestamped registration telemetry, and complete action records.

</details>


### [353] [Daily Emergency Call Volume Forecasting using Univariate and Multivariate TimeGPT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11613)
*Feriel Fass,Djemel Ziou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究评估时间序列基础模型TimeGPT预测每日急救呼叫量的能力，并与SARIMAX、Poisson/负二项回归、XGBoost、MLP、LSTM等传统方法比较。结果显示：单变量情境下SARIMAX最优，多变量情境下NBR和PR最优，TimeGPT的大规模预训练并未带来更优精度，仅用现有数据训练的轻量方法更适合该应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急救呼叫量预测对应急资源配置至关重要；近年来时间序列基础模型（如TimeGPT）声称借助大规模预训练可获得强泛化能力，但其在急救呼叫量这一高噪声、强季节性实际场景中的有效性尚不明确，需要与成熟传统方法进行严格对比验证。

Method: 使用2101天真实急救呼叫数据进行单变量与多变量预测，涵盖一步 ahead 和七天多步 ahead 场景；多变量模型引入时间、气象、人口与社会经济变量。采用按时间顺序的训练/验证/测试划分以防信息泄露，通过验证集网格搜索与早停选择超参数，并以多种误差指标评估。将TimeGPT与SARIMAX、Poisson回归、负二项回归、XGBoost、MLP、LSTM进行比较。

Result: 单变量情境下SARIMAX整体表现最佳；多变量情境下负二项回归（NBR）和Poisson回归（PR）表现最佳。TimeGPT未能在任何设定下取得优于这些基线方法的整体精度。

Conclusion: 大规模预训练的时间序列基础模型并不必然转化为急救呼叫量预测的更高精度；仅基于可用数据训练的“节俭型”方法在该应用中仍然更优，提示实际部署应优先考虑简单、数据高效的传统统计模型。

Abstract: This study investigates the potential of TimeGPT, a pretrained foundation model for timeseries, for forecasting daily emergency call volumes. Real-world emergency call data, comprising 2,101 daily observations, are used to evaluate both univariate and multivariate forecasting settings under one-step-ahead and seven-day multi-step-ahead scenarios. The multivariate forecasting incorporates temporal, meteorological, demographic, and socioeconomic variables. A chronological training, validation, and test split is adopted to prevent information leakage, while hyperparameters are selected using the validation set through grid search and early stopping when applicable. Forecasting performance is evaluated using multiple error metrics. Its forecasting performance is compared with several established forecasting approaches, including Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Regressors (SARIMAX), Poisson regression (PR), Negative Binomial regression (NBR), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The results show that SARIMAX achieves the best overall performance in the univariate setting. In the multivariate setting, NBR and PR provide best performance. These findings indicate that the large-scale pretraining of TimeGPT do not necessarily translate into superior forecasting accuracy for emergency call volumes. Frugal methods trained solely on the available data remain better for this application.

</details>


### [354] [GenISys: Integrated Ship Systems Design Using Subsystem-Conditional Tabular Diffussion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11622)
*Noah J. Bagazinski,Faez Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GenISys框架，用同时条件去噪扩散概率模型（SCDDPM）实现船体、结构、推进与运营子系统的联合生成，在21.8万条散货船早期设计方案上验证其可行性优于整体生成与顺序生成方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 船舶设计需协调耦合子系统，在工程约束下平衡相互竞争的性能与成本目标。生成式AI虽已用于部件级设计，但整船生成还需考虑船体几何、结构、推进与运营之间的交互作用，现有方法缺乏对子系统间相互响应机制的建模。

Method: 构建包含217,999个候选方案（其中16,247个满足工程约束）的数据集；提出同时条件去噪扩散概率模型（SCDDPM），使各子系统模型在生成过程中同步响应其他子系统的变化；与整体式整船生成、顺序式子系统生成对比，每种架构独立训练5次；以5,000海里航程需求、降低单位货物运输成本为目标开展生成实验。

Result: SCDDPM在55.70%的生成请求中产出同时满足工程约束与低成本目标的设计，整体式模型为51.10%，顺序式模型为47.54%，即分别多出9.0%与17.2%的合格设计，且估计运输成本相当。

Conclusion: 结果表明生成式AI可通过协调子系统生成可行且高性能的集成系统，为船舶等复杂工程系统的早期一体化设计提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Ship design requires coordinating coupled subsystems to satisfy engineering constraints and balance competing performance and cost objectives. Generative artificial intelligence has supported component design, but integrated ship generation must also account for interactions among hull geometry, structure, propulsion, and operation. This paper presents GenISys, a framework for generating integrated systems, demonstrated through early-stage bulk-carrier design. Its dataset contains 217,999 proposed designs, including 16,247 that satisfy the formulated engineering constraints. The proposed simultaneous conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (SCDDPM) generates subsystems together, allowing each subsystem model to respond to changes elsewhere during generation. Experiments compare this approach with monolithic whole-ship generation and sequential subsystem generation across five independent training runs per architecture. In a study targeting lower cost per tonne of cargo transported, designs were generated for a required voyage range of 5,000 nautical miles. SCDDPM produced designs satisfying the formulated engineering constraints and meeting a common low-cost target in 55.70% of generation requests, compared with 51.10% for the monolithic model and 47.54% for the sequential model. These correspond to 9.0% and 17.2% more qualifying designs, respectively, while maintaining similar estimated transport costs. These results show how generative artificial intelligence can coordinate subsystems to generate feasible, high-performing integrated systems.

</details>


### [355] [A Trust Region Approach for Learning Schrödinger Bridges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11649)
*Takeshi Koshizuka,Denis Blessing,Max Zimmer,Sebastian Pokutta,Lorenz Richter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对仅有未归一化目标密度、缺少目标分布的采样场景，提出施罗德布里奇斯求解的信任域IPF变体，通过将更新限制在固定KL散度内提升数值稳定性，并可解释为自适应步长镜像下降，在多项困难采样任务上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在无法获得目标分布样本、仅给定未归一化密度的场景下，常用的迭代比例拟合（IPF）及其变体常出现严重数值不稳定，原因在于底层控制问题病态且最优解可能远离初始化。

Method: 提出IPF的信任域变体：约束每次更新与当前迭代点保持固定的Kullback-Leibler散度，从而限制步幅、增强数值稳定性；并证明该方法可解释为带自适应步长的镜像下降方案。

Result: 该限制显著提升了数值稳定性；方法具有镜像下降与自适应步长的理论解释；在多个具有挑战性的采样任务上展示了有效性。

Conclusion: 通过信任域式KL约束改造IPF，可在仅有未归一化目标密度时稳定地近似求解施罗德布里奇斯，并为方法提供镜像下降视角，具备实际采样效果。

Abstract: We study the numerical approximation of Schrödinger Bridges in the setting where samples from the target distribution are unavailable and only an unnormalized target density is given. In this regime, the widely used iterative proportional fitting (IPF) procedure (and its variants) often exhibits severe numerical instabilities, stemming from ill-conditioned underlying control problems and from the fact that the optimal solution may lie far from the initialization. To address these issues, we propose a trust region variant of IPF that constrains successive updates to remain at a fixed Kullback-Leibler divergence from the current iterate. This restriction significantly improves numerical stability. Moreover, we show that the resulting method admits an interpretation as a mirror descent scheme with an adaptively chosen step size. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on several challenging sampling tasks.

</details>


### [356] [Means vs. Foundation Models for Emergency Call Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11656)
*Feriel Fass,Djemel Ziou,Marie-Flavie Auclair-Fortier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究比较Hölder均值（HM）与Lehmer均值（LM）两类广义均值与微调TimeGPT在每日紧急呼叫量预测上的表现，结果表明短期广义均值略优、长期TimeGPT略优，但Diebold-Mariano检验显示各预测步长上差异均不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究简单、轻量的广义均值方法能否在应急呼叫量预测中达到与TimeGPT等大型基础模型相当的性能，从而检验复杂模型相较于简单方法的实际增益。

Method: 在真实紧急呼叫数据集上，对Hölder均值（HM）与Lehmer均值（LM）两族广义均值与微调后的TimeGPT进行对比，覆盖1至7天的预测步长；采用多种误差指标评价，并使用Diebold-Mariano检验判断差异的统计显著性。

Result: HM与LM在各预测步长上性能几乎一致。短期（1天和3天）两者优于TimeGPT，MAE分别约降低1.24%和2.48%；7天时TimeGPT更优，MAE约降低1.98%。但Diebold-Mariano检验在所有评估步长上均未发现统计学显著差异。

Conclusion: 广义均值能够提供与大型基础模型相竞争（comparable）的预测性能，说明在此类任务中简单方法可作为高效替代方案；但其与TimeGPT的差异在统计上并不显著，需谨慎解读点估计上的优势。

Abstract: This study investigates whether generalized means can achieve forecasting performance comparable to that of TimeGPT for daily emergency call volume prediction. Specifically, two families of generalized means, the Hölder means (HM) and the Lehmer means (LM), are evaluated against fine-tuned TimeGPT across forecasting horizons ranging from one to seven days. Forecasting performance is assessed on a real-world emergency call dataset using multiple error metrics, and Diebold-Mariano test. Experimental results show that HM and LM achieve nearly identical predictive performance across all forecasting horizons. For short-term forecasting, both generalized means outperform TimeGPT, with reductions of mean absolute error (MAE) approximately 1.24\% and 2.48\% at horizons of one and three days, respectively. Conversely, TimeGPT achieves a lower error at the seven-day horizon, with an descresing of MAE by 1.98\%. However, Diebold-Mariano tests reveal no statistically significant differences between the methods at the evaluated horizons. These findings suggest that generalized means can provide competitive forecasting performance compared with a energyvore foundation model.

</details>


### [357] [Update Slope Is Bounded by Prior Calibration: A Structural Bound and Its Contingent Empirical Signature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10325)
*Ben Jenkins,Mihaela Cardei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出LLM预测评估中常用的“更新斜率”指标存在两个混杂：证据构造是否知情结果，以及斜率作为变化分数受先验校准天花板的制约；并据此提出改进的评估与报告方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM预测能力评估越来越依赖“证据越丰富、预测改善越多”的更新斜率，作者关注该指标是否真正测量了模型的更新行为，还是被证据构造方式与初始校准差异所混淆。

Method: 在相同模型与问题上比较结果知情与结果盲的证据阶梯所得到的斜率；分析更新斜率作为变化分数的先验依赖结构上限；在Manifold、ForecastBench与ACLED数据池中考察斜率与先验校准的经验耦合及余量利用；并检验控制先验校准后中间更新与最终Brier分数的关联，以及问题身份与模型身份的解释方差。

Result: 结果知情的证据构造使测得斜率约为结果盲证据阶梯的四倍；斜率存在由先验决定的结构上限，只界定可行区域，斜率与先验校准是否耦合取决于余量利用并在不同数据池间变化；控制先验校准后，中间更新与最终Brier分数的关联约增强三倍；问题身份解释的方差显著多于模型身份。

Conclusion: 建议构建对结果盲的证据阶梯、在分析中控制先验校准，并在报告原始斜率的同时报告经余量归一化的指标，以避免将证据构造偏差与起始校准差异误读为更新能力。

Abstract: Evaluations of LLM forecasters increasingly measure how forecasts improve as richer evidence is supplied. We identify two confounds in this update-slope metric. First, outcome-aware evidence construction substantially inflates measured responsiveness: on the same models and questions, slopes are roughly four times larger than with resolution-blinded evidence ladders. Second, update slope is a change score with a prior-dependent structural ceiling, so raw comparisons can reflect differences in starting calibration rather than updating behavior. The ceiling defines only a feasible region; whether slope and prior calibration are empirically coupled depends on headroom utilization and varies across our Manifold, ForecastBench, and ACLED pools. Despite this variability, conditioning on prior calibration roughly triples the association between intermediate updating and final Brier score under both blinded and outcome-aware construction. Question identity also explains substantially more variance than model identity across the evaluated pools. We recommend building evidence ladders blind to outcomes, conditioning on prior calibration, and reporting headroom-normalized measures alongside raw slopes.

</details>


### [358] [A Theoretical Reduction From Membership Inference to Reconstruction Attacks Against Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11680)
*Amnon Levi,Yuval Dagan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究从学习模型中恢复训练数据的重构攻击，证明成员推断在特定对抗模型下可归约为重构，并针对随机凸优化（SCO）给出高效重构攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解成员推断与训练数据重构之间的理论联系，并评估随机凸优化学习算法在指数级大支撑分布下的隐私泄露风险。

Method: 在参数化分布族的对抗模型中，假设攻击者知道生成硬实例的参数；提出一般性归约，将高召回率、低假阳性率的成员推断测试转化为重构算法；对SCO利用结构化分布，将支撑集划分为多项式多个类别、每类含指数多元素，使重构按类别迭代而非遍历整个支撑集，并结合已有SCO成员推断结果。

Result: 若训练集大小为n，成员测试召回率至少q(n)、假阳性率O(δ²/n²)，则可构造重构算法，以1-O(δ)概率仅输出训练点，并在期望意义上恢复Ω(n·q(n))个训练点；该归约适用于任意学习算法。对SCO，结合已有成员推断结果可证明：任何在所有分布上达到低超额风险的学习算法，都存在多项式时间重构攻击，即使分布支撑集指数级大，也能恢复Ω(n)个训练点。

Conclusion: 成员推断在强召回与低假阳性条件下可推出训练数据重构；SCO中低超额风险学习算法普遍面临多项式时间重构攻击，且该风险不因支撑集指数级大而消失。

Abstract: We study reconstruction attacks, which recover training data from a learned model. In our adversarial model, the adversary designs a hard instance, drawn from a parameterized family of data distributions, and is given the parameter used to generate it. Our main contribution is a general reduction showing that, in this model, membership inference (determining whether a given datapoint was used for training) implies reconstruction: for a training set of size $n$, a membership test with recall at least $q(n)$ and false-positive rate $O(δ^2/n^2)$ yields a reconstruction algorithm that, with probability $1 - O(δ)$, outputs only training points, and recovers $Ω(n \cdot q(n))$ of them in expectation. This reduction applies to any learning algorithm. For stochastic convex optimization (SCO), we make the reduction computationally efficient over exponentially large domains via structured distributions whose support is partitioned into polynomially many categories of exponentially many elements each, so that reconstruction iterates over categories rather than the full support. Combining this with an existing membership inference result for SCO, we prove that any learning algorithm achieving low excess risk over all distributions admits a polynomial-time reconstruction attack recovering $Ω(n)$ training points, even when the underlying distribution has exponentially large support.

</details>


### [359] [Reproducible LoRA Inference Through Deterministic Split-K Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10334)
*Dhayaneshwar Balusamy,Ankur Mohan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出 vLLM 中用于 LoRA 低秩乘法的 Split-K 核在 FP32 原子加合并部分结果时引入数值非确定性，导致可复现性受损；作者提出确定性 Triton Split-K 实现，在保持并行加速的同时消除该变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA 适配的语言模型被广泛用于重复性评测、审计与决策，可复现性至关重要。然而为提升并行度而采用的 Split-K 核在使用浮点原子加合并部分结果时会产生数值非确定性，这一隐患此前缺乏系统量化与修复方案。

Method: 在 vLLM 框架下，围绕 GSM8K 数学推理、MBPP 代码生成，以及 Civil Comments 上 Jev 式结构化毒性决策三类任务，进行相同输入重放实验，量化 Atomic Split-K=8 的抖动；并通过受控追踪分析 shrink 输出差异如何传播到 KV cache 并影响 token 决策；进而实现一个保持并行度的确定性 Triton Split-K 版本作对比。

Result: 相同输入重放下，Atomic Split-K=8 在 97.61% 的对比中产生不同的 FP32 shrink 输出，而确定性版本未观察到变化；重复推理使 17.30% 的 GSM8K 与 14.96% 的 MBPP 生成结果改变，有时影响任务正确性；结构化决策概率在 81.47% 的对比中变化并出现决策翻转。确定性实现相对原子版本仅增加 1.02–2.62% 延迟，却比未切分归约快 16.8–21.1%。

Conclusion: Split-K 原子加导致的数值非确定性会沿 KV cache 累积并实质改变模型输出与决策，威胁 LoRA 模型的可复现性；所提确定性 Triton Split-K 实现几乎无额外开销地解决了该问题，是可落地的工程修复方案。

Abstract: Reproducibility is important for LoRA-adapted language models used in repeated evaluation, auditing, and decision-making. However, Split-K kernels used to introduce parallelism in low-rank LoRA multiplications can have the unintended consequence of numerical nondeterminism when partial results are combined using floating-point atomic additions. We investigate this non-determinism in vLLM across GSM8K mathematical reasoning, MBPP code generation, and Jev-style structured toxicity decisions on Civil Comments and introduce a deterministic Triton Split-K implementation. Under identical-input replay, Atomic Split-K=8 produces different FP32 shrink outputs in 97.61% of comparisons, while our Deterministic Split-K=8 shows no observed variation. Repeated atomic inference changes generated outputs in 17.30% of GSM8K and 14.96% of MBPP comparisons, sometimes altering task correctness. Structured-decision probabilities vary in 81.47% of atomic comparisons, with decision flips. Controlled tracing demonstrates how shrink-output differences propagate into the KV cache and how accumulated cache differences can change token decisions and final answers. Our deterministic Triton Split-K=8 implementation preserves parallelism, achieving 16.8-21.1% latency-based speedup over unsplit reduction with only 1.02-2.62% additional latency relative to Atomic Split-K=8.

</details>


### [360] [Resolvent Ellipsoid for Minty Set Inclusions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11691)
*Ashkan Soleymani,Gabriele Farina,Patrick Jaillet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究紧凸集上Minty集包含问题，提出基于几何分离原理与椭球法的RESOLVENT-ELLIPSOID算法，在固定尺度约束预解oracle模型下以O(poly(d, log(1/ε)))次黑盒查询计算ε-SVI解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单调包含（Minty集包含）问题在黑盒模型下的查询复杂度仍待改进，尤其在固定尺度约束预解oracle模型中，此前缺乏poly(d, log(1/ε))级别的黑盒保证，作者希望借助几何视角突破这一局限。

Method: 采用几何方法，工作于固定尺度约束预解oracle模型：在锚点a处查询返回预解点x⁺及Yosida向量g_η(a)=(a−x⁺)/η。证明每次oracle响应构成一个尖锐二分——要么返回点给出ε-SVI证书，要么Yosida向量定义Minty集的严格分离法向。将该分离原理与椭球法结合，设计RESOLVENT-ELLIPSOID算法。

Result: 证明了单次黑盒预解查询即可提供认证候选解或有效几何割。结合椭球法后，算法以O(poly(d, log(1/ε)))次黑盒oracle调用计算ε-SVI。对单调包含问题，给出了（据作者所知）固定尺度预解模型下首个poly(d, log(1/ε))黑盒保证。

Conclusion: 通过Yosida向量诱导的分离原理与椭球法结合，本文在固定尺度预解模型下实现了ε-SVI的poly(d, log(1/ε))黑盒复杂度，为单调包含提供了首个此类保证，展示了预解oracle的几何信息足以支撑高效算法。

Abstract: We study Minty set inclusion on a compact convex set $\mathcal{X} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ with a set-valued operator $A : \mathcal{X} \rightrightarrows \mathbb{R}^d$. Under the Minty promise, the goal is to compute $x \in \mathcal{X}$ and $u \in A(x)$ such that $\sup_{y \in \mathcal{X}} \langle u, x - y \rangle \le \varepsilon$. Our approach is geometric and we work in the fixed-scale constrained-resolvent oracle model, where a query at anchor $a$ is assumed to return a resolvent point $x^+$ together with the Yosida vector $g_η(a) = (a - x^+)/η$. We prove that each oracle response yields a sharp dichotomy: either the returned point provides an $\varepsilon$-SVI certificate, or the Yosida vector defines a strict separating normal for the Minty set. Thus, a single black-box resolvent query supplies either a certified candidate solution or a valid geometric cut. Combining this separation principle with the ellipsoid method, we obtain RESOLVENT-ELLIPSOID, an algorithm that computes an $\varepsilon$-SVI in $\mathcal{O}\!\left(\operatorname{poly}(d, \log(1/\varepsilon))\right)$ black-box oracle calls to the fixed-scale constrained resolvent. For monotone inclusions, our algorithm gives, to our knowledge, the first $\mathcal{O}\!\left(\mathrm{poly}(d, \log(1/\varepsilon))\right)$ black-box guarantee in the fixed-scale resolvent model.

</details>


### [361] [Direct GPU Energy Measurements of Batch-Level Sharing in Mixture-of-Experts and Recurrent Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11696)
*Rafael Pina,Varuna De Silva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文不做算子计数的能耗推断，而是在同一GPU上直接测量两类批处理特性迥异的工作负载（GPU向量化多智能体强化学习中的循环策略、MoE语言模型），检验"批次内各行能否共享计算并带来实测节能"。结论：循环策略上不行，MoE上可以，且粒度决定收益大小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高效神经网络的能耗常由FLOPs/操作数推断，但操作数并不能真实反映GPU能耗。作者希望用直接测量回答一个统一问题：批次中的不同样本（跨批次、跨时间步）能否共享计算，并带来可测的能耗节省。

Method: 在单一GPU型号上做直接的GPU能耗测量，对比两类工作负载：1) GPU向量化MARL中的循环策略，尝试共享激活模式、冻结策略掩码、训练得到的掩码，以及测试时引导（test-time steering）；2) MoE语言模型（Qwen3-30B-A3B），提出batch-aware routing按批选择专家，并引入persistence-aware OEA（单参数规则，保持批感知的截断并减少每步新增专家数）。

Result: 循环策略：共享激活模式极少持续一个时间步，冻结策略掩码失效；训练得到的掩码之所以"有效"是因为固定掩码等价于一个窄GRU，其能耗约为小稠密策略的11倍，因此答案是否定的。MoE：答案为肯定；Qwen3-30B-A3B上batch-aware routing在KL≤0.05内读取专家权重减少25–31%，500题基准变化在噪声范围内，融合前向每token能耗降低12–18%。persistence-aware OEA在batch 32–64时每步新增专家约减少40%（能耗尚未测量）。测试时引导在两类负载上均未带来超出重新挑选的收益。

Conclusion: "批内共享计算能否节能"高度依赖工作负载：对循环策略不可行（所谓共享掩码实为退化为窄GRU，代价高昂），对MoE可行且收益随粒度变化。作者同时声明这是单GPU型号的试点测量，并明确其局限。

Abstract: Energy claims for efficient neural networks are often inferred from operation counts. We report direct GPU energy measurements on two workloads that batch very differently, recurrent policies in GPU-vectorised multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models, and ask one question of both: can the rows of a batch be made to share computation, across the batch and over time, at a measured saving? On recurrent policies the answer so far is no. Shared activity patterns exist but rarely last one step, masking a frozen policy fails, and trained-in masks succeed only because a fixed mask is equivalent to a narrow GRU, at 11x the energy of a small dense policy in our implementation. Test-time steering adds nothing beyond re-picking on either workload. On MoE models the answer is yes, and granularity decides how much: on Qwen3-30B-A3B, batch-aware routing reads 25-31% fewer expert weights within KL 0.05, with benchmark changes within noise at 500 items, and uses 12-18% less energy per token on a fused forward. We also introduce persistence-aware OEA, a one-parameter rule that keeps the batch-aware cut with about 40% fewer new experts per step than native routing at batch 32-64, though its energy has not yet been measured. These are pilot measurements on one GPU type, and we state their limits.

</details>


### [362] [Scalable Counterfactual Explanations for Time Series via Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11704)
*Peiyu Li,Pouya Hosseinzadeh,Soukaina Filali Boubrahimi,Shah Muhammad Hamdi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种策略学习框架，将时间序列反事实解释建模为单步上下文赌博机问题，在自编码器潜空间中训练actor-critic智能体，实现一次前向传播即可生成有效的反事实样本，避免逐实例迭代优化，在13个UCR数据集上兼顾有效性与合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列存在复杂的时序依赖，且传统逐实例优化方法计算效率低、需为每个新输入重复迭代优化，难以捕获全局结构规律并扩展到大规规模场景。

Method: 将反事实解释建模为单步上下文赌博机策略学习问题；在预训练自编码器的潜空间中训练actor-critic智能体，学习可迁移的策略以捕获全局结构规律，推理时通过单次前向传播直接生成反事实样本。

Result: 在13个UCR基准数据集上，该方法在多种异常检测指标下取得高有效性（validity）和强合理性（plausibility），且推理阶段无需逐实例优化。

Conclusion: 通过将反事实生成与逐实例优化解耦，所提方法为时间序列反事实解释提供了一种高效且可扩展的替代方案。

Abstract: Generating counterfactual (CF) explanations for time series is challenging due to complex temporal dependencies and the computational inefficiency of traditional instance-specific optimization. We propose a policy learning framework for counterfactual explanation in time series, trained as a one-step contextual-bandit policy-learning problem. By training an actor-critic agent in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder, our method learns a transferable policy that captures global structural regularities. Unlike existing methods that rely on iterative optimization for each new input, the learned policy enables direct generation of valid and plausible counterfactuals through a single forward pass, avoiding per-instance optimization at inference time. Experiments on 13 UCR benchmark datasets show that our framework achieves high validity and strong plausibility across multiple anomaly detection metrics. Overall, by decoupling counterfactual generation from per-instance optimization, the proposed method provides an efficient and scalable alternative to existing approaches for time series counterfactual explanations.

</details>


### [363] [Variational Approach to Optimal IPS Estimator for Multi-logger Off-Policy Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11712)
*Joon Suk Huh,Junghoon Seo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究多日志策略情境老虎机中的离策略评估，提出样本相关权重的最优IPS估计器，并扩展为双重稳健形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多日志策略下的OPE中，平衡IPS与加权IPS孰优并无一致结论（Agarwal等，2017），需要解决这一选择困境并提升估计效率。

Method: 在无偏约束下最小化方差，利用变分法推导样本相关权重的闭式最优解；仅需K×K矩矩阵和K维矩向量，并进一步引入条件奖励估计器构造双重稳健扩展。

Result: 所得估计器无偏，并在广义加权IPS类中达到渐近最优方差；量化了相对半参数oracle的效率损失。实验表明其通常优于现有多日志IPS方法；DR扩展在奖励模型一致时与Kallus等（2021）的DR估计器渐近方差相同，并在某些奖励误设情形下保持半参数效率，实验中常取得更低估计误差。

Conclusion: 该工作为多日志策略OPE提供了可闭式计算、仅依赖低维矩信息的最优IPS及DR方法，在理论与实验上均表现出较好的效率和稳健性。

Abstract: We study off-policy evaluation (OPE) in contextual bandits with data collected from multiple logging policies. Inverse propensity scoring (IPS) is a standard approach to OPE and extends naturally to the multi-logger setting. However, as highlighted by Agarwal et al. [2017], neither balanced nor weighted IPS consistently outperforms the other in this setting. We resolve this dilemma by deriving an optimal IPS estimator with sample-dependent weights that minimize variance subject to unbiasedness. Using a variational calculus approach, we obtain closed-form optimal weights, yielding an estimator that is unbiased and achieves asymptotically optimal variance within a generalized weighted-IPS estimator class. Instead of a reward model, the estimator needs only a $K\times K$ matrix and a $K$-vector of moments, where $K$ is the number of logging policies, and we quantify how much efficiency this costs relative to the semiparametric oracle. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that our estimator generally improves on existing multi-logger IPS methods. We also extend our estimator to a doubly robust form by incorporating a conditional reward estimator. We compare the resulting DR extension with the semiparametrically efficient DR estimator of Kallus et al. [2021], both theoretically and empirically. We show that the two estimators achieve the same asymptotic variance when the conditional reward estimator is consistent, while our estimator can retain semiparametric efficiency under certain forms of reward misspecification. Empirically, the proposed DR estimator often achieves lower estimation error than the existing DR baseline.

</details>


### [364] [Autonomous Continual Learning and Knowledge Transfer via Cortex-Inspired Neural Assemblies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11717)
*Kevin L. McKee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FTN提出一种仿哺乳动物新皮层的持续学习与知识迁移方法，将网络表示为分布式随机专家混合体，推理时用小样本支持集计算稀疏二值路由掩码；训练中逐批次重构路由器并配合掩码重叠过滤回放，形成重叠、部分训练的子网络基底。实验显示其在块序列持续学习与知识迁移任务上接近隔离掩码的保持能力，并取得同类架构中最低的预热损失，掩码重叠几何与已知概念共享结构一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工神经网络存在灾难性遗忘：在概念漂移或域漂移下重训练会覆写已有解，且通常要求每批数据近似代表完整分布，成本高昂且不切实际。作者希望借鉴哺乳动物新皮层特性，实现无需如此严苛数据假设的持续学习与知识迁移。

Method: 提出Functional Task Networks（FTN），建模为分布式、随机化的专家混合体：在推理时利用少量输入-输出对（支撑集）计算稀疏二值路由掩码。训练时逐批次重配置路由器，并采用“掩码重叠过滤”的回放机制，使重叠且部分训练的子网络构成一组基。无关任务路由到基本独立的子装配，相关任务则在共享组件上重叠。

Result: 在块序列持续学习与知识迁移任务上，FTN的解保持能力接近不相交掩码隔离方法，并在匹配架构的对比方法中取得最低的更新前预热（head-start）损失。学到的掩码重叠几何在可获得的条件下与已知的概念共享结构相吻合。实验表明：相关概念漂移下，支撑集掩码重配置对保持是必要的；域漂移下，带回放的分布式库无需配置器即可维持保持；前向迁移（预热）与后向迁移亦由支撑集掩码配置贡献。

Conclusion: FTN通过分布式的重叠子网络与基于支撑集的掩码路由，提供了兼顾保持与迁移的持续学习框架，缓解了对每批数据代表性分布的依赖，并验证了掩码重叠几何作为概念共享结构的可解释反映。

Abstract: Unlike the brain, artificial neural networks (ANNs) suffer from "catastrophic forgetting": complete overwriting of solutions when re-training on new functions ("concept shift") or on a disjoint domain of the current function ("domain shift"). ANNs require each batch of data to be roughly representative of the complete distribution, a typically expensive and impractical requirement. In this paper, we introduce Functional Task Networks (FTNs), a method of continual learning and knowledge transfer modeled after several properties of the mammalian neocortex. FTN is formulated as a distributed, stochastic mixture of experts in which a sparse, binary routing mask is computed at inference time using a small support sample of input-output pairs. Per-batch reconfiguration of the router during training, together with mask-overlap-filtered replay, shapes a basis of overlapping, partially trained subnetworks. Unrelated tasks route through mostly separate assemblies, related tasks overlap on shared components. On block-sequentially trained continual learning and knowledge transfer tasks FTN retains solutions nearly as well as disjoint-mask isolation and attains the lowest pre-update head-start loss among matched-architecture comparators. The learned mask-overlap geometry tracks the known concept-sharing structure where available. We show experimentally that under correlated concept shift, support-set mask reconfiguration is necessary even for retention. Under domain shift, the distributed bank with replay is sufficient to handle retention without the configurer. Forward transfer, or head-start, and backward transfer, are also contributed by support-set mask configuration.

</details>


### [365] [The Dark Matter of Clinical Data: An Identification Limit on Disentangling Physiology from Care Process in electronic health records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11726)
*Mohammad Shahin,Krittaphas Chaisutyakorn,Dimitrios Proios,David Restrepo,Vishala Mishra,Boya Zhang,Aadarsh Sivaraman,Sparsh Roy,Benet Fité Abril,Tina Yen-Ting Chen,Hyunjung Gloria Kwak,Andre Kurepa Waschka,Vinayak Mathur,Leo Anthony Celi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文形式化EHR数据生成过程，论证"检验值"与"开单"通道的信息划分在单数据集中不可识别，且跨站点不变性只是可证伪的联合假设推论而非识别策略，并给出恢复识别的条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EHR表示同时编码患者生理与决定"测什么、何时测、给谁测"的临床流程，二者纠缠使得基于表示的下游分析难以区分生物学信号与测量机制，需要厘清哪些"去纠缠"策略真正具备可识别性。

Method: 构建含潜在生理、开单意图、仅在被测量时存在的实验室值、学习表示与临床环境的生成模型；用部分信息分解（PID）及Williams-Beer公理分析"值"与"开单"通道；构造观测等价模型检验跨站点不变性的可识别性；并推导恢复识别的检验设计条件。

Result: 单一数据集无法识别值/开单的信息划分：当开单依赖分析物时，未检测者的分布不可恢复，未定义记录值用哨兵编码会承载开单指示符的全部熵，从而对所有满足公理且对单射重编码不变的冗余度量固定PID。跨站点不变性是生物不变性联合排除性与表示充分性条件的可证伪推论，而非识别策略：可构造观测等价模型在检验失败或通过时对生物不变性给出相反结论；二值生理下，当病例组合不同、表示有损且生理影响结局时恰好发生，示例在机制不变下仍出现9.6个百分点站点差距。全覆盖检测可移除开单门控；当某检验精确汇总结局相关生理，或在病例组合不同的站点具备两个独立误差检验时，生物不变性可被识别。

Conclusion: 跨站点分析应作为对明确陈述的联合假设的检验来报告，而不能当作识别策略；真正的识别依赖全覆盖测量或特定检验结构（精确汇总、独立误差检验等）。

Abstract: Representations learned from electronic health record (EHR) data encode patient physiology together with the clinical process that decides what is measured, when, and for whom. We formalize the data-generating process with latent physiology, ordering intent, laboratory values that exist only when measured, a learned representation, and clinical environments, and analyze two strategies for undoing this entanglement. First, no division of the information carried by laboratory "value" and "ordering" channels is identified from a single dataset: when ordering depends on the analyte, its distribution among untested patients is not recoverable, and a sentinel code for the undefined recorded value makes it carry all the entropy of the ordering indicator, fixing partial information decomposition (PID) for every redundancy measure satisfying the Williams-Beer axioms and invariant under injective re-encoding. Second, cross-site invariance of representation-conditional outcomes is a falsifiable implication of biological invariance taken jointly with exclusion and representation-sufficiency conditions, but not an identification strategy: we construct observationally equivalent models that disagree about biological invariance, whether the invariance test fails or passes. For binary physiology this happens exactly when case mix differs, the representation is lossy, and physiology affects the outcome. A worked example yields a 9.6-percentage-point cross-site gap under an unchanged biological mechanism. Tests performed for every patient remove the ordering gate, and measured tests can restore identification: biological invariance is identified when a test exactly summarizes outcome-relevant physiology, or, for binary physiology, when two tests with independent errors are available at sites with different case mix. Cross-site analyses should be reported as tests of a stated joint hypothesis.

</details>


### [366] [Spectral Rank and Step-Direction Dynamics in Language-Model Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11752)
*Khurram Khalil,Khaza Anuarul Hoque*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出"更新近似满秩"与"稳定秩变化很小"两种看似矛盾的谱性质其实相容：当奇异值服从 σ_i ∝ i^{-α}（0<α≤1/2）时，稳定秩相对固定能量秩随维度增长可忽略。作者通过OLMo-2-7B的全SVD、9个公开RLVR阶段131对相邻checkpoint的余弦分析及OLMo-2-1B配对种子对照实验，区分了谱集中、能量覆盖与轨迹方向，并证明优势函数体系会影响方向对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型后训练通过累积更新与连续位移修改权重，但既有研究报告了两类显得互相冲突的谱特性——更新近似满秩、而稳定秩变化极小。论文意在说明二者并不矛盾，并进一步刻画训练过程中更新方向（连续checkpoint位移之间）的几何关系，弄清不同后训练配置与算法（PPO/GRPO/SFT）在方向对齐上的差异来源。

Method: （1）理论分析：对奇异值按 σ_i ∝ i^{-α}（0<α≤1/2）衰减的情形证明，随维度增大稳定秩相对固定能量秩变得可忽略；（2）对OLMo-2-7B选取的部分PPO注意力更新做完整SVD，比较稳定秩与捕获80%能量所需奇异分量数；（3）利用全模型内积计算连续checkpoint位移的余弦，覆盖9个公开RLVR阶段的全部131对相邻checkpoint（含PPO与GRPO轨迹）；（4）在四个模型族上比较SFT配置；（5）受控OLMo-2-1B实验：3组配对种子、2048 token响应上限，在匹配的60-rollout窗口下对比group-relative优势与带GAE的学得critic。

Result: 理论上证明了低稳定秩与高能量覆盖秩可以共存。OLMo-2-7B的三个PPO注意力更新稳定秩仅9.6–18.3，但需532–1,222个奇异分量才能覆盖80%能量，验证了二者的分离；131对相邻checkpoint位移在原生网格上余弦全部为负（含PPO与GRPO）；四模型族的SFT比较显示对齐性依赖配置，Mistral与FP32 Llama在训练后期出现负余弦；OLMo-2-1B受控实验中，匹配60-rollout窗口下训练后期平均余弦分别为+0.259（group-relative）与+0.012（学得critic+GAE），配对差critic-minus-group为-0.247（种子级95%区间[-0.358,-0.137]）。

Conclusion: 论文澄清了"稳定秩低"与"更新近似满秩"的表面矛盾，提出应把谱集中度、能量覆盖与轨迹方向作为三个独立概念分别度量；并表明在匹配训练条件下，优势函数体系（group-relative vs 学得critic）会显著影响连续更新的方向对齐，为理解后训练动态提供了理论与实证依据。

Abstract: Language-model post-training modifies weights through cumulative updates and successive displacements, yet existing studies report seemingly conflicting spectral properties: nearly full-rank updates and low stable-rank changes. We show these observations are compatible and characterize update directions during training. For singular values following $σ_i \propto i^{-α}$ with $0 < α\leq 1/2$, we prove that stable rank becomes negligible relative to fixed-energy rank as dimension increases. Full singular value decompositions of selected OLMo-2-7B updates confirm this separation: three proximal policy optimization (PPO) attention updates have stable ranks of 9.6-18.3 but require 532-1,222 singular components to capture 80% of their energy. We next compute consecutive checkpoint-displacement cosines from full-model inner products. Across nine publicly released reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) stages, all 131 adjacent pairs have negative cosines on their native checkpoint grids, including PPO and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trajectories. Supervised fine-tuning comparisons across four model families show configuration-dependent alignment, including negative late-training cosines for Mistral and FP32 Llama. Finally, a controlled OLMo-2-1B study with three paired seeds and a 2,048-token response cap compares group-relative advantages against a learned critic with generalized advantage estimation (GAE). At matched 60-rollout windows, late-training mean cosines are +0.259 and +0.012, respectively; the paired critic-minus-group difference is -0.247 (seed-level 95% interval [-0.358, -0.137]). These findings distinguish spectral concentration, energy coverage, and trajectory direction, and demonstrate that the advantage system influences directional alignment under matched training conditions.

</details>


### [367] [Payoff-Aware Prediction of Population Game Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11786)
*Kang Wang,Xiao Wang,Bo Li,Renzhe Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究"payoff-aware population game dynamics prediction"问题：在payoff设计改变、新payoff下轨迹数据缺失时，预测种群动态轨迹。提出PA-RmD方法，将payoff相关的激励与payoff无关的响应结构解耦，基于Riemannian game dynamics显式保留payoff信息并学习响应结构。理论上证明模型保持固定payoff下的Nash均衡，并在共享响应与payoff覆盖条件下给出有限时间单步预测界；实证在合成零和/势博弈与YouTube Trending多国数据集上验证其在payoff变化下表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多应用中payoff函数会发生变化，目标是在新payoff设计下的轨迹数据尚不可得时，提前预测由此诱导的种群轨迹。现有动态学习方法只拟合训练payoff下观测到的运动，未将payoff相关的激励与payoff无关的响应结构分离，因而难以泛化到新payoff。

Method: 基于Riemannian game dynamics框架提出PA-RmD：一种payoff-aware学习方法，显式保留payoff信息，并从数据中学习payoff无关的响应结构，从而在新payoff下进行预测。

Result: 理论：学习模型保持固定payoff下的Nash均衡，并在共享响应（shared-response）与payoff覆盖（payoff-coverage）条件下给出有限时间单步预测界。实证：在合成零和博弈、势博弈及YouTube Trending多国数据集上，方法在payoff设计变化时表现良好。

Conclusion: 将payoff信息与响应结构显式解耦的PA-RmD能有效预测新payoff设计下的种群博弈动态，兼具保持Nash均衡的理论保证与跨payoff设计的实证泛化能力。

Abstract: Population game dynamics describe how aggregate behavior evolves in response to payoff signals. In many applications, the payoff function may change, and the goal is to predict the population trajectory induced by a new payoff design before trajectory data under that design are available. We study this problem as $\textbf{payoff-aware prediction of population game dynamics}$. Standard dynamics learning methods fit the motion observed under training payoffs, but do not separate the payoff-dependent incentive from the payoff-independent response structure needed for prediction under new payoffs. Building on the existing framework of Riemannian game dynamics, we propose PA-RmD, a payoff-aware learning method that keeps payoff information explicit and learns the payoff-independent response structure from data. Theoretically, we show that the learned model preserves fixed-payoff Nash equilibria and derive finite-time one-step prediction bounds under shared-response and payoff-coverage conditions. Empirically, we evaluate PA-RmD on synthetic zero-sum and potential games, as well as a YouTube Trending multi-country dataset, showing that our method performs well under changing payoff designs.

</details>


### [368] [HexIt: Learning Hexahedral Block Decomposition with Expert Iteration on Combinatorial Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10433)
*Arjun Narayanan,Per-Olof Persson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将多面体分解为少量优质六面体块是一个长期开放问题；作者把它建模为三维广义映射上的序贯决策，智能体通过三类插入操作分裂边、面和体，直到所有单元均为六面体且满足质量阈值，并用卷积于映射对合结构的策略选择插入。策略先从构造分解中克隆，再经专家迭代提升；在边界拓扑未见的倒角实体上，最终策略20次采样期望解出率94.4%，专家迭代把大型倒角实体的best-of-20从0.203提升到0.355；同算力下PPO、GRPO、VinePPO反而使克隆策略变差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 六面体网格生成中，把多面体实体分解为少量形状良好的六面体块长期缺乏可靠方法；该文希望用学习型序贯决策自动完成这一组合搜索。

Method: 将分解问题表述为三维广义映射上的序贯决策：智能体执行边、面、体三类插入操作，逐步分裂结构，直到每个单元都是六面体并满足质量阈值；策略在广义映射的对合关系上做卷积，以选择插入操作。训练上先从构造出的分解轨迹克隆策略，再用专家迭代改进。

Result: 成功分解通常需要百余次决策，均匀随机策略几乎找不到解。在与克隆数据不共享边界拓扑的留出倒角实体上，最终策略20次采样期望解出率为94.4%；专家迭代将大型倒角实体的best-of-20解出率从0.203提升至0.355。相同计算量下，PPO、GRPO和VinePPO更新均使克隆策略性能下降。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，将六面体块分解建模为三维广义映射上的学习型序贯决策，并通过构造分解克隆与专家迭代训练，能够有效求解具有未见边界拓扑的困难实例；相较之下，常规强化学习更新在同算力下并不奏效。

Abstract: Decomposing a polyhedral solid into a few well-shaped hexahedral blocks is a long-standing open problem in mesh generation. We cast it as a sequential decision problem on a 3-dimensional generalised map: an agent splits edges, faces and volumes with three insert operations until every cell is a hexahedron and the mesh passes a quality threshold, and a policy that convolves over the map's involutions chooses each insert. A successful decomposition takes over a hundred decisions, and a uniformly random policy never finds one. We clone a policy from constructed decompositions and improve it by expert iteration. On held-out chamfered solids that share no boundary topology with the cloning data, the final policy solves an expected $94.4\%$ in $20$ samples, and expert iteration raises the best-of-20 solve rate on large chamfered solids from $0.203$ to $0.355$. At matched compute, PPO, GRPO and VinePPO updates all make the cloned policy worse.

</details>


### [369] [APO2CS: Advantage-Aware Preference Optimization for Two-Level Constructive Search in Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11792)
*Kaixi Yang,Linbo Qiao,Wei Shang,Yanqi Shi,Dongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出两层级优势感知偏好优化方法 APO2CS，用目标值差构造优势项做宏观偏好监督，并在微观层比较部分轨迹以提供更密集的监督，可从头训练或微调预训练策略，在多个组合优化任务上提升偏好学习的表达力与搜索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面向神经组合优化的偏好优化方法只用二元成对标签，一方面丢弃了解质量差异的大小（幅度信息），另一方面仅在完整解层面提供监督信号，监督稀疏、信息利用率低。

Method: 提出 APO2CS（Advantage-aware Preference Optimization for Two-level Constructive Search）：宏观层面在成对偏好中引入由目标值差导出的优势项，使偏好带有质量差异幅度信息；微观层面比较部分轨迹（中间构造状态），在序列构造过程中提供更密集的监督。该目标既可用于从零训练策略，也可用于微调预训练策略。

Result: 实验显示 APO2CS 提升了偏好学习在组合优化中的表达能力和搜索能力，并在多个组合优化任务上表现出较强的有效性与适应性，且支持从头训练与微调两种使用方式。

Conclusion: 将优势加权与多层级的轨迹级偏好监督结合，可弥补二元成对标签信息损失和整解级监督稀疏的问题，是一种可即插即用、任务可迁移的构造式神经求解器训练目标。

Abstract: Preference optimization has emerged as a promising alternative to reward-based training for neural combinatorial optimization. However, existing methods typically rely on binary pairwise labels, which discard the magnitude of solution-quality differences and provide supervision only at the complete-solution level. We propose Advantage-aware Preference Optimization for Two-level Constructive Search (APO2CS), a preference-based training objective for constructive neural solvers that integrates both macro-level and micro-level supervision. At the macro level, APO2CS enriches pairwise preferences with an advantage term derived from objective-value differences. At the micro level, it compares partial trajectories, thereby providing denser supervision throughout the sequential construction process. The resulting objective can be used either to train a policy from scratch or to fine-tune a pretrained one. Experimental results show that APO2CS improves the expressiveness and search capability of preference learning for combinatorial optimization, while demonstrating strong effectiveness and adaptability across multiple combinatorial optimization tasks.

</details>


### [370] [Efficient Online Submodular Maximization with Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11808)
*Iasonas Nikolaou,Evimaria Terzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究带基数约束与 bandit 反馈的在线单调子模最大化：每轮至多选 k 个元素且仅观测所选集合的值；提出多项式时间算法，达到 O(k√(nT log(n/k))) 的期望 (1-1/e)-regret，并首次在任意单调子模函数的 bandit 设定下实现 √T 依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线子模最大化在 bandit 反馈下信息极其有限（只能看到所选集合的总价值），而现有方法难以同时保证多项式时间、任意单调子模函数适用性以及对时间跨度 T 的 √T 级 regret；本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 采用随机化采样，并构造合适的 potential，将带基数约束的在线子模最大化归约为概率单纯形上的在线线性优化问题，从而设计高效算法。

Result: 算法在 T 轮内取得 O(k√(nT log(n/k))) 的期望 (1-1/e)-regret；据作者所知，这是 bandit 设定下针对任意单调子模函数、具有 √T 时间依赖的首个多项式时间算法。

Conclusion: 该工作通过随机采样与 potential 归约，为 bandit 反馈下的在线单调子模最大化提供了高效且具有理论 regret 保证的解决方案，并首次实现任意单调子模函数下的 √T 级依赖。

Abstract: We study online monotone submodular maximization under a cardinality constraint with bandit feedback. On each round, the learner selects at most $k$ elements from a ground set of size $n$ and observes only the value of the selected set. We develop an efficient algorithm achieving $O\!\left(k\sqrt{nT\log(n/k)}\right)$ expected $(1-1/e)$-regret over $T$ rounds. To our knowledge, this is the first polynomial-time algorithm with $\sqrt{T}$ dependence on the horizon for arbitrary monotone submodular functions in the bandit setting. Our approach uses randomized sampling and a carefully constructed potential to reduce online submodular maximization to online linear optimization over the probability simplex.

</details>


### [371] [KKT-Perturbation-Aware Communication for Fully Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Nonseparable Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11827)
*Zhaoye Pan,Tao Li,Yunjie Guo,Guanpu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出随机化KKT扰动感知通信机制，将坐标下降的自适应采样思想从计算分配迁移到通信分配，在非可分代价与耦合约束的分布式在线凸优化中按KKT算子扰动优先刷新通道，达到O(T^{2/3})期望静态遗憾与约束违反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非可分代价与耦合约束使分布式在线凸优化中每个智能体的原始-对偶更新需依赖对联合动作的局部信念及共享拉格朗日乘子，通信开销随联合决策维度与网络规模同时增长。已有事件触发方案多依据状态变化或共识误差触发通信，但在非可分耦合下，等幅误差经KKT算子作用后产生的扰动差异显著，因而这类触发准则无法准确反映信息通道的真实重要性。

Method: 提出随机化KKT扰动感知通信机制：各智能体的原始与对偶通信通道是否触发取决于其对KKT算子的影响；将坐标下降的自适应采样原理从"在决策块间分配计算"迁移为"在信息通道间分配通信"，估计扰动更大的通道获得更高的刷新优先级；基于局部信念与邻居交换的共享乘子完成原始-对偶更新。

Result: 在标准正则性假设下，算法取得O(T^{2/3})的期望静态遗憾与O(T^{2/3})的期望累积约束违反；数值实验表明，相比信念共识基线，在每传输比特下的学习性能与约束满足性能均有提升。

Conclusion: 以KKT算子扰动为触发度量可更精准地分配通信资源，在保证无遗憾学习与约束收敛的同时显著降低通信开销，优于基于状态变化或共识误差的传统事件触发方案。

Abstract: Nonseparable costs and coupled constraints in distributed online convex optimization often arise when system performance and operational constraints depend on the joint configuration of all agents and cannot be decomposed into individual contributions. Such nonseparability leads to fully distributed decision-making with challenging partial local information, where each agent evaluates its local primal-dual update using estimated global information via a local belief of the joint action and the shared Lagrange multiplier to be exchanged with neighbors. While the belief consensus established by prior works ensures no-regret learning, exchanging beliefs comprising full-dimensional primal and dual states at every round imposes a communication overhead that scales with both the joint decision dimension and the network size. Existing event-triggered schemes typically activate communication according to state variation or consensus error. Under nonseparable coupling, however, errors of equal magnitude can produce markedly different perturbations after passing through the KKT operator. We therefore propose a randomized KKT-perturbation-aware communication mechanism, where the triggering of each agent's primal and dual communication channels depends on their impact on the KKT operator. The proposed mechanism transfers the adaptive-sampling principle of coordinate descent from allocating computation across decision blocks to allocating communication across information channels: channels with larger estimated perturbations receive greater priority for refresh. Under standard regularity assumptions, the resulting algorithm achieves $O({T}^{2/3})$ expected static regret and $O({T}^{2/3})$ expected cumulative constraint violation. Numerical experiments demonstrate improved learning and constraint-enforcement performance per transmitted bit over belief consensus baselines.

</details>


### [372] [MOOD: Benchmarking Post-Hoc OOD Detection for Materials Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11839)
*Shirley X. Yu,Amey P. Pasarkar,Adji Bousso Dieng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出MOOD基准，系统评估15种事后OOD检测器在GNN材料性质预测上的迁移能力，发现现有检测器几乎等同随机猜测，并将失败原因分解为方法瓶颈与编码器瓶颈两类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事后OOD检测方法（无需重训练模型）几乎只在图像分类任务上被验证过，其在科学应用（如材料性质预测）中的GNN模型上能否迁移尚不清楚，而高风险科学部署恰恰最需要可靠的OOD检测。

Method: 构建MOOD基准：覆盖15种事后OOD检测器与2种监督诊断探针，在4种GNN架构、5个MatBench任务、15种具有物理动机的成分与结构偏移上进行评估，共264个评估设定、3个编码器训练种子下超过13,000次AUROC测量。

Result: （1）15种事后检测器AUROC均在0.5左右，接近随机；（2）失败可分解为两类瓶颈：方法瓶颈（监督探针可分但无监督检测器失败，说明嵌入中含OOD信号但未被提取）与编码器瓶颈（连监督探针也无法区分，说明冻结GNN表示中不含相关偏移信号）；（3）当OOD预测误差超过ID误差时，距离类与密度类检测器的AUROC与该误差差距大小相关。

Conclusion: 科学领域的可靠OOD检测需要能显式保留OOD相关信号的表示学习策略，尤其对于当前GNN架构完全无法编码可提取信号的任务。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for deploying machine learning models in high stakes scientific applications, yet methods that flag OOD inputs without retraining the model have been validated almost exclusively on image classification. We introduce MOOD (Materials Out-of-Distribution Detection), a benchmark for evaluating whether these post-hoc OOD detectors transfer to graph neural networks (GNNs) on materials property prediction. MOOD evaluates 15 post-hoc detectors and 2 supervised diagnostic probes across 4 GNN architectures, 5 MatBench tasks, and 15 physically motivated compositional and structural shifts, yielding 264 evaluation settings and over 13,000 AUROC measurements across three encoder training seeds. Our evaluation reveals three key findings. First, current post-hoc detectors perform near chance; all 15 detectors achieve an AUROC around 0.5. Second, detector failures decompose into two regimes: method bottlenecks and encoder bottlenecks. Method bottlenecks arise when supervised probes can separate in-distribution (ID) from OOD samples but unsupervised detectors fail, meaning that the embeddings contain OOD signal that current detectors do not extract. Encoder bottlenecks arise when even supervised probes fail to separate ID from OOD samples, indicating that the relevant shift is not accessible in the frozen GNN representation. Third, when OOD prediction error exceeds ID error, the AUROC of distance-based and density-based detectors correlates with the size of that gap. Collectively, these findings indicate that reliable OOD detection in scientific domains requires representation learning strategies that explicitly preserve OOD relevant signal, particularly for tasks where current GNN architectures encode no extractable signal at all.

</details>


### [373] [Severity-Controlled Prediction Sets for Medication Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11847)
*Yu Gu,Zijun Yu,Chi-Kuang Yeh,Xinyu Wang,Ziyang Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Conformal Severity Control（CSC），一种基于ATC药物层级量化错配严重度的后处理框架，可在不重训练预测器的情况下，按患者层面控制平均或上分位数严重度，使药物推荐预测集更倾向于精确或near-match。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物推荐属于多标签预测任务，但现有预测集评估与校准方法主要依赖精确重叠（exact-overlap）指标，把所有漏预测的药物视为同等严重，忽略了预测集与真实药物在药物层级结构中距离远近的差异。

Method: 提出Conformal Severity Control（CSC）：利用解剖治疗化学（ATC）层级来量化错配严重度，并以此进行预测集校准；作为后处理框架，无需重训练预测器，支持对平均严重度以及最高严重度错配的上分位数严重度进行患者层面控制。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV上的实验表明，CSC能够跟踪用户指定的严重度容忍度，并使预测集从远距离错配转向精确匹配或接近匹配。

Conclusion: 引入层级感知的错配严重度视角，将保守预测（conformal）思想推广到带有严重度度量的多标签场景，为药物推荐预测集提供了更细粒度、可按临床容忍度调节的校准手段。

Abstract: Medication recommendation is a multi-label prediction task. However, existing prediction-set evaluation and calibration methods rely mainly on exact-overlap metrics and therefore treat all missed medications as equally severe, overlooking how closely the prediction set matches them within the medication hierarchy. To address this, we introduce Conformal Severity Control (CSC), a post-hoc framework for calibrating medication prediction sets under hierarchy-aware mismatch severity. CSC uses the Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) hierarchy to quantify mismatch severity and controls patient-level severity without retraining the predictor, supporting both average severity and upper-quantile severity for the highest-severity mismatches. Experiments on MIMIC-IV show that CSC tracks user-specified severity tolerances and shifts prediction sets away from distant mismatches toward exact or close matches.

</details>


### [374] [Identifiable but Hard to Estimate: Rotation in Equally Spaced Overcomplete ICA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11852)
*Wenjun Xiao,Yinghao Fang,Hanxin Chen,Sihan Jia,Vince D Calhoun,Yuda BI*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究二维过完备ICA中估计公共旋转所需样本量，证明其随源数目指数增长，并用半列间距两旋转间Hellinger距离的平方倒数刻画，给出达到该尺度的一致相位估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在二维过完备独立成分分析中，给定等间距混合列、已知源数目、公共源分布与列范数，探究估计公共旋转（模列间距可识别）所需的样本量，并厘清其随源数增长的速度。

Method: 针对固定的非高斯四阶Gram-Charlier源分布，研究相隔半个列间距的两个旋转之间的Hellinger距离，并构造显式径向加权相位估计器，利用观测半径避免角谐波均值中的相消；同时计算单次观测总变差的精确指数衰减率。

Result: 固定相对角度精度所需样本量随源数目指数增长，并可由半列间距两旋转间Hellinger距离平方的倒数（至绝对常数）刻画；所提估计器在该旋转族上一致地达到该尺度；得到样本量指数上下界，精确值仍开放；含噪二元源例中，观测特征函数的精确零线可有指数小的法向导数。

Conclusion: 该文刻画了二维过完备ICA公共旋转估计样本量的指数增长律，给出可达最优尺度的估计器与指数率界，但样本量指数的精确值及一般精确率仍为开放问题。

Abstract: How many observations are needed to estimate a common rotation in two-dimensional overcomplete independent component analysis? We study equally spaced mixing columns with known source count, common source law, and column norm. For a fixed non-Gaussian fourth-order Gram-Charlier source law, the rotation is identifiable modulo the column spacing. Yet the sample size for fixed relative angular accuracy grows exponentially with the source count. We characterize this sample size, up to absolute constants, by the reciprocal of the squared Hellinger distance between two rotations separated by half the column spacing. An explicit radially weighted phase estimator attains this scale uniformly over the rotation family, using the observation radius to prevent cancellation in the mean of an angular harmonic. We also determine the exact exponential decay rate of single-observation total variation for the same pair. This gives bounds on the sample size exponent; its exact value remains open. Finally, a noisy binary-source example shows how an exact zero line of the observed characteristic function can have an exponentially small normal derivative.

</details>


### [375] [Are UFOs Real? Introducing Unified Factored Organizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11862)
*Thomas X. Sheppard,Alon Albalak,Joel Lehman,Kenneth O. Stanley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"统一因子组织器"（UFOs），通过学习其他网络表征中的规律来正则化训练，使网络获得更优的表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习普遍假设"低损失即意味着学到了好的表征"，但Kumar等（2025）质疑此假设，指出常规梯度下降训练的网络虽达低损失，却学到"破碎纠缠表征（FER）"，相关概念被割裂、无关概念被不当纠缠。而通过开放式、人类参与的进化过程可获得"统一因子表征（UFR）"。本文受UFR启发，希望找到一种可行方法让常规训练的网络也学到优质表征。

Method: 提出统一因子组织器（UFOs）：训练网络去建模其他网络表征中的规律，形成表征模型。随后训练目标网络时，既优化其任务损失，又使自身表征与UFO学到的模型对齐（UFO正则化）。

Result: 在表征易解释的图像回归任务中，经UFO训练的网络学到质量上更优的表征；在模块算术的grokking任务中，结合权重衰减可将达到grokking所需训练步数减少10倍以上，无权重衰减时可相比无正则基线减少100倍以上。

Conclusion: UFOs为表征学习提供了有效的正则化手段；若其成立，将指向一个新范式：损失函数本身也可被训练，以学习"何为好表征"的有效模型。

Abstract: Implicit in much research in deep learning is the assumption that if a network achieves low loss, then it must have learned a good representation of its training data. Recent work by Kumar et al. (2025, arXiv:2505.11581) questions this assumption, arguing that networks trained with conventional gradient descent achieve low loss despite learning fractured entangled representations (FER), leaving related concepts disconnected and unrelated concepts entangled inappropriately. Kumar et al. further show that dramatically better representations are possible: a network evolved through an open-ended, human-in-the-loop process learned unified factored representations (UFR) that capture the regularities of the domain far better than a counterpart with nearly identical outputs trained with conventional gradient descent. Inspired by UFR, this paper introduces unified factored organizers (UFOs), networks trained to model regularities in the representations of other networks. A network can then be trained both to achieve low loss on its task objective and to align its representations with the model learned by the UFO. Networks trained with UFOs are shown to learn qualitatively superior representations in an image-regression domain where representations are easily interpretable. To provide quantitative evidence for the impact of UFOs on representation learning, a transformer is trained with and without UFO regularization to grok a modular arithmetic problem set. When combined with weight decay, UFOs can reduce the number of transformer training steps needed to grok by more than 10x relative to weight decay alone. Without weight decay, UFOs can reduce the number of transformer training steps needed to grok by more than 100x relative to an unregularized baseline. If UFOs are real, they suggest a new paradigm where loss functions themselves are trained to learn an effective model of good representation.

</details>


### [376] [Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11863)
*Francisco M. López,Francisco Cruz*

Main category: cs.LG
