On the sparse-attention target, predicted indexer keys recall the needle as well as the target's own keys (one seed). We state as a hypothesis how the recipes transfer to 300B+ hybrid flagships.

</details>


### [410] [XposedMIA: Exploiting Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for One-Shot Membership Inference Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12067)
*Omar Hamdache,Serdar Kara,Kıvanç Kuzey Dikici,Abdullah Çağlar Öksüz,Anisa Halimi,Erman Ayday,Sinem Sav*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: XposedMIA 是一种一次性、基于解释的黑盒成员推断攻击，利用 LIME 局部代理几何及表格/视觉反事实解释作为样本到决策边界距离的代理，仅需单次查询即可高精度判断样本是否属于训练集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习服务日益同时输出预测与可解释性结果，解释本意是提升透明度，但可能泄露训练数据信息。现有标签-only成员推断攻击多需迭代查询或影子训练，成本高；作者希望探究解释输出是否构成新的成员泄漏通道，并在单次查询条件下实现高效攻击。

Method: 提出 XposedMIA：将 LIME 的局部代理几何重新解释为样本到模型决策边界的距离代理，并把这一"边界距离视角"扩展到表格反事实解释和图像分类器的视觉反事实解释。攻击框架为一次性黑盒成员推断：先用小规模带标签校准集（少至30个样本）做一次性校准，之后每个目标样本仅需一次查询，仅依赖预测标签及其附带解释，无需迭代查询或影子模型训练。

Result: 实验表明 XposedMIA 效果显著，在每目标仅单次查询的条件下成功率最高达0.95，说明公开解释会引入额外的成员泄漏通道。

Conclusion: 解释输出（LIME 与反事实解释）不仅是透明度工具，也是可利用的隐私攻击面；单次查询即可高精度推断成员身份，提示模型服务方在发布解释时需评估并缓解成员泄漏风险。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) services increasingly expose explainability outputs alongside model predictions. While such explanations are intended to improve transparency, they may also reveal information about the underlying training data. In this work, we show that the local surrogate geometry employed by Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) can be repurposed as a proxy for a sample's distance to the model's decision boundary. We extend this boundary-distance view to tabular counterfactual explanations and, for the first time, to visual counterfactual explanations for image classifiers. We present XposedMIA, a one-shot, explanation-based black-box membership inference attack (MIA) framework that converts the returned explanation into a proxy for the queried sample's distance to the model decision boundary. After a one-time calibration step on a small labeled calibration set of as few as 30 samples, our attack requires only a single query for each target sample. Unlike prior label-only attacks requiring iterative queries or shadow training, our method relies solely on the predicted label and its accompanying explanation. Our evaluation indicates that XposedMIA achieves high effectiveness, with success rates of up to 0.95 using only a single query per target, revealing that releasing explanations introduces an additional channel for membership leakage.

</details>


### [411] [Correct First, Fast Second: What a Local 7B Code Model Can and Cannot Do for GPU Kernel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12079)
*Jui-Chien Tsou,Po-Yi Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究同一个本地 7B 代码模型在 30 个 KernelBench 任务上，用四种交互策略替代 PyTorch 算子写 CUDA kernel 的效果；核心结论是正确性而非速度是瓶颈，策略需匹配难度，朴素多智能体框架可能有害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在固定、本地部署的 7B 代码模型条件下，交互/提示与多智能体编排策略能在多大程度上提升其将 PyTorch 算子替换为自定义 CUDA kernel 的能力，并厘清何种策略真正有效。

Method: 在 KernelBench 的 30 个任务（level 1–3，各取前 10）上，于 V100 上比较四种结构化程度递增的范式：零样本提示、性能分析引导提示、基于执行反馈的迭代精炼，以及由同一模型扮演分析、检索、生成、评估、反馈分诊四个角色并围绕非 LLM 评估器运行的多智能体循环。

Result: （1）正确性而非速度是主要约束：即使正确生成的 kernel 平均也只有 eager PyTorch 的 0.97–0.99 倍速度，7B 模型难以在稠密 GEMM 和卷积上超越 cuBLAS/cuDNN，真正收益主要来自融合的内存受限 epilogue。（2）最佳策略依难度而变：性能分析引导提示总体最强（43% 正确、27% 快于基线），但只有智能体循环解决了部分 level-2 融合问题（3/10，其余均为 0/10）。（3）朴素智能体脚手架反而有害：首个智能体仅 3% 正确，低于零样本的 30%；关键修复是让智能体目标匹配模型能力，并把算力用于真实执行 oracle 下的 best-of-n 采样（n=1 到 n=8 时正确率由 3% 升至 33%），而非增加推理步数。

Conclusion: 对小型本地代码模型而言，提升 CUDA kernel 生成应优先保证正确性与任务匹配的交互策略；盲目堆叠智能体结构或推理步数收益有限甚至有害，按能力匹配目标并在真实执行反馈下做 best-of-n 采样更有效。

Abstract: We study how much the interaction strategy around a fixed, locally hosted 7B-parameter code model (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct) affects its ability to replace PyTorch operators with custom CUDA kernels. On 30 KernelBench tasks (levels 1-3, first 10 each, evaluated on a V100), we compare four regimes of increasing structure: zero-shot prompting, profiling-guided prompting, iterative refinement on execution feedback, and a multi-agent loop (analysis, retrieval, generation, evaluation, feedback triage) in which the same model fills four roles around a non-LLM evaluator. Three findings stand out. (1) Correctness, not speed, is the binding constraint: even correct generated kernels average 0.97-0.99x the speed of eager PyTorch, because a 7B model cannot out-write cuBLAS/cuDNN on dense GEMM and convolution; the only real wins are fused memory-bound epilogues. (2) The best strategy depends on difficulty: profiling-guided prompting is strongest overall (43% correct, 27% faster than baseline), but the agent loop is the only method that solves any level-2 fusion problem (3/10 vs. 0/10 for all others). (3) Naive agentic scaffolding is actively harmful: our first agent scored 3% correct, below zero-shot's 30%, and the decisive repairs were matching the agent's ambition to the model's competence and spending compute on best-of-n sampling under a real execution oracle (3% to 33% correct from n=1 to n=8), not on more reasoning steps.

</details>


### [412] [Zero-Search Reinforcement Learning for Slay the Spire 2 with Failure-Driven Restarts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12088)
*Xiangqin Chen,Zhengxuan Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 训练一个6.6M参数的实体Transformer，每步仅一次前向、无前瞻，在《Slay the Spire 2》最高难度A10的12,800局留出测试中五角色平均胜率8.05%，A0达80.2%，接近树搜索智能体；失败驱动课程优于均匀重启分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该游戏一局需数百次决策，失败多发生在后期Boss，学习器很少到达这些状态，导致长时程、稀疏成功信号和评估困难。作者希望训练无需搜索、每步单次前向即可决策的强策略，并检验失败驱动课程能否缓解后期状态稀缺。

Method: 使用游戏自身编译程序（v0.107.1）的无头.NET宿主，按种子与动作精确回放；策略为6.6M参数实体Transformer，每步一次前向、无lookahead。训练采用失败驱动课程，按完整运行失败位置比例分配重启。评估覆盖12,800局A10留出游戏，并与AlphaSpire、Spire Mentor及GPT-6 Astra比较；另做18次训练、6个随机初始化的课程消融。

Result: A10五角色平均胜率8.05%（Ironclad 15.6%、Regent 12.5%）；AlphaSpire发布网络无搜索在同一面板为0.55%。延长A10训练使Ironclad从12.4%升至15.6%，Defect从3.0%升至8.1%。A0胜率80.2%，与Spire Mentor报告的80.3%持平；A4起Mentor领先5–8个百分点。同一2,000局A10中，Mentor搜索胜率8.8%，本文策略8.2%，单CPU核每步21–27 ms。GPT-6 Astra在11局A10中0胜。课程消融中，失败驱动分配在三个Regent初始化上均优于均匀重启，平均高3.6个百分点；Silent效应小且符号不稳定。

Conclusion: 单次前向的Transformer策略在A10具有竞争力，A0与树搜索持平，A10接近但略低于搜索智能体，且推理成本低。失败驱动课程对部分角色稳定有效，但效果依赖角色。代码、策略、游戏内mod及全部表格记录已开源。

Abstract: Slay the Spire 2 (STS2) is a deck-building roguelike in which a winning run at the highest difficulty takes several hundred decisions, and most losses happen in late boss fights that a learner seldom reaches. We train agents that choose every action with one forward pass of a 6.6M-parameter entity transformer, without lookahead. Training and evaluation run the game's own compiled assembly (v0.107.1) in a headless .NET host. The host replays a run exactly from its seed and actions, so training episodes can restart from states the learner has visited, and a failure-driven curriculum allocates these restarts in proportion to where complete runs are lost. On 12,800 held-out games at Ascension 10 (A10), the released policies win 8.05% averaged over the five characters (Ironclad 15.6%, Regent 12.5%), and AlphaSpire's released networks used without search win 0.55% on a common panel. Longer A10 training raised Ironclad from 12.4% to 15.6% and Defect from 3.0% to 8.1% on these games. At Ascension 0 the released policies win 80.2%, level with the 80.3% that the tree-search agent Spire Mentor reports, while Mentor leads by 5 to 8 points from A4 upward. Run in our host on the same 2,000 A10 games, Mentor's search wins 8.8% against 8.2% for our policies, which need 21-27 ms per decision on one CPU core. GPT-6 Astra at maximum reasoning won none of 11 A10 games through our text interface. In a controlled study of 18 training runs from six random initializations, failure-driven allocation exceeds uniform restart allocation on each of three Regent initializations, by 3.6 percentage points on average, while the Silent effect is small and changes sign. Code, trained policies, an in-game mod and the records behind every table are at https://github.com/HalfVulpes/sts2ai.

</details>


### [413] [TSFFormer: A Frequency-Domain Spike Transformer for Green Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12090)
*Jiale Deng,Shuiying Xiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出纯脉冲傅里叶Transformer——TSFFormer，用频域全局混合和动态阈值双 compartment 脉冲神经元，在可穿戴IMU人体活动识别中实现高精度、超低功耗与更快训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统DNN因密集浮点MAC操作陷入“算术-延迟死锁”，难以满足可穿戴IMU的功耗与实时性需求；现有SNN虽有超低功耗优势，但存在空间盲区、神经元刚性及梯度退化等问题。

Method: 提出TSFFormer：1）MultiHeadFourier注意力在频域进行全局混合，将复杂度从O(V²)降至O(V log V)，消除空间盲区并节省约50% GPU显存；2）设计双 compartment 时序脉冲LIF神经元（TSLIFNode），利用动态阈值适应非平稳节律并缓解梯度退化。

Result: 在8个公开IMU基准上，TSFFormer优于现有SOTA SNN，甚至超过经典DeepConvLSTM；训练速度约提升3倍，能耗足迹仅0.1 pJ；消融实验验证了各模块的协同效应。

Conclusion: TSFFormer为可穿戴传感提供了一种高精度、超低功耗、事件驱动的Green HAR新范式。

Abstract: Wearable Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) enable pervasive Human Activity Recognition (HAR), but traditional Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) suffer from an "arithmetic-latency deadlock" due to dense floating-point MAC operations. While Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer ultra-low power, existing ones face spatial blind spots, rigid neurons, and gradient degradation. To address these, we propose TSFFormer, a purely spiking Fourier Transformer for Green HAR. It introduces two key innovations: (1) a MultiHeadFourier attention that performs frequency-domain global mixing, reducing complexity from \(O(V^2)\) to \(O(V\log V)\), eliminating spatial blind spots, and saving \(\sim\)50% GPU memory; and (2) a dual-compartment Temporal Spiking LIF (TSLIFNode) that utilizes dynamic thresholds to adapt to non-stationary rhythms and mitigate gradient degradation. Extensive experiments on 8 public IMU benchmarks demonstrate that TSFFormer surpasses state-of-the-art SNNs and even the classic DeepConvLSTM, achieving a \(\sim\)3\(\times\) faster training speed with an energy footprint of 0.1 pJ. Ablation studies confirm the synergistic effect of our modules, providing a highly accurate, ultra-low-power event-driven paradigm for wearable sensing.

</details>


### [414] [Calibrating Document-Local Boundaries for Contextual Chunk Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12097)
*Yuanxiang Wang,Hui Jiang,Da Zhu,Zhihua Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究Late Chunking中同一文档内语义相似负样本难以区分的问题，从InSeNT出发分析文档内梯度，提出自适应缩放与分块感知路由的两部分框架来校准文档局部块边界，在ConTEB和NanoBEIR上提升上下文块检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Late Chunking通过先编码整篇文档再在块边界池化来保留文档上下文，块级后训练能提升依赖上下文的检索效果；但共享上下文使得同文档内语义相似的负样本（hardest sibling）难以与正样本区分，文档局部的决策边界需要被校准。

Method: 从InSeNT出发分析其文档内梯度，证明在固定logits下条件负样本分配的熵随缩放因子单调递减；据此提出两部分框架：第一部分从文档内margin自适应调整判别缩放（adaptive scaling），第二部分在文档编码时让块划分参与注意力（chunk-aware routing）。

Result: 在ConTEB和NanoBEIR上，所提模型在所评估的编码器设置下改善了上下文块检索，同时保持有竞争力的段落级检索质量；消融实验进一步刻画了自适应缩放与分块感知路由的不同作用。

Conclusion: 通过理论分析（熵随缩放因子单调递减）与两部分校准机制，可有效区分同文档内的困难负样本，实现文档局部块边界的校准，兼顾块级与段落级检索性能。

Abstract: Late Chunking encodes an entire document before pooling at chunk boundaries, preserving document context in local retrieval units. Chunk-level post-training improves context-dependent retrieval, but shared context can make semantically similar same-document negatives difficult to distinguish. We study the local decision boundary between a gold chunk and its hardest sibling. Starting from InSeNT, we analyze InSeNT's within-document gradients and show that the entropy of the conditional negative allocation decreases monotonically with the scaling factor at fixed logits. We propose a two-part framework for calibrating document-local chunk boundaries. The first component adapts the discriminative scale from within-document margins, while the second exposes chunk partitions to attention during document encoding. Experiments on ConTEB and NanoBEIR show that the resulting model improves contextual chunk retrieval across the evaluated encoder settings while retaining competitive passage-level retrieval quality; ablations further characterize the distinct roles of adaptive scaling and chunk-aware routing.

</details>


### [415] [Forecast Value Add: Reward-Based Action Selection over Probabilistic Demand Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12116)
*Ankur Verma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将预测精化建模为奖励驱动的决策问题：在强机器学习集成输出上让智能体选择基准预测、无分布边界、分位数或偏差校正估计，并结合上下文匹配历史、结构季节性护栏与可审计归因；在五个零售/消费品部署中显著降低预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强机器学习集成虽能捕捉趋势、季节性和已知事件，但仍可能低估峰值、遗漏移动事件，或将临时变化误判为需求水平变化，因此需要一种能在强集成基础上进一步精化预测并保持可审计性的机制。

Method: 将预测精化转化为奖励驱动的决策问题。每个预测周期，智能体在集成已产生的候选中选择：基准预测、无分布边界、分位数和偏差校正估计；依据日历位置、周期性与移动事件、趋势、价格和促销等上下文，与历史匹配时段进行评价；再施加结构季节性护栏约束调整，并记录模型、智能体和规划者对每个发布值的贡献。

Result: 在五个零售、消费品和直营消费者部署中评估九个月。与堆叠机器学习预测相比，精化预测使平均WMAPE降低6.3%，且每个客户均有改善，最高增益达16.7%；在45个客户-月中35个取得最低误差；与统计预测相比，平均误差降低18.7%。

Conclusion: 上下文感知且可审计的动作选择能够为强集成预测带来额外价值，说明将预测精化作为奖励驱动决策问题是一种有效的误差降低与可追溯性提升方案。

Abstract: Strong machine-learning ensembles capture much of the trend, seasonality, and known events in demand, yet they can still understate peaks, miss moving events, or mistake temporary changes for shifts in demand level. We address this gap by framing forecast refinement as a reward-driven decision problem. For each forecast period, we let an agent choose among values already produced by the ensemble: its base forecast, distribution-free bounds, quantiles, and a bias-corrected estimate. We evaluate these choices against context-matched historical periods, accounting for calendar position, recurring and moving events, trend, price, and promotions. We then apply a structural seasonal guard to constrain adjustments and record the model, agent, and planner contributions to every published value. We evaluate our approach across five retail, consumer-goods, and direct-to-consumer deployments over nine months. Our refined forecasts reduce mean WMAPE by 6.3% compared with the stacked machine-learning forecast for every customer, with gains reaching 16.7%, and achieve the lowest error in 35 of 45 customer-months. Compared with statistical forecasts, our approach reduces mean error by 18.7%. These results demonstrate that context-aware, auditable action selection can add forecast value beyond a strong ensemble.

</details>


### [416] [CARE-PO: Controllable Tool-Call Efficiency for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12125)
*Xiaoyang Ye,Xiao Yao,Hairui Zhu,Yiying Yang,Bei Gan,Jinliang Lu,Tengjin Weng,Yuan Yao,Wenhao Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文诊断出LLM智能体在长程工具使用任务中存在大量可删减的工具调用，而现有基于效率奖励的方法存在锚点随策略漂移、易坍缩为零调用、单次训练仅给单一工作点三个问题，提出CARE-PO：以任务难度锚定且训练前固定的参考预算定价调用，向GRPO rollout组注入成功轨迹并按"未获取证据"计费，并用prompt中的effort标签塑造成本曲线，从而一次训练获得效率与能力两个工作点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部工具调用是LLM智能体的主要运行成本，但训练目标几乎只对齐任务完成度。作者对Qwen3.5在GAIA上的轨迹做步骤级诊断，发现多数轨迹包含可移除的调用，且两个模型规模下比例相近。已有加入效率奖励的方法存在三大缺陷：(1) 惩罚锚点由策略自身rollout计算（如组内最短正确轨迹），随策略移动而不稳定；(2) 训练易漂移向完全不调用工具的坍缩策略（已发表报告与本文27B基线均见此退化）；(3) 一次训练只产出一个工作点，用户无法在效率与能力间权衡。

Method: 提出CARE-PO（Controllable Anchored Relative Efficiency Policy Optimization）。(1) 效率奖励以锚定于任务自身难度、并在训练前固定的参考预算来定价调用次数，避免锚点随策略漂移；(2) 在每个在线GRPO rollout组中注入一条来自训练数据的成功轨迹，并对"轨迹从未获取的证据"计费，缓解向零调用坍缩的漂移；(3) 通过prompt中的effort标签塑造成本曲线，使单次训练即可产出效率与能力两个工作点。同时给出步骤级诊断分析，并在GAIA与四个留出多跳基准、三种模型规模上评估，全部运行中调用数始终保持非零。

Result: GAIA上，三个模型规模共六个工作点中有五个同时提升成功率并降低调用数。四个留出多跳基准上结果依赖规模：27B与4B在更低调用数下成功率保持或提高，9B两个工作点则以成功率换取更少调用。三个规模的训练全过程中调用数均始终显著高于零，未出现坍缩。GAIA诊断显示多数轨迹存在可移除调用，且该比例在两种规模下相近。

Conclusion: CARE-PO通过训练前固定的任务难度锚定预算、成功轨迹注入与未获取证据计费、以及effort标签塑造成本曲线，在缓解锚点漂移与零调用坍缩的同时，实现单次训练可控的效率—能力权衡。实验表明其在GAIA上多数工作点可同时改善成功率与调用数，跨规模泛化部分成立（27B/4B稳定，9B存在权衡），且训练全程不坍缩。

Abstract: External tool calls are a major running cost of an LLM agent, while its training objectives align almost exclusively with task completion. In a step-level diagnosis of Qwen3.5 trajectories at two model sizes on GAIA, a long-horizon tool-use benchmark, we find that most contain removable calls, at a similar rate at both sizes. Some methods add an efficiency reward to the objective to reduce the call count, but introduce problems of their own: the anchor they price calls against is computed from the policy's own rollouts (e.g., the group's shortest correct rollout) and so moves with the policy; training can drift toward a collapsed policy that issues no tool call at all, a degeneracy seen in published reports and in our 27B baseline; and a training run delivers a single operating point, so the user cannot trade efficiency against capability. We present CARE-PO (Controllable Anchored Relative Efficiency Policy Optimization) to mitigate these problems. The efficiency reward prices calls against a reference budget anchored to the task's own difficulty and fixed before training. Injecting a successful trajectory from the training data into each online GRPO rollout group and charging for evidence a trajectory never gathers ease the drift toward a collapsed call count. Shaping the cost curve by an effort tag in the prompt yields an efficiency and a capability operating point from a single training run. On GAIA, five of the six operating points across three model sizes improve on their base model in success rate and call count at once. On four held-out multi-hop benchmarks the result is size-dependent: at 27B and 4B success rate is held or raised at a lower call count, while at 9B both operating points trade success rate for fewer calls. The call count remains well above zero throughout training at all three sizes.

</details>


### [417] [One-Shot Federated Graph Learning via High-Fidelity Proxies and Transferability-Guided Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12131)
*Jia Jiang,Zihan Tan,Wenke Huang,Bin Yang,Mang Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedHFT框架，从高保真知识外化与可迁移性感知知识聚合两方面缓解单次传输瓶颈，实现高效的一次性个性化联邦图学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一次性联邦图学习（OFGL）虽能在严格带宽约束下将协作压缩至单轮传输，但存在“单次传输瓶颈”：一方面，将私有图蒸馏为可共享代理时的激进单次压缩会扭曲本地图拓扑与语义，导致知识外化表达不足（保真度危机）；另一方面，服务器聚合代理时缺乏对跨客户端协作潜力的可靠识别，导致聚合知识利用不足（可迁移性不可知）。

Method: 提出FedHFT，一种一次性个性化联邦图学习（OPFGL）框架。具体包含：保真驱动的代理精炼（Fidelity-Driven Proxy Refinement）以保持客户端侧知识保真度；可迁移性引导的个性化协作（Transferability-Steered Personalized Collaboration）以实现自适应服务器端协作。

Result: 在同质图与异质图上的大量实验验证了FedHFT的优越性，并开源代码。

Conclusion: FedHFT通过同时提升知识外化的保真度与聚合过程的可迁移性感知能力，有效缓解OFGL的单次传输瓶颈，为带宽受限下的个性化联邦图学习提供了一种有效方案。

Abstract: One-shot Federated Graph Learning (OFGL) has emerged as a communication-efficient paradigm for federated graph learning under strict bandwidth constraints, compressing collaboration into a single transmission round. Nevertheless, this extreme setting suffers from a fundamental Single-Transmission Bottleneck, which limits both the quality and utility of exchanged knowledge. First, while existing methods attempt to distill private graphs into shareable proxies, their aggressive one-shot compression inherently triggers a fidelity crisis. This compression distorts local graph topology and semantics across clients, leading to externalized knowledge underexpression. Second, although the server aggregates these proxies to update global models, current integration schemes suffer from transferability agnosticism. The server cannot reliably identify cross-client collaboration potential, thus resulting in integrated knowledge underutilization. To tackle these dual challenges, we propose FedHFT, an effective One-Shot Personalized Federated Graph Learning (OPFGL) framework that addresses this bottleneck from two perspectives, namely High-Fidelity Knowledge Externalization and Transferability-Ware Knowledge Integration. We use Fidelity-Driven Proxy Refinement to preserve client-side knowledge fidelity, and Transferability-Steered Personalized Collaboration to enable adaptive server-side collaboration. The superiority of FedHFT is validated through extensive experiments on both homophilic and heterophilic graphs. The code is available at https://github.com/Jumpy-Juice/FedHFT.

</details>


### [418] [Good Views Are Not Enough: Global Counterexamples for Gaussian-Regularized JEPAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12137)
*Anran Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 高斯正则化JEPA的全局最优解并不能由"好视图"保证场景不变性或旋转唯一性，论文用全局可证的构造性反例推翻了Gaussian扩展的唯一性前提。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "Good Views"工作通过Gaussian扩展论证学习表示在全局最优处具备场景不变性与（至多相差一个旋转的）唯一性，作者质疑"好视图"是否足以支撑该前提，并要回答：视图共享什么、正则项偏好什么、预测任务能用上什么三者如何共同决定学到的表示。

Method: 用全局认证（certified）的反例分析：一是四状态玩具模型，与整个"仅场景"模型类作对比；二是512维模型，具备完整场景基、谱隙与精确总体白化，配合pooled Epps-Pulley正则，并允许在最优旋转后评估跨模态对齐误差；此外给出Bayes风险分解，把经观测信道损失的信息与拟合读出端的难度（基于保留信息）区分开；实验上在匹配的512标签读出预算与1%观测噪声下比较白化预测JEPA与next-token预测。

Result: 在四状态模型中，每个全局极小点都把场景"劈开"，且存在与之等值但在其旋转轨道之外的解，说明唯一性失效；在512维模型中，即使场景基完整、有谱隙且已做精确白化，pooled Epps-Pulley正则仍强制每个全局最优解保留nuisance，且在模态nuisance独立时即便取最佳旋转，跨模态对齐误差仍为正；高斯边际匹配可因保留独立重采样的观测变化而获益，且该收益可超过预测代价——更好对齐可伴随更差预测：白化预测JEPA对场景对齐优于next-token预测，但线性读出测试NLL高0.2872 nats/token。

Conclusion: "好视图"不充分；高斯正则化的JEPA全局最优可能既不唯一也不场景不变，场景对齐与预测性能可以解耦。分析框架把表示学习的三个决定因素——视图共享的信息、正则化偏好的信息、预测任务可利用的信息——联系起来。

Abstract: Good views do not suffice to guarantee scene invariance or uniqueness up to rotation at the global optima of Gaussian-regularized JEPAs. We give globally certified counterexamples showing that the uniqueness premise of the Gaussian extension in Good Views fails for specified soft objectives. Gaussian marginal matching can reward retaining independently resampled observation variation, and this benefit can exceed its prediction cost. In a four-state model, comparison against the entire scene-only class proves that every global minimizer splits a scene and admits an equal-value partner outside its rotation orbit. In a 512-dimensional model with a complete scene basis, a spectral gap, and exact population whitening, pooled Epps-Pulley regularization still forces every global minimizer to retain nuisance and yields positive cross-modal alignment error even after the best rotation when modality nuisances are independent. Better scene alignment can also accompany worse prediction. With matched 512-label readout budgets and 1% observation noise, whitened prediction JEPA aligns better to the scene than next-token prediction but incurs 0.2872 nats/token higher linear-readout test NLL. A Bayes-risk decomposition distinguishes information lost through the observation channel from the fitted readout's difficulty using retained information. These results connect three determinants of learned representations: what views share, what regularization favors, and what a prediction task can use.

</details>


### [419] [Visible Tails: Characterizing Adaptation to Unknown Moments in Heavy-Tailed Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12140)
*Tuan Ngoc Do,Hai Duc Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究无矩参数的重尾老虎机，提出“方差核心可见性”刻画可常数代价适应未知矩的最优臂分布类，并给出分位数截断UCB的上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重尾老虎机在未知矩参数时，携带臂均值信息的奖励可能长期不可见，导致经典UCB/均值估计失效；本文旨在解决COLT开放问题的剩余部分，即刻画哪些最优臂分布允许以常数因子代价适应未知矩。

Method: 提出单侧、平移不变的“方差核心可见性”条件：任意稀有事件中隐藏的均值至多为剩余奖励标准误的常数倍；设计知晓可见性常数的分位数截断UCB索引，并研究跨可见性级别的自适应不可能性。

Result: 在该分布类上，分位数截断UCB达到中心矩基准；不存在单一策略可跨所有可见性级别自适应。同一索引对每个“最优臂可见且奖励有限均值”的实例取得对数期望遗憾。构造无更高阶矩、间隙Δ和常数A的显式族，其对数系数与信息下界均为Δ^{-1}e^{A/Δ}量级，在单一可见性类内随逆间隙指数增长。

Conclusion: 方差核心可见性给出了重尾老虎机中可适应未知矩的最优臂规律的精确认知边界；分位数截断UCB在类内达到基准并具有对数遗憾，而跨类自适应存在根本限制，且指数型间隙依赖由信息下界匹配。

Abstract: Heavy-tailed bandit learners without moment parameters face an obstruction: the rewards that carry an arm's mean can stay unseen. We address the remaining part of a COLT open problem by characterizing the optimal-arm laws that permit adaptation to unknown moments at constant-factor cost. The condition, variance-core visibility, is one-sided and translation-invariant: the mean hidden in any rare event is at most a constant multiple of the standard error of the rewards that remain. A quantile-trimmed UCB index that knows the visibility constants attains the central-moment benchmark on this class, and no single strategy adapts across all visibility levels. The same index achieves logarithmic expected regret on every instance with a visible optimal arm and finite-mean rewards. On an explicit family with no higher moment, gap $Δ$ and constant $A$, its logarithmic coefficient and the information lower bound are of order $Δ^{-1}e^{A/Δ}$, exponential in the inverse gap within one visibility class.

</details>


### [420] [Not Yet in the Profile: Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic User Profiling by Learning from Future Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11204)
*Jieyong Kim,Neil Shah,Dong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UAPM通过Profile-Buffer-Rulebook三部件分离"已确认的用户画像主张"与"尚未确认的新行为解读"，并用双阶段特权在线策略蒸馏POPD-DS训练，在三个Web个性化任务上以相同下游输入预算超过最佳基线最多5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web个性化需要动态用户画像以跟进用户行为与偏好的变化，但新出现的用户行为往往具有歧义性，且同一种行为在不同用户身上含义不同。直接把这些模糊证据写入画像会污染用户表示，因此需要一个能区分"已确认主张"与"待验证解读"的机制。

Method: 提出UAPM（不确定性感知自适应画像管理器），以三个部件组织画像更新：Profile存放已支撑的一般性与情境性特征；Buffer存放尚存歧义的证据，置于画像之外以支持后续决策；Rulebook记录用户特有的解读规则与更新规则。训练采用POPD-DS（双专业化特权在线策略蒸馏）：第一阶段Dual Specialization将更强模型蒸馏为仅用当前信息的Student，以及可利用未来信息的、最终成为Teacher的模型；第二阶段POPD中仅固定Teacher接收未来交互，在任务奖励之外指导学生自身的管理决策，使部署时无需未来信息。

Result: 在三个Web个性化任务上，在相同的下游输入预算下，UAPM优于多个基线，相较最佳同等预算基线提升最多5%。

Conclusion: 将不确定性显式建模为画像外的缓冲证据、并配合用户个性化规则，可在不增加下游输入预算的前提下提升动态画像质量；特权信息蒸馏提供了"训练时见未来、部署时不见未来"的可行训练范式。

Abstract: On the Web, user profiling builds compact user representations from interaction histories for efficient personalization, and dynamic user profiling updates them as users' behavior and preferences change. However, new user behavior can be ambiguous, and its interpretation differs across users. To address this, we introduce Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Profile Manager (UAPM), which separates the claims in a user profile from interpretations of new behavior that are not yet confirmed, through a Profile, a Buffer, and a Rulebook. UAPM records user-specific interpretation and update rules in the Rulebook, keeps ambiguous evidence in the Buffer outside the Profile as evidence for later decisions, and writes supported general and situational characteristics to the Profile. We train UAPM with Privileged On-Policy Distillation with Dual Specialization (POPD-DS), which learns from recorded future interactions during training without access to them at deployment. Its first stage, Dual Specialization, distills a stronger model into a current-only Student and a future-informed model that becomes the Teacher. In the second stage, privileged on-policy distillation (POPD), only the fixed Teacher receives future interactions and guides the Student's own management decisions alongside task rewards. Experiments on three Web personalization tasks show that UAPM outperforms multiple baselines under the same downstream input budget, improving on the best same-budget baseline by up to 5%.

</details>


### [421] [Do Time-Series Foundation Models Forecast Index-Futures Returns? A Preregistered Evaluation of Models, Metrics, and Input Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12141)
*Rishabh Upadhyay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文检验冻结时序基础模型（TSFM）在日内股指期货收益上的"预测能力"是否为真实增量技能。在预注册评估中，5个零样本模型（Chronos-Bolt、Chronos-2、TimesFM 2.5、Moirai 2.0、TiRex）及Kronos在NQ与ES期货上、5–120分钟多个期限与多种输入表示下，与"无变化"基准对比：盲测集中0/160个单元优于无变化，SPA检验p=1.000；回溯留出集0/120。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序基础模型在基准上表现亮眼，但其在低信号领域（如日内收益）的"表面预测技巧"是否具有增量价值尚未验证，因此文章系统检验其能否超越朴素的"无变化"预测。

Method: 预注册评估：在NQ与ES期货上，用五种零样本模型及Kronos，在5–120分钟期限、原生价格/对数收益/波动率标准化收益/成交量时钟等输入表示下与无变化预测对比；采用盲测集（仅打开一次）、Hansen SPA检验、回溯留出集；并用变换感知岭回归、RankIC分析、随机游走下日内协方差闭式推导与符号随机化零假设、以及合成信号注入实验进行诊断。

Result: 盲测集0/160、回溯集0/120个模型-表示-期限-市场单元优于无变化，SPA检验p=1.000；输入表示只改变预测幅度而非准确性；价格水平相关虽>0.9996但不及无变化；日内RankIC看似有技巧（30分钟+0.35）实为均值回归平凡规则，符号随机化零假设可复现约95%；仅一个模型在5分钟波动率上胜过HAR，但输给其输入已含的EWMA；合成信号上5分钟部分恢复、30分钟变差。

Conclusion: 冻结TSFM在日内收益上的"预测技巧"多为度量假象而非增量技能；基准层面的成功不应假定可迁移至极低信号的日内收益等低信号领域。

Abstract: We ask whether the apparent forecasting skill of frozen time-series foundation models (TSFMs) on intraday index-futures returns is incremental skill. In a pre-registered evaluation on E-mini Nasdaq-100 (NQ) and E-mini S&P 500 (ES) futures, a common panel of five zero-shot models (Chronos-Bolt, Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5, Moirai 2.0 and TiRex), plus separate experiments with Kronos, is compared with a no-change forecast at 5-120 minutes, using native prices, log returns, volatility-standardised returns and a volume clock as inputs. On a blind set opened once, 0 of 160 model-representation-horizon-market cells beat no-change, and a Hansen SPA test gives p = 1.000 on both markets; a later retrospective hold-out, scored as a descriptive check, gives 0 of 120. Input representations change forecast magnitude but not accuracy, and a transformation-aware ridge regression does as well. Several standard measures nevertheless suggest skill. Price-level correlation exceeds 0.9996, but no-change scores higher. Within-day RankIC across forecast origins rewards a trivial revert-to-mean rule (+0.35 at 30 minutes); we derive the expected within-day covariance under a random walk in closed form, and a sign-randomised null reproduces about 95% of the observed value. One model beats HAR for 5-minute volatility, but not the EWMA its input already contains. On strongly planted synthetic signals the models recover part of the signal at 5 minutes, and recovery deteriorates at 30 minutes. Benchmark-level success of TSFMs should therefore not be assumed to carry over to low-signal domains such as intraday returns.

</details>


### [422] [Beyond Flat Walks: Compositional Abstraction for Autoregressive Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12160)
*Kaiwen Bian,Andrew H. Yang,Yusu Wang,Ali Parviz,Gal Mishne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出分层图抽象与"由粗到细"生成流程，将粗化、分词、解码解耦，系统考察社区粗化、分层分词与顺序随机化三条设计轴；实验表明基于遍历的分层序列化能稳定提升分布与结构保真度，其 V.U.N. 成本则取决于粗化与随机化策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归图生成器通常通过扁平的节点—边游走将图线性化，这种序列化方式在大规模复杂图上会掩盖高阶结构信息，限制生成质量。

Method: 构建分层图抽象与由粗到细的生成管线，把粗化、分词与解码三个环节分离，并由此暴露三条设计轴：社区粗化、分层分词、顺序随机化。在固定骨干网络、固定训练协议、匹配训练时间的前提下，于五个分子与五个非分子基准上进行对照实验分析。

Result: 在三条设计轴上，基于遍历的分层方法在分布保真度与结构保真度上均稳定提升；其 V.U.N. 成本强烈依赖粗化与随机化策略——社区内随机化带来的保真度—V.U.N. 权衡，在全层级遍历顺序随机化后显著缓解。分子数据集上全部取得一致增益；非分子结果则显示增益取决于所给层级与目标分布结构的对齐程度。

Conclusion: 论文系统刻画了分层序列化在何种条件下、以何种方式有益于自回归图生成：遍历式层级结构是稳定增益来源，而成本与收益的平衡由粗化与随机化策略决定，且效果依赖层级与数据结构的匹配度。

Abstract: Autoregressive graph generators typically linearize graphs through flat node-edge walks, which can obscure higher-order structure in large and complex graphs. We introduce a hierarchical graph abstraction and coarse-to-fine generation pipeline that separates coarsening, tokenization, and decoding. This exposes three design axes: community coarsening, hierarchical tokenization, and order randomization. Across these axes, traversal-based hierarchy consistently improves distributional and structural fidelity, while its V.U.N.\ cost depends strongly on the coarsening and randomization policy. In particular, the fidelity--V.U.N.\ trade-off observed under within-community randomization is substantially reduced when traversal order is randomized across the full hierarchy. With a fixed backbone, training protocol, and matched training time across five molecular and five non-molecular benchmarks, hierarchical serialization yields consistent distributional and structural gains on all molecular datasets, while the non-molecular results further show that these gains depend on how well the supplied hierarchy aligns with structure in the target distribution. Together, these results characterize when and how hierarchical serialization benefits autoregressive graph generation.

</details>


### [423] [Replication of Thermal Comfort Cohort Models: No Support for Improved Thermal Preference Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12178)
*Thomas Hirsch,Katja Ceplak,Veronika Windisch,Samina Kadkhoda Masoumali,Matias Quintana,Clayton Miller,Stefano Schiavon,Gerald Schweiger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文对“群体舒适模型（CCM）”的性能增益进行方法学评估与两项复现，发现原研究的增益在加入平凡基线（多数类、随机分布基线）后不成立，CCM并未优于简单基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个人舒适模型（PCM）需要大量个体数据，而群体舒适模型（CCM）通过按人口学/心理测量特征（冷启动）或相似热偏好（热启动）对住户分组来降低数据需求。原研究报告CCM带来性能提升，但其结论是否稳健、方法是否严谨尚缺乏独立检验。

Method: (i) 对原研究进行方法学审查；(ii) 用原两数据集之一（DORN：20人、6个月）在修订实验协议下复现；(iii) 用独立采集数据集（PersonAI：72人、4周）复现。分类性能同时用原研究的F1-micro和可处理类别不平衡的F1-macro评估，并与平凡基线比较。

Result: 在F1-micro下，始终输出多数类的平凡基线即可与CCM持平；在F1-macro下，所有CCM的中位得分均低于按估计热偏好分布随机预测的简单基线。方法学审查发现：每人与每少数类数据量不足、依赖对类别不平衡不敏感的指标、缺少平凡基线、交叉验证策略不当、存在多处信息泄漏。

Conclusion: 研究结果挑战了原研究“CCM可提升热偏好预测”的结论：CCM并未优于简单的类别分布基线。未来研究应改进实验设计（如受控热环境条件），以确保在各热偏好类别上获得足够观测。

Abstract: Cohort comfort models (CCMs) aim to overcome the extensive individual data requirements of personal comfort models (PCMs) by grouping occupants based on demographic and psychometric characteristics (cold start) or similar thermal preferences (warm start). We evaluated the validity of the reported CCM performance gains through (i) a methodological assessment of the original study, (ii) a replication using one of the two original datasets (DORN: 20 participants, 6 months) under a revised experimental protocol, and (iii) a replication using an independently collected dataset (PersonAI: 72 participants, 4 weeks). Classification performance was evaluated using F1-micro, as in the original study, and F1-macro to account for class imbalance. Under F1-micro, a trivial baseline that always outputs the majority class performed on par with cohort models. Under F1-macro, all cohort models achieved lower median scores than a simple baseline that makes random predictions based on the estimated distribution of thermal preferences. In our methodological assessment we identified the following key issues: Limited data per participant and per minority class, reliance on a metric insensitive to class imbalance, missing trivial baselines, inadequate cross validation strategy, and multiple occurrences of information leakage. Our findings challenge the original study's conclusion that CCMs improve thermal preference prediction. CCMs did not outperform simple class-distribution baselines. Future studies should improve experimental designs, including controlled thermal conditions, to obtain sufficient observations across thermal preference classes.

</details>


### [424] [scBIG++: Learning Across Genes and Cells to Predict Single-Cell Perturbation Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11217)
*Jiafa Ruan,Zican Qiao,Zongxin Yang,Ruijie Quan,Yi Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: scBIG++ 是一个全基因扰动预测框架，通过基因关系聚类与表达自适应子模块建模细胞异质性，并结合集合式图自编码器和潜空间流生成扰动后的全基因表达谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单细胞扰动预测多聚焦高变基因，限制了下游分析可用的表达变化；同时同一扰动下细胞响应存在异质性，基因程序活跃程度不同，需要同时保留共享基因结构并刻画细胞差异。

Method: 提出 scBIG++：Gene-Relation Clustering 将基因组织为公共窗口，Dynamic SoftSub 在窗口内学习表达依赖的子模块隶属关系；Set-GCAE 在对照细胞间交换对应基因组信息，将单细胞表示置于来源群体背景中；细胞表示初始化潜空间流，并以池化摘要和扰动表示作为条件生成响应；最终解码为预处理后全部蛋白编码基因的表达谱。

Result: 在六种遗传与化学扰动设置、覆盖 6,539–19,451 个基因的实验中，方法在未见靶点与组合、跨细胞系迁移及留出化合物条件下，表现出有竞争力的扰动效应恢复和全基因表达重建能力。

Conclusion: scBIG++ 能在建模细胞异质性的同时实现全基因扰动响应预测，为基因功能发现和调控分析提供更全面的表达信息，代码已公开。

Abstract: Predicting single-cell transcriptional responses to genetic and chemical interventions supports gene-function discovery and regulatory analysis. Existing studies often focus only on highly variable genes, restricting the expression changes available for downstream analysis. Cells exposed to the same intervention can also show heterogeneous expression responses, with coordinated gene programs active to different degrees. We propose scBIG++, a full-gene perturbation prediction framework that models this heterogeneity by connecting expression-adaptive gene modules with population-conditioned generation. To preserve shared gene structure while accommodating cellular variation, Gene-Relation Clustering organizes genes into common windows, within which Dynamic SoftSub learns expression-dependent submodule memberships. This shared organization enables Set-GCAE to exchange information about corresponding gene groups across control cells, placing individual representations in their source-population context. The cell representations initialize a latent flow, while their pooled summary and the perturbation representation condition response generation. Generated states are decoded into expression profiles covering all assayed protein-coding genes retained after preprocessing, supporting comprehensive analysis of perturbation-induced expression changes. Experiments across six genetic and chemical settings spanning 6,539--19,451 genes demonstrate competitive perturbation-effect recovery and full-gene expression reconstruction under unseen targets and combinations, cross-cell-line transfer, and held-out compounds. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/ttruan2426-dot/scBIG.

</details>


### [425] [SGA-Sparse: Training Native SwiGLU Gates for Activation-Sparse and Low-Bit LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11223)
*Ruokai Yin,Steven Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将预训练SwiGLU模型的gate投影直接训练为top-k路由器（SGA-Sparse），可在无额外路由参数、不改动原始SwiGLU激活的前提下实现每token 75-85%的FFN通道稀疏，精度仅比dense下降0.2-2.7pp；配合QAT后，以"等效位宽"度量权重流量，建立了优于dense低比特量化的精度-流量帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单用户LLM解码受限于FFN权重访存带宽，激活稀疏可减少权重流量，但必须在取权重之前就提前识别活跃通道。预训练SwiGLU模型中，用原生gate做免训练路由在高稀疏度下显著差于用up激活路由，因此需要找到一种能真正落地的路由方案。

Method: 先给出关键观察：经过稀疏感知训练后，gate路由与up路由的优劣排序发生反转。据此提出SGA-Sparse——把现有gate投影直接训练为固定预算的top-k路由器，端到端更新全部模型参数，保留原始SwiGLU激活形式，且不引入任何辅助路由参数（约30B tokens训练）。此外针对训练后量化会损害稀疏checkpoint的问题，研究continued-QAT（4-bit）与joint-QAT（sub-4-bit）两种量化感知训练配方，并提出把稀疏带来的权重流量下降折算为"等效比特位宽"的统一度量，以便与dense低比特量化直接对比。

Result: 1B–8B LLaMA模型在每token均匀75–85% FFN通道稀疏下，平均zero-shot精度与原始dense checkpoint相差仅0.2–2.7pp；continued-QAT在4-bit权重量化下基本恢复性能，joint-QAT更适合更激进的sub-4-bit目标。在统一权重流量度量下：2.5-bit等效模型达到dense 3-bit QAT的精度，1.5-bit等效模型接近dense 2-bit模型，并平均超过dense三值（ternary）模型1.3pp。

Conclusion: 稀疏感知训练会使原生gate成为优于up激活的路由选择，因此可直接复用gate投影做top-k路由，无需额外参数或结构改动。该方法把高FFN激活稀疏与低比特权重有效结合，在权重流量视角下刷新了精度-流量帕累托前沿，说明native-gate训练是一条实用的稀疏化路线。

Abstract: Activation sparsity can reduce FFN weight traffic during single-user LLM decoding, but active channels must be identified early enough to avoid fetching unused weights. In pretrained SwiGLU models, training-free routing with the native gate performs substantially worse than routing with the up activation at high sparsity. We show that this ordering reverses after sparsity-aware training. Based on this insight, we introduce SGA-Sparse, which converts pretrained SwiGLU LLMs into fixed-budget activation-sparse models by training the existing gate projection directly as a top-k router. SGA-Sparse updates all model parameters end-to-end while preserving the original SwiGLU activation and introducing no auxiliary router parameters. After approximately 30B training tokens, LLaMA models from 1B to 8B achieve uniform per-token 75-85% FFN channel sparsity while remaining within 0.2-2.7 pp of their original dense checkpoints in average zero-shot accuracy. Because post-training quantization degrades sparsity-trained checkpoints, we further study two complementary quantization-aware training (QAT) recipes: continued-QAT largely recovers performance at 4-bit weight quantization, while joint-QAT performs better for the more aggressive sub-4-bit target. To compare activation sparsity with dense low-bit quantization, we translate the sparsity-induced reduction in weight traffic into an equivalent bit-width. Under this unified weight-traffic metric, our 2.5- and 1.5-bit-equivalent models establish a new accuracy-traffic Pareto frontier: the 2.5-bit-equivalent models match dense 3-bit QAT accuracy, while the 1.5-bit-equivalent models approach dense 2-bit models and outperform dense ternary models by 1.3 pp on average. These results establish native-gate training as a practical approach for combining high FFN sparsity with low-bit weights.

</details>


### [426] [Do Feature Interactions Break Explainability? Provable Explanations for Any-Order Neural Additive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11224)
*Idan Refaeli,Yizhak Yisrael Elboher,Guy Katz,Shahaf Bassan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带受限特征交互的神经网络中可证明最小且充分的解释计算：证明即使常数阶交互该问题也是Σ₂^P-hard，识别两类可处理设置并给出高效算法，实验表明解释更小、获取更快且模型精度显著高于标准NAM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络的事后解释方法多为启发式，缺乏可证明保证；计算可证明充分的最小输入特征子集虽更可靠，但对一般网络不可处理。已有工作证明神经加性模型（NAM）较易处理，但标准NAM完全排除特征交互，限制过强、精度受限。因此需要在一般神经网络与纯加性模型之间架桥，研究带受限特征交互网络的可证明解释计算。

Method: 首先理论分析带交互网络的解释复杂度，证明即使仅常数阶交互，求最小充分解释仍是Σ₂^P-hard；随后识别两类可证明可处理的情形：一是交互结构具有稀疏性，二是采用更强的交互感知充分性定义。针对任一情形，设计算法以计算任意阶交互网络的可证明解释，并尽量保留加性模型的计算效率。

Result: 实验表明，所得到的解释显著小于标准算法产生的解释，获取速度更快；同时这些解释来自精度远高于标准NAM的模型。

Conclusion: 研究扩展了能够高效获得可证明解释的神经网络类别，并阐明了特征交互在决定解释计算复杂性中的根本作用。

Abstract: Post-hoc explanation methods for neural networks are often heuristic and lack provable guarantees. A common alternative to such methods that was studied in recent years is to compute a cardinally-minimal subset of input features that is provably sufficient to determine the model's prediction. For general neural networks, however, finding such explanations is computationally intractable. In contrast, recent work showed that this problem becomes more tractable for a particular family of neural networks, namely neural additive models (NAMs), though standard NAMs are highly restrictive because they exclude feature interactions altogether. In this work, we study the computation of provably minimal and sufficient explanations for neural networks with restricted feature interactions, bridging the gap between fully general neural networks and purely additive models. We first prove that even with constant-order interactions, the problem is $Σ_2^P$-hard, implying that worst-case exponential complexity is unavoidable. We then identify two provably tractable settings: one based on sparsity in the interaction structure and another based on a stronger interaction-aware notion of sufficiency. Under either of these settings, we develop algorithms that compute provable explanations for neural networks with any-order interactions while retaining much of the computational efficiency of additive models. Empirically, we show that these explanations are significantly smaller and faster to obtain than those produced by standard algorithms, while being derived from models that achieve much higher accuracy than standard NAMs. Overall, our results help expand the class of neural networks that admit efficient provable explanations, while clarifying the fundamental role of feature interactions in shaping their complexity.

</details>


### [427] [FRESCO: A Novel Consistency Control for Asynchronous Pipeline Parallel Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11238)
*Dongyeop Lee,Namhoon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FRESCO，将异步流水线并行中的参数不一致问题重构为约束优化问题，通过寻找对激活子空间作用平凡的"最小更新修改"，在保持前向等价性的同时缓解梯度不一致带来的训练不稳定，在LLM预训练中显著优于现有异步基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步流水线并行能加速分布式模型训练，但梯度计算不一致导致训练不稳定。作者指出不一致的根本来源：误差信号与前向特征（而非仅参数状态）耦合，因此只要保持前向等价，参数可以不同地演化——这为重新设计异步更新提供了理论切入点。

Method: FRESCO将异步更新形式化为一个约束优化问题：在激活子空间上作用平凡（不改变前向输出）的约束下，求解最小的更新修改量，从而在保持前向等价的前提下修正异步梯度带来的不一致。

Result: 在LLM预训练中，FRESCO一致优于代表性异步基线；增益在深流水线和高度不一致场景下最显著：流水线深度32时，达到最强基线相同loss所需迭代数减少43%、实际耗时减少30%，且内存开销降低8~921倍。

Conclusion: FRESCO不仅提升了异步流水线并行的稳定性与效率，还突破了现有异步方法的局限，为高利用率流水线并行训练建立了新基础，为大模型在多样、资源受限系统上的可扩展开发提供了路径。

Abstract: Asynchronous pipeline parallelism can accelerate distributed model training, but suffers from instability caused by inconsistent gradient computations. We identify a fundamental source of this inconsistency: error signals are coupled to forward-time features, not just parameter states. This means that parameters may evolve as long as they preserve forward-equivalence. Leveraging this insight, we introduce FRESCO, which frames asynchronous updates as a constrained optimization problem: it finds the minimal update modification that acts trivially on the activation subspace. We demonstrate that FRESCO consistently outperforms representative asynchronous baselines in LLM pre-training, with the gains most pronounced under deep pipelines and high inconsistency levels: at pipeline depth 32, it reaches the same loss as the strongest baseline with 43% fewer iterations and 30% less wall-clock time, while requiring 8~921$\times$ less memory overhead. Moving beyond the current limitations, FRESCO establishes a new foundation for high-utilization pipeline parallel training, providing a scalable path for large-model development on diverse, resource-constrained systems.

</details>


### [428] [Odds-Structured Distributional Regression for Interpretable Time-to-Event Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12268)
*Jakob Versnjak,Manuel Welte,Titus Kuehne,Marcus Kelm,Grégoire Montavon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ODDS-DR范式，将生存/时间-事件预测模型的输出参数设计为对数几率（log-odds）可加形式，从而在保持分布回归性能的同时获得逐层可加、时间依赖的特征归因能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间-事件预测受部分可观测性与偶然不确定性困扰，临床中疾病进展/再入院时机依赖于动态且潜在的健康轨迹。分布回归可给出时间上的概率分布而非确定性点预测，但其输出参数是抽象数学量，与领域概念不一致，导致可解释性差。

Method: 提出ODDS-DR：将模型输出的分布参数设计为在log-odds上可加（log-odds在临床风险建模中是公认度量），从而兼顾领域对齐与逐层计算结构，支持稳健的时间依赖特征归因。

Result: 在两个真实临床队列上验证，框架达到与SOTA相当的预测性能，并能将分布输出分解为可解释的风险标志物，且适用于灵活的预后时间窗。

Conclusion: 以log-odds可加参数化为核心的ODDS-DR在性能与可解释性之间取得平衡，为分布回归型时间-事件预测提供原则性、可归因的建模路径。

Abstract: Time-to-event prediction is fundamentally challenged by partial observability and aleatoric uncertainty. In clinical medicine, for instance, the timing of disease progression or acute readmission is contingent on highly dynamic and largely latent health trajectories. Rather than forcing a deterministic point forecast, distributional regression offers a principled means to address this complexity by predicting a probability distribution over time. However, explaining these distributional predictions presents a key obstacle: raw distribution parameters output by the model are abstract mathematical quantities that do not align well with domain concepts. To gain interpretability, we propose a novel paradigm where output parameters are designed to be additive in log-odds---a widely established measure in clinical risk modeling. Our approach, called ODDS-DR, moves beyond technical convenience to deliver clear domain alignment as well as the layer-wise computational structure required for robust, time-dependent feature attribution. Validated across two real-world clinical cohorts, our framework matches state-of-the-art predictive performance while resolving distributional outputs into interpretable risk markers across flexible prognostic horizons.

</details>


### [429] [Learning Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12285)
*Xingpeng Gao,Mingyue Cheng,Daoyu Wang,Huajian Zhang,Xiaoyu Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CastReasoner——一个"证据驱动推理"的上下文感知时间序列预测模型：用结构化思维链从上下文特征中抽取预测证据、推断未来动态，并与预测先验比对以指导自适应决策；配合 SFT+RL 两阶段后训练（多教师可控合成推理轨迹+学生感知难度筛选、细粒度多目标奖励、收敛引导的数据平衡）提升推理质量与预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的时间序列预测虽能利用上下文特征直接生成未来值或修正预测先验，但仅"引入上下文特征"并不能保证模型识别哪些特征对预测真正重要、也无法理解这些特征对未来动态意味着什么。作者认为核心难题是：如何从上下文特征中抽取可用的预测证据，以及何时、以何种方式利用这些证据来指导预测决策。

Method: 1）模型层面：CastReasoner 采用结构化思维链（CoT），依次完成"从上下文特征抽取预测证据—推断证据所暗示的未来动态—将该动态与预测先验进行对照评估"，据此做出自适应预测决策。2）训练层面：设计以推理为中心的两阶段后训练框架。第一阶段 SFT：通过可控的多教师引导合成推理轨迹，并用新颖的"学生感知难度指标"筛选高质量轨迹；第二阶段 RL：设计细粒度多目标奖励函数，进一步改进推理与预测表现。3）针对不同领域异构的学习需求，在两个阶段均引入收敛引导的数据平衡策略。

Result: 在多领域时间序列预测基准上的大量实验表明，CastReasoner 取得了更优的预测性能；两阶段训练同时提升了推理质量与预测准确率。

Conclusion: 将上下文特征转化为显式的"预测证据"并显式推理其未来含义，再与预测先验对照，是提升 LLM 时间序列预测的有效路径；配套的多教师合成数据+难度筛选+多目标强化+数据平衡的两阶段后训练方案能够协同改善推理与精度。

Abstract: LLM-driven time series forecasting has become increasingly promising by leveraging contextual features to generate future values directly or refine forecast priors. However, incorporating contextual features alone does not ensure that models can identify which features matter for forecasting and understand what they suggest about future dynamics. We argue that the fundamental challenge is how to extract predictive evidence from contextual features and when and how to leverage it to guide forecasting decisions. In this paper, we propose CastReasoner, an evidence-grounded reasoning model for context-aware time series forecasting. Specifically, CastReasoner uses a structured chain of thought (CoT) to extract predictive evidence from contextual features, infer the future dynamics suggested by this evidence, and assess these dynamics against the forecast prior to guide adaptive forecasting decisions. To enable this capability, we design a reasoning-centric two-stage post-training framework including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). First, we synthesize reasoning trajectories through controllable multi-teacher guidance and select high-quality ones using a novel student-aware difficulty metric. Second, we design fine-grained multi-objective rewards to further improve reasoning and forecasting. To address heterogeneous learning needs across domains in both stages, we introduce a convergence-guided data balancing strategy. Through this two-stage training, CastReasoner improves both reasoning quality and predictive accuracy. Extensive experiments across multi-domain forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that CastReasoner achieves superior forecasting performance.

</details>


### [430] [The Optimal Rate Constant of Heavy-Ball Momentum on Smooth Strongly Convex Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12310)
*Marcos Hernanz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究常步长、常动量重球法在光滑强凸函数类上的最优最坏情况收敛率，证明最优调参下 c(κ)→8，即渐近比梯度下降快约4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重球法在二次函数上可用常参数加速梯度下降，但在一般光滑强凸函数类上并不存在一组常参数实现类似加速。论文旨在确定：在该函数类上，通过最优调参，重球法最多能比梯度下降快多少。

Method: 将最优最坏情况收敛率写成 1−c(κ)/κ，其中 κ 为条件数。下界通过构造二元函数上的缓慢衰减螺旋轨迹，证明任何在二次函数上快于 1−8/κ 的调参都会在该函数上失效。上界来自显式调参：动量接近 Polyak 调参，步长约小 sqrt(κ)/8 倍；并构造 Lyapunov 函数，用精确算术验证其正性。

Result: 证明在所有维度至少为2时 c(κ)→8，且下界适用于任意调参，与显式调参给出的上界匹配。因此最优调参的重球法在该函数类上渐近比梯度下降快4倍。

Conclusion: 常步长、常动量重球法在光滑强凸函数类上的最优渐近加速极限为4倍；超过该极限的调参会在某些二元函数上退化为缓慢衰减螺旋，无法获得更好最坏情况保证。

Abstract: The heavy-ball method with a constant step size and a constant momentum parameter accelerates gradient descent on quadratics, but no choice of the two parameters does so on the class of smooth strongly convex functions. We determine how much faster than gradient descent it can be made on this class. Writing the best worst-case rate over all tunings as $1-c(κ)/κ$, where $κ$ is the condition number, we prove that $c(κ)$ tends to $8$ in every dimension of two or more. The lower bound on the rate holds for every tuning, because a tuning that is faster than $1-8/κ$ on quadratics follows a slowly decaying spiral on some function of two variables. The matching upper bound comes from an explicit tuning, with nearly the momentum of Polyak's tuning and a step size about $\sqrtκ/8$ times smaller, and from a Lyapunov function whose positivity is verified in exact arithmetic. Optimally tuned heavy-ball is therefore asymptotically four times faster than gradient descent on this class.

</details>


### [431] [A Unified Framework for License Plate Identification and Character-Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11289)
*Saurabh Kumar,Dewant Katare,Prakriti Jain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出共享特征编码器、无锚定位头与RoIAlign序列识别分支的统一车牌检测识别框架，并在Jetson Orin Nano上以INT8 TensorRT实现高精度、低延迟、低功耗部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘硬件上车牌检测与字符识别通常采用两阶段流程，需要图像空间裁剪和第二个识别骨干网络，推理开销和内存占用较大；因此需要一种统一、轻量且适合低功耗边缘部署的方案。

Method: 采用共享CSP-Darknet与PANet特征编码器，结合无锚定位头和基于RoIAlign的序列识别分支；字符解码直接在对齐后的特征图上完成，避免裁剪车牌图像和额外识别骨干。模型在约3.7万张人工核验、覆盖美国50州车牌布局的AI辅助数据集上训练，并转换为INT8 TensorRT引擎，在8 GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上评估。

Result: INT8模型取得97.8%的mAP50和90.7%的完整序列识别准确率；端到端延迟6.8 ms、147 FPS，推理内存315 MB，平均功耗9.4 W。相比YOLOv8s+CRNN基线，吞吐量提升7.1倍，分配推理内存降低77.8%。

Conclusion: 该统一框架通过共享编码和特征图级字符解码，在低功耗边缘设备上同时实现较高检测识别精度与实时性，并显著降低内存和计算开销，具备较强的边缘部署价值。

Abstract: This paper presents a unified framework for license plate detection and character recognition on low-power edge hardware. The proposed network uses a shared CSP-Darknet and PANet feature encoder with an anchor-free localization head and a RoIAlign-based sequence-recognition branch. Character decoding is performed directly on aligned feature maps, avoiding image-space plate cropping and a second recognition backbone. The model is trained on an AI-assisted dataset of approximately 37,000 manually verified images covering license plate layouts from all 50 United States. The dataset includes variations in illumination, viewpoint, weather, blur, occlusion, and plate design. The framework is converted to an INT8 TensorRT engine and evaluated on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano with 8 GB memory. The INT8 model shows an mAP50 of 97.8% and a full-sequence accuracy of 90.7%. It records 147 FPS at 6.8 ms end-to-end latency, with 315 MB inference memory and 9.4 W average power consumption. Relative to the YOLOv8s+CRNN baseline, the proposed deployment provides a 7.1x throughput increase and a 77.8% reduction in allocated inference memory

</details>


### [432] [A Modular Perspective for Modeling MARL Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12314)
*Tiziano Maisonhaute,Jean-Christophe Soulié,Fabien Michel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对多智能体强化学习（MARL）文献碎片化、架构选择难以被显式比较的问题，提出一种模块化视角，将 MARL 系统分解为八个功能模块，并实现可互换模块的框架 MARLKIT，以支持受控实验与机制复用组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MARL 研究日益复杂且文献分散，不同实现掩盖了底层架构选择；这种碎片化使得关键建模维度难以被单独评估，也难以识别各组件对系统动态的影响，更难以跨文献比较、复用或组合已有贡献。

Method: 提出模块化建模、分析与实现视角，将 MARL 系统拆分为八个功能模块：智能体、环境、学习、奖励建模、训练与执行模式、通信、对其他智能体的建模、评估准则；逐模块阐明作用并综述代表性方法。将该分解落地为模块显式且可互换的框架 MARLKIT，通过实验展示其原型设计、比较、复用与组合模块的能力。

Result: M ARLKIT 的实验表明，该模块化视角能够支持透明的实验假设，实现对 MARL 机制的受控变化与组合；可对模块进行原型设计、比较、复用与组合，并使不同配置之间的差异更加显式。

Conclusion: 论文为 MARL 建模与实现提供了结构化视角和共同语言，使建模选择更加明确，有助于更清晰地描述 MARL 方法，并通过系统性地隔离与组合机制支持更受控的实验。

Abstract: The growing complexity of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has fragmented the literature, obscuring underlying architectural choices behind diverse implementations. This fragmentation makes it difficult to evaluate critical modeling dimensions in isolation, identify how components affect the resulting system dynamics, and compare, reuse, or combine contributions across the literature.
  This paper proposes a modular perspective for modeling, analyzing, and implementing MARL systems. We decompose them into eight functional modules: agents, environments, learning, reward modeling, training and execution modes, communication, modeling of other agents, and evaluation criteria. For each module, we clarify its role and review representative approaches.
  We instantiate this decomposition in MARLKIT, a framework whose modules are explicit and interchangeable. MARLKIT demonstrates how the proposed perspective supports transparent experimental assumptions and the controlled variation and combination of MARL mechanisms. Experiments illustrate its ability to prototype, compare, reuse and combine modules while making differences between configurations explicit.
  Overall, the paper provides a structured perspective on MARL modeling and implementation, offering a common language for making modeling choices explicit, supporting clearer descriptions of MARL approaches, and supporting more controlled experimentation through the systematic isolation and combination of MARL mechanisms.

</details>


### [433] [On the universal structure in deterministic generative diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10338)
*Defang Chen,Zhenyu Zhou,Can Wang,Zeyu Zheng,Siwei Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出扩散模型确定性采样轨迹具有跨数据模态与模型实现的通用几何结构，并可用基于最优线性去噪器的可精确求解模型解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散生成模型已成为高维结构化数据建模的通用框架，但对其生成机制缺乏原则性理解，限制了模型训练与推理的理性改进。

Method: 分析扩散模型的确定性采样轨迹，提炼其几何结构；构建基于最优线性去噪器的可精确求解理论模型，对轨迹结构进行解释。

Result: 发现确定性采样轨迹存在与数据模态和扩散模型实现无关的通用几何结构；该结构在很大程度上可由最优线性去噪器模型精确刻画。

Conclusion: 扩散生成过程存在可理论解释的普适几何规律，为理解生成机制及改进训练与推理提供了原则性基础。

Abstract: Diffusion-based generative modeling has emerged as a general computational framework for simulating high-dimensional, structured data across various domains. Understanding its generative mechanisms is paramount for advancing model training and inference in a principled way. Here, we demonstrate that deterministic sampling trajectories share a universal geometric structure invariant to data modalities and diffusion model implementations. This structure can be largely explained by an exactly solvable model based on the optimal linear denoiser.

</details>


### [434] [How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12324)
*Ku Onoda,Haruto Kawano,Shota Takashiro,Kohei Hayashi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出MechEval基准，量化世界模型在新环境中预测机制效果所需的"曝光次数"，并构建WARC（35M参数ViT）验证测试时训练的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型能让智能体在想象经验中规划与学习，但在陌生环境中必须依靠有限交互来学习其内在机制；核心问题是：世界模型需要多少次"曝光"（每次机制发生的一次观测）才能预测新环境的机制效果，这一数据效率问题此前缺乏可度量基准。

Method: 在ARC-AGI-3（由程序定义的交互式游戏基准）上构建MechEval，从游戏程序中标注出20个游戏里69种反复出现的机制，并按每次曝光中机制所改变的具体格点来评分预测；同时构建WARC——一个在其它游戏上预训练、每次状态转移后更新全部参数的35M参数视觉Transformer作为测试平台。

Result: 在留出游戏上，WARC能以≥80%格点改变准确率预测五分之四的机制，且准确率维持到录制结束；其中一半机制可在单局游戏约80次曝光内达到该准确率，而不做更新时仅七分之一能达到。在公开游戏闭环对局中，WARC-Agent（WARC+固定图探索器）将该探索器的官方效率分从0.15提升至0.46，主要收益来自测试时训练；在Kaggle隐藏游戏榜单上得分为0.20。

Conclusion: 测试时全参数更新（测试时训练）是世界模型快速适应新环境机制的关键，少量曝光即可获得较高机制预测准确率，并能显著提升闭环探索效率；MechEval为世界模型的数据效率提供了可复现的评测方式。

Abstract: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As a test bed, we build WARC (World model for ARC-AGI-3), a 35M-parameter vision transformer that is pretrained on other games and updates all of its parameters after each transition. On held-out games, WARC learns to predict four in five mechanics with at least 80% accuracy on the cells they change and keeps that accuracy to the end of the recordings. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training. On the hidden games of the Kaggle leaderboard, our entry scores 0.20.

</details>


### [435] [Evidence or Marginal? What Moment-Vector Propagation Computes in Polynomial Density Neurons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12339)
*Przemysław Spyra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文辨析神经元在输入缺失或由信念 q 表征时应输出什么，比较两种公式 p_CD=E_q[N]/E_q[D] 与 p_EU=E_q[N/D]，并给出解释、证明、探索性实证与预注册合成检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经元的输入可能缺失，或仅以信念分布 q 已知；此时应输出什么并不显然。Hierarchical Correlation Reconstruction 将只需一次矩阵-向量乘的 p_CD 作为 p_EU 的常分母近似引入，但二者的概率语义与适用问题需要澄清。

Method: 作者对联合多项式密度 N 与输入密度 D 的两个候选公式作理论解读与证明：p_CD 视为以信念作虚拟证据的贝叶斯更新，p_EU 视为把信念安装为新边缘的 Jeffrey 规则。随后在最多 k=8 个输入的 pair family 之外作事后示例，并报告一个探索性真实数据试点；再做最多 32 个输入的预注册合成研究，检验 15 条假设，并分析 Beta 信念下截断与公式差距。

Result: 理论事后解读得到证明并示例；缺失输入时 p_CD 返回模型条件分布，而 p_EU 一般不。事后闭式结果落在全部 112 个测量差距的 2 倍因子内，负密度在输入相关性约 1/k 附近出现。预注册合成研究中 5/15 条假设获支持，2 条不确定，8 条不支持，包括关于超越等相关高斯情形的全部三条迁移假设。事后看，在 p_EU 有定义时，Beta 信念的 pair neurons 中截断通常大于公式差距，flat 与 data 信念下的 triple neurons 为例外。

Conclusion: 论文的主要贡献是把 p_CD 与 p_EU 区分成回答不同问题的精确密度更新规则，并指出实际采用 p_CD 的近似的语义代价。证据结构偏探索性且预注册检验支持有限，尤其外推性假设未获支持；因此结论应视为对公式解释与适用边界的审慎澄清，而非对 p_CD 近似的普遍验证。

Abstract: When a neuron's input is lost, or known through a belief $q$, what should it output? For a neuron storing a joint polynomial density $N$ with input density $D$, two formulas compete. $p_\mathrm{CD}=E_q[N]/E_q[D]$ costs one matrix-vector product; Hierarchical Correlation Reconstruction introduces it as a constant-denominator approximation to $p_\mathrm{EU}=E_q[N/D]$. For a density model both are exact answers to different questions: $p_\mathrm{CD}$ is Bayesian updating with the belief as virtual evidence; $p_\mathrm{EU}$ installs the belief as a new marginal (Jeffrey's rule). With a missing input $p_\mathrm{CD}$ returns the model's conditional; $p_\mathrm{EU}$ generally does not. This post hoc reading is proved, and illustrated outside the pair family up to $k=8$ inputs; it has no pre-registered test, only one exploratory real-data pilot. Post hoc, closed forms fall within a factor 2 of all 112 measured gaps, and negative density begins near input correlation $1/k$. In a pre-registered synthetic study (up to 32 inputs), 5 of 15 hypotheses are supported, 2 inconclusive and 8 not supported, including all three on transfer beyond equicorrelated Gaussians. Post hoc, where $p_\mathrm{EU}$ is defined, truncation usually outweighs the gap for Beta beliefs in pair neurons; triple neurons under flat and data beliefs are exceptions.

</details>


### [436] [Optimal Rates for Adaptive Private $k$-PCA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12419)
*Johanna Düngler,Amartya Sanyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对差分隐私随机 PCA，本文提出一种非迭代降维（非 deflation）算法，在保持数据自适应隐私噪声和任意目标维数 k 的同时，实现关于 d 与 k 均最优的样本复杂度，并移除样本量对特征值间隙的指数依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 KD-PPCA 虽首次同时实现 n=Õ(d)、数据自适应隐私噪声和任意 k，但其样本复杂度对 k 的依赖次优；此外已有效用保证要求最小样本量随特征值间隙指数增长，且谱参数依赖可改进。作者希望同时解决这些理论缺陷，并简化算法结构。

Method: 研究 n 个独立同分布随机矩阵 A_i∈R^{d×d}、公共期望 Σ 下的差分隐私随机 PCA；不使用逐特征向量 deflation，而是联合更新完整的 d×k 子空间，从而减少超参数并提升分块线性代数计算效率。

Result: 提出首个在 d 和 k 上均达到最优样本复杂度的算法，同时保留 KD-PPCA 的数据自适应隐私噪声与任意 k≤d 的扩展性；去除最小样本量对特征值间隙的指数依赖；改进谱参数依赖，并匹配 spiked covariance model 的已知下界；非 deflation 结构使算法更简单、超参数更少、计算更高效。

Conclusion: 该工作从理论和算法结构两方面改进了差分隐私随机 PCA：在最优样本复杂度、谱参数依赖、特征值间隙鲁棒性和计算效率上均优于或补充了既有方法，尤其适合需要任意目标维数 k 的隐私 PCA 场景。

Abstract: Given $n$ i.i.d. random matrices $A_i \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$ with common expectation $Σ$, the goal of \emph{Differentially Private Stochastic PCA} is to identify a $k$-dimensional subspace capturing the leading variance directions of $Σ$, while preserving differential privacy~(DP) for each individual sample $A_i$. \citet{dungler2025iterative} introduced \kdppca, the first algorithm to simultaneously (1) achieve sample complexity $n=\widetilde O(d)$ for sub-Gaussian data, (2) adapt its privacy noise to the intrinsic randomness of the data, and (3) extend seamlessly to any target dimension $k\le d$. However, its sample complexity has a suboptimal dependence on $k$. We propose the first algorithm that achieves optimal sample complexity in both $d$ and $k$, while retaining properties (2) and (3) of \kdppca. Additionally, prior utility guarantees require a minimum sample size with exponential dependence on the eigengap. Our method removes this dependence. It also improves the dependence on spectral parameters, matching known lower bounds for the spiked covariance model. Unlike deflation-based approaches like \kdppca, our algorithm updates the full $d\times k$ subspace jointly rather than one eigenvector at a time. This non-deflation structure simplifies the algorithm, reduces the number of hyper-parameters, and improves computational efficiency, particularly when using block linear algebra libraries.

</details>


### [437] [Two-Phase Rapid Simulation-Based Inference with Differentiable Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12422)
*Uros Zivanovic,Rahul Srinivasan,Roberto Trotta,Andre Scaffidi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 RSBI：一种基于扩散/薛定谔桥的似然无关贝叶斯推断变分方法，通过可微模拟器给出的距离型替代似然构建高效一次性提议分布，再用神经似然比校正并迁移到真实后验，在大先验-后验体积下实现高效采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 似然无关贝叶斯推断（SBI）在大先验体积、多峰后验与有限模拟预算下采样效率低；序列式后验估计方法常需多轮模拟，且易出现先验泄漏（prior leakage），难以兼顾效率与后验覆盖。

Method: RSBI 借鉴薛定谔桥（SB）扩散采样以处理多峰后验；先利用可微模拟器上的距离度量构造替代似然，得到高效的一次性提议分布，替代多轮序列采样；随后以该提议热启动 SB 采样器，并在提议有质量的区域学习神经似然比来校正能量，将样本传输到由模拟器和原始先验定义的真实后验；可选结合 well-tempered meta-dynamics 提升模态覆盖与先验体积探索。

Result: 在标准 SBI 基准上表现强，尤其当先验体积相对真实后验增大时；在高度受限的模拟预算下，Two Moons 上性能仅下降约 5%。还在受黑洞光谱学启发的引力波 ring-down 后验估计这一真实物理基准上进行了评估。

Conclusion: RSBI 将高效替代似然提议与薛定谔桥扩散校正相结合，在有限模拟预算和大先验体积下实现高效、多峰可覆盖的似然无关后验推断，并避免序列后验估计中常见的先验泄漏，具备真实物理问题应用潜力。

Abstract: We introduce Rapid Simulation Based Inference (RSBI), a diffusion-based variational approach to likelihood-free Bayesian inference that achieves high sampling efficiency under large prior-to-posterior volumes. RSBI builds on advances in Schrödinger Bridge (SB) diffusion sampling to handle multi-modal posteriors, with an initial likelihood supplied by a distance measure via a differentiable simulator. The key innovation of this initial surrogate likelihood is that it gives a highly efficient proposal distribution, replacing sequential rounds of other methods with an efficient one-shot proposal. Subsequent refinement then transports the proposal to the true posterior as specified by the simulator and the original prior. The SB sampler is warm-started from the proposal, and its energy is corrected by a neural likelihood ratio that is learned only where the proposal places mass. As a variational method, RSBI does not suffer from prior leakage commonly observed in standard sequential posterior estimation methods. To improve mode coverage we optionally utilize the well-tempered meta-dynamics framework, which also encourages exploration of the prior volume. We observe strong performance on standard SBI benchmarks, particularly when the prior volume is increased relative to the ground truth posterior, achieving a performance degradation of only $\sim5\%$ on Two Moons under a highly constrained simulation budget. Additionally, we evaluate RSBI's performance for gravitational wave ring-down posterior estimation, in a real-world physics benchmark inspired by black hole spectroscopy.

</details>


### [438] [UCB-min: Combining Bandits Under Variance Heterogeneity (Extended Version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12427)
*Lilia Izri,Benoit Groz,Silviu Maniu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UCB-min 是一种逐臂自适应的元算法，对每个臂取方差无关与方差感知两种探索奖励中较小者，无需已知方差或奖励归一化，在理论上达到两基线的后悔界并自动追踪最优基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多臂老虎机广泛用于推荐系统、临床试验等序列决策问题，性能依赖探索策略。实际中各臂奖励方差未知且差异大、奖励支撑常未明确，导致方差无关方法（如 UCB1）在方差小时过于保守，方差感知方法（如 UCB-V）依赖可靠的方差估计与支撑上界；异质未知方差在目标标量化等场景中普遍存在，故不存在统一最优规则。

Method: 提出 UCB-min：一种逐臂自适应元算法，为每个臂在方差无关与方差感知两类探索奖励中选择更紧的一个，无需事先知道方差区间，也无需奖励归一化；以 UCB-V 作为方差感知基线进行理论分析。

Result: 理论证明：在标准探索常数下，其后悔被两基线后悔界之和所界定；在更大常数下，可达两基线逐臂最小值（至常数项）。实验在合成数据、教育辅导任务以及 MovieLens、Steam 两个群组推荐基准上验证，UCB-min 在多种方差区间和数据集中稳定追踪最优基线算法。

Conclusion: UCB-min 以极简的逐臂取最小机制，在未知异质方差情形下兼顾鲁棒性与紧致性，理论与实验均表明能自适应匹配最优基线，具有实用价值。

Abstract: Multi-armed bandits are a natural framework for many real-world sequential decision problems, from recommender systems and clinical trials to educational test recommendation and online advertising. The performance of these algorithms depends on how they explore different arms, and exploration strategies range from variance-independent (e.g., UCB1) to variance-aware (e.g., UCB-V). In practice the reward variance of each arm is rarely known and varies widely across arms, and the reward support is often underspecified. In these cases no single rule is uniformly best: variance-independent methods are robust but loose when variances are small, while variance-aware methods are tight only when their variance estimates and the assumed support bound are reliable. Such heterogeneous, unknown variances arise in many settings, for instance when multiple objectives are scalarized into a single reward. We propose UCB-min, a per-arm adaptive meta-algorithm that selects, for each arm, the tighter of a variance-independent and a variance-aware exploration bonus, without prior knowledge of the variance regime and without reward normalization. We prove that, with UCB-V as variance-aware base, its regret is bounded by the sum of the two base bounds at the standard exploration constant, and by their per-arm minimum, up to a constant, for a larger one. We validate it on synthetic data, an educational tutoring task, and two group-recommendation benchmarks (MovieLens, Steam), showing that UCB-min consistently tracks the best base algorithm across diverse variance regimes and datasets.

</details>


### [439] [LLM-based Multi-Criteria Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Efficient 5G UPF Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11372)
*Abdelrahman Soliman,Ahmed Refaey Hussein,Lei Lei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于深度强化学习的5G UPF动态选择方法，利用LLM解析网络运营商意图并结合NWDAF异常告警构建多目标奖励函数，并在真实5G仿真平台上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有5G UPF选择研究多为有限方法，难以兼顾网络效率与资源管理；需要一种能动态响应运营商意图和网络异常、同时平衡多目标的UPF选择方案。

Method: 提出DRL-based UPF选择方法；采用动态、多目标奖励函数；通过LLM将网络运营商意图转化为可用的决策信息，并结合NWDAF异常告警；在真实5G仿真平台上进行实验验证。

Result: 在真实实验环境中，该动态DRL方案在时延、能耗和流量分布之间实现有效平衡，相较启发式基线和固定DRL方法性能提升16.89%。

Conclusion: 研究表明该方法具有面向真实场景的动态、意图驱动UPF选择应用潜力，并为多目标网络资源管理提供了有效思路。

Abstract: User plane function (UPF) selection in 5G networks is an active area of research, with various limited approaches proposed to enhance network efficiency and manage resources effectively. In this paper, we address this gap in the related literature by proposing a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) UPF selection method that utilizes a dynamic, multi-objective reward function and validating it on a real-world 5G emulation platform. The proposed method is based on the large language models' (LLMs) translation of network operator intents and the network data analytics function (NWDAF) abnormality alerts. The experimental results validated in the real-world experimental setup demonstrate that our dynamic DRL solution achieves an effective balance between latency, power consumption, and traffic distribution, outperforming the heuristic baselines and fixed DRL by 16.89%. These findings highlight the real-world applicability of our approach for dynamic, intent-driven UPF selection.

</details>


### [440] [Patching Up Circuit Learning via Parameter Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12436)
*Charles Bricout,Gennaro Gala,Viacheslav Borovitskiy,Antonio Vergari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对概率电路（PCs）在图像等高维数据上因模型体积大而难以扩展的问题，提出递归参数共享构造 RePA 与适用于无块结构数据的 NoPA，在不假设独立性的前提下大幅降低时间与内存开销，同时保持竞争力的似然。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率电路虽能保证可处理的概率推理，但代价是模型规模远大于其他生成模型。以往为把 PCs 扩展到图像等高位数据，采用参数共享和"在独立图像块上学习"的快速评估协议。作者重新审视这一做法，发现一个反直觉的可学习性问题：假设独立的模型反而能获得更优似然，这构成扩展性的瓶颈。

Method: 提出递归参数共享构造（RePA），在打破独立性假设的同时实现高效参数共享与快速评估；并进一步将其推广到本身不具块结构的数据模态（NoPA），如表格数据。

Result: 实验表明 RePA 能显著减少时间与内存消耗，同时取得有竞争力的似然；在七个表格数据集上，NoPA 也带来类似效率提升，似然与样本质量仅有微小变化。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 递归参数共享可在不依赖独立性假设的情况下有效扩展概率电路，兼顾效率与似然质量，并可推广至非块结构数据模态。

Abstract: Probabilistic circuits (PCs) have emerged as generative models guaranteeing tractable probabilistic inference. However, tractability comes at the price of larger model sizes than in other generative models. As such, to scale PCs to high-dimensional data such as images, previous work has devised several parameter sharing techniques as well as fast evaluation protocols that consider learning PCs on independent image patches. In this work, we revisit this practice to highlight a surprising learnability issue: models that assume independence counterintuitively can yield better likelihoods than models that do not. To break this apparent bottleneck and to scale PCs further, we introduce a recursive parameter sharing construction (RePA) that fosters efficiency without assuming independence. We show empirically that RePA can greatly reduce time and memory consumption while yielding competitive likelihoods. Inspired by these results, we further generalize the approach to data modalities that do not inherently exhibit patch-structure (NoPA), such as tabular data, showing similar efficiency improvements, with marginal changes in likelihoods and sample quality on seven tabular datasets. Code available at https://github.com/april-tools/RePA.

</details>


### [441] [The comparison of density estimation for transfer learning in Banach, Hilbert, Euclidean spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11382)
*Maryam Alsadat Kazemian,Azam Bastanfard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Banach流形迁移学习（BMTL），将特征嵌入测地流形并用L1密度正则，等价于最小化域间Total Variation距离，避免L2对尾部误差的放大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标标签或算力稀缺时域适应（DA）十分必要，但现有域核密度与子空间对齐方法完全假设Hilbert几何，以对称L2散度在欧氏空间或RKHS中度量分布差异；L2平方偏差会放大尾部误差，过度强调不反映真实分布偏移的密度离群点。

Method: BMTL包含两个耦合设计：其一，将特征嵌入测地流形而非视为平坦欧氏空间中的点；其二，密度匹配正则采用L1 Banach范数，依据Scheffe定理，其最小化等价于收缩域密度间的Total Variation（TV）距离——一种对样本空间各区域均匀加权的有界度量。文中还显式比较了欧氏、Hilbert与Banach几何。

Result: 在MNIST-USPS、COIL20和Office+Caltech10上取得一致增益；L1变体在每个任务上均优于结构相同的L2消融，如USPS→MNIST为92.44% vs. 89.80%；在12个Office+Caltech迁移任务上平均超过最强基线DMDA +3.68%。

Conclusion: 非Hilbert几何的域适应是可行且有效的：流形特征嵌入配合L1-TV密度对齐，比传统L2/RKHS方法更稳健，能带来稳定的跨域性能提升。

Abstract: Domain adaptation or DA methods are indispensable when target labels or computational resources are scarce, yet the domain kernel density and subspace alignment approaches completely assume a Hilbertian geometry.
  They measure distributional discrepancy with symmetric L2 divergences over Euclidean feature spaces or reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS). This preprint summarizes the manuscript Non-Hilbertian Domain Adaptation. Total Variation Alignment via L1 Density Regularization on Feature Manifolds, which proposes Banach Manifold Transfer Learning or BMTL. BMTL makes two coupled design decisions. The first one is that features are embedded on a geodesic manifold rather than treated as points of a flat Euclidean space, and the second one is that the density matching regularizer is formulated in an L1 Banach norm, whose minimization is equivalent, by Scheffe's theorem, to contracting the Total Variation or TV distance between domain densities, a bounded metric that weights all regions of the sample space uniformly. The L2 formulation, by contrast, squares deviations and therefore amplifies errors in the tails, over emphasizing density outliers that do not reflect meaningful distributional shift. Experiments on MNIST-USPS, COIL20, and Office+Caltech10 show consistent gains; the L1 variant beats an otherwise identical L2 ablation on every task, for example 92.44% vs. 89.80% on USPS->MNIST and surpasses the strongest baseline DMDA by +3.68% on average over twelve Office+Caltech transfers. This document situates the contribution with an explicit comparison of Euclidean, Hilbert, and Banach geometries.

</details>


### [442] [Learning to Select Sparse Linear Solvers with Convolutional Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12475)
*Artemis Pados,Alan Edelman,Emmanuel Lujan,Daniel Pickard,Felipe Tome,Christopher Rackauckas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究用卷积神经网络（CNN）为稀疏线性系统自动选择求解器：以矩阵非零结构生成的"spy plot"图像为输入，回归候选求解器之间的对数计时比值，在留出的 SuiteSparse 矩阵和实际高性能仿真代码矩阵上均取得较高预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏线性系统求解器的性能会随矩阵稀疏结构的不同而剧烈变化，人工或基于规则的求解器选择难以适应这种结构差异，因此需要一种能自动感知矩阵结构并预测求解器优劣的方法。

Method: 将矩阵非零元结构可视化为 spy plot 图像作为 CNN 输入，训练网络回归候选求解器之间运行时间的对数比值（log timing ratio），从而为给定矩阵预测更优求解器。

Result: 在留出的 SuiteSparse 矩阵以及来自高性能仿真代码的真实矩阵上，模型均取得了较强的求解器选择预测精度。

Conclusion: CNN 能有效从矩阵稀疏结构的图像表示中学习求解器性能差异，实现稀疏线性系统的自动求解器选择，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: We investigate convolutional-neural-network (CNN) based automatic solver selection for sparse linear systems, a problem of practical importance where solver performance varies dramatically with matrix sparsity structure. A CNN is trained to regress log timing ratios between candidate solvers using spy plot images of matrix nonzero structure as input, achieving strong prediction accuracy on both held-out SuiteSparse matrices and real-world matrices from high-performance simulation codes.

</details>


### [443] [Out-of-the-Box Tabular Foundation Models for Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12491)
*Klemens Flöge,Simon Bing,Leo Grinsztajn,Eliott Kalfon,Lennart Purucker,Noah Hollmann,Frank Hutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文评估TabPFN和TabICL两种表格基础模型作为材料科学主动学习中的即用型代理模型，在两项标准基准上与传统高斯过程、随机森林和CatBoost等基线比较，发现TFM无需特定核函数或超参数调优即可具备高度竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化广泛用于材料科学的主动学习循环，高斯过程是事实上的代理模型，但需要依赖任务的核函数选择，且对复杂关系的建模能力有限。近期表格基础模型（TFMs）在结构化数据预测任务上表现领先，且无需定制核函数或超参数调优，因此值得评估其在材料科学主动学习中的代理模型潜力。

Method: 选取TabPFN与TabICL两种表格基础模型作为即用型（out-of-the-box）代理模型，在两项标准材料科学基准上评估，并与涵盖高斯过程、随机森林和CatBoost的大量基线方法进行比较；TFM不针对主动学习任务进行专门训练，也不进行GP核选择。

Result: TFMs在两项基准上均表现出高度竞争力，且无需任务特定的主动学习训练或GP核选择，即可与大量基线方法相当或更优。

Conclusion: 结果表明TFMs可作为材料发现中主动学习的有效代理模型，值得进一步发展。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization is widely used in active learning loops for materials science. Gaussian processes serve as the de-facto surrogate model family, but require task-dependent kernel choices and can lack the modeling capacity for complex relationships. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have recently emerged as the state-of-the-art for predictive tasks on structured data, without requiring bespoke kernels or hyperparameter tuning. We evaluate two TFMs, TabPFN and TabICL, as out-of-the-box surrogate models on two standard materials science benchmarks, comparing against a large field of baselines encompassing Gaussian processes, random forests, and CatBoost. Our findings indicate that TFMs are highly competitive surrogate models across the two benchmarks, without task-specific training for active learning or GP kernel selection. Our results motivate developing TFMs further as surrogates for active learning in materials discovery.

</details>


### [444] [Constrained Look-ahead Guidance for Interference-Aware Flow Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10751)
*Doudou Zhang,Qi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无需反演的流模型图像编辑框架，用单步前瞻机制在编辑与保真奖励间取得更优平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流模型生成能力强，但受控编辑困难：在生成轨迹上需同时兼顾源图像保真度与编辑服从度。现有方法多依赖反演或启发式引导，容易导致二者失衡。

Method: 从轨迹中心的视角出发，构建无需反演的原则性框架。引入单步前瞻机制：通过去噪估计候选更新对"编辑奖励"和"保真奖励"的影响，并据此调整当前更新；每一步在显式保真约束下施加奖励驱动修正，使轨迹演化稳定连贯。前瞻设计可预判两种目标在未来状态下的交互，从而缓解编辑与保真目标间的梯度干扰。

Result: 实验表明，相较现有强基线，该方法实现更强的语义编辑效果，同时更好地保留源图像内容。

Conclusion: 以轨迹为中心、无需反演的前瞻式奖励修正框架，为流/扩散模型的可控图像编辑提供了一种兼顾保真与编辑质量的有效方案。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow models enable powerful generative modeling, but controlled editing remains challenging due to the need to balance source fidelity and edit compliance along the generative trajectory. We propose a principled, inversion-free framework for flow-based image editing from a trajectory centric perspective. Rather than relying on inversion or heuristic guidance, we introduce a one-step look-ahead mechanism that evaluates the effect of candidate updates on both edit and fidelity rewards estimated via denoising, and adjusts the current update based on this evaluation. At each step, our method applies reward-driven corrections guided by the look-ahead evaluation under an explicit fidelity constraint, resulting in stable and coherent trajectory evolution. This look-ahead design mitigates gradient interference between edit and fidelity objectives by anticipating their interaction in future states, leading to improved trade-offs. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves stronger semantic edits while better preserving source content compared to existing strong baselines.

</details>


### [445] [UniHam: A Large-Scale SOC-Complete Dataset and Benchmark for Hamiltonian Learning in Materials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12509)
*Yuewen Huang,Pin Chen,Yutong Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UniHam：构建含完整自旋-轨道耦合、10万+ DFT 复数厄米哈密顿量、覆盖72种元素的大规模数据集与基准，并从重构精度、OOD泛化和下游性质预测三方面评估模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DFT计算成本高，预测电子哈密顿量可实现广泛性质推断；但现有哈密顿量数据集规模小、结构多样性不足，且常缺失自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）等关键相对论物理，制约通用材料基础模型发展。

Method: 构建UniHam大规模哈密顿量数据集与基准套件，包含10万+ DFT计算的复数厄米哈密顿量，具备完整SOC，覆盖72种元素及多样晶格类型与空间群；在标准化协议下评测两个代表性先进模型，并提出联合评估三维度的互补指标：哈密顿量重构精度、组分/对称性偏移下的OOD泛化、以及由预测哈密顿量支持下游性质预测的能力。

Result: 实验表明该基准与指标能有效区分模型能力，揭示与SOC及元素相关的内在失效模式、组分OOD鲁棒性的显著差异，并证明谱级评估对于判断哈密顿量预测能否可靠支持下游电子结构性质是必要的。

Conclusion: UniHam提供了可复现、SOC完整的基准，有助于更精细地比较模型并加速量子材料下一代基础模型的发展。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of electronic Hamiltonians would enable broad property inference while avoiding the high computational cost of Density Functional Theory (DFT).
