However, progress toward general-purpose materials foundation models is limited by a data bottleneck: existing Hamiltonian datasets are typically small, lack structural diversity, and often omit essential relativistic physics such as spin--orbit coupling (SOC). We therefore construct UniHam, a large-scale Hamiltonian dataset and benchmark suite comprising 100,000+ DFT-computed complex-valued Hermitian Hamiltonians with full SOC, covering 72 elements and a wide range of crystal geometries and symmetries (spanning diverse lattice types and space-group families). Building on UniHam, we benchmark two representative state-of-the-art models under a standardized protocol and introduce complementary evaluation metrics that jointly assess three dimensions: (i) Hamiltonian reconstruction accuracy, (ii) out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization across composition/symmetry shifts, and (iii) the ability to support downstream property prediction from the predicted Hamiltonians. Experiments on UniHam demonstrate that the proposed benchmark and metrics effectively differentiate model capabilities, revealing intrinsic SOC- and element-dependent failure modes, large variations in compositional OOD robustness, and the necessity of spectral-level evaluation to assess whether Hamiltonian predictions reliably support downstream electronic-structure properties. Overall, UniHam provides a reproducible, SOC-complete benchmark that can sharpen model comparisons and accelerate the development of next-generation foundation models for quantum materials.

</details>


### [446] [How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11450)
*Cong Yu,Ziting Wang,Songlin Jiang,Sitong Zhang,Chengliang Chai,Youhe Jiang,Eiko Yoneki,Tuo Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究 on-policy distillation（OPD）对训练-推理不匹配（mismatch）的容忍度、误差来源及系统化利用方式，并提出准入检查与 FP8 配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD 需要在学生模型自生成响应上进行训练，而生成成本高昂，因此系统普遍采用量化推理与异步 rollout 降本；这二者都会引入 rollout 引擎与训练模型之间的训练-推理不匹配。此类不匹配会破坏 RL 稳定性，但其对 OPD 的影响尚不清楚，本文旨在厘清 OPD 的容忍边界及其可利用性。

Method: 将各类不匹配源统一到同一尺度上度量：在三组学生-教师模型对上考察量化影响，并在其中一对上补充权重陈旧（staleness）与注入噪声实验；同时与 RL 方法进行受控对比；据此提出轻量级的 rollout 配置准入检查（admission check），基于标定预算筛选候选配置而无需完整训练。

Result: OPD 可容忍显著不匹配而几乎不损失训练质量，但在更高程度下会退化，呈现经验性“不匹配预算”；质量代价与量化引入的不匹配均依赖模型，部分层对降精度尤为敏感。受控对比中 OPD 在会破坏 RL 的 rollout 配置下仍保持稳定。权重噪声还会改变生成所到达的前缀，产生逐 token 校正无法修复的误差。实践中，模型特定 FP8 配方在保持训练质量的同时可支持至少 1.93× 于 BF16 的 KV-cache token 容量；FP8 配异步 rollout 比同步 BF16 提前 1.62× 达到同等训练质量。

Conclusion: OPD 对训练-推理不匹配具有较大且可度量的容忍度，且该容忍度可被系统化利用：通过准入检查筛选配置，并结合模型特定 FP8 量化与异步 rollout，可在不损失训练质量的前提下显著提升吞吐与训练效率。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model on its own responses, guided by a fixed teacher. Generating these responses is expensive, so systems use quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts to reduce the cost. Both, however, introduce training-inference mismatch between the rollout engine and the model being trained. Such mismatch can destabilize reinforcement learning (RL), but its effects on OPD remain unclear. This paper investigates how much mismatch OPD tolerates, where its effects arise, and how training systems can use this tolerance. Measuring all mismatch sources on one scale, we examine quantization across three student-teacher pairs, with additional tests of weight staleness and injected noise on one pair. OPD tolerates substantial mismatch without meaningful loss of training quality but degrades at higher levels, revealing an empirical mismatch budget. Both the quality cost of mismatch and the mismatch introduced by quantization depend on the model, with some layers particularly sensitive to reduced precision. In controlled comparisons, OPD remains stable under rollout configurations that destabilize RL methods. Under weight noise, mismatch also shifts the prefixes reached during generation, introducing errors that per-token corrections cannot address. To put these findings into practice, we introduce a lightweight admission check that screens rollout configurations against a calibrated budget without requiring a full training run for each candidate. Model-specific FP8 recipes preserve training quality while providing capacity for at least $1.93\times$ as many KV-cache tokens as BF16. Combining FP8 with asynchronous rollouts reaches the same training quality $1.62\times$ sooner than synchronous BF16 training. Code is available at https://github.com/benyucong/train-inference-mismatch-opd

</details>


### [447] [Can the Confidence and Decisions of System 1 Models Be Trusted? An Explainability and Perturbation Audit of Jev-Style Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12521)
*Julien Delaunay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个开放、确定性的审计基准，系统评估"System 1"决策模型（单次前向传播输出类型化概率分布）的校准、跨问题干扰与事后归因忠实性，并与System 2生成式基线对比，得出五项关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: System 1决策模型已用于低延迟路由与自动分诊，但其统计校准性和事后可解释性尚未被系统刻画，缺乏公开、可复现的评测手段。

Method: 构建开放确定性审计基准，在保标签扰动下的校准、跨问题干扰、事后归因忠实性三方面评估；测试五个开源权重模型（0.8B–27B）与System 2基线（单token logprob打分、结构化JSON/CoT解码）；覆盖e-SNLI、HANS、合成临床分诊(N=900)、提示注入防御(Tensor Trust,N=250)及86例逻辑门触发套件；并引入S1-SHAP（logit链接的KernelSHAP）。

Result: (1) 模型置信度实为闭式离散度变换(1-H(p)/ln K或归一化margin)而非经验准确率；(2) 单请求打包多问题引发方向性跨问题干扰(0.8B模型11.7%–22.4%二元翻转，4B仅0.1%–0.2%)；(3) ≥4B的System 1模型在句法扰动下更快且校准更优(ECE_w=0.030–0.087，优于logprob 0.144与JSON 0.378)；(4) 提示注入防御(N=250)中≥4B模型AUROC达0.988–0.998、召回最高95.2%、零误报、耗时48–60ms；(5) 单次推理使512联盟XAI交互化(1.3–3.2s/输入)，S1-SHAP缓解softmax饱和(OR门恢复89.3%–100.0% vs 概率空间57.1%–82.1%，p_adj=0.004)。

Conclusion: System 1决策模型在≥4B规模下具备更优的校准性、抗干扰能力、高效提示注入防御与可交互的事后归因，但其"置信度"是离散度的闭式函数而非准确率估计，需谨慎解读；S1-SHAP可有效改善解释忠实性。

Abstract: "System 1" decision models (pioneered by TypeSafe AI's Jev) replace autoregressive text generation with a single forward pass returning typed probability distributions over declared schemas (Choice, Score, Noul). While deployed for low-latency routing and automated triage, their statistical calibration and post-hoc explainability remain uncharacterized. We introduce an open, deterministic audit benchmark evaluating System 1 decision models across calibration under label-preserving perturbations, cross-question interference, and post-hoc attribution faithfulness. Evaluating five open-weight models (0.8B to 27B) alongside generative System 2 baselines -- both single-token logprob scoring and structured JSON/CoT decoding -- across NLI (e-SNLI), adversarial syntactic shortcuts (HANS), synthetic clinical triage (N=900), prompt injection defense (Tensor Trust, N=250), and an 86-case logic-gate trigger suite yields five findings: (1) provider confidence is an exact closed-form dispersion transform (1 - H(p)/ln K on sub-10B models; normalized margin on Clef-27B) rather than empirical accuracy; (2) bundling multiple questions in one request induces directional cross-question interference (11.7% to 22.4% binary flips on Tev1-0.8B, vs. 0.1% to 0.2% on Tev1-4B); (3) System 1 models with >= 4B parameters are faster and better calibrated under syntactic shifts (ECE_w = 0.030 to 0.087) than logprob (0.144) and JSON (0.378) baselines; (4) for prompt-injection defense (N=250), >= 4B models achieve 0.988 to 0.998 AUROC with up to 95.2% recall and 0.0% false alarms at 48 to 60 ms; and (5) single-pass inference makes 512-coalition XAI interactive (1.3 to 3.2 s/input), while KernelSHAP with a logit link (S1-SHAP) mitigates softmax saturation on disjunctive OR gates (89.3% to 100.0% gate recovery vs. 57.1% to 82.1% in prob space; p_adj = 0.004).

</details>


### [448] [MOMENT-DP: Momentum Aware Evaluation of Correlated Noise for Differentially Private Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11457)
*Sunny Gupta,Raja Viswanadha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MOMENT-DP 框架，刻画时序相关隐私噪声在动量优化中的传播，并发现优化器状态（尤其动量）会改变不同隐私噪声机制的效用排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序相关噪声可显著提升差分隐私优化的效用，但现有机制设计与评估通常只利用工作负载结构、学习率调度或局部曲率等部分信息，忽略了持续存在的优化器状态是否提供额外且决策相关的信息。

Method: 提出 MOMENT-DP，将隐私噪声引起的最终损失表示为优化器转移算子，统一建模曲率、学习率调度、动量和时序噪声协方差；在局部二次目标上给出精确表达，并证明 NoiseCurve 的曲率感知二次准则为零动量、恒定学习率下的特例；进一步在逐样本裁剪的私有逻辑回归中检验结论。

Result: 在固定曲率、调度、隐私校准和候选机制、仅改变动量时，会出现真实的机制排序反转；该效应在精确二次动力学之外的私有逻辑回归中仍存在，但在所研究的神经网络情形中尚未得到明确结论。

Conclusion: 优化器状态是评估时序相关隐私噪声时一个建模不足但具有决策相关性的维度；MOMENT-DP 为联合考虑噪声协方差与优化器动力学提供了分析框架。

Abstract: Temporally correlated noise can substantially improve the utility of differentially private optimization, yet candidate mechanisms are commonly designed or evaluated using only partial information about the optimization process, such as workload structure, learning-rate schedules, or local curvature. We study whether persistent optimizer state provides additional information that can change the relative utility of privacy-valid correlated-noise mechanisms.
  We introduce MOMENT-DP, an optimizer-state-aware framework that models how temporally correlated privacy noise propagates through momentum-based optimization. For locally quadratic objectives, MOMENT-DP expresses privacy-induced final loss through an optimizer transfer operator that jointly captures curvature, learning-rate scheduling, momentum, and temporal noise covariance. NoiseCurve's curvature-aware quadratic criterion is recovered exactly as the zero-momentum, constant-learning-rate special case.
  Changing only momentum while holding curvature, schedule, privacy calibration, and candidate mechanisms fixed induces genuine mechanism-ranking reversals. The effect persists outside exact quadratic dynamics in per-example-clipped private logistic regression, while remaining unresolved in the neural regime we study. These results establish optimizer state as an under-modeled, decision-relevant axis in evaluating temporally correlated privacy noise.

</details>


### [449] [K-prop: Deep Online Learning by Backpropagating Temporal Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12530)
*Bingkun Liu,Paul Haider,Federico Benitez,Mihai A. Petrovici,Walter Senn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出K-prop：一种面向漏积（leaky）神经网络的在线学习算法，通过传播"核增益"（kernel gains）大幅降低实时循环学习（RTRL）的计算与内存开销，性能优于现有RTRL近似方法，在序列学习、分类与强化学习任务上可与BPTT媲美。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自循环/递归是人工与生物神经网络进行时间处理的核心机制，通常以漏积分（leaky integration）形式自然出现。但由于梯度涉及复杂的时序依赖关系，目前仍缺乏高效且有效的在线训练方法：BPTT需要完整序列、无法在线；RTRL虽可在线但计算与内存代价过高。

Method: 提出K-prop在线学习算法，针对漏型神经网络，以"核增益传播"（propagating kernel gains）替代RTRL中对完整时序雅可比矩阵的显式维护与递推，从而在保持在线更新能力的同时显著削减计算与内存复杂度；此外对算法所引入的唯一近似进行理论分析，考察其对梯度质量的影响，并推导其保持精确、有效工作的条件。

Result: 1）相比RTRL，计算与内存开销大幅降低；2）在序列学习、分类和强化学习任务上优于现有RTRL近似方法，性能与BPTT相当；3）明确了单一近似对梯度质量的作用机制，并给出K-prop保持准确有效的适用条件。

Conclusion: K-prop为漏型循环神经网络提供了一种可行的高效在线学习方案，在效果上接近BPTT而成本远低于RTRL，并通过对近似误差的理论刻画界定了其适用范围，为在线时序学习提供了实用且有理论支撑的新路径。

Abstract: Self-recurrence represents an important component for temporal processing in neural networks, both artificial and biological, where it appears naturally in the form of leaky integration. However, due to the complex temporal dependencies of the gradient, an efficient and effective method of online training is still lacking. Here we propose K-prop, a novel online learning method for leaky neural networks. It dramatically reduces the computational and memory cost of real time recurrent learning (RTRL) by propagating kernel gains. K-prop also outperforms existing RTRL approximations and achieves performance comparable to backpropagation through time in sequence learning, classification, and reinforcement learning tasks. We further analyze how its sole approximation affects gradient quality and identify conditions under which K-prop remains accurate and effective.

</details>


### [450] [JoMoHa: Joint Model--Harness Optimization with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11499)
*Xudong Wu,Guangchen Lan,Mingqi Yuan,Jiayu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 JoMoHa 框架，通过强化学习联合训练"可执行 harness 生成策略"与"任务执行策略"，实现模型与 harness 的协同进化与递归自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言智能体的性能同时取决于模型权重与 harness（运行框架），单独优化任一方都会受另一方制约，整体收益有限；作者对朴素交替训练的分析发现模型与 harness 会逐渐不兼容，干扰任务执行并可能损害模型训练，导致性能下降。

Method: JoMoHa 用强化学习同时训练两个策略：一个生成可执行 harness 的生成策略，一个任务执行策略；两者从自身生成的轨迹中同时学习任务执行与运行时改进，形成递归式自我提升（RSI）。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、DBBench 上取得所评估方法中最高的成功率，平均 70.3%，ALFWorld 上达 97.0%，优于仅优化权重与仅优化 harness 的基线。

Conclusion: 模型权重与 harness 需协同演化而非交替优化；联合强化学习可使智能体在任务执行与运行时改进上互相促进，实现持续的递归自我改进并带来显著性能提升。

Abstract: The performance of language agents depends jointly on model weights and the harness. Optimizing either alone can be constrained by the other component, limiting overall performance gains. Our analysis of naive alternating training reveals progressive incompatibility between the model and harness, which increasingly interferes with task execution and may also undermine model training, leading to performance degradation. To coordinate the evolution of models and harnesses, we introduce JoMoHa, to our knowledge the first framework to jointly train an executable harness generation policy and a task execution policy through reinforcement learning. JoMoHa outperforms the evaluated weight-only and harness-only baselines and achieves the highest success rates among the evaluated methods on ALFWorld, WebShop, and DBBench, averaging 70.3% and reaching 97.0% on ALFWorld. By learning both task execution and runtime improvement from its own generated trajectories, JoMoHa performs recursive self-improvement (RSI).

</details>


### [451] [LawKAN: Group-Law Layers for Composition -- When Imposing a Known Law Pays Off](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12567)
*Anna Mishchenko,Nikolai Gavrilin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作提出一种“把已知变换结构写进网络节点、只学习残差”的复合层：节点内嵌精确非交换群运算，边学习局部增量，零初始化校正项ψ学习硬件导致的定律偏差，并给出可精确表示性的预训练判据。在SU(2)固定角复合、真实机械臂标定与多厂商/多协议迁移上验证了精度与参数效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多任务本质上按已知规则复合变换（如机器人、导航中的链式旋转）。纯学习模型会重复学习该规则并累积误差；经典估计器则把规则硬编码，无法吸收硬件偏差。因此作者希望将已知结构作为归纳偏置固定下来，仅学习未知部分。

Method: 提出自包含复合层：节点中使用精确的非交换群律，边学习局部增量，并以零初始化的校正项ψ建模群律的未知偏差；同时给出预训练判据，用于预测目标函数是否可被精确表示。整体是“结构固定+残差学习”的参数高效设计。

Result: 在固定角SU(2)复合任务上，54参数稠密边模型为最准确的稠密模型，参数量比最强固定矩阵基线少27倍，精度距Bayes下界仅0.05°。真实机械臂上，孤立306参数ψ在N≥60时达到1.12–1.14 mm，优于Gauss-Newton的1.29–1.33 mm；方法在三个厂商、两种协议间可迁移。

Conclusion: 当数据确实服从所施加的群律时，该配方可匹配经典拟合；当任务规律与 imposed law 不一致时，其表现会下降。说明该方法的优势来自正确的结构归纳偏置，而非通用地替代经典方法。

Abstract: Many tasks compose transformations by a known rule: chained rotations in robotics and navigation. Learned models relearn it, compounding error; classical estimators hardcode it and miss hardware deviations. We impose the known structure and learn only the remainder: an exact non-commutative group law sits in the node of a self-contained layer, its edges learn local increments, and a zero-initialized correction psi learns unknown deviations of the law. A pre-training criterion predicts exact representability. On fixed-angle SU(2) composition, a 54-parameter dense edge is the most accurate dense model, at 27x fewer parameters than the strongest fixed-matrix baseline, and lies 0.05 deg above the Bayes floor. On real robot arms, an isolated 306-parameter psi reaches 1.12-1.14 mm versus 1.29-1.33 mm for Gauss-Newton at N >= 60, and the recipe transfers across three vendors and two protocols. The recipe matches classical fits where the data obey the law and loses where the imposed law is not the task's.

</details>


### [452] [Full Fine-Tuning is not the Problem: Why Adam Fails and SGD Succeeds in Few-Shot CLIP Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11152)
*Nairouz Mrabah,Ismail Ben Ayed,Eric Granger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示少样本CLIP适配中"全量微调易过拟合"的常见结论混淆了参数化与优化：在11个数据集、3种CLIP骨干、5种shot设置下，朴素SGD驱动的稠密全量微调反而优于代表性PEFT方法，而Adam/AdamW崩溃，根源在于少样本预条件不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者质疑主流认知——"全量微调会过拟合，故应采用参数高效微调（PEFT）"。作者认为该结论把参数化（全量 vs 参数高效）与优化（优化器选择）混为一谈，需要澄清少样本CLIP适配失败的真正来源。

Method: 系统对比实验：11个数据集、3种CLIP骨干、5种shot水平，比较稠密全量微调（SGD）与代表性PEFT方法及Adam/AdamW。进一步通过诊断归因（首步更新预算匹配、分子侧对齐检验）、与Shampoo/SOAP对比，并结合理论分析（少样本估计误差如何被放大为不安全更新）及插值探针与曲率探针分析损失地形。

Result: SGD全量微调在报告评估协议下优于PEFT，Adam/AdamW崩溃。崩溃源于少样本第二矩在初始化时就系统性低估全数据统计量，Adam的逆平方根归一化将误差放大为过大的自适应更新；将Adam首步更新预算对齐SGD可解决大部分崩溃，而分子侧对齐无效；Shampoo与SOAP同样失败，说明单纯更强预条件无法解决。插值探针显示低损失连接，曲率探针显示方向曲率良好。

Conclusion: 少样本CLIP适配的主要失败来源是优化器诱导的预条件（unreliable preconditioning），而非稠密全量微调本身；SGD因规避不可靠预条件器并保持贴近预训练CLIP而成功。

Abstract: Few-shot CLIP adaptation is often treated as a parameterization problem. Full fine-tuning is assumed to overfit, so parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are preferred. In this paper, we show that this conclusion conflates parameterization with optimization. Across 11 datasets, 3 CLIP backbones, and 5 shot levels, dense full fine-tuning with plain SGD outperforms representative PEFT methods under the reported evaluation protocol, whereas Adam/AdamW collapses. We trace this collapse to unreliable support-set preconditioning. The few-shot second moment systematically underestimates the corresponding full-data statistic, already at initialization. Adam's inverse-square-root normalization converts this error into an oversized adaptive update. Matching Adam's first-step update budget to SGD resolves most of the collapse, whereas numerator-side alignment does not explain the failure. Shampoo and SOAP also fail, so richer preconditioning alone does not resolve the problem. Theory formalizes how few-shot estimation error is amplified into unsafe updates. SGD succeeds because it avoids unreliable preconditioners and stays close to pretrained CLIP. Interpolation probes show low-loss connections along tested directions, and curvature probes show favorable directional curvature. These results identify optimizer-induced preconditioning, not dense full fine-tuning itself, as the main source of failure in few-shot CLIP adaptation.

</details>


### [453] [From Likelihood Convergence to Parameter Convergence in POMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12575)
*Jack Zhang,Saurabh Amin,Jiawei Zhang,Patrick Jaillet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文给出POMDP参数恢复误差的通用上界：误差由候选参数与真实模型的似然差、观测/转移核的结构性条件数以及行为策略共同控制，适用于欠完备与过完备情形，并可直接推出最大似然估计的有限样本保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于似然的POMDP学习方法虽常用，但现有有限样本保证多集中于策略次优性，参数恢复（parameter recovery）的有限样本理论仍不清晰；同时无限时域POMDP的近似最优学习往往依赖准确的转移与观测核估计，需要更明确的参数学习保证。

Method: 对任意候选POMDP参数，建立其参数恢复误差与似然间隙（likelihood gap）之间的定量关系，并引入观测核、转移核的结构性条件（conditioning）以及数据采集所用行为策略的影响；先分析欠完备（undercomplete）情形，过完备（overcomplete）情形由其自然推广得到。

Result: 得到同时覆盖欠完备与过完备情形的误差上界；由于结论对任何“似然间隙受控”的候选参数均成立，可直接给出最大似然估计及同类估计流程的有限样本保证；上界将行为策略与模型结构的贡献分离，可刻画动作覆盖等数据采集选择及其对混合性的影响如何加速参数学习。

Conclusion: 该工作为POMDP参数恢复提供了统一的有限样本分析框架，把策略次优性保证与参数估计保证联系起来，并为无限时域POMDP中基于模型规划、依赖准确核估计的近似最优学习提供理论支撑；同时揭示数据采集策略设计对参数学习效率的作用。

Abstract: Likelihood-based methods are widely used to learn the parameters of partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). While finite-sample guarantees for policy suboptimality exist for certain POMDP subclasses, analogous guarantees for parameter recovery remain less well understood. For any candidate POMDP parameter, we bound its parameter recovery error in terms of its likelihood gap to the ground truth, the structural conditioning of the observation and transition kernels, and the behavior policy used to collect data. The bound applies in both the undercomplete and overcomplete regimes, with the latter following naturally from the undercomplete analysis. Because the result applies to any sufficiently good candidate, it yields finite-sample guarantees for the maximum-likelihood estimator and any procedure producing a parameter with controlled likelihood gap. This is particularly useful for near-optimal learning in infinite-horizon POMDPs, where existing approaches largely rely on model-based planning with accurate transition and observation kernel estimates. The bound separates the contributions of the behavior policy and model, showing how data-collection choices, including action coverage, and their effects on mixing can accelerate parameter learning.

</details>


### [454] [TRACE: Adaptive Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization for Open-Ended Molecular Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12591)
*Madhav R. Muthyala,Mahsa Askari,Farshud Sorourifar,Evan Zhou,Joe Gauthier,Joel A. Paulson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TRACE 是一个开放式分子贝叶斯优化框架：用目标无关的图扰动按需生成候选，配合固定化学感知 GP 代理（fragprints），并以 Tanimoto 阈值与候选基数预算显式控制化学探索范围，用成功/失败控制器自适应调节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小评估预算下的分子优化必须同时回答两个问题：在化学空间何处搜索，以及在该区域内评估哪个候选。开放式（而非固定库）设置下候选需按需生成，若让模型自身学习"搜索几何"则不稳定且成本高，因此需要一种把探索尺度显式化、并对代理模型保持固定的方案。

Method: TRACE 由三部分组成：(1) 目标无关的图扰动机制按需生成候选分子；(2) 固定的化学感知高斯过程代理，使用 fragprints（分子指纹 + 片段描述符的组合表示）；(3) 显式的探索尺度控制——Tanimoto 相似度阈值限定化学探索幅度、基数预算限定候选搜索广度，由简单的成功/失败控制器在优化过程中扩张或收缩二者，而 GP 与采集函数只负责在可行分子中挑选待评估者。另在 FePc 案例中使用面向精确能量评估的第一性原理 DFT 工作流。

Result: 在六个高难度分子优化基准、统一 1000 次评估预算下，以随评估累积所得最佳分子衡量，TRACE 取得整体最强的样本效率。两个目标上的交叉消融表明自适应区域控制超出提案机制的贡献，但其收益依赖提案分布。应用于非贵金属分子电催化剂 FePc 的稳定性时，在 80 次设计评估内将计算得到的热力学抗 Fe 溶出能力由 0.42 eV 提升至 2.59 eV。

Conclusion: 把化学探索的几何尺度外置为可控阈值与预算、同时保持代理模型固定，是一种简单而有效的小预算开放式分子优化策略；该方法不仅在多基准上样本效率领先，也能在真实 DFT 计算闭环中显著改善催化剂的抗溶出稳定性。

Abstract: Optimizing molecules under small evaluation budgets requires deciding both where in chemical space to search and which candidate within that region to evaluate. We introduce Trust Region Adaptive Chemical Exploration (TRACE), a framework for open-ended molecular Bayesian optimization (BO), where candidates are generated on demand rather than selected from a fixed library. TRACE combines an objective-free graph-perturbation mechanism with a fixed, chemistry-aware Gaussian process (GP) surrogate using fragprints, a representation combining molecular fingerprints and fragment descriptors. Rather than learning the search geometry itself, TRACE makes the scale of chemical exploration explicit through a Tanimoto-similarity threshold controlling chemical extent and a cardinality budget controlling candidate-search breadth. A simple success/failure controller expands or contracts both quantities during optimization, while the GP and acquisition function select which admissible molecules to evaluate. Across six challenging molecular optimization benchmarks under matched 1,000-evaluation budgets, TRACE achieves the strongest overall sample efficiency as measured by the best molecule found as evaluations accumulate. Crossed ablations on two objectives further show that adaptive region control contributes beyond the proposal mechanism, while its benefit depends on the proposal distribution. We further apply TRACE to the stability of iron phthalocyanine (FePc), a non-precious molecular electrocatalyst whose degradation can involve loss of the Fe center. Using a first-principles density functional theory (DFT) workflow designed for accurate energy evaluation, TRACE increases the computed thermodynamic resistance to Fe dissolution from 0.42 to 2.59 eV over 80 designed evaluations.

</details>


### [455] [Detecting Common Golfing Faults Using AI and Video-Derived Biomechanical Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11515)
*Oliver Martin,Jeff Clark,Nawid Keshtmand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一套仅用普通视频、无需标记与标定的高尔夫挥杆动作缺陷检测流程：以身体为中心的坐标系追踪人体姿态与杆头，提取教练常用的生物力学量并用浅层提升树分类，可检测"过顶下杆"与"提前伸展"两类缺陷，且能追溯到具体信号与挥杆阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技术动作的优劣同时影响运动表现与安全，但实验室之外的动技术评估仍主要依靠人眼观察，主观性强、难以量化；而端到端深度学习虽可行，却缺乏可解释性，难以让教练信任或复核判断依据。

Method: 不做端到端学习。先在身体中心坐标系下用姿态估计追踪人体关节与杆头轨迹，在此基础上计算教练常测的生物力学量（如杆头相对挥杆平面的高度），并在下杆的特定已知阶段取值，再用浅层提升树（boosted trees）进行分类，从而判别"过顶下杆（OTT）"与"提前伸展（EE）"两类缺陷。

Result: 在来自公开来源的160个（OTT）与143个（EE）挥杆样本上，交叉验证ROC-AUC分别为0.975和0.911；模型最重要的输入信号与教练诊断这两类缺陷时所检查的信号一致；整个流程在消费级笔记本上只需数秒即可处理手机视频。

Conclusion: 由于每个特征都是有明确生物力学含义、且在已知挥杆阶段测得的量，模型的每次判定都可追溯到驱动它的信号与时刻，具备可解释性；该流程成本低、速度快，有望发展为面向各水平球手的技术诊断应用，并可推广到其他以生物力学基准评判技术的运动项目。

Abstract: Understanding how an athlete moves can improve both technique and safety, yet outside the laboratory technique is still assessed by eye. We present a pipeline that detects named golf swing faults from ordinary video, without markers or calibration. Instead of learning end to end, it tracks body pose and the clubhead in a body-centered frame, and classifies the biomechanical quantities a coach would measure, such as the height of the clubhead above the swing plane, with shallow boosted trees. We demonstrate the approach on two common faults, coming over-the-top (OTT) and early-extension (EE). On 160 swings and 143 swings from public sources it detects OTT and EE with a cross-validated ROC-AUC of 0.975 and 0.911 respectively. Because every feature is a biomechanical quantity a coach already uses, measured at a known phase of the downswing, each decision can be traced to the signals and the moments of the swing that drove it. The signals the model relies on most are the same ones a coach checks when diagnosing these faults. The pipeline processes phone video on a consumer laptop in seconds, so it could feasibly be developed into an app for golfers of all abilities and extended to other sports in which technique is judged against a biomechanical reference.

</details>


### [456] [Hydra: Towards Transferable Multi-Task Learning on Temporal Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11520)
*Kiarash Shamsi,Farimah Poursafaei,Tran Gia Bao Ngo,Reihaneh Rabbany,Baris Coskunuzer,Guillaume Rabusseau,Michael M. Bronstein,Shenyang Huang,Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Hydra架构，融合时序GNN的局部连接特征与谱学习模块的全局连接模式，在多任务目标下联合学习，实现时序图上的多任务可迁移预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的演化网络可建模为时序图（TG），其时间动态对预测未来图属性至关重要。然而现有方法主要面向单任务预测，跨任务泛化与迁移到未见网络的能力尚不清楚，时序图上的多任务图属性预测仍是开放难题。

Method: Hydra集成两部分：来自时序GNN的局部连通性特征，以及捕捉全局连通模式的谱学习模块；通过多任务目标联合学习局部与全局信息。

Result: 多任务分类中AUC相对最强竞争者提升8.9%；多任务回归中三项任务均具竞争力，其中两项最优，MAE相对最强基线改善8.2%；训练时间较时序迁移模型减少22%。

Conclusion: 首次系统性地证明时序图上的多任务可迁移学习有效；Hydra的稳定排名表现表明，时序图多任务训练是迈向可适应时序图基础模型的有前景方向。

Abstract: Real-world evolving networks are naturally modeled as temporal graphs (TGs), where capturing temporal dynamics is essential for predicting future graph properties that support downstream decision-making. Existing temporal graph methods have been developed primarily for single-task prediction, and little is known about their generalization across tasks or transfer to unseen networks. This leaves the challenge of multi-task graph property prediction in TGs largely open. We address this challenge by introducing Hydra, a novel architecture that integrates local connectivity features from temporal GNNs with a spectral learning module that captures global connectivity patterns. This design enables joint learning of local and global information under a multi-task objective. In multi-task classification, Hydra achieves an 8.9% relative gain in AUC over the strongest competitor. In multi-task regression, Hydra achieves competitive results in all three tasks, while obtaining the best results in two tasks with a 8.2% relative gain in MAE compared to the strongest baseline. Moreover, Hydra delivers these gains with a 22% reduction in training time compared to temporal transfer models. These results provide the first systematic evidence that multi-task transferable learning on temporal graphs is effective. By delivering consistent top-ranked performance, Hydra highlights multi-task training on temporal graphs as a promising direction toward adaptable foundation models for temporal graphs.

</details>


### [457] [Certify, Report, or Refuse: Harm-Constrained Conformal Prediction for Clinical Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12662)
*Zhiyuan Li,Lequan Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种免训练、带危害惩罚的风险最优保形预测框架 HC-ROCP，用于将分类器概率转化为更安全的预测集与行动策略，并在多个医学影像任务上验证其能显著降低严重行动错误、对部分声明予以认证、对不支持声明予以拒绝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠诊断覆盖率不足以排除严重行动错误，例如将黑色素瘤病例错误路由至常规随访。因此需要在预测集与行动选择中显式约束危害，并提供可认证、可拒绝、可回退的决策输出。

Method: HC-ROCP 是一个免训练框架：使用冻结分类器的概率输出，在选择预测集和行动时加入危害惩罚；在不相交的校准划分上评估策略，并进行多重性调整；同时认证有支持的声明、给出描述性回退策略，并拒绝不支持的亚组声明。

Result: 在 COVID-19 胸片、ISIC 2019 皮肤镜和 EyePACS-to-APTOS 视网膜病变迁移任务上进行回顾性评估。十个校准种子下，COVID-19 严重行动错误由精确风险最优基线的 4.68% 降至 0.54%。5% 预算下，COVID-19 与 ISIC 的全局声明获得认证，但罕见鳞状细胞癌声明被拒绝；1% 预算下所有设置均获得描述性报告。此外报告了各预算下零错误通过全局危害门所需的最少严重病例数。

Conclusion: HC-ROCP 将危害约束纳入保形风险控制，在医学影像行动决策中兼顾错误控制与声明可信度；其结果也提示部分罕见亚组需更多数据才能获得认证。

Abstract: Routing a melanoma case to routine follow-up is a serious action error that diagnostic coverage alone does not rule out. We present Harm-Constrained Risk-Optimal Conformal Prediction (HC-ROCP), a training-free framework that uses frozen classifier probabilities and adds a harm penalty when choosing prediction sets and actions. We test the resulting policies on disjoint calibration splits with multiplicity adjustment. HC-ROCP certifies supported claims, reports descriptive fallback policies, and refuses unsupported subgroup claims. We evaluate these outputs retrospectively on COVID-19 radiographs, ISIC 2019 dermoscopy, and EyePACS-to-APTOS retinopathy transfer. Across ten calibration seeds, HC-ROCP reduces COVID-19 severe-action errors from the exact risk-optimal baseline's 4.68\% to 0.54\%. At a 5\% budget, global claims are certified for COVID-19 and ISIC, but the rare squamous-cell-carcinoma claim is refused. At 1\%, all settings receive descriptive reports. For each budget, we also report the minimum severe-case count needed to pass the global harm gate with zero errors, providing a starting point for further data collection.

</details>


### [458] [Trade Promotion Optimisation for Consumer Goods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12665)
*Ankur Verma,Namrata Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出端到端促销优化系统，串联相似SKU、点弹性、弹性曲线、价格建议、促销提升与净提升；在39个SKU品牌实验中单位销量增20.6%、收入增6.9%、利润率持平，相似SKU池化使弹性误差减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 促销折扣占消费品收入很大，但规划者通常仅凭单一且常不可靠的单品价格弹性制定折扣，缺乏准确、可落地的弹性估计与优化链条。

Method: 构建端到端TPO系统：促销后依据相对滚动正常价的方向性降价事件测弹性；促销期用因果估计器残差化趋势、季节性与促销，并以Tobit似然处理缺货截断，从首个干净促销周自我更新；证据弱的SKU通过交叉验证岭回归（品类、品牌、子品类、价格线、描述）选相似SKU，借用点弹性与曲率；优化器分离自身价格提升、替代效应与促销后回落，并调整库存与促销资金。

Result: 39个SKU消费品品牌、平均弹性-3.06的四週促销实验中，方案使销量提升20.6%、收入提升6.9%，利润率持平；相比层级平均，相似SKU池化将弹性误差减半。

Conclusion: 一体化TPO链条可提升促销规划效果，相似SKU信息借用显著改善弱证据SKU的弹性估计精度，并在实验中实现销量与收入增长且不牺牲利润率。

Abstract: Trade promotions consume a large share of consumer-goods revenue, yet most planners still set discounts with a single, often unreliable, price elasticity per item. We present an end-to-end Trade Promotion Optimisation (TPO) system built as one chain: analogue SKUs, point elasticity, elasticity curve, price recommendation, promotional lift and net lift. Elasticity is measured at post-promo time from directional price-dip events against a rolling regular price, and at promo time by a causal estimator that residualises trend, seasonality and promotion, handles stock-out censoring with a Tobit likelihood and updates itself from the first clean promotion week. Items with weak evidence borrow the point elasticity and the curvature from analogue SKUs chosen by a cross-validated ridge model over category, brand, sub-category, price line and description. The optimiser separates self-price lift from substitution and post-promo dips and adjusts for inventory and trade funding. In a four-week promotion experiment on a 39-SKU consumer brand (mean elasticity -3.06), the plan lifts units by 20.6% and revenue by 6.9% at flat margin. Analogue pooling halves elasticity error relative to hierarchy averaging.

</details>


### [459] [Controlled Binary Assignment Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12668)
*Paul Fröhling,Christoph Schnörr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于几何的深度分配流（deep assignment flows）时变参数化表示与学习方法，用于图上二值数据的标注；在低维全测地子流形上沿边构造最优控制的参数流，并通过学习三元流聚合，实现高维对称参数空间中的几何积分与并行局部综合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度分配流在高维对称参数空间中的参数化与学习复杂度高、难以直接优化，本文希望借助流形的几何结构（全测地子流形）实现可学习、可并行的局部参数综合，从而刻画时变的动态网络层；同时探讨这种局部几何综合方法的表达能力边界。

Method: 以输入数据的非局部线性尺度空间表示为目标的来源，为每条边赋予一个在2维全测地子流形上最优控制的参数流；进而学习由三元组此类流在5维全测地子流形上的聚合；融合这些流决定高维对称参数空间中的轨迹，并通过几何积分得到二值深度分配流的各层；整体构成高度并行的几何局部综合方案。

Result: 数值结果表明该方法具备良好的表达能力，同时也揭示了这一高并行几何局部综合方法在高维深度分配流参数化上的局限。

Conclusion: 该工作将以几何积分为核心的深度分配流学习问题转化为低维全测地子流形上的局部流学习与聚合问题，为图上二值标注提供了一个可并行、可学习的几何框架，并明确了其表达能力的上限，为后续改进参数化与聚合方式指明了方向。

Abstract: This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.

</details>


### [460] [CoilStellaration: A Dataset and Benchmark for Engineering-Aware Stellarator Coilset Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12689)
*Jan-Hendrik Ewers,Santiago A. Cadena,Nicolò Foppiani,Andrea Merlo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CoilStellaration 数据集与基准，用于学习从目标等离子体磁场到星形器线圈几何的映射，包含17.7万组优化后的线圈集，并评估学习模型在多项工程约束下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 星形器线圈设计是高度非线性的逆问题，通常无闭式解且解不唯一；需在复现目标磁场的同时满足工程约束并控制制造成本，机器学习进入该领域门槛较高、缺乏标准化数据与评测。

Method: 构建 CoilStellaration 数据集：基于 ConStellaration 的等离子体平衡，生成177,000组优化细丝线圈集，采样工程要求并记录几何与磁场指标，覆盖不同线圈数与场周期数；设立基准任务，要求模型以目标平衡及线圈间/线圈-等离子体间距、曲率、磁场误差等条件预测线圈；发布基线模型与评测代码。

Result: 实验表明磁场精度仍是主要挑战，学习模型很少能同时满足所有要求；但将学习预测作为传统线圈优化的初始化，可加速早期优化进展。

Conclusion: 该工作为星形器线圈设计提供了可复现的数据集、基准和基线，降低机器学习与优化研究者参与门槛，支持直接线圈生成与学习初始化优化两条研究路线，助力实用且经济的聚变电站发展。

Abstract: Stellarators are fusion devices that use externally generated, three-dimensional magnetic fields to confine hot plasma and offer a promising route to commercial fusion. Their electromagnetic coils pose a challenging design problem: they must reproduce the target magnetic field while satisfying engineering constraints and remaining practical and cost-effective to manufacture. Finding suitable geometries is a highly nonlinear inverse problem that generally has neither a closed-form nor a unique solution. This problem lies at the heart of stellarator design. We introduce CoilStellaration, a dataset and benchmark for learning the mapping between coil geometries from target plasma magnetic fields and engineering requirements. The dataset contains 177,000 optimized filamentary coilsets targeting plasma equilibria from ConStellaration, with sampled engineering requirements and achieved geometric and magnetic-field metrics. It spans multiple coil counts and field-period numbers, supporting studies of both specialized and shared models across configurations. The benchmark asks models to predict coils conditioned on a target equilibrium and requirements on coil-coil and coil-plasma spacing, curvature, and magnetic-field error. We show that magnetic-field accuracy remains the main challenge, with learned models rarely satisfying all requirements simultaneously. However, using learned predictions to initialize conventional coil optimization can accelerate early progress. We release baseline models and evaluation code to support reproducible research on both direct coil generation and learned optimization initializations. By lowering the barrier for machine learning and optimization researchers to engage with stellarator coil design, we aim to accelerate progress toward practical, cost-effective stellarator power plants.

</details>


### [461] [Agnostic Marginal-Nonuniform Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12694)
*Tanmay Devale,Steve Hanneke,Amirreza Shaeiri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究边缘分布非均匀（marginal-nonuniform）框架下的不可知二分类，分别在标准不可知与松弛不可知两种准则下刻画最优学习速率，并给出细粒度速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望探究：当学习速率的常数可以依赖无标签数据的边缘分布、但保证需对所有标签条件分布一致成立时，边缘分布信息能否改善不可知学习速率；并与可实现（realizable）设定中边缘分布确有帮助的现象形成对比。

Method: 在 marginal-nonuniform 学习框架下研究不可知二分类，考察两类准则：(1) 标准不可知设定，学习者与类中最佳概念竞争；(2) 松弛不可知设定，学习者与最佳概念误差的 (1+λ) 倍竞争，其中 λ∈(0,1] 固定。通过 VC 维与 uncentered VC-eluder 维度等组合复杂度量，推导最优速率及细粒度速率。

Result: 标准不可知设定下，只要 VC(H) 有限即可由标准不可知 PAC 结果得到 1/√n 的最优速率，否则任意慢速率不可避免；细粒度最优速率为 √(VC(H)/n)，说明边缘分布依赖无助于改进。松弛不可知设定下出现三分法：有限类对应 e^{-n} 指数速率；无限类但 VC(H) 有限对应 1/n 线性速率；VC(H)=∞ 时出现任意慢速率。细粒度最优速率为 uVCE(H)/(λn)，其中 uVCE(H) 为 uncentered VC-eluder 维度。

Conclusion: 在标准不可知设定中，允许常数依赖边缘分布并不能突破基于 VC 维的速率；而在松弛不可知设定中，可实现设定的现象重新出现，并可依据有限性、VC 维有限性与无限性得到指数、线性与任意慢速率的三分刻画，同时由 uVCE 维度精确给出细粒度速率。

Abstract: We study the problem of binary classification in the marginal-nonuniform learning framework in the agnostic setting. In this model, the constants in the learning rate may depend on the marginal distribution of the unlabeled data, but the guarantee must hold uniformly over all conditional distributions of the labels. We also study fine-grained rates.
  We consider two criteria.
  (1) The standard agnostic setting, where the learner competes with the best concept in the class. In this setting, an immediate consequence of standard agnostic PAC learning results gives us the optimal rate of $\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{n}}$ for every class $\mathcal{H}$ with finite $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})$ and shows that arbitrarily slow rates are necessary otherwise. This also gives us the optimal fine-grained rate of $\sqrt{\tfrac{\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})}{n}}$. Therefore, the dependence on the marginal distribution does not help, which is in contrast to the realizable setting.
  (2) In the relaxed agnostic setting, where the learner competes with $(1+λ)$ times the error of the best concept for a fixed $λ\in (0,1]$, the picture from the realizable setting reappears. We obtain a trichotomy of the achievable optimal rates: exponential rates of the form $e^{-n}$ arise precisely when the class is finite; linear rates of the form $\tfrac{1}{n}$ arise when the class is infinite but $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})$ is finite; and arbitrarily slow rates occur when $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})=\infty$. We also obtain the optimal fine-grained rate of $\tfrac{\mathrm{uVCE}(\mathcal{H})}{λn}$, where $\mathrm{uVCE}(\mathcal{H})$ is a recently introduced combinatorial complexity dimension called the uncentered $\mathrm{VC}$-eluder dimension.

</details>


### [462] [TACTUS: A Robotic Palpation System for Spatially Heterogeneous Hardness Mapping of Woody Breast Myopathy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12695)
*Chaitanya Pallerla,Yihong Feng,Avisekh Tripathy,Yang Tian,Pouya Sohrabipour,Amirreza Davar,Casey M. Owens,Cengiz Koparan,Dongyi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TACTUS：一种自动化触觉阵列系统，可在约30秒内于20个解剖位点生成厚度归一化的三维硬度图，用于表征木质胸（WB）肌肉的空间异质性硬度，并可作为高光谱/近红外WB分级的高通量真值生成平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 木质胸（Woody breast, WB）是肉鸡胸大肌的空间异质性纤维退行性病变，其硬度在肌肉内部呈不均匀分布。现有机械参考方法依赖单点或顺序压缩测量，无法刻画空间硬度变异特征，也难以作为自动化、无操作者依赖的真值来源。

Method: 提出TACTUS（Tactile Adaptive Conformal 3D Uniform Sensing）自动化触觉阵列：集成20个独立电机驱动的触觉单元（力敏电阻+编码器线性执行器），并配备LiDAR深度相机进行表面轮廓扫描与自适应压缩，实现厚度归一化的三维硬度图；以100块肉鸡胸肉样本、覆盖4个WB严重程度等级（正常、轻度、中度、重度）进行评估，采用ANOVA、Pearson相关、半变异函数、局部变化熵与异质性分析。

Result: TACTUS在约30秒内完成20位点测量；各严重程度等级间力值差异显著（ANOVA，p<0.001），以颅侧区域区分能力最强，并在尾侧检测到质构仪未能发现的显著效应；个体水平TACTUS力值与质构仪测量中度但显著相关（r=0.441，p<0.001）；半变异函数、局部变化熵与异质性分析显示硬度变异性随WB严重度增加且具有解剖结构规律。

Conclusion: TACTUS是一种自动化、无操作者依赖的空间分辨力学表征平台，可量化WB硬度的空间异质变异，并为高光谱与近红外光谱WB分类系统提供可靠的真值生成手段。

Abstract: Woody breast (WB) myopathy is a spatially heterogeneous fibro-degenerative condition of the broiler Pectoralis major muscle. Existing mechanical reference methods rely on single-point or sequential compression measurements, limiting characterization of spatial hardness variability. This study presents TACTUS (Tactile Adaptive Conformal 3D Uniform Sensing), an automated tactile array that generates thickness-normalized, three-dimensional hardness maps at 20 anatomically distributed locations within approximately 30 s. TACTUS integrates 20 independently motorized tactuators with force-sensing resistors and encoder-driven linear actuators, alongside a LiDAR depth camera for surface profiling and adaptive compression. The system was evaluated using 100 broiler breast fillets across four WB severity classes (Normal, Mild, Moderate, Severe). TACTUS identified significant force differences among severity classes (ANOVA, p < 0.001), with the strongest differentiation in the cranial region and a significant caudal effect not detected by texture-analyzer measurements. Fillet-level TACTUS force showed moderate but significant correlation with texture-analyzer measurements (Pearson r = 0.441, p < 0.001). Semivariogram, local change entropy, and heterogeneity analyses revealed increasing and anatomically structured hardness variability with WB severity. These findings demonstrate TACTUS as an automated, operator-independent platform for spatially resolved mechanical characterization and ground-truth generation to support hyperspectral and near-infrared spectroscopy-based WB classification systems.

</details>


### [463] [Generalized Adaptive Boosting and the Geometry of Mistakes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12696)
*Marco Bressan,Nataly Brukhim,Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi,Emmanuel Esposito,Yishay Mansour,Shay Moran,Maximilian Thiessen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从“假阳性/假阴性不应简单聚合”出发，提出 Z-learner 框架：弱学习器需在给定集合 Z⊆[0,1]^2 上取得联合 (FP,FN) 保证。作者给出哪些 Z 可被 boosting 的完整几何刻画，并提出无需预知 Z 的自适应 boosting 算法，统一并推广了经典 boosting 二分性与多目标扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 boosting 通常把不同类型错误合并为单一误差率，但医疗诊断等场景中假阳性与假阴性影响不同，不能简单相加。作者希望重新审视 boosting 理论，建立能分别控制 FP 与 FN 的弱可学习性概念，并回答“哪些弱学习保证可被 boost”这一核心问题。

Method: 提出 Z-learner：对某集合 Z⊆[0,1]^2，弱假设需达到联合假阳性/假阴性保证 (FP,FN)。该定义可退化为经典 γ-弱学习（取 Z={(z1,z2): z1+z2<1/2-γ}），并纳入分布对可实现学习保证的影响。随后通过几何分析刻画可 boost 的集合 Z，并设计不依赖 Z 先验知识的自适应 boosting 算法；理论分析借助离散与计算几何中的 centerpoint theorem。

Result: 得到可 boost 集合 Z 的完整几何刻画，统一了经典 boosting 二分性结果与 Bressan 等（COLT 2025）的多目标扩展；提出无需预知 Z 的自适应算法，推广 AdaBoost 处理未知 margin 参数的能力；并证明 Z-learner 可实现置信度放大（confidence amplification）。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将弱学习保证表述为 FP/FN 联合区域上的 Z-learner，可在更一般的错误代价与分布相关设定下系统理解 boosting；其可 boost 性具有清晰的几何边界，且可通过自适应算法在实际中实现。该框架拓展了经典 boosting 理论，并为需要区分假阳性与假阴性的应用提供了理论工具。

Abstract: Not all mistakes are alike. For example, in medical diagnosis, false positive and false negative mistakes have a different impact and should not be aggregated. By revisiting the classical theory of boosting through this lens, we introduce the notion of $Z$-learner, which returns weak hypotheses achieving joint false-positive/false-negative guarantees $(\mathrm{FP},\mathrm{FN})$ from some set $Z \subseteq [0,1]^2$. This formulation generalizes the standard notion of $γ$-weak learning--recovered by taking $Z=\{(z_1,z_2): z_1+z_2<1/2-γ\}$--and allows for more flexible notions of weak learnability that account for the impact of the distribution on the achievable learning guarantees. This raises a natural question: which sets $Z$ are boostable? We answer this by giving a complete geometric characterization that unifies, as special cases, both the classical boosting dichotomy and the recent multi-objective extension of Bressan et al. (COLT 2025). We also present an adaptive algorithm for boosting $Z$-learners without relying on the prior knowledge of $Z$, generalizing AdaBoost's ability to handle unknown margin parameters. Finally, we demonstrate that $Z$-learners can achieve confidence amplification. However, the analysis is significantly more involved than in classical boosting and relies on the centerpoint theorem from discrete and computational geometry.

</details>


### [464] [Fisher-Glass Learning: Classification Bounds and Subpopulation Audits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12702)
*El Mustapha Mansouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文扩展Fisher-glass框架，把去干扰后的任务信息与局部分类难度、子群体审计联系起来，并在Waterbirds上用受控背景替换实验说明：预测准确率与任务信息、敏感性可能严重背离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠预测性能无法量化在扣除背景等干扰变化后还剩多少任务信息；背景线索改变而标签不变时，看似准确的分类器可能失效。因此需要一种能把信息量、局部难度与子群体审计结合的诊断工具。

Method: 扩展Fisher-glass框架：在显式可区分性与决策分离条件下推导局部minimax超额分类风险下界，并给出计入估计误差与正则化的统计审计。实验上，在Waterbirds上做基于特征的"任务—背景对齐"诊断，先冻结所选群体再做留出评估；对五个训练种子做保留鸟体前景、替换背景的受控实验；另用任务标签和固定干扰方向搜索，构造独立评估的子群体并估计投影预测Fisher信息。

Result: 背景类型保持时准确率93.2%，背景改变时降至40.6%，受控差异达52.6个百分点；搜索得到的子群体成员加权准确率98.8%但估计投影预测Fisher信息低；训练与采集实验显示信息增益与预测增益可以分离。

Conclusion: 诊断模型脆弱性与评估改进时，应联合考察预测性能、在声明干扰模型下的任务信息以及受控敏感性，而非只看准确率。

Abstract: Accurate classifiers can fail when background cues change without altering the correct labels. Predictive performance alone does not quantify how much task information remains after accounting for such nuisance variation. Here we extend the Fisher-glass framework to connect nuisance-adjusted information with local classification difficulty and subpopulation auditing. We derive lower bounds on local minimax excess classification risk under explicit distinguishability and decision-separation conditions, alongside statistical audits accounting for estimation error and regularization. On Waterbirds, a feature-based diagnostic of task-background alignment selects an accurately classified group, with selection frozen before held-out evaluation. Across five training seeds, background replacements preserving the extracted bird foreground and labels yield 93.2% accuracy when background type is preserved and 40.6% when it changes, a controlled difference of 52.6 percentage points. Separately, search using task labels and a fixed nuisance direction identifies an independently evaluated population with 98.8% membership-weighted accuracy and low estimated projected predictive Fisher information. Training and acquisition experiments show that information gains and predictive gains can diverge. These findings support joint assessment of predictive performance, information under declared nuisance models and controlled sensitivity when diagnosing vulnerability and evaluating model improvements.

</details>


### [465] [Scaling Taxonomy-Free Image Labeling with Generative AI: A Multimodal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12725)
*Zhenjie Zhang,Sainan Chen,Kshiteesh Hegde,Mengze,Li,Pouya Rezazadeh Kalehbasti,Munachim Ezema,Karina Sobhani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GLOC（Generative Labeling On Clusters）通过对图像嵌入聚类并在簇级别生成洞见，实现在线多模态图像描述服务的高可扩展、低延迟、低成本与高准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线图像多模态洞见需兼顾低延迟、高准确、可扩展与低成本。传统"人工标注金标准集+训练模型"流程受固定分类体系、高昂标注成本、覆盖有限与标注者误差制约，迭代困难；直接使用生成式模型则延迟高、成本难以支撑高并发请求或大规模离线标注。

Method: 利用高度优化的图像嵌入形成语义相近的图像簇，按洞见类型聚类，并在簇级别进行洞见总结，从而泛化至簇内成员，避免逐图生成。

Result: 在Pinterest用于图像描述符与Hybrid Search的pivot查询建议；离线与线上A/B测试显示GLOC在质量与效率上显著优于既有方法。

Conclusion: 以"嵌入聚类+簇级生成标注"替代逐图生成与固定分类体系，可在规模化在线场景中兼顾质量、延迟与成本，具备实际生产可行性。

Abstract: Providing real-time multimodal insights into images is challenging because it requires low latency, high description accuracy, and scalable solutions that are both cost-effective and efficient. For example, given a new image of an outfit, we would like to generate insights that the image depicts "earth tones" and "linen pants" and allow users to explore similar ideas along these themes. Traditional strategies to generate such insights would typically involve building taxonomies producing a golden set labeled by humans, training models on these datasets, and deploying these models for online inference services. Such workflows are constrained by fixed taxonomy, high labeling cost, limited labeling coverage in sample space, and human errors and expertise gaps in labelers. In addition, these methods are expensive and cumbersome to iterate over time. Recent trends have started exploring generative AI models for online insights, but this method suffers from long latency and prohibitive costs to support a high volume of requests or large amounts of offline labeling needs.
  We present Generative Labeling On Clusters (GLOC) as a solution to provide highly scalable, cost-effective, low latency, and high accuracy online image insight services. GLOC leverages highly optimized image embeddings to form image clusters that are semantically close to each other for the purpose of the type of insights, and summarizes the insights at the cluster level, which effectively generalizes to members in the cluster. At Pinterest, GLOC powers image descriptors and pivot query suggestions for Hybrid Search, which is a multimodal search service enabling users to search with both an image and a text query. Our offline and online A/B tests demonstrate that GLOC significantly outperforms previous methods, delivering improvements in quality and efficiency.

</details>


### [466] [Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12728)
*Brendan P. Murphy,Agustina Saenz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究可验证结果奖励强化学习在多轮序列决策（临床多轮问诊智能体）中的失效模式，并提出过程信用奖励设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）被广泛用于提升语言模型推理，但其对"序列决策过程"的影响尚不清楚；仅以最终结果给奖励，可能训练出程序上不可靠的多轮智能体，而现有评测无法区分真正的自适应信息获取与奖励投机捷径。

Method: 构建三个可控临床环境（药物续方分诊、急性诊断检查、剂量滴定），均含隐藏临床状态、查询成本、精确自适应oracle与确定性结果验证器；以仅结果奖励的GRPO为基线，对比对"降低不确定性的提问"给予密集过程信用、以及将探索与利用分离的变体；并在不同训练随机种子、监督预热、含偏监督数据等条件下做消融。

Result: 仅结果奖励的GRPO常能提升总体奖励，却产生过早下结论、只问一个问题（one-question collapse）、罕见高危病例失败等不良程序；诊断任务中，对降低不确定性的提问赋密集信用，在三个随机种子下均提升留出集价值与中等病例支持度，且未出现仅结果训练下的高危种子崩溃；分离探索与利用可进一步提升最佳检查点的高危支持度，但会在低急症病例上过度收集信息；过程信用强度最优值与任务相关；在有良好提问习惯的监督预热之后，强化学习通过削减提问数提升总体奖励却损害高危表现；强化学习也难以修复有偏监督数据带来的罕见行为缺陷。

Conclusion: 可验证的最终结果不足以训练可靠的多轮智能体：奖励设计必须把"达成答案所采用的程序"纳入考量，评测也需将自适应信息获取与利用奖励的投机捷径区分开来。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.

</details>


### [467] [Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Federated Unsupervised Visual Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12187)
*Jian Liang,Kuangpu Guo,Ran He,Tieniu Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedUR 是首个利用 CLIP 等预训练视觉语言模型零样本能力实现联邦无监督视觉识别的框架，通过类感知数据选择的伪标签机制、类权重与负伪标签策略、以及个性化提示聚合协议应对数据异构，在标签级与特征级分布偏移下均稳定优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督联邦学习研究主要集中于聚类与自监督表示学习，对无监督视觉识别这一关键问题仍缺乏探索；同时联邦场景中客户端数据存在显著异构性，直接聚合模型或伪标签效果不佳。

Method: 以预训练视觉语言模型（如 CLIP）的零样本能力为基础构建联邦无监督识别框架。采用类感知数据选择的伪标签机制：先估计全局伪标签分布，再据此将伪标注数据分配给各客户端。为缓解常规正伪标签的不确定性，引入类权重与负伪标签策略。并提出个性化提示聚合协议：通用视觉提示在服务器端聚合，编码本地知识的个性化文本提示保留在客户端。

Result: 在标签级和特征级分布偏移两种设定下，FedUR 一致优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了联邦无监督视觉识别的研究空白，为后续联邦无监督识别研究奠定基础，代码将开源。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a promising research paradigm that enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without data sharing. To handle unlabeled data in local clients, existing unsupervised FL research has primarily focused on tasks like clustering and self-supervised representation learning, leaving the critical problem of unsupervised visual recognition largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce FedUR, the first framework designed for unsupervised recognition by leveraging the zero-shot capabilities of pre-trained vision-language models like CLIP. Specifically, FedUR addresses data heterogeneity through a pseudo-labeling mechanism with a class-aware data selection strategy. This strategy first estimates a global pseudo-label distribution, then allocates pseudo-labeled data to clients accordingly. To handle the uncertainty of conventional positive pseudo-labels, FedUR further incorporates class weights and a negative pseudo-labeling strategy. Furthermore, FedUR proposes a personalized prompt aggregation protocol where general visual prompts are aggregated on the server, and personalized text prompts encoding local knowledge are retained on clients. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedUR consistently outperforms baseline methods under both label-level and feature-level distribution shifts. We believe this work paves the way for further advances in federated unsupervised recognition. Code will be available at {github.com/tim-learn/FedUR/}}.

</details>


### [468] [KiteNorm: Variance Regularisation for Stable and Scalable Post-LN Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12729)
*Leon A. Trochelmann,Sajad Movahedi,Shiwei Liu,Antonio Orvieto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对 Post-LayerNorm Transformer 深层训练不稳定、大学习率下易退化的问题，提出 KiteNorm：通过残差缩放与方差正则约束隐状态方差，并结合双归一化实现跳连与残差分支的可学习尺度，在最多 1.3B 参数的 decoder-only 模型中提升稳定性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Post-LayerNorm 因深层扩展困难而难以实用；已有工作多从初始化条件化入手，但在大学习率训练时稳定性仍会恶化。作者研究的 decoder-only 场景中，现有 Post-LN 方法未能超过强 Pre-LN 基线，因此需要新的后归一化训练方法来打破这一趋势。

Method: 提出 KiteNorm 后归一化训练方法，核心是约束隐状态方差。其动机来自 LayerNorm Jacobian 上界分析：方差增长会加剧梯度消失；同时经验上方差增长与秩坍塌相关。方法结合残差缩放和方差正则化以维持训练稳定性，并采用标量化的双重归一化，为 skip 分支和 residual 分支提供分别可学习的尺度。

Result: 在最多 1.3B 参数的 decoder-only Transformer 上，KiteNorm 提升了训练稳定性，并在各基线的最优学习率下优于领先方法；缩放规律显示其在深度、宽度、批大小和训练预算方面均更有利。消融实验表明，各组件对完整稳定性和性能收益都是必要的。

Conclusion: KiteNorm 通过控制隐状态方差，为 Post-LayerNorm Transformer 的深层、大学习率稳定训练提供了可行方案，并在较大规模 decoder-only 模型中展现出优于强 Pre-LayerNorm 基线的潜力。

Abstract: Post-LayerNorm Transformers have seen limited practical adoption due to enduring difficulties in scaling them to large depths. While prior research has focused on stabilising Post-LayerNorm by improving conditioning at initialisation, stability often deteriorates when models are trained with large learning rates, forcing additional compromises. In the decoder-only settings we study, existing Post-LayerNorm methods fail to outperform strong Pre-LayerNorm baselines. We propose KiteNorm, a post-norm training method designed to break this trend by constraining hidden-state variance. This approach is motivated by a bound on the LayerNorm Jacobian suggesting that variance growth contributes to gradient vanishing, alongside empirical evidence linking it to rank collapse. KiteNorm combines residual scaling and variance regularisation to maintain stability throughout training, supported by scalarised double-normalisation that provides separately learnable scales for the skip and residual branches. Across decoder-only Transformers up to 1.3B parameters, KiteNorm improves training stability and outperforms leading baselines at their optimal learning rates, with scaling laws favouring KiteNorm across depth, width, batch size, and training budget. Ablations show that each component is necessary for the full stability and performance gains.

</details>


### [469] [Controlling Temporal Pseudo-Label Marginals for Stable Online Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12242)
*Rani Amar,Ofir Lindenbaum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SCALAR——一个即插即用的 Sinkhorn 类边缘正则模块，通过在短时间窗口内约束伪标签的类别分布来缓解持续测试时自适应（CTTA）中的漂移与崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CTTA 在测试时用无标签数据流在线更新模型，但过程不稳定：早期预测偏差会被不断强化，模型逐渐只预测少数类别，导致表征漂移甚至完全崩溃。作者指出"伪标签使用的类别数变窄"是这种不稳定性的重要指标，并对其进行了量化。现有方法多通过挑选可靠样本或对损失重加权来鼓励伪标签多样性，但都没有在时间窗口上显式地约束类别边缘分布。

Method: 提出 Sinkhorn Class-Marginal Regularization（SCALAR）：一个简单、可插拔的模块，在短时间窗口内控制伪标签分布。具体做法是用缓冲区保存最近的预测，通过 Sinkhorn 算法将缓冲区中预测的类别分布做平衡，使其匹配给定的目标分布，再用平衡后的软目标（balanced soft targets）进行自适应更新；无需修改模型结构。

Result: 不改变模型架构的前提下，SCALAR 保持与基线相同的单步运行时间；在 ImageNet-C 上峰值显存仅增加 10 MB。在类别分布偏斜、非平稳且分布偏移严重的数据上效果尤为突出；与基于熵或多样性的现有稳定化方法结合时，能显著缓解漂移与崩溃问题。

Conclusion: 将"伪标签类别使用率收窄"视作 CTTA 不稳定的可量化信号，并以时间窗口内的类别边缘约束作为切入点，SCALAR 提供了一个开销极低、可与多种稳定化方法组合的通用正则化手段，为提升 CTTA 的长期稳定性提供了简洁有效的方案。

Abstract: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) methods update models online using a stream of unlabeled data to overcome distribution shifts encountered at test time. However, CTTA is often unstable, as it can reinforce biases in early predictions and increasingly predict only a few classes, resulting in drift or even collapse. In this paper, we identify narrowing pseudo-label class usage as an indicator of CTTA instability and quantify this behavior. Most existing methods have attempted to address this issue by either selecting reliable adaptation samples or re-weighting the loss to encourage diverse pseudo-labels, but they do not explicitly enforce a class marginal over a temporal window. Instead, we propose Sinkhorn Class-Marginal Regularization (SCALAR), a simple plug-and-play module that controls the pseudo-label distribution over a short temporal window. SCALAR works by maintaining recent predictions in a buffer, balancing their class distribution via the Sinkhorn algorithm to match a specified target distribution, and using the balanced soft targets for adaptation. Without changing the model architecture, SCALAR maintains the per-step runtime and increases the peak allocated GPU memory by only 10 MB on ImageNet-C. Our method is particularly effective on skewed, non-stationary data with severe distribution shifts, where SCALAR significantly alleviates drift and collapse when combined with existing stabilization methods based on entropy or diversity.

</details>


### [470] [Clique Constraints for Exact Causal Structure Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12747)
*Xiaoyu He,Pavel Rytíř,Petr Ryšavý,Jakub Mareček*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文在精确 score-based 因果结构学习中，用惰性环约束和团约束对学习到的无向骨架最大团大小施加硬上界，并在静态线性高斯 ER 与 scale-free DAG 上系统评估其计算与统计权衡。结果表明团约束并非普遍加速，收益取决于图密度、样本量和割管理策略；较紧的 Big-M 上界多能缩小固定预算最优性差距，选择性分离与 incumbent repair 是值得关注的方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确 score-based 因果结构学习具有显式结构约束和最优性证书的优势，但其 branch-and-cut 搜索计算开销大。作者希望判断：在整数候选层面加入骨架最大团上界及相应割，是否能在保持精确性的同时改善搜索效率，并刻画不同割策略与参数设置下的计算权衡。

Method: 在精确因果结构学习框架中，对整数候选懒式加入环约束和团约束，以限制无向骨架最大团尺寸；在静态线性高斯 Erdős-Rényi 与 scale-free DAG 上，比较 callback 顺序、不同团割策略、incumbent repair、分数分离和 Big-M 界。重点分析两个变体：B3 每次 callback 选择最违反的最小 (k+1)-clique 不等式；C3 通过删除违反边并用基于 QR 的最小二乘重拟合受影响回归列来修复不可行整数候选。报告因果恢复指标与 optimality gap、原始/对偶界、节点吞吐、MIPSOL 事件和 callback 成本。

Result: 团约束并未一致加速优化。其收益依赖图密度、样本量和割管理策略；大量相关约束可能降低节点吞吐。较紧的有效 Big-M 界在多数测试设置中缩小了固定预算下的 optimality gap，但在固定时间限制下未必改变 SHD 或 F1。B3 与 C3 等策略的表现在不同条件下存在差异，说明割选择与候选修复会影响精确搜索效率。

Conclusion: 该研究刻画了团约束精确因果学习的计算权衡：团约束不是普适加速器，需结合图密度、样本量和割管理策略使用；选择性分离与 incumbent repair 是有前景的改进方向，Big-M 紧化主要改善优化界而非必然改善固定时限下的结构恢复。

Abstract: Exact score-based causal structure learning supports explicit structural constraints and optimisation certificates, but its branch-and-cut search can be computationally demanding. We augment exact causal structure learning methods with an upper bound on the maximum clique size of the learned undirected skeleton, enforced at integer candidates through lazy cycle and clique constraints. On static linear-Gaussian Erdős-Rényi and scale-free DAGs, we evaluate callback order, alternative clique-cut policies, incumbent repair, fractional separation, and Big-M bounds. We report causal-recovery metrics jointly with optimality gaps, primal and dual bounds, node throughput, MIPSOL events, and callback cost. Two variants receive particular attention: B3 selects the most violated minimal (k+1)-clique inequality at each callback, whereas C3 repairs an infeasible integer candidate by deleting violating edges and refitting affected regression columns using QR-based least squares. The results do not indicate that clique constraints uniformly accelerate optimisation. However, their benefit depends on graph density, sample size, and cut-management policy, while large collections of correlated constraints can reduce node throughput. Tighter valid Big-M bounds reduced the fixed-budget optimality gap in most tested settings, without necessarily changing SHD or F1 at a fixed time limit. These findings characterize the computational trade-offs of clique-constrained exact causal learning, and identify selective separation and incumbent repair as promising directions.

</details>


### [471] [Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12777)
*Duy-Cuong Bui,Trung-Anh Dang,Vincent Nguyen,Duc V. Le,Ngoc-Son Vu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TEA-Prompt：在单提示（one-prompt）持续学习范式中，用「输入条件化的 token 相关性评分」+「注意力行为锚定损失」来在参数空间之外保护提示行为，仅 0.38M 参数即在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R、CUB-200 上取得 SOTA 且遗忘显著降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于提示的持续学习通常冻结预训练 ViT、只调少量 prompt token；为追求最大参数效率，近期出现所有任务共享同一个 prompt 的「单提示」做法。核心难题是：共享 prompt 如何在学习新类时仍保留旧类知识。现有方法在参数空间上做保护（冻结任务专属 prompt、扩展新组件、稀疏门控梯度流向），但这牺牲了可塑性，而且共享 token 中仍被允许的漂移会破坏 prompt 在旧类上的功能。作者由此提出：真正需要保护的是 prompt 的「行为」而非参数。

Method: 方法包含两个耦合组件：(i) token 评估模块，为每个 prompt token 分配连续、输入条件化的相关性分数，并将其注入注意力 logits，从而在任务间软性专化各 token，而不丢弃任何 token；(ii) 注意力行为锚定损失，仅用紧凑的高斯查询统计量（无需存储旧图像）约束每个 token 的注意力输出围绕类别特定查询区域，并按该 token 过去的相关性加权。由于锚定的是注意力「值/交互结果」，参数仍可自由更新，只要其交互保持不变。

Result: 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R、CUB-200 三个基准上取得当前最优准确率，且遗忘明显更低，总参数量仅 0.38M；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 该工作表明：在单提示持续学习中，把保护对象从「参数」转向「注意力行为」可在不牺牲可塑性的前提下缓解遗忘；用输入条件化的软 token 专化配合无旧样本的高斯统计锚定，是实现极小参数预算下高精度、低遗忘的可行路径。

Abstract: Prompt-based continual learning adapts a frozen pre-trained vision transformer by tuning a small set of prompt tokens. Recently, one-prompt methods which share one single prompt across all tasks make this paradigm maximally parameter efficient. The open question is how a shared prompt can keep the knowledge of old classes while being updated for new ones. Existing methods protect old knowledge in parameter space, where they freeze task-specific prompts, expand new components, or sparsely gate which tokens receive gradients. However, this method sacrifices plasticity, yet the drift it still permits in shared tokens can corrupt the prompt's function on past classes. What must be preserved is the prompt's behavior. We propose TEA-Prompt, which couples (i) a token evaluation module that assigns each prompt token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score injected into the attention logits, softly specializing tokens across tasks without discarding any of them, and (ii) an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains each token's attention output around class-specific query regions using only compact Gaussian query statistics without stored old images, weighted by the token's past relevance. Anchoring the attention value allows the parameters to continue updating freely, as long as their interaction remains unchanged. TEA-Prompt achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters. Code is publicy available at https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git

</details>


### [472] [Smartphone-Enabled Depth-Aware Transillumination Imaging for Detection of Chicken Breast Fillet Myopathies in Chicken Fillets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12796)
*Chaitanya Pallerla,Ramesh Bahadur Bist,Yihong Feng,Yang Tian,Shiva Paudel,Casey M. Owens,Cengiz Koparan,Jeyamkondan Subbiah,Dongyi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究提出基于智能手机透射成像与3D点云的无损框架，对267个鸡胸肉样本进行木质化鸡胸（WB）严重程度分级，融合光学、几何与物理信息特征，多模态集成模型测试准确率约90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 木质化鸡胸肉是肉鸡重要品质缺陷，传统触诊主观且费时，现有无损方法多依赖专用设备或高算力，亟需低成本、便携、客观的分级手段。

Method: 采集267个鸡胸肉样本（正常87、轻度85、重度95）的RAW透射图像和iPhone 16 Pro 3D点云；提取91个特征（14个图像特征、76个几何特征、1个基于Beer-Lambert定律的物理衰减特征）；采用偏相关控制厚度影响，并构建2D模型及融合Fusion-DGCNN、XGBoost和物理引导逻辑回归（PGLR）的多模态集成模型。

Result: 控制厚度后图像特征与WB严重程度显著相关（r=0.413，p<0.0001）；重度WB组织单位厚度光衰减较正常约高26%；仅2D模型测试准确率约82%，多模态集成模型约90%。

Conclusion: 光学、几何与物理信息特征具有互补价值，智能手机无损评估WB严重程度具备可行性。

Abstract: Woody Breast (WB) myopathy is a major quality defect in broiler chickens characterized by fibrosis, increased tissue hardness, and altered structural properties that affect product quality. Conventional palpation is subjective and labor-intensive, while many non-destructive methods require specialized equipment or substantial computational resources. This study developed a smartphone-based transillumination and 3D point-cloud framework for non-destructive WB severity classification. A total of 267 chicken breast fillets, including normal breast (NB, n = 87), mild WB (MWB, n = 85), and severe WB (SWB, n = 95), were evaluated using RAW transillumination images and 3D point clouds acquired with an iPhone 16 Pro. A total of 91 features, comprising 14 image-derived, 76 geometric, and one physics-informed Beer-Lambert attenuation feature, were extracted. Partial correlation controlling for thickness revealed a significant association between image characteristics and WB severity (r = 0.413, p < 0.0001), indicating optical information independent of fillet geometry. SWB tissue exhibited approximately 26% greater light attenuation per unit thickness than NB. The 2D-only models achieved approximately 82% test accuracy, while the multimodal ensemble combining Fusion-DGCNN, XGBoost, and physics-guided logistic regression (PGLR) achieved approximately 90% accuracy. These findings demonstrate the complementary value of optical, geometric, and physics-informed features and establish the feasibility of smartphone-based, non-destructive WB severity assessment.

</details>


### [473] [Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12799)
*Tingcheng Bian,Kangye Gong,Jinchang Luo,MingQuan Cheng,Feiran Liu,Ni Li,Xiaoling Xia,Haiwei Wang,Hui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出GRPO训练的LLM智能体最终仅保留最佳验证检查点是有损的，被丢弃的检查点构成"免费教师池"，并提出Agentic-OPD，用学生能力缺口引导教师选择（HCN）与监督过滤（LAD），实现后RL阶段的能力回收，最多提升7.4分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流做法只保留最佳验证检查点、丢弃其余检查点，本文发现这一做法存在信息损失：最佳检查点会在早期检查点已解决的问题上失败，跨检查点的问题解决并集远大于任一单点，说明被丢弃的检查点蕴含可回收的能力覆盖。

Method: 将最佳验证检查点作为学生、所有已保存检查点作为冻结教师候选，采用on-policy distillation。HCN（Highest Coverage Next）策略按教师对学生未解问题的加权覆盖度动态选择教师；LAD（Locality-Aware Distillation）模块仅在学生失败的rollout且教师表现更优的问题上施加蒸馏，限制迁移范围。

Result: 在五个智能体任务域、24个基准与任务子集上，Agentic-OPD较其初始化检查点最高提升7.4分；4B学生模型在深度搜索任务上超过GPT-5.6与DeepSeek-V4.1等前沿模型。

Conclusion: Agentic-OPD把一次已完成的RL运行重新视为可复用的策略池，确立"后RL能力回收"作为与RL算法改进本身正交的新阶段。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. We propose Agentic-OPD, which treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide both teacher selection and supervision filtering: the HCN policy (Highest Coverage Next) dynamically selects teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems, while the LAD module (Locality-Aware Distillation) confines transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better. Across five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, Agentic-OPD improves over its initialization checkpoint by up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing the latest frontier models GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search. Agentic-OPD recasts a finished RL run as a reusable pool of policies and establishes post-RL capability recovery as a stage orthogonal to improvements in the RL algorithm itself.

</details>


### [474] [Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12815)
*Saketh Vishnubhatla,Pingchuan Ma,Shu Wan,Alimohammad Beigi,Andre Harrison,Adrienne Raglin,Huan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究高维反事实推断中“反演步骤”是否必要：在CelebA和ADNI上比较基于反演与无反演（借用图像编辑思路）的方法，以有效性和身份保持为指标，给出二者权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标量一维变量的反事实推断已有清晰方法，但将反事实推断扩展到图像等高维节点仍很困难。传统流程需先从事实图像反演潜状态，再按因果图生成反事实属性并渲染图像；作者希望检验这一反演步骤在高维反事实计算中是否必需。

Method: 先讨论从标量一维情形到高维情形的扩展；再分析反演步骤的相关性，并评估一种从图像编辑文献改造而来的无反演方法；最后在CelebA和ADNI图像数据集上，用有效性（反事实属性渲染是否忠实）和身份保持（是否仍渲染同一单位/图像）两个指标进行基准测试。

Result: 实验比较了基于反演与无反演两类高维反事实推断方案，并从有效性和身份保持两个维度呈现二者的性能权衡；摘要未给出具体数值结果。

Conclusion: 高维反事实推断不一定依赖传统的先反演再渲染流程；无反演方案具有可行性，但与基于反演的方法存在有效性—身份保持等方面的权衡，需结合任务需求选择。

Abstract: Counterfactual inference is the task of answering hypothetical "what-if" queries about a unit, given an observational dataset, modeling assumptions, and a causal graph. This enables a modeler to reason about hypothetical scenarios that cannot otherwise be answered without assumptions or a causal graph. The simpler case involves a causal graph with scalar 1-D variables that denote different attributes in the data-generation process. While the literature is clear in the 1-D case, extending this to settings with high-dimensional nodes (e.g., images) remains challenging. Conventionally, in the literature, methods recover the latent state from the factual image (inversion), generate counterfactual attributes from the graph, and render the counterfactual image from the latent state using the updated attributes. In our work, we investigate the necessity of the inversion step in computing high-dimensional counterfactuals. We first discuss moving from the scalar 1-D case to the higher-dimensional case. Secondly, we discuss the relevance of the inversion step and evaluate an inversion-free counterpart repurposed from the image-editing literature. Finally, on image datasets such as CelebA and ADNI, we benchmark our approach using two measures: namely, effectiveness and identity preservation. While effectiveness is a measure of how faithfully the counterfactual attribute is rendered, identity preservation measures whether the same unit (image) is being rendered, both of which are crucial for high-dimensional counterfactual inference. We present the tradeoffs of using inversion-based and inversion-free approaches in our work.

</details>


### [475] [What the Loss Curve Misses: FP4 Pretraining Slows the Acquisition of Rare Facts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12832)
*Chang Lu,Mengjiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 低精度预训练通常以验证损失来衡量，本文追问"损失匹配是否意味着稀有事实的学习效率也相同"。作者用合成传记（控制曝光次数）训练Transformer，发现NVFP4需比BF16多1.32–1.52倍曝光才能达到同等召回率，而验证损失仅差0.5%–2%。作者进一步将成本归因于梯度噪声（而非前向量化），并给出无需拟合即可预测成本的梯度统计指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低精度（如4-bit矩阵乘）预训练的评测几乎只依赖验证损失，但损失是平均量，可能掩盖对稀有知识（出现次数少的事实）记忆效率的差异。作者希望检验：当验证损失相近时，低精度模型是否同样高效地学到稀有事实。

Method: 在合成传记数据（可控曝光次数）上从零训练Transformer，单独使用或混入网页文本；采用模拟的4-bit矩阵乘（NVFP4）对比BF16。分别在两种评测读出下测量达到同等召回率所需的曝光倍数，并在BF16矩阵乘下复测以排除评测端量化影响。进一步做受控实验：零均值梯度噪声、仅量化反向传播、2倍误差噪声、噪声仅进入Adam二阶矩估计 vs 进入参数更新，以及提高学习率的补偿实验；并用BF16检查点的梯度统计对各类格式/部分量化/噪声控制的成本排序（Spearman相关）。

Result: NVFP4达到BF16同等召回率需1.32×和1.52×的曝光次数（验证损失仅差0.5%和2%）；当两模型均以BF16矩阵乘评测时为1.26×和1.30×；主读出下匹配损失时曝光成本约1.2×。零均值梯度噪声能复现"仅量化反向传播"的成本，而仅量化反向传播几乎不改变损失。在2倍NVFP4误差的受控实验中：仅注入Adam二阶矩的噪声表现为更小学习率、成本会消退；而注入更新量的噪声降低信噪比，约三分之二的成本持续到训练结束。提高学习率以补偿更小的平均步长无法挽回成本（对噪声和NVFP4皆然）。BF16检查点的梯度统计可无需拟合地对格式、部分量化与噪声控制的成本排序，Spearman相关0.96。

Conclusion: 验证损失匹配不足以代表低精度训练对稀有事实的学习效率；曝光成本主要源自反向传播的梯度噪声（尤其是更新量中的噪声降低信噪比），且该成本无法通过调学习率弥补。建议在评估低精度训练配方时，将稀有事实获取效率与损失一并测量，并可用梯度统计作为低成本预测指标。

Abstract: Low-precision pretraining is usually judged by validation loss. We ask whether matching loss also means learning rare facts as efficiently. We train transformers from scratch with emulated 4-bit matrix multiplications on synthetic biographies with controlled exposure counts, on their own and mixed into web text. NVFP4 needs 1.32$\times$ and 1.52$\times$ as many exposures as BF16 to match its recall while validation loss differs by only 0.5% and 2%, and 1.26$\times$ and 1.30$\times$ when both models are evaluated with BF16 matrix multiplications. Under our primary readout, the exposure cost is about 1.2$\times$ at matched loss. Zero-mean gradient noise reproduces the cost of quantizing only the backward pass, which barely moves the loss. In a controlled experiment at twice the NVFP4 error, noise fed only to Adam's second-moment estimate acts like a lower learning rate and its cost fades, whereas noise in the update lowers its signal-to-noise ratio and carries about two thirds of the cost through the end of training. Raising the learning rate to offset the smaller average step does not recover the cost, either for this noise or for NVFP4. Gradient statistics of BF16 checkpoints rank the costs of formats, partial quantizations and noise controls without fitting (Spearman 0.96). We suggest measuring rare-fact acquisition alongside loss when evaluating low-precision recipes.

</details>


### [476] [Mitigating Agentic Deception via Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12835)
*Hanxiao Li,Shutong Liu,Yongjia Ma,Jiaming Ji,Juntao Dai,Shuning Zhang,Kejian Shi,Kai Chen,Pu Feng,Yuqing Ma,Qi Dou,Yaodong Yang,Xianglong Liu,Simin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将LLM智能体的欺骗行为归因于评估端部分可观测，提出评估端部分可观测扩展式博弈e-PoG，以智能体、监控器和验证器构成max-min框架，定义子博弈完美监督均衡SPOE并给出存在性与忠实性条件，配套两时间尺度策略梯度及NLI验证，在多个基准上降低欺骗并提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM作为智能体能力增强，其可能为更高奖励而欺骗人类、表面有帮助实则不忠实；现有评估主要看最终结果，不检查推理、工具使用和环境影响的忠实性。已有缓解方法依赖预定义评估器隐信念空间或一次性监控，难以扩展到自由文本语言空间，也容易被更强欺骗绕过。

Method: 把欺骗缓解建模为评估端部分可观测扩展式博弈（e-PoG）：智能体最大化奖励，监控器基于完整交互轨迹最小化智能体收益并揭示欺骗，固定验证器校验监控器主张并转化为惩罚；定义智能体与监控器之间的子博弈完美监督均衡（SPOE），证明有限博弈中的存在性，并推导两时间尺度策略梯度算法以实现忠实SPOE；实验管线加入NLI验证与确定性检查。

Result: 在Agentic Role-Playing、SearchQA和WebShop上，使用Gemma3-4B-IT与Qwen3-4B/8B进行实验，e-PoG缓解多种涌现欺骗模式，相较最强基线欺骗缓解提升26.0%，任务成功率最高提升39.8%，且收益在弱到强监督下仍保持。理论结果表明：完美验证器下所有SPOE都是忠实的；验证器不完美时，只要验证误差不反转监控器动作排序，忠实性保证仍成立。

Conclusion: 论文提出以评估端博弈监督为核心的欺骗缓解框架，将忠实性检查从最终结果扩展到完整交互轨迹，并提供均衡存在性、忠实性保证与可训练算法；实验验证其在多模型、多任务及弱到强监督场景下有效。

Abstract: As large language models become more capable agents, they can exhibit deceptive behaviors, cheating human for higher rewards while appearing helpful. We attribute this failure to evaluation-side partial observability, where models are evaluated mainly from final outcome, without checking the faithfulness of underlying reasoning, tool use, and environmental effects. Prior mitigations address this partial observability by predefined evaluator latent belief space or one-shot monitoring, which do not extend to free-form language space and vulnerable to stronger deceptions that evade simple monitoring. In this work, we formulate deception mitigation as an Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Extensive Form Game (e-PoG), a max-min framework in which an agent maximizes reward, a monitor minimizes the agent's payoff by exposing deception from the full interaction trajectory, and a fixed verifier validates the monitor's claims and converts them into penalties. We define the solution concept as a Subgame-Perfect Oversight Equilibrium (SPOE) between agent and monitor, and prove its existence in finite games. With a perfect verifier, every SPOE is faithful; with an imperfect verifier, the guarantee persists if verifier errors do not reverse the ranking of monitor actions. To achieve faithful SPOE, we derive a two-timescale policy gradient algorithm and enhance the pipeline empirically with NLI verification and deterministic checks. Experiments with Gemma3-4B-IT and Qwen3-4B/8B on Agentic Role-Playing, SearchQA, and WebShop show that e-PoG mitigates multiple emergent deception modes, outperforming the strongest baselines by 26.0% in deception mitigation and by up to 39.8% in task success. These gains persist under weak-to-strong supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/Toyoid/deceptive-agent.

</details>


### [477] [Guiding Data Allocation for Robust Subpopulation Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12884)
*Zhaoying Pan,Yipei Wang,Shenyu Lu,Xiaoqian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究子群组分布对鲁棒泛化的影响，理论上证明平衡训练数据并非唯一最优配置，并提出基于梯度的子群组比例调整方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型在训练数据上平均准确率高，但在子群组偏移（subpopulation shift）下测试表现差。常见的数据中心解决方案是强制平衡子群组比例，但完全平衡成本高、不可行，且不一定必要。因此作者质疑平衡训练数据是否为鲁棒子群组泛化的唯一最优配置。

Method: 作者扩展了高斯特征模型（Gaussian feature-model）框架，从理论上刻画了在一般训练子群组分布下的性能景观（performance landscape）；进一步推导了基于梯度的方向，用于调整子群组比例，以更高效地提升调整后准确率和最差组准确率。

Result: 理论表明存在多种配置（包括显著不平衡的配置）能与平衡配置达到相当的性能；推导出的梯度方向能更高效地改善调整后准确率与最差组准确率。

Conclusion: 策略性地分配数据比简单的平衡方法提供了更灵活、更有原则的鲁棒性能提升路径。代码已开源。

Abstract: Machine learning models often achieve high average accuracy in the training data while performing poorly on test data due to subpopulation shift. A common data-centric solution is to enforce balanced subgroup proportions, but full balance can be costly, infeasible, and not always necessary. In this work, we study whether balanced training data is the unique optimal configuration for robust subpopulation generalization. We extend a Gaussian feature-model framework to theoretically characterize the performance landscape across general training subgroup distributions. We show that multiple configurations, including substantially imbalanced ones, can perform comparably to the balanced one. We further derive gradient-based directions for adjusting subgroup proportions to improve adjusted accuracy and worst-group accuracy more efficiently. These findings suggest that strategically allocating data offers a more flexible and principled path to robust performance than simple balancing. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/subpop-data-allocation.

</details>


### [478] [Where Does Alignment Emerge and What Does It Mean? A Closer Look at the Platonic Representation Hypothesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12869)
*Julia Herbst,Simon Roschmann,Quentin Bouniot,Zeynep Akata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文重新审视"柏拉图表示假说"（PRH），定位单模态模型跨层、跨表示维度的对齐出现位置，检验新语言模型在高质量字幕条件下是否延续能力-对齐趋势，并引入单模态与多模态基线来校准跨模态表示相似度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PRH 认为神经网络正收敛到相似的表示空间，语言模型能力增强会使其表示与视觉模型对齐；但近期研究质疑该趋势对新模型是否成立，且表示相似度指标易受模型深度和宽度混淆，缺少合适基线难以解释。

Method: 作者分析单模态模型在不同层和表示维度上的对齐来源；在字幕足够干净、信息丰富的条件下检验能力-对齐趋势；并在多个数据集上构造单模态和多模态基线，对跨模态对齐进行情境化比较。

Result: 研究发现：只要字幕足够干净且信息丰富，PRH 的能力-对齐趋势对更新模型仍然成立；单模态模型的跨模态表示对齐可以超过显式对齐的视觉-语言模型，但仍显著低于同模态模型之间的对齐水平。

Conclusion: 跨模态表示对齐确实存在，但应结合层、维度及基线谨慎解读；显式多模态对齐未必优于单模态模型自然形成的对齐，PRH 的证据需在更严格的度量框架下重新评估。

Abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that neural networks are converging toward similar representation spaces. As language models become more capable, their representations are aligning with those of vision models. However, recent work has questioned whether this trend continues to hold for newer language models. Moreover, it has been shown that representation similarity metrics can be confounded by model depth and width, requiring appropriate baselines for interpretation.
