In this work, we first investigate where alignment emerges between unimodal models across model layers and representation dimensions. Next, we find that the PRH capability-alignment trend persists for newer models as long as the captions are sufficiently clean and informative. Finally, we contextualize cross-modal alignment, introducing unimodal and multimodal baselines on various datasets. Our results show that the cross-modal representational alignment of unimodal models can surpass that of explicitly aligned vision-language models, but remains substantially behind the alignment observed for models of the same modality. Code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/prh-closer-look.

</details>


### [479] [Vendi Anomaly Scores for Efficient and Accurate Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12871)
*Amey Pasarkar,Adji Bousso Dieng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"Vendi异常分数"(VAS)，从数据多样性视角重新定义异常检测：一个样本被移除后数据集多样性（Vendi分数）变化越大，越可能是异常。方法无需超参数调优、非参数、随数据规模线性扩展，在148个基准嵌入数据集上达到SOTA，并在大规模ImageNet实验中对污染率与数据规模增长保持稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异常检测对可信机器学习与科学发现至关重要，但现有方法多依赖局部密度、孤立性启发式或到拟合分布的距离，因而对邻域尺度、划分方式敏感，或依赖较强的分布假设，泛化性受限。

Method: 提出多样性视角的异常检测新范式。核心指标VAS以Vendi分数度量数据集多样性，通过计算"删除某样本后多样性下降的幅度"为该样本打分：异常样本往往携带独特信息、对整体多样性贡献大。该方法同时刻画局部冗余与全局数据结构，无需密度估计与划分启发式，也无需超参搜索，可自动适应数据的谱结构；非参数且复杂度随样本量线性增长。

Result: 在来自10个源数据集、4种嵌入架构的148个基准嵌入数据集上，VAS取得SOTA异常检测性能；在ImageNet大规模实验中，随污染率与数据规模增加仍保持稳健。

Conclusion: 将异常检测重构为"样本对整体多样性的贡献"问题，可绕开密度估计与划分启发式的固有缺陷，得到一个简洁、免调参、可扩展且性能领先的通用异常检测框架，为后续研究提供了新的方法论视角。

Abstract: Anomaly detection (AD) is a critical for trustworthy machine learning and scientific discovery. Existing methods typically define anomalies through local density, isolation heuristics, or distance from a fitted distribution, making them sensitive to neighborhood scale, partitioning choices, or restrictive distributional assumptions. In this work, we introduce a new paradigm by formulating anomaly detection from a diversity perspective. We propose the $\textit{Vendi Anomaly Score}$ (VAS), which detects anomalies by quantifying how much a sample changes the diversity of the dataset, as measured by the Vendi score, when removed. VAS captures both local redundancy and global data structure without relying on density estimation or partitioning heuristics. Moreover, VAS requires no hyperparameter tuning, instead adapting automatically to the spectral structure of the data. VAS is non-parametric and scales linearly with dataset size. Across 148 benchmark embedding datasets derived from 10 source datasets and 4 embedding architectures, VAS achieves state-of-the-art AD performance. We further validate VAS on large-scale ImageNet experiments, where it remains robust as both contamination rate and dataset scale increase.

</details>


### [480] [Adaptive Quantization Preserves Fast Rates for TD Learning over Rate-Limited Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12878)
*Sreejeet Maity,Aritra Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究通信受限条件下的策略评估问题，提出批量自适应量化TD算法（BAQ-TD），在有限容量信道下保持无量化TD的收敛速率，通信复杂度指数级改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受通信约束下的强化学习启发，关注智能体通过有限容量信道向服务器传输TD更新方向的量化估计时，能否保留无限容量信道下的统计收敛速率。

Method: 在马尔可夫决策过程环境中，采用线性函数逼近设定，提出BAQ-TD算法：用批处理（batching）降低传输信息方差，用自适应量化（adaptive quantization）编码新息（innovations）。理论分析给出高概率有限时间误差界。

Result: 证明超过某一有限信道容量时，BAQ-TD可保留无量化TD的收敛速率（仅差对数因子）。对d维值函数参数，总传输O(d log T)比特即可在T时间步长内达到阶最优速率Õ(1/T)。

Conclusion: 结果表明有限率信道下TD学习可在通信复杂度上实现指数级改进，同时保持阶最优收敛速率。

Abstract: Motivated by reinforcement learning subject to communication constraints, we study a policy evaluation problem with linear function approximation over a rate-limited channel. In our setup, an agent interacting with an unknown environment (modeled as a Markov Decision Process) transmits quantized estimates of a temporal-difference (TD) learning update direction to a server over a finite-capacity channel. Our goal is to investigate to what extent one can preserve the statistical convergence rates achievable when the channel has infinite capacity. To that end, we propose a new algorithm called Batched Adaptively Quantized TD (BAQ-TD), which uses batching to reduce the variance of the transmitted information, and adaptive quantization to encode innovations. We prove a high-probability finite-time error bound for BAQ-TD, and show that, above a certain finite channel capacity, BAQ-TD preserves the convergence rate of unquantized TD up to logarithmic factors. Specifically, for a $d$-dimensional value function parameter, we establish that transmitting a total of $\mathcal{O}(d \log(T))$ bits over a horizon of length $T$ suffices to achieve the order-optimal rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/T)$, marking an exponential improvement in communication-complexity over prior work.

</details>


### [481] [Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps: Trajectory-Free Learning for Simulating Molecular Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12880)
*Majdi Hassan,Marta Skreta,Dominique Beaini,Kirill Neklyudov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出KC-Maps：仅用无轨迹的边缘样本和已知漂移/扩散系数，学习SDE转移核，并通过边界条件与Kolmogorov–Chapman方程约束实现高效训练，在肽分子动力学模拟中显著降低GPU耗时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SDE数值积分单步便宜，但观测有意义事件常需数百万步，导致仿真墙钟时间长、硬件利用率低；现有深度学习替代方法多依赖长轨迹监督数据，适用性受限。

Method: KC-Maps学习给定初始时间与状态后、积分到任意目标时间的分布（SDE弱解/转移核）。方法仅需无轨迹的边缘样本及已知漂移和扩散系数；将边界条件直接嵌入网络结构，并利用Kolmogorov–Chapman方程构造高效训练目标。

Result: 实验表明KC-Maps能学习肽分子系统的动力学积分，并在GPU-hours指标上优于经典分子动力学模拟。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种不依赖长轨迹数据、可快速预测SDE转移分布的神经模拟方法，为分子动力学等昂贵随机过程仿真提供高效替代方案。

Abstract: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) describe stochastic processes across a wide range of scientific domains, including physics, biology, and finance. Although individual numerical integration steps are inexpensive, observing meaningful events or transitions can require millions of sequential steps, resulting in substantial wall-clock simulation time and poor hardware utilization. Deep learning offers an alternative by amortizing many integration steps into a single neural network forward pass, potentially enabling much faster simulation. However, existing supervised approaches typically require long simulated trajectory data, which restricts their applicability. In this work, we introduce Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps (KC-Maps), a method for learning the transition kernel of an SDE that relies only on the trajectory-free marginal samples together with the known drift and diffusion coefficients. Given an initial time and state of a process, KC-Maps models its distribution integrated to any given time, corresponding to the weak solution of the SDE. To recover the correct dynamics, KC-Maps satisfies two key properties: (i) it satisfies the boundary conditions, which we incorporate directly into the neural network architecture, and (ii) it respects the Kolmogorov--Chapman equation, which provides an efficient training objective. We empirically demonstrate that KC-Maps learns to integrate the dynamics of peptide molecular systems and outperforms classical molecular dynamics in terms of GPU-hours.

</details>


### [482] [NearFormer: Linear-Size Sparse Attention via Randomized Near Neighbors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12186)
*Ali Parviz,Alex Cloninger,Gal Mishne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NearFormer 将图 Transformer 的全局注意力限制在一个随机化近邻（NN）图上，以 O(|E|+nk) 的线性注意力支撑规模实现长程建模，并在精度与可扩展性之间取得良好折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图 Transformer 能捕捉长程交互，但二次注意力成本使其难以用于大规模图，因此需要一种在保留长程信息的同时降低注意力开销的方法。

Method: 提出 NearFormer：通过高效随机化构造，将每个节点连接到由标签无关的特征或谱几何定义的更广邻域中的少量近邻；NN 图通过分箱内搜索一次性构建后固定；以这些边作为稀疏全局注意力支撑，可选学习注意力偏置，同时保留原图用于局部消息传递；固定保留预算 k 时注意力支撑为 O(|E|+nk)。

Result: 在长程图基准和合成结构任务上，NearFormer 相对于局部消息传递、稠密注意力与稀疏注意力，展现出更有利的精度—可扩展性权衡。

Conclusion: NearFormer 通过固定随机近邻图上的稀疏全局注意力，在保持长程建模能力的同时获得线性规模注意力支撑，是面向大图的高效图 Transformer 方案。

Abstract: Graph transformers can capture long-range interactions, but their quadratic attention cost limits their use on large graphs. We introduce \emph{NearFormer}, a graph transformer whose global attention is restricted to a randomized near-neighbor (NN) graph. NearFormer uses an efficient randomized construction to connect each node to a small number of near neighbors from a broader neighborhood defined by a label-independent feature or spectral geometry. For a fixed retained budget \(k\), the resulting attention support has linear size \(\mathcal{O}(|E|+nk)\). The NN graph is built once by within-bin search and then held fixed. We use these edges as sparse global-attention supports, with optional learned attention biases, while preserving the original graph for local message passing. Experiments on long-range graph benchmarks and synthetic structural tasks show that NearFormer provides a favorable accuracy--scalability trade-off relative to local message passing, dense and sparse attention.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [483] [Preference-Augmented Distributional Reinforcement Learning for Risk-Sensitive Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09932)
*Zhaofan Zhang,Yue Chang,Rufeng Chen,Hechang Chen,Sihong Xie,Hui Xiong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出以分位数权重分布表示风险偏好变化，通过偏好引导探索训练，并在部署时针对最坏偏好分布优化，从而在不确定环境下实现更安全可靠的导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主系统在多种不确定性来源下安全可靠导航是核心难题。现有基于IQN的分布强化学习方法通常训练时使用固定或随机采样的标量CVaR水平，部署时依赖手工调参超参数或外部传感器信号调整风险等级，导致训练期偏好暴露与部署期风险调整不匹配，且只能在狭窄的尾部风险偏好族内学习。

Method: 将风险偏好的变化建模为分位数权重分布的偏移，而非单一标量CVaR水平；通过偏好引导的探索使智能体接触多样化风险偏好；部署阶段针对最坏情况偏好分布进行优化，推导出兼顾多种风险画像的保守策略。

Result: 在多种仿真环境和车辆平台上的实验表明，该方法在减少碰撞的同时提升了任务成功率，并降低了对超参数调优与有限传感器信号的依赖。

Conclusion: 以分位数权重分布表达风险偏好并采用最坏情况偏好优化，可缓解训练与部署阶段风险偏好不匹配问题，为部分可观测与不确定性条件下的自主导航提供更安全、鲁棒的策略。

Abstract: Ensuring safe and reliable navigation under diverse sources of uncertainty remains a central challenge for autonomous systems. Within distributional reinforcement learning (DistRL), Implicit Quantile Networks (IQN) have attracted interest for navigation under uncertainty because they enable risk adaptation through flexible quantile sampling. Existing approaches, however, typically use a fixed or randomly sampled Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) level during training and adjust the risk level during deployment using hand-tuned hyperparameters or external sensor signals. This scalar-CVaR formulation confines learning to a narrow family of tail-risk preferences, creating a mismatch between training-time preference exposure and deployment-time risk adjustment. We instead represent variations in risk preference as shifts in quantile-weight distributions and expose the agent to diverse preferences through preference-guided exploration. At deployment, we optimize against the worst-case preference distribution to derive a conservative policy that accounts for multiple risk profiles. This reduces hyperparameter tuning and reliance on limited sensor signals under partial observability. Experiments across simulated environments and vehicle platforms show that our method reduces collisions while improving task success.

</details>


### [484] [Efficient Learning of Differentiable MPC Policies on the GPU via Smoothed ADMM and First-Order Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09937)
*Jianghan Zhang,Roland Schwan,Gabriel Bravo-Palacios,John Zhang,Thomas Lew,Brian Plancher*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 SmoothedTurboMPC：一种 GPU 并行、可微的 MPC 求解器，结合 SQP 与对数障碍平滑 ADMM 内层求解，获得平滑梯度与收敛处精确敏感性；再用 SHAC 的一阶强化学习复用 rollout 中的 MPC 解来高效训练 MPC 策略，端到端训练吞吐最高提升 4.4×，赛车任务中相较 MPC PPO 回报更高且加速 46×，7 分钟训练 330 万条 transition，并在全尺寸赛车上验证了域随机化策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可微 MPC 能将结构化、约束感知的策略端到端优化，但学习 MPC 策略存在两个瓶颈：主动集切换处敏感性不光滑，以及每次策略评估都需优化求解导致计算昂贵。

Method: 1）SmoothedTurboMPC：GPU 并行的可微 MPC 求解器，将序列二次规划（SQP）与对数障碍平滑的 ADMM 内层求解器结合，实现平滑梯度、收敛处精确敏感性和 GPU 高效执行；2）训练端采用一阶强化学习 FORL 与 Short-Horizon Actor-Critic（SHAC），复用 rollout 中的 MPC 解而非反复重新评估。

Result: 与先进求解器相比，端到端训练吞吐最高提升 4.4×；在车辆竞速任务中，回报高于 MPC PPO，并获得 46× 加速，仅用 7 分钟训练 330 万条 transition；进一步通过域随机化 RL 训练更可靠的 MPC 竞速策略，并在全尺寸赛车上验证。

Conclusion: 该工作通过平滑可微 GPU MPC 求解器与高效一阶 RL 训练框架，缓解了 MPC 策略学习的非光滑敏感性和高计算成本问题，在仿真竞速与实车验证中表现有效，并已集成到开源 TurboMPC 求解器。

Abstract: Differentiable model predictive control (MPC) enables structured, constraint-aware policies to be optimized end-to-end. However, learning MPC policies faces two bottlenecks: (1) nonsmooth sensitivities at active-set transitions and (2) expensive policy evaluation, since each requires an optimization solve. We first introduce SmoothedTurboMPC, a GPU-parallel differentiable MPC solver combining sequential quadratic programming (SQP) with a log-barrier-smoothed alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) inner solver. Its design enables smooth gradients, exact sensitivities at convergence, and efficient execution on GPUs. Second, to efficiently train MPC policies, we pair our solver with first-order reinforcement learning (FORL) using Short-Horizon Actor-Critic (SHAC), which reuses rollout MPC solutions instead of repeatedly re-evaluating them. Comparisons with state of the art solvers show that the approach achieves up to $4.4\times$ higher end-to-end training throughput. On a vehicle racing task, our method achieves higher returns than MPC PPO with a $46\times$ speedup, training on 3.3 million transitions in only 7 minutes. Finally, we use the framework to train a more reliable MPC racing policy via RL with domain randomization, and validate it on a full-scale race car. We integrate our advances into the open-source TurboMPC solver.

</details>


### [485] [UniLatent: Cross-Embodiment Transfer via Latent Observation Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10061)
*Yufei Ding,Yi Du,Weiduo Yuan,Hao Jiang,Dylan Goetting,Lawrence Yunliang Chen,Daniel Seita,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: UniLatent 通过在仿真中渲染成对的源/目标机器人观测，将源视觉编码器对齐到冻结的目标编码器，从而在共享潜空间中缩小跨具身观测差异，使源机器人示教训练的策略可直接部署到目标机器人。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人数据集采集成本高且通常绑定特定具身，不同几何结构、外观与运动学的机器人之间难以复用示教数据；现有像素级图像翻译方法存在额外转换误差与部署复杂性。

Method: 提出 UniLatent 跨具身迁移框架：在仿真中渲染源机器人与目标机器人的配对观测，将源视觉编码器对齐到一个冻结的目标编码器，在共享潜空间中减少具身导致的观测差异；源示教训练的策略直接以编码后的目标观测为输入运行，无需像素级图像翻译。

Result: 在三个仿真任务、两种目标机械臂上达到最高 93% 的零样本成功率，平均超过最强像素翻译基线 30 个百分点以上；在真实 xArm→Franka 迁移中，每任务仅用 10 条目标示教微调即实现 27/30 次成功 rollout。

Conclusion: UniLatent 表明在潜空间对齐观测是一种有效且简洁的跨具身迁移方案，可显著降低对目标机器人数据的需求，并避免像素级翻译；但其对齐依赖仿真配对渲染，真实场景仍需少量目标示教微调，泛化性与更广泛具身/任务的适用性有待进一步验证。

Abstract: Robot datasets are costly to collect and are usually tied to a specific embodiment, making it difficult to reuse demonstrations across robots with different geometry, appearance, and kinematics. We introduce UniLatent, a cross-embodiment transfer framework that reduces the embodiment-induced observation gap in a shared latent space. UniLatent renders paired source-target robot observations in simulation and aligns a source visual encoder to a frozen target encoder. A policy trained on encoded source demonstrations can then run directly on target observations, with no pixel-level image translation. Across three simulation tasks and two target robot arms, UniLatent reaches up to 93% zero-shot success, exceeding the strongest pixel-translation baseline by over 30 points on average. In real-world xArm-to-Franka transfer, fine-tuning with only 10 target demonstrations per task yields 27/30 successful rollouts. Code, videos and data are available at https://selina2023.github.io/unilatent/.

</details>


### [486] [Beyond Semantic Classes: Online Physical Parameter Estimation via Embedding-Conditioned Gaussian Mixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10107)
*Alexander Borca-Tasciuc,Prayag Sharma,Franck Djeumou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于视觉嵌入、以交互经验为支撑的高斯混合后验估计器，在接触前实时推断摩擦、刚度等物理属性，并在自主赛车仿真中验证其可保留多模态信念、拒绝无关经验并提升控制适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人若能在接触前从视觉推断与交互相关的物理属性，可改善非结构化环境中的规划与控制。但视觉外观常存在歧义：相似区域在接触后可能表现出不同摩擦、刚度或下沉响应；现有方法多将歧义压缩为点估计，或用固定语义类别聚合经验，难以保留不同的物理状态。

Method: 将语义类别索引替换为以交互经验为基础、直接以连续视觉嵌入为条件的高斯混合后验；以逆建模等交互得到的高斯参数估计作为混合分量，用嵌入相似度检索并加权相关历史交互；引入支持感知融合机制，在交互历史稀疏时结合条件生成先验，并通过学习式嵌入细化提升检索相关性而不离散化表征。

Result: 实验表明该估计器能够恢复多模态物理信念、拒绝无关交互历史、避免空间地图离散化，并可在控制器频率下实时评估。在高保真自主赛车仿真中，面对未知的低/高摩擦区域，后验使控制器随着交互证据累积在多圈中持续适应，在保持摩擦感知行为的同时提升性能。

Conclusion: 以交互经验支撑的连续视觉—物理后验估计可在接触前提供多模态、可实时更新的物理属性信念，为不确定环境中的适应控制提供有效支持。

Abstract: Enabling robots to infer interaction-relevant physical properties from vision before contact would improve planning and control in unstructured environments. Vision provides useful pre-contact information, but appearance alone is often ambiguous: visually similar regions can induce different friction, stiffness, or sinkage responses upon contact. Existing approaches often collapse this ambiguity to a point estimate or aggregate experience through fixed semantic classes, limiting their ability to preserve distinct physical regimes. Instead, we propose a real-time estimator that replaces semantic class indexing with an interaction-grounded Gaussian-mixture posterior over latent physical parameters, conditioned directly on continuous visual embeddings. Our approach maintains interaction-derived Gaussian parameter estimates, typically from inverse modeling, as mixture components while using embedding similarity to retrieve and weight relevant past interactions for each new query region. A support-aware fusion mechanism incorporates a conditional generative prior model when interaction history is sparse, while a learned embedding refinement improves retrieval relevance without discretizing the representation. Our experiments show that the estimator recovers multimodal physical beliefs, rejects unrelated interaction history, avoids spatial map discretization, and evaluates at controller rates. In a high-fidelity autonomous racing simulation with unknown low- and high-friction surface regions, the posterior enables the controller to adapt over repeated laps as interaction evidence accumulates, improving performance while maintaining friction-aware behavior.

</details>


### [487] [A Unified Inertial Encoder for Human and Humanoid Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10137)
*Yutian Chen,Shibo Zhao,Rocky Duan,Karen Liu,Carmelo Sferrazza,Guanya Shi,Yuheng Qiu,Koushil Sreenath*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出统一惯性编码器，通过运动学IMU合成在人体与人形对应部位建立共享输入空间，联合训练速度估计与动作-文本对齐，实现零样本迁移到真实Unitree G1，并取得最低速度误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人的状态估计与语言驱动动作理解受限于机器人自身动作覆盖范围；人类运动数据覆盖更广，但跨人体与人形迁移需克服身体几何、传感配置和物理扰动差异。

Method: 构建统一惯性编码器，利用运动学IMU合成将人体与人形运动表示在对应身体部位；在该共同输入空间中，对真实人体运动与运动学重定向的人形运动进行联合训练，同时学习速度估计和动作-文本对齐，并采用连续时间编码及传感器与运动随机化。

Result: 模型无需物理仿真、真实机器人训练轨迹或微调即可零样本迁移至物理Unitree G1；在五个数据集上取得评估方法中最低速度误差，真实G1上为0.099 m/s；动作描述检索还能泛化到仅在人类训练中出现过的重定向G1动作类别。

Conclusion: 研究表明，人类运动知识可有效支持人形机器人惯性里程计与语言驱动动作理解的泛化。

Abstract: Learning humanoid state estimation and language-grounded motion understanding from robot recordings ties training coverage to the robot's motion repertoire. Human motion datasets offer broader coverage, yet transferring this knowledge requires overcoming differences in body geometry, sensing, and physical disturbances. To enable this transfer, we propose a unified inertial encoder whose shared inertial interface uses kinematic IMU synthesis to represent human and humanoid motion at corresponding body sites. Within this common input space, joint training on human and kinematically retargeted humanoid motion combines velocity estimation and motion--text alignment with continuous-time encoding and sensor and motion randomization. The resulting model transfers zero-shot to a physical Unitree G1 without physics simulation, real-robot training trajectories, or fine-tuning, achieving the lowest velocity error among evaluated methods across five datasets, including 0.099m/s on real G1. Its motion-description retrieval also extends to retargeted G1 motion categories observed only in human training, demonstrating how human motion knowledge can support the generalization of humanoid inertial odometry and language-grounded motion understanding.

</details>


### [488] [BATCH: Behavior Alignment for Cross-Embodiment Learning from Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10148)
*Zeyi Liu,Shuran Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出跨具身学习框架 BATCH，通过对齐人类与机器人行为，将人类演示更有效地迁移到机器人策略中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类演示数据多样且易获取，但由于具身形态、视角、动作空间和时间结构差异，直接用于机器人学习仍很困难，因此需要显式对齐人-机器人行为。

Method: BATCH 采用自监督时序表示学习，并以循环一致性（cycle-consistency）目标在无人工标注下建立跨具身对应关系；随后在自回归视频-动作扩散模型中引入两种互补训练目标：行为对齐协同训练与“人到机器人”风格迁移。

Result: 在真实世界操作任务上，相比使用未对齐数据训练及已有跨具身基线，BATCH 对未见任务配置的泛化能力更好，且风格迁移目标带来额外增益。

Conclusion: 研究表明，显式行为对齐能够使人类演示更有效地迁移为机器人策略，是提升跨具身学习效果的关键。

Abstract: Human demonstrations provide a scalable source of diverse manipulation data, but leveraging them for robot learning remains challenging due to differences in embodiment, viewpoint, action spaces, and temporal structure. We introduce BATCH, a cross-embodiment learning framework that explicitly aligns human and robot behaviors. BATCH learns self-supervised temporal representations with a cycle-consistency objective to establish cross-embodiment correspondences without manual annotation. We further introduce two complementary training objectives that leverage these correspondences within an autoregressive videoaction diffusion model: behavior-aligned co-training and human-to-robot style transfer. On real-world manipulation tasks, BATCH improves generalization to unseen task configurations compared with training on unaligned data and prior cross-embodiment baselines, with additional gains from the style-transfer objective. Our results demonstrate that explicit behavior alignment enables more effective transfer from human demonstrations to robot policies.

</details>


### [489] [Capturability-Aware Footstep Planning in Cluttered Environments: A Recursively Feasible Sequential MPC on Axis-Aligned Safe Corridors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10169)
*Athanasios Kyriakopoulos,Shubham S. Kumbhar,Kunal S. Narkhede,Abhijeet M. Kulkarni,Ioannis Poulakakis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种感知可捕获性的序列MPC框架，用于基于LIP模型的人形机器人落脚点规划，在障碍物环境中联合保证避障与行走稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人落脚点规划的核心难点在于同时保证避障与行走稳定性（可捕获性），二者往往被割裂处理；同时需要在执行中遇到突发阻塞（如门突然关闭）时仍保持可行与安全。

Method: 以相交矩形序列构造安全走廊，将避障与可捕获性约束统一编码；在此之上构建序列MPC框架，对LIP规划层给出递归可行性保证；并使规划器可自动切换到原地踏步模式以应对受阻场景。

Result: 性能在很大程度上与预测时域无关，可在保持低计算成本的同时获得高成功率；在高保真仿真中以Digit人形机器人验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作为杂乱环境中可捕获的人形机器人落脚点规划提供了一种实用方案，兼顾避障、稳定性与计算效率。

Abstract: A fundamental aspect of humanoid footstep planning is to jointly guarantee obstacle avoidance and locomotion stability. This paper presents a capturability-aware sequential Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework for Linear Inverted Pendulum (LIP)-based humanoid footstep planning in the presence of obstacles. The proposed method combines obstacle avoidance with capturability constraints through safe corridors constructed as sequences of intersecting rectangles, yielding a sequential MPC framework with recursive feasibility guarantees for the LIP-based planning layer. The planner autonomously adapts to constrained scenarios, switching to in-place walking when obstructions---such as doors assumed to be open during planning but unexpectedly found to be closed during execution---block forward motion. Performance is largely independent of the prediction horizon, allowing high success rates while keeping the computational cost low. The approach is validated in high-fidelity simulations with the humanoid robot Digit, demonstrating a practical solution for capturable humanoid footstep planning in cluttered environments.

</details>


### [490] [Agibot: An Open-Source Modular Swerve-Drive Robot Platform for Agricultural Robotics Research and Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10235)
*Moeen Ul Islam,Bishal Adhikari,Kori Edwards,Lorien Harvey,J. Alex Thomasson,Dong Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Agibot——一个开源、模块化、低成本的农业机器人平台，集成四轮独立转向驱动、可换计算单元、分布式嵌入式控制、多模态感知与可配置机械臂，并在"感知—规划—执行—验证"闭环框架下完成行栽作物导航与操作任务的实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业生产面临持续的劳动力短缺和对自动化的旺盛需求，但农业机器人研究进展受限于缺乏价格可负担、灵活且易于获取的研究平台，同时机器人教学也需要可动手操作的低成本平台。

Method: 构建开源模块化低成本平台 Agibot：四轮独立转向驱动、可替换计算模块、分布式嵌入式控制、多模态传感、可配置操作（机械臂），统一在感知—规划—执行—验证（sense-plan-act-verify）框架内，支撑感知、控制、导航、操作与自主任务验证；通过不同光照与土壤条件下的行栽作物导航与操作任务进行评测，并开展控制器调参研究与集成试验。

Result: 实验实现了可靠的车道跟随、行间自主导航、目标识别、播种（种子分发）、植株操作以及任务成功与否的闭环验证；模块化架构支持各自主性组件的独立测试、修改与验证，便于快速原型开发。

Conclusion: Agibot 以低成本、模块化、开源可获得、可配置操作与端到端自主闭环为特点，为农业机器人研究、技术开发与人才培养提供了实用平台；当前为概念验证性质，未来仍需在更复杂田间条件下扩展验证。

Abstract: Agricultural production faces persistent labor shortages and increasing demand for automation, yet progress in agricultural robotics remains constrained by the limited availability of affordable, flexible, and accessible research platforms. This paper presents Agibot, an open-source, modular, low-cost agricultural robotics platform designed for autonomy research and experimentation, with potential applications in hands-on robotics education. The platform integrates four-wheel independent swerve drive, swappable computing, distributed embedded control, multimodal sensing, and configurable manipulation within a unified sense-plan-act-verify framework supporting perception, control, navigation, manipulation, and autonomous task verification. The platform was evaluated through representative row-crop navigation and manipulation tasks under varying lighting and soil conditions. Experiments demonstrated reliable lane following, autonomous row-to-row navigation, target identification, seed dispensing, plant manipulation, and closed-loop verification of task success. Its modular architecture supports independent testing, modification, and validation of autonomy components for rapid prototyping and experimentation. These proof-of-concept tasks, controller-tuning studies, and integrated trials demonstrate the platform's research capabilities, while its accessible and reconfigurable design supports its use for hands-on robotics education. By combining affordability, modularity, open-source accessibility, configurable manipulation, and end-to-end sense-plan-act-verify autonomy, Agibot provides a practical platform for agricultural robotics research, technology development, and workforce training.

</details>


### [491] [DASH-SLAM: Calibration-Free Metric Monocular SLAM via Depth Scale Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10239)
*Otavio Ribas,Jacopo Panerati,Pierre-Yves Lajoie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 DASH-SLAM：无需任务微调，将 Depth Anything 3 的度量深度预测融入共享关键帧位姿图，通过跨重建累积的尺度校正实现单目 SLAM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何基础模型虽能估计稠密几何与相机参数，但可靠 SLAM 还需跨连续重建的一致尺度和准确数据关联；现有基础模型 SLAM 在尺度一致性与感知退化场景下仍有不足。

Method: 从共享锚点图像处深度比推导尺度校正，并用阻尼因子控制其影响；将校应用于里程计平移、回环约束与地图几何；在共享关键帧位姿图中集成预训练 Depth Anything 3 的度量深度，且不做任务特定微调。

Result: 在 TUM、Replica、7-Scenes 上优于现有方法；用刚性与相似变换对齐区分度量尺度保真度与尺度外精度；在 Unified Autonomy Stack 的隧道、雾、冻湖等四个感知退化序列上优于基础模型 SLAM 先进方法，并在经典 SLAM 失效处保持跟踪。

Conclusion: DASH-SLAM 以轻量尺度校正有效提升单目基础模型 SLAM 的尺度一致性和鲁棒性，在标准与感知退化场景中均表现优越。

Abstract: Geometric foundation models estimate dense geometry and camera parameters from monocular images, but reliable SLAM also requires consistent scale and accurate data association across successive reconstructions. We present DASH-SLAM, a monocular SLAM system that integrates metric depth predictions from pretrained Depth Anything 3 into a shared-keyframe pose graph without task-specific fine-tuning. DASH-SLAM derives scale corrections from depth ratios at shared anchor images and accumulates them across reconstructions, with a damping factor controlling their influence. These corrections rescale odometry translations, loop constraints, and map geometry. Experiments on TUM, Replica, and 7-Scenes show that DASH-SLAM outperforms state-of-the-art methods. We evaluate performance using both rigid and similarity alignment to distinguish metric-scale fidelity from accuracy up to scale. We further evaluate DASH-SLAM on four challenging sequences in perceptually-degraded environments from the Unified Autonomy Stack field dataset, covering tunnels, fog, and a frozen lake. On these sequences, DASH-SLAM outperforms the foundation-model SLAM state-of-the-art and maintains tracking where classical SLAM methods fail.

</details>


### [492] [OfficeTwin: Realizing 3D Reconstruction of Redundant Scenes through Partial Viewpoint Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10241)
*Quanyun Wu,Kyle Gao,Daisy Li,Kshitij Goyal,Dayou Mao,David A. Clausi,Jonathan Li,Yuhao Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OfficeTwin：面向机器人原生采集的办公场景数字孪生框架，将前馈3D重建得到的不完整点云，通过度量/结构约束与重复隔间（cubicle）配准到共享规范帧，生成可仿真的独立水密实体，避免生成式方法在不完整视角下的几何幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3D重建虽比COLMAP快几个数量级且在弱纹理、重复结构上更稳健，但原始点云缺少物体身份、物理属性和水密体积，无法直接用于机器人学习。机器人受自由度限制只看到物体的部分视角，办公室大量重复且弱纹理的结构使不同工位难以区分，产生冗余与残缺观测；现有图像到3D生成方法在视角不完整时会产生几何幻觉并混淆重复实例。

Method: 提出机器人原生框架OfficeTwin：先将无标定单目视频流转化为稠密点云；随后施加度量与结构约束；再利用办公环境的结构冗余性，把重复的隔间配准到统一的规范帧（canonical frame），在共享帧中融合多视角的互补观测以补全单视角被遮挡的几何，从而避免生成式幻觉。

Result: 在真实办公室扫描数据上，OfficeTwin将每个隔间重建为单独水密、具备度量尺度的实体；实验结果优于前馈重建方法与生成式基线，后者无法产出可直接用于仿真的资产。

Conclusion: 通过显式利用场景的结构重复性而非依赖生成先验，可在机器人受限视角的不完整观测下获得高保真、无水密缺陷的可仿真数字孪生，为机器人学习提供具备物体身份与物理属性的场景资产。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction turns an uncalibrated monocular stream into a dense point cloud in a single inference pass, orders of magnitude faster than classical structure-from-motion (e.g., COLMAP), and reliable on the weakly textured, repetitive surfaces where keypoint matching fails outright. However, raw point clouds lack the object identity, physical properties, and watertight volume required for robot learning. This gap widens under robot-native capture. A camera mounted on a robot constrained to a few degrees of freedom sees each object only partially, and the repetitive, weakly textured structure of an office makes distinct workstations nearly indistinguishable, leaving redundant and partial observations that downstream reconstruction cannot resolve. Existing image-to-3D generation methods struggle with these conditions, hallucinating geometry under incomplete views and confusing repeated instances. We present OfficeTwin, a robot-native framework that converts these incomplete observations into simulation-ready digital twins. OfficeTwin first imposes metric and structural constraints, then exploits the office's structural redundancy by registering repeated cubicles into a shared canonical frame, where complementary observations recover geometry occluded in any single view without hallucination. On a real office scan, OfficeTwin recovers every cubicle as an individually watertight, metric solid, outperforming feed-forward reconstruction and generative baselines that fail to produce simulation-ready assets.

</details>


### [493] [Look Only Where You Plan for Real-Time End-to-End Urban Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10264)
*Haohua Que,Tianle Zhu,Qianyi Wu,Zhipeng Bao,Handong Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LOWP：一个"只在规划处看"的轻量驾驶规划器，用两组16个可学习query经标定直接读取相机特征（3D锚点采样 + 视线射线标注的注意力），不构建稠密BEV、不做目标/地图监督，在nuScenes、NAVSIM、Bench2Drive上以紧凑表示取得有竞争力的规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强驾驶规划器中稠密BEV构建占约60%参数量，计算与存储开销大且需目标/地图监督；作者希望用稀疏、任务导向的表示替代稠密BEV，只在规划所需位置读取视觉信息。

Method: 采用"只在规划处看"的范式：两组各16个可学习query通过已知相机标定直接查询图像特征——一组在投影的3D锚点处采样图像特征（anchor-based reader），一组对带有视线（viewing ray）标注的特征做注意力（global reader）；不构建稠密BEV，也不对目标或地图做监督。评测覆盖开环nuScenes、伪仿真NAVSIM与闭环Bench2Drive。

Result: nuScenes上平均L2由0.302降至0.296 m，参数量为稠密对照的53%，同GPU速度为其1.7倍；锚点式读取器在转弯场景优于全局读取器。NAVSIM上用轨迹词表打分可在不重训情况下达到85.9 PDMS。闭环控制配置在218条路线上得65.5分，存在刹车导致的停车失效，其释放规则的总体收益尚无定论。作者区分了实测延迟与跨硬件迁移估计，后者不足以建立同硬件排序。

Conclusion: 稀疏、查询驱动的读取方式可在显著降低参数与计算的同时保持有竞争力的规划精度，说明稠密BEV并非必需；不同读取器适配不同场景（转弯偏好锚点式），而闭环失效模式与延迟评测口径仍需进一步厘清。

Abstract: Dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) construction accounts for 60% of the parameters in a strong recent driving planner. This paper presents LOWP, a planner that looks only where it plans: two sets of sixteen learnable queries read the cameras through the known calibration, one by sampling image features at projected 3D anchors and one by attending to features labeled with their viewing rays, so no dense BEV is built and no object or map is supervised. Evaluations on open-loop nuScenes, pseudo-simulated NAVSIM and closed-loop Bench2Drive show competitive planning with a compact representation. On nuScenes, average L2 changes from 0.302 to 0.296 m with 53% of the dense counterpart's parameters and 1.7 times its speed on the same GPU; the anchor-based reader performs better on turns than the global reader. On NAVSIM, scoring the planner's own trajectories alongside a vocabulary gives 85.9 PDMS without retraining. The closed-loop control configuration scores 65.5 on 218 routes, with a brake-induced standstill failure whose release rule has an inconclusive aggregate benefit. We distinguish measured latency from hardware-transferred estimates, which do not establish a common-hardware ranking.

</details>


### [494] [Who Taught the Robot That? Removing One User's Corrections from a Robot Policy That Learns Online](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10280)
*Eshika Pathak,Leela Krishna*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 机器人部署后由多名用户先后纠正，其中一人可能事后要求被移除；论文表明"能否忘记此人"取决于用户纠正方式：接管式纠错只需按序重放日志即可近似"此人从未存在"的目标机器人，而仅微调动作时其他用户的纠正已携带其影响，没有方法能恢复目标机器人。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人持续学习场景中会出现"数据移除/遗忘"的需求（如某位用户撤回其交互数据）。现有做法常是删数据后重新训练，但作者指出这忽略了训练顺序，因此需要明确定义移除目标，并考察不同纠错交互方式下该目标是否可达。

Method: 将移除目标形式化为"该用户从未出现时会存在的那个机器人"，并在两个模拟任务、脚本化用户的设定下精确计算该目标；对比两类纠错交互（接管控制 vs. 仅微调动作）下多种移除/再训练方法的可达性，包括按原始顺序重放剩余会话、单遍删除数据重训、以及在训练缓冲存在的情况下继续训练等。

Result: 在接管控制式纠错下，按原顺序重放剩余会话得到的机器人与目标机器人差距仅达训练噪声水平；而删除数据单遍重训不行，即使其他用户的纠正不依赖被移除者，因为丢失了训练顺序。在仅微调动作的纠错下，其他用户的纠正已包含被移除者的影响，所测方法均无法恢复目标机器人；不带此人继续训练可消除大部分习惯，但消除不了其数据在缓冲中"维持"的部分。此外日志能识别明显有害用户，但在影响力排序上不如简单统计纠正次数。

Conclusion: 移除的可行性与纠错交互形式紧密相关：可追溯、有序的训练日志对"忘记某人"至关重要，单纯删数据重训并不等价；当用户纠错是微调式的，影响已弥散到他人数据中，精确遗忘基本不可行，实用上只能做到部分遗忘或粗粒度识别（如找出明显有害用户）。

Abstract: A robot that keeps learning after deployment is corrected by several people in turn, and one of them may later ask to be removed. We show that whether the robot can forget that person depends on how people correct it. The goal of removal is the robot that would exist if the person had never been there, which we compute exactly in two simulated tasks with scripted users. When users correct the robot by taking over control, an ordered log of training updates is enough: retraining on the remaining sessions in their original order gives a robot as close to the goal as training noise allows. Deleting the person's data and retraining in one pass does not, even when the other users' corrections do not depend on the removed person, because it loses the order of training. When users only nudge the robot's action, the other users' corrections carry the removed person's influence, and no method we tested recovers the goal robot. Continuing to train without the person removes most of their habits, but not what their data in the training buffer keep alive. The log can identify one clearly harmful user, but not rank users by influence better than counting their corrections.

</details>


### [495] [Mobility Information Capacity of Multi-Robot Systems: Safety-Aware Maneuver Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10298)
*Weijie Yuan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出“移动信息容量”（MIC）框架，用联合机动序列与其含噪轨迹观测之间的互信息来量化多机器人系统可观测的机动自由度，并在机动资源约束下求其最大值；针对线性高斯反馈动力学模型推导有限时域基准与长时域平稳谱极限，将安全约束映射为协方差约束，并构造有限机动码本与误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共享工作空间中的多机器人需不断调整速度、方向与轨迹以协调并应对扰动，但机器人数量、空间占用率和任务吞吐量无法刻画机队可改变运动的程度，也无法说明这些变化能否被可靠观测。因此需要一种同时刻画“机动自由度”和“可观测性”的度量。

Method: 定义移动信息为联合机动序列与含噪轨迹观测之间的互信息，在机动资源约束下最大化该量形成MIC。针对带反馈动力学的线性高斯机动—观测模型，推导有限时域信息基准及稳态长时域谱极限，考虑异构机动增益、有色不确定性和时间耦合机动代价；将工作空间边界、机器人间分离和执行器机会约束映射为耦合机动协方差约束，给出协方差优化可退化为移动模式间资源分配的条件；通过个体风险筛选和噪声白化轨迹分离构造有限联合机动码本，并建立序列恢复误差与实现信息相对容量基准的界。

Result: 给出了线性高斯反馈系统下的有限时域信息基准与长时域平稳谱容量极限；刻画了安全约束下的可行机动协方差集合及资源分配型优化条件；构造了有限机动码本并给出恢复误差和信息达成度的理论界；空中机器人仿真验证了谱收敛、安全感知分配、有限码本识别以及机队规模缩放规律。

Conclusion: MIC框架从信息论角度量化多机器人移动系统支持的最大可观测机动自由度，可作为占用率与任务吞吐量指标的有效补充，为共享工作空间中机队机动能力、安全约束与可观测协调性的联合评估提供依据。

Abstract: Multiple robots operating in shared workspaces must adjust their speed, direction, and trajectories to coordinate with one another and respond to changing tasks and disturbances. The available maneuver freedom depends on the dynamics, uncertainty, and safety margins, even for a fixed fleet size and workspace. However, robot count, workspace occupancy, and task throughput do not quantify how much the fleet can vary its motion or how reliably these variations can be observed. We develop a mobility information capacity (MIC) framework that jointly characterizes these two aspects. Mobility information is defined as the mutual information between a joint maneuver sequence and its noisy trajectory observation, and MIC maximizes this quantity under maneuver-resource constraints. For a linear Gaussian maneuver-to-observation model with feedback dynamics, we characterize the finite-horizon information benchmark and derive its stationary long-horizon spectral limit, accounting for heterogeneous mobility gains, colored uncertainty, and temporally coupled maneuver costs. We further map workspace-boundary, inter-robot separation, and actuator chance constraints into coupled maneuver-covariance restrictions and derive conditions under which covariance optimization reduces to resource allocation across mobility modes. Finite joint maneuver codebooks are then constructed through individual risk screening and noise-whitened trajectory separation, with bounds linking sequence recovery error and achieved information to the capacity benchmarks. An aerial-robot simulation study evaluates spectral convergence, safety-aware allocation, finite-codebook identification, and fleet-size scaling. The resulting framework complements occupancy and task-throughput measures by quantifying the maximum observable maneuver freedom supported by a mobility system.

</details>


### [496] [GUARD: Anomaly-Informed Q-Steering for Generative Robot Policies in Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10343)
*Aryaman Gupta,Xiaoyue Wu,Rana Soltani Zarrin,Mark Van der Merwe*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GUARD——一种基于异常感知的Q引导框架，用策略训练分布学到的稠密异常分数与稀疏任务奖励共同训练Q函数，通过梯度在去噪过程中引导动作，避免进入低支持区域，无需修改预训练策略即可提升闭环鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/流匹配生成的机器人策略能刻画复杂的多模态行为，但在闭环执行中易受协变量偏移影响而失败。现有缓解手段（增加示范数据、策略微调、测试时引导）往往需要人工介入、手工设计奖励或其他任务特定信号，代价高且通用性差。作者希望利用策略自身训练分布中蕴含的信息，构造一种无需额外标注的失败预警信号。

Method: GUARD将稀疏任务奖励与从策略训练数据中学到的稠密异常分数相结合，两者共同通过一个学习到的Q函数进行传播；再由Q函数梯度在扩散/流匹配的去噪过程中对采样动作施加引导，使动作同时提升任务回报并远离数据支持不足的区域。整个过程只做推理时的引导，不直接修改预训练策略参数。

Result: 在四个Adroit灵巧操作任务上，GUARD在名义动力学下平均成功率96.0%，扰动动力学下80.0%，分别比最强基线高21.0和20.0个百分点，且异常分数最低。在手中螺丝刀旋转与重定向任务上实现直接sim-to-real迁移，成功率分别提升40和25个百分点。

Conclusion: 实验表明异常信号不仅能用于失败监测，还可以作为稀疏任务奖励的有效补充监督，用于实现鲁棒的策略引导；该框架在不改动预训练策略、不依赖额外示范或人工奖励的前提下显著提升了闭环执行的鲁棒性与实机迁移性能。

Abstract: Generative robot policies based on diffusion and flow matching can model complex, multimodal behaviors, but remain susceptible to covariate shift during closed-loop execution. Existing approaches mitigate such failures through additional demonstrations, policy fine-tuning, or test-time guidance, but often require human intervention, engineered rewards, or other task-specific signals. We introduce GUARD, an anomaly-informed Q-steering framework that leverages the policy's training distribution to construct a dense, failure-anticipatory steering signal. GUARD pairs sparse task rewards with dense anomaly scores learned from policy training data and propagates both through a learned Q-function. Its gradients then steer the denoising process toward actions that improve task return while preventing trajectories from entering poorly supported regions, without directly modifying the pretrained policy. Across four Adroit dexterous manipulation tasks, GUARD achieves average success rates of $96.0\%$ and $80.0\%$ under nominal and perturbed dynamics, outperforming the strongest baseline by $21.0$ and $20.0$ percentage points while maintaining the lowest anomaly score. GUARD further demonstrates direct sim-to-real transfer on in-hand screwdriver rotation and reorientation tasks, achieving $40$ and $25$ percentage-point gains in success rate. These results demonstrate that anomaly signals can serve not only for failure monitoring but also to complement sparse task rewards as effective supervision for robust policy steering.

</details>


### [497] [LSRP*: Scalable and Anytime Planning for Multi-Agent Path Finding with Asynchronous Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10363)
*Dachuan Liu,Shuai Zhou,Shizhe Zhao,Zhongqiang Ren*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LSRP*：面向非同步动作多智能体路径规划的 anytime 规划器，在 LSRP 初始解基础上持续优化解质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流 MAPF 算法依赖“同步动作”假设（所有智能体动作同时开始且耗时恰为一个时间单位），这一假设限制其在实践中的应用。已有的 Loosely Synchronized Rule-based Planning（LSRP）虽能摆脱该假设并为大量智能体求得次优解，但因其次优性无界，解质量往往很差。

Method: 提出新的 anytime 规划器 LSRP*，在获得初始解后继续迭代改进解的质量，直至运行时预算耗尽；论文对 LSRP* 的性质进行了理论分析，并在多种地图上与若干基线算法进行比较，智能体规模最多达 1000。

Result: LSRP* 可处理比 LSRP 多约 25% 的智能体数量，并能将 LSRP 所得解的成本最多降低约 40%；实验涵盖多类地图与最多 1000 个智能体的场景。

Conclusion: 将 LSRP 从单纯求次优解扩展为 anytime 框架，可在保持大规模可扩展性的同时显著改善解质量，从而缓解同步动作假设带来的实用限制。

Abstract: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) seeks collision-free paths for multiple agents from their respective starting locations to their respective goal locations while minimizing path costs. Although many MAPF algorithms were developed, most of them rely on a common assumption on synchronized actions, where the actions of all agents start at the same time and always take a time unit. This assumption may limit the use of MAPF planners in practice. To get rid of this assumption, recently, an algorithm called Loosely Synchronized Rule-based Planning (LSRP) was proposed, which can find sub-optimal solutions for many agents. However, LSRP often finds poor quality solutions due to its unbounded sub-optimality. This paper develops a new anytime planner called LSRP* that can keep improving solution quality after the initial solution is obtained until the runtime budget depletes. We analyze the properties of LSRP* and test it against several baselines with up to 1000 agents on various maps. LSRP* can handle up to 25% more agents than LSRP and can reduce up to 40% of the solution cost found by LSRP.

</details>


### [498] [CPNav: Calibrated Vision-Language Navigation for Object-Goal Search in Unseen Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10366)
*Qizhao Chen,Yuanhong Zeng,Shoh Nishino,Anushri Dixit*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CPNav is a map-free object-goal navigation framework that combines collision-aware planning with conformally calibrated VLM action scoring, achieving consistent gains in SR/SPL in simulation and on a real robot.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Locating a target object in unseen environments is a core embodied AI challenge. VLM-based methods offer strong semantic reasoning but yield uncalibrated, overconfident action decisions.

Method: CPNav builds a navigability map from RGB-D, generates collision-free motion primitives, and queries two VLMs for goal detection and action scoring. These scores are calibrated offline via conformal prediction using oracle actions from a tree-structured exploration procedure with backtracking, giving finite-sample guarantees at a user-specified risk level. The CP layer is model-agnostic; online, calibrated scores guide action selection while the exploration history enables backtracking.

Result: 在Habitat仿真中，相较未校准基线，CPNav在HM3D v0.2上SR、SPL相对提升6.2%和11.4%，在MP3D上提升12.4%和8.8%；在改装Hiwonder MentorPi机器人真实部署中，SR和SPL分别提升24.9%和15.2%。

Conclusion: CPNav将碰撞感知规划与统计校准的VLM动作评分相结合，提供了模型无关、带有限样本保证的导航方案，并在仿真与真实机器人上验证有效。

Abstract: Directing a robot to locate a target object in unseen environments remains a central challenge in embodied AI. Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based methods provide rich semantic reasoning but often produce uncalibrated and overconfident action decisions. We introduce CPNav, a navigation framework that combines collision-aware planning with statistically calibrated VLM action scoring for map-free object-goal navigation. From RGB-D input, CPNav constructs a navigability map, generates collision-free motion primitives, and queries two VLMs for goal detection and action scoring. The resulting scores are calibrated offline via conformal prediction (CP) using oracle actions obtained through a tree-structured exploration procedure with backtracking, providing finite-sample guarantees at a user-specified risk level. The CP layer is model-agnostic and can wrap any VLM policy. Online, calibrated VLM scores guide action selection, while a tree-structured exploration history records alternative actions and allows backtracking. We evaluate CPNav in both simulation and real-world hardware settings. In AI Habitat simulation, compared with the uncalibrated baseline method, CPNav achieves relative SR and SPL improvements of 6.2% and 11.4% on HM3D v0.2, and 12.4% and 8.8% on MP3D, respectively. In real-world deployment on a modified Hiwonder MentorPi robot, the corresponding improvements in SR and SPL are 24.9% and 15.2%, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/practice-lab-ucla/CPnav.

</details>


### [499] [Detecting and Explaining Robot Policy Failures from Sparse Internal Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10400)
*Riad Ahmed,Sujosh Nag,Moniruzzaman Akash,Momotaz Begum*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MIND 通过稀疏自编码器拆解视觉运动策略的内部激活，得到可解释特征，并据此在执行中检测与解释失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉运动策略虽能完成多种机器人操作任务，但失败原因难以理解：陌生条件与微小动作误差都会导致失败，仅从外部观察机器人无法知道策略内部出了什么问题。

Method: 用稀疏自编码器将策略内部激活分解为可单独研究的特征；通过与机器人位置、运动及周边环境的关联赋予特征语义，并通过激活引导（steering）检验其对动作的影响；从成功与失败轨迹中学习特征在失败前的变化模式，执行时检测偏离并用贡献最大的特征进行描述。

Result: 仿真与实机实验表明，这些内部特征的变化有助于检测并解释失败；检测与诊断共用同一套特征，使失败信号与策略内部可理解的变化相连接。

Conclusion: MIND 将机制可解释性引入策略诊断，实现"检测—解释"一体的失败分析框架。

Abstract: Visuomotor policies can handle many robot manipulation tasks, but understanding their failures remains difficult. Unfamiliar conditions and small action errors can lead to failure, yet watching the robot alone tells us little about what went wrong inside the policy. We introduce MIND (Mechanistic Interpretability for Neural Diagnosis), a method that looks inside a trained policy to detect failures during execution and identify the internal concepts involved. MIND uses a sparse autoencoder to break down the policy's internal activations into features that can be studied individually. We give meaning to these features by linking their activity to the robot's position, movement, and surroundings, and by steering their activations to examine how they affect the robot's actions. From successful and failed executions, we learn how the features behave on the way to a failure. During execution, MIND flags deviations from these patterns and uses the meaningful features contributing most to the change to describe the problem. Experiments in simulation and on a physical robot show that changes in these internal features help detect and explain failures. By using the same features for detection and diagnosis, MIND connects failure signals to understandable changes inside the policy.

</details>


### [500] [SimDuoReal: Object-Centric Bimanual Policy for Emergent Dexterity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10410)
*Qiyang Yan,Yulin Liu,Akash Sharma,Haozhi Qi,Guanya Shi,C. Karen Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 通过简单的以物体为中心的学习目标，让复杂的双手灵巧操作行为自发涌现并被提炼为单一通用策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双手灵巧操作需要协调臂与手，但手动指定这种协调方式困难且往往依赖具体任务，因此作者希望探索是否能让复杂双手灵巧性从简单的以物体为中心的学习目标中自动涌现。

Method: 在共享的以物体为中心的奖励下训练强化学习策略，仅改变训练环境而非为每种行为单独调优奖励；策略自发学会预抓取操作、抓取与重抓、手内调整和交接。随后在过渡状态上细化专家策略，并利用 DAgger 与强化学习将其蒸馏为单一策略。

Result: 在真实硬件上，同一策略在四个任务、未见物体且无任务特定微调的情况下于80次试验中成功61次（76.3%）；在仿真条码扫描任务中达到85.0%成功率，而两个不含交接的单臂策略为60.4%。

Conclusion: 该以物体为中心的目标为学习通用双手灵巧性提供了简单且可扩展的接口，将负担从手动设计机器人协调转移到指定物体应如何变化。

Abstract: Bimanual dexterous manipulation requires coordinated arm and hand control, yet specifying such coordination manually is challenging and often task-specific. In this work, we explore whether complex bimanual dexterity can emerge from a simple object-centric learning objective. We train reinforcement learning policies under a shared object-centric reward, varying their training environments rather than tuning separate rewards for each behavior. We find that the policies discover pre-grasp manipulation, grasping and regrasping, in-hand adjustment and handover to reach object-pose goals without hand-designed motion sequences. We then refine the experts on transition states and use DAgger and reinforcement learning to distill them into a single policy that composes these behaviors for diverse bimanual tasks. On real hardware, the same policy succeeds in 61 of 80 trials (76.3\%) across four tasks with unseen objects and no task-specific fine-tuning. In simulated barcode scanning, our policy achieves 85.0\% success, compared with 60.4\% for two single-arm policies without handover. These results suggest that this objective provides a simple and scalable interface for learning general bimanual dexterity, shifting the burden from manually designing robot coordination to specifying what should happen to the object.

</details>


### [501] [Deploying Physically and Epistemically Compliant Agents by Distilling Belief-Space Task and Motion Planners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10430)
*Phillip J. K. Christoffersen,Rachel Ma,Patrick Barragán,Dylan Hadfield-Menell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将信念空间规划器离线生成的轨迹蒸馏为基于原始观测的策略，使智能体能在不确定性下遵循指定规则，成功率远超强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度强化学习理论上可通过精心设计奖励训练智能体遵循规则，但实践中难以完美优化奖励，导致行为低效或违规；信念空间规划器虽天然符合开发者规范，却需手工编写在线规划器与信念状态估计器，工程复杂、难以规模化。

Method: 采用规划器蒸馏：先离线规划生成样本轨迹数据集，再将其蒸馏为基于原始观测的策略。针对基于历史的策略提出两项改进：Dual Averaging（结合每时间步预测损失与任务变化平均损失的损失函数）和ρ-Optimal Reinforcement（当策略自身成功回放接近最优时进行强化的反馈机制）。此外给出静态无噪声观测搜索问题完备性的充分条件，并证明连续信念下最大似然观测规划满足该条件。

Result: 提出新挑战性环境Scavenger（智能体需获取信息才能成功），在视觉信息与自然语言命令两种版本中评估：蒸馏策略成功率均超90%，而RL至多5%；蒸馏规划器对未见且故意含糊命令迁移成功率超60%，对大于训练规模的平面图成功率超75%。

Conclusion: 结合信念空间规划与策略蒸馏，可在保证遵循规范的同时避免手工在线规划器与估计器的高昂工程开销，且所学策略具备良好的泛化与迁移能力。

Abstract: In this work, we train agents to act under uncertainty according to specified, belief-dependent rules. Deep reinforcement learning (RL) can in theory train agents to follow rules if encoded into well-designed rewards, but in practice, RL fails to perfectly optimize these rewards, leading to ineffective or noncompliant agent behavior. Belief-space planners by construction produce behavior in line with developer specification, but require hand-programming online planners and belief-state estimators, adding significant engineering complexity at scale. We combine the two: we plan offline to generate a dataset of sample trajectories and then distill the plans into a policy that acts on raw observations. We propose two changes to planner distillation that address problems specific to history-based policies: Dual Averaging, a loss that combines per-timestep predictive loss and average loss on task changes, and $ρ$-Optimal Reinforcement, a feedback mechanism that reinforces the policy's own successful rollouts when these are near-optimal. We provide a sufficient condition under which static search problems with noiseless observation models is complete, and show that maximum-likelihood-observation planning implies this condition in static search with continuous beliefs. We create a challenging new domain, Scavenger, where an agent needs to gain information in order to succeed. We evaluate our distilled policy in two versions of Scavenger, one where information is provided visually and one where it is provided as a command in natural language. In either case, the learned policy attains a success rate above 90% in Scavenger, compared with at most 5% for RL. We also find that distilled planners transfer with greater than 60% success to following unseen and intentionally vague commands and greater than 75% success to following floorplans larger than those seen in training.

</details>


### [502] [Multi-Objective Adaptation After Deployment: A Position on World Models for Remote Robot Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10435)
*Jamie Santos,Kagan Tumer*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文是一篇立场/展望类论文，主张在远程非结构化环境中部署的自主机器人团队面临部署后条件变化时，用世界模型在"虚拟中"重新评估候选策略与Pareto集，以避免在真实硬件上逐一试错。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署于远程、非结构化环境的机器人团队会遭遇环境、硬件与团队构成的变化，使原本有效的策略性能退化。任务目标变化可通过从已有Pareto集中另选解来应对，但部署条件的变化会重排Pareto集本身，使原先被支配的策略重新具备竞争力，甚至需要全新策略。难点在于：如何在新情境下评估这些策略，同时把对硬件的风险降到最低，这仍是未解决问题。

Method: 提出以世界模型为核心的研究路线：利用更新后的当前条件估计，预测各候选策略的结果，从而在不物理执行每个候选方案的前提下重新评估已有策略、识别新Pareto前沿。论文给出三项研究优先级：（1）基于模型的策略重评估；（2）将预测性能与实际部署性能做对照验证；（3）把团队共享信息纳入世界模型，支撑协同适应。

Result: 论文为观点/议程型工作，未报告实验或定量结果；核心论断是世界模型在该领域虽基本未经检验，但值得作为部署后多目标适应手段加以研究，其成立前提是预测的性能变化能与真实系统上实现的变化一致。

Conclusion: 部署后多目标适应可视为"策略集的重估与重排"问题，而非单纯的选解问题；世界模型提供了一个低风险、可扩展的评估通道，但其价值取决于预测—现实的保真度与团队级信息共享机制的设计。

Abstract: Autonomous robot teams deployed in remote, unstructured environments may face changes in the environment, hardware, and team composition that degrade previously effective policies. Shifting mission objectives can be handled by selecting a different solution from an existing Pareto set, but shifting deployment conditions can reorder the set itself, making previously dominated policies competitive or new policies necessary. However, evaluating these policies in new contexts while minimizing risk to the hardware remains an open problem. We argue that, although largely untested in this domain, world models merit investigation for post-deployment multi-objective adaptation. By predicting policy outcomes under updated estimates of current conditions, world models could enable teams to re-evaluate existing policies without physically executing each candidate, provided predicted performance changes reflect those realized on deployed systems. We identify research priorities for model-based policy re-evaluation, validation of predicted against realized performance, and incorporating shared information into world models to support coordinated team adaptation.

</details>


### [503] [Spatial Representation Distillation and Knowledge Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10443)
*Jungin Park,Chaoran Zhu,Changjae Oh,Kwanghoon Sohn*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SPARK-VLA：无需推理时3D输入，通过空间表征蒸馏与知识路由将3D理解能力注入预训练VLA模型，仅0.5B语言骨干与约53M可训练参数即实现强性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维物理结构对视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）至关重要，但现有方法要么在推理时依赖显式几何输入，要么采用单一视觉通路，可能损害预训练模型继承的视觉-语义知识。作者希望在不引入外部3D输入或专家的情况下，让VLA获得空间感知能力。

Method: 提出"保留-特化-路由"框架，含两个组件：(1) 空间表征蒸馏——从冻结的3D专家向LoRA适配的视觉分支迁移3D理解，通过对齐注意力响应实现，同时保留原始视觉通路；(2) 轻量知识路由器——利用由动作损失梯度导出的路由监督，将动作相关的视觉token有选择地转发给语言模型。

Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN及真实世界操作任务上表现优异，且仅使用0.5B语言骨干和约53M可训练参数，参数效率高。

Conclusion: SPARK-VLA提供了一种有效且参数高效的3D感知VLA学习方案，在无需推理时3D输入或专家模型的前提下，兼顾空间理解能力与预训练知识的保留。

Abstract: Understanding three-dimensional physical structure has become essential for vision-language-action models (VLAs). However, existing approaches either rely on explicit geometric inputs at inference time or adopt a single visual pathway, potentially compromising the visual-semantic knowledge inherited from pre-trained models. We present SPARK-VLA, Spatial Representation distillation and Knowledge routing for VLAs, a preserve-specialize-route framework for spatially adapting VLAs without requiring external 3D inputs or experts at inference. SPARK-VLA consists of two key components: (1) spatial representation distillation, which transfers 3D understanding from a frozen 3D expert to a LoRA-adapted visual branch by aligning attention responses while preserving the original visual pathway, and (2) a lightweight knowledge router, which selectively forwards action-relevant visual tokens to the language model using routing supervision derived from action-loss gradients. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN, and real-world manipulation, SPARK-VLA achieves strong performance with only a 0.5B language backbone and approximately 53M trainable parameters, providing an effective and parameter-efficient approach to 3D-aware VLA learning. Code is available at https://github.com/park-jungin/spark-vla.

</details>


### [504] [Grip, Trace, Write: Force-Aware Imitation and Reinforcement Learning for High-DoF Robotic Handwriting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10451)
*Rongqian Chen,Yiding Chen,Jijie Zhou,Tom Z. Jiahao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"Grip, Trace, Write"：面向高自由度自由握笔书写的力感知仿真环境与学习框架，用双分支actor解耦握持与书写并保持闭环耦合，结合行为克隆与强化学习，在未见中英文内容上零微调泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数机器人书写将笔刚性固定，把书写简化为轨迹跟踪问题，忽略了自由握笔时握持稳定性、笔尖运动与接触力之间的耦合；作者希望把力感知书写作为灵巧工具使用的测试平台。

Method: 构建力感知仿真环境与学习框架。用双分支actor将"笔的保持"与"手臂—手腕书写"分离，同时保留两者闭环耦合；先学习握持控制器，再用逆运动学示教做行为克隆初始化书写，最后通过强化学习改进，奖励包含墨水（墨迹）、力、时间和保持四项。

Result: 在多样化任务上，策略在完成度、精度、力的调节和效率上均优于行为克隆与逆运动学方法，并能零微调泛化到未见过的英文和中文内容。

Conclusion: 结果确立了力感知书写作为灵巧工具使用研究测试平台的价值。

Abstract: Most robotic handwriting rigidly mounts the pen and reduces writing to trajectory tracking. A freely held pen instead couples grasp stability, tip motion, and contact force. We present Grip, Trace, Write, a force-aware simulation environment and learning framework for high-DoF handwriting. A two-branch actor separates pen retention from arm-wrist writing while preserving their closed-loop coupling. Training learns a grasp controller, initializes writing from inverse-kinematics demonstrations by behavior cloning, and improves writing through reinforcement learning with rewards on ink, force, time, and retention. Across diverse tasks, the policy improves completion, precision, force regulation, and efficiency over behavior cloning and inverse kinematics, and generalizes without fine-tuning to unseen English and Chinese content. These results establish force-aware handwriting as a testbed for dexterous tool use.

</details>


### [505] [Tactile Sensors Are an Effective Substitute for Wrist Cameras in Contact-Rich or Occluded Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10490)
*Aijia Yang,Arsh Tangri,Sergey Zakharov,Krishna Murthy Jatavallabhula*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将两个低成本触觉阵列集成进视触觉 ACT 策略，在无腕部相机的情况下以指尖触觉替代腕部相机，在接触密集任务上取得更高成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腕部相机虽能提供近距离视觉反馈，但接触密集操作中的接触常被遮挡、腕部相机也看不到；指尖触觉传感器可直接测量接触，无需视觉可达性，因此希望以触觉替代腕部相机的性能增益。

Method: 在 visuotactile ACT 策略中加入两路低成本触觉阵列，仅使用场景相机与自身视角（egocentric）视觉，训练与部署阶段均不使用腕部图像；在六类真实任务（放置、插入、遮挡取物、持续接触工具使用）上评测，并在三个接触密集任务上固定示教数据、策略结构与优化设置，单独改变腕部相机与触觉的可用性，用 Holm 校正做统计检验。

Result: 加腕部相机相比无腕部图像的纯视觉提升 18.3–28.3 个百分点；加入触觉替代方案提升 31.7–60.0 个百分点，且在三个任务上均高于带腕部相机的纯视觉策略，其中两个任务在 Holm 校正后差异显著。

Conclusion: 在所评测的接触密集场景中，指尖触觉感知可作为腕部相机的有效替代，弥补其性能优势。

Abstract: Learned manipulation policies often rely on wrist-mounted cameras for close-range visual feedback that complements external views of the workspace. However, contact-rich manipulation requires establishing and maintaining contacts that can remain hidden even from wrist cameras. Tactile sensors mounted on fingers can reliably and directly measure contact, without needing visual access. In this work, we show that this feedback enables policies to recover the performance advantage of wrist cameras using scene and egocentric vision together with touch. Our approach incorporates two low-cost tactile arrays into a visuotactile ACT policy, without wrist images during training or deployment. We evaluate six real-world task families spanning placement, insertion, occluded retrieval, and sustained-contact tool use. On three contact-rich tasks, we independently vary wrist-camera and tactile availability while keeping the demonstrations, policy architecture, and optimization settings fixed. Adding wrist cameras improves success by 18.3-28.3 percentage points over vision without wrist images. Adding tactile sensing instead improves success by 31.7-60.0 percentage points and yields higher observed success than vision-only policies with wrist cameras on all three tasks, with significant advantages on two under Holm-corrected tests. These results support finger-mounted tactile sensing as an effective alternative to wrist cameras in the evaluated contact-rich settings.

</details>


### [506] [EmbodiedIntentBench: Benchmarking Intent-Driven Runtime Adaptation for Mobile Robotic Missions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10498)
*Rajat Bhattacharjya,Changwoon Lee,Hyeonjong Ju,Sing-Yao Wu,Hamidreza Alikhani,Zhuoyi Yang,Ian Harris,Nalini Venkatasubramanian,Nikil Dutt*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 EmbodiedIntentBench 基准，以结构化“任务意图契约”评估移动机器人（UAV）在资源、连通性与物理运动约束下的意图驱动运行时自适应策略，揭示高感知精度反而导致更低任务完成率的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人感知系统需适应操作者需求、有限资源、变化的连通性以及由物理运动决定的观测机会。仅用孤立的感知精度或执行效率指标，无法判断运行时决策是否真正满足任务目标，因此需要一个面向任务意图达成的评估基准。

Method: 构建 EmbodiedIntentBench：以结构化契约表达任务意图（覆盖、时序证据、报告、紧迫性、资源）；将仿真 UAV 工作负载与具备因果关联、资源计账的执行过程耦合，使计算决策同时影响任务时间、资源消耗与可贡献证据的观测；在多阶段任务及变化的紧迫性、连通性、电池条件下评估固定与自适应感知策略，并进行消融与 Jetson AGX Orin CPU/GPU 配置的回放实验。

Result: 多阶段 Depot 研究中，达到 87.5% 全库目标召回率的配置仅完成 16 个任务中的 1 个，而较低召回率配置完成 14 个；消融显示忽略执行导致的观测损失会提高总体任务成功率并颠覆两种运行时策略的排序；Jetson AGX Orin 的 CPU 与 GPU 回放改变本地与远程策略的相对成功率；在部分 GPU 配置回放中，意图驱动自适应在任务成功率不变的情况下将建模任务能耗最多降低 28%。

Conclusion: 任务意图与执行约束下的结果之间存在显著错位，孤立指标具有误导性；EmbodiedIntentBench 为在物理与资源约束下以任务达成度评估运行时决策提供了可扩展框架。

Abstract: Mobile robotic sensing systems must adapt to operator requirements, limited resources, changing connectivity, and observation opportunities shaped by physical motion. Evaluating runtime strategies therefore requires assessing whether their decisions fulfill mission objectives, beyond isolated perception accuracy or execution efficiency. We present EmbodiedIntentBench, a benchmark for intent-driven runtime adaptation in mobile robotic missions. It represents mission intent through structured contracts for coverage, temporal evidence, reporting, urgency, and resources, and couples simulated unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) workloads with causal, resource-accounted execution. Computation decisions affect mission time, resource use, and which observations can contribute evidence. We evaluate fixed and adaptive perception strategies in multi-phase missions and under changing urgency, connectivity, and battery conditions. In the multi-phase Depot study, a configuration with 87.5% full-bank target recall across visible target observations completes only 1 of 16 missions, whereas a lower-recall configuration completes 14. In an ablation, ignoring execution-induced observation loss increases aggregate mission success and reverses the ordering of two runtime strategies. Replays using Jetson AGX Orin CPU and GPU profiles change the relative success of local and remote strategies. In selected Jetson GPU-profile replays, intent-driven adaptation reduces modeled task energy by up to 28% with unchanged mission success. EmbodiedIntentBench provides an extensible framework for evaluating runtime decisions against mission fulfillment under physical and resource constraints.

</details>


### [507] [Which Taxels, Not How Many: Tactile Sensor Placement for Dexterous Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10647)
*Taeyun Kim,Jinsoo Shin,Taehwa Kim,Taeyoon Kim,Jinyoung Choi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文在单一受控协议下检验"触觉传感器均匀布点"这一默认做法：固定教师策略、训练流程与候选触觉单元，仅改变传感器配置与输入表征，在三种机械手的掌内旋转与抓取任务上评估，发现基于接触统计挑选的少量单元即可媲美大规模均匀布点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作策略的性能受训练前的设计选择影响：哪些传感器进入观测、布设在何处、读数如何排布进入编码器，但这些选择鲜少被系统检验。尤其触觉感知领域，仿真研究普遍把触觉单元均匀铺满手部，这一布点已成未经检验的默认设定。

Method: 提出单一受控协议：保持教师策略、训练过程与候选触觉单元集合不变，仅变动传感器配置与表征方式；在三款机械手上以掌内旋转与抓取任务为评测场景进行对照实验。

Result: 由接触统计筛选出的少量触觉单元可达到远大于其规模的均匀布点效果；位于极少接触部位的单元等同于无触觉输入；使用全部候选单元时，其在输入张量中的排布方式不影响性能，即便对卷积编码器也是如此。

Conclusion: 均匀布点会高估任务实际所需的触觉单元数量。作者将结论提炼为触觉策略设计的经验要点，并给出触觉策略研究应报告的最小设计选择清单。

Abstract: Policies for dexterous manipulation depend on design choices made before training: which sensors enter the observation, where they are placed, and how their readings are arranged for the encoder. These choices are rarely examined. For tactile sensing, simulation studies place taxels uniformly over the hand, and this placement has become a default without being tested. We test this default under a single controlled protocol. The protocol holds the teacher, the training procedure, and the candidate taxels fixed and varies only the sensor configuration and the representation. We evaluate it on in-palm rotation and grasping with three robot hands. A small set of taxels selected from contact statistics matches a far larger uniform set. Taxels at rarely contacted sites are equivalent to no tactile input. With all candidate taxels, their layout in the input tensor does not affect performance, even for a convolutional encoder. Uniform placement therefore overestimates the number of taxels a task requires. We distill these results into lessons for designing tactile policies and into a minimal set of design choices that a tactile policy study should report.

</details>


### [508] [Trajectory Inversion for a Rudderless Dual Vectored-Thrust Flying Wing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10650)
*Weicheng Di,Qiqi Liu,Jinwu Xiang,Daochun Li,Zhan Tu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对无舵面双矢量推力飞翼，提出联合优化路径几何与时间的轨迹生成方法，通过轨迹反演获得满足耦合运动方程的状态与控制量，并削减推力矢量需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无舵面双矢量推力飞翼兼具垂直起降与高效前飞能力，结构紧凑且无尾；但取消气动操纵面后，推力矢量同时耦合平移与俯仰控制，难以生成动力学可行的轨迹，特别是自主特技机动轨迹，属尚未解决的问题。

Method: 提出同时优化三维路径几何与时间参数的轨迹生成方法：利用轨迹反演得到满足平移-俯仰耦合运动方程的状态与控制历程；在优化中以曲率诱导加速度与气动支撑能力之间的平衡为目标/代价，降低推力矢量需求，同时保留定义性的机动特征。随后以典型筋斗（looping）与滚转（rolling）序列进行闭环仿真跟踪验证。

Result: 优化可在保持机动特征的前提下降低推力矢量需求；生成的筋斗与滚转机动序列在闭环仿真中被成功跟踪，验证了轨迹在耦合动力学下的可行性与可跟踪性。

Conclusion: 该方法为无舵面矢量推力飞行器的自主特技机动规划提供了可行基础，表明路径几何-时间联合优化与轨迹反演相结合，可有效处理无气动操纵面带来的平移-俯仰强耦合。

Abstract: A rudderless dual vectored-thrust flying wing combines vertical takeoff and landing with efficient for- ward flight in a compact tailless configuration. Without aerodynamic control surfaces, vectored thrust couples translation and pitch control. Therefore, generating dy- namically compatible trajectories remains an open chal- lenge. To address this challenge, this study proposes a trajectory generation method that jointly optimizes path geometry and timing. Trajectory inversion yields state and control histories that satisfy the coupled equations of motion. The optimization balances curvature-induced acceleration against aerodynamic support, lowering thrust- vectoring demand while retaining the defining maneuver features. Representative looping and rolling sequences are tracked in closed-loop simulations. These results provide a basis for planning autonomous aerobatic maneuvers with rudderless vectored-thrust aircraft.

</details>


### [509] [Task-Critical Part Alignment Improves Imitation of Object Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10664)
*Denis Hadjivelichkov,Sebastian Ægidius,Valerio Modugno,Dimitrios Kanoulas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文对DINOBot模仿学习框架进行改进，引入RANSAC剔除异常值并聚焦任务相关交互区域以增强语义对应，在真实机器人任务中成功率提升13.8%并加快对齐收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DINOBot在物体-物体交互的模仿学习中，深度数据噪声与错误的特征匹配会影响对齐精度，且语义对应未聚焦于任务相关的关键交互区域，导致迁移到真实场景时鲁棒性和效率不足。

Method: 提出两项改进：一是在对齐阶段引入RANSAC进行异常值剔除，抑制噪声深度数据和虚假特征匹配的影响；二是优化语义对应过程，聚焦任务相关的交互区域，使学习到的表征优先关注对操作成功起关键作用的物体特征。

Result: 在包含抓取、插入、摇动、倾倒等真实机器人操作任务上评估，相比基线整体任务成功率提升13.8%，且对齐过程收敛更快。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了上述改进能有效提升物体-物体交互模仿学习的精度与效率，增强了演示向真实世界应用迁移的鲁棒性。

Abstract: This paper presents enhancements to the DINOBot framework for imitation learning of object-object interactions. We introduce two key contributions aimed at improving the accuracy and efficiency of alignment in imitation-based robotic tasks. First, we integrate RANdom SAmple Consensus (RANSAC) for outlier rejection during the alignment phase, effectively mitigating the impact of noisy depth data and spurious feature matches. This improves robustness when transferring demonstrations to real-world applications. Second, we refine the semantic correspondence process by focusing on task-relevant interaction regions, ensuring that the learned representation prioritizes critical object features that influence successful manipulation. We evaluated our approach in a range of real-world manipulation tasks, including picking, insertion, shaking, and pouring, using a robotic system. The experimental results demonstrate an overall improvement of 13.8% in task success rates compared to the baseline, along with faster convergence in the alignment process. These results highlight the effectiveness of our enhancements in improving precision and efficiency for object-object interaction imitation in robotics.

</details>


### [510] [DreamVLA: From Generated Human Motions to Humanoid Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10872)
*Kevin Park,Izat Rasyad,Dvij Kalaria,Shankar Sastry*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DreamVLA 用生成的运动轨迹引导仿真中的强化学习，把轨迹转化为可靠的执行数据，从而在无需新任务遥操作数据的情况下训练 VLA 模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常依赖大量机器人示范数据，而人体遥操作采集成本高昂、流程笨重，在全身人形交互任务上尤为突出；用仿真强化学习替代虽可扩展数据，但设计任务专属奖励函数依然困难。

Method: 提出 DreamVLA：以生成的运动轨迹作为参考来引导仿真 RL，将其转化为可靠的任务执行轨迹，用于在仿真中训练 VLA 模型。核心贡献是"参考条件化的 DAgger 蒸馏"流程——在失败的学习者 rollout 之后，从采样到的学习者状态出发、给定相同的参考后缀重启 RL 专家，并聚合成功的纠正轨迹，以缓解离线模仿带来的分布偏移。另含 DAgger 迭代次数、残差 RL、生成数据规模等消融实验。

Result: 在四类任务上评估：从平台抓取物体、打开抽屉、按压按钮、行走并抓取物体；并给出 DAgger 迭代次数、残差 RL 与生成数据集规模的消融结果，验证方法的有效性（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。

Conclusion: 结合生成轨迹引导的仿真 RL 与参考条件化 DAgger 蒸馏，可在不新增任务专属遥操作数据的前提下获得可用的 VLA 训练数据，为全身人形交互任务的数据规模化提供了一条低成本路径。

Abstract: Training vision-language-action (VLA) policies typically depends on substantial robot demonstration data, making human teleoperation a costly and cumbersome bottleneck, particularly for whole-body humanoid interaction. Reinforcement learning in simulation offers an alternative for scaling this data, but designing task-specific rewards remains challenging. To address this, we propose DreamVLA, which uses generated motion trajectories to guide reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation, converting them into reliable task execution trajectories. These trajectories train VLA models in simulation without new task-specific teleoperation data. Our central contribution is a reference-conditioned DAgger distillation procedure: after a failed learner rollout, we restart the RL expert from a sampled learner state with the same reference suffix and aggregate successful corrective trajectories, addressing the distribution shift left by offline imitation. We evaluate picking from a platform, opening a drawer, pressing a button, and walking and picking from a platform, with ablations of DAgger iterations, residual RL, and generated dataset scale. Project website: ember-center-berkeley.github.io/DreamVLA.

</details>


### [511] [Sampling-based Model Predictive Control as Sequential Monte Carlo Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10877)
*Austin Garrett,Muyang Yan,Zachary Kingston*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文提出用单一序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）推断算法统一多种基于采样的MPC算法（预测采样、MPPI、交叉熵法及其各类变体），并以三个独立维度（提议分布、粒子更新规则、重采样ESS阈值）刻画它们。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于采样的MPC被视作一族彼此独立的算法（预测采样、MPPI、交叉熵方法，以及其有偏、有色噪声、退火等变体），尽管它们本质上都是"采样控制序列—按代价重加权"，缺乏统一视角，难以系统比较与改进。尤其长时域下粒子退化与提议分布设计问题突出。

Method: 将采样MPC视为序贯蒙特卡洛推断问题，用统一的SMC推断算法实现上述所有算法，并由三个正交轴参数化：提议分布（proposal）、将代价加权粒子约简为名义规划的更新规则、以及触发重采样的有效样本量（ESS）阈值。在MuJoCo非线性控制、障碍场开环导航、7自由度运动规划、非抓取推T任务（仿真+Franka FR3真机）上进行评估。

Result: 重采样可缓解长时域粒子退化：在导航域28节点时域下，相比不重采样基线将碰撞率降低30%；可编程提议分布能改善push-T成功率，仿真中由1%提升至100%，真机上由10%提升至90%，优于扰动式基线。

Conclusion: 采样MPC各算法可在SMC框架下统一表述并仅由三个设计轴区分，该框架把重采样与提议设计提升为一等公民，实证表明其在长时域与精细操作任务中显著优于常规基线，为采样MPC的设计与比较提供了系统化方法论。

Abstract: Sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) is treated as a family of distinct algorithms: predictive sampling, MPPI, the cross-entropy method, and their biased, colored-noise, and annealed variants all sample control sequences and reweight them by cost. We show a single Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) inference algorithm implements them all, specified by three independent axes: the proposal, the update rule that reduces cost-weighted particles to a nominal plan, and the effective-sample-size threshold for resampling. We evaluate SMC-based planning on MuJoCo non-linear control, open-loop navigation through obstacle fields, 7-DoF motion planning, and non-prehensile push-T, in simulation and on a Franka FR3. Resampling combats particle degeneracy at long horizons. At a 28-knot horizon in our navigation domain it cut the collision rate by 30% over non-resampling baselines. Programmable proposals improve push-T success over perturbative baselines, improving from 1% to 100% in simulation and 10% to 90% on hardware.

</details>


### [512] [Zero-Shot VLA Adaptation with Retrieved Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10894)
*Subin Kim,Anh-Quan Pham,Dinesh Jayaraman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RAGu 将检索增强引入 VLA 机器人操作：通过几何标定把域外演示（如 DROID）变换到目标场景，用粗到细检索选出与基座 VLA 最兼容的轨迹，并在 flow-matching 推理阶段进行引导，从而显著提升跨域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模演示数据预训练的通用 VLA 模型在出现相机视角、背景、物体身份或机器人形态等小幅域偏移时性能明显下降。受大语言模型中 RAG 成功的启发，作者希望从域不匹配的"in-the-wild"演示数据集（如 DROID）中检索来引导目标域中的 VLA 行为。

Method: 提出 RAGu，针对机器人 RAG 的三个特有挑战给出方案：(1) 用简单几何标定把源演示变换到目标配置，缩小跨域差异；(2) 采用粗到细检索策略，从大量已预变换的候选中选出与基座 VLA 最兼容的轨迹；(3) 以引导 flow-matching 推理过程的方式注入检索信息，而非重训练基座模型或扩展其有限的上下文窗口。

Result: 在真实世界、仿真、sim-to-real 迁移以及跨本体人形机器人操作上评估：真实场景 VLA 成功率从 20% 提升到 80%，在仿真中优于最接近的相关基线。

Conclusion: 检索增强可作为无需重训练即可提升 VLA 跨域泛化与鲁棒性的有效手段；几何对齐 + 分层检索 + 推理期引导的组合能够在多种域偏移与本体差异场景下带来大幅性能提升。

Abstract: Pre-training large parametric "Vision-Language-Action" (VLA) models on large demonstration datasets has recently yielded promising results for general-purpose manipulation. However, these models still struggle under even small domain shifts relative to the training data, such as changes in camera viewpoint, background, object identity, or robot morphology. Motivated by the success of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in language models, we pursue retrieval to boost VLA performance. Specifically, we seek to leverage retrieval from domain-mismatched, "in-the-wild" demonstration datasets like DROID to guide a VLA's behavior in a new target domain. To achieve this, we introduce RAGu, which overcomes robotics-specific challenges for RAG: (1) It incorporates simple geometric calibration to transform source demonstrations into the target setup and reduce cross-domain differences. (2) It uses a coarse-to-fine retrieval strategy that selects, from a large pool of pre-warped candidates, the trajectory most compatible with the base VLA. (3) It guides the VLA's flow-matching inference procedure rather than seeking to retrain the base model or expand its limited context window. We evaluate RAGu across real-world, simulation, sim-to-real transfer, and cross-embodiment humanoid manipulation. We find it improves real-world VLA success rates from 20% to 80% and outperforms the closest-related baselines in sim. Project website: raguvla.github.io

</details>


### [513] [Beating the Pool, Not the Game: A White-Box Equilibrium Agent for Language-Based Economic Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10932)
*Sudhanshu Srivastava,Faisal Aqlan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出零推理成本、基于规则的 GLEE 竞赛智能体 sudsho，用经验池百分位设定要价、用截断均衡份额约束要价与接受，并通过回放冻结后的动作日志验证对齐性；在 117,280 局中取得 2056 评分，账号排名 26/71。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GLEE 竞赛涉及议价、谈判与说服，通常依赖大模型推理，成本高且行为难以审计。作者希望构建无需推理时 LLM 调用、行为确定、可验证对齐的规则型智能体。

Method: sudsho 以经验对局池的收益百分位作为要价目标，并用截断后的均衡份额上下界约束要价与接受阈值；除说服环节的混合策略外，每一步都是可见状态的确定性函数。对齐性通过将冻结后的动作日志重新输入策略回放来验证。

Result: 在 117,280 局比赛中，智能体以 0 美元推理成本达到 2056 总评分；以同策略复制体作为最佳智能体，账号在 71 个有排名账号中位列第 26。对三个冻结对手池快照的回放显示，池感知截断机制带来每局议价评分平均 274 至 330 分的提升，且在由记录对手决策固定回放的条件下仍成立。

Conclusion: 确定性的池感知规则策略可在零推理成本下具备竞争力，其中池百分位目标与均衡份额截断是主要增益来源，且策略对齐可通过动作日志回放进行审计。

Abstract: We describe sudsho, a rule-based agent for the GLEE Competition that plays bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion with zero inference-time LLM calls. Games are scored as payoff percentiles against an empirical pool of prior play on the same configuration, so pool percentiles set our demand targets while clamped equilibrium shares bound demands and acceptance. Every move is a deterministic function of the visible state (persuasion mixing aside), so alignment is verified by replaying the post-freeze move log through the policy. Across 117,280 games the agent reached an overall rating of 2056 at $0 inference cost, and the account, ranked by its best agent (a same-policy replica), placed 26th of 71 ranked accounts. A replay against three frozen snapshots of the opponent pool credits the pool-aware clamp with 274 to 330 points of mean per-game bargaining rating, an effect that holds where logged opponent decisions fix the replay.

</details>


### [514] [BRACE: Belief-guided Residual Adaptive Control for Safe Navigation under Unknown Disturbances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10938)
*Jaeyoun Choi,Niklas Schmid,Oswin So,Augustinos Saravanos,Chuchu Fan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BRACE：用模型预测误差推断"扰动信念"，并用其引导分层强化学习的高层策略来调整参考轨迹，从而在未知、有界、空间突变的扰动下完成reach-avoid导航；在三个突变风场仿真四旋翼环境与Crazyflie实机上均优于MPC与RL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主导航中遇到的扰动通常随空间变化、且往往是突变的（障碍物改变风向、地形变化改变附着/牵引力）。而常规跟踪控制器假定控制权限足以抑制扰动并维持安全，一旦该假定不成立（扰动强于可用控制权限），安全性与可达性都可能失效，但这一"控制权限受限"的工况在现有研究中关注不足。

Method: 提出BRACE（Belief-guided Residual Adaptive Control）分层RL框架：1）由模型预测误差在线推断扰动的信念表示（belief）；2）用该信念对高层策略进行条件化，使其自适应地修改参考轨迹；3）策略输出由名义项与信念引导的残差项组合而成；4）两者联合训练，并采用似然比优势重加权（likelihood-ratio advantage reweighting）启发式来缓解训练分布偏差。

Result: 在三个含突变切换风场的仿真四旋翼环境中评测，并在Crazyflie实机上用风扇生成扰动进行硬件验证；各设置下BRACE的reach-avoid表现均优于模型预测控制（MPC）与RL基线。

Conclusion: 将"空间变化的扰动信念"显式引入分层RL的轨迹参考层，是在控制权限不足以完全抑制扰动时实现安全reach-avoid导航的有效途径；仿真到实机的迁移验证表明该方法具备现实可行性，可作为跟踪式控制器失效工况下的补充方案。

Abstract: Disturbances encountered during autonomous navigation generally vary across space, often discontinuously, as obstacles redirect wind and changing terrain alters traction. Tracking controllers typically assume sufficient control authority to mitigate disturbances and maintain safety; the regime where this assumption fails remains underexplored. We present Belief-guided Residual Adaptive Control (BRACE), a hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework for reach-avoid navigation under unknown, bounded, spatially varying disturbances. BRACE infers a disturbance belief from model prediction errors and uses that to condition a high-level policy that adapts the reference trajectory. The policy combines a nominal and a belief-guided residual term, trained jointly with a likelihood-ratio advantage reweighting heuristic. We evaluate BRACE in three simulated quadcopter environments with abruptly switching wind fields, and validate it on Crazyflie hardware with fan-generated disturbances. Across these settings, BRACE improves reach-avoid performance over model predictive control and RL baselines.

</details>


### [515] [Explicitly capturing demonstrator multi-modality for distillation into diffusion policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10949)
*Shao Yuan Chew Chia,Rebecca H. Jiang,Abhinav Agarwal,Andreas Hofmann,Leslie Pack Kaelbling,Russ Tedrake*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将vine采样引入行为克隆数据采集，通过在同一观测上多次查询示教者（每条观测对应k个动作），消除滑动窗口数据中的歧义，使蒸馏出的扩散策略能复现示教者的多模态条件动作分布，并提升best-of-N与专家迭代等下游探索型应用的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒸馏扩散策略的输出多样性不仅影响成功率，还决定了测试时搜索、策略改进等下游应用能否有效探索。然而标准行为克隆用滑动窗口把独特观测历史与动作配对，这类数据既能被多模态策略拟合，也能被高Lipschitz常数的单模态策略拟合；已有工作发现稀疏数据训练的扩散策略倾向于后者，即对每个观测只记住一个动作，从而丢失示教者的条件分布多样性与多模态性。

Method: 把vine采样改造后用于行为克隆的数据采集：在示教者访问的部分状态处，从完全相同的观测重复查询示教者k次，得到同一观测下的k个动作，以显式区分"多模态"与"高Lipschitz单模态"两种解释。作者先在合成任务上系统研究每条观测的动作数k对所学策略的影响，再在2D卡车卸货任务上验证该方法对策略与示教者分布匹配度以及best-of-N和专家迭代性能的作用。

Result: 在合成任务上，k越大，学到的策略越能匹配示教者的条件分布，包括其多模态性与多样性；在2D卡车卸货任务上，vine采样同样使策略更接近示教者，并显著提升best-of-N与专家迭代的性能。

Conclusion: 数据采集方式本身是决定蒸馏扩散策略是否保留多模态条件分布的关键因素；通过vine采样为同一观测提供多个动作标签，可以缓解扩散策略退化为"每观测记一个动作"的问题，从而支撑需要多样性的下游搜索与策略改进应用。

Abstract: The diversity of a distilled diffusion policy's outputs matters beyond how it impacts the policy's success rate. In particular, downstream applications like test-time search and policy improvement require exploration. Thus, we want to distill multi-modal demonstrators into diffusion policies which reproduce their conditional action distributions.
