Standard data collection for behavior cloning applies a sliding window to demonstration episodes, which pairs unique observation histories with actions. These datasets can be fit by a policy that is either multi-modal, or unimodal with high Lipschitz constant to capture a diversity of actions seen at nearby observation samples. Prior work finds that diffusion policies trained on sparse data learn the latter, memorizing one action per observation. We adapt vine sampling to behavior cloning data collection to resolve this ambiguity: at some states the demonstrator visits, query it $k$ times from exactly the same observation. On a synthetic task, we study how the number of actions per observation, $k$, affects the learned policy, and find that larger $k$ yields a policy that better matches the demonstrator's conditional distribution, including its multi-modality and diversity. On a 2D truck unloading task, vine sampling likewise leads to a policy closer to the demonstrator and substantially improves both best-of-$N$ and expert iteration performance.

</details>


### [516] [BAT-WAM: Bridging Action and Touch in World-Action Models for Dexterous Hands](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10967)
*Dong Fang,Feixuan Huang,Yuanxin Zhong,Yuxiang Gao,Qi Song,Yunlong Wang,Xiaosong Jia,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 BAT-WAM，用视觉作为连续上下文、以 RGB 条件潜变量桥接触觉与动作流，缓解灵巧操作中关节状态和触觉缺失问题，并在重建、预测与真机任务上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作的世界动作模型依赖手部构型与接触信息，但关节状态和全手触觉常部分或完全缺失；仅靠 RGB 难以可靠恢复这些模态。作者还观察到手部状态与触觉信息之间存在相关性，因此希望联合建模视觉、关节状态与触觉。

Method: BAT-WAM 为触觉流和动作流分别学习独立的码本与解码器；通过一个由 RGB 条件化的连续潜变量桥接两条流，实现双向学习；视觉信息作为连续上下文提供场景与手-物几何线索。

Result: 在 HTBench 协议下，完全掩码时触觉重建 RMSE 相对图像条件 HandTouch 检查点降低 34.73%，部分掩码时降低 38.84%；以目标时刻 RGB 和历史动作为条件预测未来触觉时，平均 RMSE 相对 OpenWAM with HandTouch 降低 85.56%。真机实验与未见物体/场景泛化实验均优于相关 WAM 基线。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将视觉上下文、手部状态与触觉进行联合建模，是提升多模态世界动作模型表征能力与灵巧操作表现的有效途径。

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation with world action models (WAMs) relies on hand configuration and contact information, yet joint-state and whole-hand tactile observations may be partially or entirely missing. RGB images provide scene context and hand-object geometry but are insufficient to reliably recover these missing modalities. We further observe a correlation between hand state and tactile information. Motivated by this observation, we introduce BAT-WAM, a framework that bridges visual, joint-state, and tactile representations for WAMs. BAT-WAM learns separate codebooks and decoders for the tactile and action streams. An RGB-conditioned continuous latent bridge connects the two streams for bidirectional learning, while visual information serves as continuous context. Under the HTBench evaluation protocol, BAT-WAM reduces the root mean squared error (RMSE) of tactile reconstruction by 34.73% under fully masked conditions and 38.84% under partially masked conditions, relative to an image-conditioned HandTouch checkpoint. For future tactile prediction conditioned on target-time RGB and historical actions, it reduces mean RMSE by 85.56% relative to OpenWAM with HandTouch. Real-robot experiments further show that BAT-WAM consistently outperforms related WAM baselines in dexterous manipulation. Generalization experiments on unseen objects and scenes also demonstrate substantial improvements over baseline models. These findings support joint modeling of visual context, hand state, and touch as a representation approach for multimodal WAMs.

</details>


### [517] [RoboMoCap: A Large-Scale Whole-Body Motion Capture Dataset with Egocentric Vision for Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10994)
*Mayur Deshmukh,Aaron Tung,Junyi Li,Nikash Bhardwaj,Ademi Adeniji,Vincent Liu,Michael Cho,Jiafei Duan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboMoCap：一个面向"以移动为核心"的人形机器人学习的大规模多模态数据集，将第一视角视觉与标记式光学动捕对齐，包含200+小时、14名被试的全身运动与第一人称观测数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人需协调移动与操作才能穿越复杂环境、完成日常任务；从人类示范中学习这类行为，需要"精确全身运动 + 第一视角视觉"配对数据，而下肢运动与落脚点在第一人称视角中常不可见。现有第一视角数据集往往缺少高保真光学动捕，或未系统覆盖多样的移动-操作行为，形成数据缺口。

Method: 构建 RoboMoCap 数据集：14名被试、逾200小时录制；硬件包括6路头戴相机、腕部视觉与惯性传感、120 Hz 标记式全身光学动捕；内容系统覆盖移动原语、动态全身运动与移动-操作任务（变速行走、转向、受限导航、地形穿越、搬运物体、移动中操作）；提供时间对齐的多模态观测与度量尺度的全身运动表示，从而可研究第一视角不可直接观测的身体区域运动。

Result: 在三个基准任务上系统评测现有方法：第一视角全身运动重建、足部接触与落点估计、人到人形机器人的运动重定向，为后续方法提供统一评测基线与参考。

Conclusion: 通过将第一视角视觉与多场景下的高保真人体运动配对，RoboMoCap 为第一视角运动理解与人形机器人从人类示范中学习提供了数据基础与评测平台。

Abstract: Humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation to navigate complex environments and perform everyday tasks. Learning such behaviours from human demonstrations requires accurate whole-body motion paired with egocentric vision, particularly for lower-body movements and foot placements that are frequently invisible from a first-person perspective. However, existing egocentric datasets often lack high-fidelity optical motion capture or systematic coverage of diverse loco-manipulation behaviours. To address this gap, we introduce RoboMoCap, a large-scale multimodal dataset combining egocentric vision with marker-based optical motion capture, specifically designed for locomotion-centric humanoid learning. RoboMoCap comprises over 200 hours of recordings from 14 participants, featuring six head-mounted cameras, wrist-mounted visual and inertial sensing, and optical full-body motion capture at 120 Hz. The dataset systematically covers diverse locomotion primitives, dynamic whole-body movements, and loco-manipulation tasks, including variable-speed walking, turning, constrained navigation, terrain traversal, object transportation, and manipulation during locomotion. It provides temporally aligned multimodal observations and metric whole-body motion representations, enabling the study of human movement beyond directly observable body regions. We systematically evaluate existing methods on three benchmark tasks: egocentric full-body motion reconstruction, foot contact and placement estimation, and human-to-humanoid motion retargeting. By pairing egocentric vision with high-fidelity human motion across diverse locomotion and interaction scenarios, RoboMoCap provides a foundation for egocentric motion understanding and humanoid learning from human demonstrations.

</details>


### [518] [Floquet-Parameterized Koopman-MPC for Tracking Periodic Orbits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11050)
*Kartik A. Pant,Vishnu Vijay,Yufei Zhu,Xintong Deng,Taewoo Nam,Inseok Hwang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种物理信息Koopman学习方法，将周期轨道稳定性（Floquet理论）嵌入学习到的线性预测器，用于非线性系统的周期轨道跟踪控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为非线性（尤其是复杂耦合、真实参数难获取）系统设计实时周期轨道跟踪控制十分困难，例如系留风筝系统；纯数据驱动方法缺乏物理一致性。

Method: 结合动力学内在周期结构与周期性的状态-输入轨迹数据，在提升（可观测）空间中学习物理一致的线性预测器。利用Floquet理论，通过单值矩阵（monodromy matrix，即整个周期上的状态转移矩阵）获得给定轨道的周期稳定性信息；随后根据开环单值矩阵约束，以最小二乘EDMD（扩展动态模式分解）公式学习Floquet参数化的线性预测器，从而约束搜索空间、辅助Koopman学习；再基于这些线性预测器设计模型预测控制（MPC）律以跟踪周期参考信号。

Result: 在周期外力作用下的cartpole（小车-摆杆）系统上进行评估，并与纯数据驱动基线方法进行比较。

Conclusion: 将Floquet稳定性约束引入EDMD学习可有效约束搜索空间、提升Koopman线性预测器的物理一致性，并为周期参考跟踪的MPC设计提供可用的线性模型。

Abstract: Designing real-time control for nonlinear systems to track periodic orbits can be challenging, especially for complex and coupled dynamical systems (e.g., tethered kites), where the true model parameters are hard to obtain. To address this, we propose a physics-informed Koopman learning approach that incorporates periodic-orbit stability directly into the learned linear predictor. The approach combines the underlying periodic structure of the dynamics along with periodic state-input trajectory data to learn physically consistent linear predictors (in lifted/observable space). We leverage Floquet theory, which studies the stability of periodic orbits in nonlinear systems, to obtain the periodic stability information of a given orbit via a monodromy matrix (i.e., the state transition matrix over an entire period). Subsequently, we impose open-loop monodromy constraints to learn Floquet-parameterized linear predictors using a least-squares Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition (EDMD) formulation, thereby constraining the search space and aiding in Koopman learning. We then utilize these linear predictors to design a model predictive control (MPC) law for tracking periodic references. Finally, we evaluate the designed framework on a cartpole system under periodic forcing and compare it against a purely data-driven baseline.

</details>


### [519] [From Festival Video to the Stage: A Sim-to-Real Ladder for Long-Horizon Expressive Whole-Body Dance on a Commercial Humanoid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11127)
*Hesham Shehata*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作提出一条从单目视频到宇树 G1 EDU 人形机器人的传统舞蹈（阿波舞）迁移流水线，涵盖人体网格恢复、运动学重定向、仿真中的强化学习运动跟踪与 ONNX 板端部署，并通过 11 级部署阶梯在真机上检验三类干预手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统节庆舞蹈（阿波舞）动作复杂且依赖人类示范，如何以低成本（单目视频、单张消费级 GPU）将其可靠迁移到商用小人形机器人并在真实舞台稳定演出，是难点；同时真实部署中存在"静默性故障"（产物损坏、状态估计漂移、结尾不稳）等问题，需要系统性诊断手段。

Method: 构建端到端流水线：单目视频输入 → 人体网格恢复（HMR）→ 运动学重定向 → 仿真中基于强化学习的运动跟踪训练（单张 RTX 5070 GPU）→ 通过 ONNX 部署到宇树 G1 EDU 机载计算。设计 11 个版本的部署阶梯（deployment ladder）在硬件上逐步评估，并施加三类干预：(1) 检测并修复部署产物的静默损坏；(2) 在训练中建模状态估计器漂移；(3) 编辑参考动作以支持稳定执行与可控收尾。

Result: 最终策略实现：43 秒成套动作连续三次无绳索完成；46 秒带自动交接的表演；由采集动作拼接的连续 9.7 分钟无绳索演出。现场移交实验显示，单次远程请求即可让机器人从厂商步行控制器接管并在舞台上返回，实测无力矩窗口 45–140 ms。文中还报告了训练动态与硬件结果，并讨论了失败边界（柔性地板、单目捕捉中的遮挡）。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，借助"视频→重定向→RL 跟踪→ONNX 部署"的流水线与分阶段硬件验证，商用小人形机器人可完成较长时间、含交接与收尾的传统舞蹈表演；同时指出柔性地面与遮挡等条件下的失效边界，为艺术表演类机器人应用提供了可复现的工程范式。

Abstract: We present a pipeline for transferring Awa Odori, a traditional Japanese festival dance, from monocular video to a commercial Unitree G1 EDU humanoid. The pipeline combines human mesh recovery, kinematic retargeting, reinforcement learning for motion tracking in simulation, and onboard deployment via ONNX. Training ran on a single RTX 5070 GPU. An eleven-version deployment ladder evaluated on hardware examines three interventions. We detect and repair silent corruption of deployment artifacts, model state-estimator drift during training, and edit the reference motion to support stable execution and a controlled ending. The final policies achieved three consecutive rope-free completions of a 43-second routine, a 46-second performance with automatic handoff, and a continuous 9.7-minute rope-free performance composed from the captured motion. In a live handover, a single remote request let the robot start from and return to the manufacturer's walking controller on stage, with a measured torque-free window of 45-140 ms. We report the training dynamics and hardware outcomes and discuss failure boundaries involving compliant flooring and occlusion in monocular capture.

</details>


### [520] [MOSU2: Long-range Navigation System with Multi-modal Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11148)
*Jing Liang,Zhenyu Hou,Senthurbavan Kirubaharan,Md Safwan Mondal,Ashok Gudivada,Xuesu Xiao,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MOSU2 是一个长距离户外导航系统，采用两阶段轨迹选择：第一阶段用上下文推理判断何时需要额外证据，仅在交互未解决时触发第二阶段检索几何与动态信息，从而在实时性与决策准确性间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在公共户外空间长距离移动时，不仅要避障，还需判断地形适宜性以及在行人、骑行者、车辆、交通信号和临时管制面前该前进、让行还是绕行。这类决策依赖场景动态演化（如车辆是否减速、骑行者是否会横穿），而VLM虽能解读线索，却只基于缺乏度量几何与运动信息的图像推理；每步都补充这些证据又太慢，手工触发规则也难以覆盖开放式场景。

Method: 提出 MOSU2，在 MOSU 基础上构建两阶段轨迹选择框架：第一阶段进行上下文推理，判断何时需要补充证据以及检索什么；仅当交互仍无法判定时，才触发第二阶段检索几何与动态信息，并与场景上下文对齐以做导航决策。系统沿用 GPS 路径规划给出的路线，并通过多模态可通行性分析过滤候选轨迹后再选择执行轨迹。

Result: 在涵盖停车手势、施工场地、人行横道及与车辆/骑行者/行人共享道路的真实实验中，相比仅用单图像的前代方法，MOSU2 将平均导航成功率从 61.8% 提升至 94.2%，条件检测准确率从 72.2% 提升至 91.4%，平均决策延迟约为前者的 2.2 倍。

Conclusion: 按需触发的证据检索策略能有效弥补单图像 VLM 缺乏几何与运动信息的不足，在可控的延迟代价下显著提升户外长距离导航的成功率与情境判断准确性。

Abstract: Robots that travel long distances through public outdoor spaces must do more than avoid obstacles: they must remain on terrain suited to their mobility and decide when to proceed, yield, or detour around pedestrians, cyclists, vehicles, traffic signals, and temporary restrictions. These decisions are difficult because their correctness often depends on how a scene evolves, such as whether an approaching car is slowing or a cyclist will cross the robot's path. Vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret such cues, but they reason over images that lack metric geometry and motion. Supplying this evidence at every step is too slow for real-time navigation, and hand-crafted triggers cannot anticipate the open-ended variety of outdoor situations. We present MOSU2, a long-range navigation system with two-stage trajectory selection, in which first-stage contextual reasoning determines when additional evidence is needed and what to retrieve. Only when an interaction remains unresolved does the first stage trigger the second stage to retrieve geometric and dynamic information and align it with scene context to make navigation decisions. Building on MOSU, MOSU2 follows routes from GPS-based route planning and filters candidate trajectories through multi-modal traversability analysis before selecting a trajectory to move the robot. In real-world experiments spanning stop gestures, construction sites, crosswalks, and roads shared with vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians, MOSU2 raises mean navigation success from 61.8% to 94.2% and condition-detection accuracy from 72.2% to 91.4% over its single-image predecessor, at about 2.2 times its mean decision latency. Project website: https://jinggm.github.io/mosu2/

</details>


### [521] [Tutorial: Vision-Based Formation Control with Differential-Drive Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11164)
*Christian Marowski,Byung-Cheol Min*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本教程给出基于差速驱动机器人、俯视相机与Python的完整多机器人编队控制实践流程：用ArUco码估计位姿、以期望成对位移向量定义圆形编队、由相对位置误差计算运动向量并转换为差速轮指令，同时集成简易避障，并提供开源代码仓库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人教育中存在"理论理解"与"实际实现"之间的鸿沟；作者希望展示抽象数学概念如何落地为实体机器人上的协同行为，并提供可复现、可上手的教学范例。

Method: 采用差速驱动小车+俯视相机+Python的教学式实现：ArUco标记用于估计各机器人位置与朝向；用期望的成对位移向量刻画圆形编队几何；控制器比较实测相对位置与期望相对位置得到误差，据此计算运动向量并映射为差速轮速度指令；叠加基于近距离传感器的基本避障；内容按硬件与软件搭建、位姿估计、编队几何、反馈控制、系统集成、编队误差评估六步组织。

Result: 形成一套端到端可运行的教学流程与评估方法（编队误差评价），并提供附带实现代码、搭建说明与演示视频的开源GitHub仓库，支持动手学习与后续扩展。

Conclusion: 该工作强调感知与编队控制原理的平台无关性：虽基于特定机器人平台实现，但其方法可迁移到其他差速驱动机器人与仿真环境，作为连接理论与实践的机器人教学资源。

Abstract: This tutorial presents a step-by-step introduction to multi-robot formation control using differential- drive robots, an overhead camera, and Python. ArUco markers are used to estimate robot positions and orientations, while desired pairwise displacement vectors define a circular formation. By comparing measured and desired relative positions, the controller computes movement vectors that are converted into differential-drive wheel commands, with basic proximity-sensor-based obstacle avoidance. The tutorial guides readers through hardware and software setup, robot pose estimation, formation geometry, feedback control, system integration, and formation-error evaluation. Motivated by the need to bridge the gap between theoretical understanding and practical implementation in robotics education, we emphasize how mathematical concepts are translated into coordinated behaviors on physical robots. Although the implementation uses a specific robotic platform, the underlying perception and formation-control principles can be adapted to other differential-drive robots and simulation environments. The accompanying open-source GitHub repository provides the Python implementation, setup instructions, and demonstrations to support hands-on learning and further exploration of multi-robot systems.

</details>


### [522] [DexForesight: Grounding Dexterous Policies with Implicit Spatial Foresight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11166)
*Zhongxi Chen,Yi Yang,Xinyi Chen,Mingzhe Ye,Yaping Li,Zhihong Liu,Congsheng Xu,Haonan Wang,Zhijie Deng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexForesight通过将动作条件的三维世界模型表征注入灵巧手策略的潜空间，隐式获得空间前瞻能力，部署时仅保留策略（无需深度输入与显式未来预测），在11个DexJoCo仿真任务上把基础策略成功率从49.4%提升至60.5%，在三个真实机器人任务上达到58.3%（最强基线50.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作需要对周围场景与机器人手部（含被相机遮挡的手指）具备丰富的空间前瞻，而现有world-action模型多依赖显式未来预测来获取这类预测知识，代价高且部署时需要深度或预测模块。

Method: 训练阶段利用离线场景深度、运动学手部几何与示教轨迹学习一个动作条件的三维空间世界模型，预测3D手部点运动与视觉特征变化；随后冻结该世界模型，将策略查询与世界模型的预测查询做对齐，把学到的空间动力学迁移到策略潜变量中并用于条件化动作生成。部署时只保留策略，输入为RGB观测、语言指令与机器人状态。

Result: 11个DexJoCo仿真任务整体成功率由49.4%提升至60.5%；三个真实机器人灵巧操作任务上成功率58.3%，优于最强基线的50.0%。

Conclusion: 隐式注入动力学感知的世界表征，可在不进行显式未来预测、不使用深度输入的前提下为灵巧手策略提供有效空间前瞻，验证了世界模型—策略潜空间对齐这一范式的有效性与可部署性。

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation requires rich spatial foresight over both the surrounding scene and the robot hand. Existing world-action models often acquire such predictive knowledge through explicit future prediction. We introduce DexForesight, a framework that learns spatial foresight implicitly by injecting dynamics-aware world representations into the latent space of a dexterous policy. During training, DexForesight learns an action-conditioned spatial world model from offline scene depth, kinematic hand geometry, and demonstration trajectories. The world model predicts 3D hand-point motion and visual feature changes, capturing both articulated hand dynamics and scene changes under demonstrated actions, including the motion of fingers occluded from the cameras. We then freeze the world model and align policy queries with its predictive world queries, transferring the learned spatial dynamics into policy latents and using them to condition action generation. At deployment, only the policy is retained, operating on RGB observations, language, and robot state without depth input or explicit future prediction. On 11 DexJoCo simulation tasks, DexForesight improves the overall success rate of the base policy from 49.4% to 60.5%. On three real-robot dexterous manipulation tasks, DexForesight achieves 58.3% success, compared with 50.0% for the strongest baseline.Project page https://dexforesight.github.io/

</details>


### [523] [DeepSoMo: Deformable Object Motion Estimation under Proprioceptive Partial Observability via Predictive Latent Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11242)
*Hanwen Zhao,Weicheng Dai,Luoyao Chen,Chen Feng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对软体机器人中可变形体运动估计的本体感知部分可观测问题，提出从潜在动力学角度建模，并用自监督潜在预测约束保证潜在状态的时间一致性，构建 DeepSoMo 框架；在有限元仿真基准上优于同架构循环基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体机器人依赖本体感知估计形变运动时，内部观测只能间接反映全局运动、接触与形状演化，存在部分可观测性；单帧瞬时观测信息不足，长时程估计需要时间一致的潜在表征。

Method: 将可变形运动估计建模为潜在动力学问题，提出 DeepSoMo 学习框架，通过自监督潜在预测约束在潜在动力学中引入预测结构，使潜在状态保持对未来观测的预测能力；采用高保真有限元仿真作为受控真值来源，与架构匹配的循环基线对比。

Result: 在轨迹估计、姿态恢复、形状重建与接触推断等任务上，相比同架构循环基线取得一致提升。

Conclusion: 潜在时间一致性是本体感知部分可观测条件下长时程可变形运动估计的关键要求；以自监督预测约束塑造潜在动力学可有效提升估计性能，有限元仿真为方法验证提供了可控基准。

Abstract: Estimating the motion of deformable bodies in soft robotics from proprioceptive sensing is challenging due to partial observability, as internal observations provide only indirect access to global motion, contact, and shape evolution. In such settings, instantaneous observations are insufficient, and accurate estimation requires temporally consistent latent representations. This paper studies deformable motion estimation under proprioceptive partial observability from a latent dynamics perspective. We argue that a key requirement for long-horizon estimation is latent temporal consistency, where latent states remain predictive of future observations. To this end, we present DeepSoMo, a learning-based framework that enforces predictive structure in latent dynamics through a self-supervised latent prediction constraint. We evaluate the approach in a canonical deformable dynamics setting using high-fidelity finite-element simulation as a controlled source of ground truth. Results demonstrate consistent improvements in trajectory estimation, orientation recovery, shape reconstruction, and contact inference over architecture-matched recurrent baselines.

</details>


### [524] [Single-Radar Bilateral 3D Near-Field Imaging for Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11296)
*Yingqi Wang,Tingwei Chen,Zhongqin Wang,Min Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种运动辅助框架，仅用单个前向安装的毫米波雷达，在机器人一次前向行进中重建轨迹两侧的三维散射结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家庭环境中的移动机器人需要对邻近家具与周边结构进行可靠的3D感知，但单一前向毫米波雷达同时获取路径两侧信息困难，主要受近场波前曲率、目标可见性依赖视角、俯仰维多样性有限等因素制约。

Method: 建立近场模型，用发射—散射体—接收的球面路径把场景反射率与跨频率、跨机器人位置的步进频率MIMO观测相关联；采用双侧Tx联合实现宽带方向加权；用滑动孔径反投影按近场传播距离相干聚焦；再用Top-K功率融合合并不同可见性的局部图像；在横向—前向支持上做多层高度提取，并用原始MIMO通道进行带门控的自适应高度精化。

Result: 在受控环境、办公室/书房和走廊三类场景中，横向—前向平均定位误差分别为4.65 cm、5.63 cm和5.98 cm，峰背景比（PBR）均超过13 dB。

Conclusion: 该框架无需依赖场景的学习式表征，仅凭单部前向雷达一次通过即可恢复双侧三维散射结构，为机器人侧向感知提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Mobile robots operating in homes need reliable 3D perception of nearby furniture and surrounding structures, yet recovering this information on both sides of the robot's path with a single forward-mounted millimeter-wave radar remains challenging because of near-field wavefront curvature, viewpoint-dependent target visibility, and limited elevation diversity. This paper presents a motion-assisted framework for reconstructing structures on both sides of a robot's trajectory. Our near-field model relates scene reflectivity to stepped-frequency multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) observations across frequencies and robot positions using spherical paths from transmitter (Tx) to scatterer to receiver (Rx). Bilateral Tx combining provides wideband directional weighting, while sliding-aperture back-projection coherently focuses the measurements using near-field propagation distances. Top-K power fusion combines local images with different visibility. The reconstruction provides lateral-forward support for multi-layer height extraction, followed by guarded adaptive height refinement using the original MIMO channels. Experiments in controlled, office/study, and corridor environments produce mean lateral-forward localization errors of 4.65, 5.63, and 5.98 cm, respectively, with peak-to-background ratios (PBRs) exceeding 13 dB. The framework recovers bilateral 3D scattering structure from one forward pass using a single radar, without relying on learned representations of the scene.

</details>


### [525] [When Coding Agents Get Arms: Safety Risks Across the Digital-Physical Boundary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11438)
*Yiming Sun,Mi Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文提出 ArmedAgent，首个面向“编码代理零样本控制真实机械臂”的系统性安全基准，覆盖鲁棒性、恶意使用与间接提示注入三类风险，并在仿真和真实机械臂上验证当前前沿模型存在显著安全隐患。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间理解能力提升使前沿模型可驱动编码代理零样本、端到端控制真实机械臂，无需任务示范或重训练。这也带来两类新风险：一是模型能力扩展可能导致能力滥用；二是编码代理可访问网页、邮件等数字资源，间接提示注入等数字威胁可能传导至物理世界。

Method: 构建 ArmedAgent 基准，系统评估编码代理执行零样本机器人控制时的安全性。基准覆盖 5 个场景、36 个任务，包含鲁棒性、恶意使用和间接注入三类评估，并在仿真环境中测试、在真实机械臂上验证；其中部分任务专门针对早期 VLA 范式难以完成的有害行为。作者在多种主流代理框架下测试了多个前沿模型。

Result: 测试多个前沿模型（包括 GPT-6-Astra）后发现，当前系统在编码代理控制机器人时存在显著安全风险；摘要未给出具体量化指标，但强调三类风险均被纳入评估且有真实机械臂验证。

Conclusion: ArmedAgent 填补了编码代理零样本机器人控制安全评估的空白，表明数字资源中的威胁可经代理传导至物理世界，当前前沿模型与代理框架的安全保障仍不足，需要针对能力滥用和间接提示注入建立更系统的防护与评测机制。

Abstract: Advances in spatial understanding have enabled frontier models to power coding agents that control a real robot arm zero-shot and end-to-end, without task-specific demonstrations or retraining. This brings two new safety challenges. First, the extensive knowledge of frontier models lets these agents perform tasks that earlier VLA and WAM paradigms could not, opening the door to new forms of capability misuse. Second, coding agents can access digital resources such as web pages and emails. Threats in these resources, such as indirect prompt injection, can carry over into the physical world when the agent controls a robot. We therefore introduce ArmedAgent, the first systematic benchmark to evaluate both risks for coding agents performing zero-shot robot control. It covers robustness, malicious use, and indirect injection across 36 tasks in 5 scenarios, evaluated in simulation and validated on a physical robot arm. A distinctive portion of the tasks target harmful behaviors that earlier VLA paradigms could not perform. Testing several frontier models, including GPT-6-Astra, under widely used agent frameworks, we find substantial safety risks in current systems.

</details>


### [526] [Off-Policy RL with Online Inference Tuning: My Solution to the CoRL 2026 RoboEval Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11464)
*Ilia Larchenko*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出参加CoRL 2026 RoboEval双臂操作挑战的方案：用基于π₀.₅且自带价值函数的off-policy RL（AWR+RECAP，优势取官方评分），配合Thompson采样调参与生成式示范/失败恢复数据，最终在官方评测取得0.987 RDS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RoboEval挑战不仅看任务是否成功，还要按阶段、安全性、效率与双臂协同，对照人类示范打分；仅靠局部探索难以找到能拿满奖励的轨迹，因此需要一个既通用又能补齐数据短板的方案。

Method: 方案分两部分。(1) 通用部分（沿用LeHome方案）：在π₀.₅策略上做off-policy RL，该策略同时充当价值函数；用AWR和RECAP以“官方评分带来的精确优势”为训练信号，并在训练循环中把每次rollout当作约20个推理参数的Thompson采样试验。(2) 比赛专用部分：补充局部探索发现不了的数据，包括能达到满奖励的生成式示范，以及从策略自身失败起步的恢复片段。

Result: 通用部分在两天内于留出种子上取得0.85 RDS（且远未收敛）；加入比赛专用数据后，提交策略在留出种子达0.990 RDS、官方种子达0.987 RDS。

Conclusion: 以官方评分为优势信号的off-policy RL加参数探索可高效提升结构化评分，而生成式示范与失败恢复数据能显著补足探索盲区；二者结合接近满分RDS。

Abstract: The CoRL 2026 RoboEval challenge has eight bimanual tasks, and it ranks a policy not only on whether it succeeds but on how: every stage of the task, done safely, efficiently and with both arms in coordination, scored against human demonstrations. My solution has two parts. The generic part, carried over from my LeHome challenge solution, is off-policy RL on a $π_{0.5}$-based policy that is also its own value function. It is trained with AWR and RECAP on advantages of the exact official score, in a loop where every rollout is at the same time a Thompson-sampling trial of about 20 inference parameters. Out of the box, it took the policy to 0.85 RDS on held-out seeds in two days (and it was still very far from convergence). The competition-specific part adds data that local exploration cannot find: generated demonstrations that reach the full reward, and recovery episodes that start from the policy's own failures. The submitted policy reaches 0.990 RDS on held-out seeds and 0.987 on the official seeds.

</details>


### [527] [Beyond Memory Limits: A Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Map Representation for Large-Scale 3D Autonomous Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11489)
*Yizhe Zhang,Jianping Li,Yilun Gao,Liangliang Yin,Pengfei Wan,Bisheng Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FLAVOR：一种分层时空框架，将稠密度量几何限制在机器人局部地图内，同时用轻量LiDAR关键帧可见性记录与带里程计锚点的紧凑待办任务保留全局上下文，实现探索时间缩短31.98–41.88%、地图内存降低94–99%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主无人机在大规模测绘与巡检（尤其难以进入或受灾环境）中应用日益广泛，但机载内存与算力严重受限。现有系统多维护可全局查询的几何地图用于运动规划与探索决策，导致内存占用与空间查询成本随探索面积增长；而机器人中心局部建图虽能限制稠密地图的内存与计算开销，却丢失了长时程探索所需的全局任务上下文。因此需要兼顾内存有界与全局任务连续性的表示方法。

Method: 提出FLAVOR分层时空框架：1）观测层——用轻量LiDAR关键帧可见性记录保留逐射线证据，用于前沿推理；2）任务层——将局部地图范围外未解析的前沿保留为与里程计锚点关联的紧凑待办任务；3）构建稀疏拓扑图，通过保留的路径连接各锚点以支持未来重访；4）返回任务区域时，从观测中重建前沿与探索视点，并将拓扑路径实例化、结合当前局部地图校验后再执行；5）稠密地图容量固定，探索相关的内存增长仅限紧凑的观测与任务上下文。

Result: 在三个仿真场景中均完成探索，相比完成全部场景的最佳基线，探索时间缩短31.98–41.88%，地图内存占用降低94–99%；真实部署中，相对显式点云ikd-tree，森林环境内存降低92.67%，建筑工地降低62.42%，并在机载资源受限条件下保持长期任务连续性。

Conclusion: 通过把稠密几何限定在机器人中心局部地图、把全局信息压缩为轻量观测记录与锚点化待办任务，FLAVOR在不牺牲长时程探索能力的前提下实现了有界内存与高效探索，并在仿真与实地场景验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Autonomous UAV exploration is increasingly used for large-scale surveying and inspection in inaccessible or disaster-affected environments, where onboard memory and computational resources are often severely constrained. Most existing UAV exploration systems maintain globally queryable geometric map representations for motion planning and exploration decision-making, causing memory consumption and spatial-query costs to increase with the explored area. Robot-centric local mapping bounds dense-map memory and computation but discards global task context needed for long-horizon exploration.We present FLAVOR, a hierarchical spatio-temporal framework that confines dense metric geometry to a robot-centric local map while retaining compact global observation and task context. At the observation level, lightweight LiDAR-keyframe visibility records preserve ray-wise evidence for frontier reasoning. At the task level, unresolved frontiers beyond the local-map extent are retained as compact pending tasks associated with odometry anchors. A sparse topological graph connects these anchors through retained routes for future revisits.Upon returning to a task region, FLAVOR reconstructs the frontier and exploration viewpoint from observations, while the topological route is instantiated and validated against the current local map before execution. Dense-map capacity remains fixed as exploration expands, with exploration-dependent memory growth confined to compact observation and task context.FLAVOR achieves 31.98--41.88% shorter exploration time and a 94--99% smaller map memory footprint than the best baseline that completes all three simulated scenes. In real-world deployments, it reduces this footprint by 92.67% in the forest and 62.42% at the construction site relative to an explicit point-cloud ikd-tree while preserving long-term task continuity under constrained onboard resources.

</details>


### [528] [Review the Episodes, Refine the Lessons: Simple Memory Evolution for Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11509)
*Yifei Yao,Yude Zou,Xing Gao,Guanbo Jiao,Yukai Wang,Jianming Ma,Weinan Zhang,Chunhua Shen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 SimplEvo：不更新权重、不加后训练策略、不用特权信息，仅靠 MLLM 自写文本记忆（一次演示生成的坐标无关任务记忆 + 训练集上迭代精炼的有界工作记忆），即可大幅提升具身智能体的直接控制能力，EBench 成功率 46.7%→81.7%，RoboDojo 榜首 69.63%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能体研究多通过"外挂式框架工程"（harness engineering）增强前沿 MLLM，例如加入后训练策略、递归自我改进循环等，但这些增量是否真的超出 MLLM 的原生能力尚无定论。作者希望剥离这些附加组件，直接探查 MLLM 在直接控制（direct control）下、仅依靠自身文本执行经验时能达到的能力上限。

Method: 提出 SimplEvo：(1) 不需要权重更新、后训练策略或特权信息；(2) MLLM 从单次演示中一次性写出"无坐标"的任务记忆（task memory）；(3) 在严格 train-test 协议下，仅在训练回合上构建有界工作记忆（working memory），并在每回合后依据过程、完成度、失败恢复三方面的经验进行精炼；(4) 两类记忆在测试时保持固定。

Result: EBench 上 GPT-6-Astra 在直接控制下的成功率由 46.7% 提升至 81.7%；RoboDojo 榜单以 69.63% SR、75.32 分登顶。与同时存储历史视觉帧的记忆方案相比，仅用文本记忆即可达到相近 SR 且消耗更少 token。记忆固定后仍可泛化到未见布局与随机化场景配置；工作记忆可跨模型迁移，由 GPT-6-Astra 写出的记忆可被较弱 MLLM 直接复用并提升其表现，无需额外适配。

Conclusion: 结论表明，相当一部分性能提升可归因于 MLLM 的原生能力与文本化经验积累，而非复杂框架工程；文本记忆是一种高效、可迁移、可泛化的具身经验载体，为评估 MLLM 真实能力上限提供了简洁基线。

Abstract: Recent studies of embodied agents based on frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) develop harness engineering around the MLLM, such as harnesses with post-trained policies and recursive self-improvement loops. Yet whether these additions exceed the native capability of the MLLM remains unexplored. We introduce SimplEvo to explore how far an MLLM can improve under direct control when it retains its execution experience in self-written text memories. It requires no weight updates, post-trained policies, or privileged information. The MLLM writes a coordinate-free task memory once from a single demonstration. Under a strict train-test protocol, it then creates a bounded working memory on training episodes only and refines it after each episode with lessons on procedure, completion, and recovery. Both memories stay fixed at test time. On EBench, SimplEvo lifts the success rate (SR) of GPT-6-Astra under direct control from 46.7% to 81.7%, and tops the RoboDojo leaderboard with 69.63% SR and a score of 75.32. Compared with memories that also store past visual frames, SimplEvo reaches a similar SR with text memory alone while using fewer tokens. With its memories fixed, SimplEvo also generalizes to unseen layouts and randomized scene configurations. Moreover, the working memory transfers across models: written by GPT-6-Astra, it can be reused as is by weaker MLLMs and improve their performance without any adaptation of their own.

</details>


### [529] [Breaking survivorship bias in driving world models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11516)
*Zihao Sheng,Zilin Huang,Yuhao Luo,Zhengyang Wan,Boyue Wang,Soyoung Ahn,David A. Noyce,Sikai Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 驾驶世界模型因训练数据中"未来几乎都以安全结局收尾"而存在幸存者偏差，本文提出中性世界模型（NWM），用常规驾驶视频与真实事故视频混合训练，使其能更真实地预见碰撞，并作为想象引擎辅助决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶世界模型可用于在执行前"想象"候选动作的后果，但其可靠性受制于训练数据所涵盖的未来分布。现有驾驶数据集记录的未来几乎总是安全收尾，导致模型即使面对迫近碰撞也会想象出良性结果，这种幸存者偏差削弱了模型在安全关键场景中的可信度。

Method: 提出中性世界模型（NWM）：以常规驾驶数据与真实事故视频构成混合训练集，并采用边界框引导的训练目标，使模型同时学习日常未来与安全关键的碰撞未来。在决策阶段，NWM 作为"想象引擎"，对多条自车候选轨迹分别预测其对应未来，再由奖励函数评估这些想象结果并据此选择动作。

Result: NWM 能更可靠地预判迫近碰撞，同时在常规驾驶中保持较低的误报碰撞率与有竞争力的生成质量。在 NAVSIM 的困难场景中，基于 NWM 的决策流程比基线世界模型更可靠地选出更优轨迹；使用自主研究车辆采集的行人假人横穿真实数据进行的零样本实验，进一步显示其对未见传感器观测的迁移能力。

Conclusion: 结果表明，修正幸存者偏差可使世界模型更忠实地推理未来，并支撑自动驾驶中的安全关键决策。

Abstract: World models allow autonomous vehicles to imagine the consequences of candidate actions before execution, but their reliability depends on the futures represented in their training data. We identify a survivorship bias in driving world models: because the futures recorded in prevailing driving datasets almost always end safely, existing models often imagine benign outcomes even when a collision is imminent. We introduce a neutral world model (NWM) that learns both routine and safety-critical futures from a mixture of routine driving and real accident videos with a bounding-box-guided objective. The NWM more faithfully anticipates imminent collisions, while maintaining a low false collision rate and competitive generation quality in routine driving. We further use the model as an imagination engine for decision-making. Given multiple ego trajectories, the NWM predicts the future associated with each candidate, and a reward function evaluates these imagined outcomes before selecting an action. On challenging NAVSIM scenarios, this procedure selects the better trajectory more reliably than the baseline world model. Zero-shot experiments with real-world pedestrian dummy crossing data collected using an autonomous research vehicle further demonstrate transfer to unseen sensor observations. These results show that correcting survivorship bias enables world models to more faithfully reason about futures and support safety-critical decision-making in autonomous driving.

</details>


### [530] [K-PWM: Control-Oriented Structured Bilinear World Models under Partial Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11521)
*Santosh Mohan Rajkumar,Sriram Narayanan,Samuel E. Otto,Debdipta Goswami*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: K-PWM：面向部分观测系统的概率世界模型，将Koopman双线性潜动力学与非线性观测解码器耦合，用扩展卡尔曼滤波/平滑在学得模型内做潜状态推断，配合GECM闭式训练，实现数据与计算高效的长程预测与MPPI控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型需要从有限、含噪且部分可观测的数据中学习环境动力学，但现有工作多聚焦像素观测；许多物理系统只提供向量测量，仅揭示潜在状态的一部分，导致状态估计与长期预测困难。同时，常规潜变量世界模型依赖单独训练的推断网络，样本与算力开销大。

Method: 提出K-PWM：(1) 以Koopman双线性潜动力学耦合非线性观测解码器，双线性结构使高斯信念可精确传播；(2) 通过学得模型用扩展卡尔曼滤波与平滑完成概率潜状态推断，无需独立推断网络；(3) 训练采用广义期望条件最大化（GECM），对生成元、噪声协方差与潜先验给出闭式更新，解码器用梯度学习；(4) Koopman一致性初始化从数据中选择潜维度并初始化动作相关动力学；(5) 基于该模型的rollout用于不确定性感知的MPPI控制。

Result: 在部分观测的Gymnasium MuJoCo系统上，数据有限时K-PWM的长程预测误差低于对比基线，且训练时间较最强预测基线大幅缩短；在高维MuJoCo Menagerie机器人上取得有竞争力的跟踪精度，单步计算耗时低，具备实时部署潜力。

Conclusion: 结果表明，结构化的概率动力学是世界建模与部分观测下控制的一种数据高效、计算高效路径；将Koopman双线性结构与卡尔曼滤波式推断结合，可同时获得精确信念传播、高效训练与实时控制能力。

Abstract: World models learn internal simulators of environment dynamics for prediction, planning, and control, yet learning them from limited, noisy, and partial observations remains challenging. While much progress has focused on pixel-based observations, many physical systems instead provide vector-valued measurements that reveal only part of the underlying state. We introduce K-PWM, a probabilistic world model for prediction and control under partial observation. K-PWM couples Koopman-bilinear latent dynamics with a nonlinear observation decoder and performs probabilistic latent-state inference through the learned model via extended Kalman filtering and smoothing, without a separately trained inference network. Its bilinear structure enables exact propagation of the maintained Gaussian belief through the latent transition and efficient rollouts for uncertainty-aware model predictive path integral (MPPI) control. For training K-PWM, we present a generalized expectation conditional maximization (GECM) procedure with closed-form updates for the generators, noise covariances, and latent prior, complemented by gradient-based decoder learning. A Koopman-consistent initialization selects the latent dimension from data and initializes the action-dependent dynamics. With limited training data, K-PWM achieves lower long-horizon prediction error than the evaluated baselines on partially observed Gymnasium MuJoCo systems, while substantially reducing training time relative to the strongest prediction baseline. On high-dimensional MuJoCo Menagerie robots, it achieves competitive tracking accuracy with low per-step computation times, demonstrating potential for real-time deployment. These results support structured probabilistic dynamics as a data- and compute-efficient approach to world modeling and control under partial observation.

</details>


### [531] [Kimodo-Policy: Learning Kinematic Action Models for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11554)
*Yunheng Wang,Jiaxi Zhang,Wei Lu,Yuetong Fang,Taowen Wang,Yixiao Feng,Shuning Zhang,Junzhe Xu,Yichi Wang,Zizhao Yuan,Kailun Huang,Lusong Li,Mingqian Zhou,Zecui Zeng,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Kinematic Action Models（KAMs），将全身运动作为预训练目标，并以预训练运动生成器作为动作生成主干；Kimodo-Policy 用冻结的文本到运动模型加轻量 ControlNet 视觉条件，在仿真与真实人形 loco-manipulation 任务上取得有竞争力的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形 loco-manipulation 需要持续协调高维全身运动。现有 VLA 与世界动作模型虽能迁移语义和视觉动力学先验，但这些先验未必刻画机器人运动本身的结构，因此需要一种直接以全身运动为预训练对象的范式。

Method: 提出 KAMs：把全身运动作为直接预训练目标，使用预训练运动生成器作为主要动作生成主干，并通过任务条件、视觉观察和执行反馈落地时序与跨身体协调先验。具体实例 Kimodo-Policy 将冻结的 Kimodo 文本到运动主干与轻量 ControlNet 视觉条件结合；采用 root-body-hand 层级协调移动与操作，并用运动历史条件和重复动作块预测连接运动合成与闭环控制。

Result: 经大规模 loco-manipulation 预训练后，在多任务 HumanoidArena 上取得对比策略中最高的总体成功率 72.14%，在 SIMPLE 上表现有竞争力，在八个真实世界任务上平均成功率 60%；模型 678M 参数，其中 92M 可训练。消融实验支持预训练运动主干的贡献。

Conclusion: 结果初步表明，运动生成可作为人形动作学习的互补基础，为利用运动生成先验进行全身 loco-manipulation 控制提供了新路径。

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires continuous coordination of high-dimensional whole-body motion to realize task objectives. While vision-language-action models and world action models transfer semantic and visual-dynamics priors to robot control, these priors do not necessarily capture the structure of robot motion. We introduce Kinematic Action Models (KAMs), a paradigm that treats whole-body motion as a direct pretraining target and uses a pretrained motion generator as the primary action-generation backbone. KAMs ground learned temporal and cross-body coordination priors through task conditioning, visual observations, and execution feedback. We present Kimodo-Policy as an initial instantiation, combining a frozen Kimodo text-to-motion backbone with lightweight ControlNet-based visual conditioning. A root-body-hand hierarchy coordinates locomotion and manipulation, while motion-history conditioning and repeated action-chunk prediction bridge motion synthesis and closed-loop control. Following large-scale loco-manipulation pretraining, the policy achieves the highest overall success among compared policies on multi-task HumanoidArena (72.14%), competitive performance on SIMPLE, and 60% mean success across eight real-world tasks, with 678M parameters (92M trainable). Ablations support the contribution of the pretrained motion backbone. Together, these results provide initial evidence for motion generation as a complementary foundation for humanoid action learning.

</details>


### [532] [ColNav: Uncertainty-Aware Spacetime Collision Checking with Bounding Volume Hierarchies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11646)
*Sanjeev Ramkumar Sudha,Lars Ivar Hatledal,Erlend M. Coates*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ColNav：将目标与机器人位置/速度不确定性编码为时空管（支持有界集与高斯两种描述），并用包围体层次结构组织，实现单次遍历覆盖整个时域的鲁棒碰撞检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人在动态不确定环境中导航需避碰移动目标。传统方法前向传播运动并在离散时空采样点检测碰撞，会遗漏采样点之间的碰撞，且对状态估计不确定性不鲁棒。

Method: 将目标与自身机器人的位置和速度不确定性编码为时空管（spacetime tubes），提供有界集（bounded-set）和高斯（Gaussian）两种变体；将时空管组织为包围体层次结构（BVH），以单次树遍历覆盖整个时域而非检测离散时刻，返回鲁棒几何证书及碰撞时间估计；静态与动态障碍共享同一表示。

Result: 在预测模型失配条件下达到100%成功率（最佳基线65%）；在密集交通中保持最高三倍于基线的净空；并在实体机器人上验证实时运行。

Conclusion: ColNav以时空管+BVH的鲁棒碰撞检查公式，解决了采样遗漏与不确定性鲁棒性问题，兼顾实时性与安全净空，具备实机部署可行性。

Abstract: Safe navigation for mobile robots in dynamic and uncertain environments requires planning paths that avoid collisions with other moving targets. Typically this involves forward propagating the robot motion and checking for collisions at sampled points in space and time. Such methods can miss collisions between sampled points and are not robust to uncertainty in the state estimates. We propose ColNav, a robust collision check formulation with geometric volumes. The key aspect of our approach is encoding the uncertainty in the targets' and the ego robot's positions and velocities into spacetime tubes, in two variants that consume bounded-set and Gaussian uncertainty descriptions, respectively. The tubes are organised in bounding volume hierarchies, so that a single tree traversal covers the entire horizon, rather than testing sampled time instants, and returns a robust geometric certificate together with an estimate of the time to collision. Static and dynamic obstacles share the same representation. Our approach reaches the goal with a 100% success rate under prediction model mismatch, where the best baseline reaches 65%, and maintains up to three times the clearance in dense traffic. We also validate real-time operation on a physical robot.

</details>


### [533] [PA-SaR: Perception-Aware Learning, Control, and Coordination for Multi-Robot Search and Rescue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11648)
*Jocubas Dimsa,Maria Grouev,Filip Keerberg,Nicolas Laplagne,Tigo Schutgens,Sven Schoonebeek,Anahita Jamshidnejad*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出PA-SaR框架，统一协调异构局部控制、学习驱动探索、监督式任务分配与自适应受害者引导，用于自主搜救(SaR)的仿真研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主搜救需机器人在未知环境中探索、避险、协同并引导受害者脱险，但单纯提升单个机器人能力并不必然改善整体任务效果：更安全的运动可能限制探索，更快的发现会增加救援需求，而有效引导依赖受害者响应。因此需要以任务级目标为核心统一各类互补机制并分析其交互。

Method: 提出PA-SaR数学与架构框架，将异构局部控制、基于学习的探索、监督式任务分配和自适应"接近-引导"受害者引导统一起来；区分环境真值、机器人特定感知与模拟受害者行为，从而在任务各阶段集成并分析各机制交互。通过单机器人与多机器人仿真验证，涵盖模型预测与学习探索、基于感知的安全屏障、事件驱动任务分配与自适应受害者引导。

Result: 仿真显示避障与搜索完成度之间存在权衡；监督式任务分配相比仅信息共享能提升搜索完成度；增加探索并不必然带来更多救援；自适应引导相较持续引导能增加救援数量，但未检测到平均/最终受害者信任提升或死亡率下降。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在所考虑的仿真环境中，应将局部控制、团队协调与疏散引导作为相关联但彼此独立的方面分别评估，为自主搜救系统设计提供依据。

Abstract: Autonomous SaR requires robots to explore unknown or partially known environments, avoid hazards, coordinate team activities, and guide discovered victims to safety. Improving individual capabilities of robots does not necessarily improve mission outcomes: safer motion can restrict the exploration behavior, faster discovery can increase the rescue demand, and effective guidance depends on victim responses. We introduce PA-SaR, a mathematical and architectural framework for coordinating heterogeneous local control, learning-based exploration, supervisory task allocation, and adaptive approach-lead victim guidance around mission-level objectives. PA- SaR distinguishes environmental ground-truth, robot-specific perceptions, and simulated victim behavior. This provides a common basis for integrating complementary mechanisms and analyzing their interactions across mission stages. We demonstrate the framework through single- and multi-robot simulation studies incorporating model-predictive and learning-based exploration, perception-based safety shielding, event-driven task allocation, and adaptive victim guidance. The results show trade-offs between collision avoidance and search completion, indicate that supervisory allocation improves search completion beyond information sharing alone, and demonstrate that increased exploration does not necessarily yield more rescues. Adaptive guidance increases rescues relative to continuous leading, without a detected improvement in mean or final victim trust or a reduction in mortality. These findings support evaluating local control, team coordination, and evacuation as related but distinct aspects of autonomous SaR within the considered simulation environments.

</details>


### [534] [FlowEval: How Much Adaptation Does an Embodied Foundation Model Need at Deployment?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11650)
*Zhang Xi-Jia,Roman Yakunin,Shivang Chopra,Chengyue Huang,Che Chen,Siddharth Karamcheti,Zsolt Kira*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FlowEval：仅用少量成功示教、基于flow-matching目标的免训练指标，用于判断预训练具身基础模型与目标部署的匹配程度，并预估还需多少适配数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模预训练虽降低了适配成本，但预训练模型未必在每次部署中都达到所需性能。实践者需要在新任务适配前就了解：模型与目标部署的匹配度如何、还需采集多少目标域数据。

Method: 提出FlowEval——一组免训练（training-free）指标，利用flow-matching目标在少量成功目标域示教上探测具身基础模型，通过量化模型在这些成功示教上的预测分歧程度，来衡量预训练模型对目标部署的拟合水平。

Result: 在Pi-0.5、MolmoAct2、GR00T、DreamZero四个具身基础模型族上，FlowEval在真实世界与仿真操作任务中均可区分已见与未见的部署；在17个RoboCasa365操作任务上对Pi-0.5和GR00T进行微调后，FlowEval与随适配数据增加而带来的成功率提升呈相关性。

Conclusion: FlowEval可作为轻量、免训练的诊断工具，在适配前预估模型—部署之间所需的适配程度与数据量，为部署决策与数据采集规划提供依据。

Abstract: Large-scale pretraining is reducing the amount of adaptation required to deploy embodied foundation models, but it is not guaranteed that a pretrained model already provide the level of performance required in every deployment. Practitioners therefore need to understand how well a pretrained model matches a target deployment and how much adaptation data is left to be collected. We study whether a small set of successful target-domain demonstrations can reveal whether and how much target-domain data will be required before any adaptation. We introduce FlowEval, a set of training-free metrics that use the flow-matching objective to probe an embodied foundation model with a set of demonstrations. FlowEval quantifies predictive disagreement on successful target demonstrations to assess how well a pretrained model fits a target deployment. Across four embodied foundation model families: Pi-0.5, MolmoAct2, GR00T, and DreamZero, FlowEval distinguishes seen from unseen deployments across real-world and simulated manipulation. Further, by finetuning Pi-0.5 and GR00T on 17 RoboCasa365 manipulation tasks, we showed that FlowEval correlates with how success rate improves as additional adaptation data is provided. Together, these results suggest that FlowEval can serve as a lightweight, training-free diagnostic of how much model--deployment adaptation may be required.

</details>


### [535] [Enhancing Balance and Posture in Material Handling Tasks with a Wearable Robotic Tail](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11662)
*Eisa Anwar,Sajeeva Abeywardena,Stuart C. Miller,Ildar Farkhatdinov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 研究开发了一种受动物尾巴启发的可穿戴机器人尾，作为动态配重，并在模拟货架装卸任务中验证其能改善平衡、减少躯干运动和肌肉激活。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 频繁搬重物易导致肌肉骨骼劳损，下背痛影响多达40%的体力劳动者；动物尾巴可用于平衡，因此作者希望用可穿戴机器人尾提供动态反平衡。

Method: 10名参与者完成模拟货架装载/卸载任务，比较主动尾、被动尾和无尾三种条件；测量运动学、压力中心及腓肠肌、竖脊肌、胫骨前肌、肱二头肌的肌电激活。

Result: 与无尾相比，主动尾使压力中心峰值位移减少>20 mm、躯干运动减少4.3°、竖脊肌和腓肠肌激活分别减少>9%和>20%；被动尾效果较小；主动尾较被动尾增加肱二头肌激活；踝关节运动学和胫骨前肌激活无变化。

Conclusion: 可穿戴机器人尾有助于改善物料搬运中的平衡；被动反平衡有一定作用，主动运动可进一步增强效果。

Abstract: Frequent heavy lifting is linked to musculoskeletal strain, with lower back pain affecting up to 40% of manual labourers. Inspired by animals using tails for balance, we developed a wearable robotic tail as a dynamic counterbalance. Ten participants performed an imitated shelf loading/unloading task across three conditions: active tail, passive tail, and no tail. Kinematics, centre of pressure, and muscle activation (gastrocnemius, erector spinae, tibialis anterior, biceps brachii) were measured. Compared with no tail, the active tail achieved >20 mm reduction in centre of pressure peak displacement, 4.3 degree reduction in trunk motion, and >9% and >20% reductions in erector spinae and gastrocnemius activity, respectively. The passive tail produced smaller reductions, suggesting passive counterbalancing helps while active movement augments it further. Biceps brachii activation increased with the active versus passive tail. The ankle kinematics and tibialis anterior activation were unchanged. These findings support wearable robotic tails for improving balance during material handling.

</details>


### [536] [HINT-VLM: Humanoid Interactive Navigation over Rough Terrain with Embodiment-Grounded Vision-Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11665)
*Ziwon Yoon,Seok Hwan Kim,Yiyu Chen,Quan Nguyen,Lu Gan,Ye Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 面向户外崎岖地形的人形机器人NAMO问题，提出融合VLM语义先验与GP残差修正的混合规划框架，实现可移动性概率预测与不确定性感知的分层规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统导航假设环境不可交互且只关注通行；现有NAMO方法多限于平坦场景与反应式交互，缺乏对物体可移动性的预测与前瞻规划。户外崎岖地形要求机器人同时推理地形可通行性与物体可移动性。

Method: 提出混合规划框架：利用视觉语言模型（VLM）提供物体可移动性的语义先验，再用高斯过程（GP）残差模型结合机器人本体交互数据进行校正，得到具身化的概率可移动性估计，并将其嵌入分层的不确定性感知规划中，联合利用移动与操作能力。

Result: GP可修正VLM先验，输出具身落地的概率化可移动性估计；框架支持人形机器人在杂乱崎岖地形中兼顾效率与安全地导航，并联合使用行走与操作。

Conclusion: 该工作首次将预测式可移动性推理与概率化VLM融合用于崎岖地形NAMO，为人形机器人在复杂户外环境中的交互式导航提供了新方案。

Abstract: Humanoid robots have achieved significant progress in locomotion and manipulation, enabling traversal over rough terrain and richer interaction with the environment, such as moving obstacles. However, most traditional navigation methods assume non-interactive environments and focus only on traversal. While Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) approaches relax this assumption, prior efforts have largely focused on flat environments and reactive interaction, rather than predicting object movability and planning ahead. These limitations become critical in outdoor rough-terrain scenarios, where robots must jointly reason about terrain traversability and object movability. In this work, we address NAMO for humanoid robots in cluttered outdoor rough terrain by proposing a hybrid planning framework that combines semantic priors from a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with embodied robot interaction data through a Gaussian process (GP) residual model. The GP corrects the VLM-derived movability prior to produce embodiment-grounded probabilistic movability estimates, which are then incorporated into hierarchical uncertainty-aware planning. The proposed approach allows humanoids to jointly leverage locomotion and manipulation for efficient and safe navigation, representing the first solution to NAMO in rough terrain through predictive movability reasoning and probabilistic VLM integration.

</details>


### [537] [Accelerated Reinforcement Learning for Soft Robotics: Hours Instead of Years](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11718)
*Roshan S. Kaundinya,Hehui Zheng,Robert K. Katzschmann,George Haller*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出用基于绝热谱子流形(aSSM)的降维模型作为强化学习训练环境，仅需极少量数据即可高效训练软体机器人的轨迹跟踪策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习需要大量交互数据或可靠仿真器，而这两者对非线性软体机器人硬件都难以获得，因此需要一种数据高效且计算轻量的训练环境。

Method: 利用软体机器人动力学固有的时间尺度分离特性，将其约减为低维不变流形(绝热谱子流形aSSM)，并从预采集数据中学习出仅含6,924参数、六维aSSM的多项式常微分方程模型，作为RL训练环境训练轨迹跟踪策略，无需微调直接部署到真实气动软体臂上。

Result: 在六维aSSM模型上仅用3小时即可训练出策略并零微调部署，而同等训练若在硬件上进行需约3年交互。该策略对动态目标的跟踪误差比在4.8M参数RNN和1.7M参数Transformer上训练的相同策略低40%，后两者识别耗时分别为13小时和100小时，而本方法仅需5分钟。

Conclusion: 数学上有依据的低维aSSM模型可作为高效数据驱动RL训练环境，显著优于大规模神经网络基线，在训练时间、数据需求和跟踪精度上均具明显优势，为软体机器人控制提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) requires large amounts of interaction data or a reliable simulator, both hard to obtain for nonlinear soft robotic hardware. Recent work shows that a time-scale separation inherent to soft robot dynamics justifies their reduction to low-dimensional invariant manifolds, known as adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs). We demonstrate that an aSSM-reduced model, a simple polynomial ordinary differential equation learned purely from pre-collected data, can serve as an RL training environment. On a pneumatically actuated soft arm, we train a trajectory-tracking policy in 3 hours on a six-dimensional aSSM-reduced model and deploy it without fine-tuning, whereas reproducing this policy training extrapolates to 3 years of hardware interaction. Our policy tracks dynamic targets with 40% lower error than otherwise identical policies trained on a 4.8-million-parameter recurrent neural network (RNN) or a 1.7-million-parameter transformer, which take 13 and 100 hours to identify, against 5 minutes for our mathematically justified 6,924-parameter model.

</details>


### [538] [Particle Filtering with Generative Trajectory Models for State Estimation and Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11732)
*Lukas Lao Beyer,Samvit Das,Sertac Karaman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种不改动预训练生成模型的推理方法：用粒子滤波维护多组状态历史假设，并由扩散模型生成预测观测与动作提议，利用观测匹配权重同时改善状态估计和动作选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型常用于直接根据观测历史采样动作，但联合建模状态、动作和观测的模型还具备预测机器人状态与环境演化的能力。作者希望探究：仅改变推理过程、不修改预训练模型，能否利用这些预测提升状态估计与控制。

Method: 采用粒子滤波维护关于状态历史的竞争性假设。单个预训练扩散模型为各粒子生成状态假设、对应的预测观测以及动作提议。新测量到来后，根据预测观测与真实测量的匹配程度对粒子重加权。除用于状态估计外，这些权重还被用于引导动作选择，优先选择能更好解释观测的假设所关联的动作提议。

Result: 在部分可观测导航和基于视觉的操作仿真实验中，与不进行滤波的动作生成相比，该方法在使用同一预训练模型且不增加测试时信息的情况下，同时提升了状态估计精度和任务性能。

Conclusion: 在推理阶段引入粒子滤波，可以在不修改预训练生成模型的前提下释放其联合预测能力，并让状态估计与控制共享观测匹配信息，从而协同提升二者表现。

Abstract: Generative models can support both state estimation and control in robotics. For control, a common approach is to use the model as a policy that directly samples actions conditioned on observation histories. However, models that jointly represent states, actions, and observations can also predict how the robot state and its environment evolve. We investigate whether these predictions can improve state estimation and control through a change in inference procedure, without modifying the pretrained model. To this end, we use particle filtering to maintain competing hypotheses about state histories. A single pretrained diffusion model generates these hypotheses along with their predicted observations and associated action proposals. As new measurements arrive, particles are reweighted according to how well their predicted observations match the measurements. While particle filtering conventionally uses these weights only for state estimation, we also use them to guide action selection, favoring proposals associated with hypotheses that better explain the observations. Simulation experiments in partially observed navigation and vision-based manipulation demonstrate improvements in both state estimation and task performance compared to action generation without filtering, using the same pretrained model and no additional test-time information.

</details>


### [539] [Graph-Sparse Distributed Predictive Control for Multi-Robot Motion Planning vianEdge-Consensus ADMM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11755)
*Josep Borras-Borras,Pablo Segovia,Carlos Ocampo-Martinez*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种分布式MPC架构用于平面双积分器机器人的避碰运动规划：通过时变预测冲突图筛选相关成对交互，用热启动轨迹每步将避碰约束凸化一次得到固定的凸QP，再用边一致性ADMM分解实现并行局部求解与半空间投影的闭式解；当分布式候选解不满足直接执行条件时，由集中式HOCBF QP进行监督。8/16/32机器人仿真表明可无碰撞执行并显著提升计算可扩展性，任务性能与集中式全图基线相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集中式MPC虽能保证多机器人避碰，但协调所有机器人之间的成对约束导致约束数量随机器人数量平方增长、求解负担难以扩展；分布式方法又常常需要大量通信迭代或难以保证安全执行。因此需要一种既能降低协调与通信需求、又能保持安全性的可扩展方案。

Method: 1) 基于时变预测冲突图仅保留相关的成对交互，降低协调需求；2) 利用热启动轨迹每个MPC周期对避碰约束凸化一次，得到固定的凸二次规划(QP)；3) 采用ADMM的边一致性(edge-consensus)形式分解该QP，使机器人可并行做局部优化，并对分离半空间做独立闭式投影；4) 引入集中式高阶控制障碍函数(HOCBF)QP作为选择性监督，仅在分布式候选解不满足直接执行条件时介入。

Result: 在C++仿真中对8、16、32个机器人进行评测：所提架构实现无碰撞执行，计算可扩展性显著提升，同时任务级性能与集中式全连接图基线相当。

Conclusion: 将稀疏冲突图、单次凸化、边一致性ADMM分解与HOCBF选择性监督相结合，可在保证安全执行的前提下把集中式MPC的协调与计算负担大幅降低，是一种兼顾安全性与可扩展性的多机器人运动规划架构。

Abstract: This paper presents a distributed model predictive control (MPC) architecture for collision-avoiding motion planning of planar robots with double-integrator dynamics. To reduce coordination demands, a time-varying predicted conflict graph selects relevant pairwise interactions. The associated collision-avoidance constraints are convexified once per MPC update using warm-start trajectories, yielding a fixed convex quadratic program (QP). The resulting QP is then decomposed using an edge-consensus formulation of the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), enabling parallel robot-local optimization and independent closed-form projections onto separating half-spaces. Execution is selectively supervised by a centralized high-order control barrier function (HOCBF) QP when the distributed candidate does not satisfy the direct-execution conditions. Evaluated in C++ simulations involving 8, 16, and 32 robots, the proposed architecture achieves collision-free execution and substantially improves computational scalability while maintaining task-level performance comparable to a centralized complete-graph baseline.

</details>


### [540] [Planners Exploit Deterministic Error: Dithered Low-Bit World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11780)
*Yong Hwi Song,Keon Myung Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 低比特世界模型在采样规划中可能因舍入误差在迭代间持续并被候选共享而崩溃；改用每次迭代重采样且所有候选共享的抖动可显著恢复性能，并带来实际加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MPPI/CEM等采样规划器每步需查询学习世界模型数千次，低比特量化是降低机器人模型预测控制成本的直接途径；但作者发现低比特量化可能导致规划性能大幅崩溃，而单步潜空间预测误差并不能解释该现象。

Method: 采用round-to-nearest激活量化且不做校准，比较其与随机舍入在相同位宽下的规划表现；分析舍入误差是否跨规划器迭代持续、是否在候选间共享；在TD-MPC2、DINO-WM及317M参数多任务TD-MPC2上测试“所有候选共享、每次迭代重采样”的抖动；并用CUDA graphs在Ampere GPU上评估W8A4整数世界模型的规划加速与延迟开销，同时比较block-scaled NVFP4和MXFP4。

Result: 相同位宽下，决定成败的是舍入误差是否持续并共享，而非误差大小。共享抖动无需训练即可消除大部分损害：19个受影响Meta-World单元中至少恢复一半、中位数95%；DINO-WM 5个单元中4个有效；317M多任务TD-MPC2的8个受影响任务全部有效。W8A4整数TD-MPC2的规划rollout比FP32快1.9–3.3倍，完整规划步快1.3–1.5倍，但不及预转换权重的BF16；共享抖动最多增加2.3%延迟。NVFP4可消除大部分损害，MXFP4仅部分消除，说明粗网格与共享缩放相关。

Conclusion: 低比特世界模型用于采样规划时，量化误差的时间持续性与候选间共享性比误差幅度更关键；迭代重采样共享抖动是一种无需训练、低开销且有效的缓解方法。作者在查看测试数据前固定了假设、阈值和分析代码，并报告了失败假设。

Abstract: Sampling-based planners such as MPPI and CEM query a learned world model thousands of times per control step, so low-bit world models are an obvious way to make model-based control cheaper on a robot. With round-to-nearest activation quantization and no calibration, we find that planning can collapse, by up to 100 points of success, while the world model's latent one-step prediction error stays no larger than that of a stochastic rounding scheme that plans well. At the same bit width, what decides the outcome is not the size of the rounding error but whether it persists across planner iterations and is shared across candidates. Round-to-nearest leaves an error that persists, and an iterating planner drifts toward the candidates that this error favors; in TD-MPC2, holding the same dither fixed within a step or an episode brings the drift back. Dither shared by all candidates and redrawn at every iteration removes most of the damage at the same bit width and without training: at least half of it in all 19 affected Meta-World cells (task $\times$ bit width) of TD-MPC2 (median 95%), in 4 of 5 DINO-WM cells, and in all 8 affected tasks of a 317M-parameter multi-task TD-MPC2. Captured as CUDA graphs on an Ampere GPU, a W8A4 integer TD-MPC2 world model runs its planning rollouts 1.9-3.3$\times$ and the whole planning step 1.3-1.5$\times$ faster than FP32, though not faster than BF16 with pre-converted weights; shared dither adds at most 2.3% latency. In TD-MPC2, block-scaled NVFP4 removes most of the damage and MXFP4 part of it, which ties the failure to coarse grids with a shared scale. Hypotheses, thresholds and analysis code were fixed before the data that test them, and the hypotheses that failed are reported.

</details>


### [541] [HolidayFactory 1.0: Simulating, Generating, and Evaluating Industrial Robot Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11789)
*Holiday Robotics,:,Jeongmin Lee,Taehyeon Kim,Dohyun Jang,Minji Lee,Seonghun Oh,Dongwoo Park,Geonhyup Lee,Jaehyung Kim,Jaemin Yoon,Jinseop Bok,Jungwoo Kim,Minseok Yang,Philsik Chang,Soomin Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HOLIDAYFACTORY 1.0：面向工业机器人"不重置场景"的持续工作评测框架，含仿真器（HOLIDAY-SIM）、智能体式世界构建与 24/7-BENCH 七项工业任务基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人评测多以"重置后单回合"为主，而工业场景是结果相互影响、场景状态持续累积的重复作业；大规模评测此类工作需同时具备关键物理接触仿真、工业环境构建与持久状态下的性能度量。

Method: 提出由"世界+评测"组成的框架：给定人工指定工作场所与任务，定义含场景变体与流程逻辑的世界以及由作业、指标、评分细则构成的评测。HOLIDAY-SIM 在 Newton 的 SDF 水弹性接触基础上增加本构律与半隐式原始-对偶求解器，将带状态执行器动力学耦合到关节运动，并从仿真状态导出触觉与关节观测；智能体式世界构建借助几何与交互检查生成可仿真资产与场景变体，并自动提出任务条件化评测供人工确认与可执行检查；24/7-BENCH 提供七个工业任务，在不重置场景下统计完成/失败/未完成作业数、吞吐、时延与电机能耗。

Result: 受控实验刻画了所提接触、执行器与触觉模型，并验证了"验证引导的世界构建"的有效性；场景与评测生成实验显示模型评论器存在局限，且难以保证生成评测忠实反映任务要求。已有脚本化轨迹（如 code-as-policy）的作业级评测，但尚未对持久运行下的策略进行比较。

Conclusion: 该工作为工业机器人的持续作业评测提供了仿真、世界构建与基准三位一体的可扩展方案，并揭示自动生成评测的可靠性问题与策略对比的空白。

Abstract: Robots are typically evaluated in episodes that begin from a reset, while industrial work consists of repeated jobs whose outcomes affect subsequent operations. Evaluating such work at scale requires simulation of task-critical physical interactions, construction of industrial environments, and measurements of performance as scene state persists. We present HOLIDAYFACTORY 1.0, a framework for simulating, generating, and evaluating industrial robot work. Given a human-specified workplace and task, the framework defines a world pairing a scenario of scene variants and process logic with an evaluation defining a job, metrics, and a rubric. HOLIDAYFACTORY 1.0 comprises three components. HOLIDAY-SIM extends Newton's SDF-based hydroelastic contact with additional constitutive laws and a semi-implicit primal-dual solver, couples stateful actuator dynamics to articulated motion, and derives tactile and joint observations from simulated states. Agentic world construction generates simulation-ready assets and scene variants using geometric and interaction checks, and proposes task-conditioned evaluations for human confirmation and executable checks. 24/7-BENCH introduces seven industrial tasks in which jobs are evaluated without resetting the scene, measuring completed, failed, and unfinished jobs, throughput, latency, and motor energy. Controlled studies characterize the proposed contact, actuator, and tactile models and examine the effectiveness of verification-guided world construction. Experiments on scene and evaluation generation further reveal the limitations of model critics and the difficulty of ensuring that generated evaluations faithfully capture task requirements. We examine job-level evaluations with scripted trajectories (e.g., code-as-policy) but have not yet compared policies over persistent runs.

</details>


### [542] [PAIR: Proprioception-Aligned Image-Ray Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11798)
*Sung-Wook Lee,Xuhui Kang,Dylan Losey,Yen-Ling Kuo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PAIR是一个利用机器人本体感知对齐"图像—相机射线"联合表示的对比学习框架，通过让相似机器人状态在不同视点下的表征相互靠近，学习视点鲁棒特征，可训练扩散策略或后训练VLA模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视点鲁棒性仍是机器人模仿学习的主要瓶颈：图像在视点变化下具有内在歧义（相似场景外观看似不同、不同状态又可能视觉重叠），策略需同时推断任务相关状态及其在特定相机配置下的投影，导致学习效率低、难以泛化到未见视点。现有相机射线条件化仅提供额外上下文，无法将视觉表征接地到场景的投影方式；而纯几何对齐忽略相机上下文，会引入虚假对应。

Method: 提出PAIR对比学习框架，将图像特征与相机射线信息联合编码，并借助机器人本体感知作为锚点进行跨视点对齐：鼓励具有相似机器人状态的观测在表征空间中保持接近，从而为学习视点鲁棒特征提供结构化的接地信号；框架高度可适配，既可用于训练Diffusion Policy，也可用于VLA模型的后训练。

Result: 在存在相机变化的仿真与真实世界操作基准上，PAIR相较无射线条件的行为克隆基线分别提升12.7和26.7个百分点，对未见视点展现出更强泛化能力。

Conclusion: PAIR通过本体感知对齐图像—射线联合表示，将视点相关的外观投影与任务相关状态有效解耦，弥补了射线条件化缺乏接地、几何对齐缺乏相机上下文的不足；其通用性使其可作为多种策略骨干的插件式训练/后训练方案，显著提升视点泛化性能。

Abstract: While imitation learning has made substantial progress toward generalizable robot manipulation through scaling, viewpoint robustness remains a major bottleneck. Visuomotor policies rely heavily on visual inputs, yet images provide an inherently ambiguous signal under viewpoint change: similar scenes may appear markedly different across viewpoints, while distinct states may share certain visual overlaps. A policy must therefore infer not only the task-relevant state, but also how it is visually projected under a particular camera configuration. This entanglement of viewpoint-dependent appearance and task-relevant state can make learning inefficient and limit generalization to unseen viewpoints. Recent work has begun to address this challenge through camera-ray conditioning and representation learning using geometric cues to induce invariance. However, providing camera information as additional context does not by itself ground visual representations in how the task scene is visually projected, while geometric alignment without camera context can introduce spurious correspondences by ignoring viewpoint-dependent projection. We propose PAIR, a contrastive learning framework that aligns joint image-ray representations using robot proprioception. PAIR encourages observations with similar robot states to remain close in representation space across viewpoints, providing a structured grounding signal for learning viewpoint-robust features. PAIR is a highly adaptable framework: it can be used to train Diffusion Policy (DP) or post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. In simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks with camera variation, PAIR consistently outperforms the behavior cloning baseline without ray conditioning by 12.7% and 26.7% points, respectively, demonstrating stronger generalization to unseen viewpoints. Project website: PAIRrobot.github.io.

</details>


### [543] [Budget-aware Correspondence-driven View Selection for Real-time 3D Perception of Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11809)
*Vaishnav Ramesh,Jacob Carter,Shivali J. Patel,Sanjeev J. Koppal,Md Jahidul Islam*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BCVS是一种无需位姿的预算感知视图选择算法，基于图像对应关系打分，可在CPU上以22+ FPS在线过滤冗余图像序列，用于高效3D感知与重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主机器人与智能交通依赖3D视觉感知和场景重建，但真实部署常产生冗长重复的图像序列，拖累下游处理效率；而现有方法多依赖完整SfM流程或相机位姿估计，计算代价高，难以在线运行。

Method: 提出BCVS（budget-aware correspondence-driven view sampling）：完全基于特征对应关系进行打分，优先选择视图新颖性，同时保证足够重叠以维持几何稳定性；给定用户指定预算，迭代选出最独特帧并抑制近重复帧，输出保持连通性、重建损失最小的紧凑子集。

Result: 基准实验显示BCVS在紧预算下优于CPU友好型基线，预算增大时亦保持竞争力；在大型航空与海洋机器人数据的实地试验中，冗余最高降低16%，同时保持稳健的SfM配准与高质量三维重建。

Conclusion: BCVS以低成本、免位姿的对应关系驱动策略实现了高效的在线视图筛选，兼顾紧凑性与几何稳定性，并在多类真实机器人场景中验证了实用性与可扩展性。

Abstract: 3D visual perception and scene reconstruction are critical for autonomous robots and intelligent transportation, yet real-world deployments often generate long, redundant image sequences that hinder downstream processing. This report investigates BCVS (budget-aware correspondence-driven view sampling), a pose-free view selection algorithm that offers 22+ FPS on a CPU, enabling online filtering for efficient 3D perception by mobile robots. Unlike existing approaches that rely on full structure-from-motion (SfM) pipelines or camera pose estimation, BCVS employs a purely correspondence-based scoring strategy that prioritizes view novelty while maintaining sufficient overlap for geometric stability. Given a user-specified budget, BCVS iteratively selects the most distinct frames and suppresses near-duplicates, producing compact subsets that preserve connectivity and minimize reconstruction loss. Extensive experiments on benchmark show that BCVS outperforms CPU-friendly baselines at tight budgets and remains competitive as budgets scale. Field trials with large aerial and marine robotics data further validate its practicality and scalability: BCVS reduces redundancy up to 16% while sustaining robust SfM registration and high-quality 3D reconstructions.

</details>


### [544] [A Benchmark and Layered Evaluation Protocol for Evidence-Grounded Shared Belief Updating in Connected Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11842)
*Ranulfo Bezerra,Kimitoshi Yamazaki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 CREG 基准，将联网机器人中的共享推理评测从"只看最终答案"改为"证据到信念的轨迹"评测。基准含 350 个确定性场景、七类推理机制、每个证据前缀的规范后验参考，以及 9 种表示条件；在 4 个开源指令模型与 6 个透明融合基线上得到三条结论：实体接地是弱模型差距的重要来源、语义关系内容关键但图序列化无稳定收益、信念准确率沿证据序列呈强非单调（中途失败无法被终点评测发现）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联网物理系统（机器人、IoT 传感器、边缘 AI 模块）把观测融合为共享的世界描述，但现有评测大多只对最终答案或动作打分，无法判断方法是否做了证据归因、信念更新、矛盾处理与决策辩护。因此作者主张把联网机器人中的共享推理评测为可测量的"证据—信念"轨迹。

Method: 构建 Connected Robotics Evidence Graph（CREG）基准：350 个确定性生成场景，覆盖七种机制（合理修正、信念保持、关系关联、矛盾出现与消解、陈旧/延迟证据、来源可靠性）；每个证据前缀都提供规范后验参考，并由独立的 log-odds 校验器和盲审专家复核把关。设置 9 种表示条件，将关系内容与序列化、排序、元数据等因素解耦。评测对象为 4 个开放权重指令模型与 6 个透明融合基线。

Result: 三项发现：(1) 实体接地解释了弱模型缺陷的相当一部分；(2) 在依赖关系的场景中删除语义关系会使严格信念状态准确率下降 15.3 个点（Holm 校正 p<0.001），但信息量匹配的结构化列表优于完整图，且打乱图结构并无损害——即关系内容在需要处确实重要，而图序列化本身没有一致优势；(3) 信念准确率沿证据序列呈强非单调性，存在仅看终点的评测无法察觉的中途失败。

Conclusion: 应把联网机器人中的共享推理作为证据到信念的轨迹来评测；轨迹级、前缀级的度量能揭示终点评测掩盖的归因、矛盾处理与中途失效问题。所有场景、参考、提示、指标与分析代码均已开放，可离线、无需硬件复现。

Abstract: Connected physical systems fuse observations from robots, IoT sensors, and edge-AI modules into a shared account of the world, yet most evaluations score only the final answer or action and cannot tell whether a method attributed the evidence, updated its belief, handled contradictions, and justified its decision. We argue that shared reasoning in Connected Robotics should be evaluated as an evidence-to-belief trajectory, and introduce the Connected Robotics Evidence Graph (CREG) Benchmark to make that trajectory measurable. CREG comprises 350 deterministically generated scenarios across seven regimes (justified revision, belief preservation, relation association, contradiction onset and resolution, stale/delayed evidence, and source reliability), each exposing a normative posterior reference at every evidence prefix, validated by an independent log-odds checker and screened by a blinded expert audit. Nine representation conditions separate relation content from serialization, ordering, and metadata. Evaluating four open-weight instruction models and six transparent fusion baselines yields three findings. First, entity grounding accounts for a substantial part of the weak-model deficit. Second, deleting semantic relations costs 15.3 points of strict belief-state accuracy on relation-dependent scenarios (Holm-corrected p<0.001), but an information-matched structured list outperforms the full graph and shuffling the graph does not hurt: relation content matters where required, while graph serialization confers no consistent advantage. Third, belief accuracy is strongly non-monotonic along the evidence sequence, with mid-trajectory failures that endpoint-only evaluation cannot detect. All scenarios, references, prompts, metrics, and analysis code are released for offline, hardware-free reproduction.

</details>


### [545] [Decoupled Asynchronous System for Humanoids (DASH): Latency-Agnostic Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models for Humanoid Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11854)
*Bingzhang Wang,Nathan Zhao,Jialeng Ni,Jiajin Zheng,Yin Zhang,Kehua Chen,Jian Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DASH是一个解耦异步的人形机器人VLA系统，将慢速视觉语言模型（System 2）与快速流匹配动作头（System 1）作为并发进程分离，使控制频率仅由动作头决定，从0.8B到8B骨干均保持20Hz控制率并提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在闭环控制中，VLA模型的视觉语言骨干处于控制关键路径：骨干计算时机器人仍在运动，导致执行的动作基于越来越陈旧（stale）的观测，骨干越大越阻塞反应性，在人形灵巧操作中尤为严重。

Method: 提出DASH（Decoupled Asynchronous System for Humanoids）：将策略拆分为慢速视觉语言模型（System 2）与快速流匹配动作头（System 1），通过LCM通信协议以并发进程运行；动作头将来自冻结骨干的陈旧语义与自身ResNet编码器的新鲜视觉融合；采用去同步训练使动作头在部署时遇到陈旧状态下训练；并用自适应时间聚合器在可变推理延迟下对齐重叠的动作块。

Result: 在计入推理延迟的异步RoboTwin基准上，DASH从0.8B到8B骨干均保持20Hz控制率，而同步基线从9.7Hz降至4.1Hz，且各规模下成功率更高；在配备灵巧手的人形机器人上，DASH的抓取放置成功率明显高于同步流程。

Conclusion: 通过解耦骨干与控制回路，DASH将控制频率与骨干规模解耦，证明异步架构可在保持高反应性的同时利用大规模骨干，显著提升人形灵巧操作的闭环性能。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models pair a vision-language backbone with an action head, but in closed-loop control the backbone sits on the control-critical path: while it computes, the robot keeps moving, so each executed action is conditioned on an increasingly stale observation. A larger backbone therefore directly blocks reactivity, especially in humanoid dexterous manipulation. We present DASH, a Decoupled Asynchronous System for Humanoids that removes this coupling. DASH splits the policy into a slow vision-language model (System 2) and a fast flow-matching action head (System 1) that run as concurrent processes over the LCM communication protocol, so the control rate is set by the action head alone, independent of backbone size. The action head fuses stale semantics from a frozen backbone with fresh vision from its own ResNet encoder, desynchronized training exposes it to the staleness it meets at deployment, and an adaptive temporal aggregator aligns overlapping action chunks under variable inference latency. On an asynchronous RoboTwin benchmark that charges inference latency in simulated time, DASH holds 20 Hz control rate from 0.8B to 8B backbones while the synchronous rate falls from 9.7 to 4.1 Hz, with higher success at every size. On a real humanoid with dexterous hands, DASH achieves clearly higher pick-and-place success than the synchronous pipeline.

</details>


### [546] [Reliability-Adaptive Multimodal Relative Pose Tracking for Underwater Leader-Follower Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11940)
*Mingyang Yang,Zeyu Sha,Xiaorui Wang,Jun Wang,David Chen Wang,Feitian Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种可靠性自适应的多模态感知框架，用于两艘运动水下机器人之间的六自由度相对位姿跟踪，融合视觉、声学测距与水动力测量，并在嵌入式硬件上实现高效闭环编队保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下领导-跟随编队需要持续估计相对位姿，但面临感知条件退化、机载计算资源有限等挑战；单一模态可靠性随时间变化，需互补融合并适应其动态可靠性。

Method: 构建视觉、声学测距与水动力测量融合框架，依据各模态物理特性与时变可靠性自适应加权；以线性计算复杂度建模时序依赖，实现嵌入式端高效位姿估计。使用自建AUV平台开展648次水池试验，覆盖两类领导者、三种光照与九种轨迹，并与Transformer融合基线比较。

Result: 平均平移误差3.8 cm，平均姿态误差2.4°；在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上推理延迟17.62 ms，相较Transformer融合基线获得2.69倍加速；闭环实验验证了移动领导者下的稳定编队保持。

Conclusion: 该可靠性自适应多模态融合方案在退化感知与受限计算条件下可实现高精度、低延迟的水下相对位姿跟踪，并支撑闭环编队控制；包含648次试验的多模态数据集将公开。

Abstract: Underwater leader-follower formation control requires continuous relative-pose estimation despite degraded sensing conditions and limited onboard computation. This paper presents a reliability-adaptive multimodal perception framework for six-degree-of-freedom relative-pose tracking between two moving underwater robots. The framework integrates complementary visual, acoustic-ranging, and hydrodynamic measurements while accounting for their distinct physical characteristics and time-varying reliability. It adaptively weights modality contributions and models temporal dependencies with linear computational complexity, enabling efficient pose estimation on embedded hardware. Extensive experiments were conducted using a custom-built AUV platform, with 648 pool trials spanning two leader vehicle types, three illumination conditions, and nine trajectory patterns. Evaluation yields an average translational error of 3.8 cm and an average orientation error of 2.4°. On an onboard NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, the fusion network achieves an inference latency of 17.62 ms, providing a 2.69-fold speedup over the evaluated Transformer-based fusion baseline. Closed-loop experiments further demonstrate stable formation maintenance with a moving leader under onboard computational constraints.
  A multimodal dataset containing measurements from all 648 trials will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [547] [Flip Anything with Agentic Robotics Self-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11941)
*Shuangyu Xie,Kaiyuan Chen,Ken Goldberg*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出让编程智能体在物理仿真中通过迭代学习自主生成并优化双臂夹爪机器人翻转物体的策略，任务成功率从24.7%提升至95.0%，并在真实机器人上实现多阶段翻转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 翻转（将物体绕平行于支撑面的轴旋转180°）是工业检测、装配和工具使用中的常见操作，但用双臂夹爪机器人对多样物体进行翻转的策略编程十分困难，缺乏通用且可自动开发的控制方案。

Method: 构建基于物理仿真的迭代学习框架，由编程智能体针对不同几何形状物体自主开发并逐步精炼翻转策略；学习过程涵盖从基础交接、倾倒与推动，到稳健抓取与传感，再到薄物体操作及失败恢复等渐进技能；最终形成图结构代码，将高层策略选择与反应式控制相结合。

Result: 渐进式技能获取使翻转任务成功率由24.7%提升至95.0%；生成的图结构代码可迁移至真实机器人，实现多阶段翻转。

Conclusion: 编程智能体可通过仿真中的迭代学习自动获得多样物体的双臂翻转技能，图结构代码结合高层决策与反应控制，具备从仿真到真实机器人的可执行性与有效性。

Abstract: Flipping is a fundamental robotic manipulation skill that requires reorienting a target object in a stable pose on a planar support surface by rotating it 180$^\circ$ about an axis parallel to the support surface -- think of flipping a coin from heads to tails. Although flipping is a common objective in industrial tasks such as parts inspection, mechanical assembly, and tool use, coding a bimanual robot with grippers to flip diverse objects is a significant challenge. In this paper, we show that a coding agent can autonomously develop and refine object-flipping strategies through iterative learning in physics simulations across diverse object geometries. Progressive skill acquisition, from basic handover to toppling and pushing, robust grasping and sensing, and thin-object manipulation with recovery, improves task success from 24.7% to 95.0%. The resulting graph-based code integrates high-level strategy selection with reactive control, enabling multi-stage flipping on physical robots.

</details>


### [548] [The Relative Value of Demonstration Data: Execution Time Limits and Operator Mixtures in Behavior Cloning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11947)
*Jiaxuan Guo,Xingyu Ren,Youran Sun,Jingxin Yang,Kejia Zhang,Haizhao Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出"数据倍数"（data multiple）指标，衡量不同经验水平遥操作者的示范数据价值差异：在robomimic的Square与Can任务上训练行为克隆策略，发现全Worse示范集需1.55倍示范数才能达到与全Better相同的成功率，差异主要源于完成时延；且半Better半Worse的混合集所需示范数比按1/1.55折算的预测还多13%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人示范数据集常混合了经验不均的遥操作者采集的数据，采集团队需要知道"一组示范相当于另一组多少"，以便在数据规模、录制耗时与人力成本之间做决策。

Method: 定义数据倍数为两组示范使策略达到相同成功率所需示范数量之比。在robomimic的Square和Can任务上，分别用标注为Better的两位和Worse的两位遥操作者的示范训练行为克隆策略，改变数据集规模与Worse示范占比，并在20–200秒不同时间限制下评估，同时比较按示范长度比例采样与均匀采样。

Result: Square上，25秒时限内全Worse集需1.55倍示范；放宽到100秒后降至1.11，说明差异主要来自完成偏晚；Can在100秒时差异仍大部分保留。半Better半Worse集在Square上需1.22倍示范，比按1/1.55折算的预测高13%，且该超额在20–200秒各时限及均匀采样下均存在。考虑录制耗时后，在25秒时限内，只有当Worse操作员时薪低于Better的三分之一时，改用他们才在同等成功率下更划算。

Conclusion: 示范质量差异可量化为"数据倍数"，且混合数据的收益是非线性的：简单按比例折算会低估所需数据量；时延（而非纯成功率）是主要成本来源，因此是否改用低质量操作员取决于其相对时薪与时限。

Abstract: Robot demonstration datasets combine demonstrations from teleoperators of uneven experience, so collection teams need to know how many demonstrations from one group match those from another. We measure this with a data multiple: the ratio of the numbers of demonstrations two groups need for their policies to reach the same success rate. On robomimic's simulated Square and Can tasks, we train behavior-cloning policies on demonstrations from the two teleoperators robomimic labels Better and the two it labels Worse, varying dataset size and the share of Worse demonstrations. On Square, within robomimic's 25-second time limit, an all-Worse training set needs 1.55 times as many demonstrations as an all-Better set. Most of this difference is late completion: policies trained on Worse demonstrations finish later, as the Worse teleoperators do, and with a 100-second limit the multiple falls to 1.11. On Can, most of the difference remains at 100 seconds. If each Worse demonstration were worth 1/1.55 of a Better one, as in an all-Worse set, a half-Better, half-Worse set on Square would need 1.22 times as many demonstrations as an all-Better set. In fact, it needs 13% more than that, and this excess persists at every time limit from 20 to 200 seconds. The excess remains when training draws demonstrations uniformly instead of in proportion to their length. On Square, within the 25-second limit, switching to these Worse teleoperators is cheaper at equal success only if they earn less than a third of the Better teleoperators' hourly pay, because Worse demonstrations also take longer to record.

</details>


### [549] [CSG-Nav: Confidence-Aware Semantic-Geometric Fusion for Robust Exploration and Accurate Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11978)
*Shoubin Chen,Rui Xu,Zehao Wu,Kai Zhang,Tao Huang,Zhou Liu,Qingquan Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CSG-Nav：一种以置信度感知多模态融合为核心的零样本目标导航框架，通过语义源融合、空间置信度融合与语义-几何决策融合三重机制，缓解远距离感知不可靠、幻觉导致的方向偏差与几何错误的停止判断问题，在HM3Dv1/v2与MP3D上分别取得58.9%、71.6%、44.3%的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本目标导航要求智能体在无任务特定训练的情况下探索未知环境并找到目标物体，核心难点在于观测不确定性下的感知可靠性与物理可落地的目标终止判断。已有基于基础模型的方法虽提升了泛化能力，但仍受三类问题困扰：远距离感知不可靠、幻觉引起的方向偏置、以及语义上合理但几何上错误的停止决策。

Method: 提出CSG-Nav，围绕置信度感知的多模态信息融合构建三重互补融合机制：(1) 语义源融合——将开放词表检测结果、检测置信度、场景观测与关系推理结合，生成更可靠的方向级语义分数并抑制幻觉导致的方向偏差；(2) 空间置信度融合——用高斯衰减函数对多视角语义证据加权，抑制不可靠的远距离观测并累积空间一致的探索偏好；(3) 语义-几何决策融合——将语义目标检测与基于深度的三维定位结合，支撑具有物理依据的停止决策。

Result: 在HM3Dv1、HM3Dv2和MP3D上取得有竞争力的零样本性能，成功率分别为58.9%、71.6%和44.3%；融合层级消融实验以及在室内外真实环境中的部署进一步验证了该方法在不确定感知下导航的有效性与实用性。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过置信度感知的多模态融合同时处理语义、空间与几何三个层面的不确定性，可显著提升零样本目标导航的鲁棒性与落地性，说明"融合"而非单纯依赖基础模型感知输出是解决零样本导航可靠性问题的有效路径。
