Abstract: Zero-shot object-goal navigation requires autonomous agents to explore unseen environments and locate target objects without task-specific training, posing challenges in perceptual reliability under observation uncertainty and physically grounded goal termination. Although foundation-model-based approaches improve generalization, they remain vulnerable to unreliable long-range perception, hallucination-induced directional bias, and semantically plausible but geometrically incorrect stopping decisions. To address these limitations, we propose CSG-Nav, a zero-shot navigation framework centered on confidence-aware multimodal information fusion. CSG-Nav integrates three complementary fusion mechanisms. First, semantic-source fusion integrates open-vocabulary detection results, detection confidence, scene observations, and relational reasoning to produce more reliable direction-level semantic scores and suppress hallucination-induced directional bias. Second, spatial-confidence fusion weights multi-view semantic evidence using a Gaussian decay function, suppressing unreliable distant observations while accumulating spatially consistent exploration preferences. Third, semantic-geometric decision fusion combines semantic target detection with depth-based 3D localization to support physically grounded stopping decisions. Experiments on HM3Dv1, HM3Dv2, and MP3D demonstrate competitive zero-shot performance, achieving success rates of 58.9%, 71.6%, and 44.3%. Fusion-level ablations and real-world deployments in indoor and outdoor environments further verify the effectiveness and practicality of CSG-Nav for robust navigation under uncertain perception. Code is available at https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/

</details>


### [550] [Thermo-VLA: A Thermal-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model with Gated Residual Modulation for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11981)
*Jingxuan Chen,Junshi Luo,Chencheng Dong,Xiaojian Nie,Tongge Huang,Qiang Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Thermo-VLA与ThermoRes编码器，将热成像分解为冷/热属性表示并通过语言条件化残差调制注入RGB token，实现温度感知的关系推理操作；在双机械臂Unitree G1的六项真实任务中，四个热依赖任务平均成功率0.86，比直接融合RGB-热图的pi_0.5基线高18个百分点，未见物体与场景变化下仍达0.78。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型虽引入热成像，但仅将其当作普通视觉输入，缺乏对温度关系的显式建模，难以支撑温度驱动的目标选择与关系推理类操作任务。

Method: 设计ThermoRes Encoder，把热图分解为"冷"和"热"两种属性表征，并通过语言条件化的残差调制将这些表征注入RGB token中，从而在统一token空间内实现温度驱动的目标选择与连续操作；此外将该残差调制机制迁移至颜色属性以验证通用性。

Result: 在Unitree G1双臂平台的六个真实机器人任务（从基础grounding到关系推理）上，四个热依赖任务平均成功率0.86，较直接输入RGB-热观测的pi_0.5基线提升18个百分点；在未见物体与场景变化条件下平均成功率0.78，为对比方法中最优泛化性能；迁移至颜色属性后，仿真与真机实验均观察到一致提升。

Conclusion: 显式的温度属性分解与语言条件化残差调制，比简单将热图作为额外视觉通道更有效，能显著提升热依赖操作性能与泛化能力，且该机制可推广到其他感知属性（如颜色），具备良好的通用性。

Abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have begun incorporating thermal sensing, but existing approaches typically treat thermal images as ordinary visual inputs, providing limited support for temperature-aware relational reasoning in manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose Thermo-VLA with a ThermoRes Encoder, which decomposes thermal images into cold and hot attribute representations and injects them into the RGB token through language-conditioned residual modulation, enabling temperature-driven target selection and continuous manipulation. We further construct six real-world robotic tasks on a dual-arm Unitree G1 platform, spanning basic grounding to relational reasoning. Experiments show that Thermo-VLA achieves an average success rate of 0.86 across four thermal-dependent tasks, outperforming a pi_0.5 baseline that directly incorporates RGB-thermal observations by 18 percentage points. Under unseen-object and scene variations, Thermo-VLA maintains an average success rate of 0.78, achieving the best generalisation performance among the compared methods. Beyond thermal sensing, we transfer the same residual modulation mechanism to colour attributes and observe consistent improvements in both simulation and real-robot experiments, indicating its potential to generalise beyond thermal attributes. Project website: https://j-x-chen.github.io/Thermo-VLA-web/

</details>


### [551] [OASIS: Optimization-Aware Subgoal Inference with Safety Constraints for Autonomous Mobile Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11996)
*Arian Hajizadeha,Javad Pourrafia,Negar Shenavara,Sana Bashiria,Seyed Majid Esmailzadeh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OASIS：一个将NMPC优化结果反馈给SAC子目标策略的分层导航框架，在五个含静态/移动障碍的场景中取得最高总体导航成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态环境中的移动机器人既要朝目标推进，又要满足运动学限制并避障。学习到的子目标策略能把模型预测控制（MPC）引导到其局部预测视野之外，但几何上"看起来合适"的子目标并不必然对应一个可成功求解的控制问题，即子目标生成缺乏对控制层可行性的感知。

Method: 提出分层框架 OASIS：高层策略用 Soft Actor-Critic 训练，输出局部子目标；低层非线性MPC跟踪子目标，并受运动学约束、几何避障约束以及嵌入式高阶控制屏障函数（CBF）约束。关键设计是把每个子目标区间内的控制器优化结果进行汇总，在该策略下一次决策时作为输入反馈，且不需要额外的优化调用。

Result: 在五个含静态与移动障碍的导航场景中评估，包括密集交互与感知不确定性。与分层变体及直接以目标为输入的变体相比，OASIS 的总体导航成功率最高；在三个训练随机种子下与"除此之外完全相同但不含优化状态输入"的层级结构对比，成功率优势保持一致；所选策略对比显示主要优化失败更少，平均控制器耗时相近。

Conclusion: 将优化结果（优化状态）回馈到高层子目标生成中，是提升分层导航成功率的有效手段；该收益在多种子与多场景下稳健，且几乎不带来额外计算开销。

Abstract: Navigation in dynamic environments requires mobile robots to make progress toward their goals while respecting motion limits and avoiding surrounding obstacles. Learned subgoal policies can guide model predictive control beyond its local prediction horizon, but a geometrically suitable subgoal does not necessarily lead to a successfully solved control problem. This paper proposes OASIS, a hierarchical navigation framework that incorporates recent optimization outcomes into reinforcement learning-based subgoal generation. A high-level policy trained using Soft Actor--Critic generates local subgoals, while a nonlinear model predictive controller tracks them subject to motion limits, geometric collision-avoidance constraints, and embedded high-order control barrier function constraints. The outcomes of controller optimizations over each subgoal interval are summarized and provided to the policy at its next decision, without requiring additional optimization calls. The framework is evaluated in five navigation scenarios with static and moving obstacles, including dense interactions and sensing uncertainty. Comparisons with hierarchical and direct-goal control variants show that OASIS achieves the highest aggregate navigation success. Matched comparisons across three training seeds further show a consistent success advantage over the otherwise identical hierarchy without optimization-status input. The selected-policy comparison also shows fewer primary optimization failures with similar mean controller time.

</details>


### [552] [Grasp-Taxonomy Conditioning as a Mode Switch for Dexterous Grasping of Climbing Holds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12017)
*Rumi Loghmani,Abraham George,Amir Barati Farimani*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BetaGrasp 用四类抓握标签（crimp/sloper/pinch/jug）条件化 DP3 风格点云策略，在 Franka+16自由度 LEAP 手上实现按物体几何选择抓法的灵巧抓取，并以弹簧棘轮式"攀岩支点"测试台量化滑移力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧抓取需要根据物体几何选择不同手型，但单靠点云输入的策略难以从扫描中区分应执行哪种抓握；作者希望验证"显式抓握类别标签"是否是策略选择抓法的有效开关，并需要一个能定量测量抓握质量的硬件评测基准。

Method: 提出 BetaGrasp：一个 3D 扩散策略，将 DP3 风格的点云策略以四类抓握标签（crimp、sloper、pinch、jug）为条件，部署在 Franka 机械臂与 16 自由度 LEAP 手上。同时构建"攀岩支点"基准：带棘轮的弹簧测试台，输出以牛顿为单位的滑移力读数。并设置 DP3 风格基线（不给标签）进行仿真与实机对比。

Result: 点云编码器未能区分四种抓握，仅凭扫描信息几乎无法选择抓法；无标签基线从重置位姿出发的仿真 rollout 无论何种支点都退化为 jug 抓握（抓握类型正确率 25%，BetaGrasp 为 94%）。80 组配对实机试验中，BetaGrasp 将平均滑移力从 9.6 N 提升至 14.3 N，完全滑脱的比例从 44% 降至 10%。

Conclusion: 抓握类别标签在策略中起到"选择开关"的作用，显式条件化显著改善抓握类型选择与抗滑性能，说明仅靠几何点云的隐式表征不足以支撑多手型灵巧抓取，需引入语义化的抓握先验。

Abstract: Dexterous grasping in robotics relies on distinct hand configurations depending on object geometry. We introduce BetaGrasp, a 3D diffusion policy that conditions a DP3-style point-cloud policy on a four-class grasp label (crimp, sloper, pinch, and jug), running on a Franka arm with a 16-DoF LEAP hand. We also introduce a climbing-hold benchmark: a spring testbed whose ratchet gives a slip-force reading in newtons. In our analysis the policy's point-cloud encoder did not separate the four holds, so the scan alone gave it little to choose a grasp from. Without the label (a DP3-style baseline), simulated rollouts from the robot's reset pose all end in a jug grasp, whatever the hold (25% correct grasp type, versus 94% for BetaGrasp). The label works as a switch for which grasp the policy performs. On 80 paired hardware trials, BetaGrasp raises average slip force from 9.6 N to 14.3 N, and grasps slipping fully off the hold drop from 44% of trials to 10%.

</details>


### [553] [DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12038)
*Yifan Luo,Takafumi Matsumaru,Vibekananda Dutta,Xin He*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DPGS-SLAM 提出一种面向动态场景的单目 RGB 高斯泼溅 SLAM 框架：用光流+SAM2 发现并传播动态掩码，借助异步扩散补全与 Metric3D v2 深度生成"临时"静态背景高斯，并通过来源标签（provenance）隔离生成内容与真实观测，从而在遮挡背景未充分观测时仍能稳定跟踪与建图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态物体破坏 3DGS-SLAM 依赖的静态场景假设，导致跟踪漂移与地图污染；而简单剔除动态观测虽能减少干扰，却会让被遮挡的静态背景缺失或弱约束，造成空洞与重建不稳。因此需要一个既能抑制动态干扰、又能在信息缺失处提供合理"临时"约束的框架。

Method: 1) 动态区域识别：基于光流的运动发现 + SAM2 时序一致掩码传播；2) 对选定关键帧使用微调扩散修复模型补全被遮挡背景外观；3) 用 Metric3D v2 从补全图像预测度量深度，初始化"临时"高斯原语；4) 引入来源标签区分生成原语与观测支撑原语，生成内容不参与位姿估计与观测地图优化；5) 当原遮挡背景重新可见时，移除符合条件的生成原语，并用真实 RGB 与预测深度独立初始化观测支撑原语。仅使用单目 RGB 输入。

Result: 相机跟踪具有竞争力：TUM RGB-D 上平均 ATE RMSE 为 1.2 cm，BONN RGB-D 上为 2.7 cm；在 StaDy4D 上，仅用单目 RGB 输入即比 WildGS-SLAM 平均 PSNR 提升 4.60 dB。

Conclusion: 在动态环境中，以"来源感知"的方式引入扩散先验作为临时背景表征，可在不污染跟踪与地图优化的前提下缓解遮挡导致的背景缺失，实现稳定且高保真的单目稠密建图。

Abstract: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.

</details>


### [554] [Learning Contextual Motion Constraints for Object Rearrangement Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12072)
*Lexing Zhang,Zeyu Zhang,Gang Zeng,Hangxin Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MoCo-Net双流网络，从部分视角点云同时预测关节运动范围与障碍热力图，兼顾内部关节限制与外部障碍约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 铰接部件在杂乱环境中的运动不仅受自身关节限位约束，也受外部障碍物约束，但现有方法仅考虑物体铰接属性，忽略了外部约束，导致可行运动范围预测与泛化能力不足。

Method: 设计双流神经网络MoCo-Net，输入为部分视角点云观测，一路预测铰接部件的连续运动范围（内部约束），另一路预测标注潜在碰撞区域的障碍热力图（外部约束），双流相互增强。

Result: 实验表明双流设计相互促进、预测更准确；在新场景中对新物体的泛化提升；所得紧凑配置空间支持定制规划器高效完成场景重排。

Conclusion: 联合建模内部与外部运动约束可显著提升可行运动范围与障碍识别精度，并为机器人构建场景配置空间、实现高效重排动作探索提供支撑。

Abstract: The motion of an articulated part in cluttered surroundings is constrained not only by an object's intrinsic joint limits but also by extrinsic obstacles. However, existing approaches primarily consider object articulation properties alone. Here we present Motion Constraint Prediction Network (MoCo-Net), a two-stream neural network that jointly predicts the continuous motion ranges of articulated parts and obstacle heatmaps highlighting potential collision regions from partial-view point cloud observation. By capturing both internal and external motion constraints, MoCo-Net produces more accurate feasible motion range prediction and obstacles recognition, improves generalization for novel objects in new scenes, and enables robots to construct a scene configuration space for efficient exploration of rearrangement actions. Our experiments show that MoCo-Net's two-stream design enhances each other to deliver more accurate predictions, which subsequently form a compact configuration space for a customized planner to efficiently rearrange the scene.

</details>


### [555] [SAM-VTP: Video Memory and Measured Geometry for Continuous Traversability Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12099)
*Lucas Hoefs,Hui Xie,Senjian An,Fangyi Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SAM-VTP，将SAM2的视频记忆机制用于稠密、无需提示的通行性分割，并用深度几何量测与离线连续监督提升时序一致性和闭环导航可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视觉的通行性预测多为逐帧推理，预测在时间上不一致；且从外观推断地形几何不可靠，二值标签也无法表达连续/条件性的可通行程度。

Method: 微调SAM2视频记忆通路，使每帧条件化于历史观测的持久记忆，实现稠密、无提示通行性分割；由深度计算坡度、粗糙度和高度并融合进图像特征；构建离线连续监督流程，从深度几何与语义先验生成[0,1]逐像素通行性目标，无需机器人部署或逐像素标注。

Result: 在TartanGround上，相较逐帧SAM2基线SAM-TP，模糊Jaccard由0.908提升至0.924，二值IoU由0.854提升至0.886（种子间波动<0.001），帧间闪烁降低31%；两个野外场地闭环试验中，相同规划与控制下基线因掉帧导致无可行路径的频率在铺装路面高3.3倍、崎岖地面高6.9倍；SAM-VTP在机器人搭载的Orin Nano上达21.4 FPS。

Conclusion: 视频记忆、几何量测与连续监督相结合可显著提升通行性预测的时序一致性、精度与闭环导航可靠性，并保持车载实时性。

Abstract: Traversability prediction is a core component of autonomous navigation, yet most vision-based methods operate frame-wise and produce temporally inconsistent predictions. We present SAM-VTP (Video Traversability Prediction), which fine-tunes SAM2's video memory pathway for dense, prompt-free traversability segmentation, conditioning each frame on a persistent memory of prior observations. Rather than inferring terrain geometry from appearance, we measure it: slope, roughness and height are computed from depth and fused into the image features. We also introduce an offline continuous supervision pipeline that generates dense per-pixel traversability targets in [0,1] from depth-derived geometry and semantic priors, requiring no robot deployment and no per-pixel annotation, capturing conditional feasibility that binary labels cannot represent. On TartanGround, a large-scale synthetic ground-robot dataset, SAM-VTP improves fuzzy Jaccard from 0.908 to 0.924 and binary IoU from 0.854 to 0.886 over SAM-TP, a frame-wise SAM2 baseline, against a seed-to-seed spread below 0.001, and cuts frame-to-frame flicker by 31%. In closed-loop trials at two field sites, driving the same planner and controller, the baseline's dropouts leave the planner without a feasible path 3.3x more often on a paved course and 6.9x on rough ground, while SAM-VTP runs at 21.4 FPS on the Orin Nano the robot carries.

</details>


### [556] [Compact and Wide-Force-Range Magnetorheological Hand Exoskeleton for Kinesthetic Feedback in Teleoperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12130)
*Xianlong Mai,Rui Yu,Rui Chen,Daniele Leonardis,Wenbo Li,Domenico Chiaradia,Antonio Frisoli,Shuaishuai Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于磁流变（MR）制动器的可穿戴手部外骨骼系统，实现宽范围、紧凑的力触觉反馈用于机器人手遥操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手部动觉反馈对机器人手遥操作中力与位移感知的恢复与增强至关重要，尤其是渲染不同刚度物体时需要宽范围的力反馈。然而现有方法难以在保持紧凑、可穿戴设计的同时实现宽范围力反馈。

Method: 采用磁流变（MR）制动器构建手部外骨骼系统，MR制动器提供0.01–0.918 Nm的制动力矩，整体质量仅39.8 g；该外骨骼在保持1.01 N反向驱动力的情况下可渲染高达21 N的指尖力。

Result: 实验表明系统仅凭动觉反馈即可让用户辨别物体刚度；在遥抓取任务中两种条件均达100%成功率时，动觉反馈相比仅视觉反馈使物体接触力降低28.2%，提升物体安全性与沉浸感；问卷结果显示动觉反馈改善了遥操作中的可靠性、真实感与用户信心。

Conclusion: 基于MR制动器的紧凑可穿戴手部外骨骼能够实现宽范围动觉反馈，有效增强刚度感知、遥操作安全性与用户沉浸感，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Hand kinesthetic feedback is crucial for restoring and enhancing human perception of force and displacement in robotic hand teleoperation. Wide perception range of force feedback is vital in rendering objects of different stiffness, especially for high-stiffness rendering. However, existing approaches struggle to achieve wide range of force feedback while maintaining compact and wearable design. This paper presents a hand exoskeleton system employing magnetorheological (MR) brakes to provide a wide range kinesthetic feedback during teleoperation. The MR brake provides a braking torque ranging from 0.01 to 0.918 Nm, while maintaining a compact structure with a total mass of only 39.8 g. The proposed exoskeleton can render fingertip forces up to 21 N while maintaining back-driving force of 1.01 N. Experimental results show that the system allows users to discriminate object stiffness using kinesthetic feedback alone. In a tele-grasping task, when both conditions achieved a 100% success rate, kinesthetic feedback led to a 28.2% reduction in object contact force compared to visual feedback only, enhancing object safety and operator immersion. Questionnaire results further indicate that kinesthetic feedback improves reliability, realism, and user confidence during teleoperation.

</details>


### [557] [LHNav: Long-Horizon Humanoid Navigation via Multirate Coordination and Physics-Grounded Action Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12136)
*Xueyang Wang,Zehong Shen,Dingkun Wei,Huaijin Pi,Changpeng Wang,Xing Zhu,Hujun Bao,Yujun Shen,Xiaowei Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出LHNav异步系统，将人形机器人长时程语言导航分解为任务推理、局部运动生成与全身执行三类角色，并用物理数据引擎训练自然且贴合路线的运动，实现单目标到多目标的连续导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法中，任务分解难以保证执行过程中的持续进展；基于路点的导航又难以生成自然、贴合路线的全身运动。人形机器人需要在连续多个目标间保持进度，同时在狭窄空间中稳定运动。

Method: 将导航组织为三个不同时间尺度的互补角色：Brain负责任务推理，Cerebellum负责局部运动生成，Brainstem负责全身执行；实现为LHNav异步系统，利用进度与到达反馈协调导航目标、VLA运动token预测和全身控制。为训练Cerebellum，构建物理数据引擎，提升沿无碰撞路线的运动参考物理跟踪，并将示范与渲染视觉观测配对。

Result: 仿真中，导航VLA在单目标成功率和运动平滑性上优于OmniNav和DualVLN，碰撞与跌倒更少；仅用单目标示范训练时，LHNav在长时程导航任务上达到75.56%成功率。Unitree G1部署展示了真实环境中的单目标导航与零样本长时程任务执行，包括物体位置变化的布局。

Conclusion: LHNav通过异步多时间尺度架构与物理数据引擎，使任务规划与连续运动并行，并将单目标导航扩展到多目的地，实现自然、贴合路线的全身运动，具备仿真与真实机器人上的有效性。

Abstract: We study humanoid navigation across multiple destinations under long-horizon language instructions. This task is challenging because robots must maintain progress across successive goals while continuously producing natural, stable whole-body motion through confined spaces. However, task decomposition in existing methods does not by itself ensure progress throughout execution, while waypoint-based navigation does not guarantee natural, route-faithful whole-body motion. Our key idea is to organize navigation into three complementary roles operating at different time scales: a Brain for task reasoning, a Cerebellum for local motion generation, and a Brainstem for whole-body execution. We realize this idea in LHNav, an asynchronous system that uses progress and arrival feedback to coordinate navigation goals, VLA motion-token prediction, and whole-body control. To train the Cerebellum for natural, route-faithful motion, we develop a physics-grounded data engine that improves physical tracking of motion references along collision-aware routes and pairs the resulting demonstrations with rendered visual observations. Together, these designs allow task planning to proceed alongside continuous movement and extend single-goal navigation to successive destinations with natural, route-faithful whole-body motion. In simulation, our navigation VLA outperforms OmniNav and DualVLN in single-goal success and motion smoothness, with fewer collisions and falls. Using a VLA trained only on single-goal demonstrations, LHNav achieves a 75.56% success rate on long-horizon navigation tasks. Deployment on the Unitree G1 further demonstrates single-goal navigation and zero-shot long-horizon task execution in real-world environments, including layouts with repositioned objects. Project website: https://robbyant-research.github.io/LHNav/.

</details>


### [558] [BioMARS 2.0: a robotic biologist for formulating and adapting biological experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12139)
*Yibo Qiu,Zan Huang,Yilin Qiao,Ziyang Ling,Yi Wang,Zhengyang Lu,Hangke Peng,Haoliang Ye,Ao Tian,Shu'ang Sun,Handi Liu,Yuqing Long,Mohan Yang,Kan Ding,Zhenzhen Zhou,Di Wu,Yu Xiong,Yaxuan Han,Jun'ao Song,Haoran Zhang,Ronald X Xu,Mingzhai Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BioMARS：人机协同多智能体机器人系统，将知识引导的实验决策、机器人执行与生物反馈相连，在程序、参数、干预三个层面验证了反馈驱动的自动化生物实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物实验无法归结为单一优化问题，需在多个抽象层级上做决策（知识到流程、条件适配表型、选择验证假设的干预）。单纯自动化实验执行并不能决定应做什么实验、如何依生物反馈调整，因此需要连接决策与执行的系统。

Method: 提出BioMARS——人在回路的多智能体机器人系统。程序层面生成基于文献、可追溯的动作方案；参数层面利用机器人视网膜类器官培养的图像表型选择后续实验条件；干预层面基于生物医学证据提名药物重定位候选。系统结合知识引导决策、机器人执行与生物反馈。

Result: 程序层面：跨四种模型后端生成文献支撑方案，提升专家评审的协议质量评分。参数层面：三轮实验中后续轮次报告得分更高。干预层面：提名药物重定位候选，六项候选进入湿实验室测试。

Conclusion: 多种研究共同展示了反馈驱动的机器人生物实验，框架支持对实验程序、培养条件和生物干预的决策，体现多层级决策与自动化执行的结合。

Abstract: Biological experimentation is not reducible to a single optimization problem, but requires decisions at multiple levels of abstraction: translating scientific knowledge into experimental procedures, adapting culture conditions to measured phenotypes and selecting interventions that test biological hypotheses. Automating experimental execution does not, by itself, determine which experiments should be performed next or how they should change in response to biological feedback. Here we introduce BioMARS, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent robotic system that connects knowledge-guided experimental decision-making with robotic execution and biological feedback. At the procedural level, BioMARS generated literature-grounded protocols and traceable action plans, improving expert-reviewed protocol quality scores across four model backends. At the parametric level, BioMARS used image-derived phenotypes from robotic retinal organoid culture to select subsequent experimental conditions, with higher reported scores in later rounds of the three-round experiment. At the intervention level, BioMARS nominated drug-repurposing candidates from biomedical evidence and advanced six candidates to wet-lab testing by researchers. Together, these studies demonstrate feedback-driven robotic biological experimentation within a framework that supports decisions about experimental procedures, culture conditions and biological interventions.

</details>


### [559] [GeoMind: A Benchmark for Spatial Understanding in Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12175)
*Jinghe Wang,Xinrui Cao,Duo Wu,Chenghao Gu,Yong Zhong,Linjia Kang,Tianyi Xiong,Zhi Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GeoMind是一个面向桌面操作任务的系统性空间理解基准，包含54个任务变体，聚焦空间推理与空间记忆，并提供可扩展的自动化任务生成与标注流程；实验表明现有具身智能体在空间变化后的目标身份追踪以及将关系/几何约束转化为可执行动作方面存在一致弱点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放世界机器人操作不仅需要将视觉观察和语言指令映射为动作，还需要在复杂布局中识别目标（空间推理），并在交互导致场景持续变化时保持空间记忆。现有具身基准常通过强视觉线索绕过空间推理，且多聚焦静态场景，难以评估智能体的空间记忆能力。

Method: 提出GeoMind基准，围绕空间推理和空间记忆组织54个评估任务变体；构建可扩展的自动化流程，用于生成和标注任务实例，并验证目标与可执行交互。

Result: 对多种具身智能体进行广泛评估后发现，它们在空间理解上存在一致弱点：难以在空间变化后追踪目标身份，也难以将关系或几何约束转化为可执行动作。

Conclusion: GeoMind填补了现有具身基准在系统评估空间推理与空间记忆方面的不足，揭示了当前智能体在结构化空间理解上的关键短板，并公开基准以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation has advanced rapidly in mapping visual observations and language instructions to actions. However, reliable manipulation in open-world environments requires robust spatial understanding: the ability to identify targets in complex layouts (spatial reasoning) and adapt to scenes that continuously evolve through interaction (spatial memory). Yet existing embodied benchmarks fall short in evaluating spatial understanding: they often introduce strong visual cues that bypass spatial reasoning, and focus on static scenes that offer little insight into an agent's capacity for spatial memory. To address this gap, we introduce GeoMind, a systematic benchmark for structured spatial understanding through tabletop manipulation. GeoMind comprises 54 evaluated task variants organized around spatial reasoning and spatial memory. It also incorporates a scalable pipeline that automates the generation and annotation of task instances with verified targets and executable interactions. Extensive evaluations across diverse embodied agents reveal their consistent weaknesses in spatial understanding. Our findings highlight that these agents struggle to track identities after spatial changes and convert relational or geometric constraints into executable actions. We release the GeoMind benchmark at https://github.com/Notfound-JH/GEOMIND-benchmark.git.

</details>


### [560] [Embodied First Exam](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12177)
*Kangrui Wang,Qineng Wang,Changhe Chen,Pingyue Zhang,Chi Gui,Feishi Wang,Canyu Chen,Wenli Xiao,Xiaoyu Huang,Tonghe Zhang,Linjie Li,Zihan Wang,Minyeong Kim,Yiyou Sun,Mingkai Deng,Jinyu Hou,Qi Zhu,Han Liu,Eric P. Xing,Huaxiu Yao,Zhiwen Fan,Yuejiang Liu,Dawn Song,Pieter Abbeel,Li Fei-Fei,Jiajun Wu,Yuke Zhu,Guanya Shi,Ruohan Zhang,Manling Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出“Embodied First Exam”，一个面向编程智能体的统一机器人评测框架，让智能体自行选择直接控制、写代码控制或训练策略控制，并在 47 个机器人、35 个套件、1,156 个任务上评测；最强智能体在标准设置下 456 个核心任务成功率仅 34%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人基准主要围绕视觉运动策略学习构建，尚不清楚编程智能体能否在物理世界约束下可靠控制多样机器人，因此需要一个面向编程智能体的综合评测框架。

Method: 构建统一的 agent-native 评测框架，覆盖 1,156 个任务、35 个套件、47 个机器人，其中 9 个新套件扩展到空间谜题、灵巧操作、多机器人交互、动态全身控制和 sim-to-sim 工程。每个任务最多支持三种设置：Standard（仅传感器观测、默认不可重置）、Realtime（环境在智能体推理时持续运行）、Privileged（可访问完整仿真状态并无限重置，用于搜索 oracle 解和估计上界）。智能体可自行选择直接控制、代码控制或训练策略控制，并对失败阶段进行标注分析。

Result: 在 456 个核心任务上，八种智能体中最强的 GPT-6 Astra in Codex 在 Standard Setting 下成功率为 34%；Privileged Setting 的成功率可作为近似上界。论文进一步比较不同智能体、设置和失败阶段类别，定位失败发生环节。

Conclusion: 编程智能体在物理世界机器人控制上仍有很大提升空间；该基准可作为编程智能体进入物理世界前的“第一场考试”，并提供统一、可诊断的评测基础。

Abstract: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. Existing robotics benchmarks are built around visuomotor policy learning, leaving it open whether coding agents can reliably control diverse robots under physical-world constraints. We therefore introduce the Embodied First Exam, a unified, comprehensive, and agent-native evaluation framework where coding agents can choose their own control approach: direct control, code to control, or train a policy to control. We hope it serves as a first exam for coding agents before they enter the physical world, with 1,156 tasks in 35 suites on 47 robots, including 9 new suites that go beyond pick-and-place to spatial puzzles, dexterous manipulation, multi-robot interaction, dynamic whole-body control, and sim-to-sim engineering. Each task can be run in up to three evaluation settings. The Standard Setting mimics the real world: the agent receives only sensor observations and, by default, cannot reset the environment. Its Realtime variant keeps the environment running while the agent reasons. The Privileged Setting gives the agent access to the full simulator state and unlimited resets, allowing it to search for an oracle solution for training purposes. Success rates in this setting serve as an approximate upper bound. On the 456 core tasks, the strongest of eight agents, GPT-6 Astra in Codex, achieves a success rate of 34% in the Standard Setting, leaving much room for improvement. To see where agents fail, we label the stage at which failed attempts go wrong and compare failures across agents, settings, and stage categories.

</details>


### [561] [Graph-Based RL for Sequential Rendezvous Planning with Multiple Patrolling USVs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12205)
*Seung Woo Han,Hyeon Bin Yeo,Seung Heon Oh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对多无人水面艇巡逻中的指挥艇依次会合任务，提出融合网格路径规划、代理旅行时间预测与图强化学习的框架，以最小化任务完成时间和优先级相关的总延误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多USV巡逻任务需要运动可行的路径规划与优先级感知的会合排序；传统方法难以同时兼顾洋流/转率约束、时空可行性和计算效率。

Method: 网格路径规划考虑洋流，并通过多阶段机动近似转率约束，轨迹跟踪仿真验证可行性；构建可行转移图FTG表示候选会合事件及时间可行转移，用图神经网络学习调度策略；代理模型从紧凑洋流与运动特征预测旅行时间，避免FTG构建和策略训练中的重复路径搜索。

Result: 相比贪心、MLP-RL和2步前瞻贪心，平均目标分别降低10.5%、3.5%和1.5%，且统计显著；计算时间约为2步前瞻贪心的1/35；在未见优先级层级下仍优于MLP-RL，且船队规模增大时收益更明显。

Conclusion: 该框架在保证路径可行性和优先级调度约束的同时，提高了多USV会合任务的完成效率、计算经济性与规模泛化能力。

Abstract: In patrol missions involving multiple unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), a designated command USV can support fleet management by sequentially rendezvousing with each patrolling USV. These operations require motion-feasible route planning and priority-aware rendezvous sequencing, with the objective of minimizing mission completion time and total tardiness relative to priority-dependent due dates. We propose a framework combining grid-based path planning, surrogate travel-time prediction, and graph-based reinforcement learning. The path planner accounts for ocean currents and approximates turn-rate constraints through multi-stage maneuvers, with path feasibility empirically validated through trajectory-tracking simulations. For rendezvous sequencing, a Feasible Transition Graph (FTG) represents candidate rendezvous events and temporally feasible transitions, enabling a graph neural network to exploit spatiotemporal rendezvous relationships for policy learning. A surrogate predicts travel times from compact current and motion features to avoid repeated path searches during FTG construction and policy training. Evaluation using grid-based path planning shows statistically significant average objective reductions of 10.5%, 3.5%, and 1.5% compared with greedy, MLP-RL, and 2-step lookahead greedy, respectively. The policy achieves these improvements while requiring approximately 1/35 of the latter's computation time. It maintains its advantage over MLP-RL under unseen priority-tier settings, with larger gains as fleet size increases.

</details>


### [562] [A Game-Theoretic MPC Planner for Cooperative and Adversarial Drone Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12226)
*Zdeněk Bouček,Miroslav Flídr*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估一种用于无人机协同到达目标与对抗性追逃任务的博弈论模型预测控制（MPC）规划器，通过求解器比较、计算量分析与仿真/实飞验证给出其实时性边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多无人机在协同任务与对抗场景（追逃）中既需要满足个体目标，又需要实时消解冲突，因此需要一个可同时刻画合作与对抗博弈、并能在真实时间限制内完成计算的规划框架；同时现有博弈求解器的可行性与计算开销尚缺乏系统对比。

Method: 构建博弈论 MPC 规划器，集成三维预测、个体目标函数、可选的共享分离（安全距离）约束以及轨迹跟踪接口；对多种合作博弈求解器进行对比，评估其找到无冲突可行轨迹的能力；开展计算研究，量化无人机数量、预测时域与 move blocking（移动分块）对计算时间与数值收敛/可行性的影响，其中 move blocking 将控制输入在若干预测步上保持恒定以削减独立控制变量；最后用 PyBullet 仿真验证协同到达与追逃，并用实验室实飞验证轨迹跟踪接口。

Result: move blocking 通过减少独立控制变量显著降低计算时间；计时测量给出在测试配置下实时规划的实际上限（可行的无人机数量—时域组合）；仿真中成功实现协同到达目标与追逃行为；实飞实验成功验证了轨迹跟踪接口在真实无人机上的可用性；求解器对比揭示了各求解器在寻找可行消解冲突轨迹方面的差异。

Conclusion: 该博弈论 MPC 规划器可作为后续评估与控制器开发的基础框架，其性能受无人机数量、预测时域与分块策略共同制约，move blocking 是兼顾实时性与可行性的有效手段。

Abstract: We present and evaluate a game-theoretic model predictive control planner for cooperative goal reaching and adversarial pursuit-evasion with drones. The planner combines 3D prediction, individual objectives, optional shared separation constraints and trajectory-tracking interfaces. A comparison of cooperative game solvers assesses their ability to find feasible trajectories that resolve conflicts. A computational study quantifies how number of drones, prediction horizon and move blocking affect computation time and numerical acceptance. Move blocking holds control inputs constant over groups of prediction steps, reducing the number of independent control variables and lowering computation time. Timing measurements identify the practical limits of real-time planning in the tested configurations. PyBullet simulations demonstrate cooperative goal reaching and pursuit-evasion. A laboratory flight complements the simulations by validating the trajectory-tracking interfaces on physical drones. The planner can serve as a basis for further evaluation and controller development.

</details>


### [563] [Hierarchical Multi-Channel Tip-Over Prediction via Isolated Temporal Models for Planetary Rover Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12261)
*Siddhant Shete,Raul Dominguez,Frank Kirchner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于隔离时序学习的分层多通道翻车（tip-over）预测框架：多视野TCN学习渐进失稳模式，GRU前向动力学模型通过预测残差检测突发地形扰动，经决策级融合与优先级仲裁输出分级安全动作，并以Orocos RTT安全组件部署于Rock框架、100Hz运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行星漫游车在非结构化地形中作业，通信时延导致无法依赖人工实时干预，因此可靠的翻车预防至关重要。然而现有基于学习的方法通常只优化单一预测目标，难以同时刻画两类性质不同的风险：一是渐进式失稳的演化过程，二是突发地形扰动造成的瞬时异常。单一目标建模因此限制了预测的覆盖面与鲁棒性。

Method: 提出分层多通道预测框架，核心思想是"隔离时序学习 + 决策级融合"：(1) 基于惯性测量单元（IMU）数据训练多视野时序卷积网络（TCN），捕捉渐进失稳模式并给出多时间尺度的事件预测；(2) 构建基于门控循环单元（GRU）的前向动力学模型，预测漫游车名义运动，并以预测残差检测超出模型预期的动态偏差，从而识别突发扰动；(3) 两条通道保持独立训练与推理，避免目标耦合带来的相互干扰，再通过决策级融合与基于优先级的仲裁机制整合信号，生成分级安全动作（提前预警、紧急制动）；(4) 以Orocos实时工具包（RTT）安全组件形式实现，集成进Rock机器人框架，在行星漫游车软件栈上以100 Hz实时运行。

Result: 在跨越异构地形采集的IMU样本上进行实验，系统达到97.58%的事件预测覆盖率，中位提前时间为1.82 s，性能优于单独使用各预测通道的结果，验证了多通道融合相对于单通道基线在覆盖率与提前量上的优势。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，将相互隔离的时序模型通过分层决策融合组合起来，是在不确定地形环境下实现实时漫游车安全防护的有效且稳健的方案；该架构兼顾渐进失稳预警与突发扰动响应，并具备在真实机器人软件栈中以100 Hz实时部署的工程可行性。

Abstract: Reliable tip-over prevention is critical for planetary rovers operating in unstructured environments where communication delays prevent real-time human intervention. Existing learning-based approaches typically optimize a single prediction objective, limiting their ability to capture both gradual instability evolution and abrupt terrain disturbances. This work presents a hierarchical multi-channel tip-over prediction framework based on isolated temporal learning. A multi-horizon Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) learns progressive instability patterns from inertial measurements, while a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU)-based forward dynamics model predicts nominal rover motion and detects unexpected dynamic deviations through prediction residuals. These complementary signals are integrated through decision-level fusion and priority-based arbitration to generate graded safety actions, including early warning and emergency braking. The proposed system is deployed as an Orocos Real-Time Toolkit (RTT)-based safety component within the Rock robotics framework, operating at 100 Hz on a planetary rover software stack. Experiments on Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) samples collected across heterogeneous terrains demonstrate 97.58% event prediction coverage with a 1.82s median lead time, outperforming individual prediction channels. The results validate that isolated temporal models combined through hierarchical decision fusion provide a robust solution for real-time rover safety in uncertain terrain.

</details>


### [564] [VLA-MOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Task VLA Policy Consolidation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12286)
*Yongxuan Lv,Zhen Fang,Lichen Man,Hao Li,Pu Li,Hengyi Wang,Langfeng Cao,Lin Chen,Jie Huang,Xiu Su,Shan You,Fei Wang,Feng Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出VLA-MOPD协议，用多教师同策略蒸馏整合多个flow-matching VLA专家：共享学生在自身访问的观测和ODE中间状态上查询路由教师，并以掩码局部匹配损失监督动作块生成，实现技能合并并减少遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理智能体需在观测中 grounding 语言并执行动作，同时保留多种技能。VLA策略虽提供统一接口，但任务特定后训练易形成彼此分离的专家；混合任务强化学习奖励稀疏，离线蒸馏覆盖不到学生实际访问状态，端点蒸馏又缺少对中间动作生成状态的监督。

Method: 先训练任务或套件专家；再让共享学生采集机器人 rollout，并在每个访问观测和ODE中间状态上查询按指令路由的冻结教师；以脱离梯度的逐flow-step转移目标，通过掩码局部匹配损失监督有效动作块；可选引入参考策略项以促进其他任务保留。

Result: LIBERO上从每任务一条轨迹开始，mean success-once由75.4%提升至98.9%，高于端点动作蒸馏的98.15%；RoboTwin 2.0平均成功率由73.0%升至89.3%；Piper机器人两轮整合使平均成功率由70.0%升至90.0%；近似匹配的Spatial-adaptation研究中，参考匹配将Object套件下降限制在3.0点，而无参考项为13.2点。

Conclusion: VLA-MOPD通过同策略、多教师、逐ODE步骤的局部蒸馏，有效整合flow-matching VLA专家，在多个机器人与基准上显著提升成功率，并缓解跨任务遗忘。

Abstract: Physical intelligence requires embodied agents to ground language in observations and execute actions while retaining useful skills. Vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer a shared interface, but task-specific post-training often produces separate specialists. Consolidation is difficult: mixed-task reinforcement learning provides sparse trajectory-level credit, while offline distillation may miss student-visited observations and endpoint distillation does not supervise intermediate action-generation states. We introduce VLA Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (VLA-MOPD), a protocol for consolidating flow-matching VLA specialists. After acquiring task or suite experts, a shared student collects robot rollouts and queries the instruction-routed frozen teacher at each visited observation and intermediate ordinary differential equation (ODE) state. Detached per-flow-step transition targets supervise valid action chunks through a masked local matching loss; an optional reference-policy term supports retention on other tasks. Starting from one trajectory per LIBERO task, VLA-MOPD raises mean success-once from 75.4% to 98.9%, compared with 98.15% for endpoint action distillation. It improves mean RoboTwin 2.0 success from 73.0% to 89.3%; on a Piper robot, two consolidation rounds improve average success from 70.0% to 90.0%. In a near-matched Spatial-adaptation study, reference matching limits the Object suite decrease to 3.0 points, versus 13.2 without the reference term.

</details>


### [565] [Be My Eye: Learning to See Beyond a Robot's Own Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12295)
*Baifu Huang,Shilin Fang,Jianan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出任务导向的主动上下文共享框架，将机器人观测压缩为任务相关表征，在有限通信预算下增强多机器人协作决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实环境中的机器人存在部分可观测性，多机器人协作时单机观测往往不足以完成任务；现有信息共享多停留在原始观测或通用视觉特征传输，缺乏面向任务目标和执行进度的选择性编码。

Method: 两阶段训练框架：第一阶段联合编码机载观测与任务指令为紧凑上下文表征，并通过任务导向未来预测和软任务进度对应学习进行协作无关压缩；第二阶段将表征接入预训练VLA策略，实现双向上下文交换，各机器人融合伙伴互补信息与本地观测生成动作，并利用动作监督联合优化上下文表征与策略。

Result: 受控实验显示在受限通信预算下性能显著提升；三项真实世界实验在复杂双机器人任务中验证了框架有效性。

Conclusion: 结果表明应从被动视觉传输转向主动、任务导向的上下文共享，以直接支撑多机器人协同决策。

Abstract: Robots operating in the real world are inherently subject to partial observability, particularly in multi-robot collaboration, where individual observations may be insufficient for effective task execution. A key challenge is leveraging complementary observations from partner robots to support collaborative decision-making. We argue that information sharing should go beyond passively transmitting raw observations or generic visual features. Instead, robots should selectively encode task-relevant information according to task objectives and execution progress. To this end, we propose a task-oriented active context sharing framework that transforms robot observations into compact representations, preserving critical information under constrained communication budgets. The framework adopts a two-stage training paradigm. In the first stage, onboard observations and task instructions are jointly encoded into compact context representations. Task-oriented future prediction and soft task-progress correspondence learning guide this collaboration-agnostic compression, preserving information about task objectives and execution progress. In the second stage, the learned representations are integrated into a pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy, enabling bidirectional context exchange. Each robot combines complementary partner information with local observations to guide action generation. Action supervision jointly refines the context representations and policy, aligning information sharing with collaborative decision-making. Controlled experiments demonstrate substantial performance gains under constrained communication budgets, while three real-world experiments validate the framework in complex dual-robot tasks. These results highlight a shift from passive visual transmission toward active, task-oriented context sharing that directly supports collaborative decision-making.

</details>


### [566] [ExoStack: A Modular and Reconfigurable Software Framework for Wearable Robotics Using ROS 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12306)
*Debadrata Sarkar,Upamanyu Ray,Soumen Sen,Aman Arora*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ExoStack是一个基于ROS 2的模块化框架，将体感传感→步态解析→助力生成→执行驱动整条软件链贯通到嵌入式枢纽与主机，并支持参数化个性化的硬件在环优化，跨两台气动外骨骼验证了复用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴机器人依赖从体表传感、步态解析到助力生成与执行驱动的软件链，而个性化又要求每次测量响应能与产生它的助力参数保持关联；现有实现往往缺乏跨嵌入式与主机的模块化、可复用软件架构。

Method: 提出ExoStack：ESA库将ESP32配置为microROS传感/执行枢纽；ExoCore以配置实例化的节点提供多枢纽同步、步态事件检测、轨迹生成、运动规划、代价评估与人在回路(HIL)优化；PASE桌面端负责编辑配置、启动处理阶段并可视化ROS 2话题；通过定义接口可扩展硬件驱动与算法插件，无需修改通用节点。

Result: 在三台嵌入式计算机上表征了枢纽与规划器时序性能，并在两台气动外骨骼上演示了框架的复用能力。

Conclusion: ExoStack提供了一套模块化、可配置、可扩展的ROS 2软件框架，贯通传感-解析-助力-驱动全链路并支持个性化参数关联，具备良好的实时性与跨平台复用性。

Abstract: Wearable robots depend on a software chain that links body-worn sensing to gait interpretation, assistance generation, and actuation. Personalization further requires each measured response to remain associated with the assistance parameters that generated it. This paper presents ExoStack, a modular ROS 2 framework for implementing that chain across embedded hubs and a host computer. Its Embedded Sensing and Actuation (ESA) library configures ESP32 boards as microROS sensing and actuation hubs. ExoCore supplies multi-hub synchronization, gait-event detection, profile generation, motion planning, cost evaluation, and human-in-the-loop (HIL) optimization as configuration-instantiated nodes. The PASE desktop application edits configurations, launches the processing stages, and visualizes ROS 2 topics. Hardware drivers and algorithm plugins can be added through defined interfaces without modifying the generic processing nodes. We characterize hub and planner timing on three embedded computers and demonstrate reuse on two pneumatic exosuits.

</details>


### [567] [UniOMA: Unified Optimal-Transport Multi-Modal Structural Alignment for Robot Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12351)
*Xinrui Zu,Mark Hoogendoorn,Kevin Sebastian Luck,Shujian Yu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文针对机器人学习中多模态表征难以同时实现泛化与对齐的问题，提出在对比损失中加入基于Gromov–Wasserstein距离的几何感知正则化，通过动态学习的GW重心缩小跨模态结构差异，从而在实例级对齐之外增强结构一致性，并在五个机器人基准上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态对齐方法多通过条件依赖或高阶统计依赖建模，未显式考虑不同模态之间的结构一致性；同时，力觉、触觉等模态数据样本密度差异大，给机器人感知中的多模态对齐带来挑战。

Method: 提出一种几何感知的多模态对齐方法：在现有对比损失基础上引入基于Gromov–Wasserstein（GW）距离的正则项；为每个模态编码模态内几何结构，并通过动态学习的GW重心减少跨模态结构差异，实现实例级对比对齐与结构级一致性约束的结合；该最优传输对齐策略可嵌入多数InfoNCE类目标。

Result: 在五个机器人基准及多类下游任务上，该方法相较现有多模态对比学习基线提升了结构对齐效果和下游性能，包括机器人与环境状态预测；GW正则化可无缝集成到多数InfoNCE类目标中。

Conclusion: 显式建模并约束跨模态结构一致性，可有效补充实例级对比对齐，提升机器人多模态表征的结构对齐质量与下游任务表现，尤其适用于力觉、触觉等样本密度不一的新兴模态。

Abstract: Achieving generalizable and well-aligned multimodal representations remains a core challenge in robot learning. While recent approaches have attempted to align modalities by modeling conditional or higher-order statistical dependencies, they do not explicitly consider the structural coherence across modalities. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal alignment method that augments existing contrastive losses with a geometry-aware Gromov--Wasserstein (GW) distance-based regularization. To this end, we encode intra-modal geometry for each modality and reduce cross-modal structural discrepancies through a dynamically learned GW barycenter, thereby encouraging structural consistency in addition to instance-level contrastive alignment. We apply this optimal-transport-based alignment strategy to robot perception tasks involving underexplored modalities such as force and tactile signals, where modality data often exhibit varying sample densities. Extensive experiments on five robotic benchmarks show that our method improves structural alignment and downstream performance over state-of-the-art multimodal contrastive baselines across a wide range of downstream tasks, including robot and environment state prediction. Moreover, our GW-based regularization can be seamlessly integrated into most InfoNCE-like objectives.

</details>


### [568] [Safety-Constrained Intelligent Control of a 2-DOF Robotic Manipulator Using Control Barrier Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12378)
*Gabriel da Silva Lima,Made Widhi Surya Atman,Wallace Moreira Bessa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对CBF滤波器依赖不精确动态模型的问题，提出一种由笛卡尔跟踪控制器与关节空间CBF滤波器共享输出的RBF神经网络补偿器，并利用请求力矩与实际力矩之差驱动辅助状态来校正学习信号，从而降低滤波器干预对自适应学习的不利影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBF滤波器通常依赖动态模型，但当模型参数和外部力存在不确定性时，模型可能不准确，导致约束保障与跟踪性能受影响。论文希望在不牺牲安全约束的前提下提升不确定条件下的跟踪表现。

Method: 设计RBF神经网络补偿器，其输出同时供笛卡尔跟踪控制器和关节空间CBF滤波器使用；引入由“请求力矩与实际施加力矩之差”驱动的辅助状态，对神经网络学习信号进行校正，以减少CBF滤波介入对自适应过程的直接影响。采用二连杆机械臂进行约束调节、消融、匹配不确定性与扰动试验，以及工作范围和时序研究。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提控制器在参数不确定性下改善了跟踪性能，同时维持关节、速度和力矩限制；消融结果说明共享补偿与辅助校正两部分均对性能提升有贡献。

Conclusion: 共享RBF补偿与辅助学习校正能够缓解CBF滤波器对模型精度的依赖，并在不确定条件下兼顾跟踪性能与约束满足，为安全约束控制与自适应补偿的结合提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Control barrier function (CBF) filters depend on dynamic models that can be inaccurate when their parameters and external forces are uncertain. This paper investigates a radial basis function (RBF) neural network compensator whose output is shared by a Cartesian tracking controller and a joint-space CBF filter. An auxiliary state driven by the difference between requested and applied torques corrects the learning signal, reducing the direct influence of filter intervention on adaptation. A two-link manipulator is evaluated through constrained regulation, ablations, matched uncertainty and disturbance trials, and operating-range and timing studies. The results demonstrate that the proposed controller improves tracking while maintaining joint, velocity, and torque limits under parameter uncertainty, and that both the shared compensation and the auxiliary correction contribute to this improvement.

</details>


### [569] [AutoVLA-D: Learn a Trajectory-Geometric Condition from Reasoning for Autonomous Driving VLA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12382)
*Yuguang Yang,Zhewen Tan,Canyu Chen,Linlin Yang,Cheng Chi,Chunyang Liu,Kehua Sheng,Jinyu Yang,Baochang Zhan,Bo Zhang,Yan Wang,Xianbin Cao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AutoVLA-D 提出用离散轨迹几何条件（TrajCond）来增强自回归 VLA 规划的连续轨迹预测，通过两阶段训练先学习 1D-Brohan 差分动作轨迹，再同时自回归生成离散与数值轨迹，在 NAVSIM、nuScenes、NeuroNCAP 上一致提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归 VLA 规划通常直接预测连续轨迹作为最终输出，但驾驶指令描述的是动作而非自车状态，导致对最终连续轨迹的直接条件建模被削弱。作者希望填补这一"动作指令—连续轨迹"之间的表征鸿沟。

Method: 提出 TrajCond，即一种用于 VLA 规划的离散轨迹几何条件。具体将 TrajCond 表示为 1D-Brohan 差分动作轨迹，并采用两阶段训练框架先学习该离散表示，再进行最终连续轨迹预测；最终模型可同时自回归生成离散轨迹与数值轨迹，故名 AutoVLA-D（Double）。

Result: 在 NAVSIM navtest、nuScenes 与 NeuroNCAP 上的实验表明：离散轨迹作为直接输出时效果较弱，但作为 TrajCond 条件时更有效，可在闭环与开环驾驶基准上一致提升最终连续轨迹预测精度。

Conclusion: 离散轨迹本身不适宜作为最终输出，但作为中间几何条件能有效桥接动作级指令与连续轨迹预测，是一种简单且通用的增强手段。代码已开源。

Abstract: Autoregressive VLA planning usually predicts continuous trajectories as the final output, but driving instructions often describe actions rather than ego states, which weakens direct conditioning on the final continuous trajectory. We address this gap with TrajCond, which introduces a discrete trajectory-geometric condition for VLA planning. Specifically, we represent TrajCond as a 1D-Brohan differential action trajectory and learn it with a two-stage training framework before final continuous trajectory prediction. With the simultaneous autoregressive generation of discrete and numeric trajectories, we name our method AutoVLA-D (Double). Experiments on NAVSIM navtest, nuScenes, and NeuroNCAP show that discrete trajectories are weaker as direct outputs but more effective as TrajCond, consistently improving final continuous trajectory prediction across closed-loop and open-loop driving benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D.

</details>


### [570] [PCTac: Mechanochromic Photonic-Crystal Tactile Sensor for Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12383)
*Ruilin Zhang,Xuanshuo Liu,Junzhe Dai,Kefei Wu,Xuhao Qin,Ziyuan Jiao,Wanlin Li,Yurui Qu,Chenxi Xiao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出开源机械致变色光子晶体（PC）指尖传感器 PCTac，以稠密色相场作为触觉观测，并将其直接输入 Diffusion Policy，在三个真机操作任务上取得优于 RGB 触觉与纯视觉基线的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视触觉传感器主要靠成像柔性界面形变（光度立体恢复法向/深度）感知接触，力信息仍需依赖标定、几何重建或学习映射间接推断。机械致变色光子晶体材料可在受载时改变周期微结构与光谱响应，把局部应力直接编码为空间分辨的结构色场，但此类材料极少被用于闭环机器人学习的视触觉传感。

Method: 1）设计并开源机械致变色光子晶体指尖 PCTac，以稠密色相场作为触觉表示；2）开展加载特性实验，验证法向载荷与色相响应之间可重复的映射关系；3）将该色相表示直接接入 Diffusion Policy，在三个真实机器人操作任务上与 PCTac RGB、Wedge RGB 及纯视觉基线对比，共进行 90 次物理 rollout。

Result: 90 次物理试验中，PCTac Hue 成功 68 次（75.6%），高于 PCTac RGB 的 60 次（66.7%）、Wedge RGB 的 57 次（63.3%）与纯视觉的 29 次（32.2%）；并在每个任务上均取得最高成功率，包括扰动试管插入任务 16/30，对比触觉 RGB 基线 13/30、纯视觉 1/30。

Conclusion: 机械致变色结构色是一种紧凑、对载荷敏感的触觉表示，可作为有效感知通道用于机器人学习与闭环操作；同时验证了"物理编码＋原始色相观测＋扩散策略"这一简洁管线优于常规触觉 RGB 与纯视觉方案。

Abstract: Modern visuotactile sensors primarily sense contact by imaging the deformation of a compliant interface. Using techniques such as photometric stereo, they can recover detailed contact geometry, often represented as surface normals or depth. However, force-related information typically still needs to be inferred indirectly through calibration, geometric reconstruction, or learned mappings. Mechanochromic photonic-crystal (PC) materials offer an alternative physical encoding mechanism: contact loading changes their periodic microstructure and spectral response, directly transforming local stress into a spatially resolved structural-color field. Despite this potential, PC materials have rarely been explored as visuotactile sensors for closed-loop robot learning. We present PCTac, an open-source mechanochromic PC fingertip that uses a dense hue field as its tactile observation. Loading characterization demonstrates a repeatable relationship between the applied normal load and the observed hue response. We further integrate this representation directly into a Diffusion Policy and evaluate it on three real-robot manipulation tasks. Across 90 physical rollouts, PCTac Hue achieves 68 successes (75.6\%), compared with 60 (66.7\%) for PCTac RGB, 57 (63.3\%) for Wedge RGB, and 29 (32.2\%) for vision-only. PCTac Hue also achieves the highest observed success rate on each evaluated task, including Perturbed Test-Tube Insertion, where it achieves 16/30 successes versus 13/30 for tactile RGB baselines and 1/30 for vision-only. These results demonstrate the potential of mechanochromic structural color as a compact, load-sensitive tactile representation for robot learning and closed-loop manipulation. Project page: https://bey0ndt1me.github.io/PCTac-page/.

</details>


### [571] [Bridging Task Planning and Execution for Language-Conditioned Bimanual Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12409)
*Emanuele Cuzzocrea,Giuseppina Iannotti,Luca Rossini,Arturo Laurenzi,Nikos Tsagarakis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种零样本视觉语言框架，将任务目标与执行可行性联合推理，用于双臂人形机器人在杂乱环境中的语言条件操作；通过结构化场景表示、带前置/后置条件的并行双臂阶段以及分层验证器，实现障碍物重定位选择、局部恢复与定向重规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家庭辅助与物流等真实环境中的自然语言操作任务常伴随杂乱场景，需要同时考虑任务目标与执行可行性；双臂人形平台还需协调两个机械臂带来的交互与运动学约束，现有方法往往缺乏执行感知。

Method: 构建零样本视觉语言框架：以结合语义物体关系与执行约束的结构化场景表示进行规划，选择障碍物重定位与执行方式并保持任务语义；将兼容动作组织为具有显式前置/后置条件的并行双臂阶段；采用分层验证器在感知不确定性下评估条件，并利用阶段级执行历史支持局部恢复或定向重规划。

Result: 在CENTAURO轮腿混合人形机器人上、九个语言条件操作场景中，任务成功率高于非执行感知基线；在专门失败场景中，分层验证相比始终重规划能以更少模型查询恢复执行失败。

Conclusion: 将执行推理直接融入任务规划，可提升双臂人形机器人在杂乱真实环境中的语言条件操作成功率与失败恢复效率。

Abstract: Robots are increasingly expected to execute natural-language manipulation tasks in real-world environments. This is particularly relevant in household assistance and logistics, where clutter requires reasoning about both task objectives and execution feasibility. This challenge becomes even more pronounced for bimanual humanoid platforms, where coordinating two manipulators introduces additional interaction and kinematic constraints. We present a zero-shot vision-language framework for execution-aware bimanual manipulation that jointly reasons about task objectives and physical feasibility. Planning is grounded in a structured scene representation that combines semantic object relations with execution constraints, enabling the selection of obstacle relocations and execution choices while preserving task semantics. Compatible actions are organised into parallel bimanual stages with explicit pre- and post-conditions. A hierarchical validator evaluates these conditions under perceptual uncertainty and uses stage-level execution history to support local recovery or targeted replanning. Experiments on the CENTAURO hybrid wheeled-legged humanoid robot across nine language-conditioned manipulation scenarios show higher task success than a non-execution-aware baseline. In dedicated failure scenarios, hierarchical validation recovers from execution failures with fewer model queries than always replanning. These results demonstrate the benefits of combining execution reasoning directly into task planning. Videos and additional material are available on the Project Webpage: https://advrhumanoids.github.io/bridging-planning-execution/.

</details>


### [572] [V3DSAM: Semantic-Geometric Loop Verification and Geometry-Anchored Persistent Instance Mapping for Feed-Forward Dense SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12452)
*Maolin Ye,Dongqing Zhao,Linyang Li,Shuai Xue,Yuan Liu,Yiyuan Wang,Wen Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: V3DSAM：结合VGGT-SLAM 2.0几何估计与SAM3开放词汇语义，构建场景级与物体级物理对应，提升长序列稠密SLAM的跨视角关联鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列前馈式稠密SLAM中，跨视角关联常不可靠，且现有方法依赖骨干网络内部特征与帧间时序ID传播，难以稳定维持长期对应关系。

Method: 提出语义-几何双尺度回环验证：利用像素级双向重投影与物体级3D空间对应识别错误回环，无需访问骨干内部特征；并提出几何锚定的持久实例建图：在优化后的全局坐标系中，以类别约束的3D连通性定义物理实例，直接分配全局ID而不进行帧间身份传播。

Result: 在TUM RGB-D评估中，所提验证器拒绝了全部四个错误回环候选；在长序列ScanNet实验中，实例身份一致性得到提升。

Conclusion: V3DSAM降低了对骨干内部特征和时序ID传播的依赖，为实现稳健的长期跨视角关联提供了有效方案。

Abstract: To address unreliable cross-view association in long-sequence feed-forward dense SLAM, this letter presents V3DSAM, an open-vocabulary semantic dense SLAM system that establishes physical correspondences at both the scene and object levels. The system combines feed-forward geometric estimates from VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with open-vocabulary semantic observations from SAM3. We introduce semantic-geometric dual-scale loop verification, which identifies false loop closures using pixel-level bidirectional reprojection and object-level 3D spatial correspondences, without accessing backbone-internal features. We further propose geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping, which defines physical instances through class-constrained 3D connectivity in an optimized global coordinate system and assigns global IDs without inter-frame identity propagation. The proposed verifier rejects all four false loop candidates in our TUM RGB-D evaluation, while long-sequence ScanNet experiments show improved instance identity consistency. Thus, V3DSAM reduces dependence on internal backbone features and temporal ID propagation for robust long-term cross-view association.

</details>


### [573] [Galilean Robots, Aristotelian Sensors: Joint Spatiotemporal Trajectory Estimation and Extrinsic Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12526)
*Abhishek Goudar,Jonathan Kelly,Timothy D. Barfoot*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文提出用特殊伽利略群表示机器人轨迹、用亚里士多德子群表示传感器外参，从而将时空标定中的时间偏移与运动耦合统一到群结构中，避免单独参数化连续时间轨迹；并开发了twist与IMU运动先验，兼容理想与非理想时钟，在相机、位置和测距观测下验证了该方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时空标定方法通常将传感器外参表示为刚体变换加标量时间偏移，使空间与时间参数通过分离机制进入估计问题；空间变换可直接与机器人位姿复合，但时间偏移需要在平移后的时刻评估轨迹，因而依赖运动补偿、插值或连续时间轨迹表示。

Method: 采用特殊伽利略群表示机器人轨迹，采用亚里士多德子群表示传感器外参，通过群结构直接刻画运动与时间偏移之间的耦合；开发基于twist和IMU的运动先验，处理理想与非理想时钟，并使用相机、位置和测距测量进行联合轨迹估计与时空标定。

Result: 仿真和真实实验表明，在多种异构传感器配置下，该框架的标定与轨迹估计性能与现有成熟方法相当。

Conclusion: 该简化框架在不牺牲性能的前提下，相较现有方法提供了使用便利性（quality-of-life）提升，为多传感器时空标定提供了统一而简洁的群论建模范式。

Abstract: Multi-sensor state estimation requires accurate spatial and temporal calibration between heterogeneous sensors. Existing spatiotemporal calibration methods typically represent sensor extrinsic parameters as a rigid-body transformation together with a scalar temporal offset, causing the spatial and temporal parameters to enter the estimation problem through separate mechanisms. While the spatial transformation composes directly with the robot pose, accounting for the temporal offset requires evaluating the trajectory at a shifted time, typically through motion compensation, interpolation, or a continuous-time trajectory representation. In this work, we formulate joint trajectory estimation and spatiotemporal calibration using the special Galilean group for the robot trajectory and the Aristotelian subgroup for sensor extrinsics. This representation incorporates the coupling between motion and temporal offset directly through the group structure, avoiding the need for a separately parameterized continuous-time trajectory. We develop twist- and IMU-driven motion priors, accommodate both ideal and non-ideal clocks, and evaluate the framework with camera, position, and range measurements. Simulated and real experiments demonstrate calibration and trajectory-estimation performance comparable to established methods across heterogeneous sensor configurations. Our simplified framework therefore offers a quality-of-life improvement over existing methods without compromising performance.

</details>


### [574] [Modeling and Estimation of a Towed Marine System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12568)
*Josef Matouš,Simon Hoff,Damiano Varagnolo,Marius S. Rundhovde,Kristin Y. Pettersen,Martin Saska*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对由两艘自主水面艇、脐带缆、拖曳鱼及尾端环缆组成的拖曳海洋系统，建立集中质量模型，并在仅利用水面艇载传感器测量条件下提出降阶观测器与完美量测扩展卡尔曼滤波两种状态估计方法，经仿真与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拖曳海洋系统的建模与状态估计具有挑战性，且实际中往往只能获得水面自主艇的传感器信息，需要在不依赖水下直接测量的情况下估计系统状态。

Method: 采用集中质量法对缆绳和拖曳鱼建模，以兼顾关键动力学与计算可处理性；通过Lyapunov分析验证模型的稳定性与收敛性；在此基础上，仅利用ASV船载传感器测量，设计降阶观测器和完美量测扩展卡尔曼滤波（PMEKF）两种状态估计器。

Result: 数值仿真和实验结果验证了所提模型及两种状态估计方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 所建立的集中质量模型及基于ASV测量的降阶观测器与PMEKF能够有效实现拖曳海洋系统的状态估计，为相关系统建模与估计提供了可行方案。

Abstract: This paper addresses the modeling and state estimation of a towed marine system consisting of two autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs), a pair of umbilical cables, towfish, and a trailing loop cable. Inspired by the existing literature, we employ a lumped-mass modeling approach for the cables and towfish, capturing the essential dynamics while maintaining computational tractability. A Lyapunov-based analysis is conducted to verify the stability and convergence properties of the proposed model. Building on this model, we propose two state estimation methods, namely a reduced-order observer and a perfect-measurement extended Kalman filter (PMEKF), using only the measurements from the ASVs' onboard sensors. Numerical simulations and experimental results are provided to validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

</details>


### [575] [Correctness Boundaries of Typed Plans for Natural-Language Robot Fleet Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12654)
*Artem Tuzov,Dmitrii Vizitei,Evgenii Shlomov,Senya Belykh,Anastasia Malakhova,Alexander Maloletov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文研究自然语言机器人集群控制中，计划验证与执行报告能够（和不能）证明什么，并区分"可执行动作的改变"与"完成报告所覆盖需求的改变"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言下达的机器人集群命令，经类型化计划、确定性修正、集群协调与结果检查逐级执行，但现有验证与执行报告未必能说明实际行为是否仍符合原始命令。作者希望厘清"计划验证"和"执行报告"各自能证明什么，尤其是何时应重新核对有效分配、目标与报告结果同原始命令的一致性。

Method: 在基于ROS 2的三级实现中，用20台仿真机器人追踪命令在类型化计划、确定性修正、集群协调和结果检查中的流转；构建含44个案例的离线基准，检查计划结构与若干命令要求；在5种无响应模式的本地配置下统计通过率；并选取一个18次运行的仿真序列、以及若干编队与搬运轨迹进行案例分析。

Result: 5种本地配置下70.0–87.3%的响应通过率；选定18次运行序列全部满足基于位姿的任务条件，其中包含两次在软件变更后替代不完整运行的成功重跑；日志/计划显示原始任务区内的重复取货分配与目标调整；编队轨迹暴露出结构上被接受但编队形状错误的计划、被拒绝的路线，以及重规划后遗漏某台被请求机器人的到达报告。

Conclusion: 计划验证与执行报告存在区分度与局限：某些改变只影响可执行动作，某些则改变了完成报告所覆盖的需求。因此应依据原始命令重新核查有效分配、目标与所报告的结果，而不能仅凭验证通过或报告完成判定任务达成。

Abstract: We examine what plan validation and execution reports establish in natural-language robot fleet control. Commands are traced through typed plans, deterministic corrections, fleet coordination and outcome checks in a three-level Robot Operating System 2 implementation with twenty simulated robots. An offline benchmark of 44 cases checks plan structure and selected command requirements. Across five local configurations without a response schema, 70.0-87.3% of responses pass. All runs in a selected 18-run simulation series meet their pose-based task conditions. This series includes two successful repeats that replaced incomplete runs after a software change. Saved plans and logs document duplicate pickup assignments and goal adjustments within the original task zones. Separate formation traces show a structurally accepted plan with the wrong formation shape and a rejected route, and an arrival report that omitted a requested robot after replanning. Carry completion records pickup and subsequent drop-off zone presence for the same robot. The cases distinguish changes to executable actions from changes to the requirements covered by a completion report. They motivate checking the effective assignments, goals and reported outcome against the original command.

</details>


### [576] [VLA Adaptation with Real and Simulated Data: A Case Study on Robotic Chess](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12676)
*Matěj Kripner,Milan Straka*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在"按方格名称移动棋子"的精确操作任务上，系统研究了 VLA（π0.5）微调所需的数据量、更新预算、检查点选择方式，以及仿真示教能否替代部分真机数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型作为通用机器人基础模型，仍需针对每个下游任务和每种机器人单独微调。实践中缺乏明确指导：需要多少数据与训练更新、如何挑选检查点、能否用仿真缓解真机数据采集成本。

Method: 以 SO-101 机械臂按名称（如 e4、a5）在两个方格间搬运国际象棋国王为任务，同时具备精细操作与空间理解需求。在不同数据集规模与更新预算下微调 π0.5，数据来源包括遥操作示教和由随机化脚本专家（模拟人类示教多样性）生成的仿真示教；分析学习率冷却对检查点比较的影响，并检验验证损失、动作误差作为模型选择指标的有效性。真机实验最多使用 256 条遥操作示教，评测 10 个策略、每个 25 次试验；另测试多种策略自改进方法。

Result: 仿真中成功率随数据量与更新次数同步提升；短学习率冷却最多带来 31 个百分点的增益，且是公平比较检查点的必要条件；验证损失与动作误差对模型选择不可靠。真机（部分结果）显示仿真示教预训练收益显著，真机数据稀缺时最明显。负面结果：用策略自身 rollout 做过滤行为克隆、RECAP 式优势条件化、自动教练纠正、残差强化学习，均未在本设定下带来可测量的提升。

Conclusion: 为 VLA 微调提供了可操作的实证结论：数据与更新需同步扩展、学习率冷却不可省略、不宜用验证损失/动作误差选模型、仿真预训练能显著降低真机数据需求；同时诚实报告了自改进类方法在该任务上的失效。作者开源了仿真器、脚本专家与真机示教数据。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained as general-purpose foundation models for robot learning, and require fine-tuning for each downstream task and robot. This raises practical questions such as how much data and training updates are needed, how checkpoints should be selected, and whether simulation can be leveraged to alleviate the cost of real data collection. We study these questions on a task that requires both precise manipulation and spatial understanding of the scene. In this task, an SO-101 arm moves a chess king between two squares that are given only by their names, such as e4 and a5. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ with various dataset sizes and update budgets, using teleoperated demonstrations as well as simulated demonstrations from a randomized scripted expert that imitates the variability of human demonstrations. In simulation, the success rate scales with both data and updates. Importantly, we find that a short learning-rate cool-down adds up to 31 points and is necessary for comparing checkpoints, and that validation loss and action error are unreliable for model selection. On the real arm, we fine-tune on up to 256 teleoperated demonstrations and evaluate ten policies in 25 trials each. Partial results indicate that pretraining on the simulated demonstrations helps substantially, most clearly when real data is scarce. We also present a negative result, in which training on the policy's own rollouts with filtered behavior cloning, RECAP-style advantage conditioning, corrections from an automatic coach, or residual reinforcement learning did not yield a measurable improvement over plain behavior cloning in our setting. We release the simulator, the expert and the real demonstrations.

</details>


### [577] [Library of Hands: Fix the Hands, Not the World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12678)
*Hasaan Ahmad,Qizhen Ying,Yuxuan Sun,Tianjin Huang,Guangming Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出免训练的 Library of Hands（LoH）：保持世界模型冻结，仅校正“命令到实际动作”的映射（hand）。通过冻结模型从两帧图像变化中反推当前 hand，并缓存已识别的 hand，以应对相机移动或控制器变化。在三项仿真任务上成功率从28.6%提升到62.3%，且在无变化时仅下降0.6个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型加规划器在固定设置下有效，但相机移动或控制器更换会改变同一命令的实际效果。例如命令旋转90度后，使用LeWM的冻结规划器成功率从77.5%骤降到7.8%。现有方法需重训练、依赖训练数据，或无法记住重新出现的设置，因此需要一种无需训练、无需额外传感器且能复用历史设置的适应方法。

Method: LoH保持世界模型冻结，只校正从命令到实际执行动作的映射，即“hand”。它利用冻结模型读取hand：比较两帧相机图像的变化，寻找最能解释该变化的动作，作为一次hand读数。LoH保存识别到的每个hand，使重新出现的设置可被识别而非重新学习。整个过程无需额外传感器与训练数据。

Result: 闭环测试中，LoH在三个仿真任务上把成功率从28.6%提升到62.3%，提升超过一倍；在设置不变时仅损失0.6个百分点。方法无需改动即可用于另外两个世界模型，并在三个基于真实机器人数据预训练模型中的两个上有效；其收益随hand读数质量提高而增大。

Conclusion: LoH表明，面对相机或控制器变化，不必重训练世界模型：冻结模型并仅校正命令到动作的映射，即可显著恢复规划性能。其通过图像变化反推hand并缓存复用，具备免训练、无需额外传感器和跨模型适用性，为世界模型规划器的部署适应提供了轻量方案。

Abstract: A world model predicts how a scene changes after an action, and a planner uses it to search for actions that reach a goal. If the camera moves or the controller changes, the same command moves the robot differently: when its commands are turned by 90 degrees, a frozen planner with the LeWM world model that succeeds in 77.5% of episodes succeeds in only 7.8%. Current fixes retrain the model, need training data, or forget a set-up when it returns. We propose Library of Hands (LoH), a training-free method that keeps the world model frozen and corrects only the map from commands to applied actions, which we call the hand. LoH reads the hand through the frozen model, with no extra sensor: it finds the action that best explains the change between two camera images (a reading). It stores every hand it identifies, so a returning set-up is recognised rather than re-learnt. In closed-loop tests, LoH more than doubles success on three simulated tasks, from 28.6% to 62.3%, and loses only 0.6 percentage points when nothing changes. It also works, unchanged, with two other world models and on two of three models pretrained on real robot data, and its gain grows with the quality of its readings.

</details>


### [578] [Sliding into Balance: Benefits of a Sliding Payload for Load Distribution and Disturbance Rejection in Dual-UAV Transportation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12754)
*Jorge Vicente-Martinez,Francisco José Mañas-Álvarez,Edgar Ramirez-Laboreo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 研究两台无人机用单根绳索悬挂可滑动载荷的协同运输，建立含粘性摩擦的平面无量纲动力学模型，并与等总绳长的固定载荷方案在平衡、扰动和阵风仿真下比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统双机吊运常将载荷固定于两根独立绳索，易出现张力不均、绳索松弛及可达区域受限等问题；本文探索载荷可沿单绳滑动的构型能否改善这些性能。

Method: 建立滑动载荷的平面无量纲动力学模型并引入粘性摩擦；在无人机静止条件下，与总绳长相同的固定载荷方案进行平衡分析和扰动分析；进一步通过动态仿真考察真实阵风剖面下的张力表现。

Result: 解析结果表明：滑动载荷可在任意无人机相对位置下均衡两段绳索张力，平衡时不会出现绳索失张；载荷可达区域扩大一倍；除低摩擦且无人机间距较大的情形外，可容许扰动集合增大；阵风仿真中两机间平均张力不平衡较固定载荷方案降低。

Conclusion: 单绳滑动载荷构型在张力均衡、可达范围和扰动鲁棒性方面总体优于固定载荷方案，为双无人机协同吊运提供了一种有潜力的设计思路。

Abstract: This paper analyzes the cooperative transportation of a payload suspended from two drones in which, instead of being attached to two independent ropes, the payload is allowed to slide along a single rope connecting both UAVs. First, a planar nondimensional dynamical model of the sliding motion with viscous friction is presented. Then, considering stationary drones, this configuration is compared with a fixed payload with the same total rope length, both at equilibrium and under disturbances. The analytical results show that the sliding payload equalizes the tension in both rope segments for any relative position of the drones, so that no rope loses tension at equilibrium; it doubles the region reachable by the payload and, except for low friction combined with a large drone separation, it enlarges the set of admissible disturbances. Finally, a dynamic simulation also shows that under realistic gusty wind profiles, the average tension imbalance between the drones is reduced with respect to the fixed-payload solution.

</details>


### [579] [Benchmarking Real-World Robotic Manipulation through Stochastic Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12804)
*Elias Gläßer,Gülhan Şikaroğlu,Pavlo Kupyn,Marc Pollefeys,Zuria Bauer,Hermann Blum*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出"随机挑战"（stochastic challenges）范式，用可复现的真实场景配合随机任务采样，实现跨实验室、跨机器人平台的操作基准比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实环境下操作任务的可复现性与方法可比性是瓶颈：交互式任务无法用静态数据集评估，而仿真基准无法覆盖真实世界的全部复杂度，因此需要一种兼顾可复现性和严格性的真实世界基准方法。

Method: 借鉴YCB物体思路构建可复现的真实场景，并引入随机任务采样，使挑战具备隐藏测试集的严谨性与意外性；在任务样本来自同一分布的前提下，用成功率对不同实验室的不同机器人进行对比评估，并以移动操作任务实现该基准。

Result: 提出并实现了面向移动操作的随机挑战基准，并据此比较了两个不同实验室中的两台机器人，验证了基于同一分布随机样本成功率进行跨平台比较的可行性。

Conclusion: 随机挑战可作为机器人基准测试的通用范式，既保持真实场景的可复现性和系统级创新与可比性，又具备隐藏测试集的严谨性。

Abstract: A challenging bottleneck in manipulation research is reproducibility and comparability of methods in real-world environments. Since manipulation is an interactive task, it cannot be evaluated on a static dataset of observations. Benchmarking in simulation is a common remedy, but cannot cover the whole complexity of real-world tests. This paper proposes a new paradigm of stochastic challenges. Like the well-known YCB objects, it is based on reproducible real-world scenes and therefore allows system-level innovation and comparability between different platforms. Due to their stochastic nature, our challenges however, mimic the rigor and surprise of hidden test sets. To this end, we show how different robots in different labs can be compared based on their success rate over different random task samples, if these samples come from the same distribution. We propose stochastic challenges as a general paradigm for robot benchmarking and implement this paradigm in a novel benchmark for mobile manipulation, on which we compare two robots tested in two different labs.

</details>


### [580] [Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12806)
*Bing Han,Yichuan Peng,Haoyu Dong,Yuanmeng Hu,Yongyi Jia,Fangjing Wang,Kecheng Zheng,Yiming Zhang,Yanhong Zeng,Xiaoqing Zhang,Chen Song,Rundong Zou,Anqi Dong,Yuan Guan,Ka Leong Cheng,Xing Zhu,Yujun Shen,Nan Xue,Wei Ning*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出触觉基础模型 LingBot-Touch，通过统一表征实现跨压阻、磁性和视触觉等多种触觉传感器的数据融合，其触觉 token 可即插即用地接入扩散策略与 VLA 模型，在仿真和真实机器人任务中提升复杂操作能力并保持计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 触觉对接触丰富的高灵巧操作至关重要，但商用触觉传感器发展尚早、类型多样且各有优劣，核心问题是让触觉理解摆脱传感器特定物理机制，从而有效利用异构触觉数据。

Method: 构建 LingBot-Touch 触觉基础模型：学习跨不同触觉传感器的统一表征，并可扩展到新传感器类型；生成可即插即用的触觉 token，接入扩散策略及 π0.5、LingBot-VLA 等视觉-语言-动作模型。

Result: 在多种硬件平台的仿真与真实机器人实验中，统一触觉表征显著受益于复杂操作任务，同时保持较强的计算效率，并能持续增强不同策略范式的操作灵巧性。

Conclusion: 跨传感器触觉数据有望支撑触觉学习的规模化，并为未来触觉硬件与具身智能模型设计提供启示。

Abstract: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.

</details>


### [581] [Simulating Vein Compressibility for Ultrasound-Guided Femoral Access: Speed, Accuracy, and Phantom Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12818)
*Amit Manicka,Laurent Coulon,Darwin Ang,Michael Loushin,Timothy M. Kowalewski*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文验证基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim的物理仿真能否以实时速度重现超声引导股血管穿刺中探头压迫导致的组织形变，以及“静脉先于动脉塌陷”这一临床辨识信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人超声引导股动脉穿刺时，探头压力会使组织变形并改变血管解剖结构；仿真器必须足够快地复现这些力学过程以支持机器人交互，但实现静脉塌陷等临床有意义信号所需计算量尚不明确。

Method: 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim for Healthcare中构建低保真圆柱台式体模仿真，采用Stable Neo-Hookean组织本构，并由单GPU上的Vertex Block Descent求解；用机器人按压已知几何与力学性质的物理体模进行对照，并系统改变单元尺寸、时间步和求解迭代次数，随后将文献中的真实力学参数用于数字化腿部模型。

Result: 仿真在各深度对动脉预测误差不超过5个百分点；在25.4 mm按压的前11 mm内静脉误差不超过3个百分点，并复现低保真物理体模的塌陷行为。每帧墙钟时间随求解工作量线性增长，但精度不随计算量增加而提升。选定设置将每帧求解时间从29,700 ms降至30.4 ms（约976倍），与最细参考设置相差不超过1.03个百分点；纯求解30.4 ms/帧，含超声与图形渲染的全栈为56.4 ms/帧。使用真实文献力学参数时，各设置下静脉均远比动脉更早压缩，复现了预期的临床信号。

Conclusion: 结果表明，NVIDIA Isaac Sim平台可能适合用于增强强化学习训练或在线仿真，以支持基于超声的自主股动脉穿刺。

Abstract: In ultrasound-guided femoral access, probe pressure deforms the tissue and changes the vascular anatomy a robot observes. A simulator must reproduce these mechanics fast enough for robotic interaction, yet the computational effort needed for a clinically meaningful signal like vein collapse before artery is unclear. We test the feasibility of a physics-based simulation in NVIDIA's Isaac Sim for Healthcare, with Stable Neo-Hookean tissue solved by Vertex Block Descent on one GPU. A simulation of a low-fidelity cylindrical benchtop phantom with known geometry and mechanical properties, pressed by a robot, predicted its artery within 5 percentage points at every depth. It matched the vein within 3 points through 11 mm of a 25.4 mm press and followed the collapse behavior of the low-fidelity physical phantom. Across element size, time step, and solver iterations, wall clock time per frame scaled linearly with solver work, but accuracy did not improve with more work. The chosen setting reduced solver time per frame by a factor of 976, from 29,700 ms to 30.4 ms, while remaining within 1.03 points of the finest reference setting. The physics solver alone took 30.4 ms per frame, while the full stack, including ultrasound and graphics rendering, took 56.4 ms per frame. Finally, when seeded with realistic literature-based mechanical properties, the digital leg model compressed the vein far more than the artery at every setting, reproducing the expected clinical signal of vein collapse before artery, which is used to distinguish them. In total, these results suggest that the NVIDIA Isaac Sim platform may be suitable for augmenting reinforcement learning training or online simulation for autonomous femoral access with ultrasound.

</details>


### [582] [REINS: A Self-Evolving Agent Harness for Real-Time Trajectory Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10748)
*Zhihong Cui,Hengyu Liu,Haoran Tang,Shijun Liu,Amir Taherkordi,Tor Skeie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: REINS 是一个面向轨迹规划的 LLM Agent Harness：将 LLM 输出与可学习动力学模型对齐，经校准谓词与前向推演验证后，固化为可索引规则记忆，从而在毫秒级时延下实现可自我演化的实时规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 轨迹规划要么让 LLM 留在控制回路中、难以满足毫秒级约束；要么退化为离线规则或训练期监督，导致运行时规划器无法持续进化。中间混合方案又缺少 harness 所必需的“验证—固化”闭环，可靠性不足。作者因此追问：怎样的运行时 harness 能让 LLM 规划器兼顾实时性与可部署的自我演化？

Method: 提出 REINS harness，建立三种 LLM-planner 耦合：(i) 将 LLM 输出落地到可学习的变量级动力学模型；(ii) 用校准谓词和 forward rollout 进行验证；(iii) 将经验证输出固化为带索引的规则记忆，后续场景以 O(log n) 查询复用而无需再次调用 LLM。由此形成自演化闭环：熟悉场景走记忆检索，新颖场景调用 LLM，验证后的结果再回填记忆。

Result: 在不修改 LLM 权重的前提下，REINS 在仿真与真实世界基准的战术决策层达到 98%+ 合规率、碰撞率降低近 50%，时延为 1.9–4.6 ms；随着记忆成熟，LLM 调用率单调下降。

Conclusion: REINS 表明，通过“ grounding—verification—consolidation ”的 harness 设计，可以将 LLM 的能力转化为低时延、可验证、可自我演化的运行时轨迹规划器，为 LLM 在实时自主系统中的部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Agent harnesses -- runtime scaffolds that wrap an LLM's reasoning loop with tool dispatch, verification, and persistent memory -- have become the standard substrate for deploying LLMs as autonomous agents, as demonstrated by Claude Code and Codex in software engineering. In trajectory planning, however, this paradigm has not taken hold: existing LLM-based trajectory planning methods either keep the LLM in the decision loop, exceeding the millisecond-level control budget, or offload it to offline rules or training-time supervision -- leaving the runtime planner non-evolving. Intermediate hybrids still lack the verification-and-consolidation loop that makes harnesses reliable. We ask: what runtime harness would let an LLM planner meet real-time constraints while self-evolving into a deployable one? We propose REINS, a harness built on three LLM-planner couplings: LLM outputs are (i) grounded to a learned variable-level dynamics model, (ii) verified via calibrated predicates and forward rollout, and (iii) consolidated into an indexed rule memory that serves future scenes in O(log n) without re-invoking the LLM. The harness closes a self-evolution loop: familiar scenes resolve by memory lookup; novel scenes invoke the LLM, whose verified outputs enrich the memory. Without modifying LLM weights, REINS attains 98%+ compliance, nearly 50% collision reduction, and 1.9-4.6 ms latency on simulated and real-world benchmarks at the tactical decision layer, with LLM invocation rate monotonically declining as memory matures. Code: https://github.com/ZhihongCui/REINS

</details>


### [583] [Selective Cooperative Perception via Blind Spot Reasoning and Agentic Dialogue with Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10819)
*Chengyuan Ma,Shixiao Liang,Hangyu Li,Zheng Li,Hang Zhou,Keke Long,Bofeng Cao,Zhaohui Liang,Xiaopeng Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种由视觉语言模型（VLM）驱动的智能体框架，用于多智能体交通环境中的盲区推理与对话式协同感知，以提升实时协同感知的资源效率与可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模多智能体交通场景中的实时协同感知资源开销高、扩展困难。若仅在安全关键场景和关键遮挡对象上选择性执行协同感知，可显著提升效率；而VLM适合在动态不确定环境中进行复杂推理，因此可作为选择性协同感知的推理工具。

Method: 设计混合模型架构：结合传统目标检测保证稳定感知，利用视觉语言推理识别影响较大的遮挡，并通过基于物理的几何模块使推理符合真实可见性约束；同时引入思维链（CoT）提示机制增强可解释性和意图感知决策。基于城市交通中联网车辆的真实数据进行实验，比较四种先进VLM在驾驶关键盲区识别和对话性能上的表现。

Result: 实验结果显示，该方法在驾驶关键盲区检测上准确率超过80%，在对话驱动的感知共享任务上成功率超过90%。

Conclusion: 该工作为传统协同感知流程提供了可扩展、可解释且带宽高效的替代方案，并为未来联网交通系统中的智能体通信设计提供了新见解。

Abstract: Real-time cooperative perception (CP) in multi-agent traffic environments is highly resource-intensive, which posing scalability challenges for large-scale deployment. Efficiency can be significantly improved by selectively performing CP only in safety-critical scenarios and for key occluding objects. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are well-suited for complex reasoning in dynamic and uncertain environments, making them a promising tool for this selective CP task. This study proposes a VLM-driven agentic framework for blind spot reasoning and dialogue-based CP. A mixed-model architecture is designed that integrates conventional object detection for stable perception, vision-language reasoning for identifying impactful occlusions, and a physics-based geometric module to align reasoning with real-world visibility constraints. The framework also incorporates a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting mechanism to enhance interpretability and intent-aware decision-making. We collect real-world data from connected vehicles operating in urban traffic and compare the driving-critical blind spot identification and dialogue performance of four state-of-the-art VLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves over 80% accuracy in driving-critical blind spot detection and over 90% success in dialogue-driven perception sharing. This work provides a scalable, interpretable, and bandwidth-efficient alternative to conventional CP pipelines, and offers new insights into agentic communication design for future connected traffic systems.

</details>


### [584] [HSGNav: Hypothesis Scene Graphs for Multi-Scale Lifelong Navigation under Object Relocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10547)
*Kaiyao Liao,Qingfeng Li,Chen Chen,Qing Sun,Ningbo Gu,Xiaoze Wu,Haochen Zhao,Ying Li,Jianwei Niu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出假设场景图（HSG），将持久家具实体与可修正的台面小物体假设分离，构建HSGNav实现多尺度终身导航，并发布FAROS-Bench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实家居中物体常被移动，机器人需反复定位从大件家具到微小台面物品等不同尺度目标。将不同尺度检测统一实例化为3D对象对小型台面物品较脆弱，且缺乏显式状态校验会导致过时记录在场景变化后仍残留。现有GOAT-Bench等终身基准也较少要求中途记忆失效与多尺度搜索。
