TL;DR: 提出开源平台 TripleGrader，用于对已抽取的“主-谓-宾”三元组按0–10序数尺度独立评分，隐藏同伴分数，支持讨论、修订与版本发布，并计算二次加权 Cohen/Fleiss kappa；测试与两套基准语料实验表明，LLM抽取三元组需大量人工审核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识图谱需要经过验证的关系三元组，金标准基准通常由多名标注者构建；现有文本标注平台主要面向片段标注和类别标签一致性，不适合对已抽取三元组进行序数质量评分。

Method: 开发开源Web平台TripleGrader：每条三元组独立评分，评分完成前隐藏他人分数；支持线程化评论、修订建议、会话所有者审批并发布新版本；一致性采用二次加权Cohen's kappa（两人）和二次加权Fleiss型kappa（三人及以上）；支持导出。评估包括72项自动化测试（含18个REST API工作流场景）、注入10类错误检查修正能力，以及在两个已有金标准的小语料上整理4个大语言模型抽取的三元组。

Result: 在两个基准语料上，仅10%–32%的候选三元组可保持不变，53%–71%需要修正（部分为匹配基准命名规范），每个模型还需新增11–29条缺失三元组；说明抽取结果需要大量人工审核。

Conclusion: TripleGrader为已抽取三元组的序数质量评估、协作修订和评分者一致性度量提供了可用平台；实验表明LLM抽取的关系三元组质量不足以直接作为金标准，需实质性人工审查与整理。

Abstract: Knowledge graphs need validated relational triples, and gold benchmarks of such triples are often built by several annotators. Most text annotation platforms focus on span tagging and compute agreement on categorical labels. They are not designed for ordinal quality grading of triples that have already been extracted. We present TripleGrader, an open-source web platform for grading subject-predicate-object triples on a 0 to 10 ordinal scale. In TripleGrader, each triple is scored independently, and peer scores stay hidden until the grader has rated it. Graders then discuss entries in threaded comments and propose revisions, which the session owner approves and publishes as new versions. For agreement, the platform computes quadratic-weighted Cohen's kappa for two raters and a quadratic-weighted Fleiss-type kappa for three or more. Graded sessions and the final benchmark are exported in common formats. We evaluated the platform in three ways. We ran 72 automated tests, including 18 workflow scenarios through the REST API. We also injected 10 error types to check whether prescribed corrections could be applied while preserving unaffected triples. On two small corpora with existing gold benchmarks, we then used the platform to curate the triples extracted by four large language models into each benchmark. Only 10% to 32% of the candidate triples could be kept unchanged, and 53% to 71% needed corrections, partly to match the benchmarks' naming conventions. Per model, 11 to 29 missing triples had to be added. On these corpora, the extracted triples therefore needed substantial human review. The source code is available at https://github.com/razz0n/triple-grader-tool.

</details>


### [619] [SIRIS: Can LLMs Tell When Simulation Errors Matter in AI-Driven Systems Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10329)
*Jinwoo Hwang,Sukmin Cho,Tao Zhang,Soheil Abbasloo,Jongse Park,Peng Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Siris 基准，通过扰动模拟器构造“预测被改变但仅一个工作负载上推荐仍有效”的配对任务，检验 LLM 智能体能否判断模拟器局限是否会推翻其设计推荐；评测13个前沿模型发现识别局限不等于做出正确设计选择，且强模型也会错误放弃有效推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体日益用于系统研究与大规模设计评估，但模拟器天然不完美：其建模局限可能不影响最终设计选择的正确性，也可能导致选错设计。现有评测难以区分这两种情况，因此需要检验 LLM 能否基于系统理解判断“模拟器局限是否使推荐失效”。

Method: 提出 Siris：对模拟器进行扰动，构造具有相同候选方案、相同局限和相同模拟器推荐的工作负载对；扰动会改变两个工作负载上的预测，但参考模拟器只在其中一个工作负载上支持该推荐。用 LLM serving 设计问题评测13个前沿 LLM，并测试通过 review turn 进行自我纠正的效果。

Result: 评测发现：识别出模拟器局限并不能保证做出正确设计选择；即使最强模型有时也会放弃有效推荐；review turn 自我纠正可帮助部分模型恢复有效选择，但在其他若干模型上引入新错误。

Conclusion: 应通过“不完美模拟器下的设计决策”来评测 LLM 的系统理解能力，而不仅检查其是否能指出模拟器局限；模拟器局限与推荐有效性之间的区分仍是前沿模型的重要薄弱点。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly drive systems research and rely on simulators to evaluate candidate designs at scale. Simulators are imperfect by design: their modeling limitations can distort predictions yet leave the recommended design correct, or change which design should be selected. We introduce Siris to test whether LLMs can tell these cases apart, judging from their systems understanding when a limitation invalidates the simulator's recommendation. By perturbing a simulator, Siris constructs workload pairs with the same candidates, limitation, and simulator recommendation. The perturbation changes predictions on both workloads, yet a reference simulator supports the recommendation on only one. Evaluating thirteen frontier LLMs on LLM serving design problems, we find that identifying a limitation does not ensure a correct choice, and even the strongest models sometimes abandon valid recommendations. Self-correction through a review turn helps these models restore valid choices but introduces new errors in several others. These findings motivate evaluating systems understanding through design decisions under imperfect simulators.

</details>


### [620] [Evaluating classification and explainability in multimodal petrographic image analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10331)
*Thomas James Wood,Oktay Karakuş,Can Eyüpoğlu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对已发布的 LITHOS 双流视觉 Transformer 进行事后分析，从误差结构、模态敏感性与 XAI 归因三个层面超越单纯分类精度评估薄片矿物识别模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动薄片分类器普遍融合 PPL 与 XPL 两路互补光学视图，但仅凭分类准确率无法说明：错误是否反映矿物学上的亲属关系、预测对每种光学视图的依赖程度，以及归因图是否真正指向影响模型决策的区域。作者希望系统性刻画这些被准确率掩盖的性能侧面。

Method: 基于既有评测输出（105,802 颗专家标注颗粒、25 个类别）对 LITHOS 双流 ViT 开展三项分析：(1) 混淆结构与标签分类体系的对应性；(2) 用逐通道空间均值替换 XPL 或 PPL 输入，比较真类概率下降幅度；(3) 比较五种 XAI 归因方法生成的图，并用 30 颗粒（来自 29 张薄片）的超像素删除实验检验归因有效性。

Result: 误差高度贴合标签层级：误分的斜长石、微斜长石与透长石中有 72.6% 被判为泛化的"长石"类；石英族颗粒 87.1% 被归入该族内标签，而仅 66.6% 获得精确标签。XPL 替换在 25 类中的 20 类造成比 PPL 替换更大的真类概率下降，但三个石英类别例外。五种归因方法对同一输入给出视觉上差异明显的热图；超像素删除实验中"方法减随机"对比值仅为 −0.043 至 0.057，且全部 41 个 95% 置信区间均包含零。

Conclusion: 误差结构、模态敏感性与归因行为刻画的是模型性能的不同侧面，无法由分类准确率或对归因图的目视检查单独确立；细粒度的分层误差分析、模态消融与统计严格的归因检验应成为薄片识别模型评估的标准组成。

Abstract: Automated thin-section classifiers increasingly combine plane-polarised and cross-polarised light (PPL and XPL), two complementary views central to petrographic identification. Classification accuracy alone does not reveal whether model errors reflect mineralogical relationships, how predictions depend on each optical view, or whether attribution maps identify regions that influence model decisions. Here, we examine these complementary aspects of the released LITHOS dual-stream vision transformer using outputs from an earlier evaluation of 105,802 expert-annotated grains across 25 categories. Classification errors frequently followed the label taxonomy: 72.6\% of misclassified plagioclase, microcline and sanidine grains were assigned the generic Feldspar label, while 87.1\% of quartz-family grains received a label within that family, compared with 66.6\% assigned their exact label. Replacing the XPL input with its per-channel spatial means produced a greater reduction in true-class probability than equivalent PPL replacement in 20 of 25 categories, but not in the three quartz categories. Five explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) attribution procedures generated visually distinct maps for identical inputs. In a superpixel-deletion analysis involving 30 grains from 29 thin sections, method-minus-random contrasts ranged from $-0.043$ to $0.057$, with all 41 simultaneous 95\% confidence intervals including zero. Together, these findings show that error structure, modality sensitivity and attribution behaviour capture distinct aspects of model performance that cannot be established from classification accuracy or visual inspection of attribution maps alone.

</details>


### [621] [A Computational Map of the Disaster Mental Health Research Landscape](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10390)
*Soheil Shapouri,Saber Soleymani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文利用大语言模型对PubMed中7,859篇"灾害—心理健康"文献进行自动化计算综述，系统勾勒该领域在灾害类型、心理结局、研究方法与地域分布上的整体格局与方法学缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害不仅破坏基础设施、建筑与经济，也影响受灾人群的心理健康。相关研究快速扩张，已成为心理学、公共卫生及相关社会科学的重要且经费充足的领域，但其整体研究格局尚未被系统刻画，因此需要一张全景式"研究地图"来识别热点、盲区与方法学短板。

Method: 通过NCBI API检索PubMed中同时涉及"disaster"与"mental health"的文献，获取7,859篇文献的元数据；再利用Claude Sonnet从摘要中提取结构化变量（灾害类型、心理健康结局、样本量、研究方法、研究国家等），据此构建LLM辅助的计算文献计量图谱并做描述性统计与占比分析。

Result: 地震与传染病流行是研究最多的灾害，热浪、寒潮等则关注不足；PTSD、抑郁与焦虑研究充分，而攻击行为、自杀等问题相对被忽视。样本量总体不小（中位数452，IQR 142–1,568），但机器学习算法极少使用。方法上以假设显著性检验、综述、质性研究与结构方程模型最为常见，而基于主体的建模、机器学习、因果推断与自然语言处理各自占比均不足1%。研究国别高度集中在美国、日本与中国，许多灾害多发地区明显代表性不足。

Conclusion: 本文提供的LLM辅助计算式图谱给出了灾害心理健康文献的宏观概览，揭示了灾害类型与心理结局研究的不均衡、地域覆盖的偏狭以及方法学缺口，尤其指出计算方法（机器学习、因果推断、NLP、ABM等）的利用严重不足，这些方法有望推动该领域进一步发展。

Abstract: When disasters strike, they not only damage infrastructure, buildings, and the economy, but also affect the mental health of affected populations. Research on the mental health effects of disasters has expanded rapidly and has become an important, well-funded area of psychology, public health, and related social sciences. However, the overall structure of this research landscape has not been systematically characterized. Using large language models, we conducted a review of all articles related to terms 'disaster' and 'mental health' indexed in PubMed. 7,859 articles' metadata were retrieved using the NCBI API, and then Claude Sonnet was used to extract structured variables from the abstracts. The results indicated that earthquakes and epidemics were the most commonly studied disasters while many other disasters such as heat and cold waves have received less attention. PTSD, depression, and anxiety were well investigated but many other mental health issues (e.g., aggression, suicide) are relatively ignored. Despite enjoying relatively large sample sizes (median = 452, IQR = 142 - 1,568), the field rarely utilizes machine learning algorithms. Hypothesis significance testing, reviews, qualitative methods, and structural equation modeling are respectively most common methods while agent-based modeling, machine learning, casual inference, and NLP each appear in less than 1% of articles. Studies are limited to a small number of countries, particularly the United States, Japan, and China, while many disaster-prone regions remain substantially underrepresented. This LLM-assisted computational map provides a broad overview of the disaster mental health literature while highlighting important methodological gaps, with particular emphasis on the underutilization of computational methods that could help advance the field.

</details>


### [622] [Too Big to Inspect? Ethically Auditing Large Datasets Through Small Samples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10399)
*Giovana Marchetti,Jhessica Silva,Tiago Torrent,Carlos Caetano,Sandra Avila*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨能否通过对大规模数据集进行小比例随机抽样，结合AI伦理工具(AIETs)开展可行的伦理审计，并在Framed Multi30K（1%样本）与relation2B-en-research-safe（0.00006%样本）上验证该路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科技企业与研究者常以"数据集过大、无法逐条审查"为由回避偏见检查，转而依赖自动化爬取、缺乏人工治理，导致数据集继承并放大刻板印象、排斥性规范与历史偏见；而人工审计数十亿样本在现实中不可行，因此亟需低成本、可操作的偏见识别方法。

Method: 提出将AI伦理工具应用于随机小样本的"抽样伦理审计"方法：在Framed Multi30K的1%样本上同时使用Datasheets for Datasets、Data Statements、Data Nutrition Labels与Data Cards四种工具；在relation2B-en-research-safe的两个0.00006%样本上使用Datasheets for Datasets，进行定性分析。

Result: 小样本配合AIETs即可揭示伦理问题、结构性偏见与技术性不一致；随机子集足以支撑可行的定性分析，且不造成过度的算力与人力负担；研究表明，偏见一旦出现在随机样本中，即说明其源于数据构建流程本身，无需逐条检查全部实例。同时，AIETs的问题起到"挑衅者"作用，激发对同一数据集的多元视角与分析路径，但分析过程与结论仍根本依赖于人的判断。

Conclusion: 证明"数据集有偏"无需穷尽全部样本，抽样审计是可行且有效的路径；为关于伦理、透明度、问责与AI监管的公共讨论提供了负责任审计超大规模数据的实践方案，同时强调人的因素在审计中的核心地位。

Abstract: Big techs and researchers increasingly claim that their training datasets are too large to inspect for bias and ethical problems. However, in the race to build ever-large models, they have relied on automated web scraping and no human curation. Datasets built this way absorb the stereotypes, exclusionary norms, and historical prejudices of their sources, and the models trained on them can reproduce and amplify those patterns. Because manually auditing billions of samples is humanly impossible, we need practical, effective methods to identify biases in these datasets. This paper studies the feasibility of ethically auditing large datasets through small samples and proposes a practical method for identifying structural biases by applying AI Ethics Tools (AIETs) to random samples. We applied Datasheets for Datasets, Data Statements, Data Nutrition Labels, and Data Cards to a 1% sample of Framed Multi30K, and Datasheets for Datasets to two 0.00006% samples of relaion2B-en-research-safe. Our results show that evaluating small samples with AIETs can reveal ethical problems, structural biases, and technical inconsistencies. Although industry practice assumes that identifying problems requires analyzing the entire dataset, we show that a random subset supports a viable qualitative analysis without overwhelming computational or human resources. Demonstrating that a dataset is biased does not require examining every instance: if a bias appears in a random sample, it is a flaw of the creation process. The AIETs' questions acted as provocateurs, evoking different perspectives and analysis methods for the same dataset, but the analysis and its results depended fundamentally on the human factor. We hope these findings contribute to urgent public discussions about ethics, transparency, accountability, and AI regulation by offering a practical pathway for responsibly auditing massive datasets.

</details>


### [623] [Tail-risk-aware Agent Safety: Constraining Tail Risks Across Multi-step LLM Agent Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10411)
*Shilong Pan,Zhiliang Tian,Zihan Chen,Wentao Zou,Weiguo Chen,DongSheng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出尾风险感知的智能体安全框架TAS，将LLM代理工作流安全建模为依赖安全状态序列，用共享预算约束稀有极端风险（尾风险），通过MDP追踪风险传播并对齐逐步安全策略，抑制罕见高代价失败同时保留正常场景效用，在三个基准上超越十一个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体安全防御（提示工程、后训练对齐）主要提升纯LLM安全性，忽视多步执行带来的风险；外部验证虽逐步检查但忽略风险跨步传播。作者主张应关注依赖步骤间的风险转移与传播，而非单步独立验证。

Method: TAS框架将智能体工作流安全建模为依赖的安全状态序列：1）沿工作流将安全状态转移序列化为MDP以追踪风险传播；2）度量尾敏感风险以针对稀有高代价风险（尾风险）；3）用共享预算约束该风险以推导逐步安全策略。

Result: 通过约束尾风险而非平均整体风险，TAS在抑制罕见高代价失败的同时在正常场景保留效用；实验在三个基准上优于十一个基线方法。

Conclusion: 将多步依赖的风险传播纳入安全建模、并以尾风险+共享预算进行约束，是提升LLM智能体工作流安全性的有效方向。

Abstract: LLM-based agents extend LLMs with tool calls, memory, planning, and retrieval to act in external environments, but they are vulnerable to attacks at different workflow steps. Existing defenses, including prompt engineering and post-training alignment, primarily improve LLM-only safety and often overlook risks that arise from multi-step execution. External verification adds guardrails to check each step separately, but it typically ignores how risks can propagate across steps. We argue that we should consider risk transitions across dependent steps through the agent workflow, rather than separate verification on a single step. In this paper, we propose \textbf{T}ail-risk-aware \textbf{A}gent \textbf{S}afety (TAS), a tail-risk-aware safety framework that models agent workflow safety as a sequence of dependent safety states and constrains the rare but extreme risks (i.e., tail risk) with a shared budget. TAS first models safety-state transitions sequentially along the workflow as an MDP to trace risk propagation, then measures a tail-sensitive risk to target rare but high-cost risks (i.e., tail risk), and constrains the risk with a shared budget to derive a step-wise safety strategy. By constraining tail risk rather than the overall average, TAS suppresses rare high-cost failures while preserving utility in normal cases. Experiments show that TAS achieves better performance compared with eleven baselines across three benchmarks.

</details>


### [624] [Decentralised Drone Swarm Formation under Silent Failures with ACO Pheromone Claims and PSO Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10454)
*Md. Abu Horaira*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究在无中心规划者、存活数量未知、故障静默、通信短距丢包、执行噪声条件下的去中心化无人机编队：用蚁群优化(ACO)的"声称"机制分配队形位置（信息素式强化+蒸发，蒸发兼作故障检测），用粒子群优化(PSO)控制飞行并离线调参，配合噪声缓冲的Voronoi过滤防碰撞，并给出理论保证与大规模实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去中心化编队方法多假设已知成员数量、故障可检测或通信可靠，而在成员数量未知、故障静默、无线电短距且丢包、执行有噪声的"最坏条件"下缺少兼具可证明性与实用性的方案。作者希望用群体智能的机制（信息素蒸发、群体社会项）以极简信息交换同时完成分配、故障检测与防碰撞。

Method: 控制器由三部分组成：(1) ACO分配：无人机通过"声称(claim)"认领图像中的目标位置，声称像信息素一样被强化与蒸发，并在邻居间gossip传播，蒸发速率即故障检测手段；(2) PSO飞行律驱动无人机运动，并对控制器超参数做离线调参；(3) 噪声缓冲的Voronoi安全单元过滤保证间距。理论上证明：被毁无人机的声称在有界时间内消失；交换过表的无人机间冲突被一致消解；幸存者覆盖图像误差不超过2倍；安全单元可行时不会碰撞。实验在留出随机种子、两套调参配置下进行，并包含静默损失一半蜂群、未见形状迁移、300架规模、以及与共享蒸发声称但用argmax无交换的CBBA式基线对比。

Result: 最困难情形下95–99%的运行成功成像；正常难度下静默损失一半成员后96–100%恢复；不改动即迁移到8个未见形状与300架规模；21,088次运行中仅5次出现重叠。同预算调参后，CBBA式基线可靠性不低于本方法且修复更快，但本方法对未见形状泛化更好。集中式oracle速度更快。

Conclusion: 性能收益主要来自信息素动力学与调参，而非ACO的随机构造或PSO的社会项；因此可将本工作理解为一种"可证明的、带故障检测的分布式声称分配+Voronoi安全过滤"框架，其代价是收敛速度不及集中式方案，且分配环节本身可被更简单的规则式分配器替代。

Abstract: We study decentralised drone formation, without a central planner, under the conditions that make it hard: nobody knows how many drones are alive, failures are silent, radio is short-ranged and lossy, and actuation is noisy. In our controller, ant colony optimisation (ACO) allocates drones to picture positions through claims that behave as reinforced, evaporating pheromone and are gossiped between neighbours, so evaporation doubles as failure detection. A particle swarm optimisation (PSO) law flies the drones, a noise-buffered Voronoi filter keeps them apart, and PSO also tunes the controller offline. We prove that claims of destroyed drones vanish within bounded time, that conflicts between drones that exchange tables are resolved consistently, that survivors cover the picture to within a factor of two, and that drones cannot collide while their safety cells are feasible. On held-out seeds and with two tuned configurations, the controller formed the picture in 95-99% of runs in the hardest regime, restored it after a silent loss of half the swarm in 96-100% of runs at normal difficulty, transferred unchanged to eight unseen shapes and to 300 drones, and overlapped in 5 of 21,088 runs. A CBBA-style baseline that shares the evaporating claims but uses argmax without swaps was at least as reliable as ours once tuned with the same budget, and repaired faster, whereas ours generalised better to unseen shapes. The benefit thus comes from the pheromone dynamics and from tuning, not from ACO's stochastic construction or PSO's social terms. A centralised oracle is faster.

</details>


### [625] [Represented but Not Used: Value-Policy Dissociation in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10457)
*Yuzhang Luo,Mohamed Aghzal,Liangming Pan,Ziyu Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LLM智能体的中间隐状态中可线性解码动作价值，但该价值表征常未被可靠用于策略选择，形成“价值—策略分离”；基于自然隐状态变化学习的价值传输（NVT）干预比直接读出方向干预更能改变动作偏好，闭环控制器可提升任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体需选择后果跨多步展开的动作，但决策失误时难以判断是模型未表征未来后果，还是表征了却未用于决策。作者希望分离“价值表征”与“价值利用”两个环节。

Method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct与GPT-OSS-20B上，针对部分可观测Grid环境和WebShop，从中间隐状态线性解码候选动作的相对价值；比较沿价值读出方向的直接干预与Natural Value Transport（NVT，即从动作价值差异自然导致的隐状态变化中学习到的变换）；并测试以价值读出为传感器、NVT为执行器的闭环控制器。

Result: 候选动作相对价值可从隐状态线性解码，且在策略偏好较差动作的状态下仍可解码。读出方向干预效果有限且不一致；NVT在较后层更稳定地影响动作偏好；闭环控制器带来任务结果改善。

Conclusion: LLM智能体能够表征有用的前瞻性价值，但并不总能将该价值可靠转化为策略选择，即存在价值—策略分离；针对自然价值表征的干预有望改善智能体决策。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents need to choose actions whose consequences unfold over multiple future steps, yet poor decisions do not reveal whether the model failed to represent those consequences or failed to use them. Mechanistic interpretability has studied internal representations of environment state and plans, but sequential decision making also requires evaluating how candidate actions change future outcomes. Reinforcement learning formalizes this as action value. We study this computation in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, and GPT-OSS-20B across a partially observed Grid environment and WebShop, a simulated web shopping environment. We find that the relative values of candidate actions are linearly decodable from intermediate hidden states, including at states where the policy prefers a worse action. We call this gap between value representation and policy choice value-policy dissociation. To investigate how represented value relates to action selection, we compare direct interventions along the value readout direction with Natural Value Transport (NVT), a transformation learned from hidden state changes that naturally result from differences in action value. While readout-direction interventions have limited and inconsistent effects, NVT more consistently influences action preferences, particularly at later layers. We also test a closed-loop controller that uses the value readout as a sensor and NVT as an actuator, observing improvements in task outcomes. These results suggest that LLM agents can represent useful prospective value without reliably translating it into policy choice.

</details>


### [626] [PatternBloom: Empowering Agentic RAG with Externalized RL-Distilled Graph Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10477)
*Yi Ge,Heng Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PatternBloom 将 RAG 的检索单元从"内容"转为"逻辑"：用信息密度奖励(基于冻结 oracle 信息增益)引导第一轮 RL，把高奖励轨迹蒸馏为类型抽象推理骨架的图模式记忆(GPM)，再以模式增强奖励(PAR)做第二轮 RL 把策略与记忆耦合；7B 模型在 OOD 上超 27 个基线 +15.0 EM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RL 训练的分块/知识图谱片段/超边检索式 agentic RAG，其"推理路径"始终停留在语言模型隐状态中，把陈述性知识(读什么)与可跨同逻辑类型问题复用的过程性知识(怎么推理)混为一谈；随着推理深度增加，仅检索内容的方法性能趋于饱和。

Method: 提出 PatternBloom 框架。第一步 RL：用冻结 oracle 的信息增益构造 Information-Density Reward (IDR)——一个按规模归一化的互信息代理指标，为 agent 构建的证据图打分；将高奖励轨迹蒸馏为 Graph Pattern Memory (GPM)，存储类型抽象化的推理骨架；第二步 RL：用 Pattern-Augmented Reward (PAR) 将策略与记忆耦合，使过程性推理成为可学习、外部化的结构先验。

Result: 7B 规模的 PatternBloom 在 Avg-OOD EM 上超过 27 个基线 +15.0；且增益随推理深度增加而累积放大，原因是过程性知识在蒸馏后被复用，而非每次查询重新推导。

Conclusion: 检索单元由"内容"转向"逻辑"（如何推理）是提升深度推理下 RAG 性能的有效范式；通过 IDR 发现、GPM 沉淀、PAR 对齐的两阶段 RL，可把隐式推理路径外化为可复用的结构先验；代码已开源。

Abstract: Reinforcement-learning-trained agents for retrieval-augmented generation retrieve content (passages, knowledge-graph fragments, or hyperedges) and supervise training with outcome rewards on the final answer. Across these paradigms the reasoning route through retrieved content never leaves the language model's hidden state, conflating declarative knowledge with the procedural knowledge that recurs across queries of the same logical type; content-only methods consequently plateau as reasoning depth grows. We introduce PatternBloom, an agentic RAG framework that shifts the unit of retrieval from content (what to read) to logic (how to reason). A first RL stage scores the agent's constructed evidence graph by a frozen oracle's information gain through the Information-Density Reward (IDR), a size-normalized mutual-information surrogate. High-reward trajectories are distilled into a Graph Pattern Memory (GPM) of type-abstracted reasoning skeletons, and a second RL stage uses the Pattern-Augmented Reward (PAR) to couple policy to memory, turning procedural reasoning into a learnable, externalized structural prior. A 7B PatternBloom outperforms $27$ baselines by $+15.0$ Avg-OOD EM, with the gain compounding with reasoning depth precisely because procedural knowledge, once distilled, is reused rather than re-derived at every query. We release our code at https://github.com/EllenYiGe/PatternBloom.

</details>


### [627] [Sampling Is Not Curiosity: Why LLM Agents Should Investigate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10501)
*Alfonso Amayuelas,Piotr Piękos,Xin Eric Wang,William Yang Wang,Jürgen Schmidhuber,Alex Pentland*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场/观点型论文：作者指出现有 LLM agent 并非"好奇地探索"，而只是"随机地探索"，并据此提出一个定义 LLM agent 好奇心的框架及后续研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 越来越多用于开放式研究类任务，需要主动探索与调查；但推理阶段的 LLM 只是"上下文→下一 token 分布"的固定映射，权重不变，仅条件在累积。温度采样、best-of-N、树搜索、RAG 等只改变采样方式或条件内容，并不会更新 agent 对环境（世界模型）的认知。因此常被称作"好奇心"的行为，实质只是随机性带来的多样性，概念被误用，需要澄清。

Method: 概念分析与框架构建（无实验）。作者借鉴强化学习中对好奇心的理解，抽取四个必要条件：(1) 具备关于"环境如何响应自身动作"的预测结构；(2) 该结构能基于当前交互在线改进；(3) 通过其预测的改进量驱动动作选择（即内在奖励式探索）；(4) 能跨越上下文窗口持久存在。针对开放式情形再追加一条：(5) agent 应能内在地自主提出"要研究什么"。由此把这些条件作为判定"好奇心"的准入标准，并据此划分研究方向。

Result: 给出一个可判定的好奇心定义框架，用以区分"真好奇"与"随机探索"；按该框架，现有 LLM agent 及温度采样、best-of-N、树搜索、RAG 等机制均不满足条件，故被排除在"好奇心"之外；同时由各条件缺口推导出实现路径（如可在推理时更新的预测结构、跨窗口的持久记忆、把预测增益作为动作选择信号、自主生成探究目标等）所对应的研究议题。

Conclusion: "好奇心"一词应被严格保留给同时具备可在线改进的环境预测结构、由其驱动动作选择、并能跨上下文持久存在、且自主发起探究目标的系统；当前 LLM agent 属于随机探索而非好奇探索。该框架的价值在于把模糊的拟人化描述转成可检验的工程要求，并为 LLM agent 的探索能力研究提供议程。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended tasks, very common in research scenarios where they are required to explore, investigate, or act curiously. At inference time, an LLM is a fixed map from context to next-token distribution, the pretrained weights determine the function, and only its conditioning changes as context accumulates. Mechanisms like temperature, best-of-N, tree search, or RAG vary how the distribution is sampled or what it is conditioned on, but do not update the agent's model of the environment. We argue that current LLM agents do not explore curiously; they explore stochastically. From how curiosity is understood in the RL literature, it requires a predictive structure over how the environment responds to the agent's actions, which improves online from current interaction, drives action selection through its predicted improvement, and persists beyond the context window. Additionally, in its open-ended form, the agent should intrinsically originate what to investigate. Thus, we propose a framework defining curiosity in LLM agents, reserving the term for systems that satisfy it. In doing so, we identify the research directions its implementation opens up.

</details>


### [628] [TimeHF 2.0: Multimodal, Multivariate, and Multi-Region Collaborative Forecasting for Large-Scale Retail Supply Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10521)
*Zhongxuan Han,Zhengxin Shi,Kunxiu Chen,Xiaolin Huang,Yulin Huang,Anni Zhang,Xiaoming Lin,Zhengyu Chen,Xue Yu,Yang Liu,Yuanyuan Yang,Yangyang Zhang,Junheng Huang,Dongyang Geng,Ben Zhang,Xin Wang,Jiaxin Wang,Haowei Zhou,Qiqi Yan,Jiaheng Yin,Jintao Xu,Zijiang Liu,Changfei Zhan,Zhe Chen,Yutong Pan,Jinqiu Deng,Shaomin Li,Ningxuan Kang,Jianshen Zhang,Yongzhi Qi,Wei Qi,Dazhou Lei,Zuo-Jun Max Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TimeHF 2.0：JD 提出的多模态、多变量、多区域协同销量预测框架，将自然语言业务知识融入数值预测，线上相对精度提升约 18%-19%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模零售供应链需针对指定商品、未来日期/计划窗口与区域做销量预测。区域稀疏性、环境变化、销量波动和不熟悉的业务场景使多维度联合建模困难；同时业务经验、未来计划等信息难以直接转为数值特征。

Method: 构建多模态、多变量、多区域协同预测框架TimeHF 2.0：1）覆盖感知的有向编码器融合区域销量与相关协变量；2）语义对齐模块将自然语言计划与领域经验的语言模型隐表示迁移为目标特定预测上下文；3）基于销量观测的训练将语义与数值证据关联；4）文本条件未来查询与共享/路由专家实现上下文自适应预测；5）有序分布头对常规波动细粒度、极端波动粗粒度建模，并以日/窗口联合学习连接累计计划量。

Result: JD 线上并行预测中，全国日销量与计划窗口销量相对精度分别提升18.25%与17.94%；DC日销量与计划窗口销量分别提升19.44%与18.99%。组件对比、损失设计与品类分析验证了区域信息、协变量、业务知识、上下文相关处理及规划导向学习的作用。

Conclusion: 将灵活表达的业务知识以文本形式注入数值预测，并与多区域、多任务学习结合，可在真实生产中显著提升销量预测精度。

Abstract: Large-scale retail supply chains need sales forecasts for specified products, future dates or planning windows, and regions under the conditions available at the forecast origin. Regional sparsity, changing environments, volatile sales, and unfamiliar business situations make these dimensions difficult to model together. We introduce TimeHF 2.0, a multimodal, multivariate, and multi-region collaborative forecasting framework that makes flexibly expressed business knowledge usable in numerical prediction. A coverage-aware directed encoder integrates regional sales and applicable covariates. A semantic alignment module transfers language-model hidden representations of natural-language plans and domain experience into target-specific forecasting context. Learning against sales observations connects these meanings to numerical evidence, allowing business users to supply experience, future plans, and changing circumstances without defining a new numerical feature for each description. Text-conditioned future queries and shared/routed experts adapt prediction to the supplied context. An ordered-distribution head allocates fine resolution to routine fluctuations and coarse resolution to extreme sales movements, while daily/window learning connects forecasts to cumulative planning quantities. Online parallel forecasting at JD yields relative accuracy improvements of 18.25% and 17.94% for national daily and planning-window sales, and 19.44% and 18.99% for DC daily and planning-window sales, over the original production deep learning baseline. Component comparisons, loss-design results, and product-type analyses examine the roles of regional information, covariates, business knowledge, context-dependent processing, and robust planning-oriented learning.

</details>


### [629] [In Search of Lost Time: Temporal Competence in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10536)
*Ryan Liu,David Lee,Icey Siyi Ai,Marwa Abdulhai,Rachit Dubey,Thomas L. Griffiths*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文探究LLM能否真正"理解"时间：模型懂时间规则，却无法预测时长、且常在行动中忽视时间成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM正越来越多地参与与时间相关的任务（排程、人机协作、决定"思考"多久），但它们只能"间接地"接触时间——通过文字描述而非亲身体验。作者由此提问：这种二手经验是否损害了LLM在涉及时间上的推理与决策？

Method: 从"知识"到"行动"设计四个递进式评测：(1) 依据时间相关文献定理构建的问题集，检验时间规则知识；(2) 让模型预测自身任务完成时长；(3) 判断哪些任务更耗时，并比较人类任务时长的估计；(4) 检验措辞变化对时长判断的影响及人类偏差的放大效应；(5) 在真实查询中引入等待时间成本，观察其行动是否考虑时间代价。

Result: 时间规则类问题准确率达92.0–97.5%；但模型对自身完成时间低估最高达99.5%，且无法辨别哪些任务对自己更耗时；对人类任务时长估计较好，但判断随事件表述方式变化，可将类似人类偏差放大至1.3倍；在行动层面，部分模型完全无视时间成本，即使等待时间增加1,200倍仍不改变回答。

Conclusion: LLM对"可读的"时间规则掌握良好，但对"需亲身经历"的时长感知严重缺失，且该盲区会传导至决策与行动，说明一些人类习以为常的基础认知能力恰是模型的薄弱点。

Abstract: Today's large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with time: AI agents schedule tasks, coordinate with people and other AI systems, and even decide how long to think. Yet LLMs only ever encounter time secondhand---in descriptions rather than experience. Does this hinder their reasoning and decisions that involve time? Our paper traces this question from a model's knowledge to its actions through four successive evaluations. We find that models know the rules of time, which can be read, but struggle to predict durations, which must be lived; while they are highly accurate (92.0-97.5\%) on a collection of questions built from the theorems of various time-related literatures, they underestimate their own completion times by up to 99.5\% and fail to identify which tasks will take them longer to run. And while they are better at estimating durations of human tasks, their duration judgments change based on how an event is worded, magnifying similar human biases by up to 1.3$\times$. Moving from estimation to action, we find that some LLMs disregard time costs completely when answering user queries, ignoring a 1,200-fold increase in wait time entirely. Together, our experiments reveal new challenges posed to LLMs as they navigate a dimension they cannot directly perceive, and highlight how their blind spots can even be simple cognitive abilities that humans take for granted.

</details>


### [630] [Seeing Isn't Enough: Unlocking Visual Reasoning by Bridging the Reasoning-Access Gap with TIGER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10552)
*Gregory Kang Ruey Lau,Minh Huynh Nguyen,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文揭示多模态大模型存在"模态推理接入鸿沟"：模型能读取图像文字内容，却无法将视觉感知内容送入已有的文本推理机制；据此提出TIGER方法，通过挖掘合成模态反事实样本并用GRPO等强化学习方式微调，显著提升多类真实视觉基准表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs继承了语言骨干的强文本推理能力，但难以将同等能力迁移到视觉输入。作者通过对比语义等价的文本输入与渲染文字图像输入，证明这种性能退化并非单纯的感知失败，而是模型无法把已感知的视觉内容"路由"进已有的文本推理机制，即模态间的推理接入鸿沟。

Method: 提出TIGER（Text-to-Image Gap-targeted training for Enhanced Reasoning）：首先挖掘合成模态反事实样本——模型在文本问题上成功、但在对应渲染图像上失败；随后仅以图像输入为训练对象，采用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）进行后训练，并提供SFT与DPO变体。

Result: 尽管仅在无多模态标注的合成渲染文字图像上训练，TIGER在多个真实视觉基准上带来提升，涵盖几何图（MathVerse）、多学科科学题（EMMA、MMMU）、复杂图表（ChartQAPro）与具身空间推理（RoboSpatial-Home）；且可与现有SOTA的RLVR视觉推理方法互补，取得进一步增益。

Conclusion: 推理子空间激活与激活修补分析表明，TIGER有助于将视觉到推理的通路对齐至文本推理状态。说明"模态推理接入鸿沟"是可针对性训练修复的关键瓶颈，为提升MLLMs视觉推理提供了有效且可迁移的方案。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) inherit strong textual reasoning capabilities from their language backbones and text pretraining, but often fail to apply the same level of competency to visual inputs. We show that this degradation cannot be attributed to only perception failures, by evaluating models on semantically-equivalent text and rendered-text image inputs: models can accurately read text in the images and recover near-text performance when provided their own transcriptions, but just cannot reason well on the images directly. We characterize this discrepancy as a modality reasoning-access gap, where models fail to route perceived visual content into existing reasoning machinery accessible with text. To bridge this, we propose TIGER (Text-to-Image Gap-targeted training for Enhanced Reasoning), which first mines synthetic modality counterfactuals where a model succeeds on a text problem but fails when provided the corresponding rendered image, and post-trains the model on the image input via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), along with SFT and DPO variants. Importantly, although trained exclusively on synthetic rendered-text images with no multimodal annotations, TIGER results in model performance improvements across diverse real-world visual benchmarks including geometric diagrams (MathVerse), multi-disciplinary sciences (EMMA, MMMU), complex charts (ChartQAPro), and embodied spatial reasoning (RoboSpatial-Home). TIGER also complements existing state-of-the-art RLVR visual reasoning methods, yielding further performance gains. Analysis involving reasoning-subspace activation and activation patching provide support indicating that TIGER helps to align visual-to-reasoning pathways toward text reasoning states. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/minhngh/Tiger.

</details>


### [631] [Receiver-Resolution APS-PDP Maps for Wireless Channels: Benchmarking and Coarse-to-Fine Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10581)
*Peilin Zheng,Haozhe Jia,Xiucheng Wang,Wenshuo Chen,Nan Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 UrbanADPSMap 基准，将射线追踪监督转换为固定网格的 APS/PDP 目标，并设计多尺度自回归流匹配模型 SpecFlowAR，在统一 NFE=80 下将 BPL@5 降至 2.03 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有射线追踪基准多以变长多径分量列表提供监督，而实际接收机的角度与时延分辨率受阵列孔径和系统带宽限制，导致学习目标不明确、评估结果会随重建约定变化。

Method: 构建 UrbanADPSMap 基准，通过显式建模带宽受限与孔径受限的响应核，把射线追踪监督转换为固定网格的 APS 和 PDP 目标，并固定接收机域核、离散化方式与有效性掩码；在此基础上提出 SpecFlowAR，一种基于多尺度自回归流匹配的由粗到细生成器，先捕捉粗略色散结构，再细化波束相关峰值与低功率尾部，并用函数评估次数控制采样预算。

Result: 在测试集上，SpecFlowAR 在统一 NFE=80 预算下将 BPL@5 降至 2.03 dB，同时提升波束效用并降低 3GPP 色散统计误差。

Conclusion: UrbanADPSMap 通过固定接收机域核、离散化和有效性掩码，消除了重建引起的目标歧义，稳定了跨方法评估；SpecFlowAR 则在可控采样预算下实现了高质量 APS/PDP 生成。

Abstract: Angle Power Spectrum (APS) and Power Delay Profile (PDP) are receiver-facing spectra that govern beam selection and wideband equalization. Most ray-tracing benchmarks provide supervision as variable-size multipath component lists. This format does not match practical receivers, whose angular and delay resolutions are limited by array aperture and system bandwidth. As a result, learning targets are ambiguous and evaluations can change with reconstruction conventions. We introduce UrbanADPSMap, a benchmark that converts ray-traced supervision into fixed-grid APS and PDP targets by explicitly modeling bandwidth-limited and aperture-limited response kernels. By fixing the receiver-domain kernels, discretization, and validity mask, UrbanADPSMap removes reconstruction-induced target ambiguity and stabilizes downstream evaluation across methods. Built on this benchmark, we propose SpecFlowAR, a coarse-to-fine generator based on multi-scale autoregressive flow matching. The model first captures coarse dispersion structure and then refines beam-relevant peaks and low-power tails. The number of function evaluations controls the sampling budget, enabling latency and quality to be adjusted for dense spectrum queries. Experiments on the test set show that SpecFlowAR reduces BPL@5 to 2.03 dB under a unified NFE=80 budget, while improving beam utility and reducing errors of 3GPP dispersion statistics.

</details>


### [632] [InfoOrgBench: Can Agents Turn Scattered Information into Coherent Hierarchies?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10600)
*Justice Ou,Lanming Ma,Zijian Zhang,Yilun Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 InfoOrgBench：150 个任务，让智能体把分散记录整理成层级目录，用完整性检查 + 结构得分评估；测试 45 个「9 模型 × 5 框架」系统，最佳 83.2 分，且所有系统在高层父级关系上错误率显著高于叶子层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准只考察记录是否被正确分组/保留，无法直接衡量「局部归类正确但挂到了错误的上级目录」这类更高层级的结构性错误，而这类错误在真实的信息整理场景中很关键。

Method: 构建 InfoOrgBench：150 个任务，素材来自会议纪要、issue 讨论串与设计提案三类分散记录，要求智能体组织成层级结构。评估包含两部分：完整性检查（确保记录无丢失）与 Structure Score（在每一层级上与源层级结构的一致程度，与文件夹命名和顺序无关）。对 9 个模型与 5 个智能体框架两两组合共 45 个系统进行评测，并在三个领域内按层级分析错误率。

Result: 最佳系统得分 83.2/100；但在会议纪要与 issue 讨论串上无系统超过 78 分。模型选择的影响远大于框架选择：模型间均值差约 27 分，而各框架的平均效应不足 1 分。三个领域中父级层级关系的错误率均高于叶子层级；在设计提案任务上，按层级分析的输出中近一半恰好犯此类上级归属错误。

Conclusion: 评估信息组织能力必须将「记录保留」「局部归类」与「高层级关系」分开度量；仅靠完整性检查无法暴露高层结构错误，而现有系统恰恰在此薄弱。

Abstract: When agents organize records into folders, they may correctly group the excerpts of a design proposal yet place the proposal under the wrong owning group. Existing agent benchmarks do not directly measure such higher-level errors. We introduce InfoOrgBench, a benchmark of 150 tasks in which agents organize scattered records from meeting recaps, issue threads and design proposals into hierarchies. Integrity checks verify that every record is preserved, and a Structure Score measures agreement with the source hierarchy at every level, independent of folder names and order. We evaluate 45 systems that pair nine models with five agent harnesses. The best system scores 83.2 out of 100, but no system exceeds 78 on meeting recaps or issue threads. Model choice affects scores far more than harness choice: model means span about 27 points, whereas the average effect of each harness is below one point. More importantly, parent-level relations have higher error rates than leaf-level relations in all three domains. In design proposals, nearly half of the outputs analyzed by level make exactly this kind of error. These results show that evaluating information organization requires measuring higher-level relations separately from record preservation and local grouping.

</details>


### [633] [DFT-Agent Bench: Scaffold Effects and Execution Provenance in Autonomous DFT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10629)
*Shijie Liu,Jin Yang,Weilin Wan,Jingtao Han,Jia LI,Tianqi Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文发布 DFT-Agent Bench：200+ 个 Quantum ESPRESSO 任务（结构弛豫、电子结构、状态方程、弹性张量）的基准，每项带 QE 真值与公开参考交叉校验，并设有"溯源审计"以检查是否满足 QE 执行契约；在统一执行框架下对比近裸 ReAct 基线与 v5.1 脚手架在两种模型上的表现，结果显示脚手架在部分任务上稳定增益，弹性任务增益依模型而异，且溯源门控能识别"评分高但执行不完整"的案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型正被越来越多地当作自主智能体用于第一性原理材料模拟，但该场景缺少同时具备可靠真值、可复现执行框架与"执行过程合规性"检查的系统性评测，现有报道难以区分"分数高"与"真正跑通了 DFT 流程"。

Method: 构建 DFT-Agent Bench：覆盖 relaxation、electronic structure、equation-of-state、elastic-tensor 四类流水线、跨多个材料层级的 200+ 个 QE 任务；每个任务配有 QE 导出的标准答案，并在可得时与公开参考交叉核对；另设 provenance audit 检验所需 QE 执行契约是否被满足。在单一执行 harness 下，用两个模型对比"近裸 ReAct 基线"与"打包 v5.1 脚手架"，并补充一个禁用检索的固定 100 任务切片分析。

Result: 完整脚手架在两个模型上使 bands+DOS 提升 +0.08/+0.11、d 电子 vc-relax 提升 +0.17；而原本高分的 relaxation 与状态方程单元提升空间很小。弹性结果依赖模型：deepseek-v4-pro 为 0.18→0.40，claude-opus-4-8 为 0.62→0.59。禁用检索的固定 100 任务分析支持总体趋势：完全冻结的 DeepSeek 对比提升 +0.17，Opus 对比相对历史池基线提升 +0.10（p < 0.001）。溯源门控能捕获"执行不完整或未标注"却仍可拿到高评分的情形。

Conclusion: 大模型智能体做 DFT 已具备可测量的工程收益，但收益高度任务与模型相关，且在简单任务上已接近饱和；仅看评分不足以判断流程是否真正被执行，需引入执行契约层面的审计（其定位是执行合规检查，而非判定主观造假）。结论限定于所评测的 DFT 工作流；匿名评审材料给出冻结诊断切片、提示词、评分器与求解器版本。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for first-principles materials simulation. We report empirical findings from DFT-Agent Bench, a benchmark of 200+ Quantum ESPRESSO tasks spanning relaxation, electronic structure, equation-of-state, and elastic-tensor pipelines over multiple material tiers. Each task carries a QE-derived ground truth with public-reference cross-checks where available, and a provenance audit checks whether the required QE execution contract was met. Under one execution harness, we compare a near-bare ReAct baseline with a bundled v5.1 scaffold on two models. The complete scaffold improves bands+DOS by +0.08/+0.11 and d-electron vc-relax by +0.17 on both models, while high-scoring relaxation and equation-of-state cells leave little room for improvement. The elastic result is model-dependent (0.18 to 0.40 for deepseek-v4-pro and 0.62 to 0.59 for claude-opus-4-8). A fixed 100-task analysis with retrieval disabled supports the aggregate pattern: the fully frozen DeepSeek comparison gains +0.17, while the Opus comparison gains +0.10 against a historical pool baseline (p < 0.001). The provenance gate catches incomplete or unmarked executions that can receive high rubric scores; it is an execution-contract check, not a test for intentional fraud. These results characterize the evaluated DFT workflows. The anonymous review artifact contains the frozen diagnostic slice, prompts, scorer, and solver revisions: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/231e31re91287h/README.md.

</details>


### [634] [SLA-Aware Task Offloading in the IoT Edge-Cloud Continuum: Class-Weighted Deep Reinforcement Learning Against an Exact Optimum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10638)
*Shilpa Golla,Tharun Kumar Korine Palli,Urmila Bandaru*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文用可精确求解的小规模IoT边缘-云卸载系统作基准，严格对比深度强化学习智能体与动态规划最优策略，揭示奖励设计（类盲惩罚、按类惩罚、PPO-Lagrangian）对性能差距的决定性影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将深度强化学习用于边缘-云连续体中IoT任务卸载的研究，往往对所有未满足时延要求的任务施加相同惩罚，且很少把智能体性能与最优策略做对比，因此既难以判断奖励设计是否合理，也无法知道学习器离最优有多远。

Method: 构建四个规模足够小、可用动态规划精确求解的卸载系统作为基准，衡量奖励设计与学习器相对最优解的差距；同时指出"满足时延即给奖励"的机制会使每次失败的实际代价等于惩罚额加奖励额，从而改变已发表按类奖励中的类别权重，并据此提出修正的按类惩罚；将类盲惩罚、修正按类惩罚、调优PPO（按类奖励）、带可达目标的PPO-Lagrangian与调优预留规则在多随机种子下进行对比，并测试延长训练时间的影响。

Result: 即使学习器完美，类盲惩罚的代价仍比最优高65%–118%；修正的按类惩罚可把差距压缩到最优的0.13%以内。在按类奖励下，调优PPO在最小系统中距最优9%–11%，修正版本在10个随机种子中有9个胜过调优预留规则。在较大系统中，智能体仍高出最优化41%–76%，且调优规则优于其平均表现；训练时间延长十倍无法缩小该差距，带可达目标的PPO-Lagrangian也不比按类奖励更好。

Conclusion: 奖励的类别权重设计是决定卸载策略能否逼近最优的关键，单纯换用更强的学习器或更长的训练并不能弥补；深度RL方法在大规模系统中相对最优解仍有显著差距，亟需可扩展性更强的算法与更严谨的最优性基准评估。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is often used to decide where Internet of Things (IoT) tasks with different latency limits run in the edge-cloud continuum, yet some methods give every missed task the same penalty and few compare their agents with an optimal policy. This benchmark study builds four offloading systems small enough to solve exactly by dynamic programming and measures reward and learner against the optimum. A bonus for a met limit makes each miss cost its penalty plus the bonus, which shifts the class weights of published per-class rewards. A class-blind penalty stays 65% to 118% above the optimal cost even with a perfect learner, while a corrected per-class penalty comes within 0.13% of the optimum. With a per-class reward, tuned proximal policy optimization (PPO) agents come within 9% to 11% of the optimum in the smallest system, and the corrected one beats a tuned reservation rule in 9 of 10 seeds. In larger systems the agents stay 41% to 76% above the optimum, and a tuned rule beats their mean. Training ten times longer does not close this gap, and a PPO-Lagrangian agent with reachable targets does no better than the per-class reward.

</details>


### [635] [MMGraph-Agent: Agentic Multimodal RAG via Cache-Inspired Multimodal Knowledge HyperGraphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10657)
*Haoran Luo,Ziyue Zhu,Shangyang Wu,Linhao Luo,Yikai Guo,Qika Lin,Fangzhi Xu,Jiapu Wang,Xiaobao Wu,Yifan Zhu,Luu Anh Tuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MMGraph-Agent——基于缓存式多模态知识超图的统一多模态 RAG 框架，以零 API 成本实现轻量超图构建与动态记忆检索，在离线、在线及联合检索场景中同时提升效果、效率与架构统一性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG 正从纯文本流水线演化为多模态场景，涉及"知识组织"与"检索增强"两个互补维度；但现有方法存在三大痛点：构建成本高、上下文窗口受限、离线与在线知识源缺乏统一训练。

Method: 核心是以"缓存"为灵感的多模态知识超图：用超图组织多模态知识，实现极轻量构建（无需调用商业 API，零成本）；并设计基于动态记忆的检索机制，以记忆缓存替代对超长上下文的依赖，从而缓解长上下文问题；离线与在线知识源在同一框架内统一处理。

Result: 在离线检索、在线检索以及二者联合检索三种设置下进行实验，结果在性能、效率和架构统一性上均取得一致提升。代码与数据已开源（https://github.com/LHRLAB/MMGraph-Agent）。

Conclusion: 该工作把多模态 RAG 的知识组织与检索增强统一到超图+动态记忆的单框架中，兼顾低成本、低上下文负担与跨知识源一致性，为多模态 RAG 提供了可复用的架构范式。

Abstract: Driven by increasingly complex real-world applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has evolved from textual pipelines to multimodal settings, comprising two complementary dimensions: knowledge organization and retrieval enhancement. However, existing methods still face challenges of high construction cost, context window limitations, and the lack of unified training across offline and online knowledge sources. To address these challenges, we propose MMGraph-Agent, a unified multimodal RAG framework based on cache-inspired multimodal knowledge hypergraphs. MMGraph-Agent enables extremely lightweight hypergraph construction with zero API cost and dynamic memory-based retrieval that alleviates long-context issues. Experiments across offline, online, and joint retrieval settings demonstrate consistent improvements in performance, efficiency, and architectural unification. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/MMGraph-Agent.

</details>


### [636] [The Delta Gap: Cellular World Models for Perturbation Response Prediction Are Far Harder Than Global Correlation Implies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10658)
*Junhui Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文揭示细胞扰动响应模型普遍使用的全局Pearson相关系数被大量非响应基因主导、严重虚高评测结果，提出以"delta空间"评测作为主基准，并给出后处理纠正与端到端训练改进方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细胞世界模型用于预测细胞对遗传扰动的响应，但现有评测几乎只用预测与观测转录组之间的全局Pearson相关。作者发现该指标被数千个非响应基因主导，会严重夸大模型表观性能，导致对模型能力的误判，因此需要重新审视评测方式并定位真实差距。

Method: 在Replogle K562数据(509个未见扰动、5000个基因)上对比GEARS与简单baseline；提出delta空间评测(delta Pearson)作为主基准；给出两种后处理纠正：基于共表达图的RWR与kNN匹配；分析残差差距来源(扰动表示几何 vs 解码器容量)，并用oracle上界作为诊断框架；进一步提出delta对齐训练(lambda=3.0)与幅度校准变体(eta=0.3)，并做跨细胞系零样本迁移验证。

Result: GEARS全局Pearson达0.977，但delta Pearson仅0.076；预测均值训练delta的平凡baseline为0.267，是GEARS的3.5倍。残余差距中约2.8倍落在扰动表示几何而非解码器容量。delta对齐训练将delta Pearson提升至0.179(2.35倍于GEARS)，在方向准确率(0.680 vs 0.567)与基因恢复(1.52 vs 1.19)上超过平凡baseline，结合kNN达0.217；幅度校准变体(eta=0.3)使基因恢复达2.16、delta Pearson 0.218。零样本迁移(Replogle K562→Norman A549，741个共享基因)达0.328，为平凡baseline的4.7倍、标准GEARS的2.1倍。

Conclusion: 首次系统量化了"delta gap"这一评测假象，并提出以delta空间为核心的诊断框架，通过oracle上界将残余差距定位到扰动表示几何，证明该差距可通过端到端训练与后处理有效缓解且具备跨细胞系零样本泛化能力，呼吁以delta空间评测作为细胞世界模型的主要基准。

Abstract: Cellular world models aim to predict how cells respond to genetic perturbations, analogous to world models in reinforcement learning. Perturbation response models are evaluated almost exclusively by global Pearson correlation between predicted and observed transcriptomes. We show this metric is dominated by thousands of non-responsive genes and severely inflates apparent performance. On the Replogle K562 screen (509 unseen perturbations, 5000 genes), GEARS achieves global Pearson 0.977, but its delta Pearson is only 0.076. A trivial baseline predicting mean training delta achieves 0.267, which is 3.5x better than GEARS. Our primary contribution is methodological: we identify and quantify this delta gap as a systematic evaluation artifact, and propose delta-space evaluation as the primary benchmark. We provide two post-hoc corrections (RWR on co-expression graphs and kNN matching) and show that 2.8x of the remaining gap lies in perturbation representation geometry, not decoder capacity. We further show the gap is partially addressable end-to-end: delta-aligned training (lambda = 3.0) raises delta Pearson to 0.179 on Replogle (2.35x over GEARS) and surpasses the trivial baseline on direction accuracy (0.680 vs 0.567) and gene recovery (1.52 vs 1.19); combined with kNN it reaches 0.217. An amplitude-calibration variant (eta = 0.3) further raises gene recovery to 2.16 while reaching 0.218. Critically, these representations transfer zero-shot across cell lines: from Replogle K562 to unseen Norman A549, the delta-aligned model reaches 0.328 on 741 shared genes, 4.7x a trivial baseline and 2.1x standard GEARS. This is the first systematic quantification of the delta gap, and the first diagnostic framework localizing the residual gap to perturbation representation geometry via an oracle upper bound.

</details>


### [637] [RankShift: Evaluating Ranking Instability Across Benchmark Dimensions in Document Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10679)
*Halimat Afolabi,Daeyoung Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究文档解析基准测试的排名稳定性，提出RankShift系统性框架，发现匹配策略与标注格式的交互是排名不稳的主要来源，呼吁排行榜披露排名稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档解析基准（如OmniDocBench）常被视为衡量模型质量的稳定标尺，但排名可能高度依赖基准设计的细节选择，而这一稳定性问题此前缺乏系统研究。

Method: 以OmniDocBench为案例，对16个模型在3种数据配置、6种匹配策略、3种评分指标下进行受控对比（OCR与VLM），用成对秩相关、top-k波动率、成对反转率量化排名稳定性。

Result: 匹配策略与真值格式的交互是最大不稳源：区域级匹配下按JSON标注与按Markdown渲染打分，平均Kendall τ≈0.33（个别低至0.23），而整页拼接打分时τ=0.77；数据构成的页面类型分层（τ=0.48）与版式分层（τ=0.49）亦不稳定，跨数据集Shift较稳（τ=0.80）；指标选择最稳定（NED/BLEU/METEOR平均τ≈0.78）。

Conclusion: 排行榜位次并非纯粹由模型能力决定；应构建不仅报告主榜分数、还报告排名在合理设计选择下稳健性的排行榜。

Abstract: Document parsing benchmarks are often treated as stable measures of model quality, yet rankings may depend substantially on benchmark design choices. In this work, we present RankShift, a systematic study comparing OCR and vision-language models (VLMs) under controlled variation in dataset composition, matching strategy, and scoring methodology. Using OmniDocBench as a case study, we evaluate the ranking stability of 16 models across 3 dataset configurations, 6 matching strategies, and 3 scoring metrics. We quantify rank stability using pairwise rank correlation, top-k churn, and pairwise reversal rate. Our results show that the interaction between matching strategy and ground truth format is a substantial but understudied driver of instability: scoring against OmniDocBench's JSON annotations versus its Markdown rendering yields a mean Kendall's tau of approximately 0.33 under region-level matching strategies, with individual pairs as low as tau = 0.23, compared with tau = 0.77 when each page is scored as a single concatenated string. Dataset composition produces comparable instability across page-type strata (mean tau = 0.48) and layout-type strata (mean tau = 0.49), while the cross-dataset shift from OmniDocBench to Real5's Scanning reconstruction of the same pages is more stable (tau = 0.80). Metric choice is the most stable dimension, with mean tau of approximately 0.78 across NED, BLEU, and METEOR. These findings indicate that leaderboard position is not solely a property of model capability, motivating leaderboards that report not only headline scores but also the robustness of rankings across reasonable design choices.

</details>


### [638] [Audit Before You Merge: Provenance, Probing, and Continual LoRA Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10684)
*Lenny Aharon,Neta Glazer,Lior Aharon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出在公开LoRA适配器事后合并场景下，需先进行来源审计与无泄漏探测，再评估灾难性遗忘；审计后发现在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上朴素合并显著损害GSM8K与HumanEval，而适度Task Arithmetic可接近基线，且负系数搜索揭示遗忘具有可利用的结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公开LoRA适配器合并被视为无需梯度的持续适配路径，但此前工作未解决该场景下测量灾难性遗忘所需的基础设施问题：适配器来源不可靠、基座版本不匹配、近零增量模块会虚增干扰，导致遗忘评估失真。

Method: 将持续合并的每个适配器视为顺序任务，以指令微调基座模型能力为Task 0；提出两项预审计（基座模型匹配、非平凡delta范数）和无泄漏探测协议；在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上对审计后的4个适配器比较朴素合并与Task Arithmetic，并进行含负系数的坐标搜索；在Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3上复现协议。

Result: 未审计适配器会使测得的干扰膨胀约10个百分点；审计后4适配器集合上，朴素合并使GSM8K下降10.5pp、HumanEval下降18.3pp，而lambda=0.5的Task Arithmetic处于未合并基线的标准误范围内；坐标搜索发现数学适配器在lambda=-0.5时探测最优，超出仅正系数合并器的范围；Mistral上4个候选适配器有2个未通过审计，审计后合并在GSM8K上复现相同方法排序。

Conclusion: 在公开LoRA适配器持续合并研究中，来源审计和无泄漏探测应作为遗忘评估的前置条件；经过审计后，合并方法排序更可靠，遗忘具有可利用的结构，负系数感知的合并可能带来收益，且结论并非Llama特有。

Abstract: Post-hoc merging of public LoRA adapters is an attractive gradient-free path to continual adaptation, but reliable measurement of catastrophic forgetting in this setting depends on infrastructure that prior work has not addressed. We treat each adapter merge as a sequential task in a continual-learning setting, with the instruction-tuned base model's capabilities as Task 0, and study forgetting on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Public adapter hubs contain modules that fail basic provenance checks: silent base-version mismatches and near-zero delta norms whose inclusion inflates measured interference by ~10pp. We propose a two-check audit (base-model match, non-trivial delta norm) and a leakage-free probing protocol as preconditions for any forgetting study in this setting. On an audited 4-adapter set, naive merging causes -10.5pp on GSM8K and -18.3pp on HumanEval, while Task Arithmetic at lambda=0.5 sits within a standard error of the unmerged baseline. A coordinate search including negative coefficients identifies the math adapter as probe-optimal at lambda=-0.5, outside the reach of positive-only mergers, suggesting forgetting has structure that negation-aware merging may exploit. The same protocol replicates on Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, where 2 of 4 candidate adapters fail the audit and the audited merge reproduces the same merge-method ranking on GSM8K, supporting that our findings are not Llama-specific.

</details>


### [639] [RetinaGuard: Risk-Controlled Agentic Triage for Multi-Disease Retinal Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10689)
*Sohaib Sulman,Muhammad Atif Saeed,Akhtar Jamil,Alaa Ali Hameed,Roland Aydin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RetinaGuard：一种智能体式分诊框架，通过多智能体证据收集与保形风险控制，在匹配转诊预算下甄别不安全决策，其收益取决于主模型自身不确定性对错误的揭示程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视网膜筛查项目需要判断哪些自动化决策可以不经人工复核而接受。现有转诊策略（如基于置信度或校准不确定性的转诊）在安全性保障与覆盖率之间难以兼顾，因此需要一种能提供可认证安全保证、并动态权衡证据收集成本的分诊方法。

Method: 提出RetinaGuard智能体式分诊框架：质量、诊断、不确定性、验证与解释等多智能体为每张眼底照片收集证据；用学到的失败预测器估计决策不安全的概率；仅当辅助工具的期望信息价值超过其成本时才调用；接受阈值由保形风险控制（conformal risk control）认证。在RFMiD测试集上，与置信度转诊、校准不确定性转诊在匹配转诊预算和同等认证安全水平下比较，使用两种强度的RETFound主模型。

Result: 弱模型（macro-AUROC 0.896）下验证者分歧带来显著增量信息：20%预算下捕获280个不安全决策中的119个（最低置信度转诊为88个）；名义5%不安全水平下接受率37.0%（对照10.3%）。强模型（0.925）下验证者未超越不确定性信息，优势缩小至几个百分点。两种设置下名义5%水平覆盖率均约37.7%，门控将计算量削减约30%，质量智能体在多数图像损坏下减少不安全接受。

Conclusion: 智能体式证据收集的收益取决于主模型自身不确定性已能揭示多少错误：当模型较弱时收益明显，当模型较强时收益有限。该框架可在认证安全水平下提升可接受覆盖率并降低计算成本。

Abstract: Retinal screening programmes need to know which automated decisions can be accepted without review. This paper presents RetinaGuard, an agentic triage framework in which quality, diagnostic, uncertainty, verification and explanation agents gather evidence for each fundus photograph, a learned failure predictor estimates the probability that the decision is unsafe, auxiliary tools are invoked only when their expected value of information exceeds their cost, and the acceptance threshold is certified by conformal risk control. On the RFMiD test split, RetinaGuard was compared with confidence and calibrated-uncertainty referral at matched referral budgets and equal certified safety, using two RETFound primary models of different strength. With the weaker model (macro-AUROC 0.896), verifier disagreement added significant information, RetinaGuard captured 119 of 280 unsafe decisions at a 20% budget against 88 for lowest-confidence referral, and at a nominal 5% unsafe level it accepted 37.0% of cases against 10.3%. With the stronger model (0.925) the verifier added nothing beyond uncertainty and the advantage shrank to a few percentage points. In both settings its coverage at the nominal 5% level stayed near 37.7%, gating cut computation by about 30%, and a quality agent reduced unsafe acceptances under most image corruptions. The benefit of agentic evidence gathering thus depends on how much the primary model's own uncertainty already reveals about its errors.

</details>


### [640] [Hallucination-Guided Unlearning: Using Hallucination Traces to Reveal Overfitted Memories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10697)
*Jiayu Zhang,Ziqi Zhong,Yuliang Gai,Canran Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出幻觉引导的机器遗忘方法HGU，用模型自身幻觉作为诊断信号定位并编辑高责任MLP神经元，在TOFU与WMDP上取得更强的遗忘效果和更好的效用保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型安全与合规需要选择性遗忘，但有害或记忆内容常与有用知识纠缠、难以枚举；因此希望无需人工列举目标，利用模型自身失败（幻觉）来发现应被遗忘的候选内容。

Method: HGU以幻觉为诊断信号：借助证据与内部一致性定位缺乏支持的回答片段，追踪少量高责任MLP神经元，并在保持效用的KL约束下用紧凑门控对这些神经元进行编辑。

Result: TOFU上取得最佳MU-FE权衡，Avg为0.7221（forget05）与0.7699（forget10），混合遗忘/保留提示下SepS H-Avg最高（0.4382/0.4715）；WMDP辅助任务上遗忘最强（如Economics 14.2），同时Retain提升至52.7、MMLU达57.2。

Conclusion: 追踪幻觉可实现针对性的后处理式遗忘，在无需全量重训练的前提下更好地平衡遗忘有效性与通用效用。

Abstract: Selective unlearning is increasingly important for the safety and compliance of large language models. Harmful or memorized content is often entangled with useful knowledge and difficult to enumerate. We use the model's own failures to identify candidates for unlearning. We propose Hallucination-Guided Unlearning (HGU), which uses hallucinations as diagnostic signals. HGU localizes unsupported spans via evidence and internal consensus, traces a sparse set of high-responsibility MLP neurons, and edits them with compact gates under a utility-preserving KL constraint. On TOFU, HGU achieves the best MU-FE trade-off, with Avg scores of 0.7221 (forget05) and 0.7699 (forget10), and the highest SepS H-Avg (0.4382/0.4715) under mixed forget/retain prompts. On the WMDP auxiliary task, HGU yields the strongest forgetting (e.g., 14.2 on Economics) while improving Retain (52.7) and MMLU (57.2). These results suggest that tracing hallucinations enables targeted, post-hoc unlearning that better balances forgetting efficacy and general utility without full retraining.

</details>


### [641] [R-BED: A Consequence-Aware Framework for System-Level AI Evaluation and Continuous Assurance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10704)
*Vishal Srivastava*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出 R-BED（基于风险的评估设计）方法学规范，用 6+4+3 共十三维诊断结构、以失败为中介的期望损失恒等式、证据状态与独立性分级、控制保障阶梯与授权处置规则，把技术失败证据、部署控制有效性与现实后果连接到可辩护的授权决策，并配合"配置钉扎+过期+依赖声明"的持续系统评估层，使变更只按比例而非整体作废旧证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 系统评估通常只报告模型属性，而部署决策针对的是"模型+提示+工具+权限+数据+防护+运行情境"的配置化系统。二者错位，导致评估证据难以在整个部署生命周期内支撑可辩护的授权判断：任务成功率这类指标可能掩盖关键的控制弱点。

Method: 提出 R-BED 规范级方法：(1) 固定的 6+4+3 架构，共 13 个诊断维度（技术失败、部署控制、后果与影响）；(2) 以失败为中介的期望损失恒等式，与"有意行为"路径和"滥用"路径分开建模；(3) 带独立性等级的有界证据状态；(4) 控制保障阶梯；(5) 由 8 条规则支配的 5 类授权处置；(6) 持续系统评估（CSE）层，证据携带配置钉扎、有效期与声明的依赖关系。并用确定性脚本生成可复现的合成退款代理案例进行演示。

Result: 在合成退款代理走查中，确定性脚本可复现全部数值；结果显示，仅看任务成功的视角会漏掉一处后果严重的控制弱点，而该方法学将其识别为"证据缺失"，从而改变授权判断。

Conclusion: 贡献是一份可复现的方法学规范：多数组件属于将既有实践整合为单一的"证据—决策"记录，其中证据有效性登记册、权限包络与层级规则属新提议。所有内容均未经验证，作者明确列出 7 条假设供独立检验。

Abstract: Evaluations of AI systems usually report properties of a model, while decisions to deploy concern a configured system: a model together with prompts, tools, permissions, data, safeguards and an operating context. We ask how evidence about technical failures, deployment-control effectiveness and real-world consequences can be connected to defensible authorization decisions throughout the lifecycle of a deployed system. We present R-BED (Risk-Based Evaluability Design), a specification-level methodology with a fixed 6+4+3 architecture of thirteen diagnostic dimensions (technical failure, deployment controls, consequence and impact); a failure-mediated expected-loss identity that is kept separate from intended-behavior and misuse pathways; bounded evidence statuses with independence levels; a control assurance ladder; five authorization dispositions governed by eight rules; and a Continuous System Evaluation (CSE) layer in which evidence carries a configuration pin, an expiry and declared dependencies, so that a change invalidates evidence in proportion rather than wholesale. We work through a synthetic refund-agent walkthrough, with a deterministic script that reproduces every number, to show how a task-success view can miss a consequential control weakness that the procedure identifies as missing evidence. The contribution is a reproducible methodological specification. Most components are standard practice integrated into one evidence-to-decision record; the Evidence Validity Register, the authority envelope and the tier rules are proposals. None has been empirically validated, and we state seven hypotheses for independent testing.

</details>


### [642] [No Second Run: Does RSI Stop at Frontier Pre-training?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10719)
*Xiaojie Cai,Jiayi Chen,Junwei Chen,Yu Chen,Sikai Cheng,Jinquan Dai,Siyuan Feng,Bin Fu,Dayuan Fu,Guosheng Gao,Qipeng Guo,Chenwei He,Zhulin Hu,Yaxing Huang,Shuomeng Jia,Mohan Jiang,Keyang Lei,Hongliang Li,Xuefeng Li,Zhaocheng Li,Jifan Lin,Pengfei Liu,Xinghan Liu,Yixiu Liu,Pengrui Lu,Siyuan Lu,Kai Lv,Tiantian Mi,Yang Nan,Yu Qiao,Yiwei Qin,Xipeng Qiu,Junhao Shi,Runzhou Shi,Jiadi Su,Bohao Tang,Hanning Wang,Keqi Wang,Pan Wang,Ran Wang,Shaojing Wang,Yishuo Wang,Zhixin Wang,Shenyu Wu,Muhang Xie,Tianze Xu,Hang Yan,Lvmanshan Ye,Hongche Yu,Junjie Yu,Lantian Zhang,Ruihang Zhang,Bin Zhao,Chenyang Zhou,Zijin Zhou,Wenhong Zhu,Zemu Zhu,Yumin Zhuang,Haoyang Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次将递归自我改进（RSI）应用于从零开始的完整前沿预训练流程，并通过分解为若干可闭环的小循环来实现，最终产出 801-30B-A3B-Base 模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开的 RSI 工作仅针对后训练（post-training），因其有现成基座、试验成本以 GPU-小时计、且有可验证分数。而预训练成本高几个数量级：单次运行消耗数十万 GPU-小时、耗时数月且不可重复；其目标（后训练提升空间）无法由单一分数读出；需要改进的不是一个模型而是整个生产系统（数据管线、训练基础设施、团队）。作者希望把 RSI 带入预训练这一"创造 AI 的过程"本身。

Method: 由于单次不可重复的运行无法闭合端到端循环，作者将 RSI 分解为多个可闭环的更小循环，每个循环修复完整运行中被打破的某个环节；RSI 在预训练中不停止而是改变形态。基于此，由一个新组建团队从零训练 30B-A3B MoE 模型，使用 11.8T tokens、历时三个月。此外还做了轻量 SFT（6B tokens，无 RL）以探测后训练提升空间。

Result: 作为基座模型，801-30B-A3B 优于 Qwen3-30B-A3B 和 Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B，仅落后于更大的 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，并在相同 SFT 下保持该排名；仅用轻量 SFT，就在四个 agentic 基准上取得对包括 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在内完全后训练模型的最高平均分。

Conclusion: 由于后训练 RSI 以强基座模型为前提，将 RSI 引入预训练作用于后续所有阶段所依赖的基础。作者开源了 801-30B-A3B-Base 及轻量 SFT 数据（https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/801-30B）。

Abstract: Pre-training is where every foundation model begins; bringing recursive self-improvement (RSI) there would let AI improve the process that creates AI. Yet public RSI work has so far targeted only post-training, which starts from an existing base model, runs trials costing GPU-hours, and returns verifiable scores. Pre-training breaks all three conditions at orders-of-magnitude higher cost: a run consumes hundreds of thousands of GPU-hours over months and cannot be repeated; its objective, post-training headroom, cannot be read off any single score; and what must improve is not a model but the whole production system, from data pipelines and training infrastructure to the teams that run them. To our knowledge, we are the first to apply RSI to an entire frontier pre-training run from scratch and to report it in detail. RSI does not stop at frontier pre-training, but it changes form: since no end-to-end loop can close over a single unrepeatable run, we decompose it into smaller loops that can, each repairing a step the full run breaks. The result is 801-30B-A3B-Base, a 30B-A3B MoE trained from scratch on 11.8T tokens in three months by a newly formed team. We release it as a base model; the lightweight SFT reported here (6B tokens, no RL) only probes post-training headroom. As a base model, 801-30B-A3B outperforms Qwen3-30B-A3B and Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B, trailing only the larger Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and keeps this position under identical SFT; with lightweight SFT alone, it achieves the highest average on four agentic benchmarks against fully post-trained models, including Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Since post-training RSI presupposes a strong base model, bringing RSI into pre-training acts on the foundation every later stage builds on. We open-source 801-30B-A3B-Base and the lightweight SFT data at https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/801-30B .

</details>


### [643] [The Lagrangian Brain: A Constraint Mechanics of Mind and Machine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10737)
*Yuhang He,Si Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出"大脑遵循拉格朗日约束力学"假说：电路所知、被告知与所求皆为对单一脑状态的约束，各由一乘子累积违背量并将状态推回；神经元与突触按各自时间常数承载不同乘子。由此导出戴尔法则、兴奋-抑制平衡、皮层悖论反应与脑节律频率，并在无梯度训练下以单条轨迹解出全部 42 万级数独极难题、规划超训练域迷宫最短路径、在 25 倍长串上精确追踪排列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大脑任一时刻只处于一个状态，但决定其下一状态的因素大多不在当前状态之内——世界从不产生的模式、一生的统计规律、尚未到达的目标。作者类比力学：导线对珠子只通过接触时才出现的力起作用，拉格朗日用一个约束对应一个乘子来计算这类力，遂提出大脑服从同一套力学。

Method: 构建约束-乘子框架：把电路所知（永不发生之事）、被告知（经验统计）、所欲（未来目标）都表述为对单一状态的约束，每个约束配一个乘子，乘子累积约束违背量并将状态推回。将乘子分配给具体神经元件并赋予各自时间常数：抑制性中间神经元承载"从不发生"、适应承载"停留于某状态的代价"、突触承载"经验统计"、顶树突反馈承载"未来"。据此推导生理规律，并把信念定义为轨迹在各状态停留的时间、学习定义为睡眠提出法则而觉醒反驳、规划定义为目标波与当下波相遇。

Result: 理论上导出戴尔法则、交互接线与兴奋-抑制平衡、皮层悖论性反应及脑节律频率；指出联结主义与符号主义分别是"冻结乘子"与"瞬时乘子"的极限，电路运行时长即计算深度。实验上，按此原则构建、不经梯度训练（1000 道已解谜题）的机器，用每条一条轨迹解出全部 422,786 道 Sudoku-Extreme 测试题；通过"睡眠-觉醒"重新发现数独规则；在面积为训练 64 倍的迷宫中规划最短路径；在长度为训练 25 倍的字符串上精确追踪排列，而 Transformer 在此失败。

Conclusion: 心智可被视为"学会自身约束的生命"：约束—乘子机制以时间常数为组织原则，统一了神经生理现象、信念、学习与规划，并以极强外推能力区别于梯度训练的联结主义模型。

Abstract: A brain is in one state at a time, yet most of what decides its next state is absent from it: the patterns its world never produces, the statistics of a lifetime, a goal that lies ahead. In mechanics a wire acts on a bead only through a force that appears when the bead presses on it, and Lagrange computed such forces with one multiplier for each constraint. We propose that a brain follows the same mechanics. Everything a circuit knows, is told or wants is a constraint on its single state and acts through its own multiplier, which accumulates the violation and pushes the state back. Neurons and synapses carry the multipliers, each with its own time constant: inhibitory interneurons carry what never happens, adaptation the cost of staying in one state, synapses the statistics of experience, and feedback to apical dendrites the future. From this hypothesis follow Dale's law, the reciprocal wiring and balance of excitation and inhibition, the paradoxical responses of cortex and the frequencies of brain rhythms. Belief becomes the time one trajectory spends in each state, learning becomes sleep proposing laws and waking refuting the false ones, and planning becomes a wave from the goal meeting a wave from the present. Connectionism and symbolism are the limits of frozen and of instantaneous multipliers, and between them the time a circuit runs becomes the depth of its computation. A machine built on these principles, trained without gradients on 1000 solved puzzles, solves all 422,786 Sudoku-Extreme test puzzles with one trajectory each. It rediscovers the rules of Sudoku by sleeping and waking, plans shortest paths in mazes of 64 times the training area, and tracks permutations exactly on strings 25 times longer than in training, where Transformers fail. A mind, on this view, is life that learns its own constraints.

</details>


### [644] [Pulse waveform morphology encodes haemodynamic signatures of impending stroke](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10739)
*Cheng Ding,Jiaming Liu,Jian Wu,Hongxia Xu,Daoqiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 脉搏波形形态学编码了卒中即将发生前的血流动力学特征，可作为连续脑血管生物标志物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卒中本质是循环障碍，但其发生前即刻的血流动力学状态很少被观测到，因为缺乏连续生理记录。光电容积脉搏波（PPG）被每个脉搏血氧仪和数亿可穿戴设备记录，逐搏捕获外周脉搏，但其波形形态大多被丢弃。本文探究脉搏波形形态是否编码了即将发生卒中的血流动力学特征。

Method: 以院内卒中作为自然实验，利用医生判定卒中前的连续PPG数据，研究ICU（MIMIC-III，n=176）与急诊（MC-MED，n=154）两个队列；用脉搏时序、振幅、轮廓与变异性等可解释描述子刻画每一拍脉搏。

Result: 在360分钟时间窗上，形态学将卒中识别前窗口与稳定窗口区分，F1达0.941与0.989（灵敏度0.998与0.980），模型无需修改即可迁移至第二队列，且优于仅用心率。判别特征以收缩期波峰时间及其相对患者自身基线的变化为主，特征归因在队列间一致（Spearman ρ=0.865）；入院前两小时的形态学可分层后续临床病程（F1 0.714与0.691）。无卒中的高危患者中分别有29%与14%的窗口为阳性，但五窗口持续规则将警报限制到17%与2%的患者。

Conclusion: 常规记录的脉搏波携带卒中前时段的血流动力学印记，使脉搏形态学成为候选的连续脑血管生物标志物。

Abstract: Stroke is a disorder of the circulation, yet the haemodynamic state that immediately precedes it has rarely been observed, because continuous physiological recordings before a stroke are seldom available. Photoplethysmography (PPG), recorded by every pulse oximeter and by hundreds of millions of wearable devices, captures the peripheral pulse beat by beat, but its morphology is largely discarded. Here we ask whether pulse waveform morphology encodes haemodynamic signatures of impending stroke. Using in-hospital stroke as a natural experiment that provides continuous PPG before physician-adjudicated stroke recognition, we studied intensive-care (MIMIC-III, $n=176$) and emergency-department (MC-MED, $n=154$) cohorts and described each beat with interpretable descriptors of pulse timing, amplitude, contour and variability. At a nominal 360-min horizon, morphology separated pre-recognition from stable windows with $F_1$ scores of 0.941 and 0.989 (sensitivity 0.998 and 0.980), with models transferred unchanged to the second cohort, and outperformed heart rate alone on identical windows. The signature was dominated by systolic crest time and its change from each patient's own baseline, feature attribution was concordant across cohorts (Spearman $ρ=0.865$), and morphology recorded in the first two hours of care stratified the subsequent clinical course ($F_1$ 0.714 and 0.691). In high-risk patients without stroke, 29% and 14% of windows were positive, but five-window persistence rules limited alerts to 17% and 2% of patients. The results demonstrate that the routinely recorded pulse thus carries haemodynamic imprint of the period preceding stroke, positioning pulse morphology as a candidate continuous cerebrovascular biomarker.

</details>


### [645] [BlenderFORGE: Framework for Optimizing Reactive 3D-Graphics Editing Ability of MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10768)
*Zilin Guo,Tianrui Zhang,Yi Rong,Yichen Liu,Yuxin Guo,Jingcheng Ni,Lewei Lu,Zehuan Wu,Dan Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BlenderFORGE：面向开放权重MLLM智能体的可训练数据-环境-优化框架，通过生成bpy代码实现可验证的3D场景编辑，并采用SFT+AgentLoop-RL两阶段训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型作为交互式智能体虽有前景，但精确、程序化的3D图形编辑难以训练：现有系统多依赖闭源模型API，且缺少确定性、状态可验证的执行环境，无法进行可靠监督与奖励计算。

Method: 提出BlenderFORGE框架，针对四类状态可验证编辑任务（物体放置、形态键编辑、光照调整、材质修改），包含三部分：(1)基于精选资产与大规模3D场景库的可扩展扰动式数据生成流水线；(2)隔离的Blender Sandbox，用于确定性代码执行、结构化状态导出与闭环奖励计算；(3)两阶段训练：用离线教师轨迹做冷启动SFT，再用沙箱奖励进行多轮工具型智能体强化学习（AgentLoop-RL）。

Result: 在四类任务上，基于Qwen3-VL-8B与Qwen3.5-9B得到的BlenderFORGE智能体显著优于各自基座模型，在部分指标上与多个零样本闭源MLLM基线具备竞争力；跨基准评测与相机重构图实验进一步显示其具备超出原始训练设定的迁移能力。

Conclusion: 通过将数据生成、确定性可验证沙箱与两阶段SFT+RL训练相结合，可在开放权重模型上有效训练出可执行的3D图形编辑智能体，并具备一定的跨任务与跨设定泛化能力。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise as interactive agents, yet precise, programmatic 3D graphics editing remains difficult to train because existing systems largely rely on closed-source model APIs and lack deterministic, state-verifiable execution environments. We present BlenderFORGE, a trainable data-environment-optimization framework for open-weight MLLM agents that edit explicit Blender scenes through Blender Python (bpy) code generation. BlenderFORGE targets four fundamental state-verifiable editing task families: object placement, shape-key editing, lighting adjustment, and material modification. It integrates three components: (1) a scalable perturbation-based data generation pipeline built from curated assets and large-scale 3D scene repositories; (2) an isolated Blender Sandbox for deterministic code execution, structured state export, and closed-loop reward computation; and (3) a two-stage training pipeline that uses offline teacher trajectories for cold-start Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and sandbox-computed rewards for multi-turn tool-agentic Reinforcement Learning (AgentLoop-RL). Experiments across the four task families show that the resulting open-weight Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B BlenderFORGE agents substantially improve over their base models and achieve competitive performance with several zero-shot proprietary MLLM baselines on selected metrics. Additional cross-benchmark evaluations and camera-reframing experiments provide evidence of transfer beyond the original training setting.

</details>


### [646] [Multimodal Models Can See, But Can They Think? A Study of Turkish Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10831)
*Berke Bunyamin Sule,Yavuz Selim Aygan,Ahmed Zeer,Elif Ince,Ali Mert Temizsoy,Ozgur Agar,Himmet Toprak Kesgin,Muzaffer Kaan Yuce,Mehmet Fatih Amasyali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究构建多语言视觉推理评测框架（BİLSEM、MM-IQ、Visual Puzzles、PuzzleVQA），比较不同数据混合策略与SFT方法，并用LLM-as-a-Judge评估推理链质量，发现正确答案≠有效推理，基线VLM的推理稳定性常优于微调模型，且SFT可能引发模型崩溃（无限文本循环、空输出），说明当前VLM在抽象视觉推理上仍存在根本缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在高层次认知任务（模式补全、抽象逻辑、关系推理）上表现不佳，其根源在于模型缺乏发现底层规则、维持中间推理步骤的能力，而非仅在选项间做最终判断。现有评测多只看最终答案准确率，无法反映推理过程是否有效，因此需要一个同时考察推理质量与错误成因的评测框架。

Method: 构建多语言视觉推理评测框架，整合BİLSEM、MM-IQ、Visual Puzzles、PuzzleVQA四个数据集；对比多种数据混合策略与监督微调（SFT）方法；在最终答案准确率之外，采用LLM-as-a-Judge对推理链质量进行评估，并观察训练过程中的失效模式。

Result: 实验发现：正确答案并不必然对应有效的推理链；基线模型的推理稳定性往往高于经过微调的模型；SFT可能引发模型崩溃，表现为无限文本循环或空输出等异常生成现象。

Conclusion: 仅以答案准确率评测视觉推理是不充分的，需结合推理链质量评估；监督微调并非总能提升抽象视觉推理能力，甚至可能削弱推理稳定性并造成模型崩溃；当前VLM在抽象视觉推理任务上仍存在实质性短板，需要新的训练与评测范式。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models have had massive leaps in recent years. Yet, when tested on high-level cognitive tasks like pattern completion, abstract logic, and relational reasoning, they still fall short. This limitation stems from the models' lack of ability to find out underlying rules and maintain constant intermediate steps, rather than merely deciding on the correct option. To research these shortcomings, this study analyzes visual reasoning performance throughout a multilingual evaluation framework encompassing the BİLSEM, MM-IQ, Visual Puzzles, and PuzzleVQA datasets. We evaluate various data mixing strategies and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods. We observed that a correct answer does not always mean the reasoning chain is valid. Because of this, we adopt an LLM-as-a-Judge approach to assess the quality of reasoning beyond final answer accuracy. Our experimental results reveal that baseline models often exhibit more stable reasoning compared to fine-tuned counterparts. Most importantly, we observe that SFT can lead to model collapse, manifesting as infinite text loops or empty outputs. The study concludes that current VLMs still struggle with abstract visual reasoning.

</details>


### [647] [A Gamified Framework for Conflict-Driven Design: Discovering Strategies for Collaborative Resilience with Multi-Agent Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10841)
*Jin Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文将多方利益冲突下的城市韧性设计建模为非零和数字桌游，用多智能体强化学习训练利益相关者策略，并在不同规模棋盘与东京辰巳历史地图场景中评估，最后提供人机交互界面用于参与式规划实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市韧性投资需要协调多方利益相关者，但各方目标冲突使协调困难；作者希望构建可计算、可交互的实验平台，以研究个体收益与共享城市发展/韧性目标之间的权衡。

Method: 构建非零和数字桌游，让利益相关者智能体在稀缺资源约束下分配资源，并平衡个体收益与共享的城市发展和韧性目标；采用多智能体强化学习训练策略；设置4×4、8×8和基于东京辰巳历史地图的12×12三类场景，并与模拟退火基准、随机策略基线比较；提供人在回路界面支持回放和参与者接管决策。

Result: 4×4棋盘上学习策略达到模拟退火基准总回报约84%；8×8含空间与资源约束时，自博弈智能体偏好提升韧性的项目；12×12历史地图仿真中，10,000次运行平均总分452.1，随机策略基线为357.3；适应性、可持续性、防洪和绿化提升，但活力与密度下降。

Conclusion: 研究表明MARL可在冲突驱动的城市韧性设计游戏中形成有效策略，并揭示韧性收益与城市活力/密度之间的权衡；人机交互界面可作为参与式城市规划的试验平台。

Abstract: Conflicting stakeholder objectives make it difficult to coordinate investments in urban resilience. We model conflict-driven urban design as a non-zero-sum digital board game in which stakeholder agents allocate scarce resources and balance individual payoffs against shared urban development and resilience objectives. We use multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to train policies and examine their behavior across three settings. On a 4 x 4 board, learned policies reach about 84% of the total return found by a simulated annealing benchmark. On an 8 x 8 board with spatial and resource constraints, trained agents favor projects that improve resilience in self-play. In a 12 x 12 simulation initialized from historical maps of Tatsumi, Tokyo, trained agents achieve a mean total score of 452.1, compared with 357.3 for a random-policy baseline across 10,000 simulation runs. Gains in adaptability, sustainability, flood resistance, and greenery come with reductions in vitality and density. A human-in-the-loop interface supports replay and lets participants take over stakeholder decisions, providing a testbed for exploring these trade-offs in participatory urban planning.

</details>


### [648] [Factor Rank: A Canonical Algebraic Generalization of Tree Decision Diagrams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10842)
*Alexis de Colnet,Stefan Szeider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ATDD用割矩阵的秩替代TDD中对子函数个数的计数，得到一种在任意vtree上严格规范化、且更简洁的秩基表示；其保持多项式时间可判定/计数，并给出vtree变换的输出多项式时间算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TDD通过用vtree替代变量序来推广OBDD，但其宽度基于子函数计数，对线性结构不敏感。作者希望引入秩来捕捉线性结构、提升简洁性，同时不牺牲规范化性质，并回答Capelli等人提出的TDD vtree变换复杂度问题。

Method: 提出代数树决策图（ATDD）：在每个vtree切割处用割矩阵的秩代替不同子函数计数，以所有切割上的最大秩（factor rank）作为宽度；将ATDD视为规范形式的树张量网络，给出局部规范化刻画，并用Lean形式化核心结果，同时实现TDD/ATDD编译器原型。

Result: 每个TDD都可转换为宽度不增的ATDD；ATDD比TDD指数级更简洁，比结构化确定性DNNF准多项式级更简洁；对每个函数和vtree，在有理数上且无一般性假设下恰有一个ATDD；可由张量本身多项式时间判定一个树张量网络是否为其计算函数的ATDD；等价性检查化为语法相等；支持多项式时间模型计数、加权模型计数及“树张量网络是否表示布尔函数”的检测；vtree单节点旋转后仅两个张量改变，TDD和ATDD的vtree变换均为输出多项式时间。

Conclusion: ATDD在获得显著简洁性提升的同时保持了严格规范化，是任意vtree上首个基于秩的严格规范表示；其规范化具有局部可判定性，并使等价检查、计数和vtree变换高效；核心结果已在Lean中形式化验证。

Abstract: Tree decision diagrams (TDDs), recently introduced by Capelli et al. (SAT 2026), are representations of Boolean functions. They generalize OBDDs by replacing variable orders with vtrees. The width of a TDD counts the distinct subfunctions across each vtree cut. Counting subfunctions is blind to linear structure. We introduce algebraic tree decision diagrams (ATDDs) by replacing this count with the rank of the cut matrix. The maximum of these ranks over all cuts, the factor rank, is exactly the width of the ATDD. Every TDD can be converted into an ATDD of no greater width. An ATDD is a tree tensor network in canonical form. ATDDs are exponentially more succinct than TDDs, and quasi-polynomially more succinct than structured deterministic DNNFs. Our main result is that this gain in succinctness does not cost canonicity. ATDDs are the first strict canonical form for a rank-based representation over arbitrary vtrees. For each function and vtree there is exactly one ATDD, over the rationals and without any genericity assumption. The canonicity admits a local characterization. Whether a tree tensor network is the ATDD of the Boolean function it computes can be checked in polynomial time from its tensors alone. Equivalence checking becomes a test of syntactic equality. The operation set includes polynomial-time model counting, weighted model counting, and a test whether a tree tensor network represents a Boolean function.
  Capelli et al. asked for the complexity of changing the vtree of a TDD and suggested local vtree changes. We answer the question. After a rotation of the vtree at one node, the new ATDD differs from the old one in two tensors only. Vtree change runs in output-polynomial time both for TDDs and for ATDDs.
  We formalize and verify our core results in Lean. We provide a prototype implementation of TDD and ATDD compilers as a first empirical validation.

</details>


### [649] [What Broke & Why: Practical Lessons from Reinforcement Learning Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10844)
*Luv Verma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本书是面向开放模型研究者与工程实践者的语言模型强化学习后训练（RLVR）实用指南：从GRPO与训练循环讲起，经五个真实训练项目，聚焦"哪些做法有效、哪些会失败、以及为什么"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升语言模型推理、解题与工具使用能力的重要途径，但落地并不简单：模型可能拿不到有用奖励、学会钻奖励体系的空子、过早停止探索，或因评估本身失真而出现"看似提升"。实践中缺少对失败原因的清晰指导。

Method: 先铺垫后训练基础，逐步讲解GRPO与训练循环；随后依次呈现五个训练项目（数学推理、搜索智能体、训练稳定性、混合专家模型、软件工程任务），每个项目记录遇到的问题、所做的改动与经验教训；并剖析强化学习在模型内部究竟改变了什么；其余章节给出奖励设计、评估、工具调用智能体训练、常见故障调试、可复现性、rollout引擎与硬件方面的实用参考。

Result: 以五个真实训练项目的"问题—改动—教训"式复盘，沉淀出可操作的实践知识，并形成覆盖奖励设计、评估、调试、复现性与工程基础设施的参考框架。

Conclusion: 该书旨在让读者掌握如何训练模型、如何识别训练出错的信号，并判断下一步该尝试什么，是一部强调实战与失败诊断的RL后训练参考书。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important way to improve how language models reason, solve problems, and use tools. But getting it to work in practice is not always straightforward. Training can fail because a model receives no useful reward, learns to exploit the reward system, stops exploring, or appears to improve when the evaluation itself is misleading.
  In this book, we give a practical introduction to reinforcement learning post-training for language models, focusing on what works, what fails, and why. We begin with the foundations of post-training, explain GRPO and the training loop step by step, and then follow five training programs covering math reasoning, search agents, training stability, mixture-of-experts models, and software engineering tasks. Each program shows the problems encountered, the changes made, and the lessons learned.
  The book also examines what reinforcement learning actually changes inside a model.
