The remaining chapters provide a practical reference for reward design, evaluation, training tool-using agents, debugging common failures, reproducibility, rollout engines, and hardware. Written for researchers and practitioners working with open models, the book aims to help readers understand how to train models, recognize when something goes wrong, and decide what to try next.

</details>


### [650] [Inference for Reasoning Models: Practical Lessons from Evaluation and Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10845)
*Luv Verma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这不是一篇单篇论文，而是一本关于"推理设置如何影响语言模型结果与部署"的著作摘要。核心观点：同一模型的基准分数和实际表现高度依赖评估方式与运行配置，仅改动最大回复长度就能让某个数学基准的准确率从0.08%跃升到93.18%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运行语言模型不只是加载训练权重，评估方式与运行配置会让同一模型得到截然不同的基准分数、答案质量和服务成本。作者希望揭示这些常被忽视的"隐形变量"，帮助研究与工程人员理解、复现并信任推理结果。

Method: 以书籍形式系统梳理推理全流程：先讲评估环节（生成长度限制、答案抽取、打分方法、量化）；再分析即使关闭采样，输出仍会因批次、注意力后端、缓存而变化的原因；随后讨论服务性能（批处理、显存容量、延迟、吞吐、成本）；最后考察结构化输出、工具调用、推理预算与长上下文任务等控制项及相应基准的能说明与不能说明的问题。

Result: 用一个典型实验说明问题的严重性：仅改变最大回复长度，某数学基准的准确率就从0.08%变为93.18%，说明许多报告分数可能被推理设置本身而非模型能力所主导。

Conclusion: 给出实践性指导——如何记录推理运行、核查评估、估算容量并公平地比较不同系统；目标是让推理结果更易理解、复现和可信。

Abstract: Running a language model involves more than its trained weights. The same model can receive very different benchmark scores, produce different answers, or cost more to serve depending on how it is evaluated and run. In one experiment in this book, changing only the maximum response length moved accuracy on a math benchmark from 0.08% to 93.18%.
  This book explains how inference settings shape the results we report and the systems we deploy. We begin with evaluation, including generation limits, answer extraction, scoring methods, and quantization. We then examine why outputs can change across batches, attention backends, and caching, even when sampling is disabled. The next chapters cover serving performance, including batching, memory capacity, latency, throughput, and cost. We also study structured outputs, tool calls, reasoning budgets, and long-context tasks, showing what these controls and benchmarks do and do not establish.
  The book concludes with practical guidance for recording inference runs, checking evaluations, estimating capacity, and comparing systems fairly. Written for researchers and engineers working with language models, it aims to make inference results easier to understand, reproduce, and trust.

</details>


### [651] [Polynomial Denoisers on the Image Manifold: Volterra Networks for Self-Contained Pixel Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10857)
*Siddharth Roheda,Rohit Chowdhury,Amit Satish Unde,Aniruddha Bala*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出 softmax 注意力及任何归一化混合规则无法实现超越仿射的多项式映射，论证应以 Volterra 层替代注意力，提出全 Volterra 层的像素空间扩散架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期工作利用自然图像位于高维像素空间低维流形这一性质，构建无需专用机制或预训练组件的像素空间扩散模型：原始图像块上的普通 Transformer 只要预测干净图像并施加激进瓶颈压缩即可。但其混合算子仍是继承自序列建模的 softmax 注意力，而非从去噪任务推导而来，作者希望用与去噪理论一致的算子替换它。

Method: 作者基于高斯噪声下最优去噪器可展开为观测的多项式泛函（Wiener–Volterra 级数）展开理论分析，证明 softmax 注意力及任何归一化混合规则（含线性注意力）至多实现仿射多项式映射；而 Volterra 层可直接实现该函数类，且在数据流形上的逼近速率由流形维数而非环境像素维数决定。据此提出新架构：原始图像块经瓶颈嵌入，接级联低秩 Volterra 层，因每层自身非线性而无需激活函数。

Result: 所提模型在 ImageNet 256×256 与 512×512 上，在参数量与 FLOPs 匹配的条件下，与自包含像素空间扩散模型相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 这是首个混合算子全程为 Volterra 层的像素空间扩散架构：无注意力、无卷积、无预训练组件、残差路径上无激活函数，理论与实验结果支持其有效性。

Abstract: Natural images are often conjectured to lie on a low-dimensional manifold within the high-dimensional pixel space. Recent work leverages this to build self-contained pixel-space diffusion models without specialized machinery or pretrained components. A plain Transformer on raw image patches suffices, provided it predicts the clean image rather than the noise and compresses each patch through an aggressive bottleneck. The mixing operator, however, has remained softmax attention, inherited from sequence modeling rather than derived from denoising. For Gaussian noise, the optimal denoiser admits a canonical expansion in polynomial functionals of the observation, the Wiener--Volterra series. We prove that softmax attention, and any normalized mixing rule (including linear attention), cannot realize any polynomial map beyond an affine one. In contrast, Volterra layers realize this class directly and, on a data manifold, achieve approximation rates governed by the manifold dimension rather than the ambient pixel dimension. We therefore propose the architecture these results prescribe; raw image patches passed through a bottleneck embedding, followed by cascaded low-rank Volterra layers, which carry no activation function because each layer is nonlinear in its own right. To our knowledge this is the first pixel-space diffusion architecture whose mixing operators are Volterra layers throughout, with no attention, no convolution, no pretrained components, and no activation function on the residual path. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$ and $512 \times 512$, the resulting model is competitive with self-contained pixel-space diffusion at matched parameter and FLOP budgets.

</details>


### [652] [Lightfoot: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Exact, Model-Free Document Deletion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11010)
*Uday Allu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Lightfoot 提出一种确定性、可溯源的 GraphRAG：每个实体、链接、事实和同义边都由逐段抽取结果确定生成，索引时每段仅一次语言模型调用、检索零调用、删除文档为纯数据库操作；在 MuSiQue 上验证删除 10% 文档后图与重建索引一致，并与 HippoRAG 2、LightRAG、fast-graphrag 在多跳 QA 数据集上比较成本与效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GraphRAG 能提升多跳问答，但实际部署中的建图成本和文档删除/更新成本很少被研究比较；现有系统在索引和删除时可能需要大量模型调用，缺少可增量维护、可审计且低成本的方案。

Method: 将实体、链接、事实和同义边定义为逐段抽取的确定性函数，并保留 chunk 级溯源；索引每段一次 LM 调用，检索无 LM 调用，删除文档仅为数据库操作。在 MuSiQue 全量 11,402 段上验证删除 10% 文档后图与对幸存文档重新索引完全一致。在相同抽取、回答和嵌入模型下，与 HippoRAG 2、LightRAG、fast-graphrag 在 MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA、HotpotQA 上比较。

Result: Lightfoot 在三个数据集上均构建最便宜索引：比 HippoRAG 2 低 26–31%，比 LightRAG 和 fast-graphrag 低 3–6 倍。相对 HippoRAG 2，在 MuSiQue 检索显著更好（held-out 上 recall@5 +2.8、recall@10 +4.3），HotpotQA 答案 exact match +7.7；但在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上显著更差（recall@2 -3.9、F1 -8.4）。删除同批文档时 LightRAG 需 2,187 次模型调用和 3.7 小时，fast-graphrag 无删除路径。

Conclusion: Lightfoot 通过确定性、可溯源和可删除的图构建机制，显著降低索引与删除成本，并在部分多跳 QA 任务上保持竞争力；但在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上效果落后，说明其收益存在数据集依赖性，需按场景权衡成本与质量。

Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) improves multi-hop question answering, but deployed systems face two costs that research comparisons rarely measure: building the graph, and removing documents from it. We present Lightfoot, a GraphRAG system in which every entity, link, fact and synonym edge is a deterministic function of per-passage extractions carrying chunk-level provenance. Indexing makes one language-model call per passage, retrieval makes none, and deleting a document is a database operation with no model calls. On the full 11,402-passage MuSiQue corpus we verify that, after deleting 10% of the documents, the graph is identical to a fresh index of the surviving documents. We compare Lightfoot with HippoRAG 2, LightRAG and fast-graphrag under identical extraction, answer and embedding models on MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA. Lightfoot builds the cheapest index on all three datasets, 26-31% below HippoRAG 2 and 3-6x below LightRAG and fast-graphrag. Against HippoRAG 2 it is significantly better on MuSiQue retrieval (+2.8 points recall@5 and +4.3 recall@10 on a held-out split) and on HotpotQA answers (+7.7 points exact match), and significantly worse on 2WikiMultiHopQA (-3.9 recall@2, -8.4 F1). Deleting the same documents took LightRAG 2,187 model calls and 3.7 hours; fast-graphrag has no deletion path. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/udayallu-ml/Lightfoot-GraphRAG

</details>


### [653] [But It Was True When I Checked: Compiling SHOP-Style Method Preconditions into Partially-Ordered HTN Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11055)
*Harrison Oates*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文解决了HTN规划中长期悬而未决的问题：将“方法前置条件需在首个动作前成立”的语义，仅用两个额外事实编译为标准偏序HTN规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 方法前置条件在SHOP/经典HTN语义与HDDL语义下含义不同：前者要求前置条件在方法首个动作前立即成立，后者通过辅助动作检查，在偏序下可能被无关动作破坏。HDDL采用较弱语义，是因为首动作语义难以编译；后续工作多次将其在偏序下的编译列为开放问题，已有转换仅限全序。

Method: 提出一种将首动作语义编译为标准偏序HTN规划的方法，编译目标不包含方法前置条件，且仅引入两个额外事实。

Result: 给出了首动作语义在偏序HTN规划下的可行编译，突破了现有转换仅适用于全序的限制。

Conclusion: 该编译解决了HTN规划社区长期存在的开放问题，为HDDL与首动作语义之间提供了更完整的语义桥梁。

Abstract: Method preconditions specify when a method may be applied in hierarchical task network (HTN) planning, but their meaning differs under two established semantics. The SHOP planners, like the classical HTN formalism of Erol, Hendler and Nau, require the precondition to hold immediately before the method's first action. HDDL, the input language of the International Planning Competition's HTN track, instead introduces an auxiliary action to check it; under partial order, unrelated actions may invalidate the precondition before the method starts. HDDL's designers adopted this weaker semantics because the first-action reading could not easily be compiled. Subsequent work has repeatedly identified its compilation under partial order as an open question, with existing transformations limited to total order. We give a compilation of the first-action semantics into standard partially ordered HTN planning without method preconditions using only two additional facts, thereby resolving a longstanding question in the HTN planning community.

</details>


### [654] [GARP: Real-Time Generative Agents on Local Hardware in a Game Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11064)
*Piero Molino,Patrick John Chia,Federico Bianchi,Jonathan P. Chen,Paul Szerlip*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GARP 是一个在 Godot 引擎内运行实时生成式智能体（LLM 驱动游戏角色）的平台，全部推理在本地 3B 开源模型上完成、无需云端；其行为系统在原有计划/记忆/反思之上加入情绪评估、大五人格轴、六种需求与成对关系，并采用多层优化策略保证实时性，九场景 27 次运行中 25 次通过日志检查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始 Generative Agents 演示依赖云端推理和定制仿真环境，难以在真实游戏中实时运行；作者希望把这类 LLM 智能体落到本地、可玩的游戏环境里，同时让角色行为更丰富（情绪、人格、需求、关系）而不牺牲响应性。

Method: 提出 GARP 平台及其中的 Character Behavior System：每个角色由 LLM 现场生成计划、对话与记忆；在原有计划、记忆、反思之外，增加由 LLM 评估驱动的情绪系统、从大五人格导出的四条分级人格轴（同时影响仿真参数与提示文本）、紧迫度随时间增长的六种需求、以及每次对话后更新的两两关系。系统将 50+ 候选动作收窄到通常 3–8 个，用 JSON schema 约束模型输出，并在决策提示中呈现重要记忆。实时性靠分层优化：可调游戏时钟、提前决策、多级缓存、提示压缩、全异步执行。

Result: 完整闭环在本地硬件上以 3B 开源权重模型运行，不依赖云服务；九场景评估中 27 次运行有 25 次通过基于日志的检查，两次失败均出现在生日派对场景，原因是一名宾客未把该事件写进当日计划。

Conclusion: 本地实时生成式智能体在游戏引擎中是可行的，行为系统扩展（情绪、人格、需求、关系）与工程优化可以共存；但高层计划层面的遗漏仍是可靠性的主要失效来源。

Abstract: Generative agents are game characters whose plans, conversations, and memories are written on the fly by a large language model (LLM). The original Generative Agents demonstration used cloud inference in a custom simulation. We present GARP, a platform for real-time generative agents inside Godot, and describe the Character Behavior System used in GARP 2. The complete loop runs on local hardware using a 3B-parameter open-weight model and no cloud service. Alongside the original planning, memory, and reflection, GARP gives each agent an emotion system driven by LLM appraisal, four graded personality axes drawn from the Big Five that set simulation parameters as well as prompt text, six needs whose urgency grows over time, and pairwise relationships updated after every conversation. The system narrows 50+ candidate actions to typically 3-8, constrains model responses with JSON schemas, and surfaces important memories in decision prompts. A layered optimization strategy (an adjustable game clock, decisions taken ahead of need, multi-tier caching, prompt compression, and fully asynchronous execution) keeps the game responsive while the model thinks. In a nine-scenario evaluation, 25 of 27 runs passed log-based checks. Both failures occurred in the birthday party scenario, where one guest omitted the event from their daily plan.

</details>


### [655] [When Are Nearby Experts Composable? Cross-Task Model Merging in Neural Thickets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11177)
*Suxin Ji,Hungtao Wan,Mingjun Liu,An Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究"共享检查点随机扰动"产生的专家在组合后增益能否保留的问题，提出以严格联合成功率与最差任务增益（并计入弃权）为度量的专家对选择框架，给出有限差分分解与正交反例说明近邻/正交性不足，并提出质量约束的谱选择方法，在6个检查点、21个任务对上验证其优于Top-1平均。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 围绕同一共享检查点做随机扰动可得到面向不同任务的"专家"，但共享来源并不能保证二者组合（merge）后的增益仍然成立。现有做法常以权重距离或正交性作为可组合性的代理指标，作者认为这些代理不可靠，需要一个能严格衡量"组合是否真正带来联合收益"的表述与选择准则。

Method: ①将专家对选择形式化为"相对基座的联合保留"问题，采用严格联合成功率与最差任务增益作为指标，并对无条件弃权（abstain）单独计账；②用精确的有限差分分解说明组合增益的来源结构，并构造任意小的正交反例，证明仅靠邻近性与正交性不足以判定可组合性；③实例化为"质量约束的谱选择"（quality-constrained spectral selection）：固定预算下融合跨任务筛选、逐层成对几何、独立验证集与Base回退四个环节。

Result: 在6个检查点、21个任务对、5个独立扰动池上：严格联合成功率始终优于Top-1平均；在四方法规模对比中于6个检查点中的4个领先。对参数量≥1.5B的5个模型，在匹配协议下质量-only、全局余弦、谱排序的联合成功率分别为49.1%、50.5%、53.1%；谱选择器同时取得最高最差任务增益与最高Weak Pareto率、最低回退率。平均最差任务增益+0.61个百分点，但仍有17.1%的回退率和13.0%的弃权率。

Conclusion: 以基座相对增益为准的严格联合评估能有效筛选专家对，谱几何信号在匹配协议下优于距离/余弦类启发式；但可组合性仍是条件性的——弃权与回退比例表明相当一部分专家对并不产生稳定联合收益，需以显式弃权机制兜底。

Abstract: Random perturbations around a shared checkpoint can produce experts for distinct tasks, but shared origin does not ensure that their gains survive composition. We formulate expert-pair selection for joint base-relative retention, measured by strict joint success and worst-task gain with unconditional abstention accounting. An exact finite-difference decomposition and an arbitrarily small orthogonal counterexample show why proximity and orthogonality alone are insufficient. We instantiate this formulation with quality-constrained spectral selection, a fixed-budget framework combining cross-task screening, layerwise pair geometry, separate validation, and Base fallback. Across six checkpoints, 21 task pairs, and five independent perturbation pools, the procedure improves strict joint success over Top-1 averaging throughout and leads the four-method model-scale comparison on four of six checkpoints. For the five models with at least 1.5B parameters, matched quality-only, global-cosine, and spectral ranking attain 49.1%, 50.5%, and 53.1% joint success. Under this matched protocol, the spectral selector also yields the highest worst-task gain and Weak Pareto rate and the lowest regression rate. Mean worst-task gain reaches +0.61 percentage points, while 17.1% regression and 13.0% abstention show that composability remains conditional. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Thickets-Merge/.

</details>


### [656] [When Self-Consistency Hurts: The Hidden Cost of Majority Voting in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11201)
*Wanrong Yang,Lingfang Li,Jun Zhang,Dominik Wojtczak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在小语言模型上研究带自洽性（SC）的提示式思维链：用oracle门控给出上限，并据此提出可部署的贪心信号门控，按需跳过SC调用以节省计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小模型单查询算力预算紧张，但实践中常沿用大模型的固定采样预算（如N=5）无差别地施加SC，忽视实例难度差异，造成算力浪费甚至准确率下降。

Method: 在两个模型族（Qwen-2.5-0.5B、Gemma-3-1B）、FP16与MLX-Q4量化、GSM8K与MATH-500上，开展8个单任务与4个任务池化实验（n=200-400），采用1000次配对bootstrap置信区间评估。先构造逐prompt决定是否启用SC的oracle门控作为上限，再提出基于贪心结果信号的近似门控以实际部署。

Result: Oracle门控在12/12设置中以23-30%算力达到always-SC准确率的109-174%，说明N=5时always-SC处处被支配；其收益来自SC将正确贪心答案翻错（3-10.5%的prompt），在Qwen-Q4×MATH-500上该比率超过错转正比率，使always-SC比always-greedy低3个点。可部署门控跳过45-99%的SC调用，bootstrap置信区间半宽<5点，节省36-79%算力；准确率保留点估计98.1-98.8%（置信区间较宽，下界76-86%，对应SC准确率仅15-36%）。

Conclusion: 固定样本预算的SC在小模型、紧算力场景下并不划算，按需门控可大幅节省计算；但证据范围限于N=5、两个≤1B模型族与两个数学基准，作者明确界定此结论边界，且准确率保留率仅以点估计报告，需谨慎解读。

Abstract: We study prompted chain-of-thought (CoT) with self-consistency (SC), i.e. sampling N traces and plurality-voting, on small language models, a regime where per-query compute budgets are tight yet SC is commonly applied with a fixed sample budget inherited from large-model practice, regardless of instance difficulty. Across two model families (Qwen-2.5-0.5B, Gemma-3-1B) at FP16 and MLX-Q4 (4-bit quantisation in Apple's MLX framework), on GSM8K and MATH-500, we run 8 per-task and 4 task-pooled experiments at n=200-400 with 1,000x paired-bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs). Our first result is an upper bound: an oracle gate deciding per prompt whether to invoke SC reaches 109-174% of always-SC's accuracy at 23-30% of its compute in all 12/12 cases, so at N=5 always-SC is dominated everywhere on our grid. That margin is exactly the rate at which SC flips correct greedy answers to wrong, here 3-10.5% of prompts, which on Qwen-Q4 x MATH-500 exceeds the wrong-to-right rate and leaves always-SC 3 pt worse than always-greedy. Our second result is a deployable approximation: a gate over greedy-pass signals skips 45-99% of SC calls, with bootstrap CI half-widths under 5 pt, removing 36-79% of always-SC compute. Accuracy retention at those operating points has point estimates of 98.1-98.8%, which we report as point estimates because their CIs are wide (lower bounds 76-86%) over an SC accuracy of only 15-36%. The evidence covers N=5 on two <=1B families and two math benchmarks, which is the scope we claim. Code is available at https://github.com/heywanrong/SiftSC.

</details>


### [657] [LoMASA: A Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant with Confidence-Gated Delegation for B2B Quoting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11234)
*Yu Liu,Xingbang Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LoMASA：一种无需训练、完全运行于单台桌面电脑的多智能体销售助手系统，用System-1（35B MoE）单步决策并读取选项概率作置信度，System-2（27B稠密）在不确定时撰写回复与升级简报，价格/利润由代码计算且硬规则不可覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一线销售大量时间花在客户改数量/要折扣/新付款条件或成本变动后重新协调报价上，流程重复且易出错，需要一个轻量、可在个人电脑上本地运行、无需训练即可用的辅助系统来减少人工决策负担并守住定价规则。

Method: 构建LoMASA本地多智能体系统：System-1为35B混合专家模型，一次前向即可做出决策，并用答案选项的概率读出置信度；System-2为27B稠密模型，负责撰写客户回复与升级简报，仅在System-1不确定时介入；所有价格、利润与选项由代码计算，硬性定价规则不可被覆盖。在500个模拟回合、共1512个决策（基于公开供应链数据）的测试划分上评估，并对比规则基线。

Result: 销售员仅需裁决19.5%的决策；38.0%被自动结算，中位延迟2.67秒；42.5%由硬规则升级给经理。在自动结算决策上，LoMASA准确率与规则基线持平（0.894 vs 0.894），且事后利润跌破下限的承诺更少（2.61% vs 4.53%），代价是更多升级至经理。选项概率在无需训练下校准良好，而同模型用文字表达的置信度则不然。局限：27B模型很少改变决策。

Conclusion: LoMASA以"快模型+慢模型+代码硬约束"的分工，在单台桌面电脑上实现无需训练、低延迟且规则安全的销售决策辅助，可在减少人工决策与保证利润下限间取得较好平衡；其代价是更高的经理升级率，且System-2对决策的实际影响有限。

Abstract: Frontline sales staff spend much of their day re-coordinating quotes after customers change quantities, ask for discounts or new payment terms, or costs move. We present LoMASA (Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant), a training-free multi-agent system that runs entirely on one desktop computer. A 35B mixture-of-experts model (System-1) makes each decision in a single forward pass and reads its confidence from the probabilities of the answer options. A 27B dense model (System-2) writes customer replies and escalation briefs and is consulted when System-1 is unsure. Code computes every price, margin and option, and hard pricing rules cannot be overridden. On a test split of 500 simulated episodes with 1512 decisions built from public supply-chain data, the salesperson has to decide only 19.5% of decisions: 38.0% are settled automatically, with a median latency of 2.67 seconds, and 42.5% are escalated to a manager by the hard rules. On the automatically settled decisions LoMASA is as accurate as a rule baseline (0.894 vs.\ 0.894) and makes fewer commitments whose margin later falls below the floor (2.61% vs 4.53%); the price is additional escalations to the manager. Option probabilities are well calibrated without any training, unlike confidence stated in words by the same model. We also report where the design does not help: the 27B model rarely changes a decision.

</details>


### [658] [Verify Before You Fetch: Reliable KV Cache Compression for LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11319)
*Devanshu Jha,Gaurav Kumar,Agniva Chowdhury,Kumar Krishna Agrawal,Aditya Desai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VerKV 提出一种带 (ε, δ) 误差保证的混合式 KV 缓存卸载/压缩框架：GPU 上保留无查询假设的枢轴 token 与全缓存的 sketch，CPU 保留完整缓存，并以 PoissonComp 采样与 KVFetch 校验实现有界误差的注意力计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文、长期存活智能体与多智能体系统的 KV 缓存会超出 GPU HBM 容量，需卸载到主机内存，而 CPU→GPU 传输成为推理延迟瓶颈。通用（查询无关）压缩要保证任意查询下的注意力精度极其困难，甚至不可行，因此需要一种可量化误差保证的方案。

Method: VerKV 在 GPU 上维护紧凑的查询无关枢轴 token 集合与 token 级 sketch，完整 KV 缓存放于 CPU 内存；用新的随机采样过程 PoissonComp 选取枢轴 token；推理时用 KVFetch 算法基于枢轴 token 与 sketch 估计注意力计算的相对误差，若满足用户指定 (ε, δ) 容差则不访问主机内存，否则执行查询感知检索从 CPU 补充 token 以精化注意力。

Result: PoissonComp 优于现有 KV 缓存压缩方法；与 KVFetch 结合后在 32K 上下文（RULER 与 LOFT 平均）上达到近稠密性能，为稠密质量的 90–100%（Qwen3-4B、Qwen3.5-9B、Ministral-3-8B），GPU 内存占用降低 8–32 倍，每生成 token 的 CPU→GPU 取数仅为缓存量的 2–23%（依模型而定）。

Conclusion: 通过在误差估计驱动下按需取数，VerKV 在最小化 CPU→GPU 传输的同时实现了有界近似误差的注意力计算，兼顾精度与内存/带宽效率。

Abstract: Long-context applications, long-lived agents, and multi-agent systems require large language models (LLMs) to process and retain extensive information. In these settings, the KV cache can exceed GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity, necessitating offloading to host memory, where CPU-to-GPU transfers can dominate inference latency. While KV cache compression can reduce data movement, query-agnostic compression that guarantees accurate attention for arbitrary queries is extremely challenging, if not impossible. We introduce VerKV, a hybrid approach that provides $(ε, δ)$ guarantees for approximating attention on any given query. VerKV maintains a compact set of query-agnostic pivotal tokens on the GPU, together with a token-level sketch of the full KV cache, while retaining the complete cache in CPU memory. We introduce a novel stochastic sampling procedure, PoissonComp, to select the pivotal tokens. At inference time, our proposed KVFetch algorithm uses the pivotal tokens and the sketch to estimate the relative error of the resulting attention computation. If the estimate satisfies a user-specified $(ε, δ)$ tolerance, inference proceeds without accessing host memory. Otherwise, VerKV performs query-aware retrieval to fetch additional tokens from the CPU, refining the attention computation to meet the required tolerance. Thus, VerKV enables attention with bounded approximation error while minimizing CPU-to-GPU transfers. We show that PoissonComp outperforms state-of-the-art approaches to KV cache compression. Combined with KVFetch, it achieves near-dense performance (90-100% of dense quality at 32K context length, averaged over RULER and LOFT), using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3.5-9B and Ministral-3-8B, while reducing the GPU memory footprint by 8-32x and keeping CPU-to-GPU memory fetches within 2-23% of the cache per generated token, depending on the model.

</details>


### [659] [Separation of Skilling Context for Standard Operating Procedure-based Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11348)
*Mitsuhiro Nakayama,Toshiaki Sota,Takehiko Yamaguchi,Michiaki Tatsubori*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文针对SOP简洁导致LLM智能体生成技能缺乏隐性知识的问题，提出将SOP与上下文知识（CK）分开管理，并用契约感知评估区分真实违规与CK可解释差异；在8个Indeed工作流上将功能等价率从12%提升到58%，且已有CK覆盖SOP修订后79.5%的新增自动化缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SOP为便于人阅读而保持简洁，LLM智能体据此生成可执行技能时缺少隐性知识和实现细节，需要人工反复补足；且SOP演化后补足工作须重复进行，形成“SOP-技能漂移”问题。

Method: 将SOP与上下文知识（CK）分离管理，并设计契约感知评估，用于区分真正的违规与可由CK解释的差异；在8个源自Indeed的工作流上进行单LLM实验，并施加三种SOP修订扰动。

Result: 功能等价率由12%提升至58%；在三种SOP修订扰动下，先前提取的CK已覆盖新引入自动化缺口的79.5%。

Conclusion: 分离管理SOP与CK并结合契约感知评估，可缓解SOP-技能漂移，减少重复人工干预，并提升技能生成的功能等价性与对SOP演化的适应性。

Abstract: Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are kept concise for human readability, so LLM agents that generate executable skills from them lack the tacit knowledge and implementation details needed for automation. Human intervention fills these gaps, but must be repeated as SOPs evolve---a problem we call \textit{SOP-skill drift}. We propose managing SOPs and Contextual Knowledge (CK) separately, together with a \textit{contract-aware} evaluation that distinguishes genuine violations from CK-resolved differences. On eight Indeed-derived workflows (single LLM), it raises the functional-equivalence rate from 12\% to 58\%. Under three SOP-revision perturbations, previously extracted CK already covers 79.5\% of newly introduced automation gaps.

</details>


### [660] [InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11558)
*InfraRSI Team,Yuchuan Tian,Haocheng Mei,Ye Yuan,Chao Xu,Boxun Li,Guohao Dai,Kai Han,Allen Chen,Yunhe Wang,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: InfraRSI 是一个面向分布式大模型训练的智能体化自动调优框架，通过"init–doctor–run–report–apply"五阶段闭环，将开放式人类指令转化为可验证的训练优化，并在四种单/多机稠密与 MoE 负载上取得最高 2.75× 加速、MFU 由 17.4% 提升至 30.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）在孤立算法与算子合成上已见成效，但分布式 LLM 训练是启动配置、算子内核与通信调度强耦合的系统问题：单点改动常触发 OOM、编译器冲突、测量抖动或静默数值漂移，导致"逐点贪心改进"式的自动优化难以稳定奏效。因此需要一个能把人类开放指令转成"可验证优化"的工程化载体。

Method: 提出 InfraRSI 五阶段工作流：(1) init 锁定可编辑范围与固定任务契约（工作负载、损失、时间不变量），防止 reward hacking；(2) doctor 剖析基线各阶段并标定集群噪声；(3) run 联合优化启动 knob 与代码补丁，先重验证头部候选再写入跨硬件经验库；(4) report 与 (5) apply 审计源码路径、统计失败试错成本并提交晋级改动。核心算法：不再从单一 incumbent 贪心推进，而是用多样化经验种子配置初始化；在所有试验（含 OOM 作为删失样本）上拟合全局执行时间模型与峰值内存删失模型；基于模型为每个配置的显存开销定价，用在线实跑修正 LLM 先验偏差，并把"吃显存"的优化与省显存手段及已验证代码补丁配对使用。

Result: 在四个单机/多机、稠密与 MoE 的 LLM 工作负载上，最高获得 2.75× 加速，平均 MFU 从 17.4% 提升到 30.0%，优于现有调优器与编码智能体，并可跨不同 GPU 迁移经验。

Conclusion: InfraRSI 在提升训练基础设施效率的同时，形成了"运行内在线修正先验 + 跨集群经验蒸馏"的两级递归自我改进闭环，为持续推进基础模型规模化提供了可复用的自动化范式。

Abstract: While Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) accelerates isolated algorithm and kernel synthesis, distributed LLM training depends on tightly coupled launch settings, operator kernels, and communication schedules, where single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries, compiler conflicts, measurement jitter, or silent numerical drift. We present InfraRSI, the agentic harness that turns open-ended human commands into verified training optimizations via a five-stage workflow: init locks editable scope and a fixed task contract over workload, loss, and timing invariants to prevent reward hacking, doctor profiles baseline phases and calibrates cluster noise, run co-optimizes launch knobs and code patches before re-verifying top candidates against the baseline and logging findings to a cross-hardware experience bank, and report and apply audit source paths, track failed-trial costs, and commit promoted changes. Rather than stepping greedily from a single incumbent, InfraRSI initializes from diverse experience-seeded configurations and fits global execution-time and censored peak-memory models across all trials, including OOMs. Using these models, it prices per-setting memory costs, revises miscalibrated LLM priors from live runs, and pairs memory-hungry optimizations with memory savers and verified code patches. Across four single- and multi-node dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM workloads, InfraRSI achieves a speedup of up to $2.75\times$ and lifts mean Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) from $17.4\%$ to $30.0\%$, outperforming existing tuners and coding agents while transferring experience across GPUs. As it improves training infrastructure efficiency, InfraRSI forms a two-level Recursive Self-Improvement loop---revising priors online within runs and distilling experience across clusters---to push foundation model scaling.

</details>


### [661] [LiveAsset: Learning Intent Assets from Corrective Interactions for Agent Runtime Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11560)
*Guanming Liu,Weihang Wang,Peng Zhang,Meng Wu,Kainan Tu,Jiahao Liu,Yu Zhang,Liuxin Zhang,Qianying Wang,Ning Gu,Tun Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 LiveAsset：从多轮纠正交互中学习"意图资产"，用于 LLM 智能体的运行时控制，提升对用户潜在需求的满足度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在网页与在线服务上执行任务时，用户目标常表述不充分，需要通过多轮纠正来对齐。现实中用户往往只指出"结果有问题"而不说明想要什么，因此必须结合纠正前后的结果来推断意图。这类期望通常绑定特定情境，导致难以判断何时适用、如何保证后续行为符合用户预期。现有记忆/技能/规则类方案难以做到这一点。

Method: LiveAsset 是一个"意图治理框架"（intent harness）：(1) 将每次纠正与该智能体原结果和修订结果联合解释，推断用户意图；(2) 增量更新可复用的意图资产，并保留仍然适用的早期要求；(3) 在任务入口即用所学要求引导智能体执行；(4) 运行时验证：在每次回复前依据解释评估要求的适用性，并引导智能体在保留已满足项的前提下修订未满足项。评估流程为先经模拟用户多轮逐步揭示需求的"学习阶段"，再做同任务重放（π-Bench、PERMA、Vita）与跨任务迁移（PAST-Bench、SkillEvolBench）。

Result: 实验表明，LiveAsset 相比记忆型、技能型与规则型 harness 基线，能更好地满足从纠正交互中学到的要求，并在上述基准上取得更优性能。

Conclusion: 将纠正交互转化为可复用的情境化意图资产，并在执行前引导、执行后验证，是提升 LLM 智能体与用户意图对齐的有效途径；且所学资产可跨任务迁移。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents acting across web applications and online services often need multi-turn corrections to align their work with users' underspecified goals and preferences. In practice, users may identify problems in the current outcome without specifying the desired result, so learning user intentions requires interpreting each correction against the agent's preceding and revised outcomes. These expectations are often connected to a particular context, making it hard to know when they apply and how to ensure the agent later acts as the user expects. To this end, we propose LiveAsset, an intent harness that learns reusable intent assets from corrective interactions and uses them for runtime control of agent execution. LiveAsset jointly interprets each correction with the agent's original and revised results to infer user intent, incrementally updating the assets while preserving earlier requirements that remain applicable. The learned requirements guide agent execution from task entry and provide criteria for runtime verification, which uses the explanations to assess applicability before each reply is delivered and directs the agent to revise the result to address unmet requirements while preserving those already satisfied. Following a learning phase in which simulated users progressively reveal requirements through multi-turn corrections, we evaluate LiveAsset using same-task replay of the original requests on π-Bench, PERMA, and Vita and cross-task transfer on PAST-Bench and SkillEvolBench. Experiments show that LiveAsset better fulfills requirements learned from corrective interactions and improves performance on these benchmarks compared with memory, skill, and rule-based harness baselines. Code is available at github.com/landian60/LiveAsset.

</details>


### [662] [Same Error, Different Recovery: How Delivery Changes LLM Agent Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11581)
*Sunghyeun Woo,Javier Conde,Pedro Reviriego*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文把"工具调用失败后错误信息如何送达模型"（放置位置、指导措辞、是否保留失败历史、轮次结构）作为独立变量隔离研究，发现"新增用户轮次并保留失败交换"能大幅减少停止失败，并在 ToolMaze 上显著提升显式错误恢复率，但对含静默损坏的多轮任务无增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用工具的语言模型在调用失败后必须决定重试、修正还是停止告知用户，而仅凭错误文本往往不足以做对决策：同一段反馈因出现在对话中的位置不同，会诱发不同动作。现有工作未把"错误信息的投递方式"当作独立因素加以隔离，因此需要专门研究其影响。

Method: 在两个数据收集前即固定计划的预注册研究中，系统操控投递的四个维度（放置位置、指导信息、保留历史、轮次结构），覆盖 3B–70B 共 13 个开源模型，比较模型的下一步动作与最终任务完成情况，并采用精确确定性复跑保证可重复性。随后将该形式实现为确定性推理引擎中的可选"恢复层"（在保留失败交换的前提下追加新用户轮次），在公开基准 ToolMaze、多轮评测 Loud/Quiet（24 个含可见失败与静默损坏的任务，按最终状态一致性评分）以及一个编码 agent 上进行评估。

Result: 保留失败交换的新增用户轮次避免了 Llama 模型在删除该交换后出现的严重停止失败；在合并的合成比较中不劣于"历史重写"，但并非对所有模型都是最优选择。落地评估中，ToolMaze 上显式错误的成功率提升 14.2 点（7–8B 模型）和 10.5 点（32–70B 模型）；Loud/Quiet 上无可测增益；而直接告知确切故障类型的客户端表现更好。

Conclusion: 错误信息的"投递"是工具调用失败恢复中的一个独立影响因素，值得单独设计与评估；但它既不是某个推理引擎独占的解决方案，也不构成一种通用的重试策略，效果依赖于任务类型（显式报错 vs. 静默损坏）、模型规模与模型家族。

Abstract: A tool-using language model must decide whether to retry a failed call, correct it, or stop and tell the user. The error text alone may not be enough: the same feedback can lead to different actions depending on where it appears in the conversation. We isolate this delivery problem by varying placement, guidance, retained history and turn structure. Two studies with plans fixed before data collection, across 13 open models from 3B to 70B parameters, compare the next action and subsequent task completion, with exact deterministic reruns. A new user turn that retains the failed exchange avoids the severe stopping failure observed in Llama models when that exchange is removed. It is non-inferior to history rewriting in pooled synthetic comparisons, but is not best for every model. We implement this form as an opt-in recovery layer within a deterministic inference engine and evaluate it on public benchmarks and a coding agent. On ToolMaze, it raises success on explicit errors by 14.2 points with 7-8B models and 10.5 points with 32-70B models; Loud/Quiet, 24 multi-turn tasks with visible failures and silent corruption, scored by final-state agreement, shows no measurable gain. A client given the exact fault kind performs better still. The findings support delivery as a distinct factor in recovery, not an engine-exclusive solution or a universal retry policy.

</details>


### [663] [FinCutBench: A Continually Updated Benchmark for Measuring the Temporal Boundaries of LLM Financial Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11588)
*Siyuan Li,Ke Wan,Boyong Hou,Yujie Deng,Zixuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出FinCutBench，用月度更新的中英文金融选择题测量固定模型金融知识的“时间边界”，以识别参数化前视偏差，并为point-in-time金融评估的窗口选择提供经验参考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融回测等point-in-time任务虽可按日期限制外部输入，但模型参数可能已记住未来披露的金融事实，产生“参数化前视偏差”（parametric look-ahead bias）；现有评估缺少对模型金融知识随时间延伸范围的直接度量。

Method: 构建FinCutBench：当前含2023年1月至2026年9月的9,000道中英文四选一金融选择题，覆盖中美市场及四类金融信息；按事实公开的大致月份构建月度知识剖面，经下降检验和节点检查后，将拟合剖面进入低水平后的首个月定义为FinCut Boundary，并用重采样检验估计日期的稳定性；再将Transition Start与Boundary作为固定参照用于下游样本分组。

Result: 边界日期和定位精度因模型而异；以独立测量的Transition Start和Boundary分组后，部分模型在美国资产排名和盈利回忆任务上越过Boundary后出现明显相对下降；中国市场排名估计因模型而异，8组披露期配对预测误差比较的未校正p值均大于0.10。

Conclusion: FinCut Boundary为point-in-time金融评估中参数化知识的时间范围提供了经验参照，可用于评估窗口选择和结果解释，但边界估计及下游效应具有模型异质性，需谨慎外推。

Abstract: In financial backtesting and other point-in-time tasks, external inputs can be restricted by date, but model parameters may retain financial facts disclosed later, introducing parametric look-ahead bias. We introduce FinCutBench, a continually updated monthly financial knowledge benchmark for measuring how far a fixed model's financial knowledge extends over calendar time. The current dataset contains 9,000 Chinese and English four-option multiple-choice questions from January 2023 to September 2026, covering Chinese and U.S. markets and four categories of financial information. We construct monthly knowledge profiles using the approximate months in which the tested facts became public. After a profile passes the decline test and knot checks, we define the FinCut Boundary as the first month when the fitted profile reaches its lower level, and report the stability of the estimated date under resampling. Boundary dates and localization precision vary across models. Using the independently measured Transition Start and Boundary as fixed references for downstream sample grouping, we find clear relative declines after the Boundary in U.S. asset ranking and earnings recall for some models, while Chinese-market ranking estimates vary across models and all eight disclosure-period-paired forecast-error comparisons have unadjusted $p$ values above 0.10. The FinCut Boundary thus provides an empirical reference for the temporal scope of parametric knowledge in point-in-time financial evaluation, supporting evaluation-window selection and result interpretation.

</details>


### [664] [Weight-Space Programming of Policies and Their Verification via Model Checking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11604)
*Dennis Gross*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将大模型"直接写策略网络权重"与概率模型检验结合：在MDP环境与PCTL需求下，LLM写出全部权重，Storm精确计算满足概率并反馈迭代，18/18次运行在无数据与反馈前即达最优概率，且策略可泛化并经模型检验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过去的weight-space programming（LLM直接写出小型网络权重）能仅凭任务描述生成序贯决策策略，但没有任何机制保证所写策略的行为符合预期，缺乏可验证性。

Method: 把权重空间编程嵌入概率模型检验闭环：环境建模为马尔可夫决策过程，需求用PCTL表达；LLM写出策略网络全部权重，可选地在最优动作数据集上做修复，然后用模型检验器Storm计算（而非仿真估计）策略满足需求的概率，将反馈送回LLM迭代，直到需求成立或达到轮数上限。

Result: 两个LLM、三个环境下共18次运行，所得策略在未使用数据集或模型检验反馈之前就达到最优概率；为两个transporter任务编程的六个策略中有四个以概率1完成三个任务，泛化到LLM未见过的任务；该流程在六次运行中均构造出满足含PCTL until算子的复杂安全需求的策略；其中一次数据集修复把准确率提高到98.4%却破坏了需求，仅一轮模型检验反馈即恢复。

Conclusion: 模型检验提供的精确、可验证的反馈能把本质上无保证的"LLM写权重"转化为经过验证的策略合成流程，并支持对未见任务的泛化与复杂安全需求的满足。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can write the weights of small neural networks directly, without gradient descent. This weight-space programming creates policies for sequential decision-making from a task description alone, but nothing guarantees that a written policy behaves as intended. We combine weight-space programming with probabilistic model checking. Given an environment modeled as a Markov decision process and a requirement in probabilistic computation tree logic (PCTL), an LLM writes all weights of a policy network, optionally repairs them on a dataset of optimal actions, and receives model-checking feedback until the requirement holds or a round limit is reached. The model checker Storm computes, rather than estimates from simulations, the probability that the policy satisfies the requirement, so every returned policy is verified. With two LLMs on three environments, the created policy of each of the 18 runs attains the optimal probability, before any dataset or model-checking feedback. Four of six policies programmed for two transporter jobs also complete three jobs with probability 1, so they generalize to a task that the LLM never saw. The pipeline also programs a policy that satisfies a complex safety requirement expressed with the PCTL until operator in all six runs. In one of them, dataset repair raised the accuracy to 98.4\% but broke the requirement, and one round of model-checking feedback restored it.

</details>


### [665] [ODSA: Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11621)
*Macardle Meng,Haomin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ODSA框架：由一个编排LLM把已有测试时扩展方法当作动作（发现新解、比较并构建更好解、接受并验证答案），统一调度无状态worker执行，从而在单一上下文中动态分配推理算力，显著提升难基准准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法分两类：顺序式（对单一解多轮修订）和并行式（生成多个独立解再选择）。两类方法各有局限，且通常固定策略、缺乏统一调度，难以根据问题进展灵活切换与组合不同策略。

Method: ODSA（Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation）：将现有测试时扩展方法抽象为动作——发现新的独立解、比较已有解以构建更优解、接受候选答案并触发验证；由编排LLM在单一上下文内做决策并分配计算，把先前动作结果馈入后续动作，具体执行交给无状态worker；编排者自身不直接解题。

Result: 在Humanity's Last Exam上，相对无测试时扩展的单次直接调用，ODSA在三个模型上准确率提升4.7–18.0分；在单次直接调用已能解决多数问题的LiveCodeBench上，仍提升0.6–14.0分。

Conclusion: 将测试时扩展方法统一为可编排的动作集合，并由LLM在单一上下文中动态调度，是一种有效且通用的推理时算力分配范式，在困难基准与已较易基准上均带来稳定增益。

Abstract: Test-time scaling improves the accuracy of a language model's answers by spending more computation at inference time. Established methods do so either sequentially, revising a single solution over several passes, or in parallel, generating several independent solutions and selecting among them. We present ODSA (Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation), an LLM-directed scaling framework in which an orchestrator LLM is given existing test-time scaling methods as actions --- discovery of a new independent solution, comparison of existing solutions to build a better one, and acceptance of a proposed answer, which triggers its verification --- and directs stateless workers to carry them out. The orchestrator does not solve the problem itself: it allocates computation, feeds the results of earlier actions into later ones, and takes every action from a single context, so that each decision is informed by everything tried before. On Humanity's Last Exam, ODSA improves accuracy by 4.7 to 18.0 points across three models over a single direct call to the model with no test-time scaling. On LiveCodeBench, where a single direct call already solves most problems, it improves accuracy by 0.6 to 14.0 points.

</details>


### [666] [Perturbation Profiles of Scanpath Classifiers: What Reading, Code-Comprehension and Video Decoders Are Sensitive To](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11632)
*Saleh Mozaffari,Abolfazl Nadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出“扰动轮廓”方法，用五类保持特定不变量的变换逐一破坏扫描路径描述符的属性，并以重新拟合后参与者留出AUC的下降量衡量管线对该属性的敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扫描路径描述符能区分任务时，通常难以说明这种区分究竟依赖何种眼动属性；需要一种可解释、可检验的敏感性分析工具。

Method: 对试次级描述符施加五种变换，分别破坏注视顺序、持续时间—位置耦合、持续时间分布、朝向与左右手性、细粒度空间结构，同时保留其余列明不变量；每次变换后重新拟合分类器，以参与者留出AUC下降量作为管线敏感性指标；采用会重新拟合的参与者bootstrap给出区间，并通过模拟检验零效应下的区间覆盖与假阳性率。

Result: 在三个公开数据集的12个二分类问题上分析7个描述符：阅读（SB-SAT，95人）、程序理解（EMIP，最多159人）、视频与游戏观看（GazeBase，60人）。置换注视顺序可使基于平均眼跳幅度的描述符AUC提高最多0.23，因为置换后幅度变为空间散布度量；“理解”对比在合并两个程序时AUC达0.70，而仅在单一程序内降至0.47，轮廓将混杂定位到刺激布局；母语与非母语读者对比中，重复性对顺序和文本行尺度抖动敏感、对字符尺度不敏感，而持续时间加幅度描述符也达到0.65；基于代码token的图描述符在程序对比中表现最强（0.78，提升树0.87）。模拟中零目标区间排除零的合并率至多2.5%，2720个案例覆盖目标99.6%；更长运行和三个随机种子下解释结果保持，第二学习器下16项中15项保持。

Conclusion: 扰动轮廓能够揭示描述符分类性能所依赖的具体属性及其混杂来源，但衡量的是“重新拟合后的管线”而非已拟合分类器实际使用的信息；其结果需结合区间估计和稳健性检验解释。

Abstract: When a scanpath descriptor discriminates a task, it is rarely clear what the discrimination rests on. We propose a perturbation profile for trial-level descriptors. Five transformations each destroy one stated property while preserving a listed set of invariants: fixation order, duration-position coupling, the duration distribution, orientation and handedness, and fine spatial structure. The classifier is refit, and the drop in participant-held-out AUC is the pipeline's sensitivity to that property. Because refitting lets the learner use redundant information, this describes the refitted pipeline, not what a fitted classifier used. Intervals come from a participant bootstrap that refits; in simulations at the sample sizes analysed, where the target was zero they excluded zero at a pooled rate of at most 2.5%, and they covered the target in 99.6% of 2720 cases. We profiled seven descriptors on twelve binary problems from three public datasets: reading (SB-SAT, 95 participants), program comprehension (EMIP, up to 159) and video and game viewing (GazeBase, 60). Permuting fixation order raised the AUC of a descriptor built on mean saccade amplitude on three problems (by up to 0.23), because permutation turns amplitude into a measure of spatial spread. A "comprehension" contrast that pooled two programs reached AUC 0.70 with a spread-only baseline and fell to 0.47 within one program: the profile located the confound in stimulus layout. On native versus non-native readers, recurrence was sensitive to order and to jitter at the scale of text lines but not of characters, while a two-feature duration and amplitude descriptor reached the same AUC (0.65). A graph descriptor built on the code's tokens was the strongest non-baseline descriptor on the program contrast (0.78; 0.87 with boosted trees). The interpreted results held under longer runs and three seeds; under a second learner 15 of 16 kept t

</details>


### [667] [An Interpretable Fuzzy Tree for Turbofan Remaining Useful Life with an Auditable Per-Component Diagnostic Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11633)
*Hugo Henry,Bharadwaj Dogga,Scott Philips,Kelly Cohen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种可解释遗传模糊树，用巡航工况传感器均值预测涡扇发动机剩余寿命，并暴露可逐条检查的部件诊断规则；在N-CMAPSS上以333个自由参数取得多故障子集8.44、全模式11.51个循环的RMSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动剩余寿命估计虽然准确，但模型不透明，且其内部特征往往直接编码剩余寿命，而不是具体部件的健康状态，难以支撑按部件诊断与维护决策。

Method: 按发动机层级构建模糊树：传感器→部件健康→有界部件损伤→轴系损伤→剩余寿命，使各层对应不同维护问题。训练分阶段进行：健康叶节点拟合物理目标后冻结，对每个部件施加基于机队参考阈值的确定性模糊损伤映射，仅优化面向剩余寿命的聚合层。模型每周期仅使用13个巡航均值标量，不含序列模型；规则库结构支持形式化验证。

Result: 在N-CMAPSS原生划分上，多故障子集RMSE为8.44个循环，全模式为11.51个循环；模型仅333个自由参数、411条规则，比编译基线少32至12000倍。通过穷举传感器搜索，界定了在巡航均值设计下可诊断的部件范围。

Conclusion: 该工作在不牺牲较多预测精度的前提下，提供了可逐规则检查的部件诊断层，并明确了巡航均值输入设计的可诊断边界；但规则库的形式化验证尚未完成。

Abstract: Data-driven remaining useful life (RUL) estimators for turbofan engines are accurate but opaque, and their internal features typically encode remaining life rather than any specific component's state. This paper presents an interpretable genetic fuzzy tree that predicts RUL from cruise-condition sensor means on N-CMAPSS while exposing a per-component diagnostic layer inspectable rule by rule. The tree follows the engine hierarchy: sensors to component health, then to bounded component damage, spool damage, and RUL, so each level answers a different maintenance question. Training is staged so the prognostic objective cannot reshape the diagnostic layers: health leaves are fitted to physical targets and frozen, a deterministic fuzzy damage map with fleet-referenced thresholds is imposed on each component, and only the aggregation is optimized for RUL. It consumes 13 cruise-mean scalars per cycle rather than a trajectory, which removes any sequence model. On the native split it reaches 8.44 cycles RMSE on the multi-fault subset and 11.51 across all modes with 333 free parameters, 411 total rules, 32 to 12,000 times fewer than compiled baselines. An exhaustive sensor search bounds which components are diagnosable under the tested cruise-mean design, and the rule base is structured to admit formal verification, which this study does not discharge.

</details>


### [668] [Optimizing Multi-Tier Intermediation in Programmatic Advertising: A DAG-Based Mechanism for Supply Path Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11651)
*Amelia Bădică,Costin Bădică*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文将可追溯的程序化广告供应链建模为DAG中介网络，引入多属性效用与MILP处理可替代路径和比例费用，并计划用公开schain与sellers.json数据比较最优Nash社会福利与当前无序市场结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 程序化广告供应链多跳且不透明，中间环节造成显著效率损失（“ad-tech tax”）。现有Supply Path Optimization多为启发式裁剪低效路径，难以优化整个网络的均衡。

Method: 扩展有向无环图（DAG）中介模型，将其应用于由OpenRTB SupplyChain对象映射的可追溯供应链；构造多属性效用函数，并采用混合整数线性规划（MILP）刻画可替代路由（OR节点）与按比例收取的费用结构；同时给出计算方法和实验框架。

Result: 摘要未报告实证结果，主要提出实验设计：使用公开schain和sellers.json数据，以最优Nash社会福利为基准，对比当前未协调市场结果。

Conclusion: 该研究为程序化广告供应链提供可计算的整体优化框架，有望量化中间环节效率损失，并为供应链路径优化与市场协调提供基准。

Abstract: Digital programmatic advertising operates through complex, multi-hop supply chains. The opacity of these intermediary networks leads to significant efficiency losses, often referred to as the ``ad-tech tax.'' While current industry practices utilize heuristic Supply Path Optimization (SPO) to trim inefficient routes, they fail to optimize the equilibrium of the entire network. This paper extends previous work on Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) intermediation models by applying them to traceable programmatic supply chains mapped via the OpenRTB SupplyChain object. We introduce multi-attribute utility functions and Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) to account for substitutable routing (OR nodes) and percentage-based fee structures. Furthermore, we outline a computational methodology and experimental framework using public \texttt{schain} and \texttt{sellers.json} data to benchmark optimal Nash social welfare against current uncoordinated market outcomes.

</details>


### [669] [Inside the Trading Loop: Markets, Models, and Moves with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11657)
*Renee Jia,Di Mu,Yao Yu,Tianrui Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文构建了一个由LLM分析师、动量组合构建与规则化执行组成的混合多智能体交易系统，并用券商真实记录的模拟盘账户与回溯重放评估其表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM交易系统多停留在事后回测或合成数据上，缺乏与真实券商记录账户挂钩的、可复现的端到端评估；同时，LLM分析师输出与确定性动量/规则执行之间如何衔接（现金权限、调用时机、报告格式）缺少系统比较。

Method: 提出混合多智能体交易框架：公司新闻智能体与宏观智能体向协调器返回结构化报告，协调器据此设定个股权重与现金储备，再由基于动量的组合构建与规则化执行层落地交易。评估分两条线：一是以券商记录的模拟盘账户（带确定性回退机制）衡量组合引擎实盘化表现；二是通过回溯重放（retrospective replays）对比不同LLM启用配置，并设计对照实验考察现金决策权限、选择性调用、响应契约（报告格式长度）以及同日/延迟至下一交易时段使用评估结果的影响。

Result: 2026年3月11日至8月28日期间，该账户收益34.5%，同期SPY为14.4%，但原始收益优势伴随更大的最大回撤；重建策略在同日或延迟至下一时段使用评估时均高于匹配的SPY与QQQ基准。恒定现金对照组给出与立场式仓位分配接近的收益估计；更短的报告契约提升了实际解析成功率，但可能改变推荐结论。

Conclusion: LLM分析师与动量组合/规则执行的混合架构在样本期内取得了显著超出基准的收益，但收益提升与回撤扩大并存，风险调整后的价值仍需审慎评估；系统表现对现金权限设置、智能体调用策略与报告契约形式较为敏感，说明工程层面的接口设计是影响此类系统结果的关键变量。

Abstract: We built a hybrid multi-agent trading system that combines large language model (LLM) analysts with momentum-based portfolio construction and rule-based execution. Company-news and macroeconomic agents return structured reports to a coordinator that sets stock weights and cash reserves. We evaluate the portfolio engine using its broker-recorded paper account, which operated with deterministic fallbacks, and compare LLM-enabled configurations through retrospective replays. From March 11 to August 28, 2026, the account returned 34.5%, compared with 14.4% for the S&P 500 fund SPY over the same dates. This raw return advantage came with a larger maximum drawdown. Reconstructed policies also finish above matched SPY and QQQ references when assessments are used in the same session or deferred to the next. Design comparisons examine cash authority, selective invocation, and response contracts. A constant-cash control gives a return estimate close to stance-based sizing, and shorter report contracts improve observed parsing but can change recommendations.

</details>


### [670] [Self-Indexing Latent Memories for Access-Aware Continual Instruction Tuning of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11684)
*Dhruv Dixit,Paritosh Pandey,Snehalkumar 'Neil' S. Gaikwad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 TILA-CT：无回放的持续指令微调方法，用任务隔离的潜在记忆与适配器库，使每个任务模块可自索引，仅凭提示即可路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续指令微调依赖任务私有模块保留旧技能，但推理时仍需仅从提示判断该用哪个模块，模块选择成为额外负担且易出错。

Method: 在冻结大模型中为每个任务配置潜在记忆和适配器库；适配时记忆聚合因果前缀信息并注入任务条件上下文；其持久状态作为路由原型，供共享的纯提示路由器使用，实现无回放持续训练。

Result: 8 任务 CT-Pipeline 上获得 65.19 获取分与 63.98 最终宏分，平均遗忘 1.38；中段逆序为 65.38/64.17；6 个骨干上最终分与获取分差距均在 1.5 分内；消融支持记忆派生路由键与因果聚合；最终宏路由准确率 93.9%，oracle 路由仅再提升 1.21 分。

Conclusion: 结果将“任务计算的保留”与“对任务计算的学习式访问”区分开来，表明自索引任务模块可有效缓解持续指令微调中的路由问题。

Abstract: Continual instruction tuning often preserves old skills with task-private modules. Inference still requires selecting the right module from the prompt alone. We introduce Task-Isolated Latent Adapter Continual Training (TILA-CT), a replay-free method that makes each task module self-indexing. Each task receives a latent memory and adapter bank in a frozen LLM. During adaptation, the memory gathers causal-prefix information and injects task-conditioned context. For access, its persistent state provides the routing prototype used by a shared prompt-only router. On the 8-task CT-Pipeline stream, TILA-CT achieves 65.19 acquisition and 63.98 final macro score, with 1.38 points of average forgetting. A middle-reversed order gives 65.38 acquisition and 64.17 final macro score. Across 6 backbones, final scores remain within 1.5 points of acquisition. Ablations support memory-derived routing keys and causal gathering. Final macro routing accuracy is 93.9\%, and oracle routing recovers 1.21 final macro points. These results separate preserved task computation from learned access to it.

</details>


### [671] [CASCoDe: A Closed-Loop Agentic Framework for Analog Sizing and Layout Co-Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11710)
*Ziming Wei,Bingyang Liu,David Z. Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CASCoDe 是一个闭环 LLM 智能体框架，将模拟版图设计中的专家决策形式化为分层离散动作空间（尺寸选择、结构化布局规划、局部版图细化、布线尝试选择），并以反馈驱动的树搜索从电路网表一路搜索到经 DRC/LVS 与提取-RC 仿真验证的 GDS；在 20 个 SKY130 放大器上面积较传统 P&R 流程降低 59–85%（均值 71%），器件密度由 0.39 提升至 0.74。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专家手工版图与自动生成版图的差别不仅在"合法与否"，更在密度与规整性。专家做的是一连串分层的、离散的物理决策，并在拿到提取后的电学结果后反复回访、修正这些决策；而现有大多数自动化流程在控制器启动之前就已把物理搜索空间固定死，无法在物理实现与电学结果之间闭环迭代。

Method: 提出 CASCoDe 闭环 LLM 智能体框架：(1) 把专家决策抽象为分层离散动作空间——尺寸选择、结构化布局规划（floorplan）、局部版图细化、布线尝试选择； (2) 智能体在由网表到验证版图的路径上执行反馈驱动的树搜索，并自行编写电路专用的布局规划与脚本； (3) 设计执行层，通过面向适配后工具的接口适配，保证每个抽象动作都真实落到物理实现，并由 DRC、LVS 和提取-RC 仿真给出评判反馈。

Result: 在覆盖单级、两级、三级拓扑的 20 个 SKY130 放大器上：CASCoDe 是唯一在全部电路上都同时满足设计规格并给出 DRC、LVS 干净的布线版图的流程；相比使用相同 PCell 的传统 P&R 流程，面积降低 59–85%（平均 71%）；相比 APPlace、MAGICAL、ALIGN 与 ICPI，平均器件密度由 0.39 提升到 0.74；平均仅用约 11 分钟智能体时间即可产出在面积和合法性上全面超越各基线的版图；消融实验表明，结构化动作空间与反馈引导的树搜索各自都能同时降低面积与搜索开销。

Conclusion: 模拟版图自动化的关键不只是把版图画"对"，而是复现专家那种分层离散决策＋电学反馈闭环的搜索过程。CASCoDe 证明：把这种过程形式化为结构化动作空间并交给 LLM 智能体做反馈驱动树搜索、且用真实工具链（DRC/LVS/提取仿真）做落地校验，可以在合法性与密度、面积等质量指标上同时显著优于既有自动化流程与人类式启发方法。

Abstract: Expert analog layouts differ from auto-generated ones in density and regularity, not only in legality: experts make a succession of discrete, hierarchical physical decisions and revisit each after extracted electrical results, while most existing automated flows act on a physical search space fixed before the controller runs. We present CASCoDe, a closed-loop LLM agent framework for analog netlist-to-layout design that formalizes those expert decisions as a hierarchical discrete action space-sizing selection, structural floorplan, local layout refinement, routing-attempt selection-on which the agent runs feedback-driven tree search from a circuit netlist to a verified GDS. The agent authors the circuit-specific floorplans and scripts, and an execution layer of interface adaptations over adapted tools make every action land at physical implementation and be judged by DRC, LVS, and extracted-RC simulation. On 20 SKY130 amplifiers spanning single-, two-, and three-stage topologies, CASCoDe is the only flow that delivers a DRC- and LVS-clean routed layout when meeting design specifications for every circuit. It reduces area by 59-85% (mean 71%) against a conventional P&R flow on identical PCells, raises mean device density from 0.39 to 0.74 against APPlace, MAGICAL, ALIGN and ICPI. A layout that beats every baseline in area and legality appears after 11 minutes of agent time on average, and ablations show that the structured action space and the feedback-guided tree search each reduce area and search cost.

</details>


### [672] [The Value of Not Knowing: How Fresh Eyes through Naive LLMs Fuel Creativity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11725)
*David B. D'Ambrosio,Alon Albalak,Joel Lehman,Kenneth O. Stanley*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"朴素大模型"（naive LLMs）：通过训练数据剥夺或定向遗忘，让模型对特定主题保持"无知"，从而摆脱领域内主流范式与既有偏见的束缚，产生更具新颖性的种子想法；再交由更强的"导师模型"将这些想法精炼为具体方案。在1B与7B模型上，朴素模型的种子想法在novelty与usefulness上一致优于基线，导师精炼可进一步提升，说明在追求"跳出框架"的解决方案时，"信息更少反而更强"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重大科学突破常源于新视角，而具备互联网级知识的大模型却趋于产出主流观点和领域内既有偏见，难以稳定产生真正新颖的视角。作者希望检验"外行视角/新鲜眼光"能否提升模型创造力，即是否有意削弱模型在某一主题上的知识反而有益。

Method: 提出naive LLM：通过两种手段使模型对特定主题"刻意无知"——训练阶段的主题数据剥夺（deprivation）与训练后的定向遗忘（intentional forgetting）。被"卸下教条包袱"的朴素模型自由做新联想与猜想，生成种子想法；再与更强的mentor模型配对，由导师将独特视角精炼为具体提案。实验在1B与7B规模模型上进行，对比朴素模型与基线模型的想法质量。

Result: 在1B和7B模型上，朴素模型生成的种子想法在新颖性（novelty）与有用性（usefulness）上稳定优于基线对应模型；经mentor模型精炼后，想法质量进一步提升。结果在多个设置下表现一致。

Conclusion: 与"扩大训练数据规模"的主流思路相反，论文给出了"信息更少反而更强"的实例：当目标是发现真正跳出框架的解决方案时，刻意造成主题无知可作为提升LLM创造性的有效手段；"朴素模型 + 导师精炼"构成一种可复用的创意生成范式。

Abstract: Many major scientific advances come from approaching a problem with a new or novel perspective. While large language models (LLMs) with internet-scale knowledge seem poised to take such perspectives, their consistent generation remains elusive. Instead, models are drawn to dominant views and preexisting, in-field bias. To explore the potential of fresh eyes to increase creativity, this paper proposes naive LLMs, models that are made intentionally ignorant of a specific topic. Through deprivation in training or intentional forgetting, naive models are unburdened by existing dogma, allowing them to be free to make new associations and conjectures. These naive models can then be paired with a stronger mentor model that can refine their unique perspectives into concrete proposals. For the 1B and 7B models tested in this paper, naive models consistently produce seed ideas that are more novel and useful than baseline counterparts, and mentor refinement improves the ideas even further. Thus, contrary to the prevailing tradition of scaling up training data, we demonstrate a case where less information is actually more powerful, in particular when the aim is to discover genuinely outside-the-box solutions.

</details>


### [673] [State Media at Retrieval Time: A Large-Scale Audit of Russian State-Aligned Sources in AI Chatbot Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11727)
*Laura Kurek,Elijah Covert,Rafael I Bonilla,Eric Gilbert,Ceren Budak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该摘要审计11个AI聊天机器人对Pravda Network内容的检索与呈现情况，发现总体检索率低但平台差异极大，且存在“标题洗白”策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Pravda Network自2023年以来发布大量重复内容，学界担心其被用于影响AI系统；因此需要系统评估AI聊天机器人是否会检索、如何呈现以及是否加注警示。

Method: 从Pravda Network抽样标题构建10,000条提示语料，围绕标题改写和用户怀疑程度两个维度变化；通过网页界面查询11个AI聊天机器人，获得104,997条完整回答并进行大规模审计。

Result: Pravda Network内容被检索的比例总体较低（7.3%），但高度依赖平台：You.com、Claude和Copilot贡献了94%的检索。ChatGPT、Gemini和Meta AI未检索到Pravda Network文章，可能反映域名级过滤策略；但所有11个机器人都不同程度检索到其他俄罗斯国家关联媒体（中位数13.56%）。当Pravda Network文章出现时，警示率平台间差异大（5.3%至76.2%），You.com最少。另发现9.92%的样本标题将报道归因于其他更可信媒体，而文章本身转载自俄罗斯国家关联媒体，即“标题洗白”。

Conclusion: 该审计系统分析了AI聊天机器人对俄罗斯最新信息环境操纵尝试的易感性，揭示了平台差异、过滤策略与“标题洗白”风险。

Abstract: The Pravda Network is a Russian state-aligned media aggregator, with over 110 websites and more than 15 million articles published since 2023. Given its prolific and repetitive output, emerging scholarship argues that the Pravda Network was built to influence AI systems. We conduct a large-scale audit of leading AI chatbots to understand: (1) the retrieval rates of Pravda Network articles, (2) the conditions of retrieval, and (3) whether chatbot responses affirm or caveat this content. We build a 10,000 prompt corpus from sampled Pravda Network headlines varied along two dimensions (headline rewording and user skepticism) and query 11 AI chatbots via the web interface (n=104,997 completed responses). Overall, we find susceptibility to Pravda Network retrieval to be infrequent---appearing in 7.3% of responses---and highly platform dependent---with three chatbots responsible for 94% of retrievals (You.com, Claude, and Copilot). Among the frontier models, Claude is an outlier: ChatGPT, Gemini, and Meta AI retrieved no Pravda Network articles, likely indicative of a domain-level filtering policy. All 11 chatbots, however, retrieved other Russian state-aligned media to some degree (median=13.56% of responses). When Pravda Network articles are surfaced, caveat rates vary widely by platform (from 5.3% to 76.2%), with You.com providing the fewest caveats. We also identify the tactic of headline washing: where 9.92% of sampled Pravda Network headlines attribute their reporting to other, often more credible, media outlets, while the articles themselves are republished from Russian state-aligned media. We discuss headline washing's potential to launder state media as independent reporting. With this audit, we provide a systematic analysis of AI chatbots' susceptibility to Russia's latest attempt to manipulate the information environment.

</details>


### [674] [Can the Remaining Answers Change the Prediction? Worst-Case Stability Checks for Personalized Rating Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11733)
*Priyanka Siddappa,Muntaqim Ahmed Raju,Shifat Haider Al Amin,Ruizhe Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对缺失评分可能推翻个性化模型预测的问题，提出在加性响应评分模型上做精确最坏情况界审计，并用Fisher自适应更新观测评分；回顾性实验显示其降低对数损失并给出目标认证覆盖率，但证书仅保证与完整模型一致，临床效用未验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化模型依赖用户评分，但缺失评分可能改变甚至推翻当前预测；需要在不改变当前预测器的前提下，审计所有可能缺失赋值带来的最坏影响，并评估基于已观测评分的自适应更新是否可靠。

Method: 对具有加性响应评分的已完成模型，计算覆盖所有缺失赋值情形的精确最坏情况界；采用基于观测评分的Fisher自适应，与响应频率基线及仿射部分更新比较。在两个自我分诊队列中回顾性评估：108名临床医生评分3段模拟精神科访谈，以及126个咨询演示由10名专家标注；使用共享随机半历史，咨询测试排除目标专家和源视频。

Result: 共享随机半历史下，Fisher自适应相对响应频率降低对数损失：临床医生审计0.1071 nats（95% CI [0.0867,0.1261]），咨询0.0223（95% CI [0.0121,0.0321]）。认证覆盖率分别为5.4%和10.5%；相同预算下固定宽度采集将覆盖率提高到13.7%和28.6%。在权重与响应固定时，观测评分更新较仿射部分更新损失更低，且认证的目标完全相同。

Conclusion: 该证书证明与完整模型的预测一致，而非正确性或中间更新稳定性；这些评分任务用于检验方法本身，临床实用性仍待验证。

Abstract: Missing ratings can overturn a personalized model's current prediction. For completed models with additive response scores, exact worst case bounds check all missing assignments without changing the current predictor. We evaluate this audit retrospectively in two self-triage cohorts, 108 clinicians rating three simulated psychiatric interviews, and 126 counseling demonstrations annotated by ten experts. Under shared random half histories, Fisher adaptation based on observed ratings reduces log loss relative to response frequency by 0.1071 nats in the clinician audit (95% CI [0.0867,0.1261]) and 0.0223 in counseling (95% CI[0.0121,0.0321]). The counseling test excludes target experts and source videos from training. Certification covers 5.4% and 10.5% of targets; fixed width acquisition raises coverage to 13.7% and 28.6% at the same budgets. With weights and responses held fixed, the observed-rating update also has lower loss than an affine partial update while certifying exactly the same evaluated targets. The certificate establishes agreement with the completed model, not correctness or stability at intermediate updates. These rating tasks test the method; clinical usefulness remains untested.

</details>


### [675] [A Bifurcation-Theoretic Framework for the Controllability of Emergent Intelligent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11734)
*Hao Li,Shaowen Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出"涌现"(适应性)与"可控性"(可问责部署所需)由同一对象上的两个不同分岔支配，因此能力提升并不蕴含可控性提升。涌现是能力变量 S 的分岔(判据 Γ=ℱ'(0)>1)，可控性是许可变量 c 的分岔(含侵蚀项、具滞回的马鞍-结点折叠，判据 ρ*>1)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实智能系统须同时满足两种需求：涌现带来的适应性，以及可问责部署所要求的可操控性。核心问题是澄清二者关系——能力增强是否必然带来可控性增强。

Method: 将两者刻画为同一对象上的两个独立分岔。涌现为能力变量 S 的分岔，判据 Γ:=ℱ'(0)>1，等价于自洽方程存在唯一正稳定不动点，且仅由 ℱ 的凹性推出。可控性为许可变量 c 的分岔，其动力学含侵蚀项，在门控判据 ρ* 越过 1 时出现带滞回的马鞍-结点折叠。得三项定量结论：临界指数区分的是族而非对相变分类；门控代价界 K(M)∝log(1+M) 随尺度而非能力增长；折叠阈值 γ_c≈4μκ。并在两方向校准：复现二维 Ising 相变、承认两个真反馈序参量、拒绝九个候选量。

Result: 判据同时复现二维 Ising 转变并筛除九个候选量，表明序参量是几何性的而非能力相关的。许可无法被内生化；且尚无可部署系统被测量到同时满足 Γ>1 与 ρ*>1。

Conclusion: 能力提升并不蕴含可控性提升：涌现与可控性由不同分岔支配，序参量属几何性质，许可不可内生化，故不能以能力增长推断系统可问责。

Abstract: Real-world intelligent systems must reconcile two demands: the adaptability conferred by emergence and the steerability required for accountable deployment. We show that these demands are governed by two distinct bifurcations on the same object and that, consequently, increased capability does not imply increased controllability. Emergence is a bifurcation of the capability variable $S$, with criterion $Γ:=\mathcal F'(0)>1$ equivalent to the existence of a unique positive stable fixed point of a self-consistency equation, following solely from the concavity of $\mathcal F$. Controllability is a bifurcation of the permission variable $c$, whose dynamics include an erosion term and exhibit a saddle-node fold with hysteresis as the gate criterion $ρ^\ast$ crosses unity. Three quantitative results follow: the critical exponent distinguishes families rather than classifying the transition; the gating-cost bound $K(M)\propto\log(1+M)$ grows with scope, not capability; and the fold threshold is $γ_c\approx4μκ$. Calibrated in both directions, the criteria reproduce the two-dimensional Ising transition, admit two true-feedback order parameters, and reject nine candidate quantities, supporting the conclusion that the order parameter is geometric rather than capability-related. Since permission cannot be endogenized and no deployed system has been measured to satisfy $Γ>1$ and $ρ^\ast>1$ simultaneously, increased capability does not imply controllability.

</details>


### [676] [Creative Priming: Decoupling Process from Product to Escape the Creative Paradox](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11740)
*Alon Albalak,Sebastian Gabriel,David B. D'Ambrosio,Joel Lehman,Kenneth O. Stanley*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将创造力建模为一个显式过程，而非具体产物的属性，并用"创造性引导"（Creative Priming, CP）把创造过程与回答生成解耦：训练一个引导模型生成针对提示的"引子"（primer），帮助回答模型产出新颖、高质量、多样的回答，从而绕开"创造性悖论"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 承诺的重大进展（治愈疾病、发明新技术、提出新科学理论）本质上都是创造性行为，但创造力极难学习，因为它面临"创造性悖论"：学习重复过去的创造性成功案例，会让这些具体案例更可能被复现，反而抑制了所期望的创造力。作者借此论证：应当把创造力看作一个显式的过程，而非个别产物的属性，并去学习创造过程背后的生成性原则。

Method: 提出创造性引导（Creative Priming, CP）：由一个训练好的引导模型针对给定提示生成"引子"，再由回答模型在该引子辅助下生成回答，从而显式地将创造过程与回答生成解耦；引导模型通过 GRPO 训练，奖励那些能引致新颖、高质量且多样回答的引子，即强化"产生创造性回答的过程"，而不是强化任何具体回答。

Result: 摘要为方法性论述，未给出具体实验数据与量化结果；其预期/主张的效果是：通过奖励引子而非回答，能够在提升回答新颖性、质量与多样性的同时避免对特定范例的复现强化，从而缓解创造性悖论。

Conclusion: 创造力应被建模为显式过程而非产物的属性；CP 通过"引导模型 + 回答模型"的解耦设计与基于 GRPO 的过程级奖励，为学习创造过程背后的生成性原则提供了一种可行范式。

Abstract: Many of the most consequential advances promised by AI, from curing diseases and inventing new technologies to formulating new scientific theories, are fundamentally creative acts. Yet creativity is uniquely difficult to learn because it faces a creative paradox: learning to repeat past examples of creative success makes those specific examples more likely to recur, inhibiting the very creativity desired. This work argues that creativity is better modeled as an explicit process rather than as a property of individual artifacts, and proposes to learn the underlying generative principles behind the creative process. In particular, to escape the paradox, we introduce creative priming (CP), wherein a trained priming model generates a prompt-specific primer that assists a response model in being creative, explicitly decoupling the creative process from response generation. The priming model learns through GRPO, rewarding primers that lead to responses that are novel, high-quality, and diverse, thereby reinforcing the process that yields creative responses without reinforcing any specific response.

</details>


### [677] [Reproducible quantum clustering for single-cell transcriptome atlases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11745)
*Henry Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KQE-2 是一个免训练、无纠缠的混合量子-经典框架，用于实现可复现的全转录组单细胞聚类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单细胞聚类流程普遍丢弃大部分基因，且结果对随机种子敏感，导致聚类不稳定、生物学解读不一致；同时大数据规模（百万级核）下的可扩展性与可复现性难以兼顾。

Method: 提出 KQE-2：免训练的混合量子-经典框架。将细胞映射为无纠缠量子态，从而可在经典硬件上精确评估特征，并可在量子处理器上直接验证。理论上证明"去除纠缠"是对单比特特征方差进行局部约束的充要条件；实验上与 scVI 重训练对比，并在高变基因与标准下游聚类设置下评估，规模测试至 1140 万核。

Result: 重训练 scVI 会使 14% 细胞发生漂移，并改变稀有类型标记与药物靶点；KQE-2 在多次运行中给出完全一致的生物学结果。仅量子编码一项即把发育皮层准确率从 0.61 提升到 0.79。单服务器可扩展至 1140 万核，在 10 个完整图谱中有 8 个优于对比方法（另 2 个落在最优方法的运行波动范围内），即使在标准下游聚类下仍有 6 个领先。

Conclusion: 无纠缠量子编码既能带来可证明的方差约束，又能实现可复现且高精度的全转录组聚类，并具备百万级规模的可扩展性，具备替代丢基因式流程的潜力。

Abstract: Current single-cell clustering pipelines discard most genes and can yield inconsistent clusters across random seeds. We introduce KQE-2, a training-free hybrid quantum-classical framework for reproducible whole-transcriptome clustering. KQE-2 maps cells into entanglement-free quantum states, enabling exact feature evaluation on classical hardware and direct checks on a quantum processor. Theoretically, we prove that removing entanglement is necessary and sufficient to bound single-qubit feature variance locally. Practically, while retraining scVI shifted 14% of cells and altered rare-type markers and drug targets, KQE-2 delivered identical biology across runs. On standard highly variable genes, the quantum encoding alone raised accuracy on a developing cortex from 0.61 to 0.79. KQE-2 scales to 11.4 million nuclei on one server, outperforming the compared methods on eight of ten complete atlases (and within the best method's run-to-run range on two), and leads on six even under standard downstream clustering.

</details>


### [678] [ARMOR: Adaptive Curriculum Meta-Learning for Noise-Robust RAG Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11771)
*Yan Wang,Yuxin Zhang,Shenyu Zhang,Yongrui Chen,Sheng Bi,Guilin Qi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ARMOR提出一种自适应课程元学习框架，将RAG噪声鲁棒性分解为知识边界感知、检索验证与鲁棒推理三个子任务，用"教师-学生"式的自适应任务调度器按学习进度安排训练，并采用组间优势估计缓解模式坍塌，在三个多跳推理数据集上显著提升噪声鲁棒性与输出质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统虽能缓解幻觉，但检索过程不可避免地引入噪声，威胁鲁棒性。作者认为噪声鲁棒性本质上是一种复合能力，包含噪声识别、检索过滤与鲁棒推理三个环节；而现有方法往往只做单维度增强，或受噪声导致的优化干扰影响，无法覆盖这一整体性，因此需要一种能协同训练多项子能力的框架。

Method: 将RAG鲁棒性显式分解为知识边界感知、检索验证、鲁棒推理三个子任务；提出ARMOR（Adaptive Curriculum Meta-Learning for Noise Robust RAG Reasoning），借鉴教学过程中"教师—学生"机制，以自适应任务调度器作为教师，依据RAG生成器（学生）的绝对学习进度（absolute learning progress）策划训练计划；与GRPO不同，ARMOR在学习中使用组间优势估计（inter-group advantage estimation），以缓解输出空间受限造成的模式坍塌。

Result: 在2WikiMultiHopQA、MusiQue、HotPotQA三个复杂推理数据集上，ARMOR在检索噪声鲁棒性方面取得协同提升，输出质量显著优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 把RAG噪声鲁棒性拆解为可训练的子能力并结合课程式元学习调度，是提升RAG抗噪性的有效路径；自适应课程安排与组间优势估计能缓解噪声干扰和模式坍塌，带来多方面的协同增益。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems have demonstrated remarkable effectiveness in mitigating hallucinations by incorporating external knowledge. However, the retrieval process inevitably introduces noise, posing significant challenges to RAG robustness. Fundamentally, noise robustness is a composite competency encompassing noise identification, retrieval filtering, and robust reasoning. Unfortunately, existing methods often fail to capture this holistic nature, typically restricted to single-dimensional enhancements or hampered by noise-induced optimization interference. To address these limitations, we decompose RAG robustness into three sub-tasks: knowledge boundary perception, retrieval verification, and robust reasoning. Accordingly, we propose ARMOR, an Adaptive Curriculum Meta-Learning for Noise Robust RAG Reasoning. Inspired by the teaching process, ARMOR introduces an adaptive task scheduler as a teacher to curate training plans according to the absolute learning progress of RAG generators (Student). Distinct from GRPO, ARMOR utilizes inter-group advantage estimation during learning to effectively mitigate mode collapse caused by limited output spaces. Experiments on three complex reasoning datasets (2WikiMultiHopQA, MusiQue, and HotPotQA) indicate that ARMOR achieves synergistic improvements in retrieval noise robustness, significantly outperforming baselines in output quality.

</details>


### [679] [Wireless AI Networks: Co-Adapting Communication Resources and Distributed Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11774)
*Ziqiang Ye,Yue Xiao,Qiyan Zhan,Yulan Gao,Xianfu Lei,Vladimir Poulkov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出“无线AI网络”统一设计视角，以AI可执行资源预算刻画候选配置、以任务级信息价值指导选择与资源分配，实现无线通信与分布式智能的双向适配，并用两个实验验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式AI日益依赖无线网络，通信与计算资源影响AI任务的配置和执行；但资源可用性本身不足以决定支持效果，因为在相同资源约束下，不同信息选择与传输策略会导致不同的AI性能。因此需要协调资源可行性与任务级信息价值。

Method: 提出Wireless AI Networks统一视角：用AI可执行资源预算刻画候选AI配置，用任务级信息价值指导配置选择与无线资源分配；构建无线-AI协同适配框架，统筹资源抽象、联合配置与分配、执行反馈。实验包括：联邦学习中的更新选择与统计校正；敏感度感知的功率分配。

Result: 在相同模型更新载荷预算下，更新选择与统计校正可提升联邦学习效果；在相同平均发射功率约束下，敏感度感知功率分配可降低模型精度退化。

Conclusion: 分布式AI执行需要同时考虑资源可行性与任务级信息价值；无线通信与分布式智能的双向适配有助于在资源约束下更有效地配置和执行AI任务。

Abstract: Distributed artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly relies on wireless networks, where communication and computing resources shape how AI tasks are configured and executed. However, resource availability alone does not determine how effectively these tasks can be supported, since different information selections and transmission strategies may yield different AI performance under the same resource constraints. To address this challenge, this article presents Wireless AI Networks as a unified design perspective for bidirectional adaptation between wireless communication and distributed intelligence. Specifically, an AI-executable resource budget characterizes candidate AI configurations, while task-level information value guides their selection and wireless resource allocation. Building on these principles, a wireless-AI co-adaptation framework coordinates resource abstraction, joint configuration and allocation, and execution feedback. Two complementary experiments illustrate this perspective: update selection and statistical correction improve federated learning under identical model-update payload budgets, while sensitivity-aware power allocation reduces model accuracy degradation under the same average transmit-power constraint. Together, these results highlight the importance of coordinating resource feasibility and task-level information value in distributed AI execution.

</details>


### [680] [CABrain: A Correlation-Aware Brain Foundation Model for EEG Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11782)
*SuGil Choi,Mooseop Kim,Chi Yoon Jeong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对EEG基础模型的随机掩码与位置编码缺陷，提出基于图卷积网络的条件位置编码与自适应掩码策略，在十个基准数据集上取得SOTA或竞争性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型多采用"掩码块重建"的预训练方式，但纯随机掩码会使来自高度相关通道的信息性块很少被掩蔽，导致网络低估弱相关通道或序列依赖；同时，基于Transformer的模型性能受位置编码选择影响，而现有位置编码多源自NLP与CV，尚未充分适配EEG信号特性。

Method: 提出基于图卷积网络（GCN）的条件位置编码方法，显式建模通道间相关性；同时引入自适应掩码策略，通过调节掩码块重建难度来增强表征学习。据作者所述，这是首次将图表示融入条件位置编码并在EEG基础模型预训练中引入自适应掩码。

Result: 在十个基准数据集上的实验表明，所提GCN位置编码与自适应掩码策略无论单独使用还是组合使用，均达到SOTA或竞争性性能。

Conclusion: GCN条件位置编码与自适应掩码策略可有效提升EEG基础模型的表征学习能力，验证了二者在EEG基础建模中的有效性，为EEG自监督预训练提供了新思路。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models have emerged as promising paradigms for decoding brain activity through large-scale self-supervised pretraining. Notably, most existing approaches employ masked patch reconstruction, in which randomly selected EEG patches are masked and recovered by the network. However, purely random masking may limit representation learning as informative patches from highly correlated channels often remain unmasked, causing the network to underutilize weakly correlated channels or serial dependencies. Furthermore, because these models are typically based on transformer architectures, their performance is influenced by the choice of positional encoding. Although positional encoding has been extensively explored in natural language processing and computer vision, few studies have adapted it to the unique characteristics of EEG signals. To address these limitations, this study introduces a conditional positional encoding method based on graph convolutional networks (GCNs) to explicitly model inter-channel correlations, along with an adaptive masking strategy that enhances representation learning by modulating the difficulty of masked patch reconstruction. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to integrate graph-based representations into conditional positional encoding and introduce adaptive masking within EEG foundation model pretraining. Experimental results on ten benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed GCN-based positional encoding and adaptive masking strategies, both individually and in combination, achieve state-of-the-art or competitive performance, highlighting their effectiveness in EEG foundation modeling.

</details>


### [681] [When Should AI Overturn a Human Decision? Controversy at the 2026 World Cup and a $\sqrt{2/π}$ Solution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11819)
*Amir Ali Ahmadi,Parsa Alavi,Radeen Alavi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文研究如何将人类二元判罚（裁判的越位/不越位判定）与AI数值测量（VAR的越位幅度估计）结合，推导出显式的最大似然反转阈值规则，用于判定何时维持裁判判罚、何时被VAR推翻。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 足球中裁判的主观二元判罚与VAR的数值测量经常冲突，实践中缺乏一个明确、可解释的准则来决定"何时应当改判"。作者希望给出一个基于概率模型的严格阈值规则，并借此作为面向本科生和高中生的教学案例，展示AI应用中的研究问题。

Method: 把真实越位幅度视为固定未知参数，假设人类感知误差与AI测量误差为相互独立的加性高斯噪声；在零均值、已知标准差σ_H与σ_AI的条件下推导最大似然判据，得到反转阈值√(2/π)·σ_AI²/σ_H；并进一步推广到存在系统偏差的情形，证明最大似然估计的存在性与唯一性，说明最终二元决策只需阈值比较而无需数值求解，同时用数值算例演示并从校准数据估计误差参数。

Result: 得到显式阈值规则：只有当VAR测得的越位幅度超过阈值时才应推翻"不越位"判罚，而非仅仅因为VAR显示球员越过越位线；证明最大似然估计存在且唯一，最终判决可退化为一次阈值比较；给出含系统偏差的推广形式、数值示例及误差参数的校准估计方法。

Conclusion: 人类判罚与AI测量应按最大似然原则融合，用阈值而非"是否越线"来决定改判；该框架可推广到其他"人类二元判断+AI数值测量"的分类场景，且其数学门槛适合作为概率与微积分基础的教学研究素材。

Abstract: We study how to combine a human binary call (a referee's offside or onside decision) with an AI numerical measurement (VAR's estimate of an attacker's position relative to the offside line). We derive an explicit maximum-likelihood rule that determines when the referee's call should stand and when a conflicting VAR measurement should overturn it. Our model treats the true offside margin as fixed and unknown and assumes independent additive Gaussian errors in the human's perception and the AI measurement. When both errors have zero means and known standard deviations $σ_H$ and $σ_{AI}$, respectively, the reversal threshold is $\sqrt{2/π}\,σ^2_{AI}/σ_H$. An onside call is overturned precisely when VAR's measured offside margin exceeds this threshold---not merely because VAR places the attacker beyond the offside line. We also derive the rule when either source has a systematic bias. We prove that the maximum-likelihood estimate of the true margin exists and is unique, while the final binary decision requires only a threshold comparison, without computing that estimate numerically. We illustrate the rule through numerical examples and show how to estimate the error parameters from calibration data. The same analysis applies beyond soccer to binary classification problems in which a human call and an AI measurement satisfy the stated model. This paper is intended for educational purposes: we aim to illustrate how undergraduate students and advanced high school students familiar with basic probability and calculus can investigate research questions in AI and its applications.

</details>


### [682] [ACROSSVAM3.0: Resource-Bounded 4D Scene Construction and Adaptive Surface Association](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11825)
*Nan Wu,Hong Yee Hung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AcrossVAM3.0 是一个离线系统，可将文本、图像或单目 RGB 视频转换为带版本的点表示，在单 GPU 上串行运行冻结组件，并以无神经参数的协调层统一更新相机、点与轨迹；并提出多假设自适应表面链（MHAC）以保留多候选匹配与显式缺失状态，在资源受限条件下提升长程跟踪的 Average Jaccard。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将视频生成、动态重建与单目 SLAM 结合需要坐标一致、对缺失输出的显式处理以及可预测的内存占用。作者还发现严格的跨窗口匹配虽能降低局部表面误差，却会损失长程轨迹覆盖，因此需要一种在匹配可靠性与轨迹连续性之间折中的机制。

Method: 系统层面：构建 AcrossVAM3.0 离线流水线，把冻结的生成/重建/SLAM 组件在单 GPU 上顺序执行，通过不含神经参数的协调层实现统一坐标系与版本化点表示，地图修正时同步更新相机、点与轨迹，并显式管理缺失输出与内存占用。算法层面：提出多假设自适应表面链（MHAC），为每个查询保留多个候选匹配并引入显式 missing 状态，在不相交开发集上完成超参数/策略选择后用于评测。

Result: 三次新输入模式运行的采样任务进程树峰值 GPU 占用最大为 17.14 GB；在冻结的 16 场景视频套件中，全部场景产出 4D 重建，15 个产出非空 SLAM 地图。在冻结的十个视频留出集上，MHAC 相对仅位置基线将 Average Jaccard 提升 0.1394（95% bootstrap 区间 [0.1074, 0.1689]）；在 265 个 RoboTAP 视频上平均配对增益 0.0610（[0.0510, 0.0715]），215 胜、1 平、49 负。

Conclusion: 结果支持在资源受限条件下进行场景构建，并在所测试协议下获得外部跟踪增益；但作者明确指出，该工作不能证明度量尺度、语义身份或高保真新视角渲染能力。

Abstract: Combining video generation, dynamic reconstruction and monocular SLAM requires consistent coordinates, explicit handling of missing outputs and predictable memory use. We present AcrossVAM3.0, an offline system that converts text, images or monocular RGB video into a versioned point representation. Frozen components run sequentially on one GPU; map corrections update cameras, points and trajectories together. The coordination layer adds no neural parameters. Three fresh input-mode runs completed with a maximum sampled task-process-tree GPU footprint of 17.14 GB. In a frozen 16-scene video suite, every scene yielded a 4D reconstruction and 15 yielded a non-empty SLAM map. Strict cross-window matching reduced local surface error but lost long-range track coverage on TAP-Vid-DAVIS. We therefore developed multi-hypothesis adaptive surface chaining (MHAC), which retains several candidate matches and an explicit missing state. After selection on disjoint development data, MHAC improved Average Jaccard over a position-only baseline by 0.1394 on a frozen ten-video holdout (95% bootstrap interval [0.1074,0.1689]). Across 265 RoboTAP videos, the mean paired gain was 0.0610 ([0.0510,0.0715]), with 215 wins, one tie and 49 losses. These results support resource-bounded scene construction and an external tracking gain under the tested protocol. They do not establish metric scale, semantic identity or high-fidelity novel-view rendering.

</details>


### [683] [Correct Answers from Insufficient Histories: A Controlled Study of Agent Memory Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11840)
*Quan Xue,Zerui Yang,Chaorui Zhang,Haolin Ruan,Xueyan Niu,Xuanyu Zheng,Xiyuan Wang,Weixi Zhang,Wei Han,Bo Bai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文用可执行设备日志区分“答案与隐藏参考一致”和“可见上下文足以证明答案”，并设计协议分别评估参考一致性、证据充分性与上下文适配行为；结果显示两个托管读取器在证据不足时仍大量给出隐藏参考答案，且紧凑CSV带来的适配性提升不显著，因此结论是评估诊断而非通用记忆系统收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估可能把“答案碰巧匹配参考”误当成“读取器能从可见历史中合理推导答案”。当完整代理历史可确定答案、但读者可见历史并不充分时，二者存在关键区别；作者希望用可执行设备日志显式检验证据充分性和适当弃答行为。

Method: 提出协议，将参考一致性、经认证的证据充分性和上下文适配行为分开评估。证据不足的判定标准是：存在两条合法历史，其可见上下文逐字节相同但答案不同；公共时间线和查询截止点用于认证充分前缀。随后在80条确认历史上测试Qwen3-32B，并用固定输入的DeepSeek-V4-Flash复现；每个读取器发起1600次请求。另设留出法官研究，并与确定性基线比较。

Result: 在203个证据不足的原始前缀实例中，Qwen3-32B匹配87个隐藏参考，仅7次适当弃答；DeepSeek-V4-Flash匹配85个，弃答21次。紧凑CSV的适当性效应不确定：Qwen为+3.16个百分点，聚类95%区间[0.00,6.57]；DeepSeek为+2.46，[-1.84,6.94]。留出法官研究正确率99.38%，但仍存在支持错误和截断；确定性基线解决所有构造案例。

Conclusion: 结果支持对两个托管读取器配置进行“评估诊断”：模型高分可能反映隐藏参考匹配，而非可见证据充分性或适当弃答能力。该工作不证明通用记忆系统获得收益，也不证明自然语言证据评估能力提升。

Abstract: An answer can match the reference for a complete agent history even when the reader's visible history does not determine it. We study this distinction using executable device logs. Our protocol separates reference agreement, certified evidence sufficiency, and context-appropriate behavior. Insufficiency requires two legal histories yielding byte-identical visible contexts but different answers; public chronology and query cutoffs certify sufficient prefixes. On 80 confirmation histories, Qwen3-32B matches 87 hidden references among 203 insufficient raw-prefix instances, with only seven appropriate abstentions. A fixed-input DeepSeek-V4-Flash replication matches 85 and abstains on 21 of the same 203 instances. Each reader makes 1,600 requests. Compact CSV's estimated appropriateness effects remain inconclusive: +3.16 percentage points, clustered 95% interval [0.00,6.57], for Qwen and +2.46, [-1.84,6.94], for DeepSeek.
